segs.tr: wa laa yuh'ad-ditha naf-sahoo a'n qir-nihee bifraar
segs.en: 25.or suggest to himself to flee his opponent!
26.O God, defeat their enemy through that,

segs.ar: وَاقْلِمْ عَنْهُمْ أَظْفَارَهُمْ، وَفَرِّقْ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ أَسْلِحَتِهِمْ ،
segs.tr: wa aq-lim a'n-hum az'-faarahum- wa far-riq bay-nahum wabay-na as-lih'atihim
segs.en: 27.trim their nails from them, separate them from their weapons,

segs.ar: وَاخْلَعْ وَثَائِقَ أَفْئِدَتِهِمْ، وَبَاعِدْ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ أَزْوِدَتِهِمْ،
segs.tr: wakh-laa' wathaaa-iqa af-idatihim- wa baai'd bay-nahum wabay-na az-widatihim
segs.en: 28.pull out the firm ties from their hearts, keep them far away from their stores,

segs.ar: وَحَيِّرْهُمْ فِي سُبُلِهِمْ، وَضَلِّلْهُمْ عَنْ وَجْهِهِمْ،
segs.tr: wa h'ay-yir-hum fee subulihim- wa z''al-lil-hum a'w-waj-hihim
segs.en: 29.bewilder them in their roads, turn them astray from their direction,

segs.ar: وَاقْـطَعْ عَنْهُمُ الْمَدَدَ وَانْقُصْ مِنْهُمُ الْعَدَدَ،
segs.en: 30.cut off reinforcements from them, chop them down in numbers,

segs.ar: وَامْلاْ أَفْئِدَتَهُمُ الرُّعْبَ، وَاقْبِضْ أَيْـدِيَهُمْ عَنِ البَسْطِ،
segs.en: 31.fill their hearts with terror, hold back their hands from stretching forth,
32.tie back their tongues from speaking,

segs.ar: وَشَرِّدْ بهِمْ مَنْ خَلْفَهُمْ، وَنَكِّلْ بِهِمْ مَنْ وَرَاءَهُمْ،
segs.tr: wa shar-rid bihim man khal-fahum- wa nak-kil bihim maw-waraaa-ahum
segs.en: 33."scatter by them the ones behind them" (8:57), make them a lesson for those beyond them,
34.and through their degradation cut off the hopes of those who come after them!
35.O God, make the wombs of their women barren
36.dry up the loins of their men,
37.cut off the breeding of their mounts and their cattle,

segs.ar: لاَ تَأذَنْ لِسَمَائِهِمْ فِي قَطْر وَلاَ لارْضِهِمْ فِي نَبَات.
segs.tr: laa taa-d'al-lisamaaa-ihim fee qat'-r wa laa liar-z''ihim fee nabaat
segs.en: 38.and permit not their sky to rain or their earth to grow!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَقَوِّ بِذَلِكَ مِحَالَّ أَهْلِ الإسْلاَمِ ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa qaw-wi bid'alika mih'aala ah-lil-is-laam
segs.en: 39.O God, through that strengthen the prowess of the People of Islam,

segs.ar: وَحَصِّنْ بِهِ دِيَارَهُمْ ، وَثَمِّرْ بِـهِ أَمْوَالَهُمْ ،
segs.tr: wa h'as'-s'im-bihee deeaarahum- wa tham-mir biheee am-waalahum
segs.en: 40.fortify their cities, increase their properties,

segs.ar: وَفَرِّغْهُمْ عَنْ مُحَارَبَتِهِمْ لِعِبَادَتِكَ وَعَنْ مُنَابَذَتِهِمْ للْخَلْوَةِ بِكَ،
segs.tr: wa far-righ-hum a'm-muh'aarabatihim lii'baadatika wa a'm-munaabad'atihim lil-khal-wati bika
segs.en: 41.give them ease from their fighting to worship You and from their warfare to be alone with You,

segs.ar: حَتَّى لا يُعْبَدَ فِي بِقَاعِ الارْضِ غَيْرُكَ
segs.tr: h'at-taa laa yua'-bada fee biqaai'l-ar-z''i ghay-ruk
segs.en: 42.so that none will be worshipped in the regions of the earth but You

segs.ar: وَلاَ تُعَفَّرَ لاَِحَد مِنْهُمْ جَبْهَةٌ دُونَكَ.
segs.tr: wa laa tua'f-fara liah'adim-min-hum jab-hatun doonak
segs.en: 43.and no forehead of theirs may be rubbed in dust for less than You!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ اغزُ بِكُلِّ نَـاحِيَـة مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
segs.en: 44.O God, send out the Muslims of every region on raids
45.against the idolaters who face them!
46.Reinforce them with angels in ranks from You,

segs.ar: حَتَّى يَكْشِفُـوهُمْ إلَى مُنْقَطَعِ التُّـرابِ قَتْـلاً فِي أَرْضِكَ
segs.tr: h'at-taa yak-shifoohum ilaa munqat'ai't-turaabi qat-lan feee ar-z''ika
segs.en: 47.till the idolaters are routed by them to the end of the land, slain in Your earth

segs.ar: وَأَسْراً أَوْ يُقِرُّوا بِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ الَّذِي لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ
segs.tr: wa as-raa aw yuqir-roo bin-naka antal-laahool-lad'ee laaa ilaha il-laaa ant
segs.en: 48.or taken captive, or till they admit that You art God, other than whom there is no god,
49.You alone, who hast no associate!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَاعْمُمْ بِذَلِكَ أَعْدَاءَكَ فِي أَقْطَارِ الْبِلاَدِ
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma waa'-mum bid'alika aa'-daaa-aka feee aq-t'aaril-bilaadi
segs.en: 50.O God, include in this Your enemies in the regions of the lands,

segs.ar: مِنَ الْهِنْدِ وَالرُّومِ وَالتُّـرْكِ وَالْخَزَرِ وَالْحَبَشِ
segs.en: 51.the Indians, the Byzantines, the Turks, the Khazars, the Abyssinians,
52.the Nubians, the Zanjis, the Slavs, the Daylamites,

segs.ar: وَسَائِرِ أُمَمِ الشِّرْكِ الَّذِي تَخْفَى أَسْمَاؤُهُمْ وَصِفاتُهُمْ،
segs.tr: wa saaa-iri umamish-shir-kil-lad'eena takh-faaa as-maaa-uhum wa s'ifaatuhum
segs.en: 53.and the rest of the idol-worshipping nations, those whose names and attributes are concealed,

segs.ar: وَقَدْ أَحْصَيْتَهُمْ بِمَعْرِفَتِكَ، وَأَشْرَفْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِقُدْرَتِكَ.
segs.tr: wa qad ah'-s'ay-tahum bimaa'-rifatik wa ash-raf-ta a'lay-him biqud-ratik
segs.en: 54.but whom You countest in Your cognizance and overseest through Your power!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ اشْغَلِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ بِالمُشْرِكِينَ عَنْ تَنَاوُلِ أَطْرَافِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ،
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma ash-ghalil-mush-rikeena bil-mush-rikeena a'n tanaawli at'-raafil-muslimeen
segs.en: 55.O God, distract the idolaters from reaching for the borders of the Muslims through the idolaters,
56.bar them from cutting them down through being cut down,
57.and hold them back from massing together against them through dissension!
58.O God, empty their hearts of security

segs.ar: وَأَبْدَانَهُمْ مِنَ الْقُوَّةِ وَأَذْهِلْ قُلُوبَهُمْ عَنِ الاحْتِيَالِ
segs.tr: wa ab-daanahum mina alqoo-wah wa ad'-hil quloobahum a'nilih'-teeaal
segs.en: 59.and their bodies of strength, distract their hearts from thinking of stratagems,
60.make their limbs too feeble for clashing with men,
61.make them too cowardly for contending with champions,
62.send against them a troop of Your angels

segs.ar: بِبَأس مِنْ بَأْسِكَ كَفِعْلِكَ يَوْمَ بَدْر
segs.en: 63.with some of Your severity as You didst on the Day of Badr,

segs.ar: تَقْطَعُ بِهِ دَابِرَهُمْ وَتَحْصُدُ بِهِ شَوْكَتَهُمْ،
segs.tr: taq-t'au' bihee daabirahum- wa tah'-s'udu bihee shaw-katahum
segs.en: 64.so that through it You mayest cut off their roots, harvest their thorns,
65.and disperse their number!

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَامْزُجْ مِيَاهَهُمْ بِالْوَبَاءِ وَأطْعِمَتَهُمْ بِالأَدْوَاءِ
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wam-zuj meeaahahum bil-wabaaa-i wa at'-i'matahum bil-ad-waaa-i
segs.en: 66.O God, mix their waters with pestilence and their foods with maladies,

segs.ar: وَارْمِ بِلاَدَهُمْ بِالْخُسُوفِ وَأَلِـحَّ عَلَيْهَا بِـالْقُذُوفِ وَافْـرَعْهَا بِالْمُحُولِ.
segs.tr: war-mi bilaadahum bil-khusoof wa alih'-h'a a'lay-haa bil-qud'oof waf-raa'-haa bil-muh'ool
segs.en: 67.hurl down their cities, harass them with peltings, hinder them through drought,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ مِيَرَهُمْ فِي أَحَصِّ أَرْضِكَ وَأَبْعَـدِهَا عَنْهُمْ،
segs.tr: waj-a'l meearahum feee ah'as'-s'i ar-z''ika wa ab-a'dihaa a'n-hum
segs.en: 68.place their supplies in the most ill-omened part of Your earth and the farthest from them,

segs.ar: وَامْنَـعْ حُصُونَهَا مِنْهُمْ، أَصِبْهُمْ بِالْجُوعِ الْمُقِيمِ وَالسُّقْمِ الالِيمِ.
segs.tr: wam-naa' h'us'oonahaa min-hum- as'ib-hum bil-jooi'l-muqeemi was-suq-mil-aleem
segs.en: 69.bar them from its fortresses, and strike them with constant hunger and painful illness!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا غَاز غَزَاهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ مِلَّتِكَ
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa ay-yumaa ghaazin ghazaahum min ah-li mil-latik
segs.en: 70.O God, if a warrior from the people of Your creed wars against them

segs.ar: أَوْ مُجَاهِد جَاهَدَهُمْ مِنْ أَتْبَاعِ سُنَّتِكَ لِيَكُونَ دِينُكَ الاعْلَى
segs.tr: aw mujaahidin jaahadahum min atabaai' sun-natik leeakoona deenukal-aa'-laa
segs.en: 71.or a struggler from the followers of Your prescriptions struggles against them so that Your religion may be the highest,

segs.ar: وَحِزْبُكَ الأقوَى وَحَظُّكَ الأوْفَى فَلَقِّهِ الْيُسْرَ،
segs.en: 72.Your party the strongest, and Your share the fullest, cast ease to him,

segs.tr: wa hay-yi lahul-am-r wa tawal-lahoo bin-nuj-h'
segs.en: 73.arrange his affair, attend to him by granting success,

segs.ar: وَتَخَيَّرْ لَهُ الأصْحَابَ، وَاسْتَقْوِ لَهُ الظَّهْرَ،
segs.en: 74.select for him his companions, strengthen his back,

segs.ar: وَأَسْبِغْ عَلَيْهِ فِي النَّفَقَةِ وَمَتِّعْهُ بِالنَّشَاطِ،
segs.tr: wa as-bigh a'lay-hee fin-nafaqah wa mat-tia'-hoo bin-nashaat'
segs.en: 75.lavish upon him livelihood, give him enjoyment of joyous vitality,

segs.ar: وَأَطْفِ عَنْهُ حَرَارَةَ الشَّوْقِ، وَأَجِرْهُ مِنْ غَمِّ الْوَحْشَةِ،
segs.tr: wat'-fi a'n-hoo h'araaratash-shaw-q wa ajir-hoo min gham-mil-wah'-shah
segs.en: 76.cool for him the heat of yearning, give him sanctuary from the gloom of loneliness,

segs.ar: وَأَنْسِهِ ذِكْرَ الاهْلِ وَالْوَلَدِ وَأَثُرْ لَهُ حُسْنَ النِّيَّةِ وَتَوَلَّه بِالْعَافِيَةِ،
segs.tr: wa ansihee d'ik-ral-ah-li wal-walad wa aaathur lahoo h'us-nan-nee-yah wa tawal-lahoo bil-a'afeeah
segs.en: 77.make him forget the remembrance of wife and child, pass along to him an excellent intention, attend to him with well-being,
78.make safety his companion, release him from cowardice,

segs.ar: وَأَلْهِمْهُ الْجُرْأَةَ وَارْزُقْهُ الشِّدَّةَ وَأَيِّدْهُ بِالنُّصْرَةِ،
segs.tr: wa al-him-hul-jur-ah war-zuq-hush-shid-dah wa ay-yid-hoo bin-nus'-rah
segs.en: 79.inspire him with boldness, provide him with strength, support him with help,

segs.ar: وَعَلِّمْهُ السِّيَرَ وَالسُّنَنَ، وَسَدِّدْهُ فِي الْحُكْمِ،
segs.tr: wa a'l-lim-hus-seeara was-sunan wa sad-did-hoo fil-h'uk-m
segs.en: 80.teach him right conduct and the norms of the Sunna, point him straight in judgement,

segs.ar: وَاعْزِلْ عَنْهُ الرِّياءَ، وخَلِّصْهُ مِنَ السُّمْعَةِ
segs.en: 81.remove from him hypocrisy, purify him from seeking fame,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ فِكْرَهُ وَذِكْرَهُ وَظَعْنَهُ وَإقَامَتَهُ فِيْكَ وَلَكَ،
segs.tr: waj-a'l fik-rahoo wad'ik-rahoo waz'aa'-nahoo waaqaamatahoo feeka wa lak
segs.en: 82.and make his thinking and remembrance, his departing and his staying, be in You and for You!

segs.ar: فَإذا صَافَّ عَدُوَّكَ وَعَدُوَّهُ فَقَلِّلْهُمْ فِي عَيْنِهِ
segs.tr: faad'aa s'aaaf-fa a'doo-waka waa'doo-wahoo faqal-lil-hum fee a'y-nih
segs.en: 83.When he stands in ranks before Your enemy and his enemy, make them few in his eye,
84.diminish their importance in his heart,

segs.ar: وَأَدِلْ لَهُ مِنْهُـمْ وَلاَ تُدِلْهُمْ مِنْهُ
segs.tr: wa adil-lahoo min-hum- wa laa tudil-hum min-h
segs.en: 85.give him a turn to prevail over them, not them a turn to prevail over him!

segs.ar: فَإنْ خَتَمْتَ لَهُ بِالسَّعَادَةِ وَقَضَيْتَ لَهُ بِالشَّهَادَةِ
segs.tr: faan khatam-ta lahoo bis-saa'adati wa qaz''ay-ta lahoo bish-shahaadah
segs.en: 86.But if You sealest him with felicity and decreest for him martyrdom,
87.then let it be after he has exterminated Your enemies by slaying,
88.captivity has afflicted them,
89.the borders of the Muslims are secure,
90.and Your enemy has turned his back in flight!
91.O God, and if a Muslim should

segs.ar: خَلَفَ غَازِياً أَوْ مُرَابِطاً فِي دَارِهِ
segs.tr: khalafa ghaazeean aw muraabit'an fee daarih
segs.en: 92.take the place of a warrior or a soldier in his home,
93.attend to those left behind in his absence,
94.help him with a portion of his property,

segs.ar: أَوْ أَمَدَّهُ بِعِتَاد، أَوْ شَحَذَهُ عَلَى جِهَاد،
segs.tr: aw amad-dahoo bia'taad aw shah'ad'ahoo a'laa jihaad
segs.en: 95.assist him with equipment, hone him for the struggle,
96.send along with him a supplication for his purpose,

segs.ar: أَوْ رَعَى لَهُ مِنْ وَرَآئِهِ حُرْمَةً.
segs.en: 97.or guard his honour in his absence,
98.reward him with the like of his reward

segs.ar: وَزْناً بِوَزْن وَمِثْلاً بِمِثْل وَعَوِّضْهُ مِنْ فِعْلِهِ
segs.tr: waz-nam-biwaz-niw-wa mith-lam-bimith-l wa a'w-wiz''-hoo min fi'-lihee
segs.en: 99.measure for measure, like for like, and recompense him for his act

segs.ar: عِوَضاً حَاضِراً يَتَعَجَّلُ بِهِ نَفْعَ مَا قَدَّمَ،
segs.tr: i'waz''ana h'aaz''iray-yataa'j-jalu bihee naf-a' maa qad-dama
segs.en: 100.with an immediate compensation through which he will hasten to the profit of what he has sent forth

segs.ar: وَسُرُورَ مَا أَتَى به، إلَى أَنْ يَنْتَهِيَ بِهِ الْوَقْتُ
segs.tr: wa suroora maaa ataa biheee ilaaa ay-yantaheea bihil-waq-tu
segs.en: 101.and the joy of what he has given, till the present moment takes him

segs.tr: ilaa maa aj-ray-ta lahoo min faz''-lik
segs.en: 102.to the bounty You hast granted to him
103.and the generosity You hast prepared for him!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا مُسْلِم أَهَمَّهُ أَمْرُ الإِسْلاَمِ
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma wa ay-yumaa mus-limin aham-mahooo am-rul-is-laam
segs.en: 104.O God, and if the affair of Islam should worry a Muslim
105.and the alliance of the idolaters' against Islam should grieve him,
106.so that he has the intention to go to war and is about to enter the struggle,

segs.ar: فَقَعَدَ بِـهِ ضَعْفٌ أَوْ أَبطَأَتْ بِهِ فَاقَةٌ،
segs.tr: faqaa'da bihee z''aa'-f aw ab-t'aat bihee faaqah
segs.en: 107.but frailty keeps him seated, neediness keeps him waiting,
108.a mishap delays him,

segs.ar: أَوْ عَرَضَ لَهُ دُونَ إرَادَتِهِ مَانِعٌ،
segs.tr: aw a'raz''a lahoo doona iraadatihee maania'
segs.en: 109.or an obstruction prevents him from his wish,
110.write his name among the worshipers,
111.make incumbent for him the reward of the strugglers,
112.and place him among the ranks of the martyrs and the righteous!

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ صَـلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ
segs.tr: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madin a'b-dika wa rasoolika
segs.en: 113.O God, bless Muhammad, Your slave and Your messenger,

segs.ar: وَآلِ مُحَمَّد صَلاَةً عَالِيَةً عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ
segs.tr: wa aaali muh'am-madin s'alaatan a'aleeatan a'laas'-s'alawaat
segs.en: 114.and the Household of Muhammad, with a blessing high above all other blessings,
115.towering beyond all other salutations,
116.a blessing whose end is never reached
117.and whose number is never cut off,
118.like the most perfect of Your blessings that has passed
119.to any one of Your friends!
120.You art All-kind, Praiseworthy,
121.the Originator who takes back again,
122.Accomplisher of what You desirest.

S_28.name: 28. In Fleeing to Allah
S_28.nameUr: اللہ کی طرف پناہ لینے کی دعا

segs.en: O God, I have become sincere by cutting myself off for You,
and I have turned toward You with my whole being,

segs.ar: وَصَـرَفْتُ وَجْهِي عَمَّنْ يَحْتَاجُ إلَى رِفْدِكَ،
segs.tr: wa ṣaraftu wajhī ‘amman yaḥtāju ilā rifdik,
segs.en: and I have turned my face away from him who is in need of Your help,

segs.ar: وَقَلَبْتُ مَسْأَلَتِي عَمَّنْ لَمْ يَسْتَغْنِ عَنْ فَضْلِكَ،
segs.tr: wa qalabtu mas’alatī ‘amman lam yastaghnī ‘an faḍlik,
segs.en: and I have directed my request away from him who is not independent of Your favour,

segs.ar: وَرَأَيْتُ أَنَّ طَلَبَ الْمُحْتَاجِ إلَى الْمُحْتَاجِ
segs.tr: wa ra’aytu anna ṭalaba al-muḥtāji ilā al-muḥtāj
segs.en: and I have seen that the request of the needy from the needy

segs.ar: سَفَهٌ مِنْ رَأْيِهِ وَضَلَّةٌ مِنْ عَقْلِهِ،
segs.tr: safahun min ra’yihī wa ḍallatun min ‘aqlih,
segs.en: is foolishness in his opinion and an error in his intellect,
How many times have I seen, O my God,

segs.ar: مِنْ أُنَاسٍ طَلَبُوا الْعِزَّ بِغَيْرِكَ فَذَلُّوا،
segs.tr: min unāsin ṭalabū al-‘izza bi-ghayrika fa-dhallū,
segs.en: people who sought honour from other than You and were humiliated,

segs.tr: wa rāmū ath-tharwata min siwāk fa-iftaqarū,
segs.en: and strove for wealth from other than You and became poor,
and attempted elevation and were brought low!
Thus, through the observation of their likes, a prudent man is confirmed,
whose consideration makes him successful,

segs.tr: wa arshadahū ilā ṭarīqi ṣawābihī ikhtiyāruh.
segs.en: and whose testing guides him to the path of correctness.
So You, O my Master,
are, before every person asked, the object of my request,

segs.ar: وَدُونَ كُلِّ مَطْلُوبٍ إِلَيْهِ وَلِيُّ حَاجَتِي.
segs.tr: wa dūna kulli maṭlūbin ilayhī waliyyu ḥājatī.
segs.en: and before every person sought, the guardian of my need.

segs.ar: اَنتَ الْمَخْصُوصُ قَبْلَ كُلِّ مَدْعُوٍّ بِدَعْوَتِي
segs.en: You are the One singled out before every person prayed to with my supplication.
No one shares with You in my hope,

segs.ar: وَلاَ يَتَّفِقُ أَحَدٌ مَعَكَ فِي دُعَائِي،
segs.tr: wa lā yattafiqu aḥadun ma‘ak fī du‘ā’ī,
segs.en: and no one unites with You in my prayer,

segs.tr: wa lā yanẓimuhū wa iyyāka nidā’ī
segs.en: and my call does not join him and You.
Yours, O my God, is the oneness of number,
and the sovereignty of eternal, absolute power (aṣ-Ṣamad),
and the pre-eminence of ability (al-ḥawl) and strength,
and the degree of exaltation and elevation.
And whoever is other than You is one shown mercy in his life,

segs.ar: مَغْلُوبٌ عَلَى أَمْرِهِ، مَقْهُورٌ عَلَى شَأْنِهِ،
segs.en: overpowered in his affair, subdued in his condition,
differing in circumstances, shifting in attributes.
So You are exalted beyond all likenesses and opposites,
and You are too majestic for parallels and peers,
Glory be to You! There is no god but You.

S_29.name: 29. When Provision was Scarce
S_29.nameUr: تنگیِ رزق کے وقت کی دعا

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ ابْتَلَيْتَنَا فِي أَرْزَاقِنَا بِسُوءِ الظَّنِّ
segs.tr: Allāhumma innaka ibtalaytanā fī arzāqinā bi-sū’i aẓ-ẓann
segs.en: O God, You have afflicted us concerning our provisions with ill opinion,
and concerning our terms of life with prolonged expectation,

segs.ar: حَتَّى الْتَمَسْنَا أَرْزَاقَكَ مِنْ عِنْدِ الْمَرْزُوقِينَ،
segs.en: until we sought Your provisions from those who are provided for,

segs.tr: wa ṭami‘nā bi-āmālinā fī a‘māri al-mu‘ammarīn.
segs.en: and we yearned, through our expectations, for the lives of those whose lives are prolonged.
So bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَهَبْ لَنَا يَقِيناً صَادِقاً تَكْفِينا بِهِ مِنْ مَؤونَةِ الطَّلَبِ،
segs.tr: wa hab lanā yaqīnan ṣādiqan takfīnā bihī min ma’ūnati aṭ-ṭalab,
segs.en: and grant us true certainty through which You suffice us from the burden of seeking,

segs.ar: وَأَلْهِمْنَا ثِقَةً خَالِصَةً تُعْفِينَا بِهَا مِنْ شِدَّةِ النَّصَبِ،
segs.tr: wa alhimnā thiqatan khāliṣatan tu‘fīnā bihā min shiddati an-naṣab,
segs.en: and inspire us with sincere trust through which You spare us the hardship of toil,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ مَا صَرَّحتَ بِهِ مِنْ عِدَتِكَ فِي وَحْيِكَ،
segs.tr: wa ij‘al mā ṣarraḥta bihī min ‘idatika fī waḥyik,
segs.en: and make what You have plainly declared of Your promise in Your revelation,

segs.tr: wa atba‘tahu min qasamika fī kitābik
segs.en: and what You followed it with of Your oath in Your Book,

segs.ar: قَاطِعاً لاهْتِمَامِنَا بِالرِّزْقِ الَّـذِيْ تَكَفَّلْتَ بِهِ
segs.tr: qāṭi‘an li-ihtimāminā bi-ar-rizq alladhī takaffalta bih
segs.en: a severance for our concern with the provision which You guaranteed,

segs.ar: وَحَسْمَاً لِلاشْتِغَالِ بِمَا ضَمِنْتَ الْكِفَايَةَ لَهُ،
segs.tr: wa ḥasman li-al-ishtighāl bi-mā ḍaminta al-kifāyah lah,
segs.en: and a decisive end to preoccupation with what You secured sufficiency for,
for You have said—and Your saying is the truest truth—

segs.tr: wa aqsamta wa qasamuka al-abarru al-awfā:
segs.en: and You have sworn—and Your oath is the most righteous, the most perfect:

segs.tr: (Wa fī as-samā’i rizqukum wa mā tū‘adūn)
segs.en: ("And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised") [Qur'an 51:22]

segs.ar: ثُمَّ قُلْتَ: ( فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ إنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِثْلَ مَا أَنَّكُمْ تَنْطِقُوْنَ ).
segs.tr: Thumma qulta: (Fa-wa-rabbi as-samā’i wa al-arḍi innahū la-ḥaqqun mithla mā annakum tanṭiqūn).
segs.en: Then You said: ("Then, by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, indeed, it is the truth, just as you speak.") [Qur'an 51:23]
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segs.ar: وَهَبْ لِيَ الْعَافِيَةَ مِنْ دَيْن تُخْلِقُ بِهِ وَجْهِي،
segs.tr: wa hab liya al-‘āfiyata min daynin tukhliqu bihī wajhī,
segs.en: and grant me well-being from a debt by which my face is worn out,

segs.ar: وَيَحَارُ فِيهِ ذِهْنِي، وَيَتَشَعَّبُ لَهُ فِكْرِي،
segs.tr: wa yaḥāru fīhi dhihnī, wa yatasha‘‘abu lahū fikrī,
segs.en: and my mind is confused therein, and my thought is scattered for it,
and my preoccupation with practicing it is prolonged.

segs.ar: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ يَا رَبِّ مِنْ هَمِّ الدَّيْنِ وَفِكْرِهِ،
segs.tr: wa a‘ūdhu bika yā Rabbi min hammi ad-dayn wa fikrih,
segs.en: And I seek refuge in You, O Lord, from the worry of debt and its contemplation,
and the preoccupation of debt and its sleeplessness.

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْهُ.
segs.tr: Fa-ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammadin wa ālihī wa a‘idhnī minh.
segs.en: So bless Muhammad and his Household, and protect me from it.

segs.ar: وَأَسْتَجيرُ بِكَ يَا رَبِّ مِنْ ذِلَّتِهِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ
segs.tr: wa astajīru bika yā Rabbi min dhillatihī fī al-ḥayāh
segs.en: And I seek Your aid, O Lord, from its humiliation in life
and from its consequence after death.

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَجِرْنِي مِنْهُ
segs.tr: Fa-ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammadin wa ālihī wa ajirnī minh
segs.en: So bless Muhammad and his Household, and shelter me from it
with an overflowing sufficiency or an adequate subsistence that reaches.
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
and veil me from extravagance and increase,
and make me upright with generosity and moderation,
and teach me good estimation,
and restrain me with Your kindness from wastefulness,

segs.tr: wa ajri min asbābi al-ḥalāl arzāqī,
segs.en: and let my provisions flow from lawful means,

segs.tr: wa wajjih fī abwābi al-birr infāqī,
segs.en: and direct my spending in the ways of devotion,

segs.ar: وَازْوِ عَنِّي مِنَ الْمَالِ مَا يُحْدِثُ لِي مَخِيلَةً
segs.tr: wa izwi ‘annī mina al-māl mā yuḥdithu lī makhīlah
segs.en: and ward off from me of wealth whatever might generate vanity for me,

segs.ar: أَوْ تَأَدِّياً إلَى بَغْي، أَوْ مَا أَتَعَقَّبُ مِنْهُ طُغْيَـاناً.
segs.tr: aw ta’addiyan ilā baghy, aw mā ata‘aqqabu minhu ṭughyānā.
segs.en: or lead to transgression, or whatever I might inherit from it of tyranny.
O God, make the company of the poor beloved to me,
and help me to keep their company with excellent patience,

segs.ar: وَمَـا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّي مِنْ مَتَاعِ الدُّنْيَاالفَانِيَةِ
segs.tr: wa mā zawayta ‘annī min matā‘i ad-dunyā al-fāniyah
segs.en: and what You have withheld from me of the enjoyment of this fleeting world,
then store it for me in Your everlasting treasuries,

segs.tr: wa ij‘al mā khawwaltanī min ḥuṭāmihā,
segs.en: and make what You have granted me of its fragments,

segs.ar: وَعَجَّلْتَ لِي مِنْ مَتَاعِهَا بُلْغَةً إلَى جِوَارِكَ،
segs.tr: wa ‘ajjalta lī min matā‘ihā bulghatan ilā jiwārik,
segs.en: and hastened to me of its enjoyment, a means to reach Your proximity,

segs.ar: وَوُصْلَةً إلَى قُرْبِكَ، وَذَرِيعَةً إلَى جَنَّتِكَ
segs.tr: wa wuṣlatan ilā qurbik, wa dharī‘atan ilā jannatik
segs.en: and a connection to Your nearness, and a way to Your Paradise,
Surely You are the Possessor of the immense Favor,
and You are the Munificent, the Generous.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ لا يَصِفُهُ نَعْتُ الْوَاصِفِينَ ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma yā man lā yaṣifuhū na‘tu al-wāṣifīn,
segs.en: O God, O He Whom the description of the describers does not encompass,

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يُجَاوِزُهُ رَجَاءُ الرَّاجِينَ ،
segs.tr: wa yā man lā yujāwizuhū rajā’u ar-rājīn,
segs.en: O He Whom the hope of the hopeful does not pass by,

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يَضِيعُ لَدَيْهِ أَجْرُ الْمُحْسِنِينَ،
segs.tr: wa yā man lā yaḍī‘u ladayhī ajru al-muḥsinīn,
segs.en: O He with Whom the reward of the good-doers is not lost,

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ هُوَ مُنْتَهَى خَوْفِ الْعَابِدِيْنَ،
segs.tr: wa yā man huwa muntahā khawfi al-‘ābidīn,
segs.en: O He Who is the utmost limit of the fear of the worshippers,

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ هُوَ غَايَةُ خَشْيَةِ الْمُتَّقِينَ.
segs.tr: wa yā man huwa ghāyatu khashyati al-muttaqīn.
segs.en: O He Who is the goal of the reverence of the God-fearing.

segs.ar: هَذا مَقَامُ مَنْ تَدَاوَلَتْهُ أَيْدِي الذُّنُوبِ ،
segs.tr: Hadhā maqāmu man tadāwalathu aydī adh-dhunūb,
segs.en: This is the station of him whom the hands of sins have exchanged,
and the reins of errors have led,
and Satan has overcome;
so he fell short in what You commanded by negligence,
and he committed what You forbade by delusion,
like him who is ignorant of Your power over him,
or like him who denies the favour of Your kindness to him.

segs.ar: حَتَّى إذَا انْفَتَحَ لَهُ بَصَرُ الْهُدَى،
segs.tr: Ḥattā idhā infataḥa lahū baṣaru al-hudā,
segs.en: Until when the sight of guidance opened to him,

segs.ar: وَتَقَشَّعَتْ عَنْهُ سَحَائِبُ الْعَمَى أَحْصَى مَا ظَلَمَ بِهِ نَفْسَهُ،
segs.tr: wa taqashsha‘at ‘anhu saḥā’ibu al-‘amā aḥṣā mā ẓalama bihī nafsah,
segs.en: and the clouds of blindness cleared from him, he counted what he had wronged his soul with,

segs.tr: wa fakkara fīmā khālafā bihī Rabbah,
segs.en: and he reflected upon what he had opposed his Lord with.

segs.ar: فَرَأى كَبِيْرَ عِصْيَانِهِ كَبِيْراً، وَجَلِيل مُخَالَفَتِهِ جَلِيْلاً،
segs.tr: Fa-ra’ā kabīra ‘iṣyānihī kabīrā, wa jalīla mukhālafatihī jalīlā,
segs.en: So he saw the enormity of his disobedience as immense, and the greatness of his opposition as great.

segs.ar: فَأَقْبَلَ نَحْوَكَ مُؤَمِّلاً لَكَ، مُسْتَحْيِيَاً مِنْكَ،
segs.tr: Fa-aqbala naḥwaka mu’ammilan lak, mustaḥyiyan mink,
segs.en: So he turned toward You, hopeful of You, ashamed before You,

segs.tr: wa wajjaha raghbatuhū ilayka thiqatan bik,
segs.en: and directed his desire toward You, trusting in You.

segs.ar: فَأَمَّكَ بِطَمَعِهِ يَقِيناً، وَقَصَدَكَ بِخَوْفِهِ إخْلاَصَاً،
segs.tr: Fa-ammakā bi-ṭama‘ihī yaqīnā, wa qaṣadaka bi-khawfihī ikhlāṣā,
segs.en: So he aimed at You with his greed, having certainty, and intended You with his fear, having sincerity.

segs.ar: قَدْ خَلاَ طَمَعُهُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَطْمُوع فِيهِ غَيْرِكَ،
segs.tr: Qad khalā ṭama‘uhū min kulli maṭmū‘in fīhi ghayrik,
segs.en: His greed has become devoid of every object of greed other than You,

segs.ar: وَأَفْرَخَ رَوْعُهُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَحْذُور مِنْهُ سِوَاكَ،
segs.tr: wa afrakha raw‘uhū min kulli maḥdhūrin minhu siwāk,
segs.en: and his terror has settled from every object of dread other than You.
So he stood before You, imploring,

segs.tr: wa ghammaḍa baṣarahū ilā al-arḍi mutakhashshi‘an,
segs.en: and lowered his gaze to the ground, humble,
and bowed his head low to Your Might, submissive,

segs.ar: وَأَبَثَّكَ مِنْ سِرِّهِ مَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنْهُ خَضُوعاً،
segs.tr: wa abaththaka min sirrihī mā anta a‘lamu bihī minhu khuḍū‘ā,
segs.en: and scattered before You of his secret what You know better than him, in surrender,

segs.ar: وَعَدَّدَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِهِ مَا أَنْتَ أَحْصَى لَهَا خُشُوعاً
segs.tr: wa ‘addada min dhunūbihī mā anta aḥṣā lahā khushū‘ā
segs.en: and enumerated of his sins what You have counted more exactly, in awe,

segs.ar: وَاسْتَغَاثَ بِكَ مِنْ عَظِيمِ مَاوَقَعَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِكَ
segs.tr: wa istaghātha bika min ‘aẓīmi mā waqa‘a bihī fī ‘ilmika
segs.en: and sought succour in You from the immensity of what has come to pass through him in Your knowledge,

segs.tr: wa qabīḥi mā faḍaḥahū fī ḥukmik
segs.en: and the ugliness of what has disgraced him in Your judgment,
of sins whose pleasures have passed and gone,
but whose consequences remain and have become incumbent.

segs.ar: لا يُنْكِرُ يَا إلهِي عَدْلَكَ إِنْ عَاقَبْتَهُ،
segs.en: He does not deny, O my God, Your justice if You punish him,

segs.ar: وَلا يَسْتَعْظِمُ عَفْوَكَ إِنْ عَفَوْتَ عَنْهُ وَرَحِمْتَهُ;
segs.tr: wa lā yasta‘ẓimu ‘afwaka in ‘afawta ‘anhu wa raḥimtah;
segs.en: nor does he consider Your pardon great if You pardon him and have mercy on him;
because You are the Noble Lord

segs.ar: الَّذِي لا يَتَعَاظَمُهُ غُفْرَانُ الذَّنْبِ الْعَظِيم.
segs.tr: alladhī lā yata‘āẓamuhū ghufrānu adh-dhambi al-‘aẓīm.
segs.en: Whom the forgiveness of the tremendous sin does not overwhelm.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ فَهَا أَنَا ذَا قَدْ جِئْتُكَ مُطِيعاً
segs.tr: Allāhumma fa-hā anā dhā qad ji’tuka muṭī‘an
segs.en: O God, behold, here I am, I have come to You obedient

segs.ar: لِأَمْرِكَ فِيمَا أَمَرْتَ بِهِ مِنَ الدُّعَاءِ،
segs.tr: li-amrika fīmā amarta bihī min ad-du‘ā’,
segs.en: to Your command in what You commanded of supplication,

segs.ar: مُتَنَجِّزاً وَعْدَكَ فِيمَا وَعَدْتَ بِهِ مِنَ الإجَابَةِ إِذْ تَقُولُ
segs.tr: mutanajjizan wa‘daka fīmā wa‘adta bihī min al-ijābah idh taqūl:
segs.en: fulfilling Your promise in what You promised of answer when You say:
("Call upon Me; I will respond to you.") [Qur'an 40:60]
O God, so bless Muhammad and his Household

segs.tr: wa alqinī bi-maghfiratika kamā laqītuka bi-iqrārī
segs.en: and encounter me with Your forgiveness as I have encountered You with my confession,

segs.ar: وَارْفَعْنِي عَنْ مَصَارِعِ الذُّنُوبِ كَمَا وَضَعْتُ لَكَ نَفْسِي
segs.tr: wa irfa‘nī ‘an maṣāri‘i adh-dhunūb kamā waḍa‘tu lakā nafsī
segs.en: and raise me up from the downfalls of sins as I have humbled myself before You,

segs.ar: وَاسْتُرْنِي بِسِتْرِكَ كَمَا تَأَنَّيْتَنِي عَنِ الانْتِقَامِ مِنِّي.
segs.tr: wa usturnī bi-sitrika kamā ta’annaytanī ‘ani al-intiqām minnī.
segs.en: and cover me with Your covering as You have been deliberate in taking vengeance against me.

segs.tr: Allāhumma wa thabbit fī ṭā‘atika niyyatī,
segs.en: O God, and establish my intention in Your obedience,
and confirm my insight in Your worship,
and grant me success in works

segs.ar: لِمَا تَغْسِلُ بِهِ دَنَسَ الخَطَايَا عَنِّي،
segs.en: by which You may wash the dirt of errors from me,

segs.tr: wa tawaffanī ‘alā millatika wa millati nabiyyik
segs.en: and make me die on Your creed and the creed of Your Prophet
Muḥammad, peace be upon him, when You make me die.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَتُوبُ إلَيْـكَ فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا
segs.tr: Allāhumma innī atūbu ilayka fī maqāmī hādhā
segs.en: O God, I repent to You in this station of mine
from the major sins of mine and the minor,
and the hidden evil acts of mine and the manifest,
and the past slips of mine and the recent,

segs.ar: تَوْبَةَ مَنْ لا يُحَدِّثُ نَفْسَهُ بِمَعْصِيَةٍ
segs.tr: tawbata man lā yuḥaddithu nafsahū bi-ma‘ṣiyah
segs.en: the repentance of one who does not talk to himself of an act of disobedience

segs.ar: وَلاَ يُضْمِرُ أَنْ يَعُودَ فِي خَطِيئَةٍ،
segs.tr: wa lā yuḍmiru an ya‘ūda fī khaṭī’ah,
segs.en: and does not hide the intention to return to an error.

segs.ar: وَقَدْ قُلْتَ يَا إلهِي فِي مُحْكَمِ كِتابِكَ
segs.tr: wa qad qulta yā Ilāhī fī muḥkami kitābika
segs.en: For You have said, O my God, in the firm text of Your Book,
that You accept the repentance of Your servants,

segs.tr: wa ta‘fū ‘ani as-sayyi’āt, wa tuḥibbu at-tawwābīn,
segs.en: and pardon evil deeds, and love the repenters.

segs.ar: فَاقْبَلْ تَوْبَتِي كَمَا وَعَدْتَ وَأعْفُ عَنْ سَيِّئاتِي كَمَا ضَمِنْتَ،
segs.tr: Fa-iqbal tawbatī kamā wa‘adta wa u‘fu ‘an sayyi’ātī kamā ḍaminta,
segs.en: So accept my repentance as You promised, and pardon my evil deeds as You guaranteed,

segs.tr: wa awjib lī maḥabbatika kamā sharaṭt,
segs.en: and make Your love incumbent upon me as You stipulated,

segs.ar: وَلَـكَ يَـا رَبِّ شَـرْطِي أَلاّ أَعُودَ فِي مَكْرُوهِكَ،
segs.tr: wa lakā yā Rabbi sharṭī allā a‘ūda fī makrūhik,
segs.en: And Yours, O Lord, is my stipulation that I will not return to what You dislike,

segs.tr: wa ḍamānī allā arji‘a fī madhmūmik,
segs.en: and my guarantee that I will not revert to what You blame,
and my covenant that I will abandon all acts of disobedience to You.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا عَمِلْتُ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا عَلِمْتَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma innaka a‘lamu bi-mā ‘amiltu fa-ighfir lī mā ‘alimt,
segs.en: O God, surely You know better what I have done, so forgive me what You know,

segs.tr: wa iṣrifnī bi-qudratika ilā mā aḥbabt.
segs.en: and divert me by Your power to what You love.
O God, and incumbent upon me are consequences that I have guarded,
and consequences that I have forgotten,

segs.tr: wa kulluhunna bi-‘aynika allatī lā tanām,
segs.en: and all of them are in Your eye that does not sleep,
and Your knowledge that does not forget;

segs.ar: فَعَوِّضْ مِنْهَا أَهْلَهَا وَاحْطُطْ عَنّي وِزْرَهَا،
segs.en: so compensate their owners for them, and put down their burden from me,

segs.ar: وَخَفِّفْ عَنِّي ثِقْلَهَا، وَاعْصِمْنِي مِنْ أَنْ اُقَارِفَ مِثْلَهَا.
segs.tr: wa khaffif ‘annī thiqlahā, wa i‘ṣimnī min an uqārifa mithlahā.
segs.en: and lighten their weight from me, and protect me from committing their like.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ وَإنَّهُ لاَ وَفَاءَ لِي بِالتَّوْبَةِ إلاَّ بِعِصْمَتِكَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa innahū lā wafā’a lī bi-at-tawbati illā bi-‘iṣmatik,
segs.en: O God, surely there is no fulfillment for me in repentance save by Your protection,

segs.ar: وَلا اسْتِمْسَاكَ بِي عَنِ الْخَطَايَا إلاَّ عَنْ قُوَّتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa lā istimsāka bī ‘ani al-khaṭāyā illā ‘an quwwatik,
segs.en: and no holding back for me from errors save by Your strength,

segs.ar: فَقَوِّنِي بِقُوَّة كَافِيَة، وَتَوَلَّنِي بِعِصْمَة مَانِعَة.
segs.tr: fa-qawwinī bi-quwwatin kāfiyah, wa tawallanī bi-‘iṣmatin māni‘ah.
segs.en: so strengthen me with a sufficient power, and assume authority over me with a preventive protection.
O God, any servant who repents to You,

segs.ar: وَهُوَ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ فَاسِخٌ لِتَوْبَتِهِ
segs.tr: wa huwa fī ‘ilmi al-ghayb ‘indak fāsikhun li-tawbatih
segs.en: while in the knowledge of the unseen with You he is one who will break his repentance
and return to his sin and his error—

segs.ar: فَإنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أنْ أَكُوْنَ كَذلِكَ،
segs.tr: fa-innī a‘ūdhu bika an akūna kadhālik,
segs.en: surely I seek refuge in You from being like that.

segs.ar: فَاجْعَلْ تَوْبَتِي هَذِهِ تَوْبَةً لا أَحْتَاجُ بَعْدَهَا إلَى تَوْبَة،
segs.tr: Fa-ij‘al tawbatī hādhihī tawbatan lā aḥtāju ba‘dahā ilā tawbah,
segs.en: So make this repentance of mine a repentance after which I will not need a repentance,

segs.ar: تَوْبَةً مُوجِبَةً لِمَحْوِ مَا سَلَفَ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ فِيمَـا بَقِيَ.
segs.tr: tawbatan mūjibatan li-maḥwi mā salaf, wa as-salāmah fīmā baqī.
segs.en: a repentance that necessitates the wiping out of what has passed, and safety in what remains.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَعْتَـذِرُ إلَيْـكَ مِنْ جَهْلِي،
segs.tr: Allāhumma innī a‘tadhiru ilayka min jahlī,
segs.en: O God, I apologize to You for my ignorance,
and I ask You for a gift to cover my evil deed,
so join me to the protection of Your mercy out of bounty,
and cover me with the covering of Your well-being out of grace.
O God, I repent to You
from everything that opposes Your Will,
or turns away from Your Love,
whether it be from the thoughts of my heart,
and the glances of my eye,
and the narrations of my tongue,

segs.ar: تَوْبَةً تَسْلَمُ بِهَا كُلُّ جَارِحَة عَلَى حِيَالِهَا مِنْ تَبِعَاتِكَ،
segs.tr: tawbatan taslamu bihā kullu jāriḥatin ‘alā ḥiyālihā min tabi‘ātik,
segs.en: a repentance by which every limb, singly, is preserved from Your consequences,

segs.ar: وَتَأْمَنُ مِمَّا يَخَافُ الْمُعْتَدُونَ مِنْ أَلِيْمِ سَطَوَاتِكَ.
segs.tr: wa ta’manu mimmā yakhāfu al-mu‘tadūn min alīm saṭawātik.
segs.en: and is safe from what the transgressors fear of Your painful assaults.
O God, then have mercy on my solitude before You,
and the throbbing of my heart from Your reverence,
and the trembling of my limbs from Your awe.

segs.ar: فَقَدْ أَقَامَتْنِي يَا رَبِّ ذُنُوبِي مَقَامَ الْخِزْيِ بِفِنَائِكَ،
segs.tr: Fa-qad aqāmatnī yā Rabbi dhunūbī maqām al-khizy bi-finā’ik,
segs.en: For surely, O Lord, my sins have made me stand in the station of ignominy at Your door,

segs.ar: فَإِنْ سَكَتُّ لَمْ يَنْطِقْ عَنِّي أَحَدٌ،
segs.en: so if I am silent, no one will speak on my behalf,

segs.tr: wa in shafa‘tu fa-lastu bi-ahli ash-shafā‘ah.
segs.en: and if I intercede, I am not worthy of intercession.
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
and make Your Generosity an intercessor for my errors,
and revert to my evil deeds with Your pardon,
and do not repay me my full recompense with Your punishment,

segs.tr: wa ubṣuṭ ‘alayya ṭawlak wa jallilnī bi-sitrik,
segs.en: and spread over me Your favor and cover me with Your covering,

segs.ar: وَافْعَلْ بِي فِعْلَ عَزِيزٍ تَضَرَّعَ إلَيْهِ عَبْدٌ ذَلِيلٌ فَرَحِمَهُ،
segs.tr: wa if‘al bī fi‘la ‘azīzin taḍarra‘a ilayhi ‘abdun dhalīlun fa-raḥimah,
segs.en: and deal with me with the dealing of a Mighty One to whom a lowly servant implored and he had mercy on him,

segs.ar: أَوْ غَنِيٍّ تَعَرَّضَ لَهُ عَبْدٌ فَقِيرٌ فَنَعَشَهُ.
segs.tr: aw ghaniyyin ta‘arraḍa lahū ‘abdun faqīrun fa-na‘ashah.
segs.en: or a Rich One to whom a poor servant exposed himself and he revived him.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ لاَ خَفِيرَ لِي مِنْكَ فَلْيَخْفُرْنِيْ عِزُّكَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma lā khafīra lī minka fa-līakhfurnī ‘izzuk,
segs.en: O God, there is no one who can grant me protection from You, so let Your Might protect me,

segs.ar: وَلا شَفِيعَ لِيْ إلَيْكَ فَلْيَشْفَعْ لِي فَضْلُكَ،
segs.tr: wa lā shafī‘a lī ilayka fa-līashfa‘ lī faḍluk,
segs.en: and no intercessor for me before You, so let Your Favor intercede for me,
and my errors have frightened me, so let Your Pardon grant me security.

segs.ar: فَمَا كُلُّ مَا نَطَقْتُ بِهِ عَنْ جَهْلٍ مِنِّي بِسُوْءِ أَثَرِي،
segs.tr: Fa-mā kullu mā naṭaqtu bihī ‘an jahl minnī bi-sū’i atharī,
segs.en: For not all that I have spoken is from my ignorance of the evil effect of my deeds,

segs.ar: وَلاَ نِسيَانٍ لِمَا سَبَقَ مِنْ ذَمِيمِ فِعْلِي،
segs.tr: wa lā nisyān li-mā sabaqa min dhamīm fi‘lī,
segs.en: nor forgetfulness of what has preceded of my blameworthy action,

segs.tr: wa lākin li-tasma‘a samā’uka wa man fīhā,
segs.en: but so that Your Heaven and whoever is in it may hear,

segs.ar: وَأَرْضُكَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا مَا أَظْهَرْتُ لَكَ مِنَ النَّدَمِ،
segs.tr: wa arḍuka wa man ‘alayhā mā aẓhartu lakā mina an-nadam,
segs.en: and Your Earth and whoever is upon it may hear what I have revealed to You of remorse,

segs.tr: wa laja’tu ilayka fīhī mina at-tawbah,
segs.en: and what I have taken refuge in You for, of repentance,

segs.ar: فَلَعَـلَّ بَعْضَهُمْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَرْحَمُنِي لِسُوءِ مَوْقِفِي،
segs.tr: fa-la‘alla ba‘ḍahum bi-raḥmatika yarḥamunī li-sū’i mawqifī,
segs.en: so that perhaps some of them, through Your mercy, may have mercy on me because of my evil stance,

segs.ar: أَوْ تُدْرِكُهُ الرِّقَّةُ عَلَىَّ لِسُوءِ حَالِي
segs.en: or a softness may overtake them toward me because of my evil state,

segs.ar: فَيَنَالَنِي مِنْهُ بِدَعْوَةٍ أَسْمَعُ لَدَيْكَ مِنْ دُعَائِي،
segs.tr: fa-yanālanī minhu bi-da‘watin asma‘u ladayka min du‘ā’ī,
segs.en: and so I may gain from them a prayer more heard with You than my prayer,

segs.ar: أَوْ شَفَاعَـةٍ أَوْكَدُ عِنْدَكَ مِنْ شَفَاعَتِي
segs.en: or an intercession more certain with You than my intercession,

segs.ar: تَكُونُ بِهَا نَجَاتِي مِنْ غَضَبِكَ وَفَوْزَتِي بِرِضَاكَ.
segs.tr: takūnu bihā najātī min ghaḍabika wa fawzatī bi-riḍāk.
segs.en: by which will be my deliverance from Your wrath and my triumph with Your pleasure.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ يَكُنِ النَّدَمُ تَوْبَةً إِلَيْكَ فَأَنَا أَنْدَمُ اْلنَّادِمِينَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma in yakuni an-nadamu tawbatan ilayka fa-anā andamu an-nādimīn,
segs.en: O God, if remorse is repentance to You, then I am the most remorseful of the remorseful,

segs.ar: وَإِنْ يَكُنِ التَّرْكُ لِمَعْصِيَتِكَ إِنَابَةً فَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُنِيبينَ،
segs.tr: wa in yakuni at-tarku li-ma‘ṣiyatika inābatan fa-anā awwalu al-munībīn,
segs.en: and if the forsaking of disobedience to You is turning back, then I am the first of those who turn back,

segs.ar: وَإِنْ يَكُنِ الاسْتِغْفَارُ حِطَّةً لِلذُّنُوبِ فَإِنَي لَكَ مِنَ الْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ.
segs.tr: wa in yakuni al-istighfāru ḥiṭṭatan li-adh-dhunūbi fa-innī laka mina al-mustaghfirīn.
segs.en: and if seeking forgiveness is a remission of sins, then I am among those who seek forgiveness before You.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا أَمَرْتَ بِالتَّوْبَةِ وَضَمِنْتَ الْقَبُولَ
segs.tr: Allāhumma fa-kamā amarta bi-at-tawbah wa ḍaminta al-qabūl
segs.en: O God, just as You commanded repentance and guaranteed acceptance,

segs.tr: wa ḥathathta ‘alā ad-du‘ā’ wa wa‘adta al-ijābah,
segs.en: and urged to supplication and promised response,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدِ وَآلِهِ وَاقْبَلْ تَوْبَتِي
segs.tr: fa-ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa ālihī wa iqbal tawbatī
segs.en: so bless Muhammad and his Household, and accept my repentance,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَرْجِعْني مَرجَعَ الخَيبَةِ منْ رَحْمَتِك
segs.tr: wa lā tarji‘nī marja‘a al-khaybah min raḥmatik
segs.en: and do not return me to the place of disappointment from Your mercy.
Surely You are the Relenting One toward the sinners,
and the Merciful to the erring ones who turn back.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ كَمَا هَدَيْتَنَا بِهِ
segs.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa ālihī kamā hadaytanā bih
segs.en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, just as You guided us through him,

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ كَمَا اسْتَنْقَذْتَنَا بِهِ،
segs.tr: wa ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa ālihī kamā istanqadhtanā bih,
segs.en: and bless Muhammad and his Household, just as You rescued us through him,
and bless Muhammad and his Household

segs.ar: صَلاَةً تَشْفَعُ لَنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَيَوْمَ الْفَاقَةِ إلَيْكَ،
segs.tr: ṣalātan tashfa‘u lanā yawm al-qiyāmah wa yawm al-fāqah ilayk,
segs.en: with a blessing that intercedes for us on the Day of Resurrection and the Day of our utter need for You.

segs.ar: إنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْكَ يَسِيرٌ .
segs.tr: innaka ‘alā kulli shay’in qadīr wa huwa ‘alayka yasīr.
segs.en: Surely You are powerful over everything, and that is easy for You.

S_32.name: 32. After the Night Prayer
S_32.nameUr: نمازِ شب کے بعد کی دعا

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ يَا ذَا الْمُلْكِ الْمُتأبِّدِ بِالْخُلُودِ وَالْسُلْطَانِ
segs.tr: Allāhumma yā dhā al-mulki al-muta’abbidi bi-al-khulūd wa aṣ-ṣulṭān,
segs.en: O God, O Possessor of the everlasting kingdom through eternity and dominion,

segs.tr: al-mumtani‘i bi-ghayri junūd wa lā a‘wān,
segs.en: the Unassailable without armies or helpers,
and the Enduring Might throughout the passing of ages,

segs.tr: wa khawālī al-a‘wām, wa mawāḍī al-azmān wa al-ayyām,
segs.en: the long-passed years, and the elapsed times and days!

segs.ar: عَزَّ سُلْطَانُكَ عِزّاً لا حَدَّ لَهُ بِأَوَّلِيَّةٍ وَلاَ مُنْتَهَى لَهُ بِآخِرِيَّةٍ،
segs.tr: ‘azza sulṭānuka ‘izzan lā ḥadda lahū bi-awwaliyyah wa lā muntahā lahū bi-ākhiriyyah,
segs.en: Your dominion is Mighty with a Might that has no limit in beginning and no end in finality,

segs.ar: وَاسْتَعْلَى مُلْكُكَ عُلُوّاً سَقَطَتِ الأشْيَاءُ دُونَ بُلُوغِ أَمَدِهِ
segs.tr: wa ista‘lā mulkuka ‘uluwwan saqaṭati al-ashyā’u dūna bulūghi amadih,
segs.en: and Your kingdom is exalted with an Exaltation below the attainment of whose term all things fall short,

segs.ar: وَلاَ يَبْلُغُ أَدْنَى مَا اسْتَأثَرْتَ بِـهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ أَقْصَى نَعْتِ النَّـاعِتِينَ.
segs.tr: wa lā yablughu adnā mā ista’tharta bihī min dhālika aqṣā na‘ti an-nā‘itīn.
segs.en: and the utmost description of the describers does not reach the least of what You have singled out for Yourself of that.

segs.ar: ضَلَّتْ فِيْـكَ الصِّفَاتُ وَتَفَسْخَتْ دُونَكَ النُّعُوتُ
segs.tr: Ḍallat fīka aṣ-ṣifātu wa tafassakhat dūnakā an-nu‘ūt,
segs.en: The attributes have been lost concerning You, and the descriptions have been dissolved below You,

segs.tr: wa ḥārat fī kibriyā’ika laṭā’ifu al-awhām,
segs.en: and the subtleties of imaginings are bewildered in Your Grandeur.

segs.ar: كَذلِكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ الأَوَّلُ فِي أَوَّلِيَّتِكَ،
segs.tr: Kadhālika anta Allāhu al-Awwalu fī awwaliyyatik,
segs.en: Thus are You, God, the First in Your primordiality,

segs.ar: وَعَلَى ذَلِكَ أَنْتَ دَائِمٌ لا تَزُولُ،
segs.tr: wa ‘alā dhālika anta dā’imun lā tazūl,
segs.en: and upon that You are Everlasting, You do not pass away.

segs.ar: وَأَنَا الْعَبْدُ الضَّعِيْفُ عَمَلاً الجَسِيْمُ أَمَلاً،
segs.tr: Wa anā al-‘abdu aḍ-ḍa‘īfu ‘amalan al-jasīmu amalan,
segs.en: And I am the servant, weak in deed, tremendous in hope,

segs.ar: خَرَجَتْ مِنْ يَدِي أَسْبَابُ الْوُصُلاَت إلاّ مَا وَصَلَهُ رَحْمَتُكَ ،
segs.tr: kharajat min yadī asbābu al-wuṣulāt illā mā waṣalahū raḥmatuk,
segs.en: the means of connections have passed from my hand, save what Your Mercy connects,
and the ties of hopes have been cut off from me,

segs.ar: إلاّ مَا أَنَا مُعْتَصِمٌ بِهِ مِنْ عَفْوِكَ،
segs.tr: illā mā anā mu‘taṣimun bihī min ‘afwik,
segs.en: save what I cling to of Your Pardon.

segs.ar: قَلَّ عِنْدِي مَا أَعْتَدُّ بِهِ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ
segs.tr: Qalla ‘indī mā a‘taddu bihī min ṭā‘atik
segs.en: Little is what I hold in esteem of my obedience to You,

segs.ar: وَكَثُرَ عَلَيَّ مَا أَبُوءُ بِهِ مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa kathura ‘alayya mā abū’u bihī min ma‘ṣiyatik,
segs.en: and much is what I acknowledge of my disobedience to You.

segs.ar: وَلَنْ يَضِيْقَ عَلَيْكَ عَفْوٌ عَنْ عَبْدِكَ وَإنْ أَسَاءَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي.
segs.tr: Wa lan yaḍīqa ‘alayka ‘afwun ‘an ‘abdika wa in asā’a fa-‘fu ‘annī.
segs.en: And Your pardon will not be too difficult for You regarding Your servant, even if he did wrong, so pardon me.

segs.ar: أَللَّهًمَّ وَقَدْ أَشْرَفَ عَلَى خَفَايَا الأَعْمَالِ عِلْمُكَ
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa qad ashrafa ‘alā khafāyā al-a‘māl ‘ilmuk
segs.en: O God, Your knowledge has looked over the hidden parts of deeds,

segs.tr: wa inkashafa kullu mastūrin dūna khubrik
segs.en: and every concealed thing has been unveiled before Your awareness,
and the subtleties of affairs are not folded up from You,
nor are the hidden things of secrets absent from You.

segs.ar: وَقَدِ اسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيَّ عَدُوُّكَ الَّذِي اسْتَنْظَرَكَ لِغِوَايتِي فَأَنْظَرْتَهُ،
segs.tr: Wa qad istaḥwadha ‘alayya ‘aduwwuka alladhī istanẓaraka li-ghiwāyatī fa-anẓartah,
segs.en: And Your enemy has overcome me—the one who asked You for a respite to lead me astray, and You granted him respite,

segs.ar: وَاسْتَمْهَلَكَ إلَى يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ لاِضْلاَلِي فَأَمْهَلْتَهُ،
segs.tr: wa istamhalaka ilā yawmi ad-dīn li-iḍlālī fa-amhaltah,
segs.en: and who asked You for a delay until the Day of Judgment to mislead me, and You gave him a delay.
So he made me fall, while I was fleeing to You,
from minor sins that destroy,
and major deeds that ruin,
until when I committed an act of disobedience to You,
and incurred Your wrath through my evil striving,
he twisted the rope of his treachery away from me,
and met me with his word of ingratitude,

segs.ar: وَتَوَلَّى الْبَراءَةَ مِنِّي وَأَدْبَرَ مُوَلِّيَاً عَنِّي،
segs.tr: wa tawallā al-barā’ata minnī wa adbara muwalliyan ‘annī,
segs.en: and he assumed innocence of me and turned away, retreating from me.
So he left me exposed to Your wrath, alone,

segs.tr: wa akhrajanī ilā finā’i naqimatika ṭarīdā
segs.en: and expelled me to the courtyard of Your vengeance, driven out.
There is no intercessor to intercede for me with You,
and no protector to grant me security from You,
and no fortress to veil me from You,

segs.tr: wa lā malādhun alja’u ilayhī mink.
segs.en: and no refuge to shelter in from You.

segs.ar: فَهَذَا مَقَامُ الْعَائِذِ بِكَ، وَمَحَلُّ الْمُعْتَرِفِ لَكَ،
segs.tr: Fa-hādhā maqāmu al-‘ā’idhi bik, wa maḥallu al-mu‘tarif lak,
segs.en: So this is the station of the one seeking refuge in You, and the place of the one confessing to You,

segs.ar: فَلاَ يَضِيقَنَّ عَنِّي فَضْلُكَ، وَلا يَقْصُـرَنَّ دونِي عَفْوُكَ،
segs.tr: fa-lā yaḍīqanna ‘annī faḍluk, wa lā yaqṣuranna dūnī ‘afwuk,
segs.en: so let Your Favor not become narrow for me, and let Your Pardon not fall short of me,
and let me not be the most disappointed of Your repenting servants,
and not the most despairing of Your hopeful delegations.

segs.tr: Wa ighfir lī innaka khayru al-ghāfirīn.
segs.en: And forgive me, surely You are the best of those who forgive.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أَمَرْتَنِي فَتَرَكْتُ، وَنَهَيْتَنِي فَرَكِبْتُ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma innaka amartanī fa-taraktu, wa nahaytanī fa-rakibt,
segs.en: O God, surely You commanded me, and I abandoned, and You forbade me, and I committed,

segs.ar: وَسَوَّلَ لِيَ الْخَطَأَ خَاطِرُ السُّوءِ فَفَرَّطْتُ،
segs.tr: wa sawwala liya al-khaṭa’ khuṭūru as-sū’ fa-farraṭt,
segs.en: and the thought of evil tempted me to error, and I neglected,
and I do not call to witness my fasting by day,
nor do I seek refuge in my night vigil,
and no supererogatory act praises me for reviving it,

segs.ar: حَـاشَا فُرُوضِـكَ الَّتِي مَنْ ضَيَّعَها هَلَكَ،
segs.tr: ḥāshā furūḍika allatī man ḍayya‘ahā halak,
segs.en: except for Your obligatory duties, which he who neglects them perishes.

segs.tr: wa lastu atawassalu ilayka bi-faḍli nāfilah
segs.en: And I do not draw close to You by the merit of a supererogatory prayer,

segs.ar: مَعَ كَثِيرِ مَا أَغْفَلْتُ مِنْ وَظَائِفِ فُرُوضِكَ،
segs.tr: ma‘a kathīri mā aghfaltu min waẓā’ifi furūḍik,
segs.en: along with the great deal I have neglected of the functions of Your obligatory duties,
and transgressed beyond the bounds of Your limits,

segs.ar: إلَى حُرُمَات انْتَهَكْتُهَا، وَكَبَائِرِ ذُنُوب اجْتَرَحْتُهَا
segs.tr: ilā ḥurumātin intahaktuhā, wa kabā’iri dhunūbin ijtaraḥtuhā
segs.en: to sacred things that I violated, and major sins that I committed,

segs.ar: كَانَتْ عَافِيَتُكَ لِي مِنْ فَضَائِحِهَا سِتْراً.
segs.en: while Your well-being was a covering for me from their disgraces.

segs.ar: وَهَذَا مَقَامُ مَنِ اسْتَحْيَى لِنَفْسِهِ مِنْكَ،
segs.tr: Wa hādhā maqāmu mani istaḥyā li-nafsihī mink,
segs.en: And this is the station of him who was ashamed of himself before You,
and became angry with it, and was pleased with You.

segs.ar: فَتَلَقَّاكَ بِنَفْس خَاشِعَة، وَرَقَبَة خَاضِعَة، وَظَهْر مُثْقَل مِنَ الْخَطَايَا
segs.tr: Fa-talaqqāka bi-nafsin khāshi‘ah, wa raqabatin khāḍi‘ah, wa ẓahrin muthqalin mina al-khaṭāyā
segs.en: So he met You with a humble soul, a submissive neck, and a back heavily laden with errors,

segs.ar: وَاقِفاً بَيْنَ الرَّغْبَةِ إلَيْكَ وَالرَّهْبَةِ مِنْكَ،
segs.tr: wāqifan bayna ar-raghbati ilayka wa ar-rahbati mink,
segs.en: standing between desire for You and dread of You.
And You are the worthiest of those he has hoped for,

segs.tr: wa aḥaqqu man khashiyahū wa ittqāh,
segs.en: and the most entitled of those he has feared and guarded against.

segs.ar: فَاعْطِنِي يَا رَبِّ مَا رَجَوْتُ، وَآمِنِّي مَا حَذِرْتُ،
segs.tr: Fa-‘aṭinī yā Rabbi mā rajawtu, wa āminnī mā ḥadhirt,
segs.en: So give me, O Lord, what I have hoped for, and grant me security from what I have warned against,

segs.ar: وَعُدْ عَلَيَّ بِعَائِدَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ إنَّكَ أكْرَمُ الْمَسْؤُولِينَ.
segs.tr: wa ‘ud ‘alayya bi-‘ā’idati raḥmatik innaka akramu al-mas’ūlīn.
segs.en: and revert to me with the benefit of Your mercy, surely You are the Most Generous of those asked.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ وَإذْ سَتَـرْتَنِي بِعَفْوِكَ وَتَغَمَّـدْتَنِي بِفَضْلِكَ
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa idh satartanī bi-‘afwika wa taghammadtanī bi-faḍlik
segs.en: O God, since You covered me with Your pardon and submerged me in Your favor,
in the abode of passing away, in the presence of equals,
then shelter me from the disgraces of the abode of permanence,

segs.ar: عِنْدَ مَوَاقِفِ الأشْهَادِ مِنَ الْمَلائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
segs.en: at the standing-places of the witnesses: the nearest angels,

segs.tr: wa ar-rusuli al-mukarramīn wa ash-shuhadā’ wa aṣ-ṣāliḥīn,
segs.en: the honored Messengers, the martyrs, and the righteous,
from a neighbor whom I used to conceal my evil deeds from,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ ذِي رَحِم كُنْتُ أَحْتَشِمُ مِنْهُ فِي سَرِيرَاتِي،
segs.tr: wa min dhī raḥimin kuntu aḥtashimu minhu fī sarīrātī,
segs.en: and from a relative whom I used to feel ashamed before concerning my secrets.

segs.ar: لَمْ أَثِقْ بِهِمْ رَبِّ فِي السِّتْرِ عَلَيَّ،
segs.tr: Lam athiq bihim Rabbi fī as-sitr ‘alayya,
segs.en: I did not trust them, my Lord, in covering me,

segs.ar: وَوَثِقْتُ بِكَ رَبِّ فِي الْمَغفِرَةِ لِيْ،
segs.tr: wa wathiqtu bika Rabbi fī al-maghfirah lī,
segs.en: but I trusted in You, my Lord, in forgiving me,

segs.ar: وَأَنْتَ أوْلَى مَنْ وُثِقَ بِهِ وَأَعْطَى مَنْ رُغِبَ إلَيْهِ
segs.tr: wa anta awlā man wuthiqa bihī wa a‘ṭā man rughiba ilayh
segs.en: and You are the worthiest of those trusted, and the most giving of those desired,
and the most compassionate of those whose mercy is sought, so have mercy on me.

segs.ar: أَللهُمَّ وَأنتَ حَدَرْتَنِي مَاءً مَهِيناً مِنْ صُلب،
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa anta ḥadartanī mā’an mahīnan min ṣulb,
segs.en: O God, You caused me to descend as a despised water from a loins,
narrow in bones, difficult in passages,
to a narrow womb that You covered with veils.

segs.ar: تُصَرِّفُنِي حَالاً عَنْ حَالٍ حَتَّى انْتَهَيْتَ بِيْ إلَى تَمَامِ الصُّورَةِ
segs.tr: tuṣarrifunī ḥālan ‘an ḥālin ḥattā intahayta bī ilā tamāmi aṣ-ṣūrah
segs.en: You varied me from one state to another until You brought me to the completion of the form,
and established the limbs in me,
as You described in Your Book:

segs.ar: نُطْفَةً ثُمَّ عَلَقَةً ثُمَّ مُضْغَةً ثُمَّ عِظَاماً
segs.en: a drop, then a clot, then a lump of flesh, then bones,

segs.ar: ثُمَّ كَسَوْتَ الْعِظَامَ لَحْماً ثُمَّ أَنْشَأتَنِي خَلْقَاً آخَرَ كَمَا شِئْتَ،
segs.tr: thumma kasawta al-‘iẓāma laḥmā thumma ansha’tanī khalqan ākharā kamā shi’t,
segs.en: then You clothed the bones with flesh, then You brought me forth as another creation, as You willed,
until when I needed Your provision,
and could not dispense with the help of Your favor,

segs.ar: جَعَلْتَ لِي قُـوتـاً مِنْ فَضْلِ طَعَام وَشَرَاب
segs.tr: ja‘alta lī qūtan min faḍli ṭa‘āmin wa sharāb
segs.en: You made for me sustenance from the excess of food and drink

segs.ar: أَجْرَيْتَهُ لِامَتِكَ الَّتِيْ أَسْكَنْتَنِي جَوْفَهَا وَأَوْدَعْتَنِي قَرَارَ رَحِمِهَا،
segs.tr: ajraytahū li-amatika allatī askantanī jawfahā wa awda‘tanī qarāra raḥimihā,
segs.en: that You caused to flow for Your female servant in whose belly You lodged me and in the settled place of whose womb You deposited me.

segs.ar: وَلَوْ تَكِلُنِي يَا رَبِّ فِي تِلْكَ الْحَـالاتِ إلَى حَوْلِي،
segs.tr: Wa law takilunī yā Rabbi fī tilka al-ḥālāt ilā ḥawlī,
segs.en: And if You had abandoned me, O Lord, in those states to my own ability,
or compelled me to my own strength,

segs.ar: لَكَانَ الْحَوْلُ عَنِّي مُعْتَزِلاً، وَلَكَانَتِ الْقُوَّةُ مِنِّي بَعِيدَةً،
segs.tr: la-kāna al-ḥawlu ‘annī mu‘tazilā, wa la-kānat al-quwwatu minnī ba‘īdah,
segs.en: the ability would have been withdrawn from me, and the strength would have been far from me.
So You nourished me with Your favor, the nourishment of the Kind, Gentle One,

segs.ar: تَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ بِي تَطَوُّلاً عَلَيَّ إلَى غَايَتِي هَذِهِ،
segs.tr: taf‘alu dhālika bī taṭawwulan ‘alayya ilā ghāyatī hādhih,
segs.en: doing that to me as a bounty upon me, until this present time of mine.

segs.ar: لاَ أَعْدَمُ بِرَّكَ وَلاَ يُبْطِئُ بِي حُسْنُ صَنِيعِكَ،
segs.tr: Lā a‘damu birraka wa lā yubṭi’u bī ḥusnu ṣanī‘ik,
segs.en: I am not deprived of Your goodness, nor is the excellence of Your making slow for me.

segs.tr: wa lā tata’akkadu ma‘a dhālika thiqatī,
segs.en: Yet, with all that, my trust is not confirmed,

segs.ar: فَأَتَفَرَّغَ لِمَا هُوَ أَحْظَى لِيْ عِنْدَكَ،
segs.en: so that I might devote myself to what is more felicitous for me with You.

segs.ar: قَدْ مَلَكَ الشَّيْطَانُ عِنَانِي فِي سُوءِ الظَّنِّ وَضَعْفِ الْيَقِينِ،
segs.tr: Qad malaka ash-shayṭānu ‘inānī fī sū’i aẓ-ẓann wa ḍa‘fi al-yaqīn,
segs.en: Satan has taken hold of my rein through ill opinion and weakness of certainty,

segs.ar: فَأَنَا أَشْكُو سُوْءَ مُجَاوَرَتِهِ لِي وَطَـاعَةَ نَفْسِي لَـهُ،
segs.tr: fa-anā ashkū sū’a mujāwaratihī lī wa ṭā‘ata nafsī lah,
segs.en: so I complain of the evil of his neighboring me and the obedience of my soul to him.

segs.ar: وَأَسْتَعْصِمُـكَ مِنْ مَلَكَتِهِ، وَأَتَضَـرَّعُ إلَيْكَ فِي صَرفِ كَيْدِهِ عَنّي
segs.tr: wa asta‘ṣimuka min malakatih, wa ataḍarra‘u ilayka fī ṣarf kaydihī ‘annī
segs.en: And I ask You for protection from his dominion, and I implore You to turn his trickery away from me,

segs.ar: وَ أسأَلُكَ فِي أَنْ تُسَهِّلَ إلَى رِزْقِي سَبِيلاً،
segs.tr: wa as’aluka fī an tusahhila ilā rizqī sabīlā,
segs.en: and I ask You to make easy a path to my provision.

segs.ar: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى ابْتِدَائِكَ بِالنِّعَمِ الْجِسَامِ،
segs.en: So praise belongs to You for Your initiation of immense blessings,

segs.tr: wa ilhāmika ash-shukra ‘alā al-iḥsān wa al-in‘ām,
segs.en: and Your inspiration of thanks for kindness and favor.
So bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَسَهِّلْ عَلَيَّ رِزْقِي وَأَنْ تُقَنِّعَنِي بِتَقْدِيرِكَ لِيْ ،
segs.tr: wa sahhil ‘alayya rizqī wa an tuqanni‘anī bi-taqdīrika lī,
segs.en: and make my provision easy for me, and make me content with Your destiny for me,

segs.ar: وَأَنْ تُرْضِيَنِي بِحِصَّتِيْ فِيمَا قَسَمْتَ لِيْ،
segs.tr: wa an turḍiyanī bi-ḥiṣṣatī fīmā qasamt lī,
segs.en: and satisfy me with my portion in what You have allocated for me,

segs.ar: وَأَنْ تَجْعَـلَ مَـا ذَهَبَ مِنْ جِسْمِيْ وَعُمُرِيْ
segs.tr: wa an taj‘ala mā dhahaba min jismī wa ‘umurī
segs.en: and make what has passed of my body and my life

segs.ar: فِي سَبِيْلِ طَاعَتِكَ إنَّكَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ.
segs.tr: fī sabīli ṭā‘atik innaka khayru ar-rāziqīn.
segs.en: in the way of Your obedience, surely You are the best of providers.

segs.ar: أَللَهُمَّ إنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مَنْ نَارٍ تَغَلَّظْتَ بِهَا عَلَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma innī a‘ūdhu bika min nārin taghallaẓta bihā ‘alā man ‘aṣāk,
segs.en: O God, I seek refuge in You from a Fire by which You showed severity toward whoever disobeyed You,

segs.ar: وَتَوَعَّدْتَ بِهَا مَنْ صَدَفَ عَنْ رِضَاكَ،
segs.tr: wa tawa‘‘adta bihā man ṣadafa ‘an riḍāk,
segs.en: and with which You threatened whoever turned away from Your pleasure,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ نَارٍ نُورُهَا ظُلْمَةٌ وَهَيِّنُهَا أَلِيمٌ، وَبَعِيدُهَا قَرِيبٌ،
segs.tr: wa min nārin nūruhā ẓulmah wa hayyinuhā alīm, wa ba‘īduhā qarīb,
segs.en: and from a Fire whose light is darkness, whose ease is painful, and whose far is near,

segs.tr: wa min nārin ya’kulu ba‘ḍahā ba‘ḍ,
segs.en: and from a Fire some of which devours some,
and some of which assaults some,

segs.tr: wa min nārin tadharu al-‘iẓāmā ramīmā,
segs.en: and from a Fire that leaves the bones as decayed dust,
and gives its inhabitants scalding water to drink,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ نَارٍ لاَ تُبْقِي عَلَى مَنْ تَضَرَّعَ إلَيْهَا،
segs.tr: wa min nārin lā tubqī ‘alā man taḍarra‘a ilayhā,
segs.en: and from a Fire that does not spare whoever implores it,
and does not pity whoever asks for its compassion,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَقْدِرُ عَلَى التَّخْفِيفِ عَمَّنْ خَشَعَ لَهَا وَاسْتَسْلَمَ إلَيْهَا،
segs.tr: wa lā taqdiru ‘alā at-takhfīf ‘amman khasha‘a lahā wa istaslama ilayhā,
segs.en: and cannot alleviate from whoever is humbled before it and surrenders to it.

segs.ar: تَلْقَى سُكَّانَهَا بِأَحَرِّ مَا لَدَيْهَا مِنْ أَلِيْمِ النَّكَالِ وَشَدِيدِ الْوَبَالِ،
segs.tr: Talqā sukkānahā bi-aḥarri mā ladayhā min alīmi an-nakāl wa shadīd al-wabāl,
segs.en: It meets its inhabitants with the hottest of what it possesses of painful retribution and severe wretchedness.

segs.ar: وَأَعُوذُ بكَ مِنْ عَقَارِبِهَا الْفَاغِرَةِ أَفْوَاهُهَا،
segs.tr: Wa a‘ūdhu bikā min ‘aqāribihā al-fāghirah afwāhuhā,
segs.en: And I seek refuge in You from its scorpions whose mouths are wide open,
and its serpents that strike with their fangs,

segs.ar: وَشَرَابِهَا الَّذِي يُقَطِّعُ أَمْعَاءَ وَأَفْئِدَةَ سُكَّانِهَا، وَيَنْزِعُ قُلُوبَهُمْ،
segs.tr: wa sharābihā alladhī yuqaṭṭi‘u am‘ā’ wa af’idata sukkānihā, wa yanzi‘u qulūbahum,
segs.en: and its drink which cuts up the intestines and hearts of its inhabitants and tears out their hearts.

segs.ar: وَأَسْتَهْدِيْكَ لِمَا بَاعَدَ مِنْهَا وَأَخَّرَ عَنْهَا.
segs.tr: Wa astahdīka li-mā bā‘ada minhā wa akhkhara ‘anhā.
segs.en: And I ask You for guidance to what keeps far from it and delays from it.
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
and shelter me from it through the favor of Your mercy,
and pardon my slips through the excellence of Your pardon,

segs.tr: wa lā takhdhulnī yā khayra al-mujīrīn
segs.en: and do not forsake me, O best of those who grant shelter.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ تَقِي الْكَرِيهَةَ ، وَتُعْطِي الْحَسَنَةَ ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma innaka taqī al-karīhah, wa tu‘ṭī al-ḥasanah,
segs.en: O God, surely You ward off the detested, and You give the good,

segs.ar: وَتَفْعَلُ مَا تُرِيـدُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ.
segs.tr: wa taf‘alu mā turīd wa anta ‘alā kulli shay’in qadīr.
segs.en: and You do what You will, and You are powerful over everything.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، إذَا ذُكِرَ الأبْرَارُ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa ālih, idhā dhukira al-abrār,
segs.en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household when the righteous are mentioned,

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ مَا اخْتَلَفَ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ
segs.tr: wa ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa ālihī mā ikhtalafa al-laylu wa an-nahār
segs.en: and bless Muhammad and his Household as long as the night and the day follow each other,
a blessing whose supply is not cut off,

segs.ar: وَلاَ يُحْصَى عَدَدُهَا صَلاَةً تَشْحَنُ الْهَوَاءَ،
segs.tr: wa lā yuḥṣā ‘adaduhā ṣalātan tashḥanu al-hawā’,
segs.en: and whose number is not counted, a blessing that loads the atmosphere,
and fills the earth and the sky.
May God bless him until He is pleased,
and may God bless him and his Household

segs.ar: بَعْدَ الرِّضَا صَلاَةً لا حَدَّ لَها
segs.tr: ba‘da ar-riḍā ṣalātan lā ḥadda lahā
segs.en: after His pleasure, with a blessing that has no limit

segs.tr: wa lā muntahā yā arḥama ar-rāḥimīn.
segs.en: and no end, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
O Allah! I seek the best from You through Your knowledge.

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ، وَاقْضِ لِي بِالْخِيَرَةِ
segs.tr: Fa-ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa-Ālihī, wa-qḍi lī bil-khīrah
segs.en: So bless Muḥammad and his family, and decree for me the best choice.
And inspire us with knowledge of choosing rightly.
And make that a means to contentment.

segs.ar: بِمَا قَضَيْتَ لَنَا، وَالتَّسْلِيمِ لِمَا حَكَمْتَ
segs.tr: Bimā qaḍayta lanā, wa-al-taslīmi limā ḥakamta
segs.en: With what You have decreed for us, and submitting to what You decide.
So remove from us the doubts of uncertainty.
And strengthen us with the certainty of the sincere.

segs.ar: وَلَا تَسُمْنَا عَجْزَ الْمَعْرِفَةِ عَمَّا تَخَيَّرْتَ
segs.tr: Wa-lā tasumnā ʿajza al-maʿrifati ʿammā takhayyarta
segs.en: And do not make us suffer the ignorance of what You have chosen.
So that we belittle Your decree or dislike the place of Your pleasure.

segs.ar: وَنَجْنَحَ إِلَى الَّتِي هِيَ أَبْعَدُ مِنْ حُسْنِ الْعَاقِبَةِ
segs.tr: Wa-najnaḥa ilā allatī hiya abʿadu min ḥusni al-ʿāqibah
segs.en: And incline towards that which is far from a good outcome.
And nearer to the opposite of well-being.

segs.ar: حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا مَا نَكْرَهُ مِنْ قَضَائِكَ
segs.tr: Ḥabbib ʾilaynā mā nakrahu min qaḍāʾika
segs.en: Make beloved to us what we dislike from Your decree.

segs.ar: وَسَهِّلْ عَلَيْنَا مَا نَسْتَصْعِبُ مِنْ حُكْمِكَ
segs.tr: Wa-sahhil ʿalaynā mā nastasʿibu min ḥukmika
segs.en: And make easy for us what we find difficult from Your judgment.

segs.ar: وَأَلْهِمْنَا الِانْقِيَادَ لِمَا أَوْرَدْتَ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ مَشِيَّتِكَ
segs.tr: Wa-alhimnā al-inqiyāda limā awradta ʿalaynā min mashīʾatika
segs.en: And inspire us to submit to whatever You bring upon us from Your will.

segs.ar: حَتَّى لَا نُحِبَّ تَأْخِيرَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ
segs.tr: Ḥattā lā nuḥibba taʾkhīra mā ʿajjalta
segs.en: So that we do not wish to delay what You hasten.

segs.ar: وَلَا تَعْجِيلَ مَا أَخَّرْتَ، وَلَا نَكْرَهَ مَا أَحْبَبْتَ
segs.tr: Wa-lā taʿjīla mā akhkharta, wa-lā nakraha mā aḥbabta
segs.en: Nor hasten what You delay, nor dislike what You love.
Nor choose what You dislike.

segs.ar: وَاخْتِمْ لَنَا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْمَدُ عَاقِبَةً وَأَكْرَمُ مَصِيرًا
segs.tr: Wa-akhtim lanā billatī hiya aḥmadu ʿāqibatan wa-akramu maṣīrā
segs.en: And seal for us with that which is the best outcome and most honorable end.
Surely You bestow generosity and grant great gifts.

segs.ar: وَتَفْعَلُ مَا تُرِيدُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
segs.tr: Wa-tafʿalu mā turīdu, wa-anta ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
segs.en: And You do what You will, and You are powerful over all things.

S_34.name: 34. When Afflicted or Seeing Sinners Disgraced

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى سِتْرِكَ بَعْدَ عِلْمِكَ ،
segs.en: O God, praise be to You for Your covering after Your knowledge,
and Your granting of well-being after Your awareness.

segs.ar: فَكُلُّنَا قَدِ اقْتَرَفَ الْعَائِبَةَ فَلَمْ تَشْهَرْهُ ،
segs.tr: Fa-kullunā qadi iqtarafa al-‘ā’ibah fa-lam tashharh,
segs.en: For all of us have committed a shameful act, yet You did not make it public,
and perpetrated an indecency, yet You did not disgrace him,
and concealed himself with evil deeds, yet You did not point them out.
How many prohibitions of Yours have we transgressed,
and a command upon which You made us stand, yet we exceeded it,

segs.tr: wa sayyi’atan iktasabnāhā, wa khaṭī’atan irtakabnāhā,
segs.en: and an evil deed we acquired, and an error we committed.
You were the Observer of it without the sight of others,
and the One powerful to announce it beyond all who are powerful.

segs.ar: كَانَتْ عَافِيَتُكَ لَنَا حِجَاباً دُونَ أَبْصَارِهِمْ،
segs.en: Your well-being was a veil for us, excluding their eyes,
and a barrier excluding their ears.
So make what You covered of the faults,

segs.tr: wa akhfayta mina ad-dakhīlah wā‘iẓan lanā,
segs.en: and what You hid of the secret sin, an admonition for us,

segs.ar: وَزَاجِراً عَنْ سُوْءِ الْخُلْقِ وَاقْتِرَافِ الخَطِيئَـةِ،
segs.tr: wa zājiran ‘an sū’i al-khulq wa iqtirāf al-khaṭī’ah,
segs.en: and a deterrent from evil character and the commission of error,

segs.ar: وَسَعْياً إلَى التَّوْبَةِ الْمَاحِيَةِ وَالطَّرِيْقِ الْمَحْمُودَةِ،
segs.tr: wa sa‘yan ilā at-tawbati al-māḥiyah wa aṭ-ṭarīqi al-maḥmūdah,
segs.en: and a striving toward the effacing repentance and the praiseworthy path.
And bring near the time for it,
and do not burden us with heedlessness toward You.

segs.ar: إنَّا إلَيْكَ رَاغِبُونَ ، وَمِنَ الذُّنُوبِ تَائِبُونَ.
segs.tr: Innā ilayka rāghibūn, wa mina adh-dhunūbi tā’ibūn.
segs.en: Surely we are desirous of You, and repentant from sins.

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى خِيَرَتِكَ اللَّهُمَّ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segs.tr: Wa ṣalli ‘alā khiyaratika Allāhumma min khalqik
segs.en: And bless, O God, Your chosen one from Your creation,

segs.ar: مُحَمَّد وَعِتْرَتِهِ الصِّفْـوَةِ مِنْ بَرِيَّتِـكَ الطَّاهِرِينَ ،
segs.tr: Muḥammad wa ‘itratyhī aṣ-ṣifwah min barriyyatika aṭ-ṭāhirīn,
segs.en: Muḥammad, and his progeny, the elite of Your pure creation,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَامِعِينَ وَمُطِيعِينَ كَمَا أَمَرْتَ .
segs.tr: wa ij‘alnā lahum sāmi‘īn wa muṭī‘īn kamā amart.
segs.en: and make us attentive and obedient to them, as You commanded.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.
All praise is for Allah, in satisfaction with His decree.

segs.ar: شَهِدْتُ أَنَّ اللهَ قَسَمَ مَعَايِشَ عِبَادِهِ بِالْعَدْلِ،
segs.tr: shahidtu anna llāha qasama ma‘āyisha ‘ibādihi bil-‘adli
segs.en: I bear witness that Allah divided the livelihoods of His servants with justice.
And He deals with all His creation with grace.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.
And do not test me with what You have given them.
And do not test them with what You withheld from me.
So that I do not envy Your creation, nor reject Your judgment.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.
And make my soul content with Your decree.
And expand my chest through the places of Your judgment.
And grant me trust so that I acknowledge with it—

segs.ar: بِأَنَّ قَضَاءَكَ لَمْ يَجْرِ إلاَّ بِالْخِيَرَةِ.
segs.tr: bi-anna qaḍā’aka lam yajri illā bil-khīrati
segs.en: That Your decree runs only with wisdom and goodness.

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ شُكْرِي لَكَ عَلَى مَا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّي،
segs.en: And make my gratitude to You for what You withheld from me—

segs.ar: أَوْفَرَ مِنْ شُكْرِي إِيَّاكَ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنِي.
segs.tr: awfara min shukrī iyyāka ‘alā mā khawwaltanī
segs.en: Greater than my gratitude for what You granted me.

segs.ar: وَاعْصِمْنِي مِنْ أَنْ أَظُنَّ بِذِي عَدَمٍ خَسَاسَةً،
segs.tr: wa-‘ṣimnī min an aẓunna bidhī ‘adamin khasāsatan
segs.en: And protect me from thinking the poor are lowly.
Or from thinking that the wealthy have virtue.
For the noble one is he whom Your obedience ennobles.
And the mighty is he whom Your worship strengthens.
So bless Muhammad and his family.
And grant us an endless wealth.
And support us with a strength that never vanishes.
And let us roam freely in the kingdom of eternity.
Indeed, You are the One, the Only, the Eternal Refuge.
The One who neither begets nor is begotten.
And none is comparable to You.

S_36.name: 36. On Hearing Thunder
S_36.nameUr: بجلی اور گرج کے وقت کی دعا

segs.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّ هذَيْن آيَتَانِ مِنْ آياتِكَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumma inna hadhayni āyatāni min āyātika,
segs.en: O Allah! Indeed these two are among Your signs,
And these two are among Your helpers,

segs.ar: يَبْتَدِرَانِ طَاعَتَكَ بِرَحْمَةٍ نَافِعَةٍ أَوْ نِقْمَةٍ ضَارَّةٍ،
segs.tr: Yabtadirāni ṭā‘ataka biraḥmatin nāfi‘atin aw niqmatin ḍārratin,
segs.en: They hasten to obey You, bringing either helpful mercy or harmful punishment,
So do not pour upon us their evil rain,
And do not clothe us with affliction through them.
Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family,

segs.ar: وَأَنْزِلْ عَلَيْنَا نَفْعَ هَذِهِ السَّحَائِبِ وَبَرَكَتَهَا،
segs.tr: Wa anzil ‘alaynā naf‘a hādhihi as-saḥā’ibi wa barakatahā,
segs.en: And send down upon us the benefit and blessing of these clouds,
And turn away from us their harm and damage,
And do not strike us with calamity through them,
And do not send blight upon our livelihoods.

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ كُنْتَ بَعَثْتَهَا نِقْمَةً وَأَرْسَلْتَهَا سَخْطَةً
segs.tr: Allāhumma wa in kunta ba‘athtahā niqmah wa arsaltahā sakhta,
segs.en: O Allah, if You have sent them as a punishment and anger,
Then we seek refuge in You from Your anger,
And we implore You in asking for Your pardon,
So direct Your anger towards the polytheists,
And turn the mill of Your punishment upon the disbelievers.
O Allah, remove the drought of our land with Your rain,
And bring out the burning of our hearts with Your provision,
And do not distract us from You with anything else,

segs.ar: وَلاَ تَقْطَعْ عَنْ كَافَّتِنَا مَادَّةَ بِرِّكَ،
segs.en: And do not cut off from us the flow of Your goodness,
For the truly rich is the one whom You enrich,
And the safe one is the one You protect,
No one besides You has defense,
And no one can resist Your might,

segs.ar: تَحْكُمُ بِمَا شِئْتَ عَلَى مَنْ شِئْتَ،
segs.en: You judge as You will over whom You will,

segs.tr: Wataqḍī bimā aradta fī man aradta,
segs.en: And You decree as You wish upon whom You wish.

segs.ar: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا وَقَيْتَنَا مِنَ الْبَلاءِ،
segs.en: So praise is Yours for protecting us from affliction,

segs.ar: وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنَا مِنَ النِّعْمَاءِ
segs.en: And thanks are Yours for what You granted us of blessings,
A praise that surpasses the praise of those who praise,
A praise that fills His earth and His heaven,
Surely, You are the Bestower of immense favors,
The Giver of great blessings,
The Accepter of even little praise,
The Thankful for even little gratitude,
The Beneficent, the Generous, the Possessor of bounty,

segs.ar: لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ إلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.
segs.tr: Lā ilāha illā anta ilayka al-maṣīr,
segs.en: There is no god but You; to You is the return.
O Allah, no one

segs.ar: لَا يَبْلُغُ مِنْ شُكْرِكَ غَايَةً اِلاَّ حَصَلَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اِحْسَانِكَ مَا يُلْزِمُه شُكْرًا
segs.en: reaches a limit in thanking Thee without acquiring that of Thy beneficence which enjoins upon him thanksgiving,

segs.ar: وَ لَا يَبْلُغُ مَبْلَغًا مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ وَ اِنِ اجْتَهَدَ اِلاَّ كَانَ مُقَصِّرًا دُوْنَ اسْتِحْقَاقِكَ بِفَضْلِكَ
segs.en: nor does anyone reach a degree in obeying Thee, even if he strives, without falling short of what Thou deservest because of Thy bounty.
The most thankful of Thy servants has not the capacity to thank Thee,
and the most worshipful of them falls short of obeying Thee.
To none of them is due
Thy forgiveness through what he himself deserves

segs.ar: وَ لَا اَنْ تَرْضٰى عَنْهُ بِاسْتِيْجَابِهٖ
segs.en: or Thy good pleasure for his own merit.
When Thou forgivest someone, it is through Thy graciousness,
and when Thou art pleased with someone, it is through Thy bounty.
Thou showest gratitude for the paltry for which Thou showest gratitude

segs.ar: وَ تُثِيْبُ عَلٰى قَلِيْلِ مَا تَطَاعُ فِيْهِ
segs.en: and Thou rewardest the small act in which Thou art obeyed,
so that it seems as if Thy servants' thanksgiving for which Thou hast
made incumbent their reward
and made great their repayment

segs.ar: اَمْرٌ مَلَكُوْا اسْتِطَاعَةَ الْاِمْتِنَاعِ مِنْهُ دُوْنَكَ فَكـَافَيْتَهُمْ
segs.en: is an affair from which they could have held back without Thee, and hence Thou wilt recompense them,

segs.ar: اَوَ لَمْ يَكُنْ سَبَبُه بِيَدِكَ فَجَازَيْتَهُمْ
segs.en: and whose cause is not in Thy hand, and hence Thou wilt repay them.

segs.ar: بَلْ مَلَكْتَ يَآ اِلٰهِىْ اَمْرَهُمْ قَبْلَ اَنْ يَمْلِكُوْا عِبَادَتَكَ
segs.en: Nay, my Allah, Thou hadst power over their affair before they had power to worship Thee,

segs.ar: وَ اَعْدَدْتَ ثَوَابَهُمْ قَبْلَ اَنْ يُفِيْضُوْا فِىْ طَاعَتِكَ
segs.en: and Thou hadst prepared their reward before they began to obey Thee;
and that because
Thy wont is bestowal of bounty,
Thy custom beneficence,
Thy way pardon.
So all creatures confess

segs.ar: مُعْتَرِفَةٌ بِاَنَّكَ غَيْرُ ظَالِمٍ لِمَنْ عَاقَبْتَ
segs.en: that Thou wrongest not him whom Thou punishest

segs.ar: وَ شَاهِدَةٌ بِاَنَّكَ مُتَفَضِّلٌ عَلٰى مَنْ عَافَيْتَ
segs.en: and bear witness that Thou bestowest bounty upon him whom Thou pardonest.

segs.ar: وَ كُلٌّ مُقِرٌّ عَلٰى نَفْسِهٖ بِالتَّقْصِيْرِ عَمَّا اسْتَوْجَبْتَ
segs.en: Each admits that he has fallen short of what Thou meritest.

segs.ar: فَلَوْلَا اَنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَخْتَدِعُهُمْ عَنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا عَصَاكَ عَاصٍ
segs.en: Had Satan not misled them from Thy obedience, no disobeyer would have disobeyed Thee,

segs.ar: وَ لَوْلَا اَنَّه صَوَّرَ لَهُمُ الْبَاطِلَ فِىْ مِثَالِ الْحَقِّ مَا ضَلَّ عَنْ طَرِيْقِكَ ضَالٌّ
segs.en: and had he not shown falsehood to them in the likeness of truth no strayer would have gone astray from Thy path.
So glory be to Thee!

segs.ar: مَا اَبْيَنَ كَرَمَكَ فِىْ مُعَامَلَةِ مَنْ اَطَاعَكَ اَوْعَصَاكَ
segs.en: How manifest is Thy generosity in dealing with him who obeys or disobeys Thee!

segs.ar: تَشْكُرُ لِلْمُطِيْعِ مَآ اَنْتَ تَوَلَّيْتَه لَه
segs.en: Thou showest gratitude to the obedient for that which Thou undertakest for him,

segs.ar: وَ تُمْلِىْ لِلْعَاصِىْ فِيْمَا تَمْلِكُ مُعَاجَلَتَه فِيْهِ
segs.en: and Thou grantest a respite to the disobedient in that within which Thou art able to hurry him.

segs.ar: اَعْطَيْتَ كُلًّا مِنْهُمَا مَا لَمْ يَجِبْ لَه
segs.en: Thou givest to each of them that which is not his due,

segs.ar: وَ تَفَضَّلْتَ عَلٰى كُلٍّ مِنْهُمَا بِمَا يَقْصُرُ عَمَلُه عَنْهُ
segs.en: and Thou bestowest bounty upon each in that wherein his works fall short.

segs.ar: وَ لَوْ كَافَاتَ الْمُطِيْعَ عَلٰى مَآ اَنْتَ تَوَلَّيْتَه لَاَوْشَكَ
segs.en: Wert Thou to counterbalance for the obedient servant that which Thou Thyself hadst undertaken, he would be on the point of
losing Thy reward and
seeing the end of Thy favour,
but through Thy generosity Thou hast repaid him

segs.ar: عَلَى الْمُدَّةِ الْقَصِيْرَةِ الْفَانِيَةِ بِالْمُدَّةِ الطَّوِيْلَةِ الْخَالِدَةِ
segs.en: for a short, perishing term with a long, everlasting term,

segs.ar: وَ عَلَى الْغَايَةِ الْقَرِيْبَةِ الزَّائِلَةِ بِالْغَايَةِ الْمَدِيْدَةِ الْبَاقِيَةِ ثُمَّ
segs.en: and for a near, vanishing limit with an extended, abiding limit.

segs.ar: لَمْ تَسُمْهُ الْقِصَاصَ فِيْمَا اَكَلَ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ الَّذِىْ يَقْوٰى بِهٖ عَلٰى طَاعَتِكَ
segs.en: Then Thou dost not visit him with a settling of accounts for Thy provision through which he gained strength to obey Thee,

segs.ar: وَ لَمْ تَحْمِلْه عَلَى الْمُنَاقَشَاتِ فِى الْاٰلَاتِ الَّتِىْ تَسَبَّتَ بِاسْتِعْمَالِهَا اِلٰى مَغْفِرَتِكَ
segs.en: nor dost Thou force him to make reckonings for the organs he employed to find the means to Thy forgiveness.

segs.ar: وَ لَوْ فَعَلْتَ ذٰلِكَ بِهٖ لَذَهَبَ
segs.en: Wert Thou to do that to him, it would take away
everything for which he had laboured
and all wherein he had exerted himself

segs.ar: جَزَآءً لِلصُّغْرٰى مِنْ اَيَادِيْكَ وَ مِنَنِكَ
segs.en: as repayment for the smallest of Thy benefits and kindnesses,

segs.ar: وَ لَبَقِىَ رَهِيْنًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ بِسَائِرِ نِعَمِكَ
segs.en: and he would remain hostage before Thee for Thy other favours.

segs.ar: فَمَتٰى كَانَ يَسْتَحِقُّ شَيْئًا مِنْ ثَوَابِكَ لَا مَتٰى
segs.en: So how can he deserve something of Thy reward? Indeed, how?

segs.ar: هٰذَا يَا اِلٰهِىْ حَالُ مَنْ اَطَاعَكَ وَ سَبِيْلُ مَنْ تَعَبَّدَ لَكَ
segs.en: This, my Allah, is the state of him who obeys Thee and the path of him who worships Thee.

segs.ar: فَاَمَّا الْعَاصِىْ اَمْرَكَ وَ الْمُوَاقِعُ نَهْيَكَ
segs.en: But as for him who disobeys Thy command and goes against Thy prohibition,

segs.ar: فَلَمْ تُعَاجِلْهُ بِنَقِمَتِكَ لِكَىْ يَسْتَبْدِلَ بِحَالِهٖ فِىْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ حَالَ الْاِنَابَةِ اِلٰى طَاعَتِكَ
segs.en: Thou dost not hurry him to Thy vengeance, so that he may seek to replace his state in disobeying Thee with the state of turning back to obey Thee,

segs.ar: وَ لَقَدْ كَانَ يَسْتَحِقُّ فِىْ اَوَّلِ مَا هَمَّ بِعِصْيَانِكَ كُلَّ مَا اَعْدَدْتَ لِجَمِيْعِ خَلْقِكَ مِنْ عُقُوْبَتِكَ
segs.en: though he deserved from the time he set out to disobey Thee every punishment which Thou hast prepared for all Thy creatures.

segs.ar: فَجَمِيْعُ مَا اَخَّرْتَ عَنْهُ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ
segs.en: Through each chastisement which Thou hast kept back from him

segs.ar: وَ اَبْطَأْتَ بِهٖ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ سَطَوَاتِ النَّقِمَةِ وَ الْعِقَابِ
segs.en: and each penalty of Thy vengeance and Thy punishment which Thou hast delayed from him,

segs.ar: تَرْكٌ مِنْ حَقِّكَ وَ رِضًى بِدُوْنِ وَاجِبِكَ
segs.en: Thou hast refrained from Thy right and shown good pleasure in place of what Thou hast made obligatory.
So who is more generous, my Allah, than Thou?

segs.ar: وَ مَنْ اَشْقٰى مِمَّنْ هَلَكَ عَلَيْكَ لَا مَنْ
segs.en: And who is more wretched than he who perishes in spite of Thee? Indeed, who?
Thou art too blessed to be described by any but beneficence

segs.ar: وَ كَرُمْتَ اَنْ يُخَافَ مِنْكَ اِلاَّ الْعَدْلُ
segs.en: and too generous for any but justice to be feared from Thee!

segs.ar: لَا يُخْشٰى جَوْرِكَ عَلٰى مَنْ عَصَاكَ
segs.en: There is no dread that Thou wilt be unjust toward him who disobeys Thee,

segs.ar: وَلَا يُخَافُ اِغْفَالُكَ ثَوَابَ مَنْ اَرْضَاكَ
segs.en: nor any fear of Thy neglecting to reward him who satisfies Thee.
So bless Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَ هَبْ لِىْ اَمَلِىْ وَ زِذْنِىْ
segs.en: give me my hope,

segs.ar: مِنْ هُدَاكَ مَآ اَصِلُ بِهٖ اِلَى التَّوْفِيْقِ فِىْ عَمَلِىْ
segs.en: and increase me in that of Thy guidance through which I may be successful in my works!
Surely Thou art All-kind, Generous.
O Allah, I apologize to You

segs.ar: مِنْ مَظْلُومٍ ظُلِمَ بِحَضْرَتِي فَلَمْ أَنْصُرْهُ
segs.tr: Min maẓlūmin ẓulima bi-ḥaḍratī fa-lam anṣuruh
segs.en: From an oppressed person who was wronged in my presence, yet I did not aid him

segs.ar: وَمِنْ مَعْرُوفٍ أُسْدِيَ إِلَيَّ فَلَمْ أَشْكُرْهُ
segs.tr: Wa min maʿrūfin usdīya ilayya fa-lam ashkurhu
segs.en: And from a favor that was given to me, but I did not thank for it

segs.ar: وَمِنْ مُسِيءٍ اعْتَذَرَ إِلَيَّ فَلَمْ أَعْذِرْهُ
segs.tr: Wa min musī'in iʿtadhara ilayya fa-lam aʿdhirhu
segs.en: And from a wrongdoer who apologized to me, yet I did not forgive him

segs.ar: وَمِنْ ذِيْ فَاقَةٍ سَأَلَنِي فَلَمْ أُوثِرْهُ
segs.tr: Wa min dhī fāqatin saʾalanī fa-lam ūthirhu
segs.en: And from one in need who asked me, but I did not prefer him

segs.ar: وَمِنْ حَقِّ ذِيْ حَقٍّ لَزِمَنِي لِمُؤْمِنٍ فَلَمْ أُوَفِّرْهُ
