segs.en: You are powerful over everything!
segs.tr: WA ANTA A'LAA KULLI SHAY'IN QADEER

S_46.name: 46. On Eid al-Fitr and Friday
S_46.nameUr: عید الفطر اور جمعہ کی دعا

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ يَرْحَمُ مَنْ لا يَرْحَمُهُ الْعِبَادُ.
segs.en: 1.O He who has mercy upon him toward whom the servants show no mercy!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ يَقْبَلُ مَنْ لا تَقْبَلُهُ الْبِلاَدُ.
segs.en: 2.O He who accepts him whom the cities will not accept!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَن لاَ يَحْتَقِرُ أَهْلَ الْحَاجَةِ إلَيْهِ.
segs.tr: wa yaa mal-laa yah'-taqiru ah-lal-h'aajati ilay-h
segs.en: 3.O He who looks not down upon those who have need of Him!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لا يُخَيِّبُ المَلِحِّيْنَ عَلَيْـهِ،
segs.en: 4.O He who disappoints not those who implore Him!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يَجْبَهُ بِالرَّدِّ أَهْلَ الدَّالَّةِ عَليهِ،
segs.tr: wa yaa mal-laa yaj-bahoo bir-rad-di ah-lad-daaal-lati a'lay-h
segs.en: 5.O He who slaps not the brow of the people of boldness toward Him with rejection!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ يَجْتَبِي صَغِيرَ مَايُتْحَفُ بِهِ،
segs.tr: wa yaa may-yaj-tabee s'agheera maa yut-h'afu bihee
segs.en: 6.O He who collects the little that is given to Him

segs.tr: wa yash-kuru yaseera maa yua'-malu lah
segs.en: 7.and shows gratitude for the paltry that is done for Him!

segs.ar: وَيَامَنْ يَشْكُرُ عَلَى الْقَلِيْلِ، وَيُجَازيْ بِالْجَلِيلِ،
segs.tr: wa yaa may-yash-kuru a'laal-qaleeli wa yujaazee bil-jaleel
segs.en: 8.O He who shows gratitude for the small and rewards with the great!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ يَدْنُو إلَى مَنْ دَنا مِنْهُ
segs.tr: wa yaa may-yad-nooo ilaa man danaa min-h
segs.en: 9.O He who comes close to him who comes close to Him!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ يَدعُو إلَى نَفْسِهِ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ عَنْهُ،
segs.tr: wa yaa may-yad-o'ow ilaa naf-sihee man ad-bara a'n-h
segs.en: 10.O He who invites to Himself him who turns his back on Him!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لا يُغَيِّرُ النِّعْمَةَ، وَلا يُبَادِرُ بِالنَّقِمَةِ،
segs.tr: wa yaa mal-laa yughay-yirun-nia'-mah wa laa yubaadiru bin-naq-mah
segs.en: 11.O He who changes not favour and rushes not to vengeance!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ يُثْمِرُ الْحَسَنَةَ حَتَّى يُنْمِيَهَا،
segs.en: 12.O He who causes the good deed to bear fruit so that He may make it grow,
13.and overlooks the evil deed so that He may efface it!

segs.ar: انْصَرَفَتِ الآمَالُ دُونَ مَدى كَرَمِكَ بِالحَاجَاتِ
segs.en: 14.Hopes turn back with needs fulfilled short of the extent of Your generosity,
15.the cups of requests fill up with the overflow of Your munificence,
16.and attributes fall apart without reaching Your description.

segs.ar: فَلَكَ الْعُلُوُّ الأعْلَى فَوْقَ كُلِّ عَال،
segs.en: 17.For to You belongs the highest highness above everything high,
18.and the most glorious majesty beyond every majesty!
19.Everything majestic before You is small,

segs.ar: وَكُلُّ شَرِيف فِي جَنْبِ شَرَفِكَ حَقِيرٌ،
segs.tr: wa kul-lu shareefin fee jambi sharafika h'aqeer
segs.en: 20.everything eminent beside Your eminence vile!
21.Those who reach other than You are disappointed,

segs.ar: وَخَسِرَ الْمُتَعَرِّضُونَ إلاَّ لَكَ، وَضَاعَ الْمُلِمُّونَ إلاّ بِكَ،
segs.tr: wa khasiral-mutaa'r-riz''oona il-laa lak wa z''aaa'l-mulim-moona il-laa bik
segs.en: 22.those who present themselves to other than You have lost, those who stay with other than You have perished,

segs.ar: وَأَجْدَبَ الْمُنْتَجِعُـونَ إلاَّ مَنِ انْتَجَعَ فَضْلَكَ،
segs.tr: wa aj-dabal-muntajiu'wna il-laa mani antajaa' faz''-lak
segs.en: 23.and those who retreat - except those who retreat to Your bounty - are desolate!

segs.ar: بَابُكَ مَفْتُوحٌ لِلرَّاغِبِينَ، وَجُودُكَ مُبَاحٌ لِلسَّائِلِينَ،
segs.en: 24.Your door is open to the beseechers, Your munificence free to the askers,
25.Your help near to the help-seekers!

segs.ar: لاَ يَخِيبُ مِنْـكَ الآمِلُونَ، وَلاَ يَيْأَسُ مِنْ عَطَائِكَ الْمُتَعَرِّضُونَ،
segs.tr: laa yakheebu minkal-aaamiloon wa laa yay-asu min a't'aaa-ikal-mutaa'r-riz''oon
segs.en: 26.The expectant are not disappointed by You, those who present themselves despair not of Your bestowal,
27.the forgiveness-seekers become not wretched through Your vengeance!
28.Your provision is spread among those who disobey You,
29.Your clemency presents itself to those hostile toward You,
30.Your habit is beneficence toward the evildoers,
31.and Your wont is to spare the transgressors,

segs.ar: حَتَّى لَقَدْ غَرَّتْهُمْ أَنَاتُكَ عَنِ الرُّجُوعِ،
segs.en: 32.so much so that Your lack of haste deludes them from returning,
33.and Your disregard bars them from desisting!

segs.ar: وَإنَّمَا تَأَنَّيْتَ بهمْ لِيَفِيئُوا إلَى أَمْرِكَ،
segs.tr: wa in-namaa taan-nay-ta bihim leeafee-oo ilaaa am-rik
segs.en: 34.You actest without haste toward them so that they will come back to Your command
35.and You disregardest them confident in the permanence of Your kingdom,

segs.ar: فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ خَتَمْتَ لَهُ بِهَا،
segs.tr: faman kaana min ah-lis-saa'adati khatam-ta lahoo bihaa
segs.en: 36.so You sealest him who is worthy of it with felicity,

segs.ar: وَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ خَذَلْتَهُ لَهَا،
segs.tr: wa man kaana min ah-lish-shaqaawati khad'al-tahoo lahaa
segs.en: 37.and You abandonest him who is worthy of it to wretchedness!

segs.ar: كُلُّهُمْ صَائِرُونَ إلَى حُكْمِكَ وَأُمُورُهُمْ آئِلَةٌ إلَى أَمْـرِكَ،
segs.tr: kul-luhum s'aaa-iroona ilaa h'uk-mik wa umooruhum aaa-ilatun ilaaa am-rik
segs.en: 38.All of them come home to Your decree, their affairs revert to Your command;

segs.ar: لَمْ يَهِنْ عَلَى طُـولِ مُـدَّتِهِمْ سُلْطَانُـكَ
segs.tr: lam yahin a'laa t'ooli mud-datihim sul-t'aanuk
segs.en: 39.Your authority grows not feeble through their drawn out term,

segs.tr: wa lam yud-h'az'' litar-ki mua'ajalatihim bur-haanuk
segs.en: 40.Your proof is not refuted by the failure to hurry after them.
41.Your argument is established, never refuted,
42.Your authority fixed, never removed.
43.Permanent woe belongs to him who inclines away from You,
44.forsaking disappointment to him who is disappointed by You,
45.and the most wretched wretchedness to him who is deluded about You!
46.How much he will move about in Your chastisement!

segs.tr: wa maaa at'-wala tarad-dudahoo fee i'qaabika?
segs.en: 47.How long he will frequent Your punishment!
48.How far his utmost end from relief!
49.How he will despair of an easy exit!

segs.ar: عَدْلاً مِنْ قَضَائِكَ لاَ تَجُورُ فِيهِ،
segs.en: 50.[All of this] as justice from Your decree (Thou art not unjust in it!),

segs.ar: وَإنْصَافاً مِنْ حُكْمِكَ لاَ تَحِيفُ عَلَيْهِ،
segs.tr: wa ins'aafam-min h'uk-mika laa tah'eefu a'lay-h
segs.en: 51.and equity from Your judgement (Thou dost not act wrongfully against him!).
52.You supported the arguments, tested the excuses,

segs.ar: وَقَـدْ تَقَدَّمْتَ بِـالْوَعِيْـدِ وَتَلَطَّفْتَ فِي التَّرْغِيْبِ،
segs.tr: wa qad t-taqad-dam-ta bil-wae'ed wa talat'-t'af-ta fit-tar-gheeb
segs.en: 53.began with threats, showed gentleness with encouragement,
54.struck similitudes, made long the respite,
55.delayed, while You art able to hurry,
56.and acted without haste, while You art full of quick accomplishment!

segs.ar: لَمْ تَكُنْ أَنَاتُكَ عَجْزاً، وَلا إمْهَالُكَ وَهْناً،
segs.tr: lam takun anaatuka a'j-zaa wa laaa im-haaluka wah-naa
segs.en: 57.Not because of incapacity is Your slowness, feebleness Your giving respite,

segs.ar: وَلاَ إمْسَاكُكَ غَفْلَةً، وَلاَ انْتِظَارُكَ مُدَارَاةً،
segs.tr: wa laaa im-saakuka ghaf-lah wa laa antiz'aaruka mudaaraah
segs.en: 58.heedlessness Your showing restraint, dissemblance Your waiting!

segs.ar: بَلْ لِتَكُونَ حُجَّتُكَ أَبْلَغَ، وَكَرَمُكَ أكمَلَ،
segs.tr: bal-litakoona h'uj-jatuka ab-lagh wa karamuka ak-mal
segs.en: 59.But that Your argument be more conclusive, Your generosity more perfect,

segs.tr: wa ih'-saanuka aw-faa wa nia'-matuka atam
segs.en: 60.Your beneficence more exhaustive, Your favour more complete!

segs.ar: كُلُّ ذلِكَ كَانَ وَلَمْ تَزَلْ، وَهُوَ كائِنٌ وَلاَ تَزَالُ ،
segs.tr: kul-lu d'alika kaana wa lam tazal wa huwa kaaa-inoo-wa laa tazaal
segs.en: 61.All of this has been and always was, is and ever will be.

segs.ar: حُجَّتُكَ أَجَلُّ مِنْ أَنْ توصَفَ بِكُلِّهَا،
segs.tr: h'uj-jatuka ajal-lu min an toos'afa bikul-lihaa
segs.en: 62.Your argument is greater than that its totality be described,

segs.ar: وَمَجْدُكَ أَرْفَـعُ مِنْ أَنْ يُحَدَّ بِكُنْهِهِ،
segs.tr: wa maj-duka ar-fau' min ay-yuh'ad-da bikun-hih
segs.en: 63.Your glory more elevated than that it be limited in its core,

segs.ar: وَنِعْمَتُكَ أكْثَرُ مِنْ أَنْ تُحْصَى بِأَسْرِهَا،
segs.tr: wa nia'-matuka ak-tharu min an tuh'-s'aa bi s-rihaa
segs.en: 64.Your favour more abundant than that its entirety be counted,

segs.ar: وَإحْسَانُكَ أكْثَرُ مِنْ أَنْ تُشْكَرَ عَلَى أَقَلِّهِ،
segs.tr: wa ih'-saanuka ak-tharu min an tush-kara a'laaa aqal-lih
segs.en: 65.Your beneficence more abundant than that thanks be given for its least amount!

segs.ar: وَقَدْ قَصَّرَ بِيَ السُّكُوتُ عَنْ تَحْمِيدِكَ،
segs.tr: wa qad qas'-s'ara beeas-sukootu a'n tah'-meedik
segs.en: 66.Speechlessness has made me fall short of praising You,
67.restraint has made me powerless to glorify You,
68.and the most I can do is admit to inability,

segs.ar: لاَ رَغْبَةً ـ يا إلهِي ـ بَلْ عَجْزاً،
segs.en: 69.not out of desire, my God, but out of incapacity.

segs.ar: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا أَؤُمُّكَ بِالْوِفَادَةِ، وَأَسأَلُكَ حُسْنَ الرِّفَادَةِ،
segs.tr: fahaaa ana d'aa aw-um-muka bil-wifaadah wa as-aluka h'us-nar-rifaadah
segs.en: 70.So here I am: I repair to You by coming forward, and I ask from You good support

segs.ar: فَصلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَاسْمَعْ نَجْوَايَ،
segs.tr: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih was-maa' naj-waay
segs.en: 71.So bless Muhammad and his Household, hear my whispered words,

segs.ar: وَاسْتَجِبْ دُعَائِي وَلاَ تَخْتِمْ يَوْمِيَ بِخَيْبَتِي،
segs.tr: was-tajib dua'aa-ee wa laa takh-tim yaw-mee bikhay-batee
segs.en: 72.grant my supplication, seal not my day with disappointment,

segs.tr: wa laa taj-bah-nee bir-rad-di fee mas-alatee
segs.en: 73.slap not my brow by rejecting my request,

segs.ar: وَأكْرِمْ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مُنْصَرَفِي وَإلَيْكَ مُنْقَلَبِي،
segs.tr: wa ak-rim min i'ndika muns'arafee wa ilay-ka munqalabee
segs.en: 74.and make noble my coming from You and my going back to You!

segs.ar: إنَّكَ غَيْرُ ضَائِق بِمَا تُرِيْدُ وَلاَ عَاجِزٍ عَمَّا تُسْأَلُ،
segs.tr: in-naka ghay-ru z''aaa-iqim-bimaa tureed wa laa a'ajizin a'm-maa tus-al
segs.en: 75.Surely You art not constrained by what You desirest, nor incapable of what You art asked!

segs.tr: wa anta a'laa kul-li shay-in qadeer
segs.en: 76.You art powerful over everything,

segs.ar: وَلا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إلاَّ بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ.
segs.tr: wa laa h'aw-la wa laa qoo-wata il-laa bil-lahil-a'lee-yil-a'z'eem
segs.en: 77.and there is no force and no strength save in God, the All-high, the All-mighty!
Praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds!
O Allah, to Thee belongs praise!
Originator of the heavens and the earth!
Possessor of majesty and munificence!
Lord of lords!
Object of worship of every worshiper!
Creator of every creature!
Inheritor of all things!
There is nothing like Him,

segs.ar: وَ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ عِلْمُ شَىْءٍ
segs.en: knowledge of nothing escapes Him,
He encompasses everything,

segs.ar: وَ هُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ رَّقِيْبٌ
segs.en: and He is watchful over everything.

segs.ar: اَنْتَ اللهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلاَّ اَنْتَ
segs.en: Thou art Allah, there is no Allah but Thou,
the Unique, the Alone,
the Single, the Isolated.

segs.ar: وَ اَنْتَ اللهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلاَّ اَنْتَ
segs.en: Thou art Allah, there is no Allah but Thou,
the Generous, the Generously Bestowing,
the All-mighty, the Mightily Exalted,
the Magnificent, the Magnificently Magnified.

segs.ar: وَ اَنْتَ اللهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلاَّ اَنْتَ
segs.en: Thou art Allah, there is no Allah but Thou,
the All-high, the Sublimely High, the Strong in prowess.

segs.ar: وَ اَنْتَ اللهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلاَّ اَنْتَ
segs.en: Thou art Allah, there is no Allah but Thou,
the All-merciful, the All-compassionate,
the All-knowing, the All-wise.

segs.ar: وَ اَنْتَ اللهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلاَّ اَنْتَ
segs.en: Thou art Allah, there is no Allah but Thou,
the All-hearing, the All-seeing,
the Eternal, the All-aware.

segs.ar: وَ اَنْتَ اللهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلاَّ اَنْتَ
segs.en: Thou art Allah, there is no Allah but Thou,
the Generous, the Most Generous,
the Everlasting, the Most Everlasting.

segs.ar: وَ اَنْتَ اللهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلاَّ اَنْتَ
segs.en: Thou art Allah, there is no Allah but Thou,
the First before every one,
the Last after every number.

segs.ar: وَ اَنْتَ اللهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلاَّ اَنْتَ
segs.en: Thou art Allah, there is no Allah but Thou,
the Close in His highness,
the High in His closeness.

segs.ar: وَ اَنْتَ اللهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلاَّ اَنْتَ
segs.en: Thou art Allah, there is no Allah but Thou,
Possessor of radiance and glory,
magnificence and praise.

segs.ar: وَ اَنْتَ اللهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلاَّ اَنْتَ
segs.en: Thou art Allah, there is no Allah but Thou.

segs.ar: الَّذِىْ اَنْشَاْتَ الْاَشْيَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سِنْخٍ
segs.en: Thou hast brought forth the things without root,

segs.ar: وَ صَوَّرْتَ مَا صَوَّرْتَ مِنْ غَيْرِ مِثَالٍ
segs.en: formed what Thou hast formed without exemplar,
and originated the originated things without limitation.
It is Thou
who hast ordained each thing with an ordination,
eased each thing with an easing,
and governed everything below Thyself with a governing.
It is Thou
whom no associate helps with Thy creation

segs.ar: وَ لَمْ يُوَازِرْكَ فِىْ اَمْرِكَ وَزِيْرٌ
segs.en: and no vizier aids in Thy command.

segs.ar: وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَكَ مُشَاهِدٌ وَّ لَا نَظِيْرٌ
segs.en: Thou hast no witness and no equal.
It is Thou
who willed, and what Thou willed was unfailing,

segs.ar: وَ قَضَيْتَ فَكَانَ عَدْلًا مَا قَضَيْتَ
segs.en: who decreed, and what Thou decreed was just,

segs.ar: وَ حَكَمْتَ فَكَانَ نِصْفًا مَا حَكَمْتَ
segs.en: who decided, and what Thou decided was fair.
It is Thou whom place does not contain,
before whose authority no authority stands up,

segs.ar: وَ لَمْ يُعِيْكَ بُرْهَانٌ وَ لَا بَيَانٌ
segs.en: and whom no proof or explication can thwart.
It is Thou
who hast counted everything in numbers,
appointed for everything a term,
and ordained everything with an ordination.
It is Thou
before whose selfness imaginations fall short,
before whose howness understandings have no incapacity,

segs.ar: وَ لَمْ تُدْرِكِ الْاَبْصَارُ مَوْضِعَ اَيْنِيَّتِكَ
segs.en: and the place of whose whereness eyes perceive not.
It is Thou
who hast no bounds, lest Thou be bounded,
who art not exemplified, lest Thou be found,
who dost not beget, lest Thou be begotten.
It is Thou
with whom there is no opposite, lest it contend with Thee,
who hast no equal, lest it vie with Thee,
who hast no rival, lest it resist Thee.
It is Thou
who art He who began, devised,
brought forth, originated,
and made well all that He made.
Glory be to Thee!
How majestic is Thy station!
How high Thy place among the places!
How cleanly Thy Separator cleaves with the truth!
Glory be to Thee!
The Gentle - how gentle Thou art!
The Clement - how clement Thou art!
The Wise - how knowing Thou art!
Glory be to Thee!
The King - how invincible Thou art!
The Munificent - how full of plenty Thou art!
The Elevated - how elevated Thou art!
Possessor of radiance and glory,
magnificence and praise!
Glory be to Thee!
Thou hast stretched forth Thy hand with good things,
and from Thee guidance has come to be known,

segs.ar: فَمَنِ الْتَمَسَكَ لِدِيْنٍ اَوْ دُنْيَا وَجَدَكَ
segs.en: so he who begs from Thee religion or this world will find Thee.
Glory be to Thee!

segs.ar: خَضَعَ لَكَ مَنْ جَرٰى فِىْ عِلْمِكَ
segs.en: Whatever passes in Thy knowledge is subjected to Thee,

segs.ar: وَ خَشَعَ لِعَظَمَتِكَ مَا دُوْنَ عَرْشِكَ
segs.en: all below Thy Throne are humbled before Thy mightiness,
and every one of Thy creatures follows Thee in submission.
Glory be to Thee!
Thou art not sensed, nor touched,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تُمَسُّ وَ لَا تُكَادُ
segs.en: nor felt, nor beguiled,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تُمَاطُ وَ لَا تُنَازَعُ
segs.en: nor held back, nor challenged,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تُجَارٰى وَ لَا تُمَارٰى
segs.en: nor kept up with, nor resisted,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تُخَادَعُ وَ لَا تُمَاكَرُ
segs.en: nor deceived, nor circumvented.
Glory be to Thee!
Thy path is smooth ground,
Thy command right guidance,
and Thou art a living, eternal refuge.
Glory be to Thee!
Thy word is decisive,
Thy decree unfailing,
Thy will resolute.
Glory be to Thee!
None can reject Thy wish,
none can change Thy words.
Glory be to Thee,
Out-dazzling in signs,
Creator of the heavens,
Author of the spirits!
To Thee belongs praise, a praise that will be permanent with Thy permanence!

segs.ar: وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا خَالِدًا بِنِعْمَتِكَ
segs.en: To Thee belongs praise, a praise everlasting through Thy favour!

segs.ar: وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا يُوَازِىْ صُنْعَكَ
segs.en: To Thee belongs praise, a praise that will parallel Thy benefaction!

segs.ar: وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا يَزِيْدُ عَلٰى رِضَاكَ
segs.en: To Thee belongs praise, a praise that will increase Thy good pleasure!

segs.ar: وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا مَعَ حَمْدِ كُلِّ حَامِدٍ
segs.en: To Thee belongs praise, a praise along with the praise of every praiser

segs.ar: وَ شُكْرًا يَقْصُرُ عَنْهُ شُكْرُ كُلِّ شَاكِرٍ
segs.en: and a thanksgiving before which falls short the thanksgiving of every thanksgiver;
a praise which is suitable for none but Thee

segs.ar: وَ لَا يَتَقَرَّبُ بِهٖ اِلاَّ اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: and through which nearness is sought to none but Thee;
a praise which will make permanent the first [bounty]
and call forth the permanence of the last;
a praise which will multiply through recurrence of times
and increase through successive doublings;
a praise which the guardians will not be able to number

segs.ar: وَ يَزِيْدُ عَلٰى مَا اَحْصَتْهُ فِيْ كِتَابِكَ الْكَتَبَةُ
segs.en: and which exceeds what the writers number in Thy Book;
a praise which will counterbalance Thy glorious Throne
and equal Thy elevated Footstool;
a praise whose reward with Thee will be complete
and whose recompense will comprise every recompense;
a praise whose outward conforms to its inward,
and whose inward conforms to correct intention;
a praise with whose like no creature has praised Thee

segs.ar: وَ لَا يَعْرِفُ اَحَدٌ سِوَاكَ فَضْلَه
segs.en: and whose excellence none knows but Thou;

segs.ar: حَمْدًا يُعَانُ مَنِ اجْتَهَدَ فِيْ تَعْدِيْدِهٖ
segs.en: a praise in which he who strives to multiply Thy praise will be helped

segs.ar: وَيُؤَيَّدُ مَنْ اَغْرَقَ نَزْعًا فِىْ تَوْفِيَتِهٖ
segs.en: and he who draws the bow to the utmost in fulfilling it will be confirmed;

segs.ar: حَمْدًا يَجْمَعُ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنَ الْحَمْدِ
segs.en: a praise which will gather all the praise which Thou hast created

segs.ar: وَ يَنْتَظِمُ مَا اَنْتَ خَالِقُه مِنْۢ بَعْدُ
segs.en: and tie together all which Thou wilt afterwards create;

segs.ar: حَمْدًا لَا حَمْدَ اَقْرَبُ اِلٰى قَوْلِكَ مِنْهُ
segs.en: a praise than which no praise is nearer to Thy word

segs.ar: وَ لَا اَحْمَدُ مِمَّنْ يَحْمَدُكَ بِهٖ
segs.en: and than which none is greater from any who praise Thee;
a praise whose fullness will obligate increase through Thy generosity

segs.ar: وَ تَصِلُه بِمَزِيْدٍ بَعْدَ مَزِيْدٍ طَوْلًا مِنْكَ
segs.en: and to which Thou wilt join increase after increase as graciousness from Thee;
a praise that will befit the generosity of Thy face
and meet the might of Thy majesty!

segs.ar: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدِ
segs.en: My Lord, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
the distinguished, the chosen,
the honoured, the brought nigh,
with the most excellent of Thy blessings,
benedict him with the most complete of Thy benedictions,
and have mercy upon him with the most enjoyable of Thy mercies!

segs.ar: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِهٖ صَلٰوةً
segs.en: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his Household with a fruitful blessing,

segs.ar: زَاكِيَةً لَا تَكُوْنُ صَلٰوةٌ اَزْكٰى مِنْهَا وَ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلٰوةً
segs.en: more fruitful than which there is no blessing! Bless him with a growing blessing,

segs.ar: نَامِيَةً لَا تَكُوْنُ صَلٰوةٌ اَنْمٰى مِنْهَا
segs.en: more growing than which there is no blessing!
And bless him with a pleasing blessing,
beyond which there is no blessing!

segs.ar: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِهٖ صَلٰوةً
segs.en: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his Household with a blessing
which will please him and increase his good pleasure!

segs.ar: وَ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلٰوةً تُرْضِيْكَ وَ تَزِيْدُ عَلٰى رِضَاكَ لَه
segs.en: Bless him with a blessing which will please Thee and increase Thy good pleasure toward him!
And bless him with a blessing
through other than which Thou wilt not be pleased for him,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تَرٰى غَيْرَه لَهَا اَهْلًا
segs.en: and for which Thou seest no one else worthy!

segs.ar: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِهٖ
segs.en: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his Household with a blessing which
will pass beyond Thy good pleasure,
be continuous in its continuity through Thy subsistence,

segs.ar: وَ لَا يَنْفَدُ كَمَا لَا تَنْفَدُ كَلِمَاتُكَ
segs.en: and never be spent, just as Thy words will never be spent!

segs.ar: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِهٖ صَلٰوةً
segs.en: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his Household with a blessing which will

segs.ar: تَنْتَظِمُ صَلَوٰاتِ مَلَآئِكَتِكَ وَ اَنْبِيَآئِكَ وَ رُسُلِكَ وَ اَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ
segs.en: tie together the blessings of Thy angels, Thy prophets, Thy messengers, and those who obey Thee,

segs.ar: وَ تَشْتَمِلُ عَلٰى صَلَوٰاتِ عِبَادِكَ مِنْ جِنِّكَ وَ اِنْسِكَ وَ اَهْلِ اِجَابَتِكَ
segs.en: comprise the blessings of Thy servants, jinn or mankind, and those worthy of Thy response,

segs.ar: وَ تَجْتَمِعُ عَلٰى صَلٰوةِ كُلِّ مَنْ ذَرَاْتَ وَ بَرَاْتَ مِنْ اَصْنَافِ خَلْقِكَ
segs.en: and bring together the blessings of every one of the kinds of Thy creatures which Thou hast sown and authored!

segs.ar: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهٖ صَلٰوةً تُحِيْطُ بِكُلِّ صَلٰوةٍ سَالِفَةٍ وَّ مُسْتَانَفَةٍ
segs.en: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his Household with a blessing which will encompass every blessing, bygone and new!

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلٰى اٰلِهٖ صَلٰوةً مَرْضِيَّةً لَكَ وَ لِمَنْ دُوْنَكَ
segs.en: Bless him and his Household with a blessing which is pleasing to Thee and everyone below Thee
and will bring forth with all that a blessing
with which Thou wilt multiply those blessings

segs.ar: وَ تَزِيْدُهَا عَلٰى كُرُوْرِ الْاَيَّامِ زِيَادَةً فِىْ تَضَاعِيْفَ لَا يَعُدُّهَا غَيْرُكَ
segs.en: and increase them through the recurrence of days with an increasing in multiples which none can count but Thou!

segs.ar: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى اَطَآئِبِ اَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
segs.en: My Lord, bless the best of his Household, those whom Thou hast
chosen for Thy command,
appointed the treasurers of Thy knowledge,
the guardians of Thy religion,
Thy vicegerents in Thy earth,
and Thy arguments against Thy servants,

segs.ar: وَ طَهَّرْتَهُمْ مِنَ الرِّجْسِ وَ الدَّنَسِ تَطْهِيْرًا بِاِرَادَتِكَ
segs.en: purified from uncleanness and defilement through a purification by Thy desire,

segs.ar: وَ جَعَلْتَهُمُ الْوَسِيْلَةَ اِلَيْكَ وَ الْمَسْلَكَ اِلٰى جَنَّتِكَ
segs.en: and made the mediation to Thee and the road to Thy Garden!

segs.ar: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِهٖ صَلٰوةً
segs.en: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his Household with a blessing which

segs.ar: تُجْزِلُ لَهُمْ بِهَا مِنْ نِحَلِكَ وَ كَرَامَتِكَ
segs.en: makes plentiful Thy gifts and generosity,

segs.ar: وَ تُكْمِلُ لَهُمُ الْاَشْيَآءَ مِنْ عَطَايَاكَ وَ نَوَافِلِكَ
segs.en: perfects for them Thy bestowals and awards,

segs.ar: وَ تُوَفِّرُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْحَظَّ مِنْ عَوَآئِدِكَ وَ فَوَآئِدِكَ
segs.en: and fills out their share of Thy kindly acts and benefits!

segs.ar: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلٰوةً
segs.en: My Lord, bless him and his Household with a blessing
whose first has no term,
whose term has no limit,
and whose last has no utmost end!
My Lord, bless them to
the weight of Thy Throne and all below it,

segs.ar: وَ مِلْاَ سَمٰوَاتِكَ وَ مَا فَوْقَهُنَّ
segs.en: the amount that fills the heavens and all above them,

segs.ar: وَ عَدَدَ اَرْضِيْكَ وَ مَا تَحْتَهُنَّ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُنَّ صَلٰوةً
segs.en: the number of Thy earths and all below and between them, a blessing that will
bring them near to Thee in proximity,

segs.ar: وَ تَكُوْنُ لَكَ وَ لَهُمْ رِضًى
segs.en: please Thee and them,
and be joined to its likes forever!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّكَ اَيَّدْتَ دِيْنَكَ فِىْ كُلِّ اَوَانٍ بِاِمَامٍ اَقَمْتَه
segs.en: O Allah, surely Thou hast confirmed Thy religion in all times with an Imam whom Thou hast

segs.ar: عَلَمًا لِعِبَادِكَ وَ مَنَارًا فِىْ بِلَادِكَ
segs.en: set up as a guidepost to Thy servants and a lighthouse in Thy lands,
after his cord has been joined to Thy cord!
Thou hast appointed him the means to Thy good pleasure,
made obeying him obligatory,
cautioned against disobeying him,
and commanded
following his commands,
abandoning his prohibitions,
and that no forward-goer go ahead of him
or back-keeper keep back from him!
So he is the preservation of the shelter-seekers,
the cave of the faithful,
the handhold of the adherents,
and the radiance of the worlds!
O Allah,

segs.ar: فَاَوْزِعْ لِوَلِيِّكَ شُكْرَ مَا اَنْعَمْتَ بِهٖ عَلَيْهِ
segs.en: so inspire Thy guardian to give thanks for that in which Thou hast favoured him,
inspire us with the like concerning him,

segs.ar: وَ اٰتِهٖ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطَانًا نَصِيْرًا
segs.en: grant him an authority from Thee to help him,
open for him an easy opening,
aid him with Thy mightiest pillar,
brace up his back,
strengthen his arm,
guard him with Thy eye,
defend him with Thy safeguarding,
help him with Thy angels,
and assist him with Thy most victorious troops!

segs.ar: وَ اَقِمْ بِهٖ كِتَابَكَ وَ حُدُوْدَكَ
segs.en: Through him establish Thy Book, Thy bounds, Thy laws,

segs.ar: وَ شَرَآئِعَكَ وَ سُنَنَ رَسُوْلِكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهٖ
segs.en: and the norms of Thy Messenger's Sunna (Thy blessings, O Allah, be upon him and his Household),

segs.ar: وَ اَحْىِ بِهٖ مَا اَمَاتَهُ الظَّالِمُوْنَ مِنْ مَعَالِمِ دِيْنِكَ
segs.en: bring to life the guideposts of Thy religion, deadened by the wrongdoers,

segs.ar: وَاجْلُ بِهٖ صَدَآءَ الْجَوْرِ عَنْ طَرِيْقَتِكَ
segs.en: burnish the rust of injustice from Thy way,

segs.ar: وَ اَبِنْۢ بِهِ الضَّرَّآءَ مِنْ سَبِيْلِكَ
segs.en: sift the adversity from Thy road,

segs.ar: وَ اَزِلْ بِهِ النَّاكِبِيْنَ عَنْ صِرَاطِكَ
segs.en: eliminate those who deviate from Thy path,

segs.ar: وَ امْحَقْ بِهٖ بُغَاةَ قَصْدِكَ عِوَجًا
segs.en: and erase those who seek crookedness in Thy straightness!
Make his side mild toward Thy friends,
stretch forth his hand over Thy enemies,

segs.ar: وَ هَبْ لَنَا رَأفَتَه وَ رَحْمَتَه وَ تَعَطُّفَه وَ تَحَنُّنَه
segs.en: give us his clemency, his mercy, his tenderness, his sympathy,
and make us
his hearers and obeyers,
strivers toward his good pleasure,

segs.ar: وَ اِلٰى نُصْرَتِهٖ وَالْمُدَافَعَةِ عَنْهُ مُكـْنِغِيْنَ
segs.en: assistants in helping him and defending him,

segs.ar: وَ اِلَيْكَ وَ اِلٰى رَسُوْلِكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ بِذٰلِكَ مُتَقَرِّبِيْنَ
segs.en: and brought near through that to Thee and Thy Messenger (Thy blessings, O Allah, be upon him and his Household).
O Allah, and bless the friends [of the Imams],
the confessors of their station,
the keepers to their course,
the pursuers of their tracks,
the clingers to their handhold,
the adherents to their guardianship,
the followers of their imamate,
the submitters to their command,
the strivers to obey them,
the awaiters of their days,
the directors of their eyes toward them,
with blessings blessed, pure, growing,
fresh, and fragrant!

segs.ar: وَ سَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ عَلٰى اَرْوَاحِهِمْ
segs.en: Give them and their spirits peace,
bring together their affair in reverential fear,
set right their situations,
turn toward them,

segs.ar: اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ وَ خَيْرُ الْغَافِرِيْنَ
segs.en: Surely Thou art Ever-turning, All-compassionate and the Best of forgivers,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا مَعَهُمْ فِىْ دَارِ السَّلَامِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
segs.en: and place us with them in the Abode of Peace, through Thy mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!
O Allah, this is the Day of Arafah,

segs.ar: يَوْمٌ شَرَّفْتَه وَ كَرَّمْتَه وَ عَظَّمْتَه
segs.en: a day which Thou hast made noble, given honour, and magnified.
Within it Thou hast spread Thy mercy,
showed kindness through Thy pardon,
and made plentiful Thy giving,
and by it Thou hast been bounteous toward Thy servants.
O Allah, I am Thy servant whom

segs.ar: اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قَبْلَ خَلْقِكَ لَه وَ بَعْدَ خَلْقِكَ اِيَّاهُ فَجَعَلْتَه مِمَّنْ
segs.en: Thou favoured before creating him and after creating him. Thou madest him one of those whom Thou
guided to Thy religion,
gavest success in fulfilling Thy right,
preserved through Thy cord,
included within Thy party,

segs.ar: وَ اَرْشَدْتَه لِمُوَالَاةِ اَوْلِيَآئِكَ وَ مُعَادَاةِ اَعْدَآئِكَ
segs.en: and directed aright to befriend Thy friends and show enmity to Thine enemies.
Then Thou commanded him, but he did not follow Thy commands,
Thou restricted Him, but he did not heed Thy restrictions,
Thou prohibited him from disobedience toward Thee,
but he broke Thy command by doing what Thou hadst prohibited,

segs.ar: لَا مُعَانَدَةً لَكَ وَ لَا اسْتِكْبَارًا عَلَيْكَ بَلْ
segs.en: not in contention with Thee, nor to display pride toward Thee; on the contrary,

segs.ar: دَعَاهُ هَوَاهُ اِلٰى مَا زَيَّلْتَه وَ اِلٰى مَا حَذَّرْتَه
segs.en: his caprice called him to that which Thou hadst set apart and cautioned against,

segs.ar: وَ اَعَانَه عَلٰى ذٰلِكَ عَدُوُّكَ وَ عَدُوُّه فَاَقْدَمَ عَلَيهِ
segs.en: and he was helped in that by Thy enemy and his enemy. So he went ahead with it
knowing Thy threat,
hoping for Thy pardon,
and relying upon Thy forbearance,

segs.ar: وَ كَانَ اَحَقَّ عِبَادِكَ مَعَ مَا مَنَنْتَ عَلَيْهِ اَلاَّ يَفْعَلَ
segs.en: though he was the most obligated of Thy servants - given Thy kindness toward him - not to do so.

segs.ar: وَ هَا اَنَا ذَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
segs.en: Here I am, then, before Thee,
despised, lowly, humble,
abject, fearful,

segs.ar: مُعْتَرِفًاۢ بِعَظِيْمٍ مِّنَ الذُّنُوْبِ تَحَمَّلْتُه وَ جَلِيْلِ مِّنَ الْخَطَايَا اجْتَرَمْتَه
segs.en: confessing the dreadful sins with which I am burdened and the great offenses that I have committed,
seeking sanctuary in Thy forgiveness,
asking shelter in Thy mercy,

segs.ar: مُوْقِنًا اَنَّه لَا يُجِيْرُنِى مِنْكَ مُجِيْرٌ وَ لَا يَمْنَعُنِىْ مِنْكَ مَانِعٌ
segs.en: and certain that no sanctuary-giver will give me sanctuary from Thee and no withholder will hold me back from Thee.

segs.ar: فَعُدْ عَلَىَّ بِمَا تَعُوْدُ بِهٖ عَلٰى مَنِ اقْتَرَفَ مِنْ تَغَمُّدِكَ
segs.en: So act kindly toward me, just as Thou actest kindly by Thy shielding him who commits sins,

segs.ar: وَجُدْ عَلَىَّ بِمَا تَجُوْدُ بِهٖ عَلٰى مَنْ اَلْقٰى بِيَدِهٖ اِلَيْكَ مِنْ عَفْوِكَ
segs.en: be munificent toward me, just as Thou art munificent by pardoning him who throws himself before Thee,

segs.ar: وَامْنُنْ عَلَىَّ بِمَا لَا يَتَعَاظَمُكَ اَنْ تَمُنَّ بِهٖ عَلٰى مَنْ اَمَّلَكَ مِنْ غُفْرَانِكَ
segs.en: and show kindness to me, just as it is nothing great for Thee to show kindness by forgiving him who expectantly hopes in Thee!

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ لِىْ فِىْ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ نَصِيْبًا اَنَالُ بِهٖ حَظًّا مِنْ رِضْوَانِكَ
segs.en: Appoint for me in this day an allotment through which I may attain a share of Thy good pleasure,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تَرُدَّنِىْ صِفْرًا مِمَّا يَنْقَلِبُ بِهِ الْمُتَعَبِّدُوْنَ لَكَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
segs.en: and send me not back destitute of that with which Thy worshipers return from among Thy servants!

segs.ar: وَ اِنِّىْ وَ اِنْ لَّمْ اُقَدِّمْ مَا قَدَّمُوْهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحَاتِ فَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ
segs.en: Though I have not forwarded the righteous deeds which they have forwarded,

segs.ar: تَوْحِيْدَكَ وَ نَفْىَ الْاَضْدَادِ وَ الْاَنْدَادِ وَ الْاَشْبَاهِ عَنْكَ
segs.en: I have forwarded the profession of Thy Unity and the negation from Thee of opposites, rivals, and likenesses,

segs.ar: وَ اَتَيْتَكَ مِنَ الْاَبْوِابِ الَّتِىْ اَمَرْتَ اَنْ تُؤْتٰى مِنْهَا
segs.en: I have come to Thee by the gateways by which Thou hast commanded that people come,

segs.ar: وَ تَقَرَّبْتُ اِلَيْكَ بِمَا لَا يَقْرُبُ اَحَدٌ مِّنْكَ اِلاَّ بِالتَّقَرُّبِ بِهٖ
segs.en: and I have sought nearness to Thee through that without seeking nearness through which none gains nearness to Thee.
Then I followed all this
with repeated turning toward Thee,
lowliness and abasement before Thee,
opinion of Thee,
and trust in what is with Thee;

segs.ar: وَ شَفَعَتُه بِرَجَآئِكَ الَّذِىْ قَلَّ مَا يَخِيْبُ عَلَيْهِ رَاجِيْكَ
segs.en: and to that I coupled hope in Thee, since the one who hopes in Thee is seldom disappointed!
I asked Thee with the asking of one

segs.ar: الْحَقِيْرِ الذَّلِيْلِ الْبَائِسِ الْفَقِيْرِ الْخَآئِفِ الْمُسْتَجِيْرِ
segs.en: vile, lowly, pitiful, poor, fearful, seeking sanctuary;

segs.ar: وَ مَعَ ذٰلِكَ خِيْفَةً وَّ تَضَرُّعًا
segs.en: all that in fear and pleading
seeking refuge and asking shelter,
not presumptuous through the pride of the proud,
nor exalting myself with the boldness of the obedient,
nor presumptuous of the intercession of the interceders.
For I am still
the least of the least
and the lowliest of the lowly,
like a dust mote or less!
O He who does not hurry the evildoers
nor restrain those living in ease!

segs.ar: وَ يَا مَنْ يَمُنُّ بِاِقَالَةِ الْعَاثِرِيْنَ
segs.en: O He who shows kindness through releasing the stumblers
and gratuitous bounty through respiting the offenders!
I am the evildoer, the confessor, the offender, the stumbler!
I am he who was audacious toward Thee as one insolent!
I am he who disobeyed Thee with forethought!

segs.ar: اَنَا الَّذِىْ اسْتَخْفٰى مِنْ عِبَادِكَ وَ بَارَزَكَ
segs.en: I am he who hid myself from Thy servants and blatantly showed myself to Thee!

segs.ar: اَنَا الَّذِىْ هَابَ عِبَادِكَ وَ اَمِنَكَ
segs.en: I am he who was awed by Thy servants and felt secure from Thee!
I am he who dreaded not Thy penalty
and feared not Thy severity!
I am the offender against himself!
I am the hostage to his own affliction!
I am short in shame!
I am long in suffering!
By the right of him whom Thou hast distinguished among Thy creation
and by him whom Thou hast chosen for Thyself!
By the right of him whom Thou hast selected from among Thy creatures
and by him whom Thou hast picked for Thy task!
By the right of him the obeying of whom Thou hast joined to obeying Thee,
and by him the disobeying of whom Thou hast made like disobeying Thee!
And by the right of him whose friendship Thou hast bound to Thy friendship
and by him whose enmity Thou hast linked to Thine enmity!

segs.ar: تَغَمَّدْنِىْ فِىْ يَوْمِىْ هٰذَا بِمَا تَتَغَمَّدُ بِهٖ مَنْ
segs.en: Shield me in this day of mine, by that through which Thou shieldest
him who prays fervently to Thee while disavowing
and him who seeks refuge in Thy forgiveness while repenting!

segs.ar: وَ تَوَلَّنِىْ بِمَا تَتَوَلّٰى بِهٖ اَهْلَ طَاعَتِكَ وَ الزُّلْفَىْ لَدَيْكَ وَ الْمَكَانَةِ مِنْكَ
segs.en: Attend to me with that through which Thou attendest to the people of obedience toward Thee, proximity to Thee, and rank with Thee!

segs.ar: وَ تَوَحَّدْنِىْ بِمَا تَتَوَحَّدُ بِهٖ مَنْ
segs.en: Single me out, as Thou singlest him out who
fulfils Thy covenant,
fatigues himself for Thy sake alone,
and exerts himself in Thy good pleasure!
Take me not to task for
my neglect in respect to Thee,
my transgressing the limit in Thy bounds,
and stepping outside Thy ordinances!
Draw me not on little by little by granting me a respite,

segs.ar: اسْتِدْرَاجَ مَنْ مَنَعَنِىْ خَيْرَ مَا عِنْدَه وَ لَمْ يَشْرَكْكَ فِىْ حُلُوْلِ نِعْمَتِهٖ بِىْ
segs.en: like the drawing on little by little of him who withholds from me the good he has by not sharing with Thee in letting favour down upon me!
Arouse me from
the sleep of the heedless,
the slumber of the prodigal,
and the dozing of the forsaken!
Take my heart to that in which Thou hast
employed the devout,
enthralled the worshipers,
and rescued the remiss!
Give me refuge from that which will
keep me far from Thee,

segs.ar: وَ يَحُوْلُ بَيْنِىْ وَبَيْنَ حَظِّىْ مِنْكَ
segs.en: come between me and my share from Thee,
and bar me from that which I strive for in Thee!
Make easy for me
the road of good deeds toward Thee,

segs.ar: وَ الْمُسَابَقَةَ اِلَيْهَا مِنْ حَيْثُ اَمَرْتَ
segs.en: racing to them from where Thou hast commanded,

segs.ar: وَ الْمُشَاحَّةَ فِيْهَا عَلٰى مَآ اَرَدْتَ
segs.en: and coveting them as Thou desirest!

segs.ar: وَ لَا تَمْحَقْنِىْ فِيْمَنْ تَمْحَقُ مِنَ الْمُسْتَخِفِّيْنَ بِمَآ اَوْعَدْتَ
segs.en: Efface me not along with those whom Thou effacest for thinking lightly of what Thou hast promised!

segs.ar: وَ لَا تُهْلِكْنِىْ مَعَ مَنْ تُهْلِكُ مِنَ الْمُتَعَرِّضِيْنَ لِمَقْتِكَ
segs.en: Destroy me not with those whom Thou destroyest for exposing themselves to Thy hate!

segs.ar: وَ لَا تُتَبِّرْنِىْ فِىْ مَنْ تُتَبِّرُ مِنَ الْمُنْحَرِفِيْنَ عَنْ سُبُلِكَ
segs.en: Annihilate me not among those whom Thou annihilatest for deviating from Thy roads!
Deliver me from the floods of trial,
save me from the gullets of affliction,
and grant me sanctuary from being seized by respite!
Come between me and the
enemy who misguides me,
the caprice which ruins me,
and the failing which overcomes me!

segs.ar: وَلَا تُعْرِضْ عَنِّىْ اِعْرَاضَ مَنْ لَا تَرْضٰى عَنْهُ بَعْدَ غَضَبِكَ
segs.en: Turn not away from me with the turning away in wrath from one with whom Thou art not pleased!

segs.ar: وَلَا تُوْيِسْنِىْ مِنَ الْاَمَلِ فِيْكَ فَيَغْلِبَ عَلَىَّ الْقُنُوْطُ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ
segs.en: Let me not lose heart in expecting from Thee, lest I be overcome by despair of Thy mercy!

segs.ar: وَلَا تَمْنِحْنِىْ بِمَا لَا طَاقَةَ لِىْ بِهٖ فَتَهْبِطََنِىْ مِمَّّا تُحَمِّلُنِيْهِ مِنْ فَضْلِ مَحَبَّتِكَ
segs.en: Grant me not that which I cannot endure, lest Thou weighest me down with the surplus of Thy love which Thou loadest upon me!

segs.ar: وَلَا تُرْسِلْنِىْ مِنْ يَدِكَ اِرْسَالَ مَنْ
segs.en: Send me not from Thy hand, the sending of him
who possesses no good,
toward whom Thou hast no need,
and who turns not back [to Thee]!
Cast me not with the casting of him who has
fallen from the eye of Thy regard

segs.ar: وَ مَنِ اشْتَمَلَ عَلَيْهِ الْخِزْىُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ
segs.en: and been wrapped in degradation from Thee!
Rather take my hand [and save me] from
the falling of the stumblers,
the disquiet of the deviators,
the slip of those deluded,
and the plight of the perishers!

segs.ar: وَ عَافِنِىْ مِمَّا ابْتَلَيْتَ بِهٖ طَبَقَاتِ عَبِيْدِكَ وَ اِمَآئِكَ
segs.en: Release me from that with which Thou hast afflicted the ranks of Thy servants and handmaids
and make me reach the utmost degrees of him
about whom Thou art concerned,
towards whom Thou showest favour,
and with whom Thou art pleased,
so that Thou lettest him live as one praiseworthy
and takest him to Thee as one felicitous!
Collar me with the collar of abstaining from that which
makes good deeds fail
and takes away blessings!
Impart to my heart restraint before
ugly works of evil
and disgraceful misdeeds!

segs.ar: وَلَا تَشْغَلْنِىْ بِمَا لَا اُدْرِكُه اِلاَّ بِكَ عَمَّا لَا يُرْضِيْكَ عَنِّىْ غَيْرُه
segs.en: Divert me not by that which I cannot reach except through Thee from doing that which alone makes Thee pleased with me!

segs.ar: وَانْزِعْ مِنْ قَلْبِىْ حُبَّ دُنْيَا دَنِيَّةٍ
segs.en: Root out from my heart the love of this vile world,
which keeps from everything which is with Thee,

segs.ar: وَ تَصُدُّ عَنِ ابْتِغَآءِ الْوَسِيْلَةِ اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: bars from seeking the mediation to Thee,
and distracts from striving for nearness to Thee!

segs.ar: وَ زَيِّنْ لِىْ التَّفَرُّدَ بِمُنَاجَاتِكَ بِاللَّيْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ
segs.en: Embellish for me solitude in prayer whispered to Thee by night and by day!
Give me a preservation which will
bring me close to dread of Thee,
cut me off from committing things made unlawful by Thee,
and spare me from captivation by dreadful sins!

segs.ar: وَ هَبْ لِىْ التَّطْهِيْرَ مِنْ دَنَسِ الْعِصْيَانِ
segs.en: Give me purification from the defilement of disobedience,
take away from me the filth of offenses,
dress me in the dress of Thy well-being,
cloak me in the cloak of Thy release,
wrap me in Thy ample favours,

segs.ar: وَ ظَاهِرْ لَدَىَّ فَضْلَكَ وَ طَوْلَكَ
segs.en: and clothe me in Thy bounty and Thy graciousness!
Strengthen me with Thy giving success and Thy pointing the right way,

segs.ar: وَ اَعِنِّىْ عَلٰى صَالِحَ النِّيَّةِ وَ مَرْضِىِّ الْقَوْلِ وَ مُسْتَحْسَنِ الْعَمَلِ
segs.en: help me toward righteous intention, pleasing words, and approved works,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تَكِـلْنِىْ اِلٰى حَوْلِىْ وَ قُوَّتِىْ دُوْنَ حَوْلِكَ وَ قُوَّتِكَ
segs.en: and entrust me not to my force and my strength in place of Thy force and Thy strength!

segs.ar: وَ لَا تُخْزِنِىْ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُنِىْ لِلِقَآئِكَ
segs.en: Degrade me not on the day Thou raisest me up to meet Thee,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تَقْضِحْنِىْ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ اَوْلِيَآئِكَ
segs.en: disgrace me not before Thy friends,
make me not forget remembering Thee,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تُذْهِبْ عَنِّىْ شُكْرَكَ بَلْ اَلْزِمْنِيْهِ فِىْ اَحْوَالِ السَّهْوِ عِنْدَ غَفَلَاتِ الْجَاهِلِيْنَ لِاٰلَآئِكَ
segs.en: take not away from me thanking Thee, but enjoin it upon me in states of inattention when the ignorant are heedless of Thy boons,

segs.ar: وَ اَوْزِعْنِىْ اَنْ اُثْنِىَ بِمَا اَوْ لَيْتَنِيْهِ
segs.en: and inspire me to laud what Thou hast done for me
and confess to what Thou hast conferred upon me!

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ رَغْبَتِىْ اِلَيْكَ فَوْقَ رَغْبَةِ الرَّاغِبِيْنَ
segs.en: Place my beseeching Thee above the beseeching of the beseechers

segs.ar: وَ حَمْدِىْ اِيَّاكَ فَوْقَ حَمْدِ الْحَامِدِيْنَ
segs.en: and my praise of Thee above the praise of the praisers!
Abandon me not with my neediness for Thee,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تُهْلِكْنِىْ بِمَا اَسْدَيْتُه اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: destroy me not for what I have done for Thee,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تَجْبَهْنِىْ بِمَا جَبَهْتَ بِهِ الْمُعَانِدِيْنَ لَكَ
segs.en: and slap not my brow with that with which Thou slappest the brow of those who contend with Thee,
for I am submitted to Thee.
I know that the argument is Thine,
that Thou art closest to bounty,
most accustomed to beneficence,
worthy of reverent fear,
and worthy of forgiveness,

segs.ar: وَ اَنَّكَ بِاَنْ تَعْفُوَ اَوْلٰى مِنْكَ بِاَنْ تُعَاقِبَ
segs.en: that Thou art closer to pardoning than to punishing,

segs.ar: وَ اَنَّكَ بِاَنْ تَسْتُرَ اَقْرَبُ مِنْكَ اِلٰى اَنْ تَشْهَرَ
segs.en: and that Thou art nearer to covering over than to making notorious!
Let me live an agreeable life
that will tie together what I want

segs.ar: وَ تَبْلُغُ بِىْ مَآ اُحِبُّ مِنْ حَيْثُ
segs.en: and reach what I love while I
not bring what Thou dislikest

segs.ar: وَ لَا اَرْتَكِبُ مَا نَهَيْتَ عَنْهُ
segs.en: and not commit what Thou hast prohibited;

segs.ar: وَ اَمِتْنِىْ مِيْتَةَ مَنْ يَسْعٰى نُوْرُه بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَ عَنْ يَمِيْنِهٖ
segs.en: and make me die the death of him whose light runs before him and on his right hand!
Abase me before Thyself
and exalt me before Thy creatures,
lower me when I am alone with Thee
and raise me among Thy servants,

segs.ar: وَ اَغْنِنِىْ عَمَّنْ هُوَ غَنِىٌّ عَنِّىْ
segs.en: free me from need for him who has no need of me

segs.ar: وَ زِدْنِىْ اِلَيْكَ فَاقَةً وَّ فَقْرًا
segs.en: and increase me in neediness and poverty toward Thee!
Give me refuge from
the gloating of enemies,
the arrival of affliction,
lowliness and suffering!

segs.ar: تَغَمَّدْنِىْ فِيْمَا اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِ مِنِّىْ بِمَا يَتَغَمَّدُ بِهِ
segs.en: Shield me in what Thou seest from me, the shielding of him who

segs.ar: الْقَادِرُ عَلٰى الْبَطْشِ لَوْ لَا حِلْمُه
segs.en: would have power over violence had he no clemency,

segs.ar: وَ الْاٰخِذُ عَلٰى الْجَرِيْرَةِ لَوْ لَا اَنَاتُه
segs.en: and would seize for misdeeds had he no lack of haste!

segs.ar: وَ اِذَا اَرَدْتَ بِقَوْمٍ فِتْنَةً اَوْ سُوْءً فَنَجِّنِىْ مِنْهَا لِوَاذًا بِكَ
segs.en: When Thou desirest for a people a trial or an evil, deliver me from it, for I seek Thy shelter;

segs.ar: وَ اِذْ لَمْ تُقِمْنِىْ مَقَامَ فَضِيْحَةٍ فِىْ دُنْيَاكَ فَلَا تُقِمْنِىْ مِثْلَه فِىْ اٰخِرَتِكَ
segs.en: and since Thou hast not stood me in the station of disgrace in this world of Thine, stand me not in such a station in the next world of Thine!
Couple for me
the beginnings of Thy kindnesses with their ends
and the ancient of Thy benefits with the freshly risen!

segs.ar: وَ لَا تَمْدُدْ لِىْ مَدًّا يَقْسُوْ مَعَه قَلْبِىْ
segs.en: Prolong not my term with a prolonging through which my heart will harden!

segs.ar: وَ لَا تَقْرَعْنِىْ قَارِعَةً يَذْهَبُ لَهَا بَهَائِىْ
segs.en: Strike me not with a striking that will take away my radiance!

segs.ar: وَ لَا تَسُمْنِىْ خَسِيْسَةً بَصْعُرُ لَهَا قَدْرِىْ وَ لَا نَقِيْصَةً يُجْهَلُ مِنْ اَجْلِهَا مَكـَانِىْ
segs.en: Visit me not with a meanness that will diminish my worth or a decency that will keep my rank unknown!

segs.ar: وَ لَا تُرْعَنِىْ رَوْعَةً اُبْلِسُ بِهَا وَ لَا خِيْفَةً تُوْجِسُ دُوْنَهَا
segs.en: Frighten me not with a fright by which I will despair or a terror through which I will dread,
but make me
stand in awe of Thy threat,
take precautions against Thy leaving no excuses and Thy warning,
and tremble at the recitation of Thy verses!
Fill my night with life by keeping me
awake therein for worshipping Thee,
solitude with vigil for Thee,
exclusive devotion to reliance upon Thee,
setting my needs before Thee,
and imploring that Thou wilt
set my neck free from the Fire

segs.ar: وَ اِجَارَتِىْ مِمَّا فِيْهِ اَهْلُهَا مِنْ عَذَابِكَ
segs.en: and grant me sanctuary from Thy chastisement, within which its inhabitants dwell!
Leave me not blindly wandering in my insolence

segs.ar: وَ لَا فِىْ غَمْرَتِىْ سَاهِيًا حَتّٰى حِيْنٍ
segs.en: or inattentive in my perplexity for a time,
make me not
an admonition to him who takes admonishment,
a punishment exemplary for him who takes heed,
a trial for him who observes,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تَمْكـُرْ بِىْ فِيْمَنْ تَمْكـُرُ بِهٖ
segs.en: devise not against me along with those against whom Thou devisest,
replace me not with another,
change not my name,
transform not my body,
appoint me not
a mockery for Thy creatures,
a laughing-stock for Thyself,
a follower of anything but Thy good pleasure,

segs.ar: وَ لَا مُمْتَهَنًا اِلاَّ بِلْاِنْتِقَامِ لَكَ
segs.en: a menial servant for anything but avenging Thee!
Let me find
the coolness of Thy pardon
and the sweetness of Thy mercy,
Thy repose, Thy ease,
and the garden of Thy bliss!
Let me taste, through some of Thy boundless plenty,

segs.ar: الْفَرَاغِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ بِسَعَةٍ مِنْ سَعَتِكَ
segs.en: the flavour of being free for what Thou lovest

segs.ar: وَالْاِجْتِهَادِ فِيْمَا يُزْلِفُ لَدَيْكَ وَ عِنْدَكَ
segs.en: and striving in what brings about proximity with Thee and to Thee,
and give me a gift from among Thy gifts!
Make my commerce profitable
and my return without loss,
fill me with fear of Thy station,
make me yearn for the meeting with Thee,
and allow me to repent with an unswerving repentance

segs.ar: لَا تُبْقِ مَعَهَا ذُنُوْبًا صَغِيْرَةً وَّ لَا كَبِيْرَةً
segs.en: along with which Thou lettest no sins remain, small or large,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تَذَرْ مَعَهَا عَلَانِيَّةً وَ لَا سَرِيْرَةً
segs.en: and leavest no wrongs, open or secret!
Root out rancour toward the faithful from my breast,
bend my heart toward the humble,

segs.ar: وَ كُنْ لِىْ كَمَا تَكُوْنُ لِلصَّالِحِيْنَ
segs.en: be toward me as Thou art toward the righteous,
adorn me with the adornment of the godfearing,
appoint for me
a goodly report among those yet to come
and a growing remembrance among the later folk,
and take me to the plain of those who came first!
Complete the lavishness of Thy favour upon me,
clothe me in its repeated generosities,
fill my hand with Thy benefits,
drive Thy generous gifts to me,

segs.ar: وَ جَاوِرْ بِىَ الْاطْيَبِيْنَ مِنْ اَوْلِيَآئِكَ فِىْ الْجِنَانِ الَّتِىْ زَيَّنْتَهَا لَاصْفِيَآئِكَ
segs.en: make me the neighbour of the best of Thy friends in the Gardens which Thou hast adorned for Thy chosen,

segs.ar: وَ جَلِّلْنِىْ شَرَآئِفَ نِحَلِكَ فِىْ الْمُقَامَاتِ الْمُعَدَّةِ لِاَحِبَّآئِكَ
segs.en: and wrap me in Thy noble presents in the stations prepared for Thy beloveds!
Appoint for me
a resting place with Thee where I may seek haven in serenity,

segs.ar: وَ مَثَابَةً اَتَبَوَّئُهَا وَ اَقَرُّ عَيْنًا
segs.en: and a resort to which I may revert and rest my eyes,
weigh not against me my dreadful misdeeds,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تُهْلِكْنِىْ يَوْمَ تُبْلِىْ السَّرَآئِرُ
segs.en: destroy me not on the day the secrets are tried,

segs.ar: وَ اَزِلْ عَنِىْ كُلَّ شَكِّ وَ شُبْحَةٍ
segs.en: eliminate from me every doubt and uncertainty,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ لِىْ فِىْ الْحَقَّ طَرِيْقًا مِنْ كُلِّ رَحْمَةٍ
segs.en: appoint for me a way in the truth from every mercy,

segs.ar: وَ اَجْزِلْ لِىْ قِسَمَ الْمَوَاهِبِ مِنْ نَوَالِكَ
segs.en: make plentiful for me the portions of gifts from Thy granting of awards,

segs.ar: وَ وَفِّرْ عَلَىَّ حُظُوْظَ الْاِحْسَانِ مِنْ اِفْضَالِكَ
segs.en: and fill out for me the shares of beneficence from Thy bestowal of bounty!
Make my heart trust in what is with Thee
and my concern free for what is Thine,
employ me in that in which Thou employest Thy pure friends,

segs.ar: وَ اَشْرِبْ قَلْبِي عِنْدَ ذُهُوْلِ الْعُقُوْلِ طَاعَتَكَ
segs.en: drench my heart with Thy obedience when intellects are distracted,
and combine within me
independence, continence,
ease, release,
health, plenty,
tranquility, and well being!

segs.ar: وَ لَا تُحْبِطْ حَسَنَاتِىْ بِمَا يَشُوْبُهَا مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
segs.en: Make not fail my good deeds through my disobedience that stains them

segs.ar: وَ لَا خَلَوَاتِىْ بِمَا يُعْرِضُ لِىْ مِنْ نَزَغَاتِ فِتْنَتِكَ
segs.en: or my private times of worship through the instigations of Thy trial!

segs.ar: وَ صُنْ وَجْهِىْ عَنِ الطَّلَبِ اِلٰىٓ اَحَدٍ مِنَ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
segs.en: Safeguard my face from asking from anyone in the world,

segs.ar: وَذُبَّنِىْ عَنِ الْتِمَاسِ مَا عِنْدَ الْفَاسِقِيْنَ
segs.en: and drive me far from begging for that which is with the ungodly!
Make me not an aid to the wrongdoers,

segs.ar: وَ لَا لَهُمْ عَلٰى مَحْوِكِتَابِكَ يَدًا وَّ نَصِيْرًا
segs.en: nor their hand and helper in erasing Thy Book!

segs.ar: وَحُطْنِىْ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا اَعْلَمُ حِياَطَةٍ تَقِيْنِىْ بِهَا
segs.en: Defend me whence I know not with a defense through which Thou protectest me!

segs.ar: وَافْتَحْ لِىْٓ اَبْوَابَ تَوْبَتِكَ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ رَاْفَتِكَ وَ رِزْقِكَ الْوَاسِعِ
segs.en: Open toward me the gates of Thy repentance, Thy mercy, Thy clemency, and Thy boundless provision!
Surely I am one of those who beseech Thee!
And complete Thy favour toward me!
Surely Thou art the best of those who show favour!

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ بَاقِىَ عُمُرِىْ فِىْ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ ابْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِكَ
segs.en: Place the rest of my life in the hajj and the 'umra seeking Thy face,
O Lord of the worlds!

segs.ar: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهِ الطَّيِّبِيْنَ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ
segs.en: And may Allah bless Muhammad and his Household, the good, the pure,

segs.ar: وَالسَّلامُ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَيْهِمْ اَبَدَ الاٰبِدِيْنَ.
segs.en: and peace be upon him and them always and forever!

S_48.name: 48. On Eid al-Adha and Friday
S_48.nameUr: عید الاضحیٰ اور جمعہ کی دعا

segs.en: O God, this is a blessed, auspicious day,

segs.ar: وَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ فِيهِ مُجْتَمِعُونَ فِي أَقْطَارِ أَرْضِكَ،
segs.tr: wa-l-muslimūna fīhi mujtami‘ūna fī aqṭāri arḍik,
segs.en: and the Muslims are gathered in it in the regions of Your earth,

segs.ar: يَشْهَدُ السَّائِلُ مِنْهُمْ وَ الطَّالِبُ وَ الرَّاغِبُ وَ الرَّاهِبُ
segs.tr: yashhadu s-sā’ilu minhum wa-ṭ-ṭālibu wa-r-rāghibu wa-r-rāhibu
segs.en: the petitioner, the seeker, the desirous, and the dreader are present from among them,
and You are the Looker at their needs,

segs.ar: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِجُودِكَ وَ كَرَمِكَ وَ هَوَانِ مَا سَأَلْتُكَ عَلَيْكَ
segs.tr: fa-as’aluka bi-jūdika wa-karamika wa-hawāni mā sa’altuka ‘alayk
segs.en: so I ask You by Your generosity, Your nobleness, and the ease of what I ask of You upon You,

segs.ar: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
segs.en: to bless Muḥammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْمُلْكَ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ،
segs.tr: wa-as’aluka Allāhumm Rabbanā bi-anna laka l-mulka wa-laka l-ḥamd,
segs.en: And I ask You, O God, our Lord, by the fact that the dominion is Yours and the praise is Yours,

segs.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ الْحَنَّانُ الْمَنَّانُ
segs.tr: lā ilāha illā Ant, al-Ḥalīmu l-Karīmu l-Ḥannānu l-Mannān
segs.en: there is no god but You, the Forbearing, the Noble, the Compassionate, the Bestower,

segs.ar: ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ، بَدِيعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ،
segs.tr: dhū l-jalāl wa-l-ikrām, badī‘u s-samāwāt wa-l-arḍ,
segs.en: Possessor of Majesty and Honor, Originator of the heavens and the earth,
whatever You distribute among Your believing servants

segs.ar: مِنْ خَيْرٍ أَوْ عَافِيَةٍ أَوْ بَرَكَةٍ أَوْ هُدًى أَوْ عَمَلٍ بِطَاعَتِكَ
segs.tr: min khayr aw ‘āfiyatin aw barakatin aw hudā aw ‘amalin bi-ṭā‘atik
segs.en: of good, or well-being, or blessing, or guidance, or action in Your obedience,

segs.ar: أَوْ خَيْرٍ تَمُنُّ بِهِ عَلَيْهِمْ تَهْدِيهِمْ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ
segs.tr: aw khayr tamunnu bihī ‘alayhim tahdīhim bihī ilayk
segs.en: or goodness You bestow upon them, by which You guide them to You,
or You raise a rank for them with You,

segs.ar: أَوْ تُعْطِيهِمْ بِهِ خَيْراً مِنْ خَيْرِ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ
segs.tr: aw tu‘ṭīhim bihī khayran min khayri d-dunyā wa-l-ākhirah
segs.en: or You give them through it good from the good of this world and the Hereafter —

segs.ar: أَنْ تُوَفِّرَ حَظِّي وَ نَصِيبِي مِنْهُ.
segs.en: to increase my share and portion of it.
And I ask You, O God, by the fact that
the dominion and the praise are Yours,
there is no god but You,
to bless Muḥammad,
Your servant and Your messenger,
and Your beloved and Your chosen one,
and Your best selection from Your creation,

segs.ar: وَ عَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَبْرَارِ الطَّاهِرِينَ الْأَخْيَارِ
segs.tr: wa-‘alā āli Muḥammad al-abrār iṭ-ṭāhirīn al-akhyār
segs.en: and upon the Household of Muḥammad, the pious, the pure, the excellent,

segs.ar: صَلَاةً لَا يَقْوَى عَلَى إِحْصَائِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
segs.tr: ṣalātan lā yaqwā ‘alā iḥṣā’ihā illā Ant,
segs.en: a blessing that none can enumerate except You,
and to include us in

segs.ar: صَالِحِ مَنْ دَعَاكَ فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ
segs.tr: ṣāliḥi man da‘āk fī hādhā l-yawm
segs.en: the good of those who supplicated You on this day
of Your believing servants,
O Lord of the Worlds,

segs.ar: وَ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَنَا وَ لَهُمْ
segs.en: and to forgive us and them,
truly You have power over everything.
O God, to You I have directed my need,
and in You I have presented my poverty today,
and my destitution and my wretchedness,

segs.ar: وَ إِنِّي بِمَغْفِرَتِكَ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ أَوْثَقُ مِنِّي بِعَمَلِي
segs.tr: wa-innī bi-maghfiratik wa-raḥmatik awthaqu minnī bi-‘amalī
segs.en: and I am more confident in Your forgiveness and Your mercy than in my own action,

segs.ar: وَ لَمَغْفِرَتُكَ وَ رَحْمَتُكَ أَوْسَعُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
segs.en: and surely Your forgiveness and Your mercy are wider than my sins,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and the Household of Muḥammad,

segs.ar: وَ تَوَلَّ قَضَاءَ كُلِّ حَاجَةٍ هِيَ لِي
segs.tr: wa-tawalla qaḍā’a kulli ḥājatin hiya lī
segs.en: and undertake the fulfilling of every need that is mine,
by Your power over it,
and the ease of that upon You,
and by my poverty toward You,
and Your being free of need for me,

segs.ar: فَإِنِّي لَمْ أُصِبْ خَيْراً قَطُّ إِلَّا مِنْكَ
segs.tr: fa-innī lam uṣib khayran qaṭṭu illā mink,
segs.en: for I have never attained any good at all except from You,

segs.ar: وَ لَمْ يَصْرِفْ عَنِّي سُوءاً قَطُّ أَحَدٌ غَيْرُكَ
segs.tr: wa-lam yaṣrif ‘annī sū’an qaṭṭu aḥadun ghayruk,
segs.en: and no one has ever averted evil from me at all other than You,
and I do not hope for the matter of
my Hereafter and my world except You.
O God, whoever prepares himself, and equips himself,
and makes ready, and makes preparations,
for a delegation to a creature,

segs.ar: رَجَاءَ رِفْدِهِ وَ نَوَافِلِهِ وَ طَلَبَ نَيْلِهِ وَ جَائِزَتِهِ
segs.tr: rajā’a rifdihī wa-nawāfilihī wa-ṭalaba naylihī wa-jā’izatih,
segs.en: hoping for his gift and his supererogatory grants, and seeking his attainment and his prize,
then to You, O my Master, was today
my preparation and my equipping,
and my readiness and my preparations,
hoping for Your pardon and Your gift,
and seeking Your attainment and Your prize.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O God, so bless Muḥammad and the Household of Muḥammad,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تُخَيِّبِ الْيَوْمَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَجَائِي،
segs.tr: wa-lā tukhayyibi l-yawm dhālik min rajā’ī,
segs.en: and do not disappoint that hope of mine today,
O You whom no petitioner tires,
and whom no bestower diminishes,
for I did not come to You trusting
in a righteous action I presented,
and not the intercession of a creature I hoped for,

segs.ar: إِلَّا شَفَاعَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
segs.en: except the intercession of Muḥammad and his Household,
upon him and upon them be Your peace,

segs.ar: أَتَيْتُكَ مُقِرّاً بِالْجُرْمِ وَ الْإِسَاءَةِ إِلَى نَفْسِي
segs.tr: ataytuka muqirran bi-l-jurm wa-l-isā’ati ilā nafsī
segs.en: I came to You confessing the offense and the wrong done to myself,
I came to You hoping for Your great pardon,
by which You pardoned the sinners,

segs.ar: ثُمَّ لَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ طُولُ عُكُوفِهِمْ عَلَى عَظِيمِ الْجُرْمِ
segs.en: and the prolonged devotion of theirs to the grave offense did not prevent You

segs.ar: أَنْ عُدْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِالرَّحْمَةِ وَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ
segs.en: from returning to them with mercy and forgiveness,
so O You whose mercy is vast,
and whose pardon is great,
O Great One, O Great One,
O Noble One, O Noble One,

segs.ar: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: bless Muḥammad and the Household of Muḥammad,
and return to me with Your mercy,
and show me affection with Your favor,
and be vast toward me with Your forgiveness.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا الْمَقَامَ لِخُلَفَائِكَ وَ أَصْفِيَائِكَ
segs.tr: Allāhumm inna hādhā l-maqāma li-khulafā’ika wa-aṣfiyā’ik
segs.en: O God, truly this station belongs to Your Successors (Khulafā’) and Your Chosen Ones (Aṣfiyā’),
and the positions of Your Trustees (Umanā’)

segs.ar: فِي الدَّرَجَةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ الَّتِي اخْتَصَصْتَهُمْ بِهَا
segs.tr: fī d-darajati r-rafī‘ati l-latī khaṣṣaṣtahum bihā
segs.en: in the lofty rank You singled out for them,
they have been usurped from it,
and You are the Ordainer of that,
Your command is not to be overcome,

segs.ar: وَ لَا يُجَاوَزُ الْمَحْتُومُ مِنْ تَدْبِيرِكَ
segs.en: and the predetermined of Your governance is not to be transgressed,
how You willed and whenever You willed,
and for what You know best,

segs.ar: غَيْرُ مُتَّهَمٍ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ وَ لَا لِإِرَادَتِكَ
segs.en: without being accused concerning Your creation or Your will,
until Your chosen ones and Your successors became
defeated, subdued, and usurped,
they see Your judgment changed,
and Your Book abandoned,

segs.ar: وَ فَرَائِضَكَ مُحَرَّفَةً عَنْ جِهَاتِ أَشْرَاعِكَ
segs.en: and Your ordinances distorted from the directions of Your religious laws,
and the practices of Your Prophet abandoned.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ أَعْدَاءَهُمْ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَ الْآخِرِينَ
segs.tr: Allāhumm il‘an a‘dā’ahum min al-awwalīn wa-l-ākhirīn
segs.en: O God, curse their enemies from the former and the latter generations,
and those who were pleased with their deeds,
and their followers and their adherents.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O God, bless Muḥammad and the Household of Muḥammad,
truly You are Praiseworthy (Ḥamīd), Glorious (Majīd),
like Your blessings, and Your benedictions, and Your greetings,

segs.ar: عَلَى أَصْفِيَائِكَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
segs.en: upon Your chosen ones Ibrāhīm and the Household of Ibrāhīm,
and hasten the relief (al-faraj),

segs.ar: وَ الرَّوْحَ وَ النُّصْرَةَ وَ التَّمْكِينَ وَ التَّأْيِيدَ لَهُمْ
segs.en: and the comfort (ar-rawḥ), and the help (an-nuṣrah), and the establishment (at-tamkīn), and the support (at-ta’yīd) for them.
O God, and make me
one of the people of Monotheism (at-tawḥīd),
and faith in You,
and belief in Your Messenger,
and the Imams whose obedience You made obligatory,

segs.ar: مِمَّنْ يَجْرِي ذَلِكَ بِهِ وَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ
segs.tr: mimman yajrī dhālik bihī wa-‘alā yadayh
segs.en: from those by whom and upon whose hands that runs
Amen, O Lord of the Worlds.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ لَيْسَ يَرُدُّ غَضَبَكَ إِلَّا حِلْمُكَ
segs.tr: Allāhumm laysa yaruddu ghaḍabaka illā ḥilmuk,
segs.en: O God, nothing wards off Your anger except Your forbearance,

segs.ar: وَ لَا يَرُدُّ سَخَطَكَ إِلَّا عَفْوُكَ
segs.en: and nothing wards off Your displeasure except Your pardon,

segs.ar: وَ لا يُجِيرُ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَتُكَ
segs.en: and nothing grants refuge from Your punishment except Your mercy,
and nothing saves me from You

segs.ar: إِلَّا التَّضَرُّعُ إِلَيْكَ وَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
segs.en: except humility to You and before You,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and the Household of Muḥammad,

segs.ar: وَ هَبْ لَنَا يَا إِلَهِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فَرَجاً
segs.tr: wa-hab lanā yā Ilāhī min ladunka farajā
segs.en: and grant us, O my God, from Your presence a relief (faraj),

segs.ar: بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتِي بِهَا تُحْيِي أَمْوَاتَ الْعِبَادِ
segs.tr: bi-l-qudrati l-latī bihā tuḥyī amwāta l-‘ibād
segs.en: by the power by which You bring the dead of Your servants back to life,
and by which You spread the dead of the lands,

segs.ar: وَ لَا تُهْلِكْنِي يَا إِلَهِي غَمّاً
segs.en: and do not destroy me, O my God, with grief,
until You answer me,
and let me know the answer to my supplication,

segs.ar: وَ أَذِقْنِي طَعْمَ الْعَافِيَةِ إِلَى مُنْتَهَى أَجَلِي
segs.tr: wa-adhiqnī ṭa‘ma l-‘āfiyati ilā muntahā ajalī
segs.en: and let me taste the savor of well-being (al-‘āfiyah) until the end of my term,
and do not make my enemy gloat over me,
and do not give him power over my neck,
and do not give him authority over me.
My God, if You raise me,
then who is there that can put me down?
And if You put me down,
then who is there that can raise me?
And if You honor me,
then who is there that can disgrace me?
And if You disgrace me,
then who is there that can honor me?
And if You punish me,
then who is there that can have mercy on me?
And if You destroy me,

segs.ar: فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَعْرِضُ لَكَ فِي عَبْدِكَ
segs.tr: fa-man dhā l-ladhī ya‘riḍu lak fī ‘abdik
segs.en: then who is there that can challenge You concerning Your servant,
or ask You about his affair?

segs.ar: وَ قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي حُكْمِكَ ظُلْمٌ
segs.tr: wa-qad ‘alimtu annahū laysa fī ḥukmik ẓulm
segs.en: And I have known that there is no injustice (ẓulm) in Your judgment,
and no haste in Your retribution,

segs.ar: وَ إِنَّمَا يَعْجَلُ مَنْ يَخَافُ الْفَوْتَ
segs.en: and surely only one who fears loss is hasty,

segs.ar: وَ إِنَّمَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى الظُّلْمِ الضَّعِيفُ
segs.en: and surely only the weak is in need of injustice,
and You have been exalted, O my God,
far above that, a great exaltation.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O God, bless Muḥammad and the Household of Muḥammad,
and do not make me a target for tribulation (balā’),
and not an object for Your retribution (naqimah),
and grant me respite, and relieve me,
and overlook my slip,
and do not afflict me with a tribulation
upon the heels of a tribulation,
for You see my weakness,
and the fewness of my resource,
and my humility to You.

segs.ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَ اللَّهُمَّ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ غَضَبِكَ
segs.tr: A‘ūdhu bik Allāhumm al-yawm min ghaḍabik
segs.en: I seek refuge in You, O God, today from Your anger,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَعِذْنِي.
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and grant me refuge.

segs.ar: وَ أَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ
segs.en: And I seek protection in You today from Your displeasure,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَجِرْنِي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and protect me.
And I ask You for security from Your punishment,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ آمِنِّي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and grant me security.
And I seek guidance from You,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اهْدِنِي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and guide me.
And I seek Your help,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ انْصُرْنِي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and help me.
And I seek Your mercy,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ ارْحَمْنِي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and have mercy on me.
And I seek Your sufficiency,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اكْفِنِي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and suffice me.
And I seek provision from You,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ ارْزُقْنِي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and provide for me.
And I seek Your aid,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَعِنِّي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and aid me.

segs.ar: وَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا سَلَفَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
segs.en: And I seek Your forgiveness for what has passed of my sins,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اغْفِرْ لِي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and forgive me.
And I seek infallibility from You,

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اعْصِمْنِي
segs.en: so bless Muḥammad and his Household, and make me infallible.

segs.ar: فَإِنِّي لَنْ أَعُودَ لِشَيْ‏ءٍ كَرِهْتَهُ مِنِّي إِنْ شِئْتَ ذَلِكَ
segs.tr: fa-innī lan a‘ūda li-shay’in karihtahū minnī in shi’ta dhālik
segs.en: For I shall not return to anything You dislike from me, if You will that

segs.ar: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ، يَا حَنَّانُ يَا مَنَّانُ
segs.tr: yā Rabb, yā Rabb, yā Ḥannān, yā Mannān,
segs.en: O Lord, O Lord, O Compassionate One, O Bestower,
O Possessor of Majesty and Honor,
bless Muḥammad and his Household,
and answer for me all
that I have asked of You and requested from You,
and desired of You,

segs.ar: وَ أَرِدْهُ وَ قَدِّرْهُ وَ اقْضِهِ وَ أَمْضِهِ
segs.en: and will it, and decree it, and determine it, and ratify it,

segs.ar: وَ خِرْ لِي فِيمَا تَقْضِي مِنْه
segs.en: and choose the best for me in what You determine of it,
and bless me in that,
and favor me with it,
and make me happy with what You give me of it,
and increase me from Your favor,
and the vastness of what is with You,
for truly You are Vast, Noble,

segs.ar: وَ صِلْ ذَلِكَ بِخَيْرِ الْآخِرَةِ وَ نَعِيمِهَا
segs.en: and connect that with the good of the Hereafter and its bliss,
O Most Merciful of the merciful ones.

segs.ar: تَدْعُو بِمَا بَدَا لَكَ، وَ تُصَلِّي عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ هَكَذَا كَانَ يَفْعَلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
segs.tr: Tad‘ū bi-mā badā lak, wa-tuṣallī ‘alā Muḥammadin wa-ālihī alfa marratin, hākadhā kāna yaf‘alu ‘alayhi s-salām.
segs.en: You supplicate with whatever seems right to you, and you bless Muḥammad and his Household one thousand times. Thus he (peace be upon him) used to do.

S_49.name: 49. In Repelling Enemies' Plots
S_49.nameUr: دشمنوں کے مکر سے بچاؤ کی دعا

segs.en: My God, You guided me, yet I indulged (in heedlessness),
and You admonished, yet I hardened (my heart),
and You showed beautiful favour, yet I disobeyed,
Then I knew what You had issued (the warning)?
When You made me know it, I sought forgiveness, and You overlooked (my fault), yet I returned (to sin),
and You concealed (my fault), so for You, my God, is the praise.
I plunged into the valleys of perdition,

segs.ar: وَحَلَلْتُ شِعَابَ تَلَف تَعَرَّضْتُ فِيهَا لِسَطَوَاتِكَ،
segs.tr: wa-ḥalaltu shi‘āba talaf ta‘arraḍtu fīhā li-saṭawātik,
segs.en: and I settled in the passes of ruin, where I exposed myself to Your assaults,
and to the descent of Your punishments by settling in them,
And my means (of approach) to You is Monotheism (at-tawḥīd),

segs.ar: وَذَرِيْعَتِي أَنِّي لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِكَ شَيْئاً،
segs.tr: wa-dharī‘atī annī lam ushrik bik shay’ā,
segs.en: and my plea is that I did not associate anything with You,
and I did not take any god alongside You,
and I have fled to You with myself,
and to You is the escape of the one who does wrong,
and the refuge of the one who wasted his own portion, the refugee.

segs.ar: فَكَمْ مِنْ عَدُوٍّ انْتَضى عَلَيَّ سَيْفَ عَدَاوَتِهِ،
segs.en: So how many an enemy has unsheathed his sword of enmity against me,
and sharpened the blade of his knife for me,
and made keen the sharpness of its edge for me,
and mixed the deadly poisons of his venom for me,
and aimed the accurate shots of his arrows at me,
and the eye of his guard did not sleep concerning me,

segs.ar: وَأَضْمَرَ أَنْ يَسُومَنِي الْمَكْرُوهَ وَيُجَرِّ عَنِّي زُعَافَ مَرَارَتِهِ،
segs.tr: wa-aḍmara an yasūmanī l-makrūh wa-yujarri ‘annī zu‘āfa marāratih,
segs.en: and he intended to impose evil upon me and to make me swallow the deadly bitterness of his venom –

segs.ar: فَنَظَرْتَ يا إلهِيْ إلَى ضَعْفِي عَنِ احْتِمَـالِ الْفَـوَادِحِ،
segs.tr: fa-naẓarta yā Ilāhī ilā ḍa‘fī ‘ani ḥtimāli l-fawādiḥ,
segs.en: Then You looked, O my God, at my weakness in bearing the calamities,

segs.ar: وَعَجْزِي عَنِ الانْتِصَارِ مِمَّنْ قَصَدَنِيْ بِمُحَارَبَتِهِ،
segs.en: and my incapacity to defend myself against the one who intended to make war on me,

segs.ar: وَوَحْدَتِي فِي كَثِيرِ عَدَدِ مَنْ نَاوَانِيْ
segs.en: and my solitude amid the large number of those who showed me hostility

segs.ar: وَأَرْصَدَ لِيْ بِالْبَلاءِ فِيمَا لَمْ أُعْمِلْ فِيهِ فِكْرِي،
segs.tr: wa-arṣada lī bi-l-balā’ fīmā lam u‘mil fīhi fikrī,
segs.en: and lay in wait for me with tribulation in a matter in which I did not employ my thought—
So You began by granting me Your help,
and You strengthened my back with Your power,
Then You blunted his edge for me,

segs.ar: وَصَيَّرْتَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ جَمْع عَدِيْد وَحْدَهُ،
segs.en: and You made him, after a large gathering, stand alone,
and You raised my heel above him (gave me victory over him),
and You made what he aimed return upon him,
So You drove him back without his having satisfied his rage,
and without his heat of thirst being quenched,
he bit his lips,
and he turned away in retreat, his expeditions having failed.
And how many an oppressor sought to oppress me with his plots,
and set up the net of his traps for me,
and assigned to me the checking of his vigilance,
and lay in wait for me like a wild beast for its quarry,
waiting to seize the opportunity for his prey,
while he displayed to me the cheerfulness of flattery,
and looked at me with intense wrath—

segs.ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتَ يَا إلهِي تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ دَغَلْ سَرِيرَتِهِ،
segs.tr: fa-lammā ra’ayta yā Ilāhī tabārakta wa-ta‘ālayta daghala sarīratih,
segs.en: So when You saw, O my God—blessed and exalted be You—the corruption of his inner being,

segs.ar: وَقُبْحَ مَا انْطَوى عَلَيْهِ، أَرْكَسْتَهُ لاُِمِّ رَأْسِهِ فِي زُبْيَتِهِ،
segs.tr: wa-qubḥa mā nṭawā ‘alayh, arkastahū li-umm rā’sihī fī zubyatih,
segs.en: and the foulness of what he concealed, You made him fall headlong into his own pit,
and You turned him back into the downfall of his own hole,

segs.ar: فَانْقَمَعَ بَعْدَ اسْتِطَالَتِهِ ذَلِيلاً فِي رِبَقِ حِبالتِهِ
segs.tr: fa-nqama‘a ba‘da stiṭālatihī dhalīlan fī ribaq ḥibālatih
segs.en: So he was humbled after his aggression, disgraced in the snares of his own trap

segs.ar: الَّتِي كَانَ يُقَدِّرُ أَنْ يَرَانِي فِيهَا،
segs.tr: allatī kāna yuqaddir an yarānī fīhā,
segs.en: in which he intended to see me,

segs.ar: وَقَدْ كَادَ أَنْ يَحُلَّ بِيْ لَوْلاَ رَحْمَتُكَ مَا حَلَّ بِسَاحَتِهِ.
segs.tr: wa-qad kāda an yaḥulla bī lawlā raḥmatuka mā ḥalla bi-sāḥatih.
segs.en: and what befell his courtyard had nearly fallen upon me, were it not for Your mercy.

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ حَاسِد قَدْ شَرِقَ بِي بِغُصَّتِهِ،
segs.tr: Wa-kam min ḥāsidin qad shariqa bī bi-ghuṣṣatih,
segs.en: And how many an envier (ḥāsid) has choked on account of me with his grief,

segs.ar: وَشَجِيَ مِنِّي بِغَيْظِهِ، وَسَلَقَنِي بِحَدِّ لِسَانِهِ،
segs.tr: wa-shajī minnī bi-ghayẓih, wa-salaqanī bi-ḥaddi lisānih,
segs.en: and suffered on my account with his rage, and stung me with the sharpness of his tongue,
and vexed me by slandering my faults,
and made my honour a target for his aims,
and accused me of qualities that were never absent from him,
and vexed me with his guile, and intended me with his plot—
So I called upon You, O my God, seeking help in You,
confident in the swiftness of Your response,

segs.ar: عَالِماً أَنَّهُ لاَ يُضْطَهَدُ مَنْ آوى إلَى ظِلِّ كَنَفِكَ،
segs.tr: ‘āliman annahū lā yuḍṭahadu man āwā ilā ẓilli kanafika,
segs.en: knowing that no one who takes shelter under the shadow of Your protection will be wronged,

segs.ar: وَلاَ يَفْزَعُ مَنْ لَجَأَ إلَى مَعْقِل انْتِصَارِكَ،
segs.tr: wa-lā yafza‘u man laja’a ilā ma‘qil intiṣārik,
segs.en: and no one who seeks refuge in the stronghold of Your help will be terrified—
So You fortified me against his malice with Your power.

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ سَحَائِبِ مَكْرُوه جَلَّيْتَهَا عَنِّي،
segs.en: And how many clouds of detestable things You cleared away from me,
and clouds of blessings You showered upon me,
and streams of mercy You spread,
and well-being You clothed me in, and eyes of calamities You blinded,
and overpowering distresses You removed,

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ ظَنٍّ حَسَن حَقَّقْتَ، وَعَدَم جَبَرْتَ،
segs.tr: wa-kam min ẓannin ḥasanin ḥaqqaqt, wa-‘adamin jabart,
segs.en: And how many a good expectation You fulfilled, and a lack You remedied,
and a fall You revived, and wretchedness You transformed—
All of that being favour and bestowal from You,

segs.ar: وَفِي جَمِيعِهِ انْهِمَاكاً مِنِّي عَلَى مَعَاصِيْكَ،
segs.en: while in all of it, I was absorbed in Your acts of disobedience,

segs.ar: لَمْ تَمْنَعْكَ إساءَتِي عَنْ إتْمَامِ إحْسَانِكَ،
segs.en: My wrongdoing did not prevent You from completing Your benevolence,

segs.ar: وَلاَ حَجَرَنِي ذالِكَ عَنِ ارْتِكَابِ مَسَاخِطِكَ،
segs.en: and that did not restrain me from committing Your displeasing acts,

segs.ar: لاَ تُسْأَلُ عَمَّا تَفْعَلُ، وَلَقَدْ سُئِلْتَ فَأَعْطَيْتَ،
segs.tr: lā tus’alu ‘ammā taf‘al, wa-laqad su’ilta fa-a‘ṭayt,
segs.en: You are not questioned about what You do, and You were asked, and You gave,

segs.ar: وَلَمْ تُسْأَلْ فابْتَدَأْتَ، وَاسْتُمِيحَ فَضْلُكَ فَمَا أَكْدَيْتَ،
segs.tr: wa-lam tus’al fa-btada’t, wa-stumīḥa faḍluk fa-mā akdayt,
segs.en: and You were not asked, and You initiated, and Your favour was sought, and You did not fail—
You refused, O my Master, except to show benevolence,
and bestowal of grace, and granting of favour, and blessing,
and I refused except to plunge into violation of Your sanctities,
and transgression of Your bounds, and heedlessness of Your threat.

segs.ar: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ إلهِي مِنْ مُقْتَدِر لاَ يُغْلَبُ،
segs.tr: Fa-laka l-ḥamdu Ilāhī min muqtadirin lā yughlab,
segs.en: So for You is the praise, O my God, as the One who is Powerful, Who is not overcome,
and the One Possessing Deliberation, Who does not hasten.

segs.ar: هَذَا مَقَامُ مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ بِسبوغِ النِّعَمِ،
segs.en: This is the station of one who acknowledged the fullness of blessings,

segs.ar: وَقَابَلَهَا بِالتَّقْصِيرِ، وَشَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالتَّضْيِيْعِ.
segs.en: and met them with deficiency, and bore witness against himself of wasting (them).

segs.ar: أللَّهُمَّ فَإنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إلَيْكَ بِالْمُحَمَّدِيَّةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ،
segs.tr: Allāhumm fa-innī ataqarrabu ilayk bi-l-Muḥammadiyyati r-rafī‘ah,
segs.en: O God, truly I draw near to You by the lofty Muḥammadiyyah (the path/status of Muḥammad),
and the radiant ‘Alawiyyah (the path/status of ‘Alī), and I turn to You through them both,

segs.ar: أنْ تُعِيذَنِيْ مِنْ شَرِّ (كَذَا وَكَذَا) فَإِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ
segs.tr: an tu'īdhanī min sharri [kadhā wa-kadhā] fa-inna dhālik
segs.en: (asking that) You grant me refuge from the evil of [such and such], for truly that
does not strain You in Your richness,
and it does not weary You in Your power,
and You have power over everything,

segs.ar: فَهَبْ لِي يا إلهِي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ وَدَوَامِ تَوْفِيقِكَ،
segs.tr: fa-hab lī yā Ilāhī min raḥmatik wa-dawāmi tawfīqik,
segs.en: So grant me, O my God, from Your mercy and the lastingness of Your enabling (tawfīq),

segs.ar: مَا أَتَّخِذُهُ سُلَّماً أَعْرُجُ بِهِ إلى رِضْوَانِكَ،
segs.tr: mā attakhidhuhū sullaman a‘ruju bihī ilā riḍwānik,
segs.en: that which I may take as a ladder by which I may ascend to Your good pleasure,

segs.ar: وَآمَنُ بِهِ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
segs.tr: wa-āmanu bihī min ‘iqābik, yā Arḥama r-Rāḥimīn.
segs.en: and by which I may be safe from Your punishment, O Most Merciful of the merciful ones.
O God, You created me sound (or well-formed),
and You nurtured me when little, and You provided for me sufficiently.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي وَجَدْتُ فِيمَا أَنْزَلْتَ مِنْ كِتَابِكَ،
segs.tr: Allāhumm innī wajadtu fīmā anzalta min kitābik,
segs.en: O God, I found in what You revealed of Your Book,
and with which You gave glad tidings to Your servants,

segs.ar: أَنْ قُلْتَ: (يا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ
segs.en: that You said: (O My servants who have transgressed against their own souls

segs.ar: لاَ تَقْنَطُوا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللهِ إنَّ اللهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعاً)
segs.tr: lā taqnaṭū min raḥmatillāh innallāha yaghfiru dh-dhunūba jamī‘ā)
segs.en: Do not despair of God's mercy; truly, God forgives all sins) [Qur'an 39:53]

segs.ar: وَقَدْ تَقَدَّمَ مِنِّي مَا قَدْ عَلِمْتَ،
segs.en: And there has proceeded from me what You already know,
and what You know better than I do,

segs.ar: فَيَا سَوْأَتا مِمَّا أَحْصَاهُ عَلَيَّ كِتَابُكَ،
segs.en: So woe to what Your Book has enumerated against me!

segs.ar: فَلَوْلاَ الْمَوَاقِفُ الَّتِي أُؤَمِّلُ مِنْ عَفْوِكَ
segs.en: And were it not for the opportunities (or stances) in which I hope for Your pardon,

segs.ar: الَّذِي شَمِلَ كُلَّ شَيْء لاَلْقَيْتُ بِيَدِي،
segs.tr: alladhī shamila kulla shay’ lā-alqaytu bi-yadī,
segs.en: which encompasses everything, I would have cast myself down (in surrender),
And if anyone were able to flee

segs.ar: مِنْ رَبِّهِ لَكُنْتُ أَنَا أَحَقُّ بِالهَرَبِ مِنکَ،
segs.tr: min rabbihī la-kuntu ana aḥaqqu bi-l-harab minka ,
segs.en: from his Lord, I would be the most deserving to flee,

segs.ar: وَأَنْتَ لاَ تَخْفَى عَلَيْكَ خَافِيَةٌ فِي الاَرْضِ
segs.tr: wa-anta lā takhfā ‘alayk khāfiyatun fī l-arḍ
segs.en: And You, no hidden thing is concealed from You on the earth

segs.ar: وَلاَ فِي السَّمَآءِ إلاَّ أَتَيْتَ بِهَا،
segs.tr: wa-lā fī s-samā’ illā atayta bihā,
segs.en: nor in the heaven, but You bring it forth,

segs.ar: وَكَفى بِكَ جَازِياً، وَكَفى بِكَ حَسِيباً.
segs.tr: wa-kafā bik jāziyā, wa-kafā bik ḥasībā.
segs.en: and You are sufficient as a rewarder, and You are sufficient as a reckoner.

segs.ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ طَالِبِي إنْ أَنَا هَرَبْتُ،
segs.tr: Allāhumm innaka ṭālibī in anā harabt,
segs.en: O God, truly You are my seeker if I flee,
and my captor if I run away,

segs.ar: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ خَاضِعٌ ذَلِيلٌ رَاغِمٌ،
segs.tr: fa-hā ana dhā bayna yadayk khāḍi‘un dhalīlun rāghim,
segs.en: So here I am before You, submissive, abased, utterly humbled,
If You punish me, then I am worthy of that,
and it, O Lord, is justice from You,
