segs.ur: یکم محرم

segs.note: It is recommended to observe fasting on this day.
segs.ur: اس دن روزہ رکھنا مستحب ہے۔

segs.note: Offer a two unit prayer. When you finish, raise your hands towards the heavens and repeat 3 times:
segs.ur: دو رکعت نماز پڑھیں۔ جب ختم کریں تو اپنے ہاتھ آسمان کی طرف بلند کریں اور 3 مرتبہ دہرائیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ الْاِلٰهُ الْقَدِيْمُ وَهٰذِهٖ سَنَةٌ جَدِيْدَةٌ فَاَسْاَلُكَ فِيْهَا الْعِصْمَةَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ وَالْقُوَّةَ عَلٰى هٰذِهِ النَّفْسِ الْاَمَّارَةِ بِالسُّوْۤءِ وَالْاِشْتِغَالَ بِمَا يُقَرِّبُنِيْ اِلَيْكَ يَا كَرِيْمُ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْاِكْرَامِ يَا عِمَادَ مَنْ لَا عِمَادَ لَهٗ يَا ذَخِيْرَةَ مَنْ لَا ذَخِيْرَةَ لَهٗ يَا حِرْزَ مَنْ لَا حِرْزَ لَهٗ يَا غِيَاثَ مَنْ لَا غِيَاثَ لَهٗ يَا سَنَدَ مَنْ لَا سَنَدَ لَهٗ يَا كَنْزَ مَنْ لَا كَنْزَ لَهٗ يَا حَسَنَ الْبَلَاۤءِ يَا عَظِيْمَ الرَّجَاۤءِ يَا عِزَّ الضُّعَفَاۤءِ يَا مُنْقِذَ الْغَرْقٰى يَا مُنْجِيَ الْهَلْكٰى يَا مُنْعِمُ يَا مُجْمِلُ يَا مُفْضِلُ يَا مُحْسِنُ اَنْتَ الَّذِيْ سَجَدَ لَكَ سَوَادُ اللَّيْلِ وَنُوْرُ النَّهَارِ وَضَوْءُ الْقَمَرِ وَشُعَاعُ الشَّمْسِ وَدَوِيُّ الْمَاۤءِ وَحَفِيْفُ الشَّجَرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنَا خَيْرًا مِمَّا يَظُنُّوْنَ وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا مَا لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ وَلَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا بِمَا يَقُوْلُوْنَ حَسْبِيَ اللّٰهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ اٰمَنَّا بِهٖ كُلٌّ مِّنْ عِنْدِ رَبِّنَا وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ اِلَّا اُوْلُوْا الْاَلْبَابِ رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوْبَنَا بَعْدَ اِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ.
segs.en: O Allah, You are the Eternal God, and this is a new year. I ask You during it for protection from the devil, strength over this soul that commands toward evil, and engagement in that which brings me closer to You, O Generous One! O Owner of Majesty and Honor! O Pillar of him who has no pillar! O Treasure of him who has no treasure! O Sanctuary of him who has no sanctuary! O Succor of him who has no succor! O Support of him who has no support! O Reserve of him who has no reserve! O Benevolent in testing! O Great Object of hope! O Might of the weak! O Rescuer of the drowning! O Savior of the perishing! O Bestower of blessings! O Beautifier! O Giver of bounty! O Benefactor! You are the One to Whom the darkness of the night prostrates, as does the light of the day, the illumination of the moon, the rays of the sun, the murmur of the water, and the rustling of the trees—O Allah, You have no partner. O Allah, make us better than what they think, forgive us what they do not know, and do not call us to account for what they say. Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but He. In Him I have put my trust, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne. We believe in it; all is from our Lord, and none take heed except the people of understanding. Our Lord, do not cause our hearts to deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself; indeed, You are the Bestower.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA ANTAL ELAAHUL QADEEMO WA HAAZEHI SANATUN JADEEDATUN FA-AS-ALOKA FEEHAL I’SMATA MENASH SHAYTAANE WAL QUWWATA ALAA HAAZEHIN NAFSIL AMMAARATE BIS-SOOO-E WAL ISHTEGHAALA BEMAA YOQARREBONEE ELAYKA YAA KAREEMO YAA ZAL JALAALE WAL IKRAAME YAA EMAADA MAN LAA EMAADA LAHU YAA ZAKHEERATA MAN LAA ZAKHEERATA LAHU YAA HIRZA MAN LAA HIRZA LAHU YAA GHEYAASA MAN LAA GHEYAASA LAHU YAA SANADA MAN LAA SANADA LAHU YAA KANZA MAN LAA KANZA LAHU YAA HASANAL BALAAA-E YAA A’ZEEMAR RAJAAA-E YAA IZZAZ ZOAFAAA-E YAA MUNQEZAL GHARQAA YAA MUNJEYAL HALKAA YAA MUN-EMO YAA MUJMELO YAA MUFZELO YAA MOHSENO ANTAL LAZEE SAJADA LAKA SAWAADUL LAYLE WA NOORUN NAHAARE WA ZAW-UL QAMARE WA SHOAAUSH SHAMSE WA ZAWIYYUL MAAA-E WA HAFEEFUSH SHAJARE YAA ALLAAHO LAA SHAREEKA LAKA ALLAAHUMMAJ A’LNAA KHAYRAM MIMMAA YAZUNNOONA WAGH FIR LANAA MAA LAA YA’LAMOONA WA LAA TO-AAKHIZNAA BEMAA YAQOOLOONA HASBEYAL LAAHO LAA ELAAHA ILLAA HOWA ALAYHE TAWAKKALTO WA HOWA RABBUL A’RSHIL A’ZEEME AAMANNAA BEHI KULLUM MIN I’NDE RABBENAA WA MAA YAZZAKKARO ILLAA OOLUL ALBAABE RABBANA LAA TOZIGH QOLOOBANAA BA’DA IZ HADAYTANAA WA HAB LANAA MIL LADUNKA RAHMATAN INNAKA ANTAL WAHHAABO.

segs.note: Observe fasting on the first nine days of Moharram; fasting throughout the month is also recommended.
segs.ur: محرم کے پہلے نو دن روزہ رکھیں؛ پورے مہینے کا روزہ رکھنا بھی مستحب ہے۔

segs.note: On the tenth of Moharram, it is recommended to abstain from eating and drinking up to afternoon.
segs.ur: دس محرم کو عصر تک کھانے پینے سے پرہیز کرنا مستحب ہے۔

segs.note: After that, one may eat a little of the soil of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.)’s tomb (turbat al-Husayn; soil taken from the area around the holy tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.)).
segs.ur: اس کے بعد، امام حسین (ع) کی قبر کی تھوڑی سی مٹی (تربتِ حسین؛ امام حسین (ع) کے مقدس روضے کے اطراف سے لی گئی مٹی) کھائی جا سکتی ہے۔

A_R1.merits:
The month of Moharram is the month of sadness for the Ahl al-Bayt (a.s.) and their followers. In this respect, Imam al-Reza (a.s.) is reported to have said, “With the beginning of Moharram, my father (a.s.) would never smile at all. He would be dominated by depression for ten days. The tenth of this month would be the day of his misfortune, sadness, and weeping. He used to say that on this day Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) was slain.”

Sayyed Ibn Taaoos, in Iqbal al-Aa’maal, has mentioned that a number of prayers should be advisably offered at this night.

The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) is reported to have said that whoever offers the last of these prayers at this night and observes fasting the next day, which is the first day in the New Year, the New Year will be wholly good for him, and he will be saved throughout the year, and if he dies, he will be allowed Paradise.

Sayyed Ibn Taaoos has also mentioned a lengthy supplicatory prayer to be said at the sight of the new moon of Moharram.

Rayyan ibn Shabeeb has reported that Imam al-Reza (a.s.) said, “Just as He responded to the prayer of Prophet Zakariyyah, Almighty Allah shall respond the prayer of one who observes fasting on this day and prays Him.”

Imam al-Reza (a.s.) is reported to have said that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.), on the first of Moharram, used to offer a two unit prayer. When he finished, he would raise his hands towards the heavens and repeat this supplicatory prayer three times.

Shaykh al-Tusi recommends fasting on the first nine days of Moharram, and on the tenth abstaining from eating and drinking up to afternoon, then eating a little of the soil of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.)’s tomb.

Sayyed Ibn Taaoos has mentioned the merits of observing fasting during the whole month of Moharram adding that such a deed protects against committing any sin.

segs.note: On this day, Prophet Yusuf (a.s.) was freed from his prison. Hence, if one observes fasting on this day, Almighty Allah will make easy any difficulty he may face and will relieve any trouble that may face him. According to a hadees reported from the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.), Almighty Allah will respond to the prayer of him who observes fasting on this day.
segs.ur: اس دن حضرت یوسف (ع) قید خانے سے رہا ہوئے۔ لہٰذا جو شخص اس دن روزہ رکھے، اللہ تعالیٰ اسے پیش آنے والی ہر مشکل آسان فرمائے گا اور اسے لاحق ہونے والی ہر تکلیف دور فرمائے گا۔ رسول اکرم (ص) سے مروی ایک حدیث کے مطابق، جو اس دن روزہ رکھے اللہ تعالیٰ اس کی دعا قبول فرمائے گا۔

A_R6.name: The 10th Night of Muharram

segs.note: 100-Unit Prayer & Tasbih
segs.ur: 100 رکعت نماز اور تسبیح

segs.note: Offer a one hundred unit prayer with Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Tawheed three times in each unit.
segs.ur: سو رکعت نماز پڑھیں، ہر رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) تین مرتبہ پڑھیں۔

segs.note: After the prayer, repeat 70 times:
segs.ur: نماز کے بعد 70 مرتبہ دہرائیں:

segs.en: All glory be to Allah,
all praise be to Allah,
there is no god save Allah,
segs.tr: WA LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO WAL LAAHO

segs.en: Allah is the Greatest,

segs.ar: وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
segs.en: and there is neither might nor power save with Allah, the All-high the All-great.
segs.tr: WA LAA HAWLA WA LAA QUWWATA ILLAA BILLAAHIL A'LIYYIL A'ZEEM

segs.note: According to another narration, implore Almighty Allah's forgiveness after these statements.
segs.ur: ایک اور روایت کے مطابق، ان جملوں کے بعد اللہ تعالیٰ سے مغفرت طلب کریں۔

segs.note: Four-Unit Prayers & Night Vigil
segs.ur: چار رکعتی نمازیں اور شب بیداری

segs.note: Offer a four unit prayer at the last of this night, reciting Surah al-Faatehah once and repeating Ayat al-Kursi and Surahs al-Tawheed, al-Falaq, al-Nas ten times each. After accomplishment, Surah al-Tawheed is repeated one hundred times.
segs.ur: اس رات کے آخر میں چار رکعت نماز پڑھیں، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ پڑھیں اور [آیت الکرسی](A4) اور سورۂ توحید، [فلق](A117) اور [ناس](A118) ہر ایک دس مرتبہ پڑھیں۔ نماز مکمل کرنے کے بعد [سورہ توحید](A116) سو مرتبہ پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Offer a four unit prayer with Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Tawheed fifty times in each unit.
segs.ur: چار رکعت نماز پڑھیں، ہر رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) پچاس مرتبہ پڑھیں۔

segs.note: After the fourth unit, remember Almighty Allah, invoke blessings upon the Holy Prophet and his Household, and curse their enemies as many times as possible.
segs.ur: چوتھی رکعت کے بعد اللہ تعالیٰ کو یاد کریں، نبی (ص) اور ان کی آل پر درود بھیجیں اور ان کے دشمنوں پر جتنی بار ممکن ہو لعنت کریں۔

segs.note: Spend this whole night in worship.
segs.ur: یہ پوری رات عبادت میں گزاریں۔

segs.note: Visit the tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) and stay there until morning.
segs.ur: امام حسین (ع) کی قبر کی زیارت کریں اور صبح تک وہیں ٹھہریں۔

A_R6.merits:
Sayyed Ibn Taaoos, in Iqbal al-Aa’maal, has mentioned a number of supplicatory prayers and a big number of prayers that are advisably said and offered at this tenth night of Moharram. He has also cited the big rewards of saying and offering these supplications and prayers.

Concerning the four unit prayer with fifty recitations of Surah al-Tawheed: Matching the prayer of Imam Ali Ameer al-Momineen (a.s.), which brings about a tremendous reward, Sayyed Ibn Taaoos says after citing this prayer, “When you finish the fourth units, you may mention Almighty Allah, invoke blessings upon the Holy Prophet and his Household, and curse their enemies as many times as possible.”

As regarding the reward of spending this whole night with acts of worship, it has been narrated that one who does so shall be considered having worshipped Almighty Allah with the worship of all the angels. Furthermore, to practice acts of worship at this night is equal to seventy-year worship. Moreover, as for one who succeeds to visit the tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) at this night and spends the whole night there up to morning, Almighty Allah shall resurrect him, on the Judgment Day, spotted with the blood of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) in the group of those who were martyred with him.

A_R7.name: The 10th of Muharram

segs.note: The Day of Ashoora
segs.ur: یوم عاشورا

segs.note: Stop earning any worldly benefit and stop storing anything in your house on this day. Devote yourself to weeping and mourning the misfortunes of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.).
segs.ur: اس دن کوئی بھی دنیوی فائدہ کمانا چھوڑ دیں اور اپنے گھر میں کچھ ذخیرہ نہ کریں۔ خود کو امام حسین (ع) کے مصائب پر رونے اور سوگ منانے کے لیے وقف کر دیں۔

segs.note: Hold consolation ceremonies in the same way as you do for your dead sons and relatives.
segs.ur: تعزیتی مجالس اسی طرح منعقد کریں جیسے آپ اپنے وفات پا جانے والے بیٹوں اور رشتہ داروں کے لیے کرتے ہیں۔

segs.note: Visit the holy tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) with Ziyarat Ashura.
segs.ur: امام حسین (ع) کے روضۂ مبارک کی [زیارت عاشورا](G4) کے ساتھ زیارت کریں۔

segs.note: Invoke curse upon the enemies and slayers of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.).
segs.ur: امام حسین (ع) کے دشمنوں اور قاتلوں پر لعنت بھیجیں۔

segs.note: It is recommended, on this day, to invoke Almighty Allah to lay curse on the slayers of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) one thousand times by saying following statement:
segs.ur: مستحب ہے کہ اس دن اللہ تعالیٰ سے دعا کی جائے کہ وہ امام حسین (ع) کے قاتلوں پر ایک ہزار مرتبہ لعنت کرے، درج ذیل عبارت کہہ کر:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ الْعَنْ قَتَلَةَ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
segs.en: O Allah, curse the killers of al-Husayn, peace be upon him.

segs.note: Express sympathy to each other, saying:
segs.ur: ایک دوسرے کو پرسہ دیں اور کہیں:

segs.ar: اَعْظَمَ اللهُ اُجُوْرَنَا بِمُصَابِنَا بِالْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
segs.en: May Allah double up our rewards on account of our sorrow for (the martyrdom of) al-Husain, peace be upon him.
segs.tr: AA’ZAMAL LAAHO OJOORANA BE-MOSAABENAA BIL-HUSAINE A’LAIHIS SALAAMO

segs.en: and may He include you and us with those who shall take revenge upon his killers
segs.tr: WA JA-A’LANAA WA IYYAAKUM MENAT TAALEBEENA BE-SAAREHI

segs.ar: مَعَ وَلِيِّهِ الْاِمَامِ الْمَهْدِيِّ مِنَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ
segs.en: with his blood-claimer; Imam al-Mahdee, who belongs to the Household of Muhammad, peace be upon them all.
segs.tr: MA-A’ WALIYYEHIL EMAAMIL MAHDIYYE MIN AALE MOHAMMADIN A’LAIHEMUS SALAAM

segs.note: Do not eat or drink anything on this day, without the intention of ritual fasting.
segs.ur: اس دن شرعی روزے کی نیت کے بغیر کچھ نہ کھائیں اور نہ پئیں۔

segs.note: Break the abstention at the last hour of the day, after the afternoon time, with a meal usually offered to unfortunate people, such as yoghurt, milk, or the like.
segs.ur: دن کی آخری گھڑی میں، عصر کے وقت کے بعد، ایسے کھانے سے روزہ کھولیں جو عموماً ضرورت مندوں کو دیا جاتا ہے، جیسے دہی، دودھ یا اس جیسی کوئی چیز۔

segs.note: Avoid rich or delicious meals on this day, for it is a day of misfortune.
segs.ur: اس دن مرغن یا لذیذ کھانوں سے پرہیز کریں، کیونکہ یہ مصیبت کا دن ہے.

segs.note: Put on clean clothes, and unfasten the buttons and raise your sleeves just like unfortunate people.
segs.ur: صاف ستھرے کپڑے پہنیں، بٹن کھول دیں اور آستینیں چڑھا لیں، جیسے مصیبت زدہ لوگ کرتے ہیں۔

segs.note: Offer water to people on this day at the holy tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.).
segs.ur: اس دن امام حسین (ع) کے مقدس حرم میں لوگوں کو پانی پلائیں۔

segs.note: Recite Surah al-Tawheed 1,000 times on this day.
segs.ur: اس دن [سورہ توحید](A116) 1,000 مرتبہ پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Recite Dua Asharat.
segs.ur: [دعائے عشرات](E10) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Last Hours of Ashura
segs.ur: عاشورا کے آخری گھنٹے

segs.note: At the last hours of the Day of ‘Ashoora’, it is necessary to bring to mind the situation of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.)’s harem at those hours when they were taken as captives in Karbala’ while they were unimaginably depressed and unfortunate that they could do nothing but weeping.
segs.ur: یومِ عاشورا کے آخری گھنٹوں میں امام حسین (ع) کے حرم (اہلِ بیت کی مستورات) کی ان گھڑیوں کی حالت کو یاد کرنا ضروری ہے، جب وہ کربلا میں قیدی بنا لی گئی تھیں اور اس قدر غمزدہ اور بدنصیب تھیں کہ تصور نہیں کیا جا سکتا، یہاں تک کہ رونے کے سوا کچھ نہ کر سکتی تھیں.

segs.en: A catastrophe—if I wish to write it down
In brief, as a reminder for the one who remembers—
My tears flowed, and their barrier stood
Between the gaze of my eyelids and the pages.
segs.tr: MAA BAYNA LAHZIL JOFOONE WAZ ZOBORE

segs.en: And my heart said, "Have mercy on me, for no,
segs.tr: WA QAALA QALBEE BUQYAA A’LAYYA FALAA

segs.ar: وَاللهِ مَا قَدْ طُبِعْتُ مِنْ حَجَرٍ
segs.en: By Allah, I was not fashioned out of stone."
segs.tr: WAL LAAHE MAA QAD TOBE’TO MIN HAJARIN

segs.en: The earth and the heaven wept for it, and whatever
segs.tr: BAKAT LAHAL ARZO WAS SAMAAA-O WA MAA

segs.en: Is between them, in tears of crimson red.

A_R7.merits:
On this day, Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) was martyred. It is indeed the day of the calamitous misfortune and the day of grief for the Holy Imams (a.s.) and their adherents.

The adherents (Shi’ah) of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) should confer the martyrdom of their Imam and should weep for him. It is narrated that when Prophet Moosa (a.s.) was ordered to meet the Scholar, namely al-Khizr (a.s.),  the first matter they discussed was the misfortune that the Household of Prophet Muhammad (s.a.w.a.) would face. They therefore wept heavily for these misfortunes.

Ibn Abbas is reported to have said, “When I accompanied Imam Ali (a.s.) in Zeeqar, he took out a paper comprising the dictations of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) and handwritten by Imam Ali (a.s.) himself. He read some segments of that paper and I heard. It contained the story of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.)’s martyrdom with full details of the way he would be killed, the person who would kill him, those who would support him, and those who would be martyred with him. Imam Ali (a.s.) then wept heavily and caused me to weep.”

If one offers water to people on this day at the holy tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.), his reward will be similar to the reward of one who offered water to the companions of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) at Karbala. A great reward is also recorded for one who repeats Surah al-Tawheed one thousand times on this day. It is narrated that Almighty Allah shall have a merciful look at one who repeats this Surah one thousand times on this day.

Sayyed Ibn Taaoos has mentioned a supplicatory prayer similar to Dua al-Ashraat to be said on this day. More specifically, this supplicatory prayer seems to be the same as Dua al-Ashraat but according to another narration.

Shaykh al-Tusi has mentioned that Abdullah ibn Sinan reported from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) a four unit prayer and a supplicatory prayer to be offered and said at the first hours of this day; but on account of briefness, they will not be cited in this book.

No author can ever describe the actual manner of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.)’s harem, daughters, and children at these hours since the misfortunes that they had to encounter had never stricken any human being on this earth.

In Zaad al-Ma’d, Allamah al-Majlisi says that it is preferable not to observe fasting on the ninth and tenth of Moharram because the Umayyads used to observe fasting on these two days in order to express delight for and to gloat over the martyrdom of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.).
Having seen a good omen in the killing of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.), the Umayyads and their fans fabricated many lies against the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) and falsely ascribed to him that he mentioned many merits to be the reward of those who would observe fasting on these two days.
On the other hand, the Holy Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt (a.s.) are reported to have warned against observing fasting on these two days in general and on the tenth of Moharram, the Day of ‘Ashoora’, in particular.
The Umayyads - may Allah curse them - used to store up their annual nutriment in their houses on the tenth of Moharram; accordingly, Imam al-Reza (a.s.) is reported to have said, “If one refrains from arranging for any worldly benefit on the tenth of Moharram, Almighty Allah will grant him all his needs for this world and the world to come.
If one considers the tenth of Moharram to be the day of his misfortune, sadness, and weeping, Almighty Allah will make the Resurrection Day the day of his delight and happiness; and he will be delighted by us in Paradise.
If one considers the tenth of Moharram to be a blessed day and he thus stores up any annual nutriment on that day, Almighty Allah will not bless that which he stored up and will add him to the gang of Yazeed, Ubaydullah ibn Ziyad, and Umar ibn Sa’d - may Allah curse them all.”
In conclusion, it is required to suspend any worldly activity on this day and to devote oneself to weeping, mourning the martyrdom of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.), recalling his misfortunes, and ordering one’s family members to hold a consolation ceremony in the same way as one may hold for his dearest people.
It is also required to abstain from eating and drinking up to the last hour of the day at which one may break the abstention with a drink of water at least, without intending ritual fasting, since to observe fasting on this day is discommended except in cases of obligatory fasting, such as vow fasting and the like.
It is also required not to store up anything in the houses, not to laugh, not to entertain oneself, and not to play.

The summary of the worthy essay of Allamah al-Majlisi is that the reports that are ascribed to the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) concerning the merits of the tenth of Moharram, the Day of ‘Ashoora’, are all in all fabricated.

This topic has been discussed at length by the author of Shifa al-Sudoor (Ayatullah Mirza Abul Fazl al-Tehrani) at explaining the famous ‘Ziyarat Ashura’ and, precisely, the statement that reads, “O Allah, verily, the descendants of Umayyah saw a good omen in this day... etc.”
The summary of the author’s explanation is as follows: The Umayyads used to regard this day as good omen and they thus used to do many things on it.
They betook as custom on this day storing up the annual nutriment considering such to achieve happiness, good livelihood, and luxury up to the next year. In order to deny this bad habit, the Holy Imams (a.s.) warned against it in many narrations.
They considered the tenth of Moharram a feast day on which they would commit to the manners of celebration, such as conferring upon the family members with whatever they need, procuring new clothes, having one’s mustache cut, trimming the nails, and shaking hands with each other as well as other norms.
They and their fans have been observing fasting on the tenth of Moharram after they have fabricated numerous traditions entailing the significance of observing fasting on this day.
They and their fans have declared that it is recommended to supplicate Almighty Allah on this day. In order to confirm this forgery, they have invented many merits for this day, included them with fabricated supplications, and taught them to the miscreants of the nation so that they would confuse people and make the matter ambiguous for them.
The pro-Umayyad orators used to declare before people that a good event occurred to each Prophet on this day, such as that the fire that Nimrod the tyrannical ruler provoked in order to throw Prophet Abraham (a.s.) there was extinguished on the tenth of Moharram! Firaun who chased Prophet Moosa (a.s.) was drowned on the tenth of Moharram!
Prophet Eesaa (a.s.) was saved from crucifixion on the tenth of Moharram! (All these are fabrications that were invented by the Umayyads and their fans in order to cover their crime of slaying Imam al-Husain (a.s.) and in order to make people forget this astounding event.)

Supporting this, Shaykh al-Saduq has reported that Jibillah al-Makkiyyah said that she heard Meesum al-Tammar - may Allah sanctify his soul - saying, “By Allah I swear, this nation will kill the grandson of their Prophet on the tenth of Moharram. The enemies of Allah will betake that day as blessed day.
This shall inevitably take place, because it has been cited already in the eternal knowledge of Almighty Allah. I knew these facts from my master and the commander of the believers (namely, Imam Ali ibn Abi-Talib) (a.s.).”
Jibillah (the reporter) then said that she asked Meesum, “How come that the people will betake the day on which al-Husayn (a.s.) will be slain as blessed day?”
As he wept, Meesum answered, “They will fabricate traditions and will falsely claim that Almighty Allah accepted the repentance of Prophet Adam on the tenth of Moharram. The truth about this is that Almighty Allah accepted the repentance of Prophet Adam (a.s.) in Zilhajj.
They will falsely claim that Almighty Allah saved Prophet Jonah from the fish that had swallowed him on the tenth of Moharram. The truth about this is that the event was in Zilqad. They will falsely claim that the Ark of Prophet Nooh (a.s.) rested on Mount Judi on the tenth of Moharram. The truth about this is that the Ark rested on the tenth of Zilhajj.
They will falsely claim that Almighty Allah split the river for Prophet Moosa (a.s.) to cross on the tenth of Moharram. The truth about this is that the event occurred in Rabee al-Awwal... etc.”

This narration of Meesum al-Tammar has, openly and plainly, confirmed that such traditions were invented and fabricated against the Holy Infallibles (a.s.). It is also one of the signs indicating the true Prophethood of the Holy Prophet Muhammad (s.a.w.a.) and the true Divinely commissioned leadership of the Holy Imams (a.s.).
Finally, it acts as one of the proofs on the veracity and honesty of Shi’ism. In this narration, Imam Ali (a.s.) undoubtedly predicted that which we have been experiencing and witnessing, which is the fabrications and the forgery of lies against the Holy Infallibles (a.s.).

Despite all that, the most surprising thing is to notice that some people contrive a supplicatory prayer comprising these lies and some unskilled and inexpert writers add such a fabricated supplication to their books that take their way to the publics who will then recite it, although it is surely forbidden to believe in such a false supplication, because it is fabricated.
Beginning with statements of praise and glorification of Almighty Allah, this false supplication comprises statements such as “O He Who accepted the repentance of Adam on the Day of Ashoora’! O He Who raised Idris to the heavens on the Day of Ashoora’! O He Who made the Ark of Nooh (a.s.) rest on Mount Judi on the Day of Ashoora’!
O He Who saved Abraham from fire on the Day of ‘Ashoora’... etc.”
Undoubtedly, this supplication was invented by the Nasibis (or Nawasib) (Nasibees (or Nawasib) are those who openly declare enmity towards the Ahl al-Bayt and their adherents.
Addressing to the Shi’ah, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) defines a Nasibee as the one who shows enmity to the followers of the Holy Imams (a.s.)) of al-Madinah, the Khawarij of Muscat, or their likes who imitated the Umayyads in their wrongdoings against the Household of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.).

A_R9.name: Aamal of Ashura

segs.note: Ashura Rites
segs.ur: اعمالِ عاشورا

segs.note: Pray Fajr Salat. After Fajr Salaat carry out the Aamaal Ashoora.
segs.ur: نماز فجر پڑھیں۔ نماز فجر کے بعد اعمال عاشورا انجام دیں۔

segs.note: Do not drink water, nor eat food.
segs.ur: نہ پانی پئیں اور نہ کھانا کھائیں۔

segs.note: Barefoot, bareheaded, attired in black, come out from the shade and shelter of your homes, in the open, under the sky.
segs.ur: ننگے پاؤں، ننگے سر، سیاہ لباس پہنے، اپنے گھروں کے سائے اور پناہ سے نکل آئیں، کھلی فضا میں، آسمان کے نیچے.

segs.note: Together, disciplined, row after row, reciting moment to moment events that took place in Karbala, move forward, till evening.
segs.ur: سب مل کر، منظم انداز میں، صف در صف، کربلا میں پیش آنے والے واقعات کو لمحہ بہ لمحہ پڑھتے ہوئے شام تک آگے بڑھتے رہیں۔

segs.note: Pray Zohr and Asr Salat at their fixed times.
segs.ur: نماز ظہر اور عصر ان کے مقررہ اوقات میں پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Invoke Allah to lay curse upon the killers of Imam Husain, his family and friends:
segs.ur: اللہ سے دعا کریں کہ وہ امام حسین، ان کے اہل بیت اور اصحاب کے قاتلوں پر لعنت کرے:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ الْعَنْ قَتَلَةَ الْحُسَيْنِ وَاَوْلاَدِهٖ وَاَصْحَابِهٖ.
segs.en: O Allah, curse the killers of al-Husayn, his children, and his companions.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAL A’N QATALATAL HUSAINE WA AWLAADEHI WA ASHAABEHI.

segs.note: And say:
segs.ur: اور کہیں:

segs.ar: یَا لَيْتَنِيْ كُنْتُ مَعَكُمْ فَاَفُوْزَ فَوْزًا عَظِيْمًا.
segs.en: Would that I had been with you, so that I could achieve a great success.
segs.tr: YAA LAYTANI KUNTO MA-A’KUM FA AFOOZA FAWZAN A’ZEEMA.

segs.note: Comfort and console each other with:
segs.ur: ایک دوسرے کو ان الفاظ سے تسلی اور دلاسا دیں:

segs.ar: اَعْظَمَ اللهُ اُجُوْرَنَا وَاُجُوْرَكُمْ بِمُصَابِنَا بِالْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَجَعَلْنَا وَاِيَّاكُمْ مِنَ الطَّالِبِيْنَ بِثَارِهٖ مَعَ وَلِيِّهِ الْاِمَامِ الْمَهْدِيِّ مِنْ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ.
segs.en: May Allah make great our rewards and your rewards for our grief over al-Husayn, peace be upon him, and may He place us and you among those who seek his vengeance alongside his representative, the Imam al-Mahdi from the family of Muhammad, peace be upon them.
segs.tr: A-A’ZAMAL LAAHO OJOORANAA WA OJOORAKUM BEMOSAABENAA BIL HUSAINE A’LAYHIS SALAAMO WA JA-A’LANAA WA IYYAAKUM MENAT TAALEBEENA BESAAREHI MA-A’ WALIYYEHIL EMAAMIL MAHDIYYE MIN AALE MOHAMMADIN A’LAYHEMUS SALAAMO.

segs.note: Prayer & Dua of Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.)
segs.ur: امام صادق (ع) کی نماز اور دعا

segs.note: After the Fajr prayer and before Zuhr, do the following, as Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s.) advised:
segs.ur: نماز فجر کے بعد اور ظہر سے پہلے درج ذیل عمل کریں، جیسا کہ امام جعفر صادق (ع) نے تاکید فرمائی ہے:

segs.note: Offer a 4 rakat prayer standing under the sky:
segs.ur: کھلے آسمان تلے کھڑے ہو کر 4 رکعت نماز پڑھیں:

segs.note: In the first rakat after recitation of Surah al-Fatehah, recite Surah al-Kafiroon.
segs.ur: پہلی رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) پڑھنے کے بعد [سورہ کافرون](A113) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: In the second rakat, after recitation of Surah al-Fatehah, recite Surah al-Ikhlaas.
segs.ur: دوسری رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) پڑھنے کے بعد [سورہ اخلاص](A116) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: In the third rakat, after the recitation of Surah al-Fatehah, recite Surah al-Ah’zaab.
segs.ur: تیسری رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) پڑھنے کے بعد [سورہ احزاب](A37) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: In the fourth rakat, after the recitation of Surah al-Fateha, recite Surah al-Monafeqoon.
segs.ur: چوتھی رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) پڑھنے کے بعد [سورہ منافقون](A67) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: After the prayer, say 100 times:
segs.ur: نماز کے بعد 100 مرتبہ کہیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ الْعَنْ قَتَلَةَ الْحُسَيْنِ وَاَوْلاَدِهٖ وَاَصْحَابِهٖ.
segs.en: O Allah, curse the killers of al-Husayn, his children, and his companions.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAL A’N QATALATAL HUSAINE WA AWLAADEHI WA ASHAABEHI.

segs.note: Take a few steps forward and say:
segs.ur: چند قدم آگے بڑھیں اور کہیں:

segs.ar: اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَاِنَّا اِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُوْنَ رِضًا بِقَضَآئِهٖ وَتَسْلِيْمًا لِاَمْرِهٖ
segs.en: Indeed we belong to Allah and indeed to Him we shall return; submitting to His decree and resigning to His command.
segs.tr: INNAA LILLAAHE WA INNAA ELAYHE RAAJEO’ON REZAN BEQAZAAAEHI WA TASLEEMAN LE-AMREHI

segs.note: Then go back to your place and recite:
segs.ur: پھر اپنی جگہ پر واپس جائیں اور پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ عَذِّبِ الْفَجَرَةَ الَّذِيْنَ شَاقُّوْا رَسُوْلَكَ وَحَارَبُوْا اَوْلِيَآئَكَ وَعَبَدُوْا غَيْرَكَ وَاسْتَحَلُّوْا مَحَارَمَكَ وَالْعَنِ الْقَادَةَ وَالْاَتْبَاعَ وَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْهُمْ فَخَبَّ وَاَوْضَعَ مَعَهُمْ اَوْرَضِىَ بِفِعْلِهِمْ لَعْنًا كَثِيْرًا اَللّٰهُمَّ وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاجْعَلْ صَلَوَاتِكَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ وَاسْتَنْقِذْهُمْ مِنْ اَيْدِى الْمُنَافِقِيْنَ الْمُضِلِّيْنَ وَالْكَفَرَةِ الْجَاحِدِيْنَ وَافْتَحْ لَهُمْ فَتْحًا يَّسِيْرًا وَاَتِحْ لَهُمْ رَوْحًا وَفَرَجًا قَرِيْبًا وَاجْعَلْ لَهُمْ مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ عَلٰى عَدُوِّكَ وَعَدُوِّهِمْ سُلْطٰنًا نَّصِيْرًا. اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ كَثِيْرًا مِّنَ الْاُمَّةِ نَاصَبَتِ الْمُسْتَحْفِظِيْنَ مِنَ الْاَئِمَّةِ وَكَفَرَتْ بِالْكَلِمَةِ وَعَكَفَتْ عَلَى الْقَادَةِ الظَّلَمَةِ وَهَجَرَتِ الْكِتَابَ وَالسُّنَّةَ وَعَدَلَتْ عَنِ الْحَبْلَيْنِ الَّذَيْنِ اَمَرْتَ بِطَاعَتِهِمَا وَالتَّمَسُّكِ بِهِمَا فَاَمَاتَتِ الْحَقَّ وَحَادَتْ عَنِ الْقَصْدِ وَمَالَأَتِ الْاَحْزَابَ وَحَرَّفَتِ الْكِتَابَ وَكَفَرَتْ بِالحَقِّ لَمَّا جَائَهَا وَتَمَسَّكَتْ بِالْبَاطِلِ لَمَّا اعْتَرَضَهَا وَضَيَّعَتْ حَقَّكَ وَاَضَلَّتْ خَلْقَكَ وَقَتَلَتْ اَوْلاَدَ نَبِيِّكَ وَخِيَرَةَ عِبَادِكَ وَحَمَلَةَ عِلْمِكَ وَوَرَثَةَ حِكْمَتِكَ وَوَحْيِكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ فَزَلْزِلْ اَقْدَامَ اَعْدَآئِكَ وَاَعْدَآءِ رَسُوْلِكَ وَاَهْلِ بَيْتِ رَسُوْلِكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ وَاَخْرِبْ دِيَارَهُمْ وَافْلُلْ سِلاَحَهُمْ وَخَالِفْ بَيْنَ كَلِمَتِهِمْ وَفُتَّ فِىْ اَعْضَادِهِمْ وَاَوْ هِنْ كَيْدَهُمْ وَاضْرِبْهُمْ بِسَيْفِكَ الْقَاطِعِ وَارْمِهِمْ بِحَجَرِكَ الدَّامِغِ وَطُمَّهُمْ بِالْبَلَآءِ طَمًّا وَقُمَّهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ قَمًّا وَعَذِّبْهُمْ عَذَابًا نُكْرًا وَخُذْهُمْ بِالسِّنِيْنَ وَالْمُثَلاَتِ الَّتِىْ اَهْلَكْتَ بِهَا اَعْدَآئَكَ اِنَّكَ ذُوْ نِقْمَةٍ مِّنَ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ سُنَّتَكَ ضَآئِعَةٌ وَاَحْكَامَكَ مُعَطَّلَةٌ وَعِتْرَةَ نَبِيِّكَ فِى الْاَرْضِ هَآئِمَةٌ اَللّٰهُمَّ فَاَعِنِ الْحَقَّ وَاَهْلَهٗ وَاَقْمَعِ الْبَاطِلَ وَاَهْلَهٗ وَمُنَّ عَلَيْنَا بِالنَّجَاةِ وَاهْدِنَا اِلَى الْاِيْمَانِ وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَنَا وَانْظِمْهُ بِفَرَجِ اَوْلِيَآئِكَ وَاجْعَلْهُمْ لَنَاوُدًّا وَاجْعَلْنَا لَهُمْ وَفْدًا اَللّٰهُمَّ وَاَهْلِكْ مَنْ جَعَلَ يَوْمَ قَتْلِ ابْنِ نَبِيِّكَ وَخِيَرَتِكَ عِيْدًا وَاسْتَهَلَّ بِهٖ فَرَجًا وَمَرَحًا وَخُذْ اٰخِرَهُمْ كَمَا اَخَذْتَ اَوَّلَهُمْ وَضَاعِفِ اللّٰهُمَّ الْعَذَابَ وَالتَّنْكِيْلَ عَلٰى ظَالِمِىْ اَهْلِ بَيْتِ نَبِيِّكَ وَاَهْلَكْ اَشْيَاعَهُمْ وَقَادَتَهُمْ وَاَبْرِحُمَاتَهُمْ وَجَمَاعَتَهُمْ اَللّٰهُمَّ وَضَاعِفْ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ وَبَرَكَاتِكَ عَلٰى عِتْرَةِ نَبِيِّكَ الْعِتْرَةِ الضَّائِعَةِ الْخَآئِفَةِ الْمُسْتَذَلَّةِ بَقِيَّةٍ مِّنَ الشَّجَرَةِ الطَّيِّبَةِ الزَّاكِيَةِ الْمُبَارَكَةِ وَاَعْلِ اَللّٰهُمَّ كَلِمَتَهُمْ وَاَفْلِجْ حُجَّتَهُمْ وَاكْشِفِ الْبَلَآءَ وَاللَّاوَآءَ وَحَنَادِسَ الْاَبَاطِيْلِ وَالْعَمٰى عَنْهُمْ وَثَبِّتْ قُلُوْبَ شِيْعَتِهِمْ وَحِزْبِكَ عَلٰى طَاعَتِكَ وَوِلاَيَتِهِمْ وَنُصْرَتِهِمْ وَمُوَالاَتِهِمْ وَاَعِنْهُمْ وَامْنَحْهُمُ الصَّبْرَ عَلَى الْاَذٰى فِيْكَ وَاجْعَلْهُمْ اَيَّامًا مَّشْهُوْدَةً وَاَوْقَاتًا مَّحْمُوْدَةً مَّسْعُوْدَةً تُوْشِكُ فِيْهَا فَرَجَهُمْ وَتُوْجِبُ فِيْهَا تَمْكِيْنَهُمْ وَنَصْرَهُمْ كَمَا ضَمِنْتَ لِاَوْلِيٰآئِكَ فِىْ كِتَابِكَ الْمُنْزَلِ فَاِنَّكَ قُلْتَ وَقَوْلُكَ الْحَقُّ وَعَدَ اللهُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنْكُمْ وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَيَسْتَخْلِفَنَّهُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ كَمَا اسْتَخْلَفَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ دِيْنَهُمُ الَّذِى ارْتَضٰى لَهُمْ وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُمْ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ اَمْنًا يَّعْبُدُوْنَنِىْ لاَ يُشْرِكُوْنَ بِىْ شَيْئًا. اَللّٰهُمَّ فَاكْشِفْ غُمَّتَهُمْ يَا مَنْ لاَّ يَمْلِكُ كَشْفَ الضُّرِّ اِلاَّ هُوَ يَا وَاحِدُ يَا اَحَدُ يَا حَىُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ وَاَنَا يَا اِلٰهِىْ عَبْدُكَ الْخَآئِفُ مِنْكَ وَالرَّاجِعُ اِلَيْكَ السَّآئِلُ لَكَ الْمُقْبِلُ عَلَيْكَ اللَّاجِئُ اِلٰى فِنَآئِكَ الْعَالِمُ بِاَنَّهٗ لاَ مَلْجَأَ مِنْكَ اِلاَّ اِلَيْكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ فَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآئِىْ وَاسْمَعْ يَا اِلٰهِىْ عَلاَنِيَتِىْ وَنَجْوَاىَ وَاجْعَلْنِىْ مِمَّنْ رَضِيْتَ عَمَلَهٗ وَقَبِلْتَ نُسُكَهٗ وَنَجَّيْتَهٗ بِرَحْمَتِكَ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْكَرِيْمُ اَللّٰهُمَّ وَصَلِّ اَوَّلاً وَاٰخِرًا عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَبَارِكْ عَلىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَارْحَمْ مُحَمَّدًا وَّاٰلَ مُحَمَّدٍ بِاَكْمَلِ وَاَفْضَلِ مَا صَلَّيْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ وَتَرَحَّمْتَ عَلٰى اَنْبِيَآئِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ وَمَلَآئِكَتِكَ وَحَمَلَةِ عَرْشِكَ بِلَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّآ اَنْتَ اَللّٰهُمَّ لاَ تُفَرِّقْ بَيْنِىْ وَبَيْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ وَاجْعَلْنِىْ يَا مَوْلاَىَ مِنْ شِيْعَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلِىٍّ وَّفَاطِمَةَ وَالْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِمِ الطَّاهِرَةِ الْمُنْتَجَبَةِ وَهَبْ لِىَ التَّمَسُّكَ بِحَبْلِهِمْ وَالرِّضَا بِسَبِيْلِهِمْ وَالْاَخْذَ بِطَرِيْقَتِهِمْ اِنَّكَ جَوَادٌ كَرِيْمٌ.
segs.en: O Allah, punish the wicked who opposed Your Messenger, fought Your close friends, worshipped other than You, and violated Your prohibitions. Curse the leaders and the followers, and whoever among them joined them, actively participated with them, or was pleased with their deeds—a manifold cursing. O Allah, hasten the relief (Faraj) of the family of Muhammad; send Your blessings upon him and upon them, and rescue them from the hands of the misguiding hypocrites and the ungrateful deniers. Open for them an easy victory, provide them with comfort and a near relief, and grant them from Yourself a supportive authority against Your enemy and their enemy. O Allah, indeed a great part of the nation harbored enmity toward the divinely protected Imams, disbelieved in the Word, devoted themselves to the tyrannical leaders, abandoned the Book and the Sunnah, and turned away from the two weighty things (al-Thaqalayn) whose obedience and adherence You commanded. Thus, they suppressed the truth, deviated from the right path, aided the factions, distorted the Book, and disbelieved in the truth when it came to them. They held fast to falsehood when it confronted them, wasted Your right, led Your creation astray, and killed the children of Your Prophet, the elite of Your servants, the bearers of Your knowledge, and the inheritors of Your wisdom and Your revelation. O Allah, make the feet of Your enemies, the enemies of Your Messenger, and the enemies of the Household of Your Messenger tremble. O Allah, destroy their homelands, shatter their weapons, cause divergence in their words, break their strength, weaken their plots, strike them with Your decisive sword, pelt them with Your crushing stone, overwhelm them completely with affliction, suppress them thoroughly with punishment, and chastise them with an unprecedented chastisement. O Allah, seize them with years of hardship and exemplary punishments like those with which You destroyed Your enemies; indeed, You take vengeance upon the criminals. O Allah, indeed Your Sunnah is discarded, Your laws are suspended, and the progeny of Your Prophet are wandering aimlessly in the land. O Allah, assist the truth and its people, suppress falsehood and its people, favor us with salvation, guide us to faith, hasten our relief, and unite it with the relief of Your close friends. Instill love for us in their hearts, and make us an arriving delegation to them. O Allah, destroy whoever made the day of the killing of Your Prophet’s son and Your elite choice an Eid, welcoming it with joy and celebration. Seize the last of them just as You seized the first of them. O Allah, double the punishment and exemplary torment upon the oppressors of the Household of Your Prophet, and destroy their factions, their leaders, their defenders, and their entire group. O Allah, double Your blessings, Your mercy, and Your bounties upon the progeny of Your Prophet—the discarded, fearful, and abased progeny, the remnants of the pure, immaculate, and blessed tree. O Allah, elevate their word, make their proof triumphant, and remove from them the affliction, the adversity, the darkness of falsehoods, and the blindness. Firmly establish the hearts of their Shia and Your party upon obedience to You, their guardianship (Wilayah), their victory, and their allegiance. Assist them, grant them patience over injury sustained for Your sake, and make for them witnessed days and praised, auspicious times, in which their relief is near and their empowerment and victory become mandatory, just as You guaranteed for Your close friends in Your revealed Book, for You said—and Your word is the truth: "Allah has promised those who have believed among you and done righteous deeds that He will surely grant them succession upon the earth just as He granted it to those before them and that He will surely establish for them [in authority] their religion which He has preferred for them and that He will surely substitute for them, after their fear, security, [for] they worship Me, not associating anything with Me." O Allah, remove their grief, O He besides Whom none possesses the power to remove distress! O One! O Unique! O Living! O All-Sustaining! And I, O my God, am Your servant who fears You, returns to You, asks of You, turns toward You, and seeks refuge in Your courtyard, knowing well that there is no refuge from You except in You. O Allah, accept my supplication, and hear, O my God, my open prayers and my secret invocations. Make me among those whose deeds You are pleased with, whose rituals You have accepted, and whom You have saved through Your mercy; indeed, You are the Almighty, the Generous. O Allah, send blessings first and last upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad; bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and have mercy on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, with the most complete and excellent blessings, benedictions, and mercy You have ever bestowed upon Your Prophets, Your Messengers, Your angels, and the bearers of Your Throne—by virtue of 'there is no god but You'. O Allah, do not cause separation between me and Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, Your blessings be upon him and upon them. Make me, O my Master, among the Shia of Muhammad, Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, al-Husayn, and their pure, chosen progeny. Grant me adherence to their rope, satisfaction with their path, and adoption of their way; indeed, You are All-Bountiful, Generous.

MASH-HOODATAN WA AWQAATAM MAHMOODATAM MAS-O'ODATAM TOOSHEKO FEEHAA FARAJAHUM WA TOOJEBO FEEHAA TAMKEENAHUM WA NASRAHUM KAMAA ZAMINTA LE-AWLEYAAA-EKA FEE KETAABEKAL MUNZALE FA-INNAKA QULTA WA QAWLOKAL HAQQO WA-A'DAL LAAHUL LAZEENA AAMANOO MINKUM WA A'MELUS SAALEHAATE LAYASTAKHLEFANNAHUM FIL ARZE KAMAS TAKHLAFAL LAZEENA MIN QABLEHIM WA LAYOMAKKENANNA LAHUM DEENAHOMUL LAZEER TAZAA LAHUM WA LAYOBADDELANNAHUM MIM BA'DE KHAWFEHIM AMNAYN YA'BODOONANEE LAA YUSHREKOONA BEE SHAY-AN. ALLAAHUMMA FAKSHIF GHUMMATAHUM YAA MAL LAA YAMLEKO KASHFIZ ZURRE ILLAA HOWA YAA WAAHEDO YAA AHADO YAA HAYYO YAA QAYYOOMO WA ANAA YAA ELAAHI A'BDOKAL KHAAA-EFO MINKA WAR-RAAJE-O' ELAYKAS SAAA-ELO LAKAL MUQBELO A'LAYKAL LAAJE-O ELAA FENAAA-EKAL A'ALEMO BE-ANNAHU LAA MAL-JA-A MINKA ILLAA ELAYKA ALLAAHUMMA FATAQABBAL DO-A'AA-EE WAS-MA' YAA ELAAHEE A'LAANEYATEE WA NAJWAAYA WAJ-A'LNEE MIMMAN RAZEETA A'MALAHU WA QABILTA NOSOKAHU WA NAJJAYTAHU BE-RAHMATEKA INNAKA ANTAL A'ZEEZUL KAREEMO ALLAAHUMMA WA SALLE AWWALAN WA AAKHERAN A'LAA MOHAMMADIWN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WA BAARIK A'LAA MOHAMMADIWN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WAR-HAM MOHAMMADAWN WA AALA MOHAMMADIN BE-AKMALE WA AFZALE MAA SALLAYTA WA BAARAKTA WA TARAHHAMTA A'LAA AMBEYAAA-EKA WA ROSOLEKA WA MALAAA-EKATEKA WA HAMALATE A'RSHEKA BE-LAA ELAAHA ILLAA ANTA ALLAAHUMMA LAA TOFARRIQ BAYNEE WA BAYNA MOHAMMADIWN WAA AALE MOHAMMADIN SALAWAATOKA A'LAYHE WA A'LAYHIM WAJ-A'LNEE YAA MAWLAAYA MIN SHEE-A'TE MOHAMMADIWN WA A'LIYYIWN WA FAATEMATA WAL-HASANE WAL-HUSAINE WA ZURRIYYATEHEMAT TAAHERATIL MUNTAJABATE WA HAB LEYAT TAMASSOKA BEHABLEHIM WAR-REZAA BE-SABEELEHIM WAL-AKHZA BETAREEQATEHIM INNAKA JAWAADUN KAREEMUN.

segs.note: Now go into prostration (Sajdah), keep either side of your face on the earth, one after the other, and say:
segs.ur: اب سجدے میں جائیں، اپنے چہرے کی ایک جانب اور پھر دوسری جانب زمین پر رکھیں اور کہیں:

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ يَحْكُمُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيَفْعَلُ مَا يُرِيْدُ اَنْتَ حَكَمْتَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ مَحْمُوْدًا مَّشْكُوْرًا فَعَجِّلْ يَا مَوْلاَىَ فَرَجَهُمْ وَفَرَجَنَابِهِمْ فَاِنَّكَ ضَمِنْتَ اِعْزَازَهُمْ بَعْدَ الذِّلَّةِ وَتَكْثِيْرَهُمْ بَعْدَ الْقِلَّةِ وَاِظْهَارَهُمْ بَعْدَ الْخُمُوْلِ يَا اَصْدَقَ الصَّادِقِيْنَ وَيَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ فَاَسْئَلُكَ يَا اِلٰهِىْ وَسَيِّدِىْ مُتَضَرِّعًا اِلَيْكَ بِجُوْدِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ بَسْطَ اَمَلِىْ وَتَجَاوُزَ عَنِّىْ وَقَبُوْلَ قَلِيْلِ عَمَلِىْ وَكَثِيْرِهٖ وَالزِّيَادَةَ فِىْ اَيَّامِىْ وَتَبْلِيْغِىْ ذٰلِكَ الْمَشْهَدَ وَاَنْ تَجْعَلَنِىْ مِمَّنْ يُدْعٰى فَيُجِيْبُ اِلٰى طَاعَتِهِمْ وَمُوَالاَتِهِمْ وَنَصْرِهِمْ وَتُرِيَنِىْ ذٰلِكَ قَرِيْبًا سَرِيْعًا فِىْ عَافِيَةٍ اِنَّكَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ.
segs.en: O He Who judges whatever He wills and does whatever He intends! You have judged, so to You belongs all praise, praised and thanked. Therefore, O my Master, hasten their relief (Faraj) and our relief through them; for indeed, You guaranteed their honor after abasement, their multiplication after paucity, and their manifestation after obscurity—O Most Truthful of the truthful, and O Most Merciful of the merciful! So I ask You, O my God and my Master, pleading to You by Your bounty and Your generosity, to expand my hope, to overlook [my shortcomings], to accept the small amount of my deeds as well as the large, to extend my days, and to cause me to reach that witnessed day [of their return]. And [I ask] that You make me among those who are called and thus answer to their obedience, their allegiance, and their victory; and that You show me that day near and swift, in safety and well-being; indeed, You are Powerful over all things.
segs.tr: YAA MAN YAHKOMO MAA YASHAAA-O WA YAF-A’LO MAA YOREEDO ANTA HAKAMTA FALAKAL HAMDO MA MAHMOODAM MASHKOORAN FA-A’JJIL YAA MAWLAAYA FARAJAHUM WA FARAJANAA BEHIM FA-INNAKA ZAMINTA E-A'ZAAZAHUM BA'DAZ ZILLATE WA TAKSEERAHUM BA'DAL QILLATE WA IZHAARAHUM BA'DAL KHOMOOLE YAA ASDAQAS SAADEQEENA WA YAA ARHAMAR RAAHEMEENA FA-AS-ALOKA YAA ELAAHEE WA SAYYEDEE MOTAZARRE-A'N ELAYKA BEJOODEKA WA KARAMEKA BASTA AMALEE WA TAJAAWOZA A'NNEE WA QABOOLA QALEELE A'MALEE WA KASEEREHI WAZ-ZEYAADATA FEE AYYAAMEE WA TABLEEGHEE ZAALEKAL MASH-HADA WA AN TAJ-A'LANEE MIMMAN YUD-A' FA-YOJEEBO ELAA TAA-A'TEHIM WA MOWAALAATEHIM WA NASREHIM WA TOREYANEE ZAALEKA QAREEBAN SAREE-A'N FEE A'AFEYATIN INNAKA A'LAA KULLE SHAY-IN QADEERUN.

segs.note: Raise your head, look towards the sky and say:
segs.ur: اپنا سر اٹھائیں، آسمان کی طرف دیکھیں اور کہیں:

segs.ar: اَعُوْذُ بِكَ اَنْ اَكُوْنَ مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ لاَ يَرْجُوْنَ اَيَّامَكَ فَاَعِذْنِىْ يَا اِلٰهِىْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ.
segs.en: I seek refuge in You from being among those who do not hope for Your Days; so protect me from that, O my God, through Your mercy.
segs.tr: A-O’OZO BEKA AN AKOONA MENAL LAZEENA LAA YARJOONA AYYAAMAKA FA-A-I’ZNEE YAA ELAAHEE BE-RAHMATEKA MIN ZAALEKA.

segs.note: Ziyarat before Sunset
segs.ur: غروب آفتاب سے پہلے کی زیارت

segs.note: Before sunset on the day of Ashura, recite this ziyarat, sharing sorrow with the Holy Prophet, Ali al-Murtaza, Fatemah Zahra and Hasan al-Mujtaba (peace be upon them all):
segs.ur: روزِ عاشورا غروبِ آفتاب سے پہلے یہ زیارت پڑھیں اور رسولِ اکرم (ص)، علی مرتضیٰ (ع)، فاطمہ زہرا (س) اور حسن مجتبیٰ (ع) (ان سب پر سلام ہو) کے غم میں شریک ہوں:

segs.ar: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ اٰدَمَ صِفْوَةِ اللهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ نُوْحٍ نَبِىِّ اللهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ خَلِيْلِ اللهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُوْسٰى كَلِيْمِ اللهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عِيْسٰى رُوْحِ اللهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُحَمَّدٍ حَبِيْبِ اللهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عَلِىٍّ اَمِيْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَلِىِّ اللهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ الْحَسَنِ الشَّهِيْدِ سِبْطِ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَابْنَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَابْنَ الْبَشِيْرِ النَّذِيْرِ وَابْنَ سَيِّدِ الْوَصِيِّيْنَ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَابْنَ فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَآءِ سَيِدَةِ نِسَآءِ الْعَالَمِيْنَ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَبَا عَبْدِ اللهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خِيَرَةَ اللهِ وَابْنَ خِيَرَتِهٖ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ثَارَ اللهِ وَابْنَ ثَارِهٖ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ اَيُّهَا الْوِتْرَ الْمَوْتُوْرُ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ اَيُّهَا الْاِمَامُ الْهَادِى الزَّكِىُّ وَعَلٰى اَرْوَاحٍ حَلَّت بِفِنَآئِكَ وَاَقَامَتْ فِىْ جِوَارِكَ وَوَفَدَتْ مَعَ زُوَّارِكَ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنِّىْ مَا بَقِيْتُ وَبَقِىَ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ فَلَقَدْ عَظُمَتْ بِكَ الرَّزِيَّةُ وَجَلَّ الْمُصَابُ فِى الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَفِى الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ وَفِىْ اَهْلِ السَّمٰوٰتِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ وَفِى الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ وَفِىْ اَهْلِ السَّمٰوٰتِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ وَفِىْ سُكَّانِ الْاَرْضِيْنَ فَاِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَاِنَّا اِلَيْهِ رٰجِعُوْنَ وَصَلَوٰتُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهٗ وَتَحِيَّاتُهٗ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلٰى اٰبَآئِكَ الطَّيِّبِيْنَ الْمُنْتَجَبِيْنَ وَعَلٰى ذَرَارِيْهِمُ الْهُدَاةِ الْمَهْدِيِّيْنَ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلاَىَ وَعَلَيْهِمْ وَعَلٰى رُوْحِكَ وَعَلٰى اَرْوَاحِهِمْ وَعَلٰى تُرْبَتِكَ وَعَلٰى تُرْبَتِهِمْ اَللّٰهُمَّ لَقِّهِمْ رَحْمَةً وَّرِضْوَانًا وَّرَوْحًا وَّرَيْحَانًا اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلاَىَ يَا اَبَا عَبْدِ اللهِ يَابْنَ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّيْنَ وَابْنَ سَيِّدِ الْوَصِيِّيْنَ وَيَابْنَ سَيِّدَةِ نِسَآءِ الْعَالَمِيْنَ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا شَهِيْدُ يَابْنَ الشَّهِيْدِ يَا اَخَا الشَّهِيْدِ يَا اَبَا الشُّهَدَآءِ اَللّٰهُمَّ بَلِّغْهُ عَنِّىْ فِىْ هٰذِهِ السَّاعَةِ وَفِىْ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ وَفِىْ هٰذَا الْوَقْتِ وَفِىْ كُلِّ وَقْتٍ تَحِيَّةً كَثِيْرَةً وَّسَلاَمًا سَلاَمُ اللهِ عَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهٗ يَا بْنَ سَيِّدِ الْعَالَمِيْنَ وَعَلَى الْمُسْتَشْهَدِيْنَ مَعَكَ سَلاَمًا مُّتَّصِلاً مَّا تَّصَلَ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَى الْحُسَيْنِ ابْنِ عَلِىِّ نِالشَّهِيْدِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلٰى عَلَىِّ ابْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ الشَّهِيْدِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلٰى عَبَّاسِ ابْنِ اَمِيْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ الشَّهِيْدِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَى الشُّهَدَآءِ مِنْ وُّلْدِ اَمِيْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَى الشُّهَدَآءِ مِنْ وُّلْدِ الْحَسَنِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَى الشُّهَدَآءِ مِنْ وُّلْدِ الْحَسَنِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَى الشُّهَدَآءِ مِنْ وُّلْدِ الْحُسَيْنِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَى الشُّهَدَآءِ مِنْ وُّلْدِ جَعْفَرٍ وَّعَقِيْلٍ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلٰى كُلِّ مُسْتَشْهِدٍ مَّعَهُمْ مِّنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّبَلِّغْهُمْ عَنِّىْ تَحِيَّةً كَثِيْرَةً وَّسَلاَمًا اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُوْلَ اللهِ اَحْسَنَ اللهُ لَكَ الْعَزَآءَ فِىْ وَلَدِكَ الْحُسَيْنِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا فَاطِمَةُ اَحْسَنَ اللهُ لَكِ الْعَزَآءَ فِىْ وَلَدِكِ الْحُسَيْنِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَمِيْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ اَحْسَنَ اللهُ لَكَ الْعَزَآءَ فِىْ وَلَدِكَ الْحُسَيْنِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَبَا مُحَمَّدٍۨ الْحَسَنَ اَحْسَنَ اللهُ لَكَ الْعَزَآءَ فِىْ اَخِيْكَ الْحُسَيْنِ يَا مَوْلاَىَ يَا اَبَا عَبْدِ اللهِ اَنَا ضَيْفُ اللهِ وَضَيْفُكَ وَجَارُ اللهِ وَجَارُكَ وَلِكُلِّ ضَيْفٍ وَّجَارٍ قِرًى وَّقِرَاىَ فِىْ هٰذَا الْوَقْتِ اَنْ تَسْئَلَ اللهَ سُبْحَانَهٗ وَتَعَالٰى اَنْ يَّرْزُقَنِىْ فَكَاكَ رَقَبَتِىْ مِنَ النَّارِ اِنَّهٗ سَمِيْعُ الدُّعَآءِ قَرِيْبٌ مُّجِيْبٌ.
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Adam, the elite choice of Allah. Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Noah, the Prophet of Allah. Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Abraham, the intimate friend of Allah. Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Moses, the one who spoke to Allah. Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Jesus, the spirit of Allah. Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Muhammad, the beloved of Allah. Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Ali, the Commander of the Faithful and the close friend (Wali) of Allah. Peace be upon you, O inheritor of al-Hasan, the martyr, the grandson of the Messenger of Allah. Peace be upon you, O son of the Messenger of Allah. Peace be upon you, O son of the bearer of glad tidings and warner, and the son of the master of executors. Peace be upon you, O son of Fatima al-Zahra, the leader of the women of the worlds. Peace be upon you, O Aba Abdillah. Peace be upon you, O elite choice of Allah and the son of His elite choice. Peace be upon you, O vengeance of Allah and the son of His vengeance. Peace be upon you, O unique one who was wronged, whose family was slain. Peace be upon you, O guiding and pure Imam, and upon the souls that alighted in your courtyard, stayed in your vicinity, and arrived with your visitors. Peace be upon you from me for as long as I endure and as long as the night and the day remain. Indeed, the calamity through you has become grand, and the grief is momentous among the believers, among the Muslims, among the inhabitants of the heavens entirely, and among the dwellers of the earths. Therefore, indeed we belong to Allah and indeed to Him we shall return. May the blessings of Allah, His bounties, and His greetings be upon you and upon your pure, chosen forefathers, and upon their offspring—the guides, the rightly-guided. Peace be upon you, O my master, and upon them; and upon your soul and upon their souls; and upon your soil and upon their soil. O Allah, grant them mercy, pleasure, comfort, and ease. Peace be upon you, O my master, O Aba Abdillah, O son of the Seal of the Prophets, son of the master of executors, and son of the leader of the women of the worlds. Peace be upon you, O martyr, son of the martyr, brother of the martyr, and father of the martyrs. O Allah, convey to him from me at this hour, on this day, at this moment, and at every moment, abundant greetings and peace. May the peace of Allah, His mercy, and His blessings be upon you, O son of the master of the worlds, and upon those who achieved martyrdom with you—a continuous peace for as long as the night and day are joined. Peace be upon al-Husayn, the son of Ali, the martyr. Peace be upon Ali, the son of al-Husayn, the martyr. Peace be upon Abbas, the son of the Commander of the Faithful, the martyr. Peace be upon the martyrs from the children of the Commander of the Faithful. Peace be upon the martyrs from the children of al-Hasan. Peace be upon the martyrs from the children of al-Husayn. Peace be upon the martyrs from the children of Ja'far and Aqil. Peace be upon every martyr who died with them from among the believers. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and convey to them from me abundant greetings and peace. Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah; may Allah make excellent your consolation over your son al-Husayn. Peace be upon you, O Fatima; may Allah make excellent your consolation over your son al-Husayn. Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful; may Allah make excellent your consolation over your son al-Husayn. Peace be upon you, O Aba Muhammad al-Hasan; may Allah make excellent your consolation over your brother al-Husayn. O my master, O Aba Abdillah, I am the guest of Allah and your guest, and the neighbor of Allah and your neighbor. For every guest and neighbor there is hospitality; and my hospitality at this moment is that you ask Allah, Glory be to Him and the Exalted, to grant me the release of my neck from the Fire. Indeed, He is the Hearer of prayers, Near, and Responding.
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA WAARESA AADAMA SIFWATIL LAAHE. ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA WAARESA NOOHIN NABIYYIL LAAHE. ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA WAARESA IBRAAHEEMA KHALILIL LAAHE. A_R9.merits:
Tears come to our eyes as the dry yellow leaves drop on the ground in autumn. It is an instinctive self-regulation; we weep, mourn and cry; in the height of our love for the Holy Imam some of our scrape and cut ourselves not others, to feel the pain and hurt the martyrs of Karbala suffered on the 10th Muharram in 61 Hijra. In no way there is any hint of self-torture or show-off, as Oways Qaranee broke all his teeth when he heard the news that in the battle of Uhad his “beloved”, the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) had lost of couple of teeth. It is the domain of love and passionate attachment, deep and abiding devotedness like the jump Prophet Ibraheem took into the blazing fire.

The Imam had emphasized that whoso prays as directed (below) shall be entitled to receive the recompense of several Hajj; shall be kept safe from death by drowning burning and building collapse and no enemy can never get an upper hand over him or her.

A_S1.name: Daily Dua for the Month of Safar

segs.note: al-Muhaddis al-Fayz and other scholars have mentioned that if you desire to be saved from the misfortunes and bad luck of the month of Safar, you may repeat the following supplicatory prayer ten times every day in this month:
segs.ur: محدث فیض اور دوسرے علماء نے ذکر کیا ہے کہ اگر آپ ماہ صفر کی نحوست اور بدبختی سے نجات چاہتے ہیں تو اس مہینے میں ہر روز یہ دعا دس مرتبہ پڑھیں:

segs.ar: يَا شَدِيْدَ الْقُوٰى وَيَا شَدِيْدَ الْمِحَالِ
segs.en: O Lord of mighty prowess! O One of intense might!
segs.tr: YAA SHADEEDAL QOWAA WA YAA SHADEEDAL MEHAALE

segs.ar: يَا عَزِيْزُ يَا عَزِيْزُ يَا عَزِيْزُ
segs.en: O Almighty! O Almighty! O Almighty!
segs.tr: YAA A’ZEEZO YAA A’ZEEZO YAA A’ZEEZO

segs.en: All of Your creation is humbled before Your greatness,
so suffice me against the evil of Your creation.

segs.ar: يَا مُحْسِنُ يَا مُجْمِلُ يَا مُنْعِمُ يَا مُفْضِلُ
segs.en: O Beneficent! O Gracious! O Bestower of blessings! O Giver of bounty!
segs.tr: YAA MOHSENO YAA MUJMELO YAA MUN-E’MO YAA MUFZELO

segs.ar: يَا لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ اِنِّيْۤ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِيْنَ
segs.en: O One besides whom there is no god except You! Glory be to You, indeed I have been of the wrongdoers.
segs.tr: YAA LAA ELAAHA ILLAA ANTA SUBHAANAKA INNEE KUNTO MENAZ ZAALEMEENA

segs.en: So We responded to him and delivered him from distress,
segs.tr: FASTAJABNAA LAHU WA NAJJAYNAAHO MENAL GHAMME

segs.en: and thus do We deliver the believers.

segs.ar: وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِهِ الطَّيِّبِيْنَ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ.
segs.en: And may the blessings of Allah be upon Muhammad and his pure, immaculate family.
segs.tr: WA SALLAL LAAHO A’LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALEHIT TAYYEBEENAT TAAHEREENA.

A_S1.merits: The Month of Safar is well-known for bringing bad luck; and nothing can remove bad luck except almsgiving, supplication to Almighty Allah, and traditional supplications of seeking His protection against Satan and bad things.

A_S5.name: 20th Safar (Arbaeen - 40th Day)

segs.note: On this day, visit the tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) with Ziyarat Arbaeen.
segs.ur: اس دن [زیارت اربعین](G3) کے ساتھ امام حسین (ع) کے مرقد کی زیارت کریں۔

A_S5.merits:
In the word of the two Shaykhs, on the twenties of Safar, the harem of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) arrived in al-Madinah returning from Syria. On this day too, Jabir ibn ‘Abdullah al-Ansari, the first to visit the tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.), arrived there.

Imam al-Hasan al-Askari(a.s.) is reported to have said: “The signs of a true believer are five: offering a fifty-one units of Daily obligatory and supererogatory (mustahab / naafelah) prayers, visiting the tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) on the twentieth of Safar (i.e. Ziyarat al-Arbae'en), putting a ring in the right hand, covering one’s forehead with dust (i.e. prostrating oneself to Almighty Allah earnestly), and repeating the Basmalah (Bismil-laahir-rahmaanir-raheem: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful) audibly in certain prayers.”

In Tahzeeb al-Ahkam and al-Misbah, Shaykh al-Tusi has mentioned a form of Ziyarah that is dedicated to this day.

A_T2.name: Aamal from the 12th to 17th Nights of Rabi al-Awwal

segs.note: On the 12th of Rabi' al-Awwal, offer a two-unit prayer: in the first unit recite Surah al-Fatihah once and Surah al-Tawhid three times, and in the second Surah al-Fatihah once and Surah al-Kafirun three times.
segs.ur: ربیع الاول کی 12 تاریخ کو دو رکعت نماز پڑھیں: پہلی رکعت میں ایک مرتبہ [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) اور تین مرتبہ [سورہ توحید](A116) اور دوسری رکعت میں ایک مرتبہ [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) اور تین مرتبہ [سورہ کافرون](A113) پڑھیں۔

A_T2.merits:
12th of Rabi' al-Awwal: According to the opinion of al-Kulayni and al-Mas’udi, the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) was born on the twelfth of Rabi’ al-Awwal. This is also the unanimous opinion of the other Muslim sects. On this day too, the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) entered the holy city of al-Madinah after he had left Makkah. Shaykh al-Tusi adds that on this day in AH 132, the Marwanid Dynasty perished.

14th of Rabi' al-Awwal: On the fourteenth of Rabi’ al-Awwal AH 64, Yazid ibn Mu’awiyah, the Umayyad tyrant, perished and, thus, hurried to join the lowest stage of Hellfire. According to the book of Akhbar al-Duwal, Yazid was infected by pleurisy in Hawran. His dead body was thus moved to Damascus where he was buried in al-Bab al-Saghir. His grave is now a dunghill. He lived thirty-seven years and ruled for three years and nine months.

17th night of Rabi' al-Awwal: At the seventeenth night of Rabi’ al-Awwal, the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.), the Seal of the Prophets, was born. It is thus a very blessed night. Sayyid Ibn Tawus has narrated that one year before Hegira, the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) ascended to the seven heavens at the seventeenth night of Rabi’ al-Awwal.

A_W1.name: 3rd Jumada al-Akhirah (Martyrdom of Lady Fatimah al-Zahra (s.a.))

segs.note: On this day, hold consolation ceremonies, visit Lady Fatimah al-Zahra (a.s.), and curse those who wronged her and usurped her right.
segs.ur: اس دن مجالسِ عزا منعقد کریں، حضرت فاطمہ زہرا (س) کی زیارت کریں، اور ان لوگوں پر لعنت کریں جنہوں نے ان پر ظلم کیا اور ان کا حق غصب کیا۔

segs.note: Before the ziyarah, offer her Ziyarah Prayer: two units, reciting Surah al-Fatihah once and Surah al-Tawhid sixty times in each if possible. Otherwise recite al-Fatihah and al-Tawhid in the first unit and al-Fatihah and Surah al-Kafirun in the second.
segs.ur: زیارت سے پہلے ان کی زیارت کی نماز پڑھیں: دو رکعت، ہر رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) ساٹھ مرتبہ پڑھیں، اگر ممکن ہو۔ ورنہ پہلی رکعت میں فاتحہ اور توحید اور دوسری رکعت میں فاتحہ اور [سورہ کافرون](A113) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: After the prayer, recite this ziyarah:
segs.ur: نماز کے بعد یہ زیارت پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا سَيِّدَةَ نِسَاۤءِ الْعَالَمِيْنَ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا وَالِدَةَ الْحُجَجِ عَلَى النَّاسِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ اَيَّتُهَا الْمَظْلُوْمَةُ الْمَمْنُوْعَةُ حَقَّهَا اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰۤى اَمَتِكَ وَ ابْنَةِ نَبِيِّكَ وَ زَوْجَةِ وَصِيِّ نَبِيِّكَ صَلَاةً تُزْلِفُهَا فَوْقَ زُلْفٰى عِبَادِكَ الْمُكَرَّمِيْنَ مِنْ اَهْلِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ اَهْلِ الْاَرَضِيْنَ.
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O doyenne of the women of the world! Peace be upon you, O mother of the Arguments on all peoples! Peace be upon you, O wronged one whose right was usurped. O Allah, send blessings to Your she-servant, the daughter of Your Prophet, the wife of the Successor of Your Prophet-such remarkable blessings that approach her nearer to You than the steps of Your honored servants among the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth.
segs.tr: ASSALAAMU A'LAYKI YAA SAYYIDATA NISAA-IL 'AALAMEENA ASSALAAMU A'LAYKI YAA WAALIDATAL HUJAJI A'LAN NAASI AJMA'EENA ASSALAAMU A'LAYKI AYYATUHAL MAZLOOMATUL MAMNOO'ATU HAQQAHAA ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA AMATIKA WABNATI NABIYYIKA WA ZAWJATI WASIYYI NABIYYIKA SALAATAN TUZLIFUHAA FAWQA ZULFAA I'BAADIKAL MUKARRAMEENA MIN AHLIS SAMAAWAATI WA AHLIL ARAZEEN.
segs.ur: سلام ہو آپ پر اے جہانوں کی عورتوں کی سردار، سلام ہو آپ پر اے ان کی والدہ جو لوگوں پر خدا کی حجتیں ہیں، سلام ہو آپ پر اے وہ مظلومہ جس کا حق چھین لیا گیا۔ اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما اپنی کنیز، اپنے نبی کی دختر اور اپنے نبی کے وصی کی شریکِ حیات پر ایسی رحمت جو اس کو نزدیک کرے، بڑھ کر تیرے عزت والے بندوں کی نسبت جو آسمانوں میں رہنے والے اور زمین میں بسنے والے ہیں۔

A_W1.merits:
On the third of Jamadi al-Akhirah, AH 11, Lady Fatimah al-Zahra’(a.s.) departed life.

As he mentions that Lady Fatimah al-Zahra’(a.s.) departed life on this day, Sayyid Ibn Tawus, in Iqbal al-A’mal, has mentioned this form of Ziyarah that is dedicated to her. It has been narrated that if one visits Lady Fatimah al-Zahra’(a.s.) with this form of Ziyarah and then implores for Almighty Allah’s forgiveness, Almighty Allah will forgive his sins and allow him Paradise.

The son of Sayyid Ibn Tawus has also mentioned this form of Ziyarah in his book entitled Zawa’id al-Fawa’id, adding that it is dedicated to the day of Lady Fatimah’s demise, which is the third of Jumada al-Akhirah.

A_W2.name: 20th Jumada al-Akhirah (Birthday of Lady Fatimah al-Zahra (s.a.))

segs.note: It is proper to observe fasting.
segs.ur: روزہ رکھنا مناسب ہے۔

segs.note: It is recommended to give alms and offer good things to the believers.
segs.ur: صدقہ دینا اور مومنین کو اچھی چیزیں پیش کرنا مستحب ہے۔

segs.note: It is recommended to visit Lady Fatimah al-Zahra’(a.s.) - the Doyenne of the women of this world as well as the world to come - by saying the forms of Ziyarah: Ziyarat of Lady Fatimah al-Zahra.
segs.ur: مستحب ہے کہ حضرت فاطمہ زہرا (س) - دنیا اور آخرت کی عورتوں کی سردار - کی زیارت ان کی زیارت کے صیغے پڑھ کر کی جائے: [زیارت حضرت فاطمہ زہرا](G52)۔

A_W2.merits: On the twentieth of Jamadi al-Akhirah, Lady Fatimah al-Zahra’(a.s.) was born five or two years after the beginning of the Holy Prophet’s Divine Mission.

A_W3.name: Aamal in Jumada al-Akhirah

segs.note: At any time in Jumada al-Akhirah, offer a four-unit prayer, two units at a time:
segs.ur: جمادی الآخر میں کسی بھی وقت چار رکعت نماز پڑھیں، دو دو رکعت کر کے:

segs.note: In the first unit, Surah al-Faatehah is recited once, Ayat al-Kursi once, and Surah al-Qadr repeated twenty-five times.
segs.ur: پہلی رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ، [آیۃ الکرسی](A4) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ قدر](A101) 25 مرتبہ پڑھی جاتی ہے۔

segs.note: In the second unit, Surah al-Faatehah is recited once, Surah al-Takathur (No. 102) once, and Surah al-Tawheed repeated twenty-five times.
segs.ur: دوسری رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ، [سورہ تکاثر](A106) (نمبر 102) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) 25 مرتبہ پڑھی جاتی ہے۔

segs.note: In the third unit, Surah al-Faatehah is recited once, Surah al-Kafirun (No. 109) once, and Surah al-Falaq (No. 113) repeated twenty-five times.
segs.ur: تیسری رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ، [سورہ کافرون](A113) (نمبر 109) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ فلق](A117) (نمبر 113) 25 مرتبہ پڑھی جاتی ہے۔

segs.note: In the fourth unit, Surah al-Faatehah is recited once, Surah al-Nasr (No. 110) once, and Surah al-Nas (No. 114) repeated twenty-five times.
segs.ur: چوتھی رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ، [سورہ نصر](A114) (نمبر 110) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ ناس](A118) (نمبر 114) 25 مرتبہ پڑھی جاتی ہے۔

segs.note: After the four units, repeat 70 times:
segs.ur: چار رکعت کے بعد 70 مرتبہ دہرائیں:

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَ اللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ
segs.en: All glory be to Allah, all praise be to Allah, there is no god save Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
segs.tr: SUBHAANAL LAAHI WAL HAMDU LILLAAHI WA LAA ILAAHA ILLAL LAAHU WAL LAAHU AKBAR
segs.ur: اللہ پاک تر ہے حمد اللہ ہی کیلئے ہے اللہ کے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں اور اللہ بزرگتر ہے

segs.note: You may also repeat 7 times:
segs.ur: آپ 7 مرتبہ بھی دہرا سکتے ہیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD
segs.ur: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما محمد(ص) و آل محمد(ع) پر

segs.note: After that, repeat 3 times:
segs.ur: اس کے بعد، 3 مرتبہ دہرائیں:

segs.en: O Allah, (please do) forgive the believing men and women.
segs.ur: اے معبود! مومن مردوں اور مومنہ عورتوں کو بخش دے

segs.note: After that, prostrate and repeat 3 times:
segs.ur: اس کے بعد، سجدہ کریں اور 3 مرتبہ دہرائیں:

segs.ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَ الْاِكْرَامِ يَا اَللّٰهُ يَا رَحْمَانُ يَا رَحِيْمُ يَاۤ اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
segs.en: O Ever-living! O Self-Subsisting! O Lord of majesty and honor! O All-beneficent! O All-merciful! O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
segs.tr: YAA HAYYU YAA QAYYOOMU YAA ZAL JALAALI WAL IKRAAMI YAA ALLAAHU YAA RAHMAANU YAA RAHEEMU YAA ARHAMAR RAAHIMEEN
segs.ur: اے زندہ اے پائیندہ اے جلالت اور بزرگی کے مالک اے اللہ اے بڑے رحم والے اے مہربان اے سب سے زیادہ رحم کرنے والے۔

segs.note: Then pray to Almighty Allah for your needs.
segs.ur: پھر اللہ تعالیٰ سے اپنی حاجتوں کے لیے دعا کریں۔

A_W3.merits:
Sayyid Ibn Tawus has mentioned this prayer for any time in the month of Jumada al-Akhirah.

If one does all this, he, as well as his property, wife, sons, religion, and worldly affairs, will be saved up to the next year. If he dies during that year, he will be rewarded as martyred.

A_X1.name: Importance of the Month of Rajab and its Aamal

segs.note: Observe fasting during Rajab.
segs.ur: ماہِ رجب میں روزہ رکھیں۔

segs.note: Repeat this plea for forgiveness often in Rajab, much more than in other months:
segs.ur: مغفرت کی یہ التجا رجب میں کثرت سے دہرائیں، دوسرے مہینوں سے کہیں زیادہ:

segs.en: I implore for the forgiveness of Allah and I pray to Him for accepting of my repentance.

segs.note: If you cannot fast in Rajab, repeat 100 times each day in Rajab:
segs.ur: اگر آپ رجب میں روزہ نہ رکھ سکیں تو رجب میں ہر روز 100 مرتبہ کہیں:

segs.en: Glory be to the All-majestic God.

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَا يَنْبَغِيْ التَّسْبِيْحُ اِلَّا لَهٗ
segs.en: Glory be to Him other than Whom none should be glorified.
segs.tr: SUBHAANA MAN LAA YANBAGHIT TASBEEHO ILLAA LAHU

segs.en: Glory be to the All-honorable and All-dignified.

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَبِسَ الْعِزَّ وَهُوَ لَهٗ اَهْلٌ.
segs.en: Glory be to Him Who has dressed Himself with grandeur that fits none but Him.
segs.tr: SUBHAANA MAN LABESAL I’ZZA WA HOWA LAHU AHLUN.

segs.note: For the daily rites of Rajab, see General Aamal in Rajab and Daily Supplications of Rajab.
segs.ur: رجب کے روزانہ اعمال کے لیے دیکھیں [رجب کے عمومی اعمال](X2) اور [رجب کی روزانہ دعائیں](X3)۔

A_X1.merits:
In addition to the months of Sha’ban and Ramazan, the month of Rajab enjoys a great honor, as cited in many narrations that have also conveyed the merits of this month. Furthermore, the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) is reported as saying, “Verily, Rajab is the Great Month of Allah. No other month can be as sacred and virtuous as this month. To fight against the polytheists during this month is forbidden. Most certainly, Rajab is the month of Allah, Sha’ban is my month, and Ramadan is the month of my people. Therefore, if one observes fasting on one day of this month, he will bindingly win the Grand Pleasure of Almighty Allah, will be taken away from His ire, and the gates of Hellfire will be closed in his face.”

Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kazim (a.s.) is also reported to have said, “If one observes fasting on one day in Rajab, Hellfire will go away from him a distance of one year walking. One who fasts three days will bindingly win Paradise.”

The Imam (a.s.) is also reported as saying, “Rajab is (the name of) a river in Paradise that is whiter than milk and sweeter than honey. Hence, if one fasts even a single day in Rajab, Almighty Allah will allow him to drink from that river.”

Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s.) has reported the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) as saying: Rajab is the month of imploring for forgiveness for my people; so, you should implore forgiveness repeatedly in this month much more than you do in other months, for Almighty Allah is forgiving and merciful. This month is described as the advantageous month, because mercy is poured on my people during it so heavily.

In a considerable form of narration, Ibn Baabwayh has quoted Salim as saying: I once visited Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) in the last days of Rajab. When his eyes turned towards me, he asked, “Have you fasted on any day in this month, Salim?” “No, I have not,” answered I. “You have missed great reward,” said the Imam (a.s.). “Such a great reward that none can ever grant except Almighty Allah. Verily, this month has been given precedence to the other months by Almighty Allah Who has also given its sanctity a great consideration and will have certainly honored those who observe fasting during it.” I then said, “O son of Allah’s Messenger, what if I fast on the rest days of Rajab, will I then be awarded anything of the rewards dedicated to those fasting in it?” Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) answered, “Listen, Salim! If one observes fasting on the last day of this month, this will secure him against the agonies of death, the horror of the resurrection, and the grave chastisement. As for one who observes fasting on the last two days of this month, this will give him permission to pass the Discriminating Bridge (sirat) peacefully. As for one who observes fasting on the last three days of the month, one shall be secured on the Grand Horror Day against all the horrors and hardships thereon and shall be also granted release from Hellfire.”

To observe fasting during the month of Rajab wholly brings about great favors.

A_X2.name: General Aamal in Rajab

segs.note: Each day in Rajab, recite:
segs.ur: رجب کے ہر دن پڑھیں:

segs.en: O He who manages the wants of the needy,
and is aware of that which is hidden in the heart of the silent sufferers!

segs.ar: لِكُلِّ مَسْاَلَةٍ مِنْكَ سَمْعٌ حَاضِرٌ وَجَوَابٌ عَتِيْدٌ
segs.en: Every problem receives Your attention, and is settled well.
segs.tr: LEKULLE MAS-ALATIN MINKA SAM-U’N HAAZERUN WA JAWAABUN A’TEEDUN

segs.en: O Allah, Your promises come true,
Your favors are many,
and Your Mercy is extensive,

segs.ar: فَاَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: therefore, I beseech You to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: FA-AS-ALOKA AN TOSALLEYA A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: and fulfill my desires in this world and in the world to come.
segs.tr: WA AN TAQZEYA HAWAAA-EJEE LID-DUNYAA WAL AAKHERATE

segs.en: Verily, You have power over all things

A_X2.merits: Imam Zayn al-Aabedin (a.s.) used to say this supplicatory prayer on the first day of Rajab while he was imprisoned.

A_X3.name: Daily Supplications of Rajab

segs.note: Dua Khaba al-Wafidun
segs.ur: دعا خاب الوافدون

segs.note: Each day in Rajab, recite:
segs.ur: رجب کے ہر دن پڑھیں:

segs.en: Those who approach other than You are disappointed.
Those who try to gain the favour of other than You are losers;
those who make other than You the goal of their journey perish;

segs.ar: وَاَجْدَبَ الْمُنْتَجِعُوْنَ اِلَّا مَنِ انْتَجَعَ فَضْلَكَ
segs.en: and all except those who seek resort in Your grace face desolation
segs.tr: WA AJDABAL MUNTAJE-O’ONA ILLAA MANIN TAJA-A’ FAZLAKA

segs.en: Your door is open for the seekers
and your boons are given to those who seek them,
and Your grace is freely available to those who ask for it,
Access to You is granted to those who hope for it!
Your sustenance is extended for even those who disobey You.
Your forbearance extends to those who antagonize You.
Your habit is to do favor to the wrongdoers
and Your way is to be benevolent to the transgressors.
O Allah, so (lovingly) guide me with guidance enjoyed by the rightly-guided,
and enable me to strive like the diligent,
do not place me with the negligent who are kept at a distance from You
segs.tr: WA LAA TAJ-A’LNEE MENAL GHAAFELEENAL MUB-A’DEENA

segs.en: and forgive me on the Day of Retribution.

segs.note: Dua Sabr al-Shakirin
segs.ur: دعا صبر الشاکرین

segs.note: It may be repeated at any time:
segs.ur: اسے کسی بھی وقت دہرایا جا سکتا ہے:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ صَبْرَ الشَّاكِرِيْنَ لَكَ
segs.en: O Allah, I implore You to grant me the patience of those who always thank You,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA SABRASH SHAAKEREENA LAKA

segs.en: the efforts of those who fear You,
and the conviction of those who worship You devoutly.
O Allah, You are the Most High, the All-Supreme,
and I am Your servant—the destitute and the needy.
You are the Self-Sufficient, the Praised,
and I am the abject and lowly servant.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALEHI

segs.en: and favour me with Your sufficiency upon my poverty,
and with Your forbearance upon my ignorance,
and with Your strength on my weakness,
O All-Strong, O Almighty.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household;
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALEHIL

segs.en: the Successors (of prophet hood) and the Pleased;

segs.ar: وَاكْفِنِيْ مَا اَهَمَّنِيْ مِنْ اَمْرِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
segs.en: and suffice me from whatever aggrieves me from the affairs pertaining to the world and the Hereafter.
segs.tr: WAK-FENEE MAA AHAMMANEE MIN AMRID DUNYAA WAL AAKHERATE

segs.en: O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!

segs.note: Dua Ya Dhal Minan
segs.ur: دعا یا ذا المنن

segs.en: O Allah, the Lord of the complete favors,
the utter bounties,
the immense mercy,
and all-encompassing power,
and the immense blessings,
and the great gifts,
and the elegant boons,
and plentiful rewards!
O He Who cannot be described by any analogy,
nor compared with any like,
and nor overcome with the help of any supporter.
O He Who created and then granted sustenance,
and inspired (them) and then endowed them with speech,
and originated (the creation) and then initiated it,
transcended it and then surmounted it,
and determined it in an excellent form,
and then formed it in a perfect manner,
and advanced conclusive proofs,
and blessed abundantly,
and rewarded plenteously,
and conferred gracious gifts!
O He Who is so lofty in might
so he eludes the gaze of the creatures' eyes,
and so close in affection
so as to ascend all notions of thought!
O He Who is the sole sovereign of His dominion

segs.ar: فَلَا نِدَّ لَهٗ فِىْ مَلَكُوْتِ سُلْطَانِهٖ
segs.en: that no peer can ever be found for Him in the realms of His power
segs.tr: FALAA NIDDA LAHU FEE MALAKOOTE SULTAANEHI

segs.en: and has been so matchless in bounties and supremacy

segs.ar: فَلَا ضِدَّ لَهٗ فِیْ جَبَرُوْتِ شَاْنِهٖ
segs.en: that nothing can oppose Him in the omnipotence of His situation!
segs.tr: FALAA ZIDDA LAHU FEE JABAROOTE SHAANEHI

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ حَارَتْ فِي كِبْرِيَاءِ هَيْبَتِهٖ دَقَاۤئِقُ لَطَاۤئِفِ الْاَوْهَامِ
segs.en: O He the greatness of whose awe, bewilders the intricate subtleties of the imagination
segs.tr: YAA MAN HAARATA FEE KIBREYAA-E HAYBATEHI DAQAAEQO LATAAEFIL AWHAAME

segs.ar: وَانْحَسَرَتْ دُوْنَ اِدْرَاكِ عَظَمَتِهٖ خَطَاۤئِفُ اَبْصَارِ الْاَنَامِ
segs.en: and before Whose greatness are wearied the glances of the eyes of the worlds inhabitants!
segs.tr: WAN HASARAT DOONA IDRAAKE A’ZAMATEHI KHATAAEFO ABSAARIL ANAAME.

segs.en: O He before Whose Awe all faces have humbled themselves,
to His greatness all necks bend,
and His fear makes the hearts quake!

segs.ar: اَسْاَلُكَ بِهٰذِهِ الْمِدْحَةِ الَّتِىْ لَا تَنْبَغِيْ اِلَّا لَكَ
segs.en: I beseech You in the name of this piece of praise which suits none but You,
segs.tr: AS-ALOKA BEHAAZEIL MIDHATIL LATEE LAA TAMBAGHEE ILLAA LAKA

segs.en: and by the promise which You have made incumbent upon Yourself
segs.tr: WA BEMAA WA AYTA BEHI A’LAA NAFSEKA

segs.en: for the believers who call upon You,

segs.ar: وَبِمَا ضَمِنْتَ الْاِجَابَةَ فِيْهِ عَلٰى نَفْسِكَ لِلدَّاعِيْنَ
segs.en: and by the assurance You have given to answer the appeals of those who supplicate to You.
segs.tr: WA BEMAA ZAMINTAL EJAABATA FEEHE A’LAA NAFSEKA LID-DAA-E’ENA

segs.en: O the sharpest of listeners!
and the keenest of observers!
and the swiftest of reckoners!
O Powerful and All-strong!
bless Muhammad, the seal of the Prophets,
and his Household,

segs.ar: وَاقْسِمْ لِيْ فِیْ شَهْرِنَا هٰذَا خَيْرَ مَا قَسَمْتَ
segs.en: and allot for me in this month of ours the best of what You have allotted to anyone,
segs.tr: WAQ SIM LEE FEE SHAHRENAA HAAZAA KHAYRA MAA QASAMTA

segs.ar: وَاحْتِمْ لِيْ فِیْ قَضَاۤئِكَ خَيْرَ مَا حَتَمْتَ
segs.en: and ordain for me in Your ordainments the best of what You have ordained for anyone,
segs.tr: WAH TIM LEE FEE QAZAAEKA KHAYRA MAA HATAMTA,

segs.en: seal my life with happiness with which You seal the lives of others,
segs.tr: WAKH TIM LEE BIS-SA-A’ADATE FEEMAN KHATAMTA

segs.en: Give me a prosperous life, so long as You keep me alive,
and grant me to die happy and forgiven,

segs.ar: وَتَوَلَّ اَنْتَ نَجَاتِیْ مِنْ مُسَائَلَةِ الْبَرْزَخِ
segs.en: You assume the charge of my deliverance during the questioning in the purgatory,
segs.tr: WA TAWALLA ANTA NAJAATEE MIN MOSAA-ALATIL BARZAKHE

segs.en: and spare me from Munkar and Nakir,
and make Mubashshir and Bashir appear before my eyes,
segs.tr: WA ARE A’YNEE MOBASHSHERANW WA BASHEERANW,

segs.ar: وَّاجْعَلْ لِيْ اِلٰى رِضْوَانِكَ وَجِنَانِكَ مَصِيْرًا
segs.en: let my return be toward Your pleasure and paradise,
segs.tr: WAJ A’L LEE ELAA RIZWAANEKA WA JENAANEKA MASEERAN

segs.en: and grant me a happy life,
and a big kingdom,
and bless Muhammad and his Household very much.
segs.tr: WA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALEHI KASEERAA.

segs.note: This supplicatory prayer is also advisably said in Masjid Sa’sa’ah.
segs.ur: اس دعا کو مسجد صعصعہ میں پڑھنا بھی مستحب ہے۔

segs.note: Dua of Imam al-Mahdi’s Signature
segs.ur: امام مہدی (عج) کے توقیع کی دعا

segs.en: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّىْ اَسْاَلُكَ بِمَعَانِىْ جَمِيْعِ مَا يَدْعُوْكَ بِهٖ وُلَاةُ اَمْرِكَ
segs.en: O Allah, I beseech You by the meanings of all the supplications of those whom You have invested with Your authority,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE ASALOKA BE-MA-A’ANEE JAMEE-E’ MAA YADO’OKA BEHI WOLAATO AMREKAL

segs.en: the trustees of Your secret,
those who rejoice in Your command,
the describers of Your power,
the proclaimers of Your supremacy.

segs.ar: اَسْاَلُكَ بِمَا نَطَقَ فِيْهِمْ مِنْ مَشِيَّتِكَ
segs.en: I implore You by Your will that has manifested itself through them
segs.tr: ASALOKA BEMAA NATAQA HEEHIM MIM MASHIYYATEKA

segs.en: and thus You have made them the essences of Your Words,
