segs.tr: YAA QADEEMU YAA MUSAHHILU YAA MUYASSIRU YAA MUMEETU YAA MUHYEE

segs.ar: يَا نَافِعُ يَا رَازِقُ يَا مُقْتَدِرُ [مُقَدِّرُ] يَا مُسَبِّبُ يَا مُغِيْثُ
segs.en: O Grantor of benefits! O Provider of sustenance! O All-competent! O Creator of causes! O Aide!
segs.tr: YAA NAAFI'U YAA RAAZIQU YAA MUQTADIRU [MUQADDIRU] YAA MUSABBIBU YAA MUGHEETH

segs.ar: يَا مُغْنِيْ يَا مُقْنِيْ يَا خَالِقُ يَا رَاصِدُ يَا وَاحِدُ
segs.en: O Grantor of wealth! O Giver to hold! O Creator! O Onlooker! O One!
segs.tr: YAA MUGHNEE YAA MUQNEE YAA KHAALIQU YAA RAASIDU YAA WAAHID

segs.ar: يَا حَاضِرُ يَا جَابِرُ يَا حَافِظُ يَا شَدِيْدُ يَا غِيَاثُ
segs.en: O Present! O Mender! O Safeguarding! O Firm (in punishment)! O Aid!
segs.tr: YAA HAADIRU YAA JAABIRU YAA HAAFIZU YAA SHADEEDU YAA GHIYAATH

segs.en: O Donor! O Straitening!

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ عَلَا فَاسْتَعْلٰى فَكَانَ بِالْمَنْظَرِ الْاَعْلٰى
segs.en: O He Who has mounted to the most elevated point, He thus occupies the most exalted site!
segs.tr: YAA MAN A'LAA FASTA'LAA FAKAANA BIL MANZARIL A'LAA

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ قَرُبَ فَدَنَا وَبَعُدَ فَنَاَىٰ وَعَلِمَ السِّرَّ وَاَخْفَى
segs.en: O He Who has approached so closely that He has become the nearest of all things and, at the same time, He has been so far that He is in the furthest point, and He has known the secret and even what is more hidden!
segs.tr: YAA MAN QARUBA FADANAA WA BA'UDA FANA'AA WA A'LIMAS SIRRA WA AKHFAA

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ اِلَيْهِ التَّدْبِيْرُ وَلَهُ الْمَقَادِيْرُ
segs.en: O He to Whom all management is relegated and to Whom all measures are referred!
segs.tr: YAA MAN ILAYHIT TADBEERU WA LAHUL MAQAADEER

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنِ الْعَسِيْرُ عَلَيْهِ سَهْلٌ يَسِيْرٌ
segs.en: O He for Whom the most difficult thing is easy and simple!
segs.tr: WA YAA MANIL A'SEERU A'LAYHI SAHLUN YASEER

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ هُوَ عَلٰى مَا يَشَاءُ قَدِيْرٌ
segs.en: O He Who has power to do whatever He wills!
segs.tr: YAA MAN HUWA A'LAA MAA YASHAA'U QADEER

segs.ar: يَا مُرْسِلَ الرِّيَاحِ يَا فَالِقَ الْاِصْبَاحِ
segs.en: O He Who sends forth the wind! O He Who causes the dawn to break!
segs.tr: YAA MURSILAR RIYAAHI YAA FAALIQAL ISBAAH

segs.ar: يَا بَاعِثَ الْاَرْوَاحِ يَا ذَا الْجُوْدِ وَالسَّمَاحِ
segs.en: O He Who revives the spirits! O Lord of magnanimity and lenience!
segs.tr: YAA BAA'ITHAL ARWAAHI YAA DHAL JOODI WAS SAMAAH

segs.ar: يَا رَادَّ مَا قَدْ فَاتَ يَا نَاشِرَ الْاَمْوَاتِ يَا جَامِعَ الشَّتَاتِ
segs.en: O He Who has the power to restore that which has been missed! O He Who resurrects the dead bodies! O He Who draws together the dispersal!
segs.tr: YAA RAADDA MAA QAD FAATA YAA NAASHIRAL AMWAATI YAA JAAMI'ASH SHATAAT

segs.ar: يَا رَازِقَ مَنْ يَشَاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
segs.en: O He Who provides sustenance to whomever He wants without measure!
segs.tr: YAA RAAZIQA MAN YASHAA'U BIGHAYRI HISAAB

segs.ar: وَيَا فَاعِلَ مَا يَشَاءُ كَيْفَ يَشَاءُ
segs.en: O He Who has power to do whatever He wills however He wills!
segs.tr: WA YAA FAA'ILA MAA YASHAA'U KAYFA YASHAA'

segs.en: O Lord of Majesty and Honor!
segs.tr: WA YAA DHAL JALAALI WAL IKRAAM

segs.ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ يَا حَيًّا حِيْنَ لَا حَيَّ
segs.en: O Ever-living! O Self-subsistent! O He Who existed when there existed nothing else!
segs.tr: YAA HAYYU YAA QAYYOOMU YAA HAYYAN HEENA LAA HAYY

segs.ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا مُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتٰى يَا حَيُّ
segs.en: O Ever-living! O Reviver of the dead! O Ever-living!
segs.tr: YAA HAYYU YAA MUHYIYAL MAWTAA YAA HAYY

segs.ar: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ بَدِيْعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْاَرْضِ
segs.en: There is no god save You the excellent Maker of the heavens and the earth.
segs.tr: LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA BADEE'US SAMAAWAATI WAL ARD

segs.ar: يَا اِلٰهِيْ وَسَيِّدِيْ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O my God and my Master, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: YAA ILAAHEE WA SAYYIDEE SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.en: have mercy upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
and send benedictions upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: WA BAARIK A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.ar: كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ وَرَحِمْتَ [تَرَحَّمْتَ‏] عَلٰى اِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَاٰلِ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ
segs.en: just as You have sent blessings and benedictions and had mercy upon Abraham and the household of Abraham.
segs.tr: KAMAA SALLAYTA WA BAARAKTA WA RAHIMTA [TARAHHAMTA] A'LAA IBRAAHEEMA WA AALI IBRAAHEEM

segs.en: You are verily worthy of all praise and full of all glory.

segs.ar: وَارْحَمْ ذُلِّي وَفَاقَتِيْ وَفَقْرِيْ وَانْفِرَادِيْ وَوَحْدَتِي
segs.en: Have mercy upon my humiliation, neediness, poverty, loneliness, aloneness,
segs.tr: WARHAM DHULLEE WA FAAQATEE WA FAQREE WANFIRAADEE WA WAHDATEE

segs.ar: وَخُضُوْعِيْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ وَاعْتِمَادِيْ عَلَيْكَ وَتَضَرُّعِيْ اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: humbleness before You, reliance upon You, and submission to You.
segs.tr: WA KHUDOO'EE BAYNA YADAYKA WA'TIMAADEE A'LAYKA WA TADARRU'EE ILAYK

segs.ar: اَدْعُوْكَ دُعَاءَ الْخَاضِعِ الذَّلِيْلِ الْخَاشِعِ الْخَاۤئِفِ الْمُشْفِقِ
segs.en: I implore You with the imploring of the humble, the subservient, the fearful, the scared the afraid,
segs.tr: AD'OOKA DU'AA'AL KHAADI'IDH DHALEELIL KHAASHI'IL KHAA'IFIL MUSHFIQ

segs.en: the miserable, the modest, the insignificant, the hungry, the poor,

segs.ar: الْعَاۤئِذِ الْمُسْتَجِيْرِ الْمُقِرِّ بِذَنْبِهِ الْمُسْتَغْفِرِ مِنْهُ الْمُسْتَكِيْنِ لِرَبِّهٖ
segs.en: the seeker of Your refuge, the seeker of Your protection, the confessing of his sins, the implorer for You to forgive his sin, and the humble to his Lord;
segs.tr: AL-A'A'IDHIL MUSTAJEERIL MUQIRRI BIDHANBIHIL MUSTAGHFIRI MINHUL MUSTAKEENI LIRABBIH

segs.ar: دُعَاءَ مَنْ اَسْلَمَتْهُ ثِقَتُهٗ [نَفْسُهٗ‏] وَرَفَضَتْهُ اَحِبَّتُهٗ وَعَظُمَتْ فَجِيْعَتُهٗ
segs.en: I implore You with the imploration of one whom has been disappointed by those whom he trusts, rejected by his intimate ones, and whose catastrophe has been enormous.
segs.tr: DU'AA'A MAN ASLAMAT-HU THIQATUHOO [NAFSUHOO] WA RAFADAT-HU AHIBBATUHOO WA A'ZUMAT FAJEE'ATUH

segs.ar: دُعَاءَ حَرِقٍ حَزِيْنٍ ضَعِيْفٍ مَهِيْنٍ بَاۤئِسٍ مُسْتَكِيْنٍ بِكَ مُسْتَجِيْرٍ
segs.en: I implore You the imploration of one burning, sad, weak, mortified, depressed, wretched, and resorting to Your shelter.
segs.tr: DU'AA'A HARIQIN HAZEENIN DA'EEFIN MAHEENIN BAA'ISIN MUSTAKEENIN BIKA MUSTAJEER

segs.en: O Allah, I also beseech You in the name of Your being the King,

segs.ar: وَاَنَّكَ مَا تَشَاءُ مِنْ اَمْرٍ يَكُوْنُ وَاَنَّكَ عَلٰى مَا تَشَاءُ قَدِيْرٌ
segs.en: whatever You will shall definitely take place, and You have power over all things.
segs.tr: WA ANNAKA MAA TASHAA'U MIN AMRIN YAKOONU WA ANNAKA A'LAA MAA TASHAA'U QADEER

segs.ar: وَاَسْاَلُكَ بِحُرْمَةِ هٰذَا الشَّهْرِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْبَيْتِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْبَلَدِ الْحَرَامِ
segs.en: I beseech You in the name of the holiness of this sacred month, the Sacred House, the Sacred Town,
segs.tr: WA AS'ALUKA BIHURMATI HAADHASH SHAHRIL HARAAMI WAL BAYTIL HARAAMI WAL BALADIL HARAAM

segs.en: the Rukn (i.e. the corner of the Holy Ka'bah), the Maqam (i.e. the standing-place of Prophet Abraham), the great rituals,
segs.tr: WAR RUKNI WAL MAQAAMI WAL MASHAA'IRIL I'ZAAM

segs.ar: وَبِحَقِّ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهِ السَّلَامُ
segs.en: and in the name of Your Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him and his Household.
segs.tr: WA BIHAQQI NABIYYIKA MUHAMMADIN A'LAYHI WA AALIHIS SALAAM

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ وَهَبَ لِاٰدَمَ شَيْثًا، وَلِاِبْرَاهِيْمَ اِسْمَاعِيْلَ وَاِسْحَاقَ
segs.en: O He Who gave Shayth to Adam, and gave Ishmael and Isaac to Abraham!
segs.tr: YAA MAN WAHABA LI-AADAMA SHAYTHAN WA LI-IBRAAHEEMA ISMAA'EELA WA IS-HAAQ

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ رَدَّ يُوْسُفَ عَلٰى يَعْقُوْبَ
segs.en: O He Who returned Joseph to Jacob!
segs.tr: WA YAA MAN RADDA YOOSUFA A'LAA YA'QOOB

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ كَشَفَ بَعْدَ الْبَلَاءِ ضُرَّ اَيُّوْبَ
segs.en: O He Who relieved Job from his harm after long hardships!
segs.tr: WA YAA MAN KASHAFA BA'DAL BALAA'I DURRA AYYOOB

segs.en: O He Who returned Moses to his mother!
O He Who increased al-Khadir knowledge!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ وَهَبَ لِدَاوُدَ سُلَيْمَانَ وَلِزَكَرِيَّا يَحْيَىٰ وَلِمَرْيَمَ عِيْسَىٰ
segs.en: O He Who gave Solomon to David, gave John to Zachariah, and gave Jesus to Mary!
segs.tr: WA YAA MAN WAHABA LIDAAWUDA SULAYMAANA WA LIZAKARIYYAA YAHYAA WA LIMARYAMA I'EESAA

segs.en: O He Who safeguarded the daughter of Shu'ayb!
O He Who cared for the son of the mother of Moses!
segs.tr: WA YAA KAAFILA WALADI UMMI MOOSAA

segs.ar: اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: I beseech You to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: AS'ALUKA AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوْبِيْ كُلَّهَا وَتُجِيْرَنِي مِنْ عَذَابِكَ
segs.en: forgive my all sins, save me from Your chastisement,
segs.tr: WA AN TAGHFIRA LEE DHUNOOBEE KULLAHAA WA TUJEERANEE MIN A'DHAABIK

segs.ar: وَتُوْجِبَ لِي رِضْوَانَكَ وَاَمَانَكَ وَاِحْسَانَكَ وَغُفْرَانَكَ وَجِنَانَكَ
segs.en: and confer upon me with Your pleasure and security and with Your favoring, forgiveness, and gardens of Your Paradise.
segs.tr: WA TOOJIBA LEE RIDWAANAKA WA AMAANAKA WA IHSAANAKA WA GHUFRAANAKA WA JINAANAK

segs.ar: وَاَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تَفُكَّ عَنِّيْ كُلَّ حَلْقَةٍ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَ مَنْ يُؤْذِيْنِيْ
segs.en: I ask You to redeem me from all circles of misfortune that are drawn around those who intend harm to me and me,
segs.tr: WA AS'ALUKA AN TAFUKKA A'NNEE KULLA HALQATIN BAYNEE WA BAYNA MAN YU'DHEENEE

segs.ar: وَتَفْتَحَ لِيْ كُلَّ بَابٍ وَتُلَيِّنَ لِيْ كُلَّ صَعْبٍ وَتُسَهِّلَ لِيْ كُلَّ عَسِيْرٍ
segs.en: unlock for me all doors, make easy for me all hardships, alleviate for me all difficult matters,
segs.tr: WA TAFTAHA LEE KULLA BAABIN WA TULAYYINA LEE KULLA SA'BIN WA TUSAHHILA LEE KULLA A'SEER

segs.ar: وَتُخْرِسَ عَنِّيْ كُلَّ نَاطِقٍ بِشَرٍّ وَتَكُفَّ عَنِّيْ كُلَّ بَاغٍ
segs.en: mute all those who speak ill of me, defend me against all oppressors,
segs.tr: WA TUKHRISA A'NNEE KULLA NAATIQIN BISHARRIN WA TAKUFFA A'NNEE KULLA BAAGH

segs.ar: وَتَكْبِتَ [عَنِّي‏] كُلَّ عَدُوٍّ لِيْ وَحَاسِدٍ وَتَمْنَعَ مِنِّيْ كُلَّ ظَالِمٍ
segs.en: suppress all my enemies and envious ones, protect me against all unjust ones,
segs.tr: WA TAKBITA [A'NNEE] KULLA A'DUWWIN LEE WA HAASIDIN WA TAMNA'A MINNEE KULLA ZAALIM

segs.ar: وَتَكْفِيَنِيْ كُلَّ عَاۤئِقٍ يَحُوْلُ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَ حَاجَتِيْ
segs.en: and rescue me from all impediments that lie between my needs and me,
segs.tr: WA TAKFIYANEE KULLA A'A'IQIN YAHOOLU BAYNEE WA BAYNA HAAJATEE

segs.ar: وَيُحَاوِلُ اَنْ يُفَرِّقَ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَ طَاعَتِكَ وَيُثَبِّطَنِيْ عَنْ عِبَادَتِكَ
segs.en: try to take me away from acts of obedience to You, and try to frustrate me from serving You.
segs.tr: WA YUHAAWILU AN YUFARRIQA BAYNEE WA BAYNA TAA'ATIKA WA YUTHABBITANEE A'N I'BAADATIK

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ اَلْجَمَ الْجِنَّ الْمُتَمَرِّدِيْنَ وَقَهَرَ عُتَاةَ الشَّيَاطِيْنِ
segs.en: O He Who has bridled all mutinous jinn, overcome all tyrannical devils,
segs.tr: YAA MAN ALJAMAL JINNAL MUTAMARRIDEENA WA QAHARA U'TAATASH SHAYAATEEN

segs.ar: وَاَذَلَّ رِقَابَ الْمُتَجَبِّرِيْنَ وَرَدَّ كَيْدَ الْمُتَسَلِّطِيْنَ عَنِ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِيْنَ
segs.en: mortified the necks of the oppressors, and deterred all the ruling authorities from harming the enfeebled ones!
segs.tr: WA ADHALLA RIQAABAL MUTAJABBIREENA WA RADDA KAYDAL MUTASALLITEENA A'NIL MUSTAD'AFEEN

segs.ar: اَسْاَلُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلٰى مَا تَشَاءُ وَتَسْهِيْلِكَ لِمَا تَشَاءُ كَيْفَ تَشَاءُ
segs.en: I beseech You in the name of Your power over all things and Your alleviating whatever You will however You will,
segs.tr: AS'ALUKA BIQUDRATIKA A'LAA MAA TASHAA'U WA TAS-HEELIKA LIMAA TASHAA'U KAYFA TASHAA'

segs.ar: اَنْ تَجْعَلَ قَضَاءَ حَاجَتِيْ فِيْمَا تَشَاءُ
segs.en: to grant my requests as You will.
segs.tr: AN TAJ'ALA QADAA'A HAAJATEE FEEMAA TASHAA'

segs.note: Then prostrate, pressing your cheeks to the ground, and recite:

segs.en: O Allah, I am prostrating myself before You and I have full faith in You;
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA LAKA SAJADTU WA BIKA AAMANT

segs.ar: فَارْحَمْ ذُلِّي وَفَاقَتِيْ وَاجْتِهَادِيْ وَتَضَرُّعِيْ وَمَسْكَنَتِيْ وَفَقْرِيْ اِلَيْكَ يَا رَبِّ
segs.en: so, (please) have mercy upon my humility, neediness, efforts, meekness, paucity, and my want to You, O my Lord.
segs.tr: FARHAM DHULLEE WA FAAQATEE WAJTIHAADEE WA TADARRU'EE WA MASKANATEE WA FAQREE ILAYKA YAA RABB

segs.note: Try to shed at least a single tear, for this is the sign that the dua is accepted.

A_X14.merits:
The most important rite on the fifteenth of Rajab is the supplicatory prayer known as Dua Umm Dawud. This great supplicatory prayer brings about innumerable rewards some of which are that it grants the requests, relieves from anguishes, and saves from the persecutions of the wrongdoers.

Shaykh al-Tusi describes the rite in his book Misbah al-Mutahajjid.

A_X15.name: Aamal of Laylat al-Mab'ath (27th Night)

segs.note: After the Isha prayer, sleep, then wake at any hour before midnight.
Offer a prayer of twelve units, two at a time. In each unit, recite Surah al-Fatihah and any short surah from Surah Muhammad (47) to the end of the Qur'an.
After the prayer, recite Surah al-Fatihah, Surah al-Falaq, Surah al-Nas, Surah al-Tawheed, Surah al-Kafirun, Surah al-Qadr and Ayat al-Kursi seven times each, then recite:

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا
segs.en: All praise be to Allah Who has not taken to Himself a son,
segs.tr: AL-HAMDU LILLAAHIL LADHEE LAM YATTAKHIDH WALADAA

segs.ar: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهٗ شَرِيْكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ
segs.en: Who has no partner in the Sovereignty
segs.tr: WA LAM YAKUN LAHOO SHAREEKUN FIL MULK

segs.ar: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهٗ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ الذُّلِّ
segs.en: nor has He any protecting friend through dependence.
segs.tr: WA LAM YAKUN LAHOO WALIYYUN MINADH DHULL

segs.en: And magnify Him with all magnificence.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّي اَسْاَلُكَ بِمَعَاقِدِ عِزِّكَ عَلٰى اَرْكَانِ عَرْشِكَ
segs.en: O Allah, verily I beseech You in the name of the situations of Your Dignity on the pillars of Your Throne,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS'ALUKA BIMA'AAQIDI I'ZZIKA A'LAA ARKAANI A'RSHIK

segs.en: in the name of Your utmost mercy in Your Book,
in the name of Your Name—the Greatest, the Greatest, the Greatest,
in the name of Your Mention—the Highest, the Highest, the Highest,
and in the name of Your Words the perfect,
to bless Muhammad and his Household
segs.tr: AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَفْعَلَ بِيْ مَا اَنْتَ اَهْلُهُ
segs.en: and do to me that which befits You.
segs.tr: WA AN TAF'ALA BEE MAA ANTA AHLUH

segs.note: Then ask for what you need.
It is also recommended to perform ghusl on this night.

A_X15.merits:
The twenty-seventh night of Rajab is the night on which Prophet Muhammad (s.a.w.a.) was given the mission of promulgating the religion. This highly blessed night is called laylat al-mab'ath, which stands for the beginning of the Holy Prophet's Mission of promulgating the true religion of Almighty Allah.

Shaykh al-Tusi, in his book of Misbah al-Mutahajjid, has quoted Imam Muhammad al-Jawad (a.s.) as saying, “There is a night in Rajab, which carries for people fortune that is more preferable than whatever is subjected to sunlight. It is the twenty-seventh night of Rajab. The next morning was the beginning of the Holy Prophet's prophethood. Verily, one who does acts of worship at this night will have the reward of one who has worshipped Almighty Allah for sixty years.” When the Imam (a.s.) was asked about the rites to be done at this night, he described this prayer and supplication.

A_Y1.name: Importance of the Month of Shaban

segs.note: Observe fasting in Sha'ban, the month of the Holy Prophet (s).
segs.ur: شعبان میں، جو نبی (ص) کا مہینہ ہے، روزہ رکھیں۔

segs.note: For the daily rites of Sha'ban, see General Aamal in Shaban and Daily Salawat of Shaban.
segs.ur: شعبان کے روزانہ اعمال کے لیے دیکھیں [شعبان کے عمومی اعمال](Y2) اور [شعبان کی روزانہ صلوات](Y3)۔

A_Y1.merits:
This holy month is ascribed to the Holy Prophet (s), who used to observe fasting in it and connect it to the obligatory fasting of Ramadan. He (s) used to say, "Sha'ban is my month; hence, Paradise will be incumbently decided for one who observes fasting on one day of my month."

Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a) is reported to have said: Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn Zayn al-'Abidin (a) used to gather all his companions at the beginning of Sha'ban and say to them, "O my companions, do you know what this month is? It is Sha'ban. The Holy Prophet (s) used to say, 'Sha'ban is my month.' You should thus fast in this month as a sign of your love for your Prophet and as a sign of seeking nearness to your Lord. I swear by Him Who grasps my soul in His Hand: I heard my father al-Husayn (a) saying that he heard Imam Ali, the Commander of the Faithful, saying, 'As for anyone who observes fasting in Sha'ban for the love of the Messenger of Allah (s) and for seeking nearness to Almighty Allah, Almighty Allah will love him, draw him near to His honor on the Resurrection Day, and decide Paradise for him incumbently.'"

Shaykh al-Tusi has narrated on the authority of Safwan al-Jammal that Imam al-Sadiq (a) instructed him to urge all people he knew to observe fasting in Sha'ban. "May Allah accept me as ransom for you! Is there a particular reason for this instruction?" asked Safwan al-Jammal. Imam al-Sadiq (a) answered, "Yes, there is. When his eyes fell on the new moon of Sha'ban, the Messenger of Allah (s) ordered a spokesman to declare the following to the people of al-Madinah: 'O people of Yathrib! I am the messenger of Allah's Messenger to you all, carrying this message: verily, Sha'ban is my month; therefore, may Allah have mercy upon him who helps me undertake my month.'" Imam al-Sadiq (a) then added, "Ameer al-Momineen (Imam Ali) used to say, 'I have never missed the fasting in Sha'ban since I heard the call of the Messenger of Allah in Sha'ban, and I shall never miss it so long as I am alive, God willing.'"

Imam al-Sadiq (a) further said, "To fast in two consecutive months is repentance before Almighty Allah."

Isma'il ibn 'Abd al-Khaliq narrated that when the subject of observing fasting in Sha'ban was once discussed in his presence, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a) said, "The merits of observing fasting in Sha'ban are so great that even one who sheds inviolable blood is expected to be forgiven."

segs.note: Each day in Sha'ban, recite 70 times:
segs.ur: شعبان کے ہر دن 70 مرتبہ پڑھیں:

segs.en: I implore for the forgiveness of Allah and I pray to Him for approval of my repentance.

segs.note: Also recite 70 times each day in Sha'ban:
segs.ur: نیز ماہ شعبان میں ہر روز 70 مرتبہ پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّٰهَ الَّذِيْ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الرَّحْمٰنُ الرَّحِيْمُ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ وَ اَتُوْبُ اِلَيْهِ
segs.en: I implore for the forgiveness of Allah; there is no god save Him, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful, the Ever-living, the Self-subsisting, and to Him I turn repentant.
segs.tr: ASTAGHFIRULLAAHAL LAZEE LAA ILAAHA ILLAA HUWAR RAHMAANUR RAHEEMUL HAYYUL QAYYOOMU WA ATOOBU ILAYH

segs.note: Give alms this month, even if it is only half a date.
segs.ur: اس مہینے میں صدقہ دیں، چاہے آدھی کھجور ہی ہو۔

segs.note: Throughout the month, repeat 1,000 times:
segs.ur: پورے مہینے 1000 مرتبہ دہرائیں:

segs.ar: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَ لَا نَعْبُدُ اِلَّاۤ اِيَّاهُ مُخْلِصِيْنَ لَهُ الدِّيْنَ وَ لَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُشْرِكُوْنَ
segs.en: There is no god save Allah, and we worship none save Him, being sincere to Him in obedience, though the polytheists be averse.
segs.tr: LAA ILAAHA ILLALLAAHU WA LAA NA'BUDU ILLAA IYYAAHU MUKHLISEENA LAHUD DEENA WA LAW KARIHAL MUSHRIKOON

segs.note: It is recommended to say the following form of invocation of blessings upon the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) and his Household (a.s.) that is reported from Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Sajjad (a.s.) (i.e. Imam Zayn al-’Abidin) each midday (zohr) in Sha’ban and at the fifteenth night of it:
segs.ur: مستحب ہے کہ نبی (ص) اور ان کے اہل بیت (ع) پر درود کی درج ذیل صورت جو امام علی بن الحسین سجاد (ع) (یعنی امام زین العابدین) سے منقول ہے، ماہ شعبان میں ہر روز ظہر کے وقت اور اس کی پندرھویں رات کو پڑھی جائے:

segs.en: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلی مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad;
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: the tree of Prophethood,
the trustees of the (Divine) Mission,
the frequently visited by the angels,
the core of knowledge,
and the Household of the Divine Revelation.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADENIL

segs.en: the sailing ships through the abysmal waves.
He who embarks on will be saved
but he who abandons will be drowned.
He who precedes them will miss the Right Path
and he who misses them will lose,
but he who adheres to them will win.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADENIL

segs.en: the impregnable shelter,
the succorers of the helpless, distressed ones,
the haven of the fugitives,
and the asylum of those who seek refuge.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADENIL

segs.en: so many blessings that please them

segs.ar: وَلِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَدَاءً وَقَضَاءً
segs.en: and settle all (our) duties towards Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: WA LEHAQQE MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN ADAA-AN WA QAZAA-AN

segs.en: by Your might and power,
O Lord of the worlds!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADENIL

segs.en: the pure, pious, and righteous
whose rights have been made incumbent upon us by You
and the obedience to whom and whose (divinely ordained) leadership have been (also) deemed obligatory upon us by You.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADENIL

segs.en: fill my heart with obedience to You,
do not disgrace me due to my acts of disobedience to You,

segs.ar: وَارْزُقْنِیْ مُوَاسَاةَ مَنْ قَتَّرْتَ عَلَیْہِ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ
segs.en: and grant me sympathy towards those whose sustenance You have straitened
segs.tr: WAR ZUQNEE MOWAASAATA MAN QATTARTA A’LAYHE MIN RIZQEKA

segs.en: for You have blessed me with affluence in livelihood
since You have displayed Your justice on me
and bestowed life on me to live under Your shade.
This is the month of Your Prophet and the Master of Your Messengers.
segs.tr: WA HAAZAA SHAHRO NABIYYEKA SAYYEDE ROSOLEKA

segs.en: It is Sha`ban, which You have encompassed with Your mercy and pleasure
and on which the Messenger of Allah,
segs.tr: WAR RIZWAANIL LAZEE KAANA RASOOLUL LAAHE

segs.en: peace and blessings be upon him and his Household,
segs.tr: SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI WA SALLAMA

segs.en: used to observe fasting painstakingly and used to spend it with acts of worship
on all of its days and nights
on account of Your honoring and dignifying this month,
segs.tr: BOKHOO-A’N LAKA FEE IKRAAMEHI WA E-A’ZAAMEHI

segs.en: up to his death.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَاَعِنَّا عَلَی الْاِسْتِنَانِ بِسُنَّتِہٖ فِیْہِ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) help us follow the example of him (i.e. the Holy Prophet as regards the honoring of this month)
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA FA-A-I’NNA ALAL ISTENAANE BESUNNATEHI FEEHE

segs.en: and help us attain his intercession for us.
O Allah, (please do) decide him as my interceder (before You) whose intercession for me is acceptable
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WAJ A’LHO LEE SHAFEE-A’N MOSHAFFA-A’N

segs.en: and as my clear path toward You,
and make me follow him

segs.ar: حَتّٰی اَلْقَاكَ یَوْمَ الْقِیَامَةِ عَنِّیْ رَاضِیًا
segs.en: until I meet You on the Resurrection Day in such a state that You are pleased with me
segs.tr: HATTAA ALQAAKA YAWMAL QEYAAMATE A’NNEE RAAZEYAN

segs.en: having overlooked my sins

segs.ar: قَدْ اَوْجَبْتَ لِیْ مِنْكَ الرَّحْمَةَ وَالرِّضْوَانَ
segs.en: and confer upon me with Your mercy and good pleasure
segs.tr: QAD AWJABTA LEE MINKAR RAHMATA WAR-RIZWAANA

segs.en: settling me in the Eternal Abode
and the Place of the Righteous.

segs.note: It is recommended to say the following confidential prayer (Munaajaat) that has been narrated by Ibn Khalawayh who commented on it, saying, “This is the confidential prayer of Imam Ali Ameer al-Momineen and the Holy Imams (a.s.) who used to say it in the month of Sha’ban.”
segs.ur: مستحب ہے کہ درج ذیل مناجات پڑھی جائے جسے ابن خالویہ نے روایت کیا ہے اور اس کے بارے میں کہا ہے: «یہ امیرالمومنین امام علی اور ائمہ طاہرین (ع) کی مناجات ہے جسے وہ ماہ شعبان میں پڑھا کرتے تھے۔»

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN
segs.ur: اے معبود! محمد (ص) و آلِ محمد (ع) پر رحمت نازل فرما

segs.en: You listen to my supplication whenever I pray to you,
segs.ur: اور میری دعا سن جب میں تجھ سے دعا کروں

segs.en: listen to my call whenever I call upon you,
segs.ur: اور میری پکار سن جب میں تجھے پکاروں

segs.en: and accept from me whenever I make my submission to you in confidence,
segs.ur: اور میری طرف توجہ فرما جب میں تجھ سے مناجات کروں

segs.en: for I have fled to You
segs.ur: کیونکہ میں بھاگ کر تیری طرف آیا ہوں

segs.en: standing before You,
segs.ur: اور میں تیری بارگاہ میں کھڑا ہوں

segs.en: showing submission to You,
segs.ur: تیرے سامنے اپنی عاجزی کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے

segs.en: imploring You,
segs.ur: اور تیرے سامنے گڑگڑاتے ہوئے

segs.en: and hoping for the reward that You have for me.
segs.ur: اور تیرے پاس جو ثواب ہے اس کی امید رکھتے ہوئے

segs.en: You know what is in my inner self,
segs.ur: اور تو جانتا ہے جو کچھ میرے دل میں ہے

segs.en: and you are aware of my needs,
segs.ur: اور تو میری حاجت سے آگاہ ہے

segs.en: and You know what is in my conscience,
segs.ur: اور تو میرے باطن سے باخبر ہے

segs.ar: وَلَا يَخْفٰى عَلَيْكَ اَمْرُ مُنْقَلَبِيْ وَمَثْوَايَ
segs.en: and all my moves and stillness are known by You.
segs.tr: WA LAA YAKHFAA A’LAYKA AMRO MUNQALABEE WA MASWAAYA
segs.ur: اور تجھ پر میری دنیا و آخرت کی حالت مخفی نہیں ہے

segs.ar: وَمَآ اُرِيْدُ اَنْ اُبْدِءَ بِهٖ مِنْ مَنْطِقِيْ
segs.en: So are all the utterances which I want to begin with,
segs.tr: WA MAA OREEDO AN UBDE-A BEHI MIN MANTEQEE
segs.ur: اور نہ وہ جس کا میں ارادہ کرتا ہوں کہ اپنی زبان سے اس کا آغاز کروں

segs.en: all the requests that I want to express,
segs.ur: اور جس حاجت کا اظہار کرنا چاہتا ہوں

segs.en: and all the expectation that I hope for my future.
segs.ur: اور جس کی اپنے انجام کے لیے امید رکھتا ہوں

segs.ar: وَقَدْ جَرَتْ مَقَادِيْرُكَ عَلَيَّ يَا سَيِّدِيْ
segs.en: O my Master, all Your decisions in relation to me have come to pass
segs.tr: WA QAD JARAT MAQAADEEROKA A’LAYYA YAA SAYYEDEE
segs.ur: اے میرے آقا! مجھ پر تیری وہ تقدیریں جاری ہو چکی ہیں

segs.ar: فِيْمَا يَكُوْنُ مِنِّيْٓ اِلٰٓى اٰخِرِ عُمْرِيْ
segs.en: in all that happens to me up to the end of my life,
segs.tr: FEEMAA YAKOONO MINNEE ELAA AAKHERE U’MREE
segs.ur: جو میری عمر کے آخری دم تک مجھ سے سرزد ہوں گی

segs.en: including my secret and open matters, shall be experienced by me.
segs.ur: خواہ میرے باطن میں ہوں یا ظاہر میں

segs.ar: وَبِيَدِكَ لَا بِيَدِ غَيْرِكَ زِيَادَتِيْ وَنَقْصِيْ
segs.en: And it is in Your hands, not anybody else’s, that are all my gains and losses
segs.ur: اور تیرے ہی ہاتھ میں ہے نہ کہ کسی دوسرے کے ہاتھ میں، میری زیادتی اور کمی

segs.en: and all the benefits and harms that come upon me.
segs.ur: اور میرا نفع اور نقصان

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْٓ اِنْ حَرَمْتَنِيْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْ يَرْزُقُنِيْ
segs.en: My Lord, if You deprive me (of Your sustenance), then who else can ever provide me with sustenance?
segs.tr: ELAAHEE IN HARAMTANEE FAMAN ZAL LAZEE YARZOQONEE
segs.ur: میرے معبود! اگر تو مجھے محروم کر دے تو پھر کون ہے جو مجھے رزق دے گا

segs.ar: وَاِنْ خَذَلْتَنِيْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْ يَنْصُرُنِيْ.
segs.en: If You forsake me, then who else will help me?
segs.tr: WA IN KHAZALTANEE FAMAN ZAL LAZEE YANSORONEE
segs.ur: اور اگر تو مجھے بے یار و مددگار چھوڑ دے تو پھر کون ہے جو میری مدد کرے گا

segs.en: My Lord, I do seek Your protection against Your wrath
segs.ur: میرے معبود! میں تیرے غضب سے تیری پناہ مانگتا ہوں

segs.en: and earning your displeasure.
segs.ur: اور تیری ناراضگی کے نازل ہونے سے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْٓ اِنْ كُنْتُ غَيْرَ مُسْتَأْهِلٍ لِرَحْمَتِكَ
segs.en: O my Lord, if I am not deserving of Your mercy,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE IN KUNTO GHAYRA MUSTAAHELIN LE-RAHMATEKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! اگر میں تیری رحمت کا اہل نہیں ہوں

segs.ar: فَاَنْتَ اَهْلٌ اَنْ تَجُوْدَ عَلَيَّ بِفَضْلِ سَعَتِكَ
segs.en: You are certainly fit to be generous to me by virtue of your magnanimity.
segs.tr: FA-ANTA AHLUN AN TAJOODA A’LAYYA BE-FAZLE SA-A’TEKA
segs.ur: تو تو اس کا اہل ہے کہ اپنی وسیع بخشش کے فضل سے مجھ پر کرم فرمائے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ كَاَنِّيْ بِنَفْسِيْ وَاقِفَةٌ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
segs.en: My Lord, it is as if I see myself standing before You,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE KA-ANNEE BE-NAFSEE WAAQEFATUN BAYNA YADAYKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! گویا میں خود کو تیرے سامنے کھڑا دیکھ رہا ہوں

segs.en: It has been shaded by the goodness of my trust in you
segs.tr: WA QAD AZALLAHAA HUSNO TAWAKKOLEE A’LAYKA
segs.ur: اور تجھ پر میرے اچھے توکل کا سایہ اس پر پڑ رہا ہے

segs.ar: فَقُلْتَ مَآ اَنْتَ اَهْلُهٗ وَتَغَمَّدْتَنِيْ بِعَفْوِكَ
segs.en: You said what befitted You and sheltered me with your forgiveness.
segs.tr: FAQULTO MAA ANTA AHLOHU WA TAGHAMMAD-TANEE BE-A’FWEKA
segs.ur: پس تو نے وہی فرمایا جو تیری شان کے لائق ہے اور تو نے مجھے اپنے دامنِ عفو میں ڈھانپ لیا

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْٓ اِنْ عَفَوْتَ فَمَنْ اَوْلٰى مِنْكَ بِذٰلِكَ
segs.en: My Lord, if you pardon me, then who else is worthier than You are in pardoning.
segs.tr: ELAAHEE IN A’FAWTA FAMAN AWLAA MINKA BE-ZAALEKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! اگر تو مجھے معاف فرمائے تو کون ہے جو تجھ سے زیادہ اس کا اہل ہو

segs.en: If my time of death is near
segs.tr: WA IN KAANA QAD DANAA AJALEE
segs.ur: اور اگر میری موت قریب آ گئی ہے

segs.en: and my deeds have not brought me close to You
segs.ur: اور میرا عمل مجھے تیرے قریب کرنے والا نہیں ہے

segs.ar: فَقَدْ جَعَلْتُ الْاِقْرَارَ بِالذَّنْبِ اِلَيْكَ وَسِيْلَتِيْٓ
segs.en: I make this confession of my sins to be a means of approaching You.
segs.tr: FAQAD JA-A’LTUL IQRAARA BIZ-ZANBE ELAYKA WASEELATEE
segs.ur: تو میں نے تیرے حضور اپنے گناہ کے اعتراف کو ہی اپنا وسیلہ بنا لیا ہے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ قَدْ جُرْتُ عَلٰى نَفْسِيْ فِيْ النَّظَرِ لَهَا
segs.en: My Lord, I have been unjust to my soul for I have not looked after it;
segs.tr: ELAAHEE QAD JURTO A’LAA NAFSEE FIN NAZARE LAHAA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! میں نے اپنے نفس کی دیکھ بھال میں اس پر ظلم کیا

segs.ar: فَلَهَا الْوَيْلُ اِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَهَآ
segs.en: It will be doomed if You do not forgive me.
segs.tr: FALAHAL WAYLO IN LAM TAGHFIR LAHAA
segs.ur: پس اس کے لیے ہلاکت ہے اگر تو نے اس کی مغفرت نہ فرمائی

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ لَمْ يَزَلْ بِرُّكَ عَلَيَّ اَيَّامَ حَيَاتِيْ
segs.en: My Lord, You have never ceased Your favors from me all my lifetime;
segs.tr: ELAAHEE LAM YAZAL BIRROKA A’LAYYA AYYAAMA HAYAATEE
segs.ur: میرے معبود! میری زندگی کے دنوں میں تیرا احسان ہمیشہ مجھ پر رہا

segs.ar: فَلَا تَقْطَعْ بِرَّكَ عَنِّيْ فِيْ مَمَاتِيْٓ
segs.en: So do not cease Your goodness towards me at the time of my death.
segs.tr: FALAA TAQ-TA’ BERRAKA A’NNEE FEE MAMAATEE
segs.ur: پس میری موت کے وقت بھی مجھ سے اپنا احسان منقطع نہ فرما

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ كَيْفَ اٰيَسُ مِنْ حُسْنِ نَظَرِكَ لِيْ بَعْدَ مَمَاتِيْ
segs.en: My Lord, how can I despair of Your benevolent attention towards me after my death
segs.tr: ELAAHEE KAYFA AAYASO MIN HUSNE NAZAREKA LEE BA’DA MAMAATEE
segs.ur: میرے معبود! میں مرنے کے بعد تیری حسنِ نظر سے کیونکر ناامید ہو سکتا ہوں

segs.ar: وَاَنْتَ لَمْ تُوَلِّنِيْٓ اِلَّا الْجَمِيْلَ فِيْ حَيَاتِيْ
segs.en: while You have always been good to me throughout my lifetime?
segs.tr: WA ANTA LAM TOWALLENEE ILLAL JAMEELA FEE HAYAATEE
segs.ur: جبکہ تو نے میری زندگی میں میرے ساتھ سوائے اچھائی کے کوئی برتاؤ نہیں کیا

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ تَوَلَّ مِنْ اَمْرِيْ مَآ اَنْتَ اَهْلُهٗ
segs.en: My Lord, (please) manage my affairs in the very way that befits You,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE TAWALLA MIN AMREE MAA ANTA AHLOHU
segs.ur: میرے معبود! میرے معاملات کی اس طرح سرپرستی فرما جو تیرے شایانِ شان ہے

segs.ar: وَعُدْ عَلَيَّ بِفَضْلِكَ عَلٰى مُذْنِبٍ قَدْ غَمَرَهُ جَهْلُهٗ
segs.en: and confer upon me—a sinful person who is covered by his ignorance—with Your favors.
segs.tr: WA U’D A’LAYYA BE-FAZLEKA A’LAA MUZNEBIN QAD GHAMARAHU JAHLOHU
segs.ur: اور مجھ گنہگار پر اپنے فضل سے توجہ فرما جسے اس کی نادانی نے گھیر رکھا ہے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ قَدْ سَتَرْتَ عَلَيَّ ذُنُوْبًا فِيْ الدُّنْيَا
segs.en: My Lord, You have concealed my sins in this world,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE QAD SATARTA A’LAYYA ZONOOBAN FID DUNYAA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! تو نے دنیا میں میرے گناہوں کی پردہ پوشی فرمائی

segs.ar: وَاَنَآ اَحْوَجُ اِلٰى سَتْرِهَا عَلَيَّ مِنْكَ فِي الْاُخْرٰى
segs.en: but I am in greater need of their being concealed in the Next Life.
segs.tr: WA ANAA AHWAJO ELAA SATREHAA A’LAYYA MINKA FIL UKHRAA
segs.ur: جبکہ میں آخرت میں تجھ سے ان کی پردہ پوشی کا زیادہ محتاج ہوں

segs.en: My Lord, You have been good to me
segs.ur: میرے معبود! تو نے مجھ پر احسان کیا

segs.ar: اِذْ لَمْ تُظْهِرْهَا لِاَحَدٍ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِيْنَ
segs.en: in that You did not reveal them to any of Your righteous servants;
segs.tr: IZ LAM TUZHIRHAA LE-AHADIN MIN E’BAADEKAS SAALEHEEN
segs.ur: کہ تو نے میرے گناہ اپنے نیک بندوں میں سے کسی پر ظاہر نہیں کیے

segs.ar: فَلَا تَفْضَحْنِيْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلٰى رُؤُسِ الْاَشْهَادِ
segs.en: therefore, (please) do not disgrace me on the Resurrection Day before all the witnesses.
segs.tr: FALAA TAFZAHNEE YAWMAL QEYAAMATE A’LAA RO-OOSIL ASHHAADE
segs.ur: پس روزِ قیامت بھی تمام گواہوں کے سامنے مجھے رسوا نہ فرما

segs.en: My Lord, it is Your magnanimity that expanded my hope,
segs.ur: میرے معبود! تیری سخاوت نے میری امید بڑھا دی ہے

segs.en: and surely Your pardon is superior to my deeds.
segs.ur: اور تیرا عفو میرے عمل سے برتر ہے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ فَسُرَّنِيْ بِلِقَآئِكَ يَوْمَ تَقْضِيْ فِيْهِ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ
segs.en: My Lord, therefore gladden my heart when I meet You on the day when You shall judge between Your servants.
segs.tr: ELAAHEE FASURRANEE BELEQAAA-EKA YAWMA TAQZEE FEEHE BAYNA E’BAADEKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! اپنی ملاقات سے مجھے اس دن شاد فرما جس روز تو اپنے بندوں کے درمیان فیصلہ کرے گا

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ اِعْتِذَارِيْٓ اِلَيْكَ اعْتِذَارُ مَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَغْنِ عَنْ قَبُوْلِ عُذْرِهٖ
segs.en: My Lord, I submit to You the apology of one who cannot dispense with the acceptance of his excuse;
segs.tr: ELAAHEE E-A’TEZAAREE ELAYKA’ TEZAARO MAN LAM YASTAGHNE A’N QABOOLE U’ZREHI
segs.ur: میرے معبود! تیرے حضور میری معذرت اس شخص کی معذرت ہے جو اپنے عذر کی قبولیت سے بے نیاز نہیں ہو سکتا

segs.ar: فَاقْبَلْ عُذْرِيْ يَآ اَكْرَمَ مَنِ اعْتَذَرَ اِلَيْهِ الْمُسِيْٓئُوْنَ.
segs.en: so, (please) accept my excuse, O most Magnanimous of all those before whom the guilty make an apology.
segs.tr: FAQBAL U’ZREE YAA AKRAMA MANE’ TAZARA ELAYHIL MOSEE-OONA.
segs.ur: پس میرا عذر قبول فرما اے ان سب سے بڑھ کر کرم والے جن سے گنہگار معذرت چاہتے ہیں

segs.en: My Lord, (please) do not reject my request,
segs.ur: میرے مولا میری حاجت رد نہ فرما

segs.en: do not disappoint my hope for You,
segs.ur: اور میری امید میں مجھے ناامید نہ کر

segs.en: and do not cut off from You my hope and expectations from You.
segs.tr: WA LAA TAQTA’ MINKA RAJAAA-EE WA AMALEE
segs.ur: اور اپنی بارگاہ سے میری آس اور امید کو منقطع نہ فرما

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ لَوْ اَرَدْتَ هَوَانِيْ لَمْ تَهْدِنِيْ
segs.en: My Lord, had You wanted to humiliate me, You would not have guided me (to You).
segs.tr: ELAAHEE LAW ARADTA HAWAANEE LAM TAHDENEE
segs.ur: میرے معبود! اگر تو میری رسوائی چاہتا تو مجھے ہدایت نہ فرماتا

segs.en: and had You wanted to disgrace me, You would not have granted me well-being.
segs.tr: WA LAW ARADTA FAZEEHATEE LAM TO-A’AFENEE
segs.ur: اور اگر مجھے ذلیل کرنا چاہتا تو مجھے عافیت نہ بخشتا

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ مَا اَظُنُّكَ تَرُدُّنِيْ فِيْ حَاجَةٍ قَدْ اَفْنَيْتُ عُمْرِيْ فِيْ طَلَبِهَا مِنْكَ
segs.en: My Lord, I do not expect You to reject my request that I spent my whole lifetime asking for it from You.
segs.tr: ELAAHEE MAA AZUNNOKA TARUDDANEE FEE HAAJATIN QAD AFNAYTO U’MREE FEE TALABEHAA MINKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! میرا یہ گمان نہیں کہ تو مجھے اس حاجت میں نامراد لوٹائے گا جس کے لیے میں نے اپنی عمر تجھ سے مانگنے میں گزاری ہے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ اَبَدًا اَبَدًا دَآئِمًا سَرْمَدًا
segs.en: My Lord, all praise be to You, forever, forever, perpetually, everlastingly,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE FALAKAL HAMDO ABADAN ABADAN DAAA-EMAN SARMADAN
segs.ur: میرے معبود! حمد تیرے ہی لیے ہے، ہمیشہ ہمیشہ، دائمی، بڑھتی ہوئی اور لازوال

segs.ar: يَزِيْدُ وَلَا يَبِيْدُ كَمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضٰٓى
segs.en: increasingly, and imperishably, as exactly as You like and please.
segs.tr: YAZEEDO WA LAA YABEEDO KAMAA TOHIBBO WA TARZAA
segs.ur: جیسا کہ تو پسند فرماتا اور راضی ہوتا ہے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْٓ اِنْ اَخَذْتَنِيْ بِجُرْمِيْٓ اَخَذْتُكَ بِعَفْوِكَ
segs.en: My Lord, if You punish me for my offense, I shall cling to Your pardon,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE IN AKHAZTANEE BEJURMEE AKHAZTOKA BE-A’FWEKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! اگر تو نے میرے جرائم پر میرا مواخذہ کیا تو میں تیری بخشش کا واسطہ دوں گا

segs.en: and if You seize me for my sins, I shall take hold of Your forgiveness,
segs.tr: WA IN AKHAZTANEE BE-ZONOOBEE AKHAZTOKA BEMAGHFERATEKA
segs.ur: اور اگر تو نے میرے گناہوں پر مجھے پکڑا تو میں تیری مغفرت کی دہائی دوں گا

segs.ar: وَاِنْ اَدْخَلْتَنِيْ النَّارَ اَعْلَمْتُ اَهْلَهَآ اَنِّيْٓ اُحِبُّكَ
segs.en: and if You put me to the fire, I shall declare to its inmates that I love You.
segs.tr: WA IN ADKHALTANIN NAARA A-A’LAMTO AHLAHAA ANNEE OHIBBOKA
segs.ur: اور اگر تو نے مجھے جہنم میں ڈالا تو میں اہل جہنم کو بتاؤں گا کہ میں تجھ سے محبت کرتا تھا

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْٓ اِنْ كَانَ صَغُرَ فِيْ جَنْبِ طَاعَتِكَ عَمَلِيْ
segs.en: My Lord, should my deeds be insignificant with respect to obedience to You,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE IN KAANA SAGHORA FEE JANBE TAA-A’TEKA A’MALEE
segs.ur: میرے معبود! اگر تیری اطاعت کے سلسلے میں میرا عمل کمتر ہے

segs.ar: فَقَدْ كَبُرَ فِيْ جَنْبِ رَجَآئِكَ اَمَلِيْٓ
segs.en: Great indeed is my hope with respect to my expectations from You.
segs.tr: FAQAD KABORA FEE JANBE RAJAAA-EKA AMALEE
segs.ur: تو بھی تجھ سے بخشش کی امید رکھنے میں میری آرزو بہت بڑی ہے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ كَيْفَ اَنْقَلِبُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ بِالْخَيْبَةِ مَحْرُوْمًا
segs.en: My Lord, how can it be that I return from You with disappointment and deprivation
segs.tr: ELAAHEE KAYFA ANQALEBO MIN I’NDEKA BIL-KHAYBATE MAHROOMAN
segs.ur: میرے معبود! کس طرح میں تیری درگاہ سے مایوسی میں خالی ہاتھ پلٹ جاؤں

segs.ar: وَقَدْ كَانَ حُسْنُ ظَنِّيْ بِجُوْدِكَ اَنْ تَقْلِبَنِيْ بِالنَّجَاةِ مَرْحُوْمًا
segs.en: for indeed my beautiful opinion about Your generosity was that You shall reverse my fate by saving me mercifully.
segs.tr: WA QAD KAANA HUSNO ZANNEE BEJOODEKA AN TAQLEBANEE BIN-NAJAATE MARHOOMAN
segs.ur: جبکہ میں تیری عطا سے یہ توقع رکھتا ہوں کہ تو مجھے رحمت و بخشش کے ساتھ پلٹائے گا

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ وَقَدْ اَفْنَيْتُ عُمُرِيْ فِيْ شِرَّةِ السَّهْوِ عَنْكَ
segs.en: My Lord, I have spent my entire lifetime in being negligent to You
segs.tr: ELAAHEE WA QAD AFNAYTO O’MOREE FEE SHIRRATIS SAHWE A’NKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! میں نے تجھے فراموش کر کے اپنی زندگی برائی میں گزاری

segs.ar: وَاَبْلَيْتُ شَبَابِيْ فِيْ سَكْرَةِ التَّبَاعُدِ مِنْكَ
segs.en: and I have spent my whole youth with the stupor of being distant from You.
segs.tr: WA ABLAYTO SHABAABEE FEE SAKRATIT TABAA-O’DE MINKA
segs.ur: اور میں نے اپنی جوانی تجھ سے دوری اور غفلت میں گنوائی

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ فَلَمْ اَسْتَيْقِظْ اَيَّامَ اغْتِرَارِيْ بِكَ
segs.en: My Lord, I did not wake up from my delusions
segs.tr: ELAAHEE FALAM ASTAYQIZ AYYAAMAGH TERAAREE BEKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! تیرے مقابل جرات کرنے کے دوران میں ہوش میں نہ آیا

segs.en: and did not desist from pursuing the path of Your displeasure.
segs.ur: اور تیری ناخوشی کے راستے پر چلتا گیا

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ وَاَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ عَبْدِكَ قَآئِمٌ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
segs.en: My Lord, nevertheless, I am—Your servant and the son of Your servant, now standing before You
segs.tr: ELAAHEE WA ANAA A’BDOKA WAB NO A’BDEKA QAAA-EMUN BAYNA YADAYKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! اور میں تیرا بندہ اور تیرے بندے کا بیٹا ہوں جو تیری بارگاہ میں کھڑا ہے

segs.en: and begging You in the name of Your generosity.
segs.ur: اور تیرے ہی لطف و کرم کو وسیلہ بنا کر تیری بارگاہ میں آیا ہے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْٓ اَنَا عَبْدٌ اَتَنَصَّلُ اِلَيْكَ مِمَّا كُنْتُ اُوَاجِهُكَ بِهٖ
segs.en: My Lord, I am a servant, disavowing before You
segs.tr: ELAAHEE ANAA A’BDUN ATANASSALO ELAYKA MIMMAA KUNTO OWAAJEHOKA BEHI
segs.ur: میرے معبود! میں وہ بندہ ہوں جو تیرے حضور اس رویے سے بیزاری ظاہر کرتا ہے جس کے ساتھ میں تیرے روبرو آیا

segs.en: of my past attitude of lack of shame in Your sight
segs.ur: تیری نگاہوں سے شرم و حیا کی کمی کے سبب

segs.ar: وَاَطْلُبُ الْعَفْوَ مِنْكَ اِذِ الْعَفْوُ نَعْتٌ لِكَرَمِكَ
segs.en: seek Your pardon as it is the attribute of Your magnanimty to pardon;
segs.tr: WA ATLOBUL A’FWA MINKA EZIL A’FWO NA’TUN LEKARAMEKA
segs.ur: اور میں تجھ سے عفو کا طالب ہوں کیونکہ معاف کر دینا تیرے لطف و کرم کا خاصہ ہے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لِيْ حَوْلٌ فَاَنْتَقِلَ بِهٖ عَنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
segs.en: My Lord, I had no strength to desist from Your disobedience
segs.tr: ELAAHEE LAM YAKUN LEE HAWLUN FA-ANTAQEKA BEHI A’N MA’SEYATEKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! میں گناہوں سے نکلنے کی طاقت نہیں رکھتا تھا

segs.en: except when You awakened me for Your love
segs.ur: مگر اس وقت جب تو نے اپنی محبت سے مجھے بیدار کیا

segs.en: and I became just as You wanted me to be.
segs.tr: WA KAMAAA ARADTA AN AKOONA KUNTO
segs.ur: اور میں ویسا ہی ہوا جیسا تو نے چاہا کہ میں بنوں

segs.en: I have thus thanked You, for You admitting me into Your generosity
segs.ur: پس میں تیرا شکر گزار ہوں کہ تو نے مجھے اپنے لطف و کرم میں داخل فرمایا

segs.ar: وَلِتَطْهِيْرِ قَلْبِيْ مِنْ اَوْسَاخِ الْغَفْلَةِ عَنْكَ
segs.en: and You have purified my heart from the filth of being inattentive to You.
segs.tr: WA LE-TATHEERE QALBEE MIN AWSAAKHIL GHAFLATE A’NKA
segs.ur: اور میرے دل کو غفلت کی آلودگیوں سے پاک کیا

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ انْظُرْ اِلَيَّ نَظَرَ مَنْ نَادَيْتَهٗ فَاَجَابَكَ
segs.en: My Lord, (please) look upon me in the same way as You have looked at one whom You called and he has responded to You
segs.tr: ELAAHIN ZUR ELAYYA MAN NAADAYTAHU FA-AJAABAKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! میری طرف اس طرح نظر فرما جیسے اس پر نظر فرمائی جسے تو نے پکارا تو اس نے تیری پکار کا جواب دیا

segs.en: and whom You used him in Your service with Your aid and so he obeys You.
segs.ur: اور تو نے اپنی مدد سے اس سے کام لیا تو اس نے تیری اطاعت کی

segs.ar: يَا قَرِيْبًا لَا يَبْعُدُ عَنِ الْمُغْتَرِّ بِهٖ
segs.en: O Near One Who does not keep away from the one who is deluded about Him,
segs.tr: YAA QAREEBAN LAA YAB-O’DO A’NIL MUGHTARRE BEHI
segs.ur: اے وہ قریب جو کسی غافل سے بھی دور نہیں ہوتا

segs.ar: وَيَا جَوَادًا لَا يَبْخَلُ عَمَّنْ رَجَا ثَوَابَهٗ
segs.en: O He Who is too magnanimous to deprive one who hopes for His reward!
segs.tr: WA YAA JAWAADAN LAA YABKHALO A’MMAN RAJAA SAWAABAHU
segs.ur: اور اے وہ سخی جو اس سے بخل نہیں کرتا جو اس کے ثواب کی امید رکھتا ہے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ هَبْ لِيْ قَلْبًا يُدْنِيْهِ مِنْكَ شَوْقُهٗ
segs.en: My Lord, (please) grant me a heart whose longing for You will draw one close to You,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE HAB LEE QALBAN YUDNEEHE MINKA SHAWQOHU
segs.ur: میرے معبود! مجھے ایسا دل عطا فرما جس کا اشتیاق اسے تیرے قریب کر دے

segs.en: a tongue whose truthfulness ascends towards You,
segs.ur: اور ایسی زبان بخش جس کی سچائی تیری بارگاہ میں بلند کی جائے

segs.en: and a sight whose trueness brings it close to You.
segs.ur: اور ایسی نظر عطا فرما جس کی حقیقت اسے تیرے قریب لائے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْٓ اِنَّ مَنْ تَعَرَّفَ بِكَ غَيْرُ مَجْهُوْلٍ
segs.en: My Lord, certainly he who recognizes You shall never be anonymous,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE INNA MAN TA-A’RRAFA BEKA GHAYRO MAJHOOLIN
segs.ur: میرے معبود! جسے تیری پہچان ہو جائے وہ گمنام نہیں رہتا

segs.en: he who seeks Your shelter shall never be disappointed,
segs.ur: اور جو تیری پناہ لے وہ بے یار و مددگار نہیں رہتا

segs.en: and he to whom You turn to does not fall victim to servility (dejection).
segs.tr: WA MAN AQBALTA A’LAYHE GHAYRO MAMLOOKIN.
segs.ur: اور جس کی طرف تو متوجہ ہو جائے وہ کسی کا غلام نہیں بنتا

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْٓ اِنَّ مَنِ انْتَهَجَ بِكَ لَمُسْتَنِيْرٌ
segs.en: My Lord, certainly he who abides by Your Path shall be enlightened,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE INNA MANIN TAHAJA BEKA LA-MUSTANEERUN
segs.ur: میرے معبود! بے شک جو تیرے بتائے ہوئے راستے پر چلے وہ راہ پا جاتا ہے

segs.en: and he who resorts in You finds refuge.
segs.tr: WA INNA MANE’ TASAMA BEKA LAMUSTAJEERUN
segs.ur: اور جو تیرا دامن تھام لے وہ پناہ پا جاتا ہے

segs.ar: وَقَدْ لُذْتُ بِكَ يَآ اِلٰهِيْ فَلَا تُخَيِّبْ ظَنِّيْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ
segs.en: Indeed certainly I have taken shelter in You, My Lord! So, (please) do not let down my opinion in Your mercy
segs.tr: WA QAD LUZTO BEKA YAA ELAAHEE FALAA TOKHAYYIB ZANNEE MIN RAHMATEKA
segs.ur: اور اے میرے معبود! میں نے تیری پناہ لی ہے، پس اپنے لطف و کرم کے بارے میں میرے گمان کو جھوٹا نہ کر

segs.en: and do not exclude me from Your compassion.
segs.ur: اور مجھے اپنی مہربانی سے محروم نہ فرما

segs.en: My Lord, place me among the people of Your friendship (wilayah),
segs.ur: میرے معبود! مجھے اپنے خاص دوستوں کے مقام پر فائز فرما

segs.ar: مُقَامَ مَنْ رَجَا الزِّيَادَةَ مِنْ مَحَبَّتِكَ
segs.en: the position of those who (incessantly) hope to increase Your love.
segs.tr: MOQAAMA MAN RAJAZ ZEYAADATA MIN MAHABBATEKA
segs.ur: اس شخص کی مانند جو تیری محبت میں اضافے کا امیدوار ہو

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ وَاَلْهِمْنِيْ وَلَهًا بِذِكْرِكَ اِلٰى ذِكْرِكَ
segs.en: My Lord, (please) inspire me with a mounting passion for Your rememberance,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE WA ALHIMNEE WALAHAN BE-ZIKREKA ELAA ZIKREKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! اور میرے دل میں اپنے ذکر کا والہانہ شوق الہام فرما

segs.ar: وَهِمَّتِيْ فِيْ رَوْحِ نَجَاحِ اَسْمَآئِكَ وَمَحَلِّ قُدْسِكَ
segs.en: and (please) with an ardour for the refreshing resort to Your names and the station of Your Holiness.
segs.tr: WA HIMMATEE FEE RAWHE NAJAAHE ASMAAA-EKA WA MAHALLE QUDSEKA
segs.ur: اور میری ہمت کو اپنے اسماء کے فیض اور اپنے مقامِ قدس کی کامیابی میں لگا دے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ بِكَ عَلَيْكَ اِلَّآ اَلْحَقْتَنِيْ بِمَحَلِّ اَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ
segs.en: My Lord, I beseech You in Your name to put me in the abode of those who are obedient to You
segs.tr: ELAAHEE BEKA A’LAYKA ILLAA ALHAQTANEE BE-MAHALLE AHLE TAA-A’TEKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! تجھے تیرے ہی حق کی قسم کہ مجھے اپنے اطاعت گزاروں کے ٹھکانے پر پہنچا دے

segs.en: and to the righteous sanctuary of Your good pleasure,
segs.ur: اور اپنی رضا کے پسندیدہ مقام پر قرار دے

segs.en: for I, certainly have no power to repel any harm
segs.ur: کیونکہ میں نہ تو اپنے نفس سے کسی برائی کو دور کرنے کی قدرت رکھتا ہوں

segs.en: nor to obtain any benefit for it.
segs.ur: اور نہ اسے کوئی فائدہ پہنچانے کا اختیار رکھتا ہوں

segs.en: My Lord, I am Your weak and sinful servant—
segs.ur: میرے معبود! میں تیرا کمزور، گنہگار بندہ ہوں

segs.en: and Your repenting slave.
segs.ur: اور تیرا توبہ کرنے والا غلام ہوں

segs.ar: فَلا تَجْعَلْنِيْ مِمَّنْ صَرَفْتَ عَنْهُ وَجْهَكَ
segs.en: So, (please) do not include me amongst those from whom You have turned away Your face
segs.tr: FA-LAA TAJ-A’LNEE MIMMAN SARAFTA A’NHO WAJHAKA
segs.ur: پس مجھے ان لوگوں میں سے نہ بنا جن سے تو نے اپنا رخ پھیر لیا ہے

segs.en: and those who are excluded from Your pardon because of their lapses.
segs.ur: اور جن کی غفلت نے انہیں تیرے عفو سے محروم کر دیا ہے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ هَبْ لِيْ كَمَالَ الْاِنْقِطَاعِ اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: My Lord, (please) grant me absolute devotion to You
segs.tr: ELAAHEE HAB LEE KAMAALAL IN-QETAA-E’ ELAYKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! مجھے اپنی طرف مکمل یکسوئی اور توجہ عطا فرما

segs.ar: وَاَنِرْ اَبْصَارَ قُلُوْبِنَا بِضِيَآءِ نَظَرِهَآ اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: and illumine the vision of our hearts by the light of their gaze looking towards You
segs.tr: WA ANIR ABSAARE QOLOOBENAA BE-ZEYAAA-E NAZAREHAA ELAYKA
segs.ur: اور ہمارے دلوں کی آنکھوں کو اپنے دیدار کے نور سے روشن بنا دے

segs.ar: حَتّٰى تَخْرِقَ اَبْصَارُ الْقُلُوْبِ حُجُبَ النُّوْرِ
segs.en: until the vision of our hearts pierces the curtains of light
segs.tr: HATTAA TAKHREQA ABSAARUL QOLOOBE HOJOBAN NOORE
segs.ur: یہاں تک کہ دلوں کی آنکھیں نور کے پردوں کو چیر ڈالیں

segs.en: to reach the core of supremacy,
segs.ur: اور عظمت کے سرچشمے تک پہنچ جائیں

segs.en: and that our souls become suspended by the majesty of Your Holiness.
segs.tr: WA TASEERA ARWAAHONAA MO-A’LLAQATAN BE-I’ZZE QUDSEKA
segs.ur: اور ہماری روحیں تیری پاکیزہ عزت کے ساتھ وابستہ ہو جائیں

segs.en: My Lord, (please) appoint me of those who responded to You when You called them,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE WAJ A’LNEE MIMMAN NAADAYTAHU FA-AJAABAKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! اور مجھے ان لوگوں میں قرار دے جنہیں تو نے پکارا تو انہوں نے تجھے لبیک کہا

segs.en: and at whom You glanced so he swoons before Your Majesty
segs.ur: اور تو نے ان پر نظر فرمائی تو وہ تیرے جلال و ہیبت سے غش کھا گئے

segs.en: So You speak to him secretly and he works for You openly.
segs.tr: FANAAJAYTAHU SIRRAN WA A’MELA LAKA JAHRAN
segs.ur: پس تو نے پوشیدہ طور پر ان سے مناجات کی اور انہوں نے ظاہر میں تیرے لیے عمل کیا

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ لَمْ اُسَلِّطْ عَلٰى حُسْنِ ظَنِّيْ قُنُوْطَ الْاَيَاسِ
segs.en: My Lord, I have not let the despondency of despair overcome my good opinion of You,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE LAM OSALLIT A’LAA HUSNE ZANNEE QONOOTAL AYAASE
segs.ur: میرے معبود! میں نے اپنے اچھے گمان پر ناامیدی کو مسلط نہیں ہونے دیا

segs.ar: وَلَا انْقَطَعَ رَجَآئِيْ مِنْ جَمِيْلِ كَرَمِكَ
segs.en: nor has my hope in Your beautiful generosity been cut off.
segs.tr: WA LAN QATA-A’ RAJAAA-EE MIN JAMEELE KARAMEKA
segs.ur: اور تیرے حسین لطف و کرم سے میری امید کبھی منقطع نہیں ہوئی

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْٓ اِنْ كَانَتِ الْخَطَايَا قَدْ اَسْقَطَتْنِيْ لَدَيْكَ
segs.en: My Lord, if my lapses have made me to fall from Your grace,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE IN KAANATIL KHATAAYAA QAD ASQATATNEE LADAYKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! اگر خطاؤں نے مجھے تیری نگاہ میں گرا دیا ہے

segs.en: So please pardon me for the beauty of my reliance upon You.
segs.ur: تو میرے اس اچھے توکل کے سبب مجھ سے درگزر فرما جو مجھے تجھ پر ہے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْٓ اِنْ حَطَّتْنِيْ الذُّنُوْبُ مِنْ مَكَارِمِ لُطْفِكَ
segs.en: My Lord, if my wrongdoings have excluded me from the generosity of Your grace,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE IN HATTAT-NIZ ZONOOBO MIN MAKAAREME LUTFEKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! اگر گناہوں نے مجھے تیرے شایانِ شان لطف سے دور گرا دیا ہے

segs.ar: فَقَدْ نَبَّهَنِيْ الْيَقِيْنُ اِلٰى كَرَمِ عَطْفِكَ
segs.en: So certainly my conviction reassures me of Your generosity and gentleness.
segs.tr: FAQAD NABBAHATNIL YAQEENO ELAA KARAME A’TFEKA
segs.ur: تو یقین نے مجھے تیری مہربانی کی طرف بیدار کر دیا ہے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْٓ اِنْ اَنَامَتْنِيْ الْغَفْلَةُ عَنِ الْاِسْتِعْدَادِ لِلِقَآئِكَ
segs.en: My Lord, if my neglect has lulled me into slumber preventing me from preparing myself for my meeting with You,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE IN ANAA MATNIL GHAFLATO A’NIL ISTE’DAADE LE-LEQAAA-EKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! اگر غفلت نے مجھے تیری بارگاہ میں حاضری کی تیاری سے سلا دیا ہے

segs.en: So certainly my recognition apprises me of your generous bounties has awakened me.
segs.ur: تو تیری نعمتوں کی معرفت نے مجھے بیدار کر دیا ہے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْٓ اِنْ دَعَانِيْٓ اِلَى النَّارِ عَظِيْمُ عِقَابِكَ
segs.en: My Lord, if Your grave chastisement calls me to the Hellfire,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE IN DA-A’AANEE ELAN NAARE A’ZEEMO E’QAABEKA
segs.ur: میرے معبود! اگر تیرے عظیم عذاب نے مجھے آگ کی طرف بلایا ہے

segs.ar: فَقَدْ دَعَانِيْٓ اِلَى الْجَنَّةِ جَزِيْلُ ثَوَابِكَ
segs.en: So Your plentious reward has called me to Paradise.
segs.tr: FAQAD DA-A’AANEE ELAL JANNATE JAZEELO SAWAABEKA
segs.ur: تو تیرے کثیر ثواب نے مجھے جنت کی طرف بلایا ہے

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ فَلَكَ اَسْاَلُ وَاِلَيْكَ اَبْتَهِلُ وَاَرْغَبُ
segs.en: My Lord, so to You I beg and I implore and I request.
segs.tr: ELAAHEE FALAKA AS-ALO WA ELAYKA ABTAHELO WA ARGHABO
segs.ur: میرے معبود! پس میں صرف تجھ ہی سے مانگتا ہوں اور تیرے ہی حضور گڑگڑاتا ہوں اور تیری ہی طرف رغبت رکھتا ہوں

segs.ar: وَاَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: I beseech You to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: WA AS-ALOKA AN TOSALLEYA A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN
segs.ur: اور تجھ سے سوال کرتا ہوں کہ محمد (ص) و آلِ محمد (ع) پر رحمت نازل فرما

segs.en: and to include me with those who always remember You,
segs.tr: WA AN TAJ-A’LANEE MIMMAN YODEEMO ZIKRAKA
segs.ur: اور مجھے ان میں سے قرار دے جو ہمیشہ تیرا ذکر کرتے ہیں

segs.en: and those who never break their promise to You,
segs.ur: اور تیرے عہد کو نہیں توڑتے

segs.en: and who do not neglect to thank You,
segs.ur: اور تیرے شکر سے غافل نہیں ہوتے

segs.en: and who never belittle Your commands.
segs.ur: اور تیرے حکم کو سبک نہیں سمجھتے

segs.en: My Lord, (please do) join me to the most radiant light of Your might,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE WA ALHIQNEE BE-NOORE I’ZZEKAL ABHAJE
segs.ur: میرے معبود! اور مجھے اپنی تابناک عزت کے نور سے ملا دے

segs.en: so that I will recognize You
segs.ur: تاکہ میں تیری معرفت حاصل کر لوں

segs.en: and renounce all else except You,
segs.ur: اور تیرے سوا سب سے منہ موڑ لوں

segs.en: and that I will be fearful of and careful with You.
segs.ur: اور تجھ سے ڈرنے والا اور تیرا خیال رکھنے والا بن جاؤں

segs.en: O Lord of Majesty and Honor!
segs.ur: اے جلال اور بزرگی کے مالک

segs.ar: وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُوْلِهِ وَاٰلِهِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ
segs.en: May Allah send blessings to Muhammad, His Messenger, and upon his Household the Infallible,
segs.tr: WA SALLAL LAAHO A’LAA MOHAMMADIN RASOOLEHI WA AALEHIT TAAHEREENA
segs.ur: اور اللہ رحمت نازل فرمائے اپنے رسول محمد (ص) پر اور ان کی پاکیزہ آل پر

segs.en: and may countless greetings be to them.
segs.ur: اور خوب سلام بھیجے، بہت زیادہ سلام۔

segs.note: This confidential prayer (Munajat), ascribed to the Holy Imams (a.s.), is highly significant since it comprises excellent meanings. It is advisable to say it with presence of heart all the time.
segs.ur: ائمہ طاہرین (ع) سے منسوب یہ مناجات نہایت اہم ہے کیونکہ اس میں بلند معانی ہیں۔ اسے ہمیشہ حضورِ قلب کے ساتھ پڑھنا مستحب ہے۔

segs.note: As mentioned in Iqbal al-A’mal, narrations have referred to many prayers to be offered at the first night of Sha’ban. One of these prayers is a twelve unit prayer in each unit of which Surah al-Faatehah is recited once and Surah al-Tawheed repeated eleven times.
segs.ur: جیسا کہ اقبال الاعمال میں مذکور ہے، روایات میں شعبان کی پہلی رات پڑھی جانے والی بہت سی نمازوں کا ذکر ہے۔ ان میں سے ایک بارہ رکعت کی نماز ہے جس کی ہر رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) گیارہ مرتبہ پڑھی جاتی ہے.

A_Y6.name: First Day of Shaban

segs.note: Observe fasting on the first day of Sha'ban.
segs.ur: شعبان کے پہلے دن روزہ رکھیں۔

segs.note: Observe fasting on three days in Sha'ban, and offer a two unit prayer on the nights of those days: in each unit recite Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Tawheed eleven times.
segs.ur: شعبان میں تین دن روزہ رکھیں، اور ان دنوں کی راتوں میں دو رکعت نماز پڑھیں: ہر رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) گیارہ مرتبہ پڑھیں۔

A_Y6.merits:
A great reward is gained from fasting on the first day of Sha’ban. Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq(a.s.) is reported as saying, “Paradise will be incumbently decided for one who observes fasting on the first day of Sha’ban.”

Likewise, Sayyid Ibn Tawus has narrated on the authority of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) that an abundant reward will be conferred to one who observes fasting on three days in Sha’ban at the nights of which a two unit prayer is offered. In each unit of this prayer, one should recite Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Tawheed eleven times.

The book of Tafsir (exegesis of the Holy Qur’an) that is ascribed to the Imam (a.s.) has comprised a narration referring to the great value of the month of Sha’ban. At the end of his Persian book of Kelimeh Teyyibeh, Shaykh al-Nuri, a master scholar, has referred to this narration, which is too long to be mentioned literally here. This is the summary of this wonderful narration:

On the first day of Sha’ban, Imam AliAmeer al-Momineen(a.s.) passed by a group of Muslims who sat in a mosque debating about theological matters, such as fatalism, with loud voices and intense arguments. The Imam (a.s.) stopped by them and greeted them. They responded to his greeting, made him room, and begged him to sit with them. However, the Imam (a.s.) did not care for them; rather, he addressed to them saying:

“O you people who discuss matters that are neither their business nor benefiting them! You should have known that Almighty Allah has certain servants who are silent although they are neither inexpressive nor mute. Rather, whenever they consider the magnificence of Almighty Allah, their tongues die down, their hearts repose, their intellects halt, and their minds cease, on account of their glorifying, honoring, and feeling the majesty of Almighty Allah. When they regain consciousness, they compete with each other on seeking nearness to Him by means of pure acts. They regard themselves as wrongdoers and transgressors while they are free from any negligence or immoderation; rather, they do not accept to give little to Almighty Allah and they do not regard anything that they do for Him as adequate. They therefore exert all efforts in acts of worship to Him. When you notice them as they prepare themselves for acts of worship, you find them fearful, frightened, anxious, and terrified. Thus, great is the difference between them and you, the heretic people! You should have known that the more one may know about fatalism the more silent one will be. On the contrary, the most ignorant with fatalism are those who debate about it very much. O group of heretic people! This day is the first day of Sha’ban, the honorable month. Our Lord has given it this name (i.e. Sha’ban), because welfare is distributed in this month. Your Lord has opened wide the gates of His Paradise and offered you the palaces and bliss of Paradise with the cheapest costs and the easiest matters; therefore, you should purchase them. On the other hand, Iblis the cursed (i.e. Satan) has presented before you the varieties of his evils and ordeals. You always wander in the paths of error and tyranny, taking the paths of Iblis and missing the paths of goodness whose doors are open wide before you.

This is the first day of Sha’ban. The sections of its benefits are prayer, almsgiving, enjoining the right, forbidding the wrong, piety to parents, relatives and neighbors, setting aright matters of difference, and conferring upon the poor and the needy with charity. Nevertheless, you are discussing matters (i.e. fatality) that you are not asked to discuss and matters that you are asked not to deal with since they lead to revealing the secrets of Almighty Allah; and those who try to track the secrets of Almighty Allah shall be of those who will perish. If you knew what our Lord - Majestic and Honorable is He - decided for His obedient servants on this day, you would certainly stop debating and take the initiative in carrying out the commandments by which you are bound.”

The group then asked him, “O Ameer al-Momineen, what has Almighty Allah decided for His obedient servants on this day?”

Imam Ali(a.s.) then narrated to them that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.), once, sent an army to counter the atheists. It was very dark night when the camp of the Muslim army was attacked by the atheists. All Muslims were asleep except Zayd ibn Harithah, ‘Abdullah ibn Rawahah, Qutadah ibn Nu’man, and Qays ibn ‘Asim al-Minqari. These individuals were taking the sides of the camp reciting the Holy Qur’an and offering prayers. When the enemies were about to raid the Muslims, lights came out from the mouths of these wakeful individuals to light up the whole camp and supply the Muslims with power and courage due to which they could overcome their enemies causing them to be killed, wounded, or taken as captives. When the Muslims returned home, they informed the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) about the whole story. He (s.a.w.a.) therefore commented, “These lights were the result of the acts of worship these individuals did on the first day of Sha’ban.”

The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) then mentioned each and every deed that these individuals had done on the first day of Sha’ban. He then said, “On the first day of Sha’ban, Iblis distributes his hosts all over the earth and instructs them to try their best to attract as many numbers of people as possible. On the other side, Almighty Allah distributes His angels all over the earth and asks them to guide His servants to righteousness. Accordingly, the all will be happy except those who intentionally choose to reject and do wrong and, thus, join the party of Iblis. Furthermore, on the first day of Sha’ban, Almighty Allah gives the orders of opening the gate of Paradise and orders the Tree of Tuba (joy) to lower its twigs towards this world. Then, a caller will shout out on behalf of our Lord, ‘O Servants of Allah, these are the twigs of the Tree of Tuba. You must hang on to them so that they will raise you to Paradise. These are also the twigs of the Tree of Zaqqum. Beware lest they will take you to Hellfire.’

(The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) then continues,) I swear by Him Who has chosen me for conveying the (Divine) Mission as a prophet, anyone who tries any of the doors of decency on this day will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Tuba and it will lead him to Paradise. But anyone who tries any of the doors of evil on this day will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Zaqqum and it will lead him to Hellfire.

Thus, one who voluntarily offers a prayer on this day will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Tuba. One who observes fasting on this day will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Tuba. One who reconciles between two spouses, between a father and his son, between two relatives, between two neighbors, or between any two individuals will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Tuba. One who grants respite or releases an insolvent debtor from the debt will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Tuba. One who, after checking his accounts, finds out that he owed somebody an amount and thus he settles that debt will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Tuba. One who volunteers to maintain for an orphan will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Tuba. One who refrains a wicked individual from reviling at the honor of a believer will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Tuba. One who recites the Holy Qur’an or even a portion of it will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Tuba. One who frees himself for mentioning and thanking the graces of Almighty Allah will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Tuba. One who visits an ailed person will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Tuba. One who acts piously to his parents or one of them on that day will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Tuba. One who seeks his parents’ satisfaction on that day after he has enraged them will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Tuba. In general, anyone who does any act of decency on that day will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Tuba.

(The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) then continues,) I swear by Him Who has chosen me for conveying the (Divine) Mission as a prophet, anyone who does any act of wickedness or disobedience to Almighty Allah on that day will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Zaqqum, which will take him to Hellfire.

I swear by Him Who has chosen me for conveying the (Divine) Mission as a prophet, one who neglects or disregards the obligatory prayer will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Zaqqum. If one is visited by a needy person while he knows his actual financial situation and he has the capability to change it without causing himself any harm and without the existence of another person who can do this mission; nevertheless, he ignores and leaves him encountering his neediness, he will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Zaqqum. If one rejects the apology of one who had wronged him then he punishes him more than the required, he will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Zaqqum. If one makes quarrel between two spouses, between a father and his son, between two brothers, between two relatives, between two neighbors, between two friends, or between two sisters, he will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Zaqqum. One who deepens the problems of an insolvent debtor while he is aware of his insolvency and hardship will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Zaqqum. One who illegally denies the loan that he has taken from somebody and, moreover, transgresses him will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Zaqqum. One who turns away from, harms, and spoils the property of an orphan will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Zaqqum. One who ascribes dishonor to a faithful individual and urges people to think ill of him will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Zaqqum. One who sings a song that leads to acts of disobedience to Almighty Allah will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Zaqqum. One who recounts his ill deeds in battles and his wrongdoings against people, taking pride in them, will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Zaqqum. One who neglects visiting his ailed neighbor and does not participate in his funeral ceremony on account of belittling him will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Zaqqum. One who turns away from an injured person on account of disdain, contempt, or disparagement will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Zaqqum. One who acts impiously to his parents or one of them or does not please them on this day on account of a previous impiety to them will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Zaqqum. In general, anyone who commits any act of indecency on that day will hang on to one of the twigs of the Tree of Zaqqum.

I swear by Him Who has chosen me for conveying the (Divine) Mission as a prophet, those who hang on to the twigs of the Tree of Tuba will be raised to Paradise.’

The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) then raised his sight toward the heavens for a while and smiled pleasingly. He then lowered his sight toward the earth and frowned. He then turned his face towards his companions and said, “I swear by Him Who has chosen Muhammad of conveying the Divine Mission as a prophet, I have just seen the Tree of Tuba raising its twigs and I have seen it taking those who hanged on to its twigs to Paradise. I have also seen some people hanging on to one twig, others to two, or even more according to their deeds of obedience to Almighty Allah. I can see Zayd ibn Harithah hanging on to all of its twigs and it is raising him up. Because of this, I smiled pleasingly. I then looked at the ground and, I swear by Him Who has chosen me for conveying the Mission as a prophet, I have seen the Tree of Zaqqum lowering its twigs and leading those who have hanged on to it to Hellfire. I have seen some of them hanging on to one twig, others to two, and so on, according to their acts of disobedience. I can see some of the hypocrites hanging on to all the twigs and the Tree of Zaqqum is taking them to the lowest of its stages. because of this, I frowned.”

A_Y7.name: Third of Shaban

segs.note: Birthday Dua of Imam Husayn (a.s.)
Fast on this day, and recite:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْۤ اَسْاَلُكَ بِحَقِّ الْمَوْلُوْدِ فِيْ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ الْمَوْعُوْدِ بِشَهَادَتِهٖ قَبْلَ اسْتِهْلَالِهٖ وَوِلَادَتِهٖ
segs.en: O Allah, I beseech You in the name of the one born on this day, the promised with martyrdom before the beginning of his lifetime and before his birth,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS'ALUKA BIHAQQIL MAWLOODI FEE HAADHAL YAWMIL MAW'OODI BISHAHAADATIHEE QABLAS TIHLAALIHEE WA WILAADATIH

segs.ar: بَكَتْهُ السَّمَاۤءُ وَمَنْ فِيْهَا وَالْاَرْضُ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَلَمَّا يَطَاْ لَابَتَيْهَا
segs.en: the heavens and all their inhabitants wept for him; and so did the earth and those living on it before his feet stepped on it,
segs.tr: BAKAT-HUS SAMAA'U WA MAN FEEHAA WAL ARDU WA MAN A'LAYHAA WA LAMMAA YATA' LAABATAYHAA

segs.ar: قَتِيْلِ الْعَبْرَةِ وَسَيِّدِ الْاُسْرَةِ الْمَمْدُوْدِ بِالنُّصْرَةِ يَوْمَ الْكَرَّةِ
segs.en: the mourned slain one, the master of the Family (of Prophethood), the one who shall be backed with victory on the Day of Return,
segs.tr: QATEELIL A'BRATI WA SAYYIDIL USRATIL MAMDOODI BIN NUSRATI YAWMAL KARRAH

segs.ar: الْمُعَوَّضِ مِنْ قَتْلِهٖ اَنَّ الْاَئِمَّةَ مِنْ نَسْلِهٖ وَالشِّفَاۤءَ فِيْ تُرْبَتِهٖ
segs.en: the one whom has been awarded the favor of the Imams' being from his offspring as recompense of his being slain, the one awarded the favor of the soil of his grave carrying cure,
segs.tr: AL-MU'AWWADI MIN QATLIHEE ANNAL A'IMMATA MIN NASLIHEE WASH SHIFAA'A FEE TURBATIH

segs.ar: وَالْفَوْزَ مَعَهٗ فِيْۤ اَوْبَتِهٖ وَالْاَوْصِيَاۤءَ مِنْ عِتْرَتِهٖ بَعْدَ قَاۤئِمِهِمْ وَغَيْبَتِهٖ
segs.en: the one awarded the favor that he will be triumphing when he will be returned and the Prophet's Successors from his offspring will be returned after the advent of their Rising Imam and after his occultation
segs.tr: WAL FAWZA MA'AHOO FEE AWBATIHEE WAL AWSIYAA'A MIN I'TRATIHEE BA'DA QAA'IMIHIM WA GHAYBATIH

segs.ar: حَتّٰى يُدْرِكُوْا الْاَوْتَارَ وَيَثْاَرُوْا الثَّارَ وَيَرْضُوْا الْجَبَّارَ وَيَكُوْنُوْا خَيْرَ اَنْصَارٍ
segs.en: so that they shall take revenge, retaliate, please the Omnipotent Lord, and be the best supporters.
segs.tr: HATTAA YUDRIKUL AWTAARA WA YATH'ARUTH THAARA WA YARDUL JABBAARA WA YAKOONOO KHAYRA ANSAAR

segs.ar: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مَعَ اخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ
segs.en: May Allah's blessings be perpetually upon them whenever night and day succeed each other.
segs.tr: SALLALLAAHU A'LAYHIM MA'AKH TILAAFIL LAYLI WAN NAHAAR

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَبِحَقِّهِمْ اِلَيْكَ اَتَوَسَّلُ وَاَسْاَلُ سُؤَالَ مُقْتَرِفٍ مُعْتَرِفٍ مُسِيْۤءٍ اِلٰى نَفْسِهٖ مِمَّا فَرَّطَ فِيْ يَوْمِهٖ وَاَمْسِهٖ
segs.en: O Allah, I thus beg You in the name of them and implore You with the imploration of a sinful one who confesses of his sin, and who has done evil to himself due to his violations— the past and the present.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA FABIHAQQIHIM ILAYKA ATAWASSALU WA AS'ALU SU'AALA MUQTARIFIN MU'TARIFIN MUSEE'IN ILAA NAFSIHEE MIMMAA FARRATA FEE YAWMIHEE WA AMSIH

segs.en: He thus beseeches You for Your protection up to the place of his grave.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعِتْرَتِهٖ وَاحْشُرْنَا فِيْ زُمْرَتِهٖ وَبَوِّئْنَا مَعَهٗ دَارَ الْكَرَامَةِ وَمَحَلَّ الْاِقَامَةِ
segs.en: O Allah, (please) send blessings to Muhammad and his Offspring, include us with his group (on the Resurrection Day), and allow us to dwell in the House of Honor with him and in the abode of residence.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA FASALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA I'TRATIHEE WAHSHURNAA FEE ZUMRATIHEE WA BAWWI'NAA MA'AHOO DAARAL KARAAMATI WA MAHALLAL IQAAMAH

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَكَمَا اَكْرَمْتَنَا بِمَعْرِفَتِهٖ فَاَكْرِمْنَا بِزُلْفَتِهٖ وَارْزُقْنَا مُرَافَقَتَهٗ وَسَابِقَتَهٗ
segs.en: O Allah, as You have conferred upon us with the honor of our recognition of him, so (please) confer upon us with the honor of being near to him, bestow upon us with the bliss of accompanying him _ and enjoying a close rank to him,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WA KAMAA AKRAMTANAA BIMA'RIFATIHEE FA-AKRIMNAA BIZULFATIHEE WARZUQNAA MURAAFAQATAHOO WA SAABIQATAH

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ يُسَلِّمُ لِاَمْرِهٖ وَيُكْثِرُ الصَّلَاةَ عَلَيْهِ عِنْدَ ذِكْرِهٖ
segs.en: and include us with those who submit to him totally and those who invoke Your blessings upon him whenever they mention him,
segs.tr: WAJ'ALNAA MIMMAN YUSALLIMU LI-AMRIHEE WA YUKTHIRUS SALAATA A'LAYHI I'NDA DHIKRIH

segs.ar: وَعَلٰى جَمِيْعِ اَوْصِيَاۤئِهٖ وَاَهْلِ اَصْفِيَاۤئِهِ الْمَمْدُوْدِيْنَ مِنْكَ بِالْعَدَدِ الْاِثْنٰي عَشَرَ النُّجُوْمِ الزُّهَرِ وَالْحُجَجِ عَلٰى جَمِيْعِ الْبَشَرِ
segs.en: and upon all his Successors and Selected Ones, whom are defined by You as twelve persons, being the luminous stars, and the Arguments against all humankind.
segs.tr: WA A'LAA JAMEE'I AWSIYAA'IHEE WA AHLI ASFIYAA'IHIL MAMDOODEENA MINKA BIL A'DADIL ITHNAA A'SHARAN NUJOOMIZ ZUHARI WAL HUJAJI A'LAA JAMEE'IL BASHAR

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَهَبْ لَنَا فِيْ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ خَيْرَ مَوْهِبَةٍ وَاَنْجِحْ لَنَا فِيْهِ كُلَّ طَلِبَةٍ
segs.en: O Allah, and (please) grant us on this day the best of grants, make all our prayers on this day responded,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WA HAB LANAA FEE HAADHAL YAWMI KHAYRA MAWHIBATIN WA ANJIH LANAA FEEHI KULLA TALIBAH

segs.ar: كَمَا وَهَبْتَ الْحُسَيْنَ لِمُحَمَّدٍ جَدِّهٖ وَعَاذَ فُطْرُسُ بِمَهْدِهٖ
segs.en: just as You gifted al-Husayn to Muhammad, his grandfather, just as the angel Futrus sought refuge with his (i.e. al-Husayn) cradle,
segs.tr: KAMAA WAHABTAL HUSAYNA LIMUHAMMADIN JADDIHEE WA A'ADHA FUTRUSU BIMAHDIH

segs.ar: فَنَحْنُ عَاۤئِذُوْنَ بِقَبْرِهٖ مِنْ بَعْدِهٖ نَشْهَدُ تُرْبَتَهٗ وَنَنْتَظِرُ اَوْبَتَهٗ
segs.en: we are thus seeking refuge with his tomb after him (i.e. his martyrdom), as we are witnessing the soil of him and expecting his return.
segs.tr: FANAHNU A'A'IDHOONA BIQABRIHEE MIN BA'DIHEE NASH-HADU TURBATAHOO WA NANTAZIRU AWBATAH

segs.en: Respond to us, O Lord of the worlds.

segs.note: Last Dua of Imam Husayn (a.s.)
After the birthday dua, recite the last dua of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.), which he said when his enemies surrounded him in large numbers on the day of Ashura:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ مُتَعَالِيْ الْمَكَانِ عَظِيْمُ الْجَبَرُوْتِ شَدِيْدُ الْمِحَالِ غَنِيٌّ عَنِ الْخَلَایِقِ عَرِيْضُ الْكِبْرِيَاۤءِ
segs.en: O Allah, You are verily the Elevated in position, the Magnificent in omnipotence, the Mighty in prowess, the Self-Sufficient from the creatures, the Ample in pride,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA ANTA MUTA'AALIL MAKAANI A'ZEEMUL JABAROOTI SHADEEDUL MIHAALI GHANIYYUN A'NIL KHALAAYIQI A'REEDUL KIBRIYAA'

segs.ar: قَادِرٌ عَلٰى مَا تَشَاۤءُ قَرِيْبُ الرَّحْمَةِ صَادِقُ الْوَعْدِ سَابِغُ النِّعْمَةِ حَسَنُ الْبَلَاۤءِ
segs.en: the Powerful over all that which You want, the Close in mercy, the Truthful in promise, the Opulent in favors, the Sympathetic in ordeals,
segs.tr: QAADIRUN A'LAA MAA TASHAA'U QAREEBUR RAHMATI SAADIQUL WA'DI SAABIGHUN NI'MATI HASANUL BALAA'

segs.ar: قَرِيْبٌ اِذَا دُعِيْتَ مُحِيْطٌ بِمَا خَلَقْتَ قَابِلُ التَّوْبَةِ لِمَنْ تَابَ اِلَيْكَ قَادِرٌ عَلٰى مَاۤ اَرَدْتَ
segs.en: the Nigh when You are prayed, the All-encompassing of all that which You have created, the Accepter of the repentance of him who repents to You, the Powerful to do whatever You want,
segs.tr: QAREEBUN IDHAA DU'EETA MUHEETUN BIMAA KHALAQTA QAABILUT TAWBATI LIMAN TAABA ILAYKA QAADIRUN A'LAA MAA ARADT

segs.ar: وَمُدْرِكٌ مَا طَلَبْتَ وَشَكُوْرٌ اِذَا شُكِرْتَ وَذَكُوْرٌ اِذَا ذُكِرْتَ
segs.en: the Taker in all that which You decide, the Thankful for those who thank You, and the Rememberer of those who mention You.
segs.tr: WA MUDRIKUN MAA TALABTA WA SHAKOORUN IDHAA SHUKIRTA WA DHAKOORUN IDHAA DHUKIRT

segs.ar: اَدْعُوْكَ مُحْتَاجًا وَاَرْغَبُ اِلَيْكَ فَقِيْرًا وَاَفْزَعُ اِلَيْكَ خَاۤئِفًا
segs.en: I pray You for I need You, I desire for You for I am in want of You, I resort to You for I am terrified,
segs.tr: AD'OOKA MUHTAAJAN WA ARGHABU ILAYKA FAQEERAN WA AFZA'U ILAYKA KHAA'IFAA

segs.ar: وَاَبْكِيْۤ اِلَيْكَ مَكْرُوْبًا وَاَسْتَعِيْنُ بِكَ ضَعِيْفًا وَاَتَوَكَّلُ عَلَيْكَ كَافِيًا
segs.en: I weep before You for I am distressed, I seek Your aid for I am weak, and I depend upon You for I trust in none save You.
segs.tr: WA ABKEE ILAYKA MAKROOBAN WA ASTA'EENU BIKA DA'EEFAN WA ATAWAKKALU A'LAYKA KAAFIYAA

segs.ar: اُحْكُمْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا [بِالْحَقِّ] فَاِنَّهُمْ غَرُّوْنَا وَخَدَعُوْنَا وَخَذَلُوْنَا وَغَدَرُوْا بِنَا وَقَتَلُوْنَا
segs.en: (Please do) decide between our people and us with the truth, for they have deceived us, cheated us, disappointed us, betrayed us, and killed us.
segs.tr: UHKUM BAYNANAA WA BAYNA QAWMINAA BIL HAQQI FA-INNAHUM GHARROONAA WA KHADA'OONAA WA KHADHALOONAA WA GHADAROO BINAA WA QATALOONAA

segs.ar: وَنَحْنُ عِتْرَةُ نَبِيِّكَ وَوَلَدُ حَبِيْبِكَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ الَّذِيْ اصْطَفَيْتَهٗ بِالرِّسَالَةِ وَائْتَمَنْتَهٗ عَلٰى وَحْيِكَ
segs.en: We are the progeny of Your Prophet and the sons of Your beloved one; namely, Muhammad the son of 'Abdullah, whom You have chosen for the Divine Mission and for keeping Your Revelation.
segs.tr: WA NAHNU I'TRATU NABIYYIKA WA WALADU HABEEBIKA MUHAMMADIBNI A'BDILLAAHIL LADHIS TAFAYTAHOO BIR RISAALATI WA'TAMANTAHOO A'LAA WAHYIK

segs.ar: فَاجْعَلْ لَنَا مِنْ اَمْرِنَا فَرَجًا وَمَخْرَجًا بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَاۤ اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
segs.en: So, (please) prepare a way out and a relief for us, out of Your mercy, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
segs.tr: FAJ'AL LANAA MIN AMRINAA FARAJAN WA MAKHRAJAN BIRAHMATIKA YAA ARHAMAR RAAHIMEEN

A_Y7.merits:
About this blessed day, Shaykh al-Tusi says in Misbah al-Mutahajjid: Imam al-Husayn ibn Ali (a.s.) was born on the third of Sha'ban. Abu'l-Qasim ibn 'Ala' al-Hamadani, the representative of Imam al-Hasan al-'Askari (a.s.), received a document telling that our master, Imam al-Husayn ibn Ali (a.s.), was born on the third of Sha'ban; therefore, you should observe fasting on this day and say this supplicatory prayer.

Last Dua of Imam Husayn (a.s.): Ibn 'Ayyash has reported al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Sufyan al-Bazufi as saying that he heard Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a.s.) saying this supplicatory prayer on the third of Sha'ban, the birthday of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.).

A_Y9.name: Fifteenth Night of Shaban

segs.note: Ghusl, Night Vigil & Ziyarat
segs.ur: غسل، شب بیداری اور زیارت

segs.note: Bathe on this night.
segs.ur: اس رات غسل کریں.

segs.note: Spend this whole night in worship, prayer, supplication and seeking forgiveness, as Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn, Zayn al-Abidin (a) used to.
segs.ur: یہ پوری رات عبادت، نماز، دعا اور استغفار میں گزاریں، جیسا کہ امام علی بن الحسین زین العابدین (ع) کیا کرتے تھے۔

segs.note: Visit the tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a).
segs.ur: امام حسین (ع) کی قبر کی زیارت کریں۔

segs.note: A short form of this ziyarah: stand on elevated ground, look right and left, raise your head to the sky and say:
segs.ur: اس زیارت کی ایک مختصر صورت: بلند جگہ پر کھڑے ہوں، دائیں بائیں دیکھیں، سر آسمان کی طرف اٹھائیں اور کہیں:

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَاۤ اَبَا عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O Abu Abdillah; peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy and blessings.
segs.tr: ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA ABAA A'BDIL LAAH ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA WA RAHMATUL LAAHI WA BARAKAATUH

segs.note: Ziyarah of Imam al-Mahdi (a.t.f.s.)
segs.ur: زیارت امام مہدی (عج)

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ بِحَقِّ لَيْلَتِنَا هٰذِهِ وَمَوْلُوْدِهَا وَحُجَّتِكَ وَمَوْعُوْدِهَا الَّتِيْ قَرَنْتَ اِلٰى فَضْلِهَا فَضْلًا فَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُكَ صِدْقًا وَعَدْلًا لَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَاتِكَ وَلَا مُعَقِّبَ لِاٰيَاتِكَ
