segs.en: O Allah, by the right of this night of ours, and its Newborn, and Your Proof and its Promised One — the night to whose merit You have joined further merit, so Your Word was fulfilled in truth and justice; none can alter Your words, and none can pursue Your signs;
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA BI-HAQQI LAYLATINAA HAAZIHI WA MAWLOODIHAA WA HUJJATIKA WA MAW-U'WDIHAA-LLATEE QARANTA ILAA FADLIHAA FADLAA, FATAMMAT KALIMATUKA SIDQAW WA A'DLAA, LAA MUBADDILA LI-KALIMAATIK WA LAA MU-A'QQIBA LI-AAYAATIK

segs.ar: نُوْرُكَ الْمُتَاَلِّقُ وَضِيَاۤؤُكَ الْمُشْرِقُ وَالْعَلَمُ النُّوْرُ فِيْ طَخْيَاۤءِ الدَّيْجُوْرِ الْغَاۤئِبُ الْمَسْتُوْرُ
segs.en: he is Your radiant light, Your shining brightness, the luminous banner amid the pitch darkness — the hidden, the veiled one,
segs.tr: NOORUKAL MUTA-ALLIQ WA DIYAAA-UKAL MUSHRIQ WAL A'LAMUN NOORU FEE TAKHYAAA-ID DAYJOOR AL-GHAAA-IBUL MASTOOR

segs.ar: جَلَّ مَوْلِدُهُ وَكَرُمَ مَحْتِدُهُ وَالْمَلَاۤئِكَةُ شُهَّدُهُ وَاللّٰهُ نَاصِرُهُ وَمُؤَيِّدُهُ اِذَا اٰنَ مِيْعَادُهُ وَالْمَلَاۤئِكَةُ اَمْدَادُهُ
segs.en: lofty is his birth and noble his lineage, the angels are his witnesses, and Allah is his helper and supporter; when his appointed time arrives, the angels shall be his reinforcements,
segs.tr: JALLA MAWLIDUHU WA KARUMA MAHTIDUH, WAL MALAAA-IKATU SHUHHADUH, WALLAAHO NAASIRUHU WA MU-AYYIDUH, IZAA AANA MEE-A'ADUHU WAL MALAAA-IKATU AMDAADUH

segs.ar: سَيْفُ اللّٰهِ الَّذِيْ لَا يَنْبُوْ وَنُوْرُهُ الَّذِيْ لَا يَخْبُوْ وَذُوْ الْحِلْمِ الَّذِيْ لَا يَصْبُوْ
segs.en: he is the sword of Allah that never fails, His light that never dims, and the possessor of forbearance who never inclines to folly,
segs.tr: SAYFUL LAAHIL LAZEE LAA YANBOO WA NOORUHUL LAZEE LAA YAKHBOO WA ZUL HILMIL LAZEE LAA YASBOO

segs.ar: مَدَارُ الدَّهْرِ وَنَوَامِيْسُ الْعَصْرِ وَوُلَاةُ الْاَمْرِ وَالْمُنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا يَتَنَزَّلُ فِيْ لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ
segs.en: the pivot of time, the laws of the age, the holders of authority, upon whom descends what is sent down on the Night of Decree,
segs.tr: MADAARUD DAHRI WA NAWAAMEESUL A'SRI WA WULAATUL AMRI WAL MUNAZZALU A'LAYHIM MAA YATANAZZALU FEE LAYLATIL QADR

segs.ar: وَاَصْحَابُ الْحَشْرِ وَالنَّشْرِ تَرَاجِمَةُ وَحْيِهِ وَوُلَاةُ اَمْرِهِ وَنَهْيِهِ
segs.en: and the masters of the Gathering and the Resurrection, the interpreters of His revelation and the executors of His command and His prohibition.
segs.tr: WA ASHAABUL HASHRI WAN NASHRI TARAAJIMATU WAHYIH WA WULAATU AMRIHI WA NAHYIH

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلٰى خَاتِمِهِمْ وَقَاۤئِمِهِمُ الْمَسْتُوْرِ عَنْ عَوَالِمِهِمْ
segs.en: O Allah, so bless their seal and their Riser, hidden from their worlds,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA FASALLI A'LAA KHAATIMIHIM WA QAAA-IMIHIMUL MASTOORI A'N A'WAALIMIHIM

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَاَدْرِكْ بِنَاۤ اَيَّامَهُ وَظُهُوْرَهُ وَقِيَامَهُ وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ اَنْصَارِهِ وَاقْرِنْ ثَارَنَا بِثَارِهِ
segs.en: O Allah, let us reach his days, his manifestation, and his rising; make us among his supporters; join our claim for retribution with his,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WA ADRIK BINAAA AYYAAMAHU WA ZUHOORAHU WA QIYAAMAH, WAJ-A'LNAA MIN ANSAARIH, WAQRIN THAARANAA BI-THAARIH

segs.ar: وَاكْتُبْنَا فِيْۤ اَعْوَانِهِ وَخُلَصَاۤئِهِ وَاَحْيِنَا فِيْ دَوْلَتِهِ نَاعِمِيْنَ وَبِصُحْبَتِهِ غَانِمِيْنَ وَبِحَقِّهِ قَاۤئِمِيْنَ وَمِنَ السُّوْۤءِ سَالِمِيْنَ
segs.en: and record us among his helpers and his intimates; let us live in his rule in bliss, gaining through his company, upholding his right, and safe from all harm — O Most Merciful of the merciful.
segs.tr: WAKTUBNAA FEE A'WAANIHI WA KHULASAAA-IH, WA AHYINAA FEE DAWLATIHI NAA-I'MEEN, WA BI-SUHBATIHI GHAANIMEEN, WA BI-HAQQIHI QAAA-IMEEN, WA MINAS SOOO-I SAALIMEEN

segs.ar: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ وَصَلَوَاتُهُ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّيْنَ وَالْمُرْسَلِيْنَ وَعَلٰى اَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الصَّادِقِيْنَ وَعِتْرَتِهِ النَّاطِقِيْنَ وَالْعَنْ جَمِيْعَ الظَّالِمِيْنَ وَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ يَاۤ اَحْكَمَ الْحَاكِمِيْنَ
segs.en: And praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds, and His blessings upon our master Muhammad, the seal of the Prophets and Messengers, and upon his truthful Household and his eloquent progeny; and curse all wrongdoers, and judge between us and them, O Most Just of judges.
segs.tr: WAL HAMDU LILLAAHI RABBIL A'ALAMEEN, WA SALAWAATUHU A'LAA SAYYIDINAA MUHAMMADIN KHAATAMIN NABIYYEENA WAL MURSALEEN, WA A'LAA AHLI BAYTIHIS SAADIQEEN WA I'TRATIHIN NAATIQEEN, WAL A'N JAMEE-A'Z ZAALIMEEN, WAHKUM BAYNANAA WA BAYNAHUM YAA AHKAMAL HAAKIMEEN

segs.note: Dua Allahumma Anta al-Hayy al-Qayyum
segs.ur: دعا اللهم انت الحی القیوم

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيْمُ الْخَالِقُ الرَّازِقُ الْمُحْيِيْ الْمُمِيْتُ الْبَدِيْۤءُ الْبَدِيْعُ
segs.en: O Allah, You are the Ever-living, the Self-subsisting, the Most High, the All-magnificent, the Creator, the Sustainer, the Giver of life, the Bringer of death, the Beginner, the Innovator;
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA ANTAL HAYYUL QAYYOOM, AL-A'LIYYUL A'ZEEM, AL-KHAALIQUR RAAZIQ, AL-MUHYIL MUMEET, AL-BADEE-O'L BADEE'

segs.ar: لَكَ الْجَلَالُ وَلَكَ الْفَضْلُ وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الْمَنُّ وَلَكَ الْجُوْدُ وَلَكَ الْكَرَمُ وَلَكَ الْاَمْرُ وَلَكَ الْمَجْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ
segs.en: Yours is the majesty, Yours the bounty, Yours the praise, Yours the favor, Yours the generosity, Yours the nobility, Yours the command, Yours the glory, and Yours the thanks, alone, with no partner unto You;
segs.tr: LAKAL JALAAL, WA LAKAL FADL, WA LAKAL HAMD, WA LAKAL MANN, WA LAKAL JOOD, WA LAKAL KARAM, WA LAKAL AMR, WA LAKAL MAJD, WA LAKASH SHUKR, WAHDAKA LAA SHAREEKA LAK

segs.ar: يَا وَاحِدُ يَا اَحَدُ يَا صَمَدُ يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُوْلَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا اَحَدٌ
segs.en: O One, O Only, O Self-sufficient, O He Who has not begotten and was not begotten, and there is none comparable to Him.
segs.tr: YAA WAAHIDO YAA AHADO YAA SAMADO YAA MAL LAM YALID WA LAM YOOLAD WA LAM YAKUL LAHU KUFUWAN AHAD

segs.ar: صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاغْفِرْ لِيْ وَارْحَمْنِيْ وَاكْفِنِيْ مَاۤ اَهَمَّنِيْ وَاقْضِ دَيْنِيْ وَوَسِّعْ عَلَيَّ فِيْ رِزْقِيْ
segs.en: Bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, forgive me, have mercy on me, spare me what worries me, settle my debt, and expand my sustenance for me,
segs.tr: SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALI MUHAMMAD, WAGH FIR LEE WARHAMNEE WAKFINEE MAAA AHAMMANEE, WAQDI DAYNEE, WA WASSI' A'LAYYA FEE RIZQEE

segs.ar: فَاِنَّكَ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ كُلَّ اَمْرٍ حَكِيْمٍ تَفْرُقُ وَمَنْ تَشَاۤءُ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ تَرْزُقُ فَارْزُقْنِيْ وَاَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِيْنَ
segs.en: for on this night You distinguish every wise matter, and You provide for whomever You will among Your creatures; so provide for me, for You are the Best of providers.
segs.tr: FA-INNAKA FEE HAAZIHIL LAYLATI KULLA AMRIN HAKEEMIN TAFRUQ, WA MAN TASHAAA-O MIN KHALQIKA TARZUQ, FARZUQNEE WA ANTA KHAYRUR RAAZIQEEN

segs.ar: فَاِنَّكَ قُلْتَ وَاَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْقَاۤئِلِيْنَ وَالنَّاطِقِيْنَ وَاسْئَلُوْا اللّٰهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ فَمِنْ فَضْلِكَ اَسْاَلُ
segs.en: For You have said — and You are the Best of speakers — "Ask Allah of His bounty"; so of Your bounty I ask,
segs.tr: FA-INNAKA QULTA WA ANTA KHAYRUL QAAA-ILEENA WAN NAATIQEEN, WAS-ALUL LAAHA MIN FADLIH, FAMIN FADLIKA AS-AL

segs.ar: وَاِيَّاكَ قَصَدْتُ وَابْنَ نَبِيِّكَ اعْتَمَدْتُ وَلَكَ رَجَوْتُ فَارْحَمْنِيْ يَاۤ اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
segs.en: and toward You I have directed myself, and upon the son of Your Prophet I have relied, and in You I have hoped; so have mercy on me, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
segs.tr: WA IYYAAKA QASADT, WABNA NABIYYIKA A'TAMADT, WA LAKA RAJAWT, FARHAMNEE YAA ARHAMAR RAAHIMEEN

segs.note: Dua Allahummaqsim Lana
segs.ur: دعا اللهم اقسم لنا

segs.note: It may be recited at any time:
segs.ur: اسے کسی بھی وقت پڑھا جا سکتا ہے:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اقْسِمْ لَنَا مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ مَا يَحُوْلُ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ مَعْصِيَتِكَ وَمِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا تُبَلِّغُنَا بِهِ رِضْوَانَكَ وَمِنَ الْيَقِيْنِ مَا يَهُوْنُ عَلَيْنَا بِهِ مُصِيْبَاتُ الدُّنْيَا
segs.en: O Allah, apportion for us of Your fear that which comes between us and disobedience to You, and of Your obedience that which brings us to Your good pleasure, and of certainty that which makes the calamities of this world light upon us,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAQ SIM LANAA MIN KHASHYATIKA MAA YAHOOLU BAYNANAA WA BAYNA MA'SIYATIK, WA MIN TAA-A'TIKA MAA TUBALLIGHUNAA BIHI RIDWAANAK, WA MINAL YAQEENI MAA YAHOONU A'LAYNAA BIHI MUSEEBAATUD DUNYAA

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَمْتِعْنَا بِاَسْمَاعِنَا وَاَبْصَارِنَا وَقُوَّتِنَا مَاۤ اَحْيَيْتَنَا وَاجْعَلْهُ الْوَارِثَ مِنَّا
segs.en: O Allah, let us enjoy our hearing, our sight, and our strength for as long as You keep us alive, and make them what outlasts us,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA AMTI-A'NAA BI-ASMAA-A'NAA WA ABSAARINAA WA QUWWATINAA MAA AHYAYTANAA, WAJ-A'LHUL WAARISA MINNAA

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ ثَارَنَا عَلٰى مَنْ ظَلَمَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلٰى مَنْ عَادَانَا وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مُصِيْبَتَنَا فِيْ دِيْنِنَا
segs.en: grant us retribution against whoever wrongs us, give us victory over whoever is hostile to us, and do not let our affliction be in our religion,
segs.tr: WAJ-A'L THAARANAA A'LAA MAN ZALAMANAA, WANSURNAA A'LAA MAN A'ADAANAA, WA LAA TAJ-A'L MUSEEBATANAA FEE DEENINAA

segs.ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلِ الدُّنْيَا اَكْبَرَ هَمِّنَا وَلَا مَبْلَغَ عِلْمِنَا وَلَا تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمُنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَاۤ اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
segs.en: and do not make the world our greatest concern nor the sum of our knowledge, and do not let anyone rule over us who has no mercy on us — by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
segs.tr: WA LAA TAJ-A'LID DUNYAA AKBARA HAMMINAA WA LAA MABLAGHA I'LMINAA, WA LAA TUSALLIT A'LAYNAA MAL LAA YARHAMUNAA, BI-RAHMATIKA YAA ARHAMAR RAAHIMEEN

segs.note: Salawat, Dua Kumayl & Litany ×100
segs.ur: صلوات، دعائے کمیل اور وظیفہ ×100

segs.note: Recite the midday salawat of Sha’ban: Daily Salawat of Shaban.
segs.ur: شعبان کا دوپہر کا درود پڑھیں: [شعبان کا روزانہ درود](Y3)۔

segs.note: Recite Dua Kumayl.
segs.ur: [دعائے کمیل](E31) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Repeat 100 times:
segs.ur: 100 مرتبہ دہرائیں:

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَاللهُ اَكْبَرُ وَلَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ
segs.en: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no god but Allah.
segs.tr: SUBHAANAL LAAHI WAL HAMDU LILLAAHI WALLAAHO AKBAR WA LAA ILAAHA ILLAL LAAH

segs.note: Prayer & Dua after Isha
segs.ur: نماز عشاء کے بعد کی نماز اور دعا

segs.note: After the obligatory Isha prayer, offer a two-unit prayer: in the first unit recite Surah al-Faatehah and Surah al-Kafirun, in the second Surah al-Faatehah and Surah al-Ikhlas.
segs.ur: واجب نماز عشاء کے بعد دو رکعت نماز پڑھیں: پہلی رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) اور [سورہ کافرون](A113) اور دوسری رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) اور [سورہ اخلاص](A116) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: On finishing, repeat "SubhanAllah" thirty-three times, "Alhamdulillah" thirty-three times, and "Allahu Akbar" thirty-four times, then say:
segs.ur: فارغ ہونے پر «سبحان الله» تینتیس مرتبہ، «الحمد لله» تینتیس مرتبہ اور «الله اکبر» چونتیس مرتبہ دہرائیں، پھر کہیں:

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ اِلَيْهِ مَلْجَاُ الْعِبَادِ فِي الْمُهِمَّاتِ وَاِلَيْهِ يَفْزَعُ الْخَلْقُ فِي الْمُلِمَّاتِ
segs.en: O He to Whom servants turn for refuge in urgent matters, and to Whom creation flees in calamities,
segs.tr: YAA MAN ILAYHI MALJA-UL I'BAADI FIL MUHIMMAAT, WA ILAYHI YAFZA-U'L KHALQU FIL MULIMMAAT

segs.ar: يَا عَالِمَ الْجَهْرِ وَالْخَفِيَّاتِ يَا مَنْ لَا تَخْفٰى عَلَيْهِ خَوَاطِرُ الْاَوْهَامِ وَتَصَرُّفُ الْخَطَرَاتِ
segs.en: O Knower of the open and the hidden, O He from Whom the passing thoughts of illusion and the shifting of ideas are not concealed,
segs.tr: YAA A'ALIMAL JAHRI WAL KHAFIYYAAT, YAA MAL LAA TAKHFAA A'LAYHI KHAWAATIRUL AWHAAMI WA TASARRUFUL KHATARAAT

segs.ar: يَا رَبَّ الْخَلَاۤئِقِ وَالْبَرِيَّاتِ يَا مَنْ بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوْتُ الْاَرَضِيْنَ وَالسَّمَاوَاتِ
segs.en: O Lord of all creatures and beings, O He in Whose hand is the dominion of the earths and the heavens,
segs.tr: YAA RABBAL KHALAAA-IQI WAL BARIYYAAT, YAA MAM BI-YADIHI MALAKOOTUL ARADEENA WAS SAMAAWAAT

segs.ar: اَنْتَ اللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْتَ اَمُتُّ اِلَيْكَ بِلَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْتَ فَيَا لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْتَ
segs.en: You are Allah, there is no god but You; I connect myself to You by "there is no god but You"; so O He besides Whom there is no god,
segs.tr: ANTAL LAAHO LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANT, AMUTTU ILAYKA BI-LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANT, FA-YAA LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANT

segs.ar: اجْعَلْنِيْ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ مِمَّنْ نَظَرْتَ اِلَيْهِ فَرَحِمْتَهُ وَسَمِعْتَ دُعَاۤءَهُ فَاَجَبْتَهُ وَعَلِمْتَ اسْتِقَالَتَهُ فَاَقَلْتَهُ وَتَجَاوَزْتَ عَنْ سَالِفِ خَطِيْۤئَتِهِ وَعَظِيْمِ جَرِيْرَتِهِ
segs.en: make me, this night, among those upon whom You have looked with mercy, whose supplication You have heard and answered, whose plea for release You have known and granted, and whose past sins and grave offenses You have overlooked.
segs.tr: IJ-A'LNEE FEE HAAZIHIL LAYLATI MIMMAN NAZARTA ILAYHI FARAHIMTAH, WA SAMI'TA DU-A'AA-AHU FA-AJABTAH, WA A'LIMTAS TIQAALATAHU FA-AQALTAH, WA TAJAAWAZTA A'N SAALIFI KHATEE-ATIHI WA A'ZEEMI JAREERATIH

segs.ar: فَقَدِ اسْتَجَرْتُ بِكَ مِنْ ذُنُوْبِيْ وَلَجَأْتُ اِلَيْكَ فِيْ سَتْرِ عُيُوْبِيْ
segs.en: I have indeed taken refuge in You from my sins, and have taken shelter in You for the covering of my faults.
segs.tr: FAQADIS TAJARTU BIKA MIN ZUNOOBEE WA LAJA-TU ILAYKA FEE SATRI U'YOOBEE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَجُدْ عَلَيَّ بِكَرَمِكَ وَفَضْلِكَ وَاحْطُطْ خَطَايَايَ بِحِلْمِكَ وَعَفْوِكَ
segs.en: O Allah, be generous to me with Your nobility and bounty, and remove my sins by Your forbearance and pardon,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA FAJUD A'LAYYA BI-KARAMIKA WA FADLIK, WAHTUT KHATAAYAAYA BI-HILMIKA WA A'FWIK

segs.ar: وَتَغَمَّدْنِيْ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ بِسَابِغِ كَرَامَتِكَ وَاجْعَلْنِيْ فِيْهَا مِنْ اَوْلِيَاۤئِكَ الَّذِيْنَ اجْتَبَيْتَهُمْ لِطَاعَتِكَ وَاخْتَرْتَهُمْ لِعِبَادَتِكَ وَجَعَلْتَهُمْ خَالِصَتَكَ وَصَفْوَتَكَ
segs.en: and envelop me this night with Your abundant honor, and make me, in it, among Your friends whom You have selected for Your obedience, chosen for Your worship, and made Your own elite and pure ones.
segs.tr: WA TAGHAMMADNEE FEE HAAZIHIL LAYLATI BI-SAABIGHI KARAAMATIK, WAJ-A'LNEE FEEHAA MIN AWLIYAAA-IKAL LAZEENAJ TABAYTAHUM LI-TAA-A'TIK, WAKH TARTAHUM LI-I'BAADATIK, WA JA-A'LTAHUM KHAALISATAKA WA SAFWATAK

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِيْ مِمَّنْ سَعَدَ جَدُّهُ وَتَوَفَّرَ مِنَ الْخَيْرَاتِ حَظُّهُ وَاجْعَلْنِيْ مِمَّنْ سَلِمَ فَنَعِمَ وَفَازَ فَغَنِمَ
segs.en: O Allah, make me among those whose fortune is blessed, whose share of good is abundant, and make me among those who are spared and so are blessed, who succeed and so gain,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAJ-A'LNEE MIMMAN SA-I'DA JADDUH, WA TAWAFFARA MINAL KHAYRAATI HAZZUH, WAJ-A'LNEE MIMMAN SALIMA FANA-I'MA WA FAAZA FAGHANIM

segs.ar: وَاكْفِنِيْ شَرَّ مَاۤ اَسْلَفْتُ وَاعْصِمْنِيْ مِنَ الْاِزْدِيَادِ فِيْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ وَحَبِّبْ اِلَيَّ طَاعَتَكَ وَمَا يُقَرِّبُنِيْ مِنْكَ وَيُزْلِفُنِيْ عِنْدَكَ
segs.en: and spare me the evil of what I have committed before, protect me from adding to my disobedience to You, and make dear to me Your obedience and whatever draws me near to You and brings me closer to You.
segs.tr: WAKFINEE SHARRA MAAA ASLAFT, WA A'SIMNEE MINAL IZDIYAADI FEE MA'SIYATIK, WA HABBIB ILAYYA TAA-A'TAKA WA MAA YUQARRIBUNEE MINKA WA YUZLIFUNEE I'NDAK

segs.ar: سَيِّدِيْۤ اِلَيْكَ يَلْجَاُ الْهَارِبُ وَمِنْكَ يَلْتَمِسُ الطَّالِبُ وَعَلٰى كَرَمِكَ يُعَوِّلُ الْمُسْتَقِيْلُ التَّاۤئِبُ
segs.en: My Master, to You the fugitive takes refuge, from You the seeker requests, and upon Your generosity the penitent seeking release relies.
segs.tr: SAYYIDEE ILAYKA YALJA-UL HAARIB, WA MINKA YALTAMISUT TAALIB, WA A'LAA KARAMIKA YU-A'WWILUL MUSTAQEELUT TAAA-IB

segs.ar: اَدَّبْتَ عِبَادَكَ بِالتَّكَرُّمِ وَاَنْتَ اَكْرَمُ الْاَكْرَمِيْنَ وَاَمَرْتَ بِالْعَفْوِ عِبَادَكَ وَاَنْتَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ
segs.en: You have taught Your servants generosity, and You are the most Generous of the generous; You have commanded Your servants to pardon, and You are the All-forgiving, the All-merciful.
segs.tr: ADDABTA I'BAADAKA BIT TAKARRUM, WA ANTA AKRAMUL AKRAMEEN, WA AMARTA BIL A'FWI I'BAADAK, WA ANTAL GHAFOORUR RAHEEM

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَلَا تَحْرِمْنِيْ مَا رَجَوْتُ مِنْ كَرَمِكَ وَلَا تُؤْيِسْنِيْ مِنْ سَابِغِ نِعَمِكَ وَلَا تُخَيِّبْنِيْ مِنْ جَزِيْلِ قِسَمِكَ
segs.en: O Allah, so do not deprive me of what I have hoped for from Your generosity, and do not make me despair of Your abundant blessings, and do not disappoint me of Your generous portion,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA FALAA TAHRIMNEE MAA RAJAWTU MIN KARAMIK, WA LAA TU-YISNEE MIN SAABIGHI NI-A'MIK, WA LAA TUKHAYYIBNEE MIN JAZEELI QISAMIK

segs.ar: فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ لِاَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ وَاجْعَلْنِيْ فِيْ جُنَّةٍ مِنْ شِرَارِ بَرِيَّتِكَ
segs.en: that You grant this night to those who obey You, and place me in a shield against the wicked of Your creation.
segs.tr: FEE HAAZIHIL LAYLATI LI-AHLI TAA-A'TIK, WAJ-A'LNEE FEE JUNNATIM MIN SHIRAARI BARIYYATIK

segs.ar: رَبِّ اِنْ لَمْ اَكُنْ مِنْ اَهْلِ ذٰلِكَ فَاَنْتَ اَهْلُ الْكَرَمِ وَالْعَفْوِ وَالْمَغْفِرَةِ
segs.en: My Lord, if I am not worthy of that, then You are worthy of generosity, pardon, and forgiveness,
segs.tr: RABBI IL LAM AKUM MIN AHLI ZAALIKA FA-ANTA AHLUL KARAMI WAL A'FWI WAL MAGHFIRAH

segs.ar: وَجُدْ عَلَيَّ بِمَاۤ اَنْتَ اَهْلُهُ لَا بِمَاۤ اَسْتَحِقُّهُ فَقَدْ حَسُنَ ظَنِّيْ بِكَ وَتَحَقَّقَ رَجَاۤئِيْ لَكَ وَعَلِقَتْ نَفْسِيْ بِكَرَمِكَ
segs.en: so be generous to me according to what befits You, not according to what I deserve — for my thought of You is good, my hope in You is firm, and my soul clings to Your generosity;
segs.tr: WA JUD A'LAYYA BIMAAA ANTA AHLUH, LAA BIMAAA ASTAHIQQUH, FAQAD HASUNA ZANNEE BIK, WA TAHAQQAQA RAJAAA-EE LAK, WA A'LIQAT NAFSEE BI-KARAMIK

segs.en: for You are the Most Merciful of the merciful and the most Generous of the generous.
segs.tr: FA-ANTA ARHAMUR RAAHIMEENA WA AKRAMUL AKRAMEEN

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَاخْصُصْنِيْ مِنْ كَرَمِكَ بِجَزِيْلِ قِسَمِكَ وَاَعُوْذُ بِعَفْوِكَ مِنْ عُقُوْبَتِكَ
segs.en: O Allah, favor me exclusively from Your generosity with a generous portion, and I seek refuge in Your pardon from Your punishment,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WAKHSUSNEE MIN KARAMIKA BI-JAZEELI QISAMIK, WA A-U'ZU BI-A'FWIKA MIN U'QOOBATIK

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذَّنْبَ الَّذِيْ يَحْبِسُ عَلَيَّ الْخُلُقَ وَيُضَيِّقُ عَلَيَّ الرِّزْقَ
segs.en: and forgive me the sin that withholds good character from me and narrows my sustenance,
segs.tr: WAGH FIR LEEYAZ ZAMBAL LAZEE YAHBISU A'LAYYAL KHULUQA WA YUDAYYIQU A'LAYYAR RIZQ

segs.ar: حَتّٰىۤ اَقُوْمَ بِصَالِحِ رِضَاكَ وَاَنْعَمَ بِجَزِيْلِ عَطَاۤئِكَ وَاَسْعَدَ بِسَابِغِ نَعْمَاۤئِكَ
segs.en: so that I may stand upon what pleases You, enjoy Your generous giving, and be blessed by Your abundant favor.
segs.tr: HATTAA AQOOMA BI-SAALIHI RIDAAK, WA AN-A'MA BI-JAZEELI A'TAAA-IK, WA AS-A'DA BI-SAABIGHI NA'MAAA-IK

segs.ar: فَقَدْ لُذْتُ بِحَرَمِكَ وَتَعَرَّضْتُ لِكَرَمِكَ وَاسْتَعَذْتُ بِعَفْوِكَ مِنْ عُقُوْبَتِكَ وَبِحِلْمِكَ مِنْ غَضَبِكَ
segs.en: I have indeed taken refuge in Your sanctuary, presented myself for Your generosity, and sought protection in Your pardon from Your punishment and in Your forbearance from Your wrath;
segs.tr: FAQAD LUZTU BI-HARAMIK, WA TA-A'RRADTU LI-KARAMIK, WASTA-A'ZTU BI-A'FWIKA MIN U'QOOBATIK, WA BI-HILMIKA MIN GHADABIK

segs.ar: فَجُدْ بِمَا سَاَلْتُكَ وَاَنِلْ مَا الْتَمَسْتُ مِنْكَ اَسْاَلُكَ بِكَ لَا بِشَيْءٍ هُوَ اَعْظَمُ مِنْكَ
segs.en: so grant me what I have asked You, and give me what I have sought from You; I ask You by You, not by anything greater than You.
segs.tr: FAJUD BIMAA SA-ALTUK, WA ANIL MAL TAMASTU MINK, AS-ALUKA BIKA LAA BI-SHAY-IN HUWA A'ZAMU MINK

segs.note: Then prostrate and repeat "YAA RABB" (O my Lord) twenty times, then "YAA ALLAAH" (O Allah) seven times, then "LAA HAWLA WA LAA QUWWATA ILLAA BILLAAH" (there is no power and no strength except with Allah) seven times,
segs.ur: پھر سجدہ کریں اور «یا رب» (اے میرے پروردگار) بیس مرتبہ، پھر «یا الله» (اے اللہ) سات مرتبہ، پھر «لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله» (اللہ کے سوا نہ کوئی طاقت ہے نہ کوئی قوت) سات مرتبہ دہرائیں،

segs.note: then "MAA SHAAA-AL LAAH" (what Allah wills) ten times, then "LAA QUWWATA ILLAA BILLAAH" (there is no strength except with Allah) ten times, then invoke Allah's blessings upon the Holy Prophet and make your requests.
segs.ur: پھر دس مرتبہ "ما شاء الله" (جو اللہ چاہے) کہیں، پھر دس مرتبہ "لا قوة إلا بالله" (اللہ کے سوا کوئی طاقت نہیں) کہیں، پھر رسول اللہ (ص) پر درود بھیجیں اور اپنی حاجات طلب کریں۔

segs.note: Dua after the Shaf’ Prayer
segs.ur: نمازِ شفع کے بعد کی دعا

segs.note: Recite right after the Shaf’ prayer, at the last hours of the night:
segs.ur: رات کے آخری پہروں میں، نمازِ شفع کے فوراً بعد پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ تَعَرَّضَ لَكَ فِي هٰذَا اللَّيْلِ الْمُتَعَرِّضُوْنَ وَقَصَدَكَ الْقَاصِدُوْنَ وَاَمَّلَ فَضْلَكَ وَمَعْرُوْفَكَ الطَّالِبُوْنَ
segs.en: My God, tonight those who seek You have presented themselves before You, those who intend You have set their aim upon You, and those who ask have hoped for Your bounty and Your kindness,
segs.tr: ILAAHEE TA-A'RRADA LAKA FEE HAAZAL LAYLIL MUTA-A'RRIDOON, WA QASADAKAL QAASIDOON, WA AMMALA FADLAKA WA MA'ROOFAKAT TAALIBOON

segs.ar: وَلَكَ فِيْ هٰذَا اللَّيْلِ نَفَحَاتٌ وَجَوَاۤئِزُ وَعَطَايَا وَمَوَاهِبُ تَمُنُّ بِهَا عَلٰى مَنْ تَشَاۤءُ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ وَتَمْنَعُهَا مَنْ لَمْ تَسْبِقْ لَهُ الْعِنَايَةُ مِنْكَ
segs.en: and Yours, on this night, are gusts of grace, rewards, gifts, and endowments which You bestow upon whomever You will of Your servants, and withhold from whoever Your prior care has not preceded.
segs.tr: WA LAKA FEE HAAZAL LAYLI NAFAHAATUW WA JAWAAA-IZU WA A'TAAYAA WA MAWAAHIBU TAMUNNU BIHAA A'LAA MAN TASHAAA-O MIN I'BAADIK, WA TAMNA-U'HAA MAL LAM TASBIQ LAHUL I'NAAYATU MINK

segs.ar: وَهَاۤ اَنَا ذَا عُبَيْدُكَ الْفَقِيْرُ اِلَيْكَ الْمُؤَمِّلُ فَضْلَكَ وَمَعْرُوْفَكَ
segs.en: And here am I, Your humble servant, in need of You, hoping for Your bounty and Your kindness;
segs.tr: WA HAAA ANAA ZAA U'BAYDUKAL FAQEERU ILAYKAL MU-AMMILU FADLAKA WA MA'ROOFAK

segs.ar: فَاِنْ كُنْتَ يَا مَوْلَايَ تَفَضَّلْتَ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ عَلٰىۤ اَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَعُدْتَ عَلَيْهِ بِعَاۤئِدَةٍ مِنْ عَطْفِكَ
segs.en: so if, O my Master, You have shown favor tonight to any of Your creatures and returned to him with a portion of Your kindness,
segs.tr: FA-IN KUNTA YAA MAWLAAYA TAFADDALTA FEE HAAZIHIL LAYLATI A'LAA AHADIM MIN KHALQIK, WA U'DTA A'LAYHI BI-A'AA-IDATIM MIN A'TFIK

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ الطَّيِّبِيْنَ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ الْخَيِّرِيْنَ الْفَاضِلِيْنَ وَجُدْ عَلَيَّ بِطَوْلِكَ وَمَعْرُوْفِكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
segs.en: then bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad — the good, the pure, the excellent, the virtuous — and be generous to me with Your grace and Your kindness, O Lord of the worlds.
segs.tr: FASALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALI MUHAMMADIN AT-TAYYIBEENAT TAAHIREENAL KHAYYIREENAL FAADILEEN, WA JUD A'LAYYA BI-TAWLIKA WA MA'ROOFIKA YAA RABBAL A'ALAMEEN

segs.ar: وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّيْنَ وَاٰلِهِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيْمًا اِنَّ اللّٰهَ حَمِيْدٌ مَجِيْدٌ
segs.en: And Allah's blessings be upon Muhammad, the seal of the Prophets, and his pure Household, and abundant peace; verily Allah is Praiseworthy, All-glorious.
segs.tr: WA SALLAL LAAHO A'LAA MUHAMMADIN KHAATAMIN NABIYYEENA WA AALIHIT TAAHIREENA WA SALLAMA TASLEEMAA, INNAL LAAHA HAMEEDUM MAJEED

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْۤ اَدْعُوْكَ كَمَاۤ اَمَرْتَ فَاسْتَجِبْ لِيْ كَمَا وَعَدْتَ اِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيْعَادَ
segs.en: O Allah, I call upon You as You have commanded; so answer me as You have promised, for verily You do not break Your promise.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AD-U'WKA KAMAA AMART, FASTAJIB LEE KAMAA WA-A'DT, INNAKA LAA TUKHLIFUL MEE-A'AAD

segs.note: Prophet’s Prostration Duas
segs.ur: رسول (ص) کے سجدے کی دعائیں

segs.note: Recite in prostration:
segs.ur: سجدے میں پڑھیں:

segs.ar: سَجَدَ لَكَ سَوَادِيْ وَخَيَالِيْ وَاٰمَنَ بِكَ فُؤَادِيْ هٰذِهِ يَدَايَ وَمَا جَنَيْتُهُ عَلٰى نَفْسِيْ يَا عَظِيْمُ تُرْجٰى لِكُلِّ عَظِيْمٍ اِغْفِرْ لِيَ الْعَظِيْمَ فَاِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذَّنْبَ الْعَظِيْمَ اِلَّا الرَّبُّ الْعَظِيْمُ
segs.en: My silhouette and my shadow have prostrated to You, and my heart has believed in You; these are my two hands and what I have wrought against myself. O Most Great, You are hoped for at every great matter — forgive me the great sin, for none forgives a great sin except the Great Lord.
segs.tr: SAJADA LAKA SAWAADEE WA KHAYAALEE WA AAMANA BIKA FU-AADEE, HAAZIHI YADAAYA WA MAA JANAYTUHU A'LAA NAFSEE, YAA A'ZEEMU TURJAA LI-KULLI A'ZEEM, IGHFIR LIYAL A'ZEEM, FA-INNAHU LAA YAGHFIRUZ ZAMBAL A'ZEEMA ILLAR RABBUL A'ZEEM

segs.note: Raise your head, prostrate again and say:
segs.ur: اپنا سر اٹھائیں، دوبارہ سجدہ کریں اور کہیں:

segs.ar: اَعُوْذُ بِنُوْرِ وَجْهِكَ الَّذِيْۤ اَضَاۤءَتْ لَهُ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْاَرَضُوْنَ وَانْكَشَفَتْ لَهُ الظُّلُمَاتُ وَصَلَحَ عَلَيْهِ اَمْرُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ وَالْاٰخِرِيْنَ
segs.en: I seek refuge in the light of Your Countenance, by which the heavens and the earths were illumined, the darkness was dispelled, and the affairs of the first and the last were set right,
segs.tr: A-U'ZU BI-NOORI WAJHIKAL LAZEEE ADAAA-AT LAHUS SAMAAWAATU WAL ARADOON, WAN KASHAFAT LAHUZ ZULUMAAT, WA SALAHA A'LAYHI AMRUL AWWALEENA WAL AAKHIREEN

segs.ar: مِنْ فُجْاَةِ نَقِمَتِكَ وَمِنْ تَحْوِيْلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَمِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ
segs.en: from the sudden onset of Your vengeance, from the turning away of Your well-being, and from the vanishing of Your blessing.
segs.tr: MIN FUJ-ATI NAQIMATIK, WA MIN TAHWEELI A'AAFIYATIK, WA MIN ZAWAALI NI'MATIK

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِيْ قَلْبًا تَقِيًّا نَقِيًّا وَمِنَ الشِّرْكِ بَرِيْئًا لَا كَافِرًا وَلَا شَقِيًّا
segs.en: O Allah, grant me a heart that is God-fearing and pure, free of association, neither disbelieving nor wretched.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAR ZUQNEE QALBAN TAQIYYAN NAQIYYAW WA MINASH SHIRKI BAREE-AL LAA KAAFIRAW WA LAA SHAQIYYAA

segs.note: Then press your face to the ground and say:
segs.ur: پھر اپنا چہرہ زمین سے لگائیں اور کہیں:

segs.ar: عَفَّرْتُ وَجْهِيْ فِيْ التُّرَابِ وَحُقَّ لِيْۤ اَنْ اَسْجُدَ لَكَ
segs.en: I have laid my face in the dust, and it is only right that I prostrate to You.
segs.tr: A'FFARTU WAJHEE FIT TURAAB WA HUQQA LEE AN ASJUDA LAK

segs.note: Prayers of the Night
segs.ur: رات کی نمازیں

segs.note: Offer the famous Namaz of Jafar-e-Tayyaar.
segs.ur: مشہور [نمازِ جعفرِ طیار](F11) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: On the mid-Shaban night, offer a four-unit prayer, reciting Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Ikhlas a hundred times in each unit.
segs.ur: شعبان کی پندرہویں رات چار رکعت نماز پڑھیں، ہر رکعت میں ایک مرتبہ [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) اور سو مرتبہ [سورہ اخلاص](A116) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: On finishing, say:
segs.ur: فارغ ہونے پر کہیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْۤ اِلَيْكَ فَقِيْرٌ وَمِنْ عَذَابِكَ خَاۤئِفٌ مُسْتَجِيْرٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I am in need of You, and fearful of Your punishment, seeking refuge,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE ILAYKA FAQEERUW WA MIN A'ZAABIKA KHAAA-IFUM MUSTAJEER

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تُبَدِّلْ اِسْمِيْ وَلَا تُغَيِّرْ جِسْمِيْ وَلَا تَجْهَدْ بَلَاۤئِيْ وَلَا تُشْمِتْ بِيْۤ اَعْدَاۤئِيْ
segs.en: O Allah, do not change my name, do not alter my body, do not intensify my trial, and do not let my enemies gloat over me;
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA LAA TUBADDIL ISMEE WA LAA TUGHAYYIR JISMEE WA LAA TAJHAD BALAAA-EE WA LAA TUSHMIT BEE A'DAAA-EE

segs.ar: اَعُوْذُ بِعَفْوِكَ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ وَاَعُوْذُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِكَ وَاَعُوْذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ
segs.en: I seek refuge in Your pardon from Your punishment, I seek refuge in Your mercy from Your chastisement, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your wrath, and I seek refuge in You from You.
segs.tr: A-U'ZU BI-A'FWIKA MIN I'QAABIK, WA A-U'ZU BI-RAHMATIKA MIN A'ZAABIK, WA A-U'ZU BI-RIDAAKA MIN SAKHATIK, WA A-U'ZU BIKA MINK

segs.ar: جَلَّ ثَنَاۤؤُكَ اَنْتَ كَمَا اَثْنَيْتَ عَلٰى نَفْسِكَ وَفَوْقَ مَا يَقُوْلُ الْقَاۤئِلُوْنَ
segs.en: Exalted is Your praise; You are as You have praised Yourself, and above what any speaker can say.
segs.tr: JALLA THANAAA-UKA ANTA KAMAA ATHNAYTA A'LAA NAFSIKA WA FAWQA MAA YAQOOLUL QAAA-ILOON

segs.note: Offer a hundred-unit prayer, reciting Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Ikhlas ten times in each unit.
segs.ur: سو رکعت نماز پڑھیں، ہر رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ اخلاص](A116) دس مرتبہ پڑھیں۔

segs.note: A six-unit prayer is also recommended, reciting Surah al-Faatehah, Yasin, al-Mulk, and Surah al-Ikhlas in each unit; see Thirteenth of Rajab.
segs.ur: چھ رکعت نماز بھی مستحب ہے، جس کی ہر رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5)، [یٰس](A40)، [ملک](A71) اور [سورہ اخلاص](A116) پڑھی جائے؛ دیکھیے [13 رجب](X11)۔

A_Y9.merits:
This night is extraordinarily honorable. Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a) narrates that when Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (a) was asked about the merits of the fifteenth night of Shaban, he said: "It is the most favorable night after the Night of Decree. On it, Almighty Allah bestows His favors upon His servants and grants pardon out of His own bounty; so exert every effort to seek nearness to Him this night, for He — Majestic and Honorable — has decided not to turn away any asker so long as he does not ask for an act of disobedience. Allah has chosen this night for us, the Ahl al-Bayt, just as He chose the Night of Decree for our Prophet — peace be upon him and his Household. So pray and give thanks diligently."

One of the marvelous blessings of this night is that it is the birth night of the Patron of the Age, Imam al-Mahdi (a) — may Allah accept our souls as ransom for him. He was born in Surra-man-ra'a (Samarra) just before daybreak in 255 AH, which only increases the merit of this honorable night.

Ghusl: Bathing lessens the punishment for one's sins.

Night vigil: A tradition confirms that whoever spends this whole night in worship, his heart will not die when other hearts die.

Ziyarah of Imam al-Husayn (a): Visiting the tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a) is the most favorable act of this night, bringing forgiveness of one's sins; whoever desires that 124,000 Prophets shake his hand may visit the holy tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a) this night. Whoever performs even this form of Ziyarah is expected to win the reward of a Hajj and an Umrah.

Ziyarah of Imam al-Mahdi (a.t.f.s.): This is a form of Ziyarah for Imam al-Mahdi (a), mentioned by both Sayyid Ibn Tawus and Shaykh al-Tusi.

Dua Allahumma Anta al-Hayy al-Qayyum: Shaykh Isma'il ibn Fadl al-Hashimi reports that Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a) instructed him to say this dua on the fifteenth night of Shaban.

Dua Allahummaqsim Lana: The Holy Prophet (s) used to say this dua on this night — one of the perfect, comprehensive prayers said at all times, per the book Awali al-La'ali.

Dua Kumayl: Narrations especially recommend Dua Kumayl for this night.

Litany ×100: It is repeated a hundred times so that past disobedience is forgiven and worldly and religious needs are granted.

Prayer & dua after Isha: Shaykh al-Tusi, in Misbah al-Mutahajjid, narrates that Abu-Yahya asked Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a) about the best supplication for this night. By Allah, even if your requests were as numerous as raindrops, Allah would grant them all out of His generosity and favor.

Dua after the Shaf’ Prayer: Shaykh al-Tusi and Shaykh al-Kaf'ami say it is fitting to say this dua this night, recommended right after the Shaf' Prayer at the last hours of the night.

Shaykh al-Tusi and Sayyid Ibn Tawus narrate a supplication to be said after each two units of the Night Prayer, the Shaf’ Prayer, and the Watr Prayer.

Prophet’s prostration duas: Shaykh al-Tusi narrates, on the authority of Hammad ibn Isa, from Aban ibn Taghlib, from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a): it was the fifteenth night of Shaban when the Holy Prophet (s) was with his wife Aisha. At midnight the Prophet left the bed; when Aisha awoke and could not find him, she grew jealous, thinking he had gone to another wife, and rose, putting on her cloak — made of neither silk, linen, nor cotton, but camel hair. She searched the rooms of his other wives but found him prostrate on the ground like a discarded garment. Drawing near, she heard him saying these supplications. When the Prophet finished and turned back to bed, Aisha hurried ahead and reached it first. Hearing her fast breathing, he wondered aloud, then said, "Do you know what night this is? This is the mid-Shaban night. On it shares of provision are distributed, lifetimes are decided, and pilgrims of the coming year are appointed. Allah, this night, forgives as many of His creatures as the hairs on the horses of the Kalb tribe, and sends angels down to the earth, to Makkah."

Namaz of Jafar-e-Tayyaar: Narrated by Shaykh al-Tusi from Imam al-Rida (a).

Four-unit prayer: Reported by Abu-Yahya al-San'ani and thirty other trustworthy narrators from Imam Muhammad al-Baqir and Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a). Traditions have set a great reward for whoever offers a hundred-unit prayer this night, reciting Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Ikhlas ten times in each unit.

A_Y10.name: Fifteenth Day of Shaban

segs.note: Visit Imam al-Mahdi (a) at each time and place, and pray to Almighty Allah for hastening his advent.
segs.ur: امام مہدی (ع) کی ہر وقت اور ہر جگہ زیارت کریں اور اللہ تعالیٰ سے ان کے ظہور میں تعجیل کی دعا کریں۔

segs.note: His ziyarah at the Vault (sirdab) in Samarra' is more favorable.
segs.ur: سامرا کے سرداب میں ان کی زیارت زیادہ بہتر ہے۔

segs.note: Observe fasting on the last three days of Sha'ban and join it to the obligatory fasting of Ramadan.
segs.ur: شعبان کے آخری تین دن روزہ رکھیں اور اسے ماہِ رمضان کے واجب روزوں سے ملا دیں۔

segs.note: In the rest of the days of Sha'ban, repeat this supplication very often:
segs.ur: شعبان کے باقی دنوں میں یہ دعا بہت کثرت سے پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ غَفَرْتَ لَنَا فِيْمَا مَضٰى مِنْ شَعْبَانَ فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا فِيْمَا بَقِيَ مِنْهُ
segs.en: O Allah, if You have not forgiven us in what has passed of Sha'ban, then forgive us in what remains of it.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA IL LAM TAKUN GHAFARTA LANAA FEEMAA MADAA MIN SHA'BAANA FAGHFIR LANAA FEEMAA BAQIYA MINHU

A_Y10.merits:
On the fifteenth of Sha'ban, the twelfth Imam al-Mahdi, the Patron of the Age (Sahib al-Zaman), was born. May Almighty Allah's blessings be upon him and his immaculate ancestors. Beyond any dispute, Imam al-Mahdi (a) shall appear, overcome, and fill the earth with justice and equality just as it will have been filled with injustice and bias.

Imam al-Rida (a) is reported as saying: if one observes fasting on the last three days of Sha'ban and joins it to the obligatory fasting of Ramadan, Almighty Allah will decide him as having observed fasting for two consecutive months.

Abu'l-Salt al-Harawi has narrated that when he visited Imam al-Rida (a) on the last Friday of Sha'ban, the Imam said to him: Abu'l-Salt, the days of Sha'ban have almost passed; this is the last Friday. You should thus settle what you have missed in this month by working harder in the rest of it. Supplicate God, implore His forgiveness, recite the Holy Qur'an, and repent to Him from your sins so that you receive the month of Ramadan with pure sincerity to Him. You must fulfill all the trusts that you are liable to settle, not bear malice against any of your brethren-in-faith, and give up any sin that you commit. Fear Almighty Allah and trust in Him in secret and openly, for "if anyone puts his trust in Allah, sufficient is Allah for him — for Allah will surely accomplish His purpose; verily for all things has Allah appointed a due proportion." (65:3)

The supplication is repeated often because Almighty Allah saves many people from Hellfire on account of the sanctity of this month.

A_Y11.name: Ziyarat on the 15th of Shaban

segs.note: On the 15th of Sha'ban, visit Imam Husayn (a.s.) with the ziyarat of the 1st of Rajab, Ziyarat of Imam Husayn (a.s.), or with this form.
Stand at the tomb and recite:

segs.en: All praise be to Allah the Most High and the All-great.

segs.ar: وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ اَيُّهَا الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ الزَّكِيُّ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O righteous, pure servant (of Allah).
segs.tr: WAS SALAAMU A'LAYKA AYYUHAL A'BDUS SAALIHUZ ZAKIYY

segs.ar: اُوْدِعُكَ شَهَادَةً مِنِّيْ لَكَ تُقَرِّبُنِيْ اِلَيْكَ فِيْ يَوْمِ شَفَاعَتِكَ
segs.en: I entrust with you a testimony of mine that takes me near you on the day of your intercession (for some people).
segs.tr: OODI'UKA SHAHAADATAN MINNEE LAKA TUQARRIBUNEE ILAYKA FEE YAWMI SHAFAA'ATIK

segs.en: I bear witness that although you were slain, you have not died;
segs.tr: ASH-HADU ANNAKA QUTILTA WA LAM TAMUT

segs.ar: بَلْ بِرَجَاۤءِ حَيَاتِكَ حَيِيَتْ قُلُوْبُ شِيْعَتِكَ
segs.en: rather, the hearts of your adherents (Shi'ah) are living on the hope of your being alive,
segs.tr: BAL BIRAJAA'I HAYAATIKA HAYIYAT QULOOBU SHEE'ATIK

segs.en: and by the light of your illumination have your seekers been guided (to the right path).
segs.tr: WA BIDIYAA'I NOORIKAH TADAT TAALIBOONA ILAYK

segs.ar: وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ نُوْرُ اللّٰهِ الَّذِيْ لَمْ يُطْفَاْ وَلَا يُطْفَاُ اَبَدًا
segs.en: I also bear witness that you are verily the Light of Allah that has not and shall never be extinguished
segs.tr: WA ASH-HADU ANNAKA NOORULLAAHIL LADHEE LAM YUTFA' WA LAA YUTFA'U ABADAA

segs.ar: وَاَنَّكَ وَجْهُ اللّٰهِ الَّذِيْ لَمْ يَهْلِكْ وَلَا يُهْلَكُ اَبَدًا
segs.en: and you are verily the Face of Allah that has not and shall never be perishing.
segs.tr: WA ANNAKA WAJHULLAAHIL LADHEE LAM YAHLIK WA LAA YUHLAKU ABADAA

segs.en: I also bear witness that this soil is yours,
segs.tr: WA ASH-HADU ANNA HAADHIHIT TURBATA TURBATUK

segs.en: this holy precinct is yours,
and this death is the death of your body only,
while you have never been humiliated since Allah is the One Who is pouring honor upon you
and you have never been defeated since Allah is the One Who is supporting you.

segs.ar: هٰذِهِ شَهَادَةٌ لِيْ عِنْدَكَ اِلٰى يَوْمِ قَبْضِ رُوْحِيْ بِحَضْرَتِكَ
segs.en: I would like you to keep this testimony of mine with you up to the day when my soul will be grasped in the presence of you.
segs.tr: HAADHIHEE SHAHAADATUN LEE I'NDAKA ILAA YAWMI QABDI ROOHEE BIHADRATIK

segs.en: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
segs.tr: WAS SALAAMU A'LAYKA WA RAHMATULLAAHI WA BARAKAATUH

A_Y11.merits:
There are numerous traditions revealing the merits of visiting Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) on the fifteenth of Sha'ban. As a sufficient merit, these narrations have been reported through several valid chains of authority from Imam Zayn al-'Abidin and Imam al-Sadiq as saying, “He who would like to be shaken hands by one hundred thousand and twenty-four prophets, may visit the tomb of Abu-'Abdullah al-Husayn on the fifteenth of Sha'ban, because the spirits of the prophets ask Almighty Allah to permit them to visit Imam al-Husayn's tomb and the Almighty gives them permission. So, blessed be the one who shakes hands with these prophets among whom is the five constancy-endowed Messengers; namely, Noah, Abraham, Moses, Jesus, and Muhammad, peace be upon them all.”

When the reporter asked the Imam (a.s.) to explain the meaning of constancy-endowed, the Imam (a.s.) answered, “These prophets were sent to the east and west of the globe and to both humankind and jinn.”

There are two forms of visiting the holy tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) on the fifteenth of Sha'ban. The first form is the same as the one for ziyarah on the first of Rajab (Ziyarat of Imam Husayn (a.s.)), and the second is this one.

In his book of al-Balad al-Amin, Shaykh al-Kaf'ami has reported Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) as saying that one who visits Imam al-Husayn's tomb on the fifteenth of Sha'ban may stop at the tomb and say these words.

A_AA1.name: Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.)'s Sermon in the Holy Month of Ramazan

segs.note: O people, the month of Allah has come upon you with blessings, mercy, and forgiveness. This month is the most favorable month in the view of Almighty Allah. Its days are the best days. Its nights are the best nights. Its hours are the best hours.
segs.ur: اے لوگو، اللہ کا مہینہ برکت، رحمت اور مغفرت کے ساتھ آپ پر سایہ فگن ہو گیا ہے۔ یہ مہینہ اللہ تعالیٰ کے نزدیک سب سے افضل مہینہ ہے۔ اس کے دن بہترین دن ہیں۔ اس کی راتیں بہترین راتیں ہیں۔ اس کی گھڑیاں بہترین گھڑیاں ہیں۔

segs.note: In this month, you have been invited to the hospitality of Almighty Allah and you have been chosen to be within the people of Almighty Allah’s honoring. Your breaths in this month are (considered) glorification (of Almighty Allah). Your sleep in this month is (considered) an act of worship. Your deeds are accepted in this month. Your prayers are responded in this month.
segs.ur: اس مہینے میں آپ کو اللہ تعالیٰ کی ضیافت میں بلایا گیا ہے اور آپ کو اللہ تعالیٰ کی کرامت کے اہل لوگوں میں منتخب کیا گیا ہے۔ اس مہینے میں آپ کی سانسیں (اللہ کی) تسبیح شمار ہوتی ہیں۔ اس مہینے میں آپ کی نیند عبادت ہے۔ اس مہینے میں آپ کے اعمال قبول ہوتے ہیں۔ اس مہینے میں آپ کی دعائیں مستجاب ہوتی ہیں۔

segs.note: You may thus pray Almighty Allah with sincere intentions and pure hearts that He will guide you to observing fasting (properly) and to reciting His Book in this month. Verily, the true miserable is he whom is deprived of Almighty Allah’s forgiveness in this magnificent month.
segs.ur: یوں آپ سچی نیتوں اور پاک دلوں کے ساتھ اللہ تعالیٰ سے دعا کر سکتے ہیں کہ وہ آپ کو اس مہینے میں (صحیح طور پر) روزے رکھنے اور اس کی کتاب کی تلاوت کرنے کی توفیق دے۔ بے شک حقیقی بدبخت وہ ہے جو اس عظیم مہینے میں اللہ تعالیٰ کی مغفرت سے محروم رہ جائے۔

segs.note: As you feel hunger and thirst in this month, you should remember the hunger and thirst of the Resurrection Day. Give alms to the poor and the needy among you. Respect those who are older than you are. Have mercy upon those who are younger than you are. Esteem your ties with your relatives. Keep your tongues from obscenity.
segs.ur: جب آپ اس مہینے میں بھوک اور پیاس محسوس کریں تو قیامت کے دن کی بھوک اور پیاس کو یاد کریں۔ اپنے فقیروں اور مسکینوں کو صدقہ دیں۔ اپنے سے بڑوں کا احترام کریں۔ اپنے سے چھوٹوں پر رحم کریں۔ اپنے رشتہ داروں سے تعلق کو قدر کی نگاہ سے دیکھیں۔ اپنی زبانوں کو فحش گوئی سے بچائیں.

segs.note: Cast down your looks from all that which is unlawful for you to gaze and close your hearings against all that which is unlawful for you to hear. Treat kindly the orphans among you so that your orphans will be treated kindly. Repent from your sins. Raise your hands towards Him (i.e.
segs.ur: جس چیز کو دیکھنا آپ پر حرام ہے اس سے اپنی نگاہیں نیچی رکھیں اور جس چیز کو سننا آپ پر حرام ہے اس سے اپنے کان بند رکھیں۔ اپنے درمیان کے یتیموں کے ساتھ بھلائی کریں تاکہ آپ کے یتیموں کے ساتھ بھلائی کی جائے۔ اپنے گناہوں سے توبہ کریں۔ اس کی طرف اپنے ہاتھ اٹھائیں (یعنی

segs.note: Almighty Allah) with supplications at the times of your prayers, for these times are the best hours at which Almighty Allah looks at His servants with mercy - He will respond to their prayers, answer their calls, and receive their supplications.
segs.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ) کو اپنی نمازوں کے اوقات میں دعاؤں کے ساتھ پکارو، کیونکہ یہ اوقات بہترین ساعتیں ہیں جن میں اللہ تعالیٰ اپنے بندوں کو رحمت کی نگاہ سے دیکھتا ہے - وہ ان کی دعائیں قبول فرماتا ہے، ان کی پکار کا جواب دیتا ہے اور ان کی دعاؤں کو شرف قبولیت بخشتا ہے۔

segs.note: O people, truly, your souls are dependent upon your deeds; therefore, try to free them by means of imploring for forgiveness. Likewise, your backs are heavily burdened by your sins; therefore, try to lighten the burdens on your backs by means of long prostration (before your Lord).
segs.ur: اے لوگو، بے شک آپ کی جانیں آپ کے اعمال کے بدلے گروی ہیں؛ لہٰذا استغفار کے ذریعے انہیں چھڑائیں۔ اور آپ کی پیٹھیں آپ کے گناہوں کے بوجھ سے گراں بار ہیں؛ لہٰذا (اپنے رب کے حضور) طویل سجدوں کے ذریعے اپنی پیٹھ کا بوجھ ہلکا کریں۔

segs.note: Let it be known to you that Almighty Allah has sworn by His Mighty that He shall not chastise the performers of prayers and those who prostrate before Him and that He shall not frighten them with Hellfire on that day when all humankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds.
segs.ur: جان لیں کہ اللہ تعالیٰ نے اپنی عزت کی قسم کھائی ہے کہ وہ نماز پڑھنے والوں اور اپنے سامنے سجدہ کرنے والوں کو عذاب نہیں دے گا، اور اس دن جب تمام انسان رب العالمین کے سامنے کھڑے ہوں گے انہیں جہنم سے نہیں ڈرائے گا۔

segs.note: O people, if anyone of you gives food to a faster (i.e. an observer of fasting) to break his fast in this month, he shall be awarded by Almighty Allah the reward of manumitting a bond Muslim as well as a forgiveness of all his past sins.”
segs.ur: اے لوگو، تم میں سے جو اس مہینے میں کسی روزہ دار کو افطار کرائے گا، اللہ تعالیٰ اسے ایک مسلمان غلام آزاد کرنے کا ثواب اور اس کے تمام گزشتہ گناہوں کی مغفرت عطا فرمائے گا۔”

segs.note: The attendants asked, “O Allah’s Messenger, not all of us can do this!”
segs.ur: حاضرین نے عرض کیا: “یا رسول اللہ، ہم سب یہ نہیں کر سکتے!”

segs.note: The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) answered, “Show fearfulness of Almighty Allah even by a half of a date. Show fearfulness of Almighty Allah even by a single drink of water. Verily, Almighty Allah shall give this great reward to those who do the least of their capability if they cannot do the much.
segs.ur: رسول اللہ (ص) نے جواب دیا: “اللہ تعالیٰ سے ڈرو، چاہے آدھی کھجور کے ذریعے ہو۔ اللہ تعالیٰ سے ڈرو، چاہے پانی کے ایک گھونٹ کے ذریعے ہو۔ بے شک جو لوگ زیادہ نہ کر سکیں اور اپنی استطاعت کے مطابق کم از کم کریں، اللہ تعالیٰ انہیں یہ عظیم اجر عطا فرمائے گا۔

segs.note: O people, as to those among you who behave politely in this month, they shall be permitted to pass the Discriminating Bridge (sirat) on the day when many feet will slip (i.e. the Resurrection Day). As to those among you who relieve their servants from a part of their jobs, Almighty Allah shall make easy for them the interrogation on the Resurrection Day.
segs.ur: اے لوگو، تم میں سے جو اس مہینے میں خوش اخلاقی اختیار کرے گا، اسے اس دن پلِ صراط سے گزرنے کی اجازت ملے گی جب بہت سے قدم پھسل جائیں گے (یعنی روزِ قیامت)۔ اور تم میں سے جو اپنے ماتحتوں کے کام میں کچھ کمی کرے گا، اللہ تعالیٰ روزِ قیامت اس کا حساب آسان کر دے گا۔

segs.note: As to those who stop bothering the others, Almighty Allah shall save them from His ire on the day when they shall meet Him. As to those who honor an orphan in this month, Almighty Allah shall honor them on the day when they will meet Him.
segs.ur: جو لوگ دوسروں کو تکلیف دینا چھوڑ دیں، اللہ تعالیٰ اس دن جب وہ اس سے ملیں گے انہیں اپنے غضب سے بچائے گا۔ اور جو لوگ اس مہینے میں کسی یتیم کی عزت کریں، اللہ تعالیٰ اس دن جب وہ اس سے ملیں گے ان کی عزت فرمائے گا.

segs.note: As to those who keep good ties with their relatives in this month, Almighty Allah will keep good ties with them through His mercy on the day when they will meet Him. On the other hand, as to those who rupture their relations with their relatives in this month, Almighty Allah will prevent them from receiving His mercy on the day when they will meet Him.
segs.ur: جو لوگ اس مہینے میں اپنے رشتہ داروں سے اچھے تعلقات رکھیں گے، اللہ تعالیٰ اس دن جب وہ اس سے ملیں گے اپنی رحمت سے ان کے ساتھ اچھا تعلق رکھے گا۔ اور جو لوگ اس مہینے میں اپنے رشتہ داروں سے تعلق توڑیں گے، اللہ تعالیٰ اس دن جب وہ اس سے ملیں گے انہیں اپنی رحمت سے محروم رکھے گا.

segs.note: As to those who voluntarily offer a prayer in this month, Almighty Allah will release them from Hellfire. As to those who perform a religious rite in this month, they shall be given the reward of performing seventy religious rites in other months.
segs.ur: جو لوگ اس مہینے میں نفل نماز پڑھیں گے، اللہ تعالیٰ انہیں جہنم کی آگ سے آزاد کر دے گا۔ اور جو لوگ اس مہینے میں کوئی فریضہ ادا کریں گے، انہیں دوسرے مہینوں میں ستر فرائض ادا کرنے کے برابر ثواب دیا جائے گا.

segs.note: As to those who very frequently invoke Almighty Allah’s blessings upon me in this month, Almighty Allah shall make their scales heavy (i.e. full of good deeds) when the others’ scales will be light (i.e. lacking good deeds). As to those who recite a single verse of the Qur’an in this month, they shall have the reward of one who has recited the whole Qur’an in other months.
segs.ur: جو لوگ اس مہینے میں مجھ پر بہت زیادہ درود بھیجیں گے، اللہ تعالیٰ ان کے میزان کو بھاری کر دے گا (یعنی نیکیوں سے بھرا ہوا) جس دن دوسروں کے میزان ہلکے ہوں گے (یعنی نیکیوں سے خالی)۔ اور جو لوگ اس مہینے میں قرآن کی ایک آیت پڑھیں گے، انہیں اتنا ثواب ملے گا جتنا دوسرے مہینوں میں پورا قرآن پڑھنے والے کو ملتا ہے.

segs.note: O people, certainly, the gates of Paradise are open wide in this month; therefore, pray your Lord not to close them before you. Similarly, the gates of Hellfire are close in this month; therefore, pray your Lord not to open them for you. Devils are tied up in this month; therefore, pray your Lord not to set them up over you...”
segs.ur: اے لوگو، بے شک اس مہینے میں جنت کے دروازے کھلے ہوئے ہیں؛ لہٰذا اپنے رب سے دعا کریں کہ انہیں آپ کے لیے بند نہ کرے۔ اور اس مہینے میں دوزخ کے دروازے بند ہیں؛ لہٰذا اپنے رب سے دعا کریں کہ انہیں آپ کے لیے نہ کھولے۔ شیاطین اس مہینے میں جکڑے ہوئے ہیں؛ لہٰذا اپنے رب سے دعا کریں کہ انہیں آپ پر مسلط نہ کرے...”

A_AA1.merits:
Shaykh al-Saduq has narrated on the authority of Imam al-Rida(a.s.) on the authority of his immaculate fathers on the authority of Imam AliAmeer al-Momineen(a.s.) who said that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.), once, delivered a speech to the community, saying,

Shaykh al-Saduq has also narrated that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) used to release all prisoners and give all beggars when the month of Ramadan comes upon him.

To sum it up, the month of Ramadan is the month of Allah. It is the most honorable of all months. In this month, the doors of heavens, gardens of Paradise, and mercy are opened while the doors of Hellfire are closed. In this month too, there is a night at which the acts of worship are more favorable than the worship of one thousand months.
In view of that, you are advised to take notice of this and consider how to spend the nights and days of this month and how to keep your organs and senses against committing any act of disobedience to Almighty Allah.
Beware of being one of those who spend the nights of Ramadan with sleeping and its days with negligence of mentioning your Lord. In this respect, a Hadith reads, “Verily, Almighty Allah releases one million persons from Hellfire at the last of each day in Ramadan and, more specifically, at the hour of breaking the fasting.
At the last night and on the last day of Ramadan, He releases from Hellfire as same as the number of all those whom He has released all over the month of Ramadan.”

Dear reader: Beware lest the holy month of Ramadan comes upon you and ends while you have still had some sins owing to which you will be punished. Beware lest you are included with the sinners whom are deprived of imploring for the forgiveness of their sins and praying Almighty Allah for granting your desires.

Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq(a.s.) is reported to have said, “Verily, one whom is not forgiven in Ramadan will not be forgiven up to the next Ramadan unless (he participates in the season of the Hajj and thus) he witnesses the ritual of the Halting at Mount ‘Arafat (al-wuquf ‘ala‘arafah).”

Moreover, try to keep yourself against all that which is deemed forbidden by Almighty Allah and try your best not to break your fasting with a forbidden thing. Finally, you should act upon the following recommendation of our master, Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s.):
“When you begin your day observing fasting, you should make sure that your hearing, your sight, your hair, your sink, and all your organs are also observing fasting, that is abstaining from not only the forbidden acts but also the discommended ones.”

Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) has also said, “Do not allow the day on which you observe fasting to be like your other days.”

He has also said, “Verily, fasting is not the abstinence from food and drink; rather, when you observe fasting, you should keep your tongues from uttering falsehood, keep your sights from seeing forbidden views, do not engage yourselves in disputes, do not envy each other, do not backbite each other, do not quarrel with each other, do not swear, whether falsely or truly,
do not insult each other, do not revile at each other, do not wrong each other, do not engage yourselves in shameless disputes, do not be bored, do not be careless of mentioning Almighty Allah or of prayers, abide by silence, quietness, patience, truthfulness, and avoidance of the evildoers, avoid perjury, lie, slander, contention, evil thinking, backbiting, and talebearing,
ready yourselves for the Next World and for your happy days; that is the Advent of the Rising Imam from the Household of Muhammad - peace be upon them all - expecting that which Almighty Allah has promised you, preparing yourselves for meeting Almighty Allah with tranquility, solemnity, piety, submission, and humiliation of the slaves who fear and hope for their masters.
O observer of fasting, purify your heart from defects, clean your inner self from filth, wash your body from dirt, disavow the enemies of Almighty Allah, act sincerely in His presence, abstain from all that which He has deemed unlawful for you to do in secret and in public, fear Almighty Allah as exactly as He deserves in secret and in public,
dedicate yourself to Almighty Allah during the days of your fasting, empty your heart from all things save Him, and ready yourself to do whatever is commanded by Him and to do whatever He has ordered you to do. After you do all these, only then you are considered fasting for the sake of Almighty Allah as truly as it should be. Carry out all that which He has ordered you to do.
But if you violate any of these matters, this will decline the degree of your fasting. My father - peace be upon him - narrated that when the Holy Messenger of Allah - peace be upon him and his Household - heard a woman, who claimed observing fasting, insulting one of her bondwomen, he summoned her, brought her some food, and ordered her to eat.
‘I am observing fasting!’ she stated. But the Holy Prophet - peace be upon him and his Household - answered, ‘How can you be fasting while you have insulted your bondwoman?’ Verily, fasting is not to abstain from eating and drinking; rather, Almighty Allah has decided fasting to be screen from all spoken and done evildoings.
Too little is the fasting and too much is the feeling of hunger!’”

Imam AliAmeer al-Momineen(a.s.) has said, “Too many are the fasting ones who suffer nothing but thirst. Likewise, too many are the worshippers who suffer nothing but fatigue. How wonderful the sleeping and eating of the courteous ones are!”

It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir ibn Yazid that Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (a.s.) narrated that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) said to Jabir ibn ‘Abdullah al-Ansari, “Listen, Jabir! This is the month of Ramadan.
If one observes fasting on the days of this month, spends a part of its nights with acts of worship, wards off his stomach and private parts, and suppresses his tongue - if one does all these things, he will dispose of all his sins in the same way as the month ends.” Jabir commented, “O Allah’s Messenger, what wonderful these words are!”
The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) answered, “But how difficult these terms are!”

A_AA2.name: Recitation of the Holy Quran in Ramazan

segs.note: In fact, the best of deeds at the nights and on the days of Ramadan is the recitation of the Holy Qur’an.
segs.ur: درحقیقت رمضان کی راتوں اور دنوں میں سب سے بہترین عمل قرآن کریم کی تلاوت ہے۔

segs.note: It is thus highly advisable to recite it in this month in a way different from reciting it in the other months, since its revelation was in Ramadan.
segs.ur: اس لیے اسے اس مہینے میں دوسرے مہینوں سے مختلف انداز میں پڑھنا بہت مناسب ہے، کیونکہ اس کا نزول رمضان میں ہوا تھا۔

segs.note: It is recommended to recite the whole Qur’an once a month or once each six days in the other months, according to some narrations.
segs.ur: مستحب ہے کہ پورا قرآن مہینے میں ایک بار یا دوسرے مہینوں میں ہر چھ دن میں ایک بار پڑھا جائے، بعض روایات کے مطابق۔

segs.note: As to the month of Ramadan, it is required to recite it wholly once every three days.
segs.ur: جہاں تک ماہ رمضان کا تعلق ہے، اسے (قرآن کو) ہر تین دن میں ایک بار مکمل پڑھنا ضروری ہے.

segs.note: If possible, it will be better if it is recited wholly every day.
segs.ur: اگر ممکن ہو تو بہتر ہے کہ اسے ہر روز پورا پڑھا جائے۔

segs.note: It is also advisable to say supplications, offer prayers, implore for Almighty Allah’s forgiveness, and confess His Oneness (by repeating the phrase of la-ilaha illal-lahu –there is no god save Allah-) as much as possible in Ramadan.
segs.ur: یہ بھی مستحب ہے کہ ماہ رمضان میں جہاں تک ممکن ہو دعا، نماز، استغفار اور توحید (لا الٰہ الا اللہ کی تکرار کے ساتھ) کثرت سے کی جائے۔

segs.note: It is finally recommended to pay a great interest to the reported acts of worship as well as the supererogatory (mustahab / nafilah) prayers at nights and days.
segs.ur: آخر میں یہ مستحب ہے کہ منقول عبادات اور راتوں اور دنوں کی نافلہ نمازوں کا بہت اہتمام کیا جائے۔

A_AA2.merits:
A Hadith reads that everything has a springtime; and the springtime of the Holy Qur’an is the month of Ramadan.

‘Allamah al-Majlisi has narrated that some of the Holy Imams (a.s.) used to recite the whole Qur’an forty times, or even more, in Ramadan.

The reward of reciting the whole Qur’an is doubled when its recitation is dedicated to the souls of the holy fourteen Infallibles (a.s.) by dedicating each recitation to each one of them respectively. According to some narrations, the reward of one who dedicates the recitation of the Holy Qur’an to the Holy Infallibles (a.s.) is that one shall be included with them on the Resurrection Day.

In this regard, Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn Zayn al-’Abidin (a.s.) used to stop talking in Ramadan except with phrases of prayers, glorification of Almighty Allah, implorations of His forgiveness, and phrases of confessing of His magnificence (i.e. Takbir –saying: Allahu-akbar).

A_AA3.name: Aamal to be Performed Only During the Night

segs.note: Breaking the Fast
segs.ur: افطار

segs.note: It is recommended to postpone breaking one’s fast later than the Isha’ Prayer unless one is too weak to keep fasting or one is being waited by people to break the fasting altogether, in an invitation for example.
segs.ur: مستحب ہے کہ افطار نماز عشا کے بعد تک مؤخر کیا جائے، سوائے اس کے کہ روزہ جاری رکھنے کی طاقت نہ ہو یا لوگ سب کے ساتھ مل کر افطار کرنے کے لیے انتظار کر رہے ہوں، مثلاً کسی دعوت میں۔

segs.note: Begin breaking the fast with food that is utterly lawful, especially dates.
segs.ur: افطار کا آغاز بالکل حلال غذا سے کریں، خاص طور پر کھجور سے۔

segs.note: It is also advisable to break the fast with dates, ripe dates, candy, sugar-candy, and cool water.
segs.ur: یہ بھی مستحب ہے کہ افطار کھجور، تازہ کھجور، مٹھائی، مصری اور ٹھنڈے پانی سے کیا جائے۔

segs.note: Recite the familiar iftar duas, such as:
segs.ur: افطار کی معروف دعائیں پڑھیں، جیسے:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ وَعَلٰى رِزْقِكَ اَفْطَرْتُ وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ
segs.en: O Allah, for the sake of You have I fasted, with Your sustenance have I broken my fast, and in You have I trusted.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA LAKA SUMTO WA A’LAA RIZQEKA AFTARTO, WA A’LAYKA TAWAKKALTO.

segs.note: Sayyid ibn Tawus and al-Kaf’ami narrate this dua, which begins:
segs.ur: سید ابن طاووس اور کفعمی یہ دعا نقل کرتے ہیں، جو ان الفاظ سے شروع ہوتی ہے:

segs.en: O Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Light...

segs.note: Imam Ali (a.s.) used to say this when he broke his fast:
segs.ur: امام علی (ع) افطار کرتے وقت یہ فرمایا کرتے تھے:

segs.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْنَا وَعَلٰى رِزْقِكَ اَفْطَرْنَا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ.
segs.en: In the Name of Allah. O Allah, for You have we fasted and with Your sustenance have we broken our fasting; so, (please) accept form us. You are surely the All-hearing, the All-knower.
segs.tr: BISMIL LAAHE ALLAAHUMMA LAKA SUMNAA WA A’LAA RIZQEKA AFTARNAA FATAQABBAL MINNAA INNAKA ANTAS SAMEE-U’L A’LEEM.

segs.note: At the first bite of the food with which you break the fast, say:
segs.ur: جس کھانے سے افطار کریں اس کے پہلے لقمے پر کہیں:

segs.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ، يَا وَاسِعَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ اِغْفِرْ لِيْ.
segs.en: In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful. O Liberal in forgiving! (Please do) forgive me.
segs.tr: BISMIL LAAHIR RAHMAANIR RAHEEM. YAA WAASE-A’L MAGHFERATE IGHFIR LEE.

segs.note: Recite Surah al-Qadr when breaking the fast.
segs.ur: روزہ افطار کرتے وقت [سورہ قدر](A101) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Give alms at the time of breaking the fast, and offer food to other fasters, even a single date and a drink of water.
segs.ur: افطار کے وقت صدقہ دیں، اور دوسرے روزہ داروں کو کھانا کھلائیں، چاہے ایک کھجور اور پانی کا ایک گھونٹ ہی ہو۔

segs.note: Qadr & Dukhan Each Night
segs.ur: ہر رات سورہ قدر اور دخان

segs.note: Recite Surah al-Qadr 1,000 times each night.
segs.ur: ہر رات [سورہ قدر](A101) 1,000 مرتبہ پڑھیں۔

segs.note: When possible, recite Surah al-Dukhan 100 times each night.
segs.ur: ممکن ہو تو ہر رات [سورہ دخان](A48) 100 مرتبہ پڑھیں۔

A_AA3.merits:
Breaking the fast with dates: This act doubles the reward of the prayer to four hundred folds.

Allahumma laka sumto: One who says this supplicatory prayer will be awarded, by Almighty Allah, the rewards of all those who observe fasting on that day.

Allahumma Rabban Nur al-Azim: This supplicatory prayer also brings about a great merit.

Forgiveness at the first bite: Forgiveness of Almighty Allah is the reward of those who say this imploration. A Hadees reads: Almighty Allah releases from Hellfire one million persons at the last hour of every day in Ramazan; therefore, pray Him to include you with these released ones.

Feeding fasters: Concerning this, the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) is reported to have said, “Verily, anyone who offers food for a faster in Ramazan will have the same reward that is decided for the faster without having any amount of his reward reduced and will have the same reward of acting good deeds according to the power of that food.”

‘Allamah al-Hilli, in al-Risalah al-Sa’diyyah, has narrated that Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s.) said, “As for any believer who feeds another believer with a single bite of food in Ramazan, Almighty Allah will decide for him the reward of manumitting thirty believing slaves and will decide to respond to his prayers.”

Dua for forty years of forgiveness: Sayyid ibn Tawus has mentioned that if one says a supplicatory prayer each night in Ramazan, his sins of forty years will be forgiven.

A_AA4.name: One Thousand Unit Prayers

segs.note: One of the recommended acts in the month of Ramazan is to offer the one thousand unit prayer.
segs.ur: ماہ رمضان کے مستحب اعمال میں سے ایک ہزار رکعت نماز پڑھنا ہے۔

segs.note: The most familiar form of the prayer:
segs.ur: دعا کی سب سے معروف صورت:

segs.note: As for the first twenty nights of Ramazan, twenty units of this prayer should be offered at each night with an interval between each two units.
segs.ur: جہاں تک ماہ رمضان کی پہلی بیس راتوں کا تعلق ہے، ہر رات اس نماز کی بیس رکعتیں پڑھی جائیں، ہر دو رکعت کے درمیان وقفے کے ساتھ.

segs.note: To explain, eight units should be offered after the obligatory Maghrib Prayer and the others are performed after the obligatory Isha’ Prayer.
segs.ur: وضاحت: آٹھ رکعتیں واجب نماز مغرب کے بعد پڑھی جائیں اور باقی واجب نماز عشاء کے بعد ادا کی جائیں۔

segs.note: The total is thus seven hundred units and the remainder is three hundred.
segs.ur: یوں کل سات سو رکعتیں ہوئیں اور باقی تین سو رہ گئیں۔

segs.note: These three hundred units should be offered at the Qadr Nights, which are the nineteenth, the twenty-first, and the twenty-third nights of the month.
segs.ur: یہ تین سو رکعتیں شبہائے قدر میں پڑھنی چاہییں، جو مہینے کی انیسویں، اکیسویں اور تیئیسویں راتیں ہیں۔

segs.note: One hundred units should be offered at each of these three Qadr Nights.
segs.ur: ان تینوں شبہائے قدر میں سے ہر رات سو رکعت نماز پڑھنی چاہیے۔

segs.note: Thus, one thousand units are completed.
segs.ur: یوں ایک ہزار رکعتیں مکمل ہو جاتی ہیں۔

segs.note: After every two units of the supererogatory (nafilah) prayers in Ramazan, recite:
segs.ur: ماہ رمضان میں نافلہ نمازوں کی ہر دو رکعت کے بعد پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِيْمَا تَقْضِيْ وَتُقَدِّرُ مِنَ الْاَمْرِ الْمَحْتُوْمِ،
segs.en: O Allah, at the time of taking decisions that are inevitable
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAJ A’L FEEMAA TAQZEE WA TOQADDERO MENAL AMRIL MAHTOOME

segs.en: and rendering possible things and events decisively,
segs.tr: WA FEEMAA TAFROQO MENAL AMRIL HAKEEME

segs.en: at the Destiny Night,

segs.ar: اَنْ تَجْعَلَنِيْ مِنْ حُجَّاجِ بَيْتِكَ الْحَرَامِ،
segs.en: (please) write my name in the list of those pilgrims of Your ‘Sacred House’
segs.tr: AN TAJ-A’LANEE MIN HUJJAAJE BAYTEKAL HARAAMIL

segs.en: whose pilgrimage receive Your approval, whose efforts are appreciated,
whose sins are forgiven.

segs.ar: وَاَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُطِيْلَ عُمْرِيْ فِيْ طَاعَتِكَ،
segs.en: I pray You to make possible for me long lifetime that is spent in obedience to You,
segs.tr: WA AS-ALOKA AN TOTEELA U’MREE FEE TAA-A’TEKA

segs.ar: وَتُوَسِّعَ لِيْ فِيْ رِزْقِيْ، يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
segs.en: and grant me enough means of livelihood. O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
segs.tr: WA TOWASSE-A’ LEE FEE RIZQEE, YAA ARHAMAR RAAHEMEEN.

A_AA4.merits:
Master scholars have referred to this prayer in their books of jurisprudence and acts of worship. However, the way of offering this prayer has been mentioned by narrations in many forms. According to the report of Ibn Abi-Qurrah from Imam Muhammad al-Jawad (a.s.) that is also adopted by Shaykh al-Mufid in his book of al-Ghariyyah wa’l-Ashraf, this prayer, in its most familiar form, is offered as follows:

It is worth mentioning that other divisions of these one thousand units have been cited.

Our virtuous readers are expected to offer this prayer so as not to miss its great rewards and merits.

Dua after every two units: It has been narrated that it is recommended to say this supplicatory prayer after the accomplishment of every two units of the supererogatory (mustahab / nafilah) prayers (nawafil) in Ramazan:

A_AA5.name: Duas after Every Obligatory Prayer

segs.note: Dua Hajj (Allahummarzuqni)
segs.ur: دعائے حج (اللهم ارزقنی)

segs.note: After every obligatory prayer in the month of Ramazan, recite:
segs.ur: ماہ رمضان میں ہر فرض نماز کے بعد پڑھیں:

segs.en: O Allah, (please) confer upon me with the grace of pilgrimage to Your Holy House

segs.ar: فِي عَامِیْ هٰذَا وَفِیْ كُلِّ عَامٍ
segs.en: in this year and every year
segs.tr: FEE A’AMEE HAAZAA WA FEE KULLE A’AAMIN

segs.ar: مَا اَبْقَيْتَنِیْ فِیْ يُسْرٍ مِنْكَ وَعَافِيَةٍ،
segs.en: as long as You keep me alive, with easiness, good health,
segs.tr: MAA ABQAYTANEE FEE YUSRIN MINKA WA A’AFEYATIN

segs.en: and expansive sustenance from You.

segs.ar: وَلَا تُخْلِنِيْ مِنْ تِلْكَ الْمَوَاقِفِ الْكَرِيْمَةِ،
segs.en: Do not deprive me of these noble situations,
segs.tr: WA LAA TUKHLENEE MIN TILKAL MAWAAQEFIL KAREEMATE

segs.en: holy places,

segs.ar: وَزِيَارَةِ قَبْرِ نَبِيِّكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ،
segs.en: and visiting the tomb of Your Prophet may Your blessings be upon him and his Household.
segs.tr: WA ZEYAARATE QABRE NABIYYEKA SALAWAATOKA A’LAYHE WA AALEHI

segs.en: (Please) stand for me in all of my needs for this worldly life and the Next World.
segs.tr: WA FEE JAMEE-E’ HAWAA-EJID DUNYAA WAL AAKHERATE

segs.en: O Allah, I beseech You regarding that
which You decide and determine

segs.ar: مِنَ الْاَمْرِ الْمَحْتُوْمِ فِيْ لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ،
segs.en: from the inevitable decisions that You make on the Grand Night decisions
segs.tr: MENAL AMRIL MAHTOOME FEE LAYLATIL QADRE

segs.en: that are neither retreated
nor altered to include me with
the pilgrims to Your Holy House
whose pilgrimage is admitted by You,
whose efforts are thankfully accepted by You,
whose sins are forgiven by You,
and whose offenses are pardoned by You.
Within Your determined decisions,
segs.tr: WAJ A’L FEEMAA TAQZEE WA TOQADDERO

segs.en: please decide for me a long life,
expansive sustenance,
and help to fulfill my trusts and settle my debts.
segs.tr: WA TOADDEYA A’NNEE AMAANATEE WA DAYNEE

segs.en: Respond to me, O Lord of the worlds!

segs.note: Dua Ya Aliyyu Ya Azim
segs.ur: دعا یا علی یا عظیم

segs.en: O Most High! O All Great!
O All-forgiving! O All-merciful!
You are the All-great Lord
like Whom there is nothing,
and He is the All Hearing, the All-aware.
This is a month that You have glorified, ennobled,
segs.tr: WA HAAZAA SHAHRUN A’ZZAMTAHU WA KARRAMTAHU

segs.en: honored, and preferred to the other months.
segs.tr: WA SHARRAFTAHU WA FAZZALTAHU A’LASH SHOHOORE

segs.ar: وَهُوَ الشَّهْرُ الَّذِيْ فَرَضْتَ صِيَامَهٗ عَلَيَّ،
segs.en: It is the month that You imposed upon me to observe fasting in it.
segs.tr: WA HOWASH SHAHRUL LAZEE FARAZTA SEYAAMAHU A’LAYYA

segs.en: It is the month of Ramazan
during which You revealed the Qur'an

segs.ar: هُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ وَبَيِّنَاتٍ مِّنَ الْهُدىٰ وَالْفُرْقَانِ،
segs.en: as guidance for people, clear proofs on true guidance, and distinction (between the right and the wrong).
segs.tr: HODAL LIN-NAASE WA BAYYENAATIM MENAL HODAA WAL FURQAAN

segs.en: You decided the Grand Night to be in it
and You have decided it to be more favorable that one thousand months.
segs.tr: WA JA-A’LTAHAA KHAYRAM MIN ALFE SHAHRIN

segs.ar: فَيَا ذَا الْمَنِّ وَلَا يُمَنُّ عَلَيْكَ،
segs.en: So, O Lord of graces! None can ever do favor to You!
segs.tr: FAYAA ZAL MANNE WA LAA YOMANNO A’LAYKA

segs.ar: مُنَّ عَلَيَّ بِفَكَاكِ رَقَبَتِيْ مِنَ النَّارِ
segs.en: Please, do me a favor by releasing me from the Fire
segs.tr: MUNNA A’LAYYA BE-FAKAAKE RAQABATEE MENAN NAARE

segs.en: and by including me with those to whom You do this favor,
and allow me to enter Paradise,
on account of Your mercy. O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!

segs.note: Dua Allahumma Adkhil
segs.ur: دعا اللهم ادخل

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَدْخِلْ عَلٰی اَهْلِ الْقُبُوْرِ السُّرُوْرِ
segs.en: O Allah, instill happiness in the spirits of the inhabitants of the grave.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA ADKHIL A’LAA AHLIL QOBOORIS SOROORE

segs.en: O Allah, enrich every indigent.
O Allah, satisfy every hungry person.
O Allah, clothe every unclothed one.
O Allah, facilitate the payment of every indebted one.
O Allah, relieve every deeply anguished one.
O Allah, return every stranger.
O Allah, free every captive.
O Allah, reform every uneven
affair of the Muslims.
O Allah, cure every sick person.
O Allah, fill our poverty with your needlessness.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ غَیِّرْ سُوْءَ حَالِنَا بِحُسْنِ حَالِكَ
segs.en: O Allah, change our unpleasant state into Your beautiful state.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA GHAYYIR SOO-A HAALANAA BE-HUSNE HAALEKA

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّیْنَ وَاَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
segs.en: O Allah, facilitate the payment of our debt and make us needless.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAQ ZE A’NNAD DAYNA WA AGHNENAA MENAL FAQRE

segs.en: Surely You are All-Powerful over everything.

A_AA5.merits:
Dua Hajj: Sayyid Ibn Tawus has narrated that Imam al-Sadiq and Imam al-Kazim (a.s.) instructed to say this supplicatory prayer after each and every obligatory prayer all over the month of Ramazan.

Dua Allahumma Adkhil: In al-Misbah and in al-Balad al-Amin, Shaykh al-Kaf’ami, as well as Shaykh al-Shahid in al-Majmu’ah, have narrated that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) said that one who says this supplicatory prayer after each obligatory prayer in Ramadan will have all his sins forgiven up to the Resurrection Day.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي بِكَ وَمِنْكَ أَطْلُبُ حَاجَتِي
segs.en: O Allah, from You and by You, I beseech for settling my need.
segs.tr: allahumma inni bika wa minka atlubu hajati

segs.en: If others beg people for settling their needs,
segs.tr: wa man talaba hajatan ila alnnasi

segs.ar: فَإِنِّي لاَ أَطْلُبُ حَاجَتِي إِلاَّ مِنْكَ
segs.en: I ask none except You for settling my need;
segs.tr: fa-inni la atlubu hajati illa minka

segs.en: from You alone, since You have no partner with You.
I thus implore You in the name of Your favor and Your pleasure,

segs.ar: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
segs.en: to send blessings to Muhammad and his Household
segs.tr: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ahli baytihi

segs.ar: وَأَنْ تَجْعَلَ لِي فِي عَامِي هٰذَا إِلَىٰ بَيْتِكَ ٱلْحَرَامِ سَبِيلاً
segs.en: and to choose for me a way to Your Holy House this year:
segs.tr: wa an taj`ala li fi `ami hadha ila baytika alharami sabilan

segs.en: a pilgrimage that is admitted,
accepted, pure,
and sincerely intended for You
by which You delight me
and raise my rank with You.
Confer upon me with the grace of making me cast my sight down (against what is illegal for me to look at),
making me act chastely,

segs.ar: وَأَنْ أَكُفَّ بِهَا عَنْ جَمِيعِ مَحَارِمِكَ
segs.en: and making me stop committing any deed that You have deemed unlawful
segs.tr: wa an akuffa biha `an jami`i maharimika

segs.ar: حَتَّىٰ لاَ يَكُونَ شَيْءٌ آثَرَ عِنْدِي مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ وَخَشْيَتِكَ
segs.en: so that nothing will be more preferred in my sight than obedience to You, fear of You,
segs.tr: hatta la yakuna shay`un athara `indi min ta`atika wa khashyatika

segs.en: doing all that which You love,
and avoiding all that which You have detested and warned against.
(Please) make all that take place with easiness, lenience,
segs.tr: waj`al dhalika fi yusrin wa yasarin

segs.en: and good health as well as the grace that You have bestowed upon me.

segs.ar: وَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ وَفَاتِي قَتْلاً فِي سَبِيلِكَ
segs.en: I beseech You to cause me to die as martyr for Your sake,
segs.tr: wa as'aluka an taj`ala wafati qatlan fi sabilika

segs.en: under the pennon of Your Prophet and in the line of Your intimate servants.

segs.ar: وَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَقْتُلَ بِي أَعْدَاءَكَ وَأَعْدَاءَ رَسُولِكَ
segs.en: I ask You to make me a means of killing Your enemies and the enemies of Your Messenger.
segs.tr: wa as'aluka an taqtula bi a`da'aka wa a`da'a rasulika

segs.ar: وَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُكْرِمَنِي بِهَوَانِ مَنْ شِئْتَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segs.en: I ask You to honor me through humiliating any one of Your created beings that You choose,
segs.tr: wa as'aluka an tukrimani bihawani man shi'ta min khalqika

segs.ar: وَلاَ تُهِنِّي بِكَرَامَةِ أَحَدٍ مِنْ أَوْلِيَائِكَ
segs.en: and not to humiliate me through honoring any of Your intimate servants.
segs.tr: wa la tuhinni bikaramati ahadin min awliya'ika

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْ لِي مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلاً
segs.en: O Allah, find me a way with the Messenger.
segs.tr: allahumma ij`al li ma`a alrrasuli sabilan

segs.en: Allah is Sufficient unto me! Only that which Allah wants shall take place.

A_AA10.name: Dua Iftitah

segs.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
segs.ur: عظیم اور دائمی رحمتوں والے خدا کے نام سے

segs.en: O Allah! I begin the Glorification with Thy Praise
segs.ur: اے معبود! تیری حمد کے ذریعے تیری تعریف کا آغاز کرتا ہوں

segs.en: and You, by Your grace, direct (me) to what is right.
segs.ur: اور تو اپنے احسان سے راہ راست دکھانے والا ہے

segs.ar: وَاَيْقَنْتُ اَنَّكَ اَنْتَ اَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ فِىْ مَوْضِعِ الْعَفْوِ وَالرَّحْمَةِ
segs.en: And I am certain that You are the Most Merciful in regard with forgiveness and mercy.
segs.tr: WA AYQANTO ANNAKA ANTA ARHAMUR RAAHEMEENA FEE MAWZE-I’L A’FWE WAR-RAHMATE
segs.ur: اور مجھے یقین ہے کہ تو معافی دینے اور مہربانی کرنے کے مقام پر سب سے بڑھ کر رحم و کرم کرنے والا ہے

segs.ar: وَاَشَدُّ الْمُعَاقِبِيْنَ فِى مَوْضِعِ النَّكَالِ وَالنَّقِمَةِ
segs.en: And the most severe in regard with exemplary punishment and chastisement to wrong doers.
segs.tr: WA ASHADDUL MO-A’AQEBEENA FEE MAW-ZE-I’N NAKAALE WAN-NAQEMATE
segs.ur: اور شکنجہ و عذاب کے موقع پر سب سے سخت عذاب دینے والا ہے

segs.ar: وَاَعْظَمُ الْمُتَجَبِّرِيْنَ فِىْ مَوْضِعِ الْكِبْرِيَآءِ وَالْعَظَمَةِ
segs.en: And the Omnipotent in the domain of absolute power and might.
segs.tr: WA A-A’ZAMUL MOTAJABBEREENA FEE MAW-ZE-I’L KIBREYAA-E WAL-A’ZAMATE.
segs.ur: اور بڑائی اور بزرگی کے مقام پر تو تمام قاہروں اور جابروں سے بڑھا ہوا ہے

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَذِنْتَ لِىْ فِىْ دُعَائِكَ وَمَسْئَلَتِكَ
segs.en: O Allah, You have permitted me to invoke Thee and beg Thee,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA AZINTA LEE FEE DO-A’A-EKA WA MAS-ALATEKA
segs.ur: اے الله! تو نے مجھے اجازت دے رکھی ہے کہ تجھ سے دعا و سوال کروں

segs.en: then do listen my praise, O the Hearer,
segs.ur: پس اے سننے والے یہ تعریف سن

segs.en: and answer my prayer, O Merciful.
segs.ur: اور اے مہربان میری دعا قبول فرما

segs.en: And reduce my lapses, O the All Forgiving.
segs.ur: اے بخشنے والے میری خطا معاف کر

segs.ar: فَكَمْ يَا اِلٰهِىْ مِنْ كُرْبَةٍ قَدْ فَرَّجْتَهَا
segs.en: O Allah! There are so many trouble which You have removed,
segs.tr: FA-KAM YAA ELAAHEE MIN KURBATIN QAD FARRAJTAHAA
segs.ur: پس اے میرے معبود! کتنی ہی مصیبتوں کو تو نے دور کیا

segs.en: and sorrows which You have dispelled,
segs.ur: اور کتنے ہی اندیشوں کو ہٹایا

segs.en: and mistakes that You have reduced,
segs.ur: اور خطاؤں سے در گزر کی

segs.en: and mercy that You have spread,
segs.ur: رحمت کو عام کیا

segs.en: and circles of calamities which You have cleared.
segs.ur: اور بلاؤں کے گھیرے کو توڑا اور رہائی دی

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىْ لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ صَاحِبَةً وَّلَا وَلَدًا
segs.en: All Praise be to Allah (alone) who did not take a mate nor a son
segs.tr: ALHAMDO LIL-LLAAHIL LAZEE LAM YATTAKHIZ SAAHEBATAN WA LAA WALADAN
segs.ur: حمد اس الله کیلئے ہے جس نے نہ کسی کو اپنی زوجہ بنایا اور نہ کسی کو اپنا بیٹا بنایا

segs.ar: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهٗ شَرِيْكٌ فِى الْمُلْكِ
segs.en: Who has no partner in His Kingdom,
segs.tr: WA LAM YAKUN LAHU SHAREEKUN FIL MULKE
segs.ur: نہ ہی سلطنت میں اس کا کوئی شریک ہے

segs.ar: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهٗ وَلِىٌّ مِنَ الذُّلِّ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيْرًا
segs.en: nor does He have master in dependence, Then Magnify Him as He should be magnified.
segs.tr: WA LAM YAKUN LAHU WALIYYUN MENAZ ZULLE WA KABBIRHO TAKBEERAN
segs.ur: اور نہ وہ عاجز ہے کہ کوئی اس کا سر پرست ہو، اس کی بڑائی بیان کرو

segs.en: All Praise is for Allah with All Praises
segs.ur: حمد الله ہی کیلئے ہے اس کی تمام خوبیوں کے ساتھ

segs.en: for all His bounties.
segs.ur: اس کی ساری نعمتوں پر

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىْ لَا مُضَّآدَّ لَهٗ فِىْ مُلْكِهٖ
segs.en: All Praise is for Allah who does not have any opposition in His Kingdom
segs.tr: ALHAMDO LILLAAHIL LAZEE LAA MOZAAD-DA LAHU FEE MULKEHI
segs.ur: حمد اس الله کیلئے ہے جس کی حکومت میں اس کا کوئی مخالف نہیں

segs.en: nor any dispute in His commands.
segs.tr: WA LAA MONAA-ZE-A’ LAHU FEE AMREHI
segs.ur: نہ اس کے حکم میں کوئی رکاوٹ ڈالنے والا ہے

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىْ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ فِىْ خَلْقِهٖ
segs.en: All Praise is for Allah who does not have a partner in His creation
segs.tr: ALHAMDO LILLAAHIL LAZEE LAA SHAREEKA LAHU FEE KHALQEHI
segs.ur: حمد اس الله کیلئے ہے جس کی آفرینش میں کوئی اس کا شریک نہیں

segs.en: nor is there anything similar unto Him in His greatness.
segs.tr: WA LAA SHA-BEHA LAHU FEE A’ZAMATEHI
segs.ur: اور اسکی بڑائی میں کوئی اس جیسا نہیں

segs.en: All Praise is for Allah the evident in His command
segs.ur: حمد اس الله کیلئے ہے کہ خلق میں آشکار ہے

segs.ar: اَمْرُهٗ وَحَمْدُهٗ الظَّاهِرِ بِالْكَرَمِ مَجْدُهٗ الْبَاسِطِ بِالْجُوْدِ
segs.en: and His praise is apparent, His glory is through Honour,
segs.tr: AMROHU WA HAMDOHUZ ZAAHERE BIL-KARAME MAJDOHUL BAASETE BIL-JOODE
segs.ur: جسکا حکم اور حمد، اس کی شان اس کی بخشش کے ساتھ ظاہر ہے، بن مانگے دینے میں کھلا ہے

segs.en: His hands open with generosity, which does not decreases His treasure
segs.ur: اس کا ہاتھ، وہی ہے جس کے خزانے کم نہیں ہوتے

segs.ar: وَلَا تَزِيْدُهٗ كَثْرَةُ الْعَطَآءِ اِلَّا جُوْدًا وَكَرَمًا
