segs.en: and His excess bestowals does not increases anything except with generosity and honour,
segs.tr: WA LAA TAZEEDOHU KASRATUL A’TAA-E ILLAA JOODAN WA KARAMAN
segs.ur: اور کثرت کے ساتھ عطا کرنے سے اس کی بخشش اور سخاوت میں اضافہ ہوتا ہے

segs.en: Surely He is the Mighty, the excessive Provider.
segs.ur: کیونکہ وہ زبردست عطا کرنے والا ہے

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّىْ اَسْئَلُكَ قَلِيْلًا مِنْ كَثِيْرٍ
segs.en: O Allah I ask You some of my many needs
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA QALEELAN MIN KASEERIN
segs.ur: اے معبود! میں سوال کرتا ہوں تجھ سے بہت میں سے تھوڑے کا

segs.en: upon which I greatly depend
segs.ur: جبکہ مجھے اس کی بہت زیادہ حاجت ہے

segs.en: while You are needless of them since eternity,
segs.ur: اور تو ہمیشہ اس سے بے نیاز ہے

segs.en: they are a lot for me,
segs.ur: اور وہ نعمت میرے لیے بہت بڑی ہے

segs.en: but for You it is very easy and simple.
segs.ur: اور تیرے لئے اس کا دینا آسان ہے

segs.en: O Allah, surely Your forgiveness of my sins,
segs.ur: اے معبود! بے شک تیرا میرے گناہ کو معاف کرنا

segs.en: Your overlooking of my mistakes,
segs.ur: میری خطا سے تیری در گزر

segs.en: Your forgiveness of my injustices (unto me)
segs.ur: میرے ستم سے تیری چشمپوشی

segs.en: Your concealment of my evil deeds,
segs.ur: میرے برے عمل کی پردہ پوشی

segs.en: Your forbearance on the extremity of my crimes which were committed
segs.ur: میرے بہت سے جرائم پر تیری بردباری

segs.ar: عِنْدَ مَا كَانَ مِنْ خَطَئِیْ وَعَمْدِىْ
segs.en: either due to negligence or wilfuly.
segs.tr: I’NDA MAA KAANA MIN KHA-TA-EE WA A’MADEE
segs.ur: جبکہ ان میں سے بعض بھول کر اور بعض میں نے جان بوجھ کر کئے ہیں

segs.ar: اَطْمَعَنِىْ فِىْ اَنْ اَسْئَلُكَ مَا لَا اَسْتَوْجِبُهٗ مِنْكَ
segs.en: Provide me hope to ask from You of that which I am not worthy of.
segs.tr: AT-MA-A’NEE FEE AN AS-ALAKA MAA LAA ASTAWJEBOHU MINKAL
segs.ur: تب بھی اس سے مجھے طمع ہوئی کہ میں تجھ سے وہ مانگوں جس کا میں حقدار نہیں

segs.en: You have sustained me due to Your mercy
segs.ur: چنانچہ تو نے اپنی رحمت سے مجھے روزی دی

segs.en: And shown me of Your Power
segs.ur: اور اپنی قدرت کے کرشمے دکھائے

segs.en: and introduced me by Your response (to my prayers).
segs.ur: قبولیت کی پہچان کرائی

segs.en: Then I have come calling You, believing in You,
segs.ur: پس اب میں با امن ہوکر تجھے پکارتا ہوں

segs.ar: وَاَسْئَلُكَ مُسْتَانِسًا لَا خَائِفًا وَلَا وَجِلًا
segs.en: and I ask You as a close acquaintance, neither fearful nor afraid,
segs.tr: WA AS-ALOKA MUSTAA-NESAN LAA KHAA-EFAN WA LAA WAJELAN
segs.ur: اور سوال کرتا ہوں الفت سے نہ ڈرتے اور گھبراتے ہوئے

segs.ar: مُدِلًا عَلَيْكَ فِيْمَا قَصَدْتُ فِيْهِ اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: having faith upon You whenever I turn to You concerning it.
segs.tr: MODILLAN A’LAYKA FEEMAA QASADTO FEEHE ELAYKA
segs.ur: اور مجھے ناز ہے کہ اس بارے میں تیری بارگاہ میں آیا ہوں

segs.ar: فَاِنْ اَبْطَا عَنِّىْ عَتَبْتُ بِجَهْلِىْ عَلَيْكَ
segs.en: I blame my ignorance about You for this delay.
segs.tr: FA-IN AB-TA-A A’NNEE A’TABTO BE-JAHLEE A’LAYKA
segs.ur: پس اگر تو نے قبولیت میں دیر کی تو میں بوجہ نادانی تجھ سے شکوہ کروں گا

segs.ar: وَلَعَلَّ الَّذِىْ اَبْطَا عَنِّىْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لِىْ
segs.en: And perhaps whatever is delayed in my matter is better for me,
segs.tr: WA LA-A’LLAL LAZEE AB-TA-A A’NNEE HOWA KHAYRUN LEE
segs.ur: اور شاید وہ تاخیر میرے لیے بہتری کی حامل ہو

segs.en: for You know about the consequences of the affairs.
segs.ur: کاموں کے نتائج سے متعلق تیرے علم میں

segs.en: Then I did not see an Honourable Master
segs.ur: پس میں نے کوئی مہربان مولا نہیں دیکھا

segs.ar: اَصْبَرَ عَلٰى عَبْدٍ لَئِيْمٍ مِنْكَ عَلَىَّ
segs.en: more patient to His disgraceful servant than You are to me.
segs.tr: ASBARA A’LAA A’BDIN LA-EEMIN MINKA A’LAYYA
segs.ur: جو تیرے سوا میرے جیسے پست بندے پر صابر ہو

segs.ar: يَا رَبِّ اِنَّكَ تَدْعُوْنِىْ فَاُوَلِّىْ عَنْكَ
segs.en: O Lord! You call me but I turn away from You,
segs.tr: YAA RABBE INNA TAD-O’ONEE FA-OWALLEE A’NKA
segs.ur: اے پروردگار! تو مجھے پکارتا ہے تو میں تجھ سے منہ موڑتا ہوں

segs.en: You care to love me but I am bent upon hating You.
segs.ur: تو مجھ سے محبت کرتا ہے میں تجھ سے خفگی کرتا ہوں

segs.en: You want to show Your affections for me but I do not accept it from You
segs.tr: WA TA-TA-WADDADO ELAYYA FALAA AQBALO MINKA
segs.ur: تو میرے ساتھ الفت کرتا ہے میں بے رخی کرتا ہوں

segs.en: as if I am obliging You.
segs.ur: جیسے کہ میرا تجھ پر کوئی احسان رہا ہو

segs.ar: فَلَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ ذٰلِكَ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ لِىْ
segs.en: But this should not prevent You from bestowing (Your) mercy,
segs.tr: FALAM YAMNA’KA ZAALEKA MENAR RAHMATE LEE
segs.ur: تو بھی میرا یہ طرز عمل تجھے مجھ پر رحمت فرمانے سے باز نہیں رکھتا

segs.ar: وَالْاِحْسَانِ اِلَىَّ وَالتَّفَضُّلِ عَلَىَّ بِجُوْدِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ
segs.en: goodness, and grace upon me for the sake of Your generosity and Your Honour.
segs.tr: WAL EHSAANE ELAYYA WAT TAFAZZOLE A’LAYYA BEJOODEKA WA KARAMEKA
segs.ur: اور مجھ پر اپنی عطا و بخشش کے ساتھ فضل و احسان کرنے سے باز نہیں رکھتا

segs.en: Then have mercy on Your ignorant servant
segs.ur: پس اپنے اس نادان بندے پر رحم کر

segs.en: and be generous to him with Your graceful obligations.
segs.ur: اور اس پر اپنے فضل و احسان سے سخاوت فرما

segs.en: Certainly You are Generous, Honourable.
segs.ur: بے شک تو بہت دینے والا سخی ہے

segs.en: All Praise is for Allah, the Owner of the Kingdom,
segs.ur: حمد ہے اس اللہ کے لیے جو سلطنت کا مالک

segs.en: the One Who makes the ships sail, Controller of the winds,
segs.ur: کشتی کو رواں کرنیوالا، ہواؤں کو قابو رکھنے والا

segs.ar: فَالِقِ الْاِصْبَاحِ دَيَّانِ الدِّيْنِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
segs.en: Breaker of dawn, administrator of the authority, Lord of the Universe.
segs.tr: FAALEQIL ISBAAHE DAYYAANID DEENE RABBIL A’ALAMEENA.
segs.ur: صبح کو روشن کرنے والا، اور قیامت میں جزا دینے والا، جہانوں کا پروردگار ہے

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَلٰى حِلْمِهٖ بَعْدَ عِلْمِهٖ
segs.en: All Praise is for Allah due to His forbearance after His Knowledge
segs.tr: ALHAMDO LILLAAHE A’LAA HILMEHI BA’DA I’LMEHI
segs.ur: حمد ہے اللہ کی کہ جانتے ہوئے بھی بردباری سے کام لیتا ہے

segs.ar: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَلٰى عَفْوِهٖ بَعْدَ قُدْرَتِهٖ
segs.en: and All Praise is for Allah on account of His forgiveness after His Power.
segs.tr: ALHAMDO LILLAAHE A’LAA A’FWEHI BA’DA QUDRATEHI
segs.ur: اور حمد ہے اس اللہ کی جو قوت کے باوجود معاف کرتا ہے

segs.ar: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَلٰى طُوْلِ اَنَاتِهٖ فِىْ غَضَبِهٖ
segs.en: All Praise is for Allah due to the length of His respite in His anger
segs.tr: WAL HAMDO LILLAAHE A’LAA TOOLE ANAATEHI FEE GHAZABEHI
segs.ur: اور حمد ہے اس اللہ کی جو حالت غضب میں بھی بڑا بردبار ہے

segs.en: while He is having power on what He wills.
segs.tr: WA HOWA QAADERUN A’LAA MAA YOREEDO.
segs.ur: اور وہ جو چاہے اسے کرگزرنے کی طاقت رکھتا ہے

segs.en: All Praise is for Allah, the Creator of the creatures,
segs.ur: حمد ہے اس اللہ کی جو مخلوق کو پیدا کرنیوالا

segs.en: Spreader of the sustenance, Breaker of dawn,
segs.ur: روزی کشادہ کرنیوالا، صبح کو روشنی بخشنے والا

segs.en: the Owner of the majesty and Honour, favours and bounties,
segs.tr: ZIL JALAALE WAL IKRAAME WAL FAZLE WAL IN-A’AMIL
segs.ur: صاحب جلالت و کرم اور فضل و نعمت کا مالک ہے

segs.en: One who, when far, is not seen,
segs.ur: جو ایسا دور ہے کہ نظر نہیں آتا

segs.en: and when near, then witnesses the whispers,
segs.ur: اور اتنا قریب ہے کہ سرگوشی کو بھی جانتا ہے

segs.en: the Blessed, the High.
segs.ur: وہ مبارک اور برتر ہے

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىْ لَيْسَ لَهٗ مُنَازِعٌ يُعَادِلُهٗ
segs.en: All Praise is for Allah for whom there is no dispute who can equal Him
segs.tr: ALHAMDO LILLAAHIL LAZEE LAYSA LAHU MONAA-ZE-U’N YO-A’ADELOHU
segs.ur: حمد ہے اس الله کی جس کا ہمسر نہیں جو اس سے جھگڑا کرے

segs.ar: وَلَا شَبِيْهٌ يُشٰاكِلُهٗ وَلَا ظَهِيْرٌ يُعٰاضِدُهٗ
segs.en: nor any resemblance  who can be similar to Him, nor any helper to assist Him,
segs.tr: WA LAA SHA-BEEHUN YOSHAAKELOHU WA LAA ZAHEERUN YO-A’AZEDOHU
segs.ur: نہ کوئی اس جیسا ہے کہ اس کا ہمشکل ہو، نہ کوئی اس کا مددگار و ہمکار ہے

segs.en: He subdues the powerful ones
segs.ur: وہ اپنی عزت میں سب عزت والوں پر غالب ہے

segs.en: while the great ones are humble before His Greatness.
segs.ur: اور سبھی عظمت والے اس کی عظمت کے آگے جھکتے ہیں

segs.en: So He attains by His power whatever He wills.
segs.ur: وہ جو چاہے اس پر قادر ہے

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىْ يُجِيْبُنِىْ حِيْنَ اُنَادِيْهِ
segs.en: All Praise is for Allah who answers when I call Him,
segs.tr: AL-HAMDO LILLAAHIL LAZEE YOJEEBONEE HEENA ONAADEEHE
segs.ur: حمد ہے اللہ کی جسے پکارتا ہوں تو وہ جواب دیتا ہے

segs.ar: وَيَسْتُرُ عَلَىَّ كُلَّ عَوْرَةٍ وَاَنَا اَعْصِيْهِ
segs.en: covers up all my defects while I disobey Him,
segs.tr: WA YASTORO A’LAYYA KULLA A’WRATIN WA ANAA A-A’SEEHE
segs.ur: اور میری ہر برائی کی پردہ پوشی کرتا ہے میں اسکی نافرمانی کرتا ہوں

segs.en: confers great bounties upon me but I do not give Him anything in return.
segs.tr: WA YO-A’ZZEMUN NE’MATA A’LAYYA FALAA OJAA-ZEEHE
segs.ur: تو بھی مجھے بڑی بڑی نعمتیں دیتا ہے کہ جن کا بدلہ میں اسے نہیں دیتا

segs.ar: فَكَمْ مِنْ مَوْهِبَةٍ هَنِيْئَةٍ قَدْ اَعْطَانِىْ
segs.en: Then how many nice favours He has granted on me,
segs.tr: FAKAM MIN MAWHEBATIN HANEE-ATIN QAD A-A’TAANEE
segs.ur: پس اس نے مجھ پر کتنی ہی خوشگوار عنایتیں اور بخششیں کی ہیں

segs.en: and great dangers from which He has saved me,
segs.ur: کتنی ہی خطرناک آفتوں سے مجھے بچالیا ہے

segs.en: and happy joys which He has availed to me,
segs.ur: کئی حیرت انگیز خوشیاں مجھے دکھائی ہیں

segs.en: then I praised Him as He should be praised and I remember Him as He should be glorified.
segs.tr: FA-USNEE A’LAYHE HAAMEDAN WA AZKOROHU MOSABBEHAN.
segs.ur: پس ان پر اس کی حمد و ثنا کرتا ہوں اور لگاتار اس کا نام لیتا ہوں

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىْ لَا يُهْتَكُ حِجَابُهٗ
segs.en: All Praise is for Allah whose veil cannot be torn,
segs.tr: ALHAMDO LILLAAHIL LAZEE LAA YOHTAKO HEJAABOHU
segs.ur: حمد ہے اللہ کی جس کا پردہ ہٹایا نہیں جاسکتا

segs.ar: وَلَا يُغْلَقُ بَابُهٗ وَلَا يُرَدُّ سَآئِلُهٗ
segs.en: nor His door locked nor the one who begs from Him be neglected
segs.tr: WA LAA YUGHLAQO BAABOHU WA LAA YORADDO SAA-ELOHU
segs.ur: اس کا در رحمت بند نہیں ہوتا، اس کا سائل خالی نہیں جاتا

segs.en: nor the one who hopes from Him despaired.
segs.ur: اور اس کا امیدوار مایوس نہیں ہوتا

segs.en: All praise is for Allah who protects the fearful ones
segs.ur: حمد ہے اللہ کی جو ڈرنے والوں کو پناہ دیتا ہے

segs.en: and saves the righteous,
segs.ur: نیکوکاروں کو نجات دیتا ہے

segs.en: raises the oppressed,
segs.ur: لوگوں کے دبائے ہوؤں کو ابھارتا ہے

segs.en: degrades the prouds,
segs.ur: بڑا بننے والوں کو نیچا دکھاتا ہے

segs.en: destroys the Kings and appoints other (in their place).
segs.ur: بادشاہوں کو تباہ کرتا اور ان کی جگہ دوسروں کو لے آتا ہے۔

segs.ar: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ قَاصِمِ الْجَبَّارِيْنَ مُبِيْرِ الظَّالِمِيْنَ
segs.en: All Prase is for Allah, the Breaker of the tyrants, the Destroyer of oppressors,
segs.tr: WAL HAMDO LILLAAHE QAASEMIL JABBAAREENA MOBEERIZ ZAALEMEENA
segs.ur: حمد ہے اللہ کی کہ وہ دھونسیوں کا زور توڑنے والا، ظالموں کو برباد کرنے والا

segs.en: the Overtaker of fugitives, Chastiser of the unjust,
segs.ur: بھاگنے والوں کو پا لینے والا، اور بے انصافوں کو سزا دینے والا ہے

segs.en: the Helper of the crying ones,
segs.ur: وہ دادخواہوں کا دادرس

segs.en: the Centre of the demands of beseechers,
segs.ur: حاجات طلب کرنے والوں کا ٹھکانہ

segs.en: the Confidence of the believers.
segs.ur: اور مومنوں کی ٹیک ہے

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىْ مِنْ خَشْيَتِهٖ تَرْعَدُ السَّمَآءُ وَسُكَّانُهَا
segs.en: All Praise is for Allah with Whose fear the heavens and its inhabitants shiver
segs.tr: ALHAMDO LILLAAHIL LAZEE MIN KHASYATEHI TAR-A’DUS SAMAA-O WA SUKKAANOHAA
segs.ur: حمد ہے اس اللہ کی جس کے خوف سے آسمان اور آسمان والے لرزتے ہیں

segs.en: and the earth and its dwellers tremble,
segs.ur: زمین اور اس کے آبادکار دہل جاتے ہیں

segs.ar: وَتَمُوْجُ الْبِحَارُ وَمَنْ يَسْبَحُ فِىْ غَمَرَاتِهَا
segs.en: the oceans and whatever float in its depths overflows (with awe).
segs.tr: WA TAMOOJUL BEHAARO WA MAN YASBAHO FEE GHAMARAATEHAA.
segs.ur: سمندر لرزتے ہیں اور وہ جو انکے پانیوں میں تیرتے ہیں

segs.en: All Praise is for Allah Who guided us to this (path).
segs.ur: حمد ہے اللہ کی جس نے ہمیں یہ راہ ہدایت دکھائی

segs.ar: وَمَا كُنَّا لِنَهْتَدِىَ لَوْلَا اَنْ هَدَانَا اللهُ
segs.en: And we could not have been guided had Allah not guided us.
segs.tr: WA MAA KUNNA LE-NAHTADEYA LAW LAA AN HADAANAL LAAHO.
segs.ur: اور ہم ہرگز ہدایت نہ پاسکتے اگر اللہ تعالیٰ ہمیں ہدایت نہ فرماتا

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِى يَخْلُقُ وَلَمْ يُخْلَقُ
segs.en: All Praise is for Allah, the One Who creates but is not created,
segs.tr: ALHAMDO LILLAAHIL LAZEE YAKHLOQO WA LAM YUKHLAQ
segs.ur: حمد ہے اس اللہ کی جو خلق کرتا ہے اور وہ مخلوق نہیں

segs.ar: وَيَرْزُقُ وَلَا يُرْزَقُ وَيُطْعِمُ وَلَا يُطْعَمُ
segs.en: He sustains but is not sustained, He feeds but is not fed,
segs.tr: WA YARZOQO WA LAA YURZAQO WA YUT-E’MO WA LAA YUT-A’MO
segs.ur: وہ رزق دیتا ہے اور وہ مرزوق نہیں، وہ کھانا کھلاتا ہے اور کھاتا نہیں

segs.en: He causes death to the living and gives life to the dead.
segs.tr: WA YOMEETUL AHYAAHO WA YOHYIL MAWTAA
segs.ur: وہ زندوں کو مارتا ہے اور مردوں کو زندہ کرتا ہے

segs.en: He is the Living Who shall never die.
segs.ur: وہ ایسا زندہ ہے جسے موت نہیں

segs.ar: بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
segs.en: In His hands is all the goodness, and He has Power over all things.
segs.tr: BE-YADEHIL KHAYRO WA HOWA A’LAA KULLE SHAY-IN QADEERUN.
segs.ur: بھلائی اسی کے ہاتھ میں ہے اور وہ ہرچیز پر قدرت رکھتا ہے

segs.en: O Allah send Your blessings on Mohammad
segs.ur: اے معبود! حضرت محمد پر اپنی رحمت نازل فرما

segs.en: Your servant, Your messenger, Your trustworthy and Your selected,
segs.tr: A’BDEKA WA RASOOLEKA WA AMEENEKA WA SAFIYYEKA
segs.ur: جو تیرے بندے تیرے رسول تیرے امانتدار تیرے برگزیدہ

segs.en: Your beloved, Your chosen one from Your creatures,
segs.tr: WA HABEEBEKA WA KHEYARATEKA MIN KHALQEKA
segs.ur: تیرے حبیب اور تیری مخلوق میں سے تیرے پسندیدہ ہیں

segs.en: the protector of Your secrets, the conveyor of Your message,
segs.tr: WA HAAFEZE SIRREKA WA MOBALLEGHE RESAALAATEKA
segs.ur: تیرے راز کے پاسدار ہیں اور تیرے پیغاموں کے پہنچانے والے ہیں

segs.ar: اَفْضَلَ وَاَحْسَنَ وَاَجْمَلَ وَاَكْمَلَ وَاَزْكٰى وَاَنْمٰى
segs.en: the most superior, the best, the most handsome, the most perfect, the most purified, the evergrowing,
segs.tr: AFZALA WA AHSANA WA AJMALA WA AKMALA WA AZKAA WA ANMAA
segs.ur: ان پر رحمت کر بہترین نیکوترین زیباترین کامل ترین روئیدہ ترین پاکیزہ ترین

segs.en: the most sublime, the most purified, the noblest
segs.tr: WA ATYABA WA ATHARA WA ASNAA
segs.ur: عمدہ ترین شفاف ترین روشن ترین

segs.en: and the maximum of blessing the like of which You have not blessed,
segs.tr: WA AKSARA MAA SALLAYTA WA BAARAKTA WA TARAH-HAMTA
segs.ur: اور تو نے جو بہت رحمت کی برکت دی نوازش کی

segs.ar: وَتَحَنَّنْتَ وَسَلَّمْتَ عَلٰى اَحَدٍ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
segs.en: You blessed, had mercy, affections, salutations, on anyone from Your servants,
segs.tr: WA TAHANNANTA WA SALLAMTA A’LAA AHADIN MIN E’BAADEKA
segs.ur: مہربانی کی اور درود بھیجا اپنے بندوں میں سے کسی ایک پر

segs.en: Your prophets, Your messengers, Your chosen ones
segs.tr: WA AMBEYAA-EKA WA ROSOLEKA WA SIFWATEKA
segs.ur: اپنے نبیوں اپنے رسولوں اور اپنے برگزیدوں میں سے

segs.en: and the honoured ones from among Your creatures.
segs.tr: WA AHLIL KARAAMATE A’LAYKA MIN KHALQEKA.
segs.ur: اور جو تیرے ہاں بزرگی والے ہیں تیری مخلوق میں سے

segs.en: O Allah send blessings upon Ali, the Chief of the faithfuls,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WA SALLE A’LAA A’LIYYIN AMEERIL MOA-MENEENA
segs.ur: اے معبود! امیرالمومنین(ع) پر رحمت فرما

segs.en: the successor to the Messenger of the Lord of the universe,
segs.ur: جو جہانوں کے پروردگار کے رسول کے وصی ہیں

segs.en: Your servant, Your beloved representative, brother of Your Messenger
segs.tr: A’BDEKA WA WALIYYEKA WA AKHEE RASOOLEKA
segs.ur: تیرے بندے تیرے ولی تیرے رسول کے بھائی

segs.en: and Your Proof upon Your creatures.
segs.ur: تیری مخلوق پر تیری حجت

segs.en: Your greatest sign, Your important news.
segs.ur: تیری بہت بڑی نشانی اور نبأ عظیم ہیں

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى الصِّدِّيْقَةِ الطَّاهِرَةِ فَاطِمَةَ سَيِّدَةِ نِسَآءِ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
segs.en: And (O Allah) send blessings upon the truthful, the pure Fatemah, the leader of the women of the universe,
segs.tr: WA SALLE A’LAS SIDDEEQATIT TAAHERATE FAATEMATA SAYYEDATE NESAA-IL A’ALAMEENA
segs.ur: اور صدیقہ طاہرہ فاطمہ (سلام اللہ علیھا) پر رحمت فرما جو تمام جہانوں کی عورتوں کی سردار ہیں

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سِبْطَىِ الرَّحْمَةِ وَاِمَامَىِ الْهُدٰى اَلْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ
segs.en: and (O Allah) send blessing upon the two grandsons of the mercy, and the two Imams of guidance, Hasan and Husain,
segs.tr: WA SALLE A’LAA SIBTAYIR RAHMATE WA EMAAMAYIL HODAL HASANE WAL HUSAYNE
segs.ur: اور نبی رحمت کے دو نواسوں اور ہدایت والے دو ائمہ(ع) حسن(ع) و حسین(ع) پر رحمت فرما

segs.en: the two leaders of the Youths of the Paradise
segs.ur: جو جنت کے جوانوں کے سید و سردار ہیں۔

segs.en: and (O Allah) send blessings upon the Imams of Muslims,
segs.ur: اور مسلمانوں کے ائمہ(ع) پر رحمت فرما کہ وہ

segs.en: Ali the son of Husain,
segs.ur: علی زین العابدین(ع)

segs.ar: وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِىٍّ وَجَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: Mohammad, the son of Ali, Ja’far, the son of Mohammad;
segs.tr: WA MOHAMMAD IBNE A’LIYYIN WA JA’FAR IBNE MOHAMMADIN
segs.ur: محمد الباقر(ع)، جعفر الصادق(ع)

segs.ar: وَمُوْسٰى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ وَعَلِىِّ بْنِ مُوْسٰى
segs.en: Moosa, the son of Jafar; Ali, the son of Moosa;
segs.tr: WA MOOSABNE JA’FARIN WA A’LIYY IBNE MOOSAA
segs.ur: موسیٰ الکاظم(ع)، علی الرضا(ع)

segs.ar: وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِىٍّ وعَلِىِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: Mohammad, the son of Ali; Ali, the son of Mohammad;
segs.tr: WA MOHAMMAD IBNE A’LIYYIN WA A’LIYY IBNE MOHAMMADIN
segs.ur: محمد تقی الجواد(ع)، علی نقی الہادی(ع)

segs.ar: وَالْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِىٍّ وَالْخَلَفِ الْهَادِى الْمَهْدِىِّ
segs.en: Hasan, the son of Ali; and the successor, the Guide, Mahdi
segs.tr: WAL HASAN IBNE A’LIYYIN WAL KHALAFIL HAADIL MAHDIYYE
segs.ur: حسن العسکری(ع) اور بہترین سپوت ہادی المہدی(ع) ہیں

segs.ar: حُجَجِكَ عَلٰى عِبَادِكَ وَاُمَنَآئِكَ فِىْ بِلاَدِكَ
segs.en: Your Proof upon Your servants and Your trustworthy one in Your cities.
segs.tr: HOJAJEKA A’LAA E’BAADEKA WA OMANAA-EKA FEE BELAADEKA
segs.ur: جو تیرے بندوں پر تیری حجتیں اور تیرے شہروں میں تیرے امین ہیں

segs.en: Blessings, Abundant and permanent.
segs.ur: ان پر رحمت فرما بہت بہت ہمیشہ ہمیشہ

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى وَلِىِّ اَمْرِكَ الْقَآئِمِ الْمُؤَمَّلِ
segs.en: O Allah and send blessings upon the master of Your command, the Qaem (Upright), the expected one
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WA SALLE A’LAA WALIYYE AMREKAL QAA-EMIL MO-AMMALE
segs.ur: اے معبود اپنے ولی امر پر رحمت فرما کہ جو قائم امیدگاہ

segs.en: and the awaited justice,
segs.ur: عادل اور منتظر ہے

segs.en: surround him with Your prominent Angels
segs.ur: اسکے گرد اپنے مقرب فرشتوں کا گھیرا لگادے

segs.ar: وَاَيِّدْهُ بِرُوْحِ الْقُدُسِ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
segs.en: and support him with ‘Ruh al-Qudus’ (the Holy Spirit), O Lord of the universe
segs.tr: WA AYYIDHO BE-ROOHIL QODOSE YAA RABBAL A’ALAMEENA.
segs.ur: اور روح القدس کے ذریعے اسکی تائید فرما اے جہانوں کے پروردگار

segs.en: O Allah make him the caller to Your Book
segs.ur: اے معبود! اسے اپنی کتاب کی طرف دعوت دینے والا قرار دے

segs.en: and the Qaem (upright one) with Your religion,
segs.ur: اور اپنے دین کیلئے قائم

segs.ar: اسْتَخْلِفْهُ فِى الْاَرْضِ كَمَا اسْتَخْلَفْتَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهٖ
segs.en: appoint him in the earth, as You appointed Those before him.
segs.tr: ISTAKHLIFHO FIL ARZE KAMAS TAKHLAFTAL LAZEENA MIN QABLEHI
segs.ur: اسے زمین میں اپنا خلیفہ بنا جیسے ان کو خلیفہ بنایا جو اس سے پہلے ہو گزرے ہیں

segs.ar: مَكِّنْ لَهٗ دِيْنَهُ الَّذِىْ ارْتَضَيْتَهٗ لَهٗ
segs.en: Grant authority for him concerning his religion which You have chosen for him.
segs.tr: MAKKIN LAHU DEENAHUL LAZEER TAZAYTAHU LAHU
segs.ur: اپنے پسندیدہ دین کو اس کیلئے پائیدار بنادے

segs.en: Convert his fear into security
segs.ur: اسکے خوف کے بعد اسے امن دے

segs.en: as He worships only You and does not associate anyone with You,
segs.ur: کہ وہ تیرا عبادت گزار ہے کسی کو تیرا شریک نہیں بناتا۔

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَعِزَّهُ وَاَعْزِزْ بِهٖ وَانْصُرْهُ وانْتَصِرْ بِهٖ
segs.en: O Allah strengthen him and strengthen (the believer) through him.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA A-I’ZZAHU WA A-A’ZIZ BEHI WAN SURHO WAN TASIR BEHI
segs.ur: اے معبود! اسے معزز فرما اور اس کے ذریعے مجھے عزت دے، اسکی مدد کر اور اس کے ذریعے میری مدد فرما

segs.ar: وَانْصُرْهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيْزًا وَافْتَحْ لَهٗ فَتْحًا يَسِيْرًا
segs.en: Help him and help the believer through him, and help him a mighty helping and grant him an easy victory.
segs.tr: WAN SURHO NASRAN A’ZEEZAN WAF TAH LAHU FATHAN YASEERAN
segs.ur: اسے باعزت مدد دے اور اسے آسانی کے ساتھ فتح دے

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ لَهٗ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطَانًا نَصِيْرًا
segs.en: And make him from Your side the helped authority.
segs.tr: WAJ A’L LAHU MIN LADUNKA SULTAANAN NASEERAN.
segs.ur: اور اسے اپنی طرف سے قوت والا مددگار عطا فرما

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَظْهِرْ بِهٖ دِيْنَكَ وَسُنَّتَ نَبِيِّكَ
segs.en: O Allah, through him make Your religion and the Sunnah of Your Prophet prevail,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA AZHIR BEHI DEENAKA WA SUNNATA NABIYYEKA
segs.ur: اے معبود! اس کے ذریعے اپنے دین اور اپنے نبی کی سنت کو ظاہر فرما

segs.ar: حَتّٰى لَا يَسْتَخْفِىَ بِشَىْءٍ مِنَ الْحَقِّ مَخَافَةَ اَحَدٍ مِنَ الْخَلْقِ
segs.en: till, nothing is hidden from the Truth due to fear of the creatures
segs.tr: HATTAA LAA YASTAKHFEYA BE-SHAY-IN MENAL HAQQE MAKHAAFATA AHADIN MENAL KHALQE.
segs.ur: یہاں تک کہ حق میں سے کوئی چیز مخلوق کے خوف سے مخفی و پوشیدہ نہ رہ جائے

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّا نَرْغَبُ اِلَيْكَ فِى دَوْلَةٍ كَرِيْمَةٍ
segs.en: O Allah! We desire from You a noble Government
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNAA NARGHABO ELAYKA FEE DAWLATIN KAREEMATIN
segs.ur: اے معبود! ہم ایسی برکت والی حکومت کی خاطر تیری طرف رغبت رکھتے ہیں

segs.en: through which You help Islam and its followers
segs.ur: جس سے تو اسلام و اہل اسلام کو قوت دے

segs.en: and degrade hypocrisy and its followers
segs.tr: WA TOZILLO BEHAN NEFAA-QA WA AHLAHU
segs.ur: اور نفاق و اہل نفاق کو ذلیل کرے

segs.ar: وَتَجْعَلُنَا فِيْهَا مِنَ الدُّعَاةِ اِلٰى طَاعَتِكَ
segs.en: and make us in (the government) among the callers to Your obedience
segs.tr: WA TAJ-A’LONAA FEEHAA MENAD DO-A’ATE ELAA TAA-A’TEKA
segs.ur: اور اس حکومت میں ہمیں اپنی اطاعت کیطرف بلانے والے قرار دے

segs.ar: وَالْقَادَةِ اِلٰى سَبِيْلِكَ وَتَرْزُقُنَا بِهَا كَرَامَةَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
segs.en: and guides to Your path and through it grant us the honour of this world and hereafter.
segs.tr: WAL QAADATE ELAA SABEELEKA WA TARZOQONAA BEHAA KARAAMATAD DUNYAA WAL AAKHERATE.
segs.ur: اور اپنے راستے کیطرف رہنمائی کرنے والے قرار دے اور اس کے ذریعے ہمیں دنیا و آخرت کی عزت دے

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ مَا عَرَّفْتَنَا مِنَ الْحَقِّ فَحَمِّلْنَاهُ
segs.en: O Allah whatever You have introduced to us from the truth then make us bear it
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA MAA A’RRAFTANAA MENAL HAQQE FAHAMMILNAAHO
segs.ur: اے معبود! جس حق کی تو نے ہمیں معرفت کرائی اسکے تحمل کی توفیق دے

segs.en: and reach unto us what we have fallen short of (performing)
segs.ur: اور جس سے ہم قاصر رہے اس تک پہنچادے

segs.en: O Allah! Through him, congregate our dispersed ones,
segs.ur: اے معبود اسکے ذریعے ہم بکھروں کو جمع کردے

segs.en: and collect our scattered ones,
segs.ur: اسکے ذریعے ہمارے جھگڑے ختم کر

segs.ar: وَارْتُقْ بِهٖ فَتْقَنَا وَكَثِّرْ بِهٖ قِلَّتَنَا
segs.en: and unite our disunited ones. Increase our scantiness through him,
segs.tr: WAR-TUQ BEHI FATQANAA WA KASSIR BEHI QILLATANAA
segs.ur: اور ہماری پریشانی دور فرما، اسکے ذریعے ہماری قلت کو کثرت میں بدل دے

segs.ar: وَاَعْزِزْ بِهٖ ذِلَّتَنَا وَاَغْنِ بِهٖ عَائِلَنَا
segs.en: grant respect to our disgraced ones through him. Make our poor rich through him.
segs.tr: WA A-A’ZIZ BEHI ZILLATANAA WA AGHNE BEHI A’A-ELANAA
segs.ur: اور ذلت کو عزت میں بدل دے، اسکے ذریعے ہمیں نادار سے تونگر بنا

segs.en: And pay our debts through him.
segs.ur: اور ہمارے قرض ادا کر دے

segs.ar: وَاجْبُرْ بِهٖ فَقْرَنَا وَسُدَّ بِهٖ خَلَّتَنَا
segs.en: Remove our poverty through him. Dispel our adversities through him.
segs.tr: WAJ BUR BEHI FAQRANAA WA SUDDA BEHI KHALLATANAA
segs.ur: اسکے ذریعے ہمارا فقر دور فرما دے، ہماری حاجتیں پوری کر دے

segs.ar: وَيَسِّرْ بِهٖ عُسْرَنَا وَبَيِّضْ بِهٖ وُجُوْهَنَا
segs.en: Make our difficulties easy through him. Brighten our faces through him.
segs.tr: WA YASSIR BEHI U’SRANAA WA BAYYIZ BEHI WOJOOHANAA
segs.ur: اور تنگی کو آسانی میں بدل دے، اس کے ذریعے ہمارے چہرے روشن کر

segs.ar: وَفُكَّ بِهٖ اَسْرَنَا وَاَنْجِحْ بِهٖ طَلِبَتَنَا
segs.en: Free our captives through him. Fulfill our demands through him.
segs.tr: WA FUKKA BEHI ASRANAA WA ANJEH BEHI TALEBATANAA
segs.ur: اور ہمارے قیدیوں کو رہائی دے، اسکے ذریعے ہماری حاجات بر لا

segs.en: Fulfill our promises through him.
segs.ur: اور ہمارے وعدے نبھا دے

segs.en: Answer our prayers through him.
segs.ur: اسکے ذریعے ہماری دعائیں قبول فرما

segs.en: Grant our requests through him.
segs.ur: اور ہمارے سوال پورے کر دے

segs.ar: وَبَلِّغْنَا بِهٖ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ آمَالَنَا
segs.en: Fulfill our hopes of this world and the hereafter through him.
segs.tr: WA BALLIGHNAA BEHI MENAD DUNYAA WAL AAKHERATE AAMAALANAA
segs.ur: اس کے ذریعے دنیا و آخرت میں ہماری امیدیں پوری فرما

segs.en: And provide us more than our expectations.
segs.ur: اور ہمیں ہماری درخواست سے زیادہ عطا کر

segs.en: O the Best of the asked one
segs.ur: اے سوال کئے جانے والوں میں بہترین

segs.en: and the Largest of Provider. Cure our hearts through him
segs.tr: WA AWSA-A’L MO’TEENA ISHFE BEHI SODOORANAA
segs.ur: اور اے سب سے زیادہ عطا کرنے والے، اس کے ذریعے ہمارے سینوں کو شفا دے

segs.en: and remove the anger of our hearts through him.
segs.ur: اور ہمارے دلوں سے بغض و کینہ مٹا دے

segs.ar: وَاهْدِنَا بِهٖ لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيْهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِاِذْنِكَ
segs.en: And guide us in dispute concerning the truth through him with Your permission.
segs.tr: WAH DENAA BEHI LEMAKH TOLEFA FEEHE MENAL HAQQE BE-IZNEKA
segs.ur: جس حق میں ہمارا اختلاف ہے اپنے حکم سے اس کے ذریعے ہمیں ہدایت فرما

segs.ar: اِنَّكَ تَهْدِىْ مَنْ تَشَآءُ اِلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيْمٍ
segs.en: You guide to whomever You Wish to the right path.
segs.tr: INNAKA TAHDEE MAN TASHAA-O ELAA SERAATIL MUSTAQEEME
segs.ur: بے شک تو جسے چاہتا ہے سیدھے راستے کی طرف لے جاتا ہے

segs.en: And help us through him against Your enemies and Our enemies,
segs.tr: WAN SURNAA BEHI A’LAA A’DUWWEKA WA A’DUWWENAA
segs.ur: اس کے ذریعے اپنے اور ہمارے دشمن پر ہمیں غلبہ عطا فرما

segs.en: O Lord of Truths, Ameen.
segs.ur: اے سچے خدا ایسا ہی ہو۔

segs.en: O Allah, we complain to You,
segs.ur: اے معبود! ہم تجھ سے شکایت کرتے ہیں

segs.en: the loss of our prophet, Your blessing be upon him and his progeny
segs.tr: FAQDA NABIYYENAA SALAWAATOKA A’LAYHE WA AALEHI
segs.ur: اپنے نبی کے اٹھ جانے کی کہ ان پر اور ان کی آل(ع) پر تیری رحمت ہو

segs.en: and the occultation of our master, the proliferate of our enemies,
segs.tr: WA GHAYBATA WALIYYENAA WA KASRATA A’DUWWENAA
segs.ur: اور اپنے ولی کی پوشیدگی کی اور دشمنوں کی کثرت کی

segs.en: the scarcity of our numbers, the severity of mischief amongst us,
segs.tr: WA QILLATA A’DADENAA WA SHIDDATAL FETANE BENAA
segs.ur: اور اپنی قلت تعداد اور فتنوں کی سختی کی

segs.en: oppositions of the time against us.
segs.ur: اور حوادث زمانہ کی یلغار کی شکایت کرتے ہیں

segs.en: Send blessings upon Mohammad and his progeny and help us
segs.ur: پس محمد اور ان کی آل(ع) پر رحمت فرما

segs.ar: وَاَعِنَّا عَلٰى ذٰلِكَ بِفَتْحٍ مِنْكَ تُعَجِّلُهٗ
segs.en: in all these, with a hastened victory from Your side.
segs.tr: WA A-I’NNA A’LAA ZAALEKA BE-FATHIN MINKA TO-A’JJELOHU
segs.ur: اور ہماری مدد فرما ان پر فتح کے ساتھ اور اس میں جلدی کر کے

segs.en: And by the removal of difficulties and a mighty helping,
segs.tr: WA BEZURRIN TAK-SHEFOHU WA NASRIN TO-I’ZZOHU
segs.ur: تکلیف دور کردے، نصرت سے عزت عطا کر

segs.en: and a truthful king whom You manifest
segs.ur: حق کے غلبے کا اظہار فرما

segs.en: and mercy from You with which You envelop us
segs.ur: ایسی رحمت فرما جو ہم پر سایہ کرے

segs.en: and cover us with Your safety
segs.ur: اور امن عطا کر جو ہمیں محفوظ بنا دے

segs.en: through Your Mercy, O the Most Merciful of mercifuls.
segs.ur: اپنی رحمت سے اے سب سے زیادہ رحم کرنے والے۔

A_AA10.merits:
The word Iftetah is used in the Urdu language and its literal meaning is “to start” or “to commence.” It is for this reason that Surah Hamd is called “Fatehatul Kitab” or ‘the surah which starts the Quran”. Therefore our scholars recommend that after sighting the moon of the holy month of Ramazan, one should commence the recitation of the Quran with the recitation of Surah Hamd and commence the sequence of supplications with this dua.
Dua Iftetah is narrated by Shaikh Abbas Qummi in Mafatihul Jinaan from Hazrat Imam-e-Zamana (a.t.f.s.) and is amongst those duas which are recommended for recitation every night. In reality, a glance at the meanings of the words of this dua makes us feel that it is a rendition of our heartfelt entreaties. The characteristics found in those duas which are narrated by the Holy Imams (a.s.), are present in this dua as well, which is an added proof that this dua is narrated by Hazrat Imam-e-Zamana (a.t.f.s.) himself and not from an ordinary individual. These characteristics include:
1.	The praise and glorification of Allah in the words of the Holy Imams (a.s.)
2.	Acknowledgement of the bounties of Allah and His covering of our sins
3.	Seeking forgiveness for our sins and requesting for bounties from Allah
4.	Seeking blessings and benedictions upon the Ahle Bayt (a.s.)
Dua Iftetah, in addtion to the above features, encompasses these aspects:
It seeks salutations and blessing upon the Holy Imams (a.s.) in the nights of Mah-e-Ramazan. This act itself is the key for the acceptance of supplications. It is also the best way to seek the duas of the Imams (a.s.) for our needs.
A special part of this dua is dedicated to supplications for Hazrat Imam Mahdi (a.s.) – supplication for his health and well being; supplication for his respect; supplication for our own safety and the protection of our respect for his sake as well as supplications for his early reappearance. It also seeks a pure and long government and wealth for him; the elevation of the flag of Islam and the end of all forms of polytheism and hypocrisy. In addition to this, the sentences of this dua seek help for repayment of debts, for expansion of sustenance and alleviation of all difficulties and worries.
The last part of the dua is expressed as a plea before Allah, the Almighty in which we convey our love for Ahle Bayt (a.s.) right from Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) up to Imam Mahdi (a.s.). In addition, the true meaning of Iftetah, which is victory or good start is shown to be the time of reappearance of Imam-e-Zamana (a.t.f.s.). These expressions of the dua are given below –
“O Allah! We complain to You, the loss of our prophet, Your blessings be upon him and his progeny and the occulation of our master, the proliferate of our enemies, the scarcity of our numbers, the severity of mischief upon us, oppositions of the time against us. Send blessings upon Mohammed (s.a.w.a.) and his progeny. And help us in all these, with a hastened victory from Your side. And by the removal of difficulties and a mighty helping, and a truthful king whom You manifest and mercy from Your side which You make us respect and cover with Your safety through Your Mercy, O the Most Merciful of mercifuls.”
Therefore, we request all believers that from the eve of the Holy month of Ramazan till its last night, one should not forsake the recitation of this dua for even a single night. In order that one receives an increased reward for this action, one should make an intention from the first night itself to recite this dua on behalf of Imam-e-Zamana (a.t.f.s.) and offer the reward of this recitation to Hazrat Zahra (s.a.). Inshallah, with this action, he will recieve the tawfeeq to recite the dua in the right spirit.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ بَهَائِكَ بِأَبْهَاهُ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to give me from Your brilliance at its most splendrous,
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka min baha'ika bi-abhahu

segs.en: and all Your glories are radiantly brilliant.
O Allah, I beseech You in the name of all Your glories.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ جَمَالِكَ بِأَجْمَلِهِ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to grant me from Your beauty at its utmost ,
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka min jamalika bi-ajmalihi

segs.en: and all Your beauties are beautiful.
O Allah, I beseech You by all Your beauties.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ جَلالِكَ بِأَجَلِّهِ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to give me from Your majesty that gives grandeur,
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka min jalalika bi-ajallihi

segs.en: and all Your majestic powers are majestic.
O Allah, I beseech You in the name of all Your majesty.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ عَظَمَتِكَ بِأَعْظَمِهَا
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to give me from Your greatness at its greatest,
and all Your greatness are great.
O Allah, I beseech You in the name of all Your greatness.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ نُورِكَ بِأَنْوَرِهِ
segs.en: O Allah, I beseech You to give me from Your light at its utmost luminosity,
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka min nurika bi-anwarihi

segs.en: and all Your Light is luminious.
O Allah, I beseech You by all Your Light.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ بِأَوْسَعِهَا
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to give me from Your mercy at its utmost inclusiveness,
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka min rahmatika bi-awsa`iha

segs.en: and all Your mercy is inclusive.
O Allah, I beseech You by all your mercy.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ كَلِمَاتِكَ بِأَتَمِّهَا
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to give me from Your Words at their utmost completeness,
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka min kalimatika bi-atammiha

segs.en: and all Your words are complete
O Allah, I beseech You by all Your Words.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ كَمَالِكَ بِأَكْمَلِهِ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to give me from Your perfections at their utmost perfectness
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka min kamalika bi-akmalihi

segs.en: and all Your perfections are perfect.
O Allah, I beseech You by all Your perfections.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ أَسْمَائِكَ بِأَكْبَرِهَا
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to give me from Your Names the greatest of them ,
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka min asma'ika bi-akbariha

segs.en: and all Your Names are great.
O Allah, I beseech You by all Your Names.

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ عِزَّتِكَ بِأَعَزِّهَا
segs.en: O Allah, I beseech You to give me from Your might at its mightiest,
and all Your might is mighty.
O Allah, I beseech You by all your might.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ مَشِيئَتِكَ بِأَمْضَاهَا
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to give me from Your Will at its utmost effectualness
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka min mashi'atika bi-amdaha

segs.en: and all Your willing is effectual.
O Allah, I beseech You by all Your Will.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ قُدْرَتِكَ بِٱلْقُدْرَةِ ٱلَّتِي ٱسْتَطَلْتَ بِهَا عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to give me from Your that omnipotence which controls everything,
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka min qudratika bilqudrati allati istatalta biha `ala kulli shay'in

segs.en: and all your powers are prevailing.
O Allah, I beseech You by all Your omnipotence.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ عِلْمِكَ بِأَنْفَذِهِ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to give me from Your knoweledge at its utmost pervasiveness,
and all Your knowledge is pervasive.
O Allah, I beseech You all by Your knowledge.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ قَوْلِكَ بِأَرْضَاهُ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You grant me from Your most admirable of sayings,
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka min qawlika bi-ardahu

segs.en: and all Your sayings are admirable.
O Allah, I beseech You by all Your sayings.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ مَسَائِلِكَ بِأَحَبِّهَا إِلَيْكَ
segs.en: O Allah, I beseech You to grant me from the most cherished of requests made to You
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka min masa'ilika bi-ahabbiha ilayka

segs.en: and all requests made to you are cherished.
O Allah, I beseech You by all requests made to You.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ شَرَفِكَ بِأَشْرَفِهِ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to give me from Your dignity at its noblest,
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka min sharafika bi-ashrafihi

segs.en: and all Your dignity is noble.
O Allah, I beseech You by all Your dignity.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ سُلْطَانِكَ بِأَدْوَمِهِ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to grant me from Your most enduring authority,
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka min sultanika bi-adwamihi

segs.en: and all Your authority is enduring.
O Allah, I beseech You by all Your authority.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ مُلْكِكَ بِأَفْخَرِهِ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to grant me from Your kingdom at its utmost magnificence,
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka min mulkika bi-afkharihi

segs.en: and all Your kingdom is magnificent.
O Allah, I beseech You by Your entire kingdom.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ عُلُوِّكَ بِأَعْلاهُ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to grant me from Your highness at its utmost sublimity
and all Your eminence is sublime.
O Allah, I beseech You by all Your highness.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ مَنِّكَ بِأَقْدَمِهِ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to grant me from Your earliest of favours,
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka min mannika bi-aqdamihi

segs.en: and all Your bounties are pre eternal.
O Allah, I beseech You by all Your bounties.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ آيَاتِكَ بِأَكْرَمِهَا
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to grant me noblest of Your signs which gives out freely,
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka min ayatika bi-akramiha

segs.en: and all Your signs are noble.
O Allah, I beseech You by of all Your signs.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا أَنْتَ فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلشَّأْنِ وَٱلْجَبَرُوتِ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to give me whereby You exercises absolute authority and power,
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka bima anta fihi min alshsha'ni waljabaruti

segs.ar: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ شَأْنٍ وَحْدَهُ وَجَبَرُوتٍ وَحْدَهَا
segs.en: I beseech You by the works that engage You and Your prepotency, by every single work and every single prepotency.
segs.tr: wa as'aluka bikulli sha'nin wahdahu wa jabarutin wahdaha

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا تُجِيبُنِي بِهِ حِينَ أَسْأَلُكَ فَأَجِبْنِي يَا اللَّهُ
segs.en: O Allah, I beseech You by that whereby You will answer my supplication So answer me, O Allah!
segs.tr: allahumma inni as'aluka bima tujibuni bihi hina as'aluka fa-ajibni ya allahu

A_AA12.name: Dua Abu Hamza Thumali

segs.note: In the last hour of the nights of Ramazan, recite:
segs.ur: ماہ رمضان کی راتوں کی آخری ساعت میں پڑھیں:

segs.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful
O Allah, do not discipline me through Your Punishment,
and do not scheme against me with Your schemes,

segs.ar: مِنْ اَیْنَ لِیَ الْخَیْرُ یَا رَبِّ
segs.en: How can I attain goodness, O Lord,
while it is not found except with You
And from where will my salvation come?
while it can only be attained through You?

segs.ar: لَا الَّذِیْ اَحْسَنَ اسْتَغْنٰی عَنْ عَوْنِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ
segs.en: Neither he who has done righteous deeds is needless of Your aid and mercy

segs.ar: وَلَا الَّذِی اَسَآءَ وَاجْتَرَءَ عَلَیْكَ وَلَمْ یُرْضِكَ خَرَجَ عَنْ قُدْرَتِكَ
segs.en: nor can the one who has sinned and shown daring against you, and did not please You,  escape from the scope of Your Power.

segs.ar: یَا رَبِّ یَا رَبِّ یَا رَبِّ…
segs.en: O Lord, O Lord, O Lord......

segs.note: Repeat this phrase as many times as possible in one breath.
segs.ur: اس جملے کو ایک ہی سانس میں جتنا ممکن ہو دہرائیں۔

segs.en: Through You have I known You
And You guided me to You and called me towards You

segs.ar: وَلَوْ لَا اَنْتَ لَمْ اَدْرِمَا اَنْتَ
segs.en: If it were not for You, I would not have known what You are
All praise is due to Allah, upon whom I call, and He responds to me,
Even though I am slow (in responding) when He calls on me.
All praise is due to Allah, whom I ask, and He gives me,
Even though I am stingy when He asks me (to give for the sake of God)

segs.ar: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِیْ اُنَادِیْهِ كُلَّمَا شِئْتُ لِحَاجَتِیْ
segs.en: All praise is due to Allah, upon whom I call for my needs whenever I wish,

segs.ar: وَاَخْلُوْ بِهٖ حَیْثُ شِئْتُ لِسِرِّیْ بِغَیْرِ شَفِیْعٍ
segs.en: And with whom I converse in confidence whenever I want, without any intercessor,
And He grants my need.

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِیْ لَا اَدْعُوْ غَیْرَهٗ
segs.en: All praise is due to Allah- I do not call on other than He,

segs.ar: وَلَوْ دَعَوْتُ غَیْرَهٗ لَمْ یَسْتَجِبْ لِیْ دُعَآئِیْ
segs.en: and if I called on other than He, they would not answer my prayers.

segs.ar: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِیْ لَا اَرْجُوْ غَیْرَهٗ
segs.en: All praise is due to Allah - I do not hope in other than He,
and if I did hope in other than He, they would disappoint me.

segs.ar: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِیْ وَكَلَنِیْ اِلَیْهِ فَاَكْرَمَنِیْ
segs.en: All praise is due to Allah, who entrusted me to Himself, and thus honoured me,
And did not entrust me to people so that they would belittle me.

segs.ar: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِیْ تَحَبَّبَ اِلَیَّ وَهُوَ غَنِیٌّ عَنِّیْ
segs.en: All praise be to Allah alone Who endears Himself to me, while He is Needless of me.
All praise is due to Allah, who is forbearing with me,
To the extent that it is as if I have no sins.
Accordingly, my Lord is the only One Whom I should thank,
and He is the worthiest of being praised by me.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَجِدُ سُبُلَ الْمَطَالِبِ اِلَیْكَ مُشْرَعَۃً
segs.en: O Allah, I find paths towards asking You are set out,
And the springs of hope in You are overflowing,
And seeking help through Your Beneficence for those who hope in You is open to everyone,
and the doors of praying to You are open for those crying out for help.
I know that You are ever-responsive to those who hope in You,
and ever on the look-out to rescue those who are yearning (for You)
and in desiring Your Generosity,
and being pleased with Your decree,
There is good compensation in lieu of what the stingy withhold
and alternative to that which is in the hands of  monopolists
(My Lord), the one travelling towards has only a short distance (to traverse)
And You do not conceal Yourself from Your creation,
unless their deeds veil them from You.
I have turned towards You with my request,
And directed myself towards You with my need,
I have made my plea for help only to You,
And (made my only) means praying to You,
although I do not deserve to be heard by You,
And have no reason for You to forgive me,
But (I have turned to You) because of my confidence in Your Magnanimity,
Seeking refuge in the Truth of Your Promise
And  shelter in my faith in Your Oneness
and my certainty that You know about me
that I have no lord other than You
and no god other than You,
Unique, without any partner,
O Allah, It is You Who have said, and Your statements are Truth,
and Your promise is always true,
“Ask Allah of His bounty.
Surely Allah is ever Merciful to you.”
It is not among Your traits, my Master,
that You command (us) to ask, but then withhold from giving,

segs.ar: وَاَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بِالْعَطِیَّاتِ عَلٰی اَهْلِ مَمْلَكَتِكَ
segs.en: while You are The Benefactor Who confers blessings upon the inhabitants of His Dominion.
and constantly turns them with His Kindness and Compassion

segs.ar: اِلٰهی رَبَّیْتَنِیْ فِیْ نِعَمِكَ وَاِحْسَانِكَ صَغِیْرًا
segs.en: O my Allah, You brought me up amid Your bounties and favours when I was little
and made my name known when I was grown.

segs.ar: فَیَا مَنْ رَبَّانِیْ فِی الدُّنْیَا بِاِحْسَانِهٖ وَتَفَضُّلِهٖ وَنِعَمِهٖ
segs.en: O He Who brought me up in this world with His Goodness, Favours and blessings,

segs.ar: وَاَشَارَ لِیْ فِی الْاَخِرَۃِ اِلٰی عَفْوِهٖ وَكَرَمِهٖ
segs.en: and, in the Hereafter, directed me to His Forgiveness and Generosity,
My knowledge of You, O my Lord, is my guide to You
and my love for You is my intercessor towards You,
I am sure of my guide, by Your guidance,
and I rely upon my intercessor’s success before You.

segs.ar: اَدْعُوْكَ یَا سَیِّدِیْ بِلِسَانٍ قَدْ اَخْرَسَهٗ ذَنْبُهٗ
segs.en: I call upon You, my Master, with a tongue whose sins have it mute,

segs.ar: رَبِّ اُنَاجِیْكَ بِقَلْبٍ قَدْ اَوْبَقَهٗ جُرْمُهٗ
segs.en: My Lord, I whisper to You with a heart whose crime have destroyed it,
I call upon You, my Lord, with both fear and desire,
(I am both) Hopeful and fearful.
When I see my sins, my Master, I am terrified,
but when I see Your generosity, I feel desirous (for Your pardon).
If You forgive, then You are the best of those who show mercy,
and if You punish, You are not an oppressor.

segs.ar: حُجَّتِیْ یَا اَللهُ فِیْ جُرْاَتِیْ عَلٰی مَسْئَلَتِكَ
segs.en: That which gives me the daring to ask You, O Allah

segs.ar: مَعَ اِتْیَانِیْ مَا تَكْرَهُ جُوْدُكَ وَكَرَمُكَ
segs.en: despite my having committed that which You detest is Your Generosity and Magnanimity,

segs.ar: وَعُدَّتِیْ فِیْ شِدَّتِیْ مَعَ قِلَّۃِ حَیَآئِیْ رَافَتُكَ وَرَحْمَتُكَ
segs.en: And my means in times of hardship, despite my lack of shyness, is Your Compassion and Mercy.

segs.ar: وَقَدْ رَجَوْتُ اَنْ لَا تَخِیْبَ بَیْنَ ذَیْنِ وَذَیْنِ مُنْیَتِیْ
segs.en: And I hope that my hope will not be disappointed amid these two matters (Your Generosity and Your Mercy)
So, make my hopes come true,
and hear my prayers,
For You are the best of those who are asked,
and the best of those in whom people hope.

segs.ar: عَظُمَ یَا سَیِّدِیْ اَمَلِیْ وَسَآءَ عَمَلِیْ
segs.en: My Master, my hope is great while my actions are bad,
So, grant me of Your pardon in accordance with my hope,
and do not take me to account by the worst of my deeds.

segs.ar: فَاِنَّ كَرَمَكَ یَجِلُّ عَنْ مُجَازَاۃِ الْمُذْنِبِیْنَ
segs.en: For Your Generosity is more exalted than to punish the sinners,
and Your forbearance is greater than to recompense those with shortcomings.
I, my Master, am seeking refuge with Your Favour,
fleeing from You towards You,

segs.ar: مُتَنَجِّزٌ مَا وَعَدْتُ مِنَ اصَّفْحِ عَمَنَّ اَحْسَنَ  بِكَ ظَنًّا
segs.en: hoping for the amnesty that You have promised to give those who have good hope in You.

segs.ar: وَمَا اَنَا یَا رَبِّ وَمَا خَطَرِیْ؟
segs.en: What am I? O Lord! What importance do I have?
Grant me through Your benevolence
and be charitable to me by means of Your pardon.
O my Lord! Cover me with Your protective covering,
and pardon me from reproach, by the Honour of Your Face.

segs.ar: فَلَوِاطَّلَعَ الْیَوْمَ عَلٰی ذَنْبِیْ غَیْرُكَ مَا فَعَلْتُهٗ
segs.en: For anyone other than You was aware of my sin today, I would no have performed it,
And if had I anticipated a quick punishment, I would have avoided it.
Not because You are the least important of those who watch over me
or because You are the least weighty of those who observe me,

segs.ar: بَلْ لِاَنَّكَ یَا رَبِّ خَیْرُ السَّاتِرِیْنَ
segs.en: But because You, O my Lord, are the Best Concealer
The Most Wise,
The Most Generous
The Concealer of defects,
The Forgiver of sins,
The Knower of the unseen.
You conceal the sin out of Your Magnanimity,
and put off punishment out of Your Forbearance.

segs.ar: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلٰی حِلْمِكَ بَعْدَ عِلْمِكَ
segs.en: All praise is due to You, for Your Forbearance despite Your Knowledge
and for Your pardon despite Your Power,

segs.ar: وَیَحْمِلُنِیْ وَیُجَرِّئُنِیْ عَلٰی مَعْصِیَتِكَ حِلْمُكَ  عَنِّیْ
segs.en: It is Your forbearance towards me that gives me the daring to disobey You,

segs.ar: وَیَدْعُوْنِیْ اِلٰی قِلَّۃِ الْحَیَآءِ سِتْرُكَ عَلَیَّ
segs.en: It is Your concealment (of my faults) that leads me to lack of shyness.

segs.ar: وَیُسْرِعَنِیْ اِلَی التَّوَثُّبِ عَلٰی مَحَارِمِكَ مَعْرِفَتِیْ بِسَعَۃِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَعَظِیْمِ عَفْوِكَ
segs.en: It is my knowledge of the expanse of Your Mercy and the Greatness of Your Pardon that causes me to hasten in leaping towards what You have made forbidden.
O Forbearing! O Generous!
O the Ever Living, the One Who sustains and protects all that exists
O Forgiver of sins!
O Accepter of repentance!
O Bestower of great favours!
O He whose goodness has always been present,
Where is Your beautiful concealment?
Where is Your exalted pardon?
Where is Your imminent relief?
Where is Your quick rescue?
Where is Your expansive mercy?
Where are Your honourable bounties?
Where are Your pleasant endowments?
Where are sublime acts?
Where is Your great favour?
Where are Your huge bounties?
Where is Your eternal goodness?
Where is Your Generosity, O Generous?
By it (Your Generosity) and by Muhammad (s.a.w.a.) and the family of Muhammad (a.s.) save me,
And by Your Mercy rescue me.
O Beneficent! O Benevolent!
O Gracious! O Compassionate!

segs.ar: لَسْتُ اَتَّكِلُ فِی النَّجَاۃٍ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ عَلٰی اَعْمَالِنَا
segs.en: In seeking salvation from Your punishment, I do not rely upon our deeds;
rather, I depend on Your Grace towards us
because You are the Lord of righteousness and the Lord of forgiveness.
You take the initiative in doing good out of Your graciousness
and pardon sins out of Your generosity.
We  do not know what we should be thankful for

segs.ar: اَجَمِیْلَ مَا تَنْشُرُ اَمْ قَبِیْحَ مَا تَنْشُرُ
segs.en: The beauty of that which You make apparent, or the ugliness of that which You conceal,
(We do not know what we should be thankful for) the great trials (you test us with) and trusts (that you entrust us with)

segs.ar: اَمْ كَثِیْرَ مَا مِنْهُ نَجَّیْتَ وَعَافَیْتَ
segs.en: or the numerous (misfortunes) from which You have saved and relieved?
O Beloved of those who endear themselves to Him,

segs.ar: وَیَا قُرَّۃَ عَیْنِ مَنْ لَاذَبِكَ وَانْقَطَعَ اِلَیْكَ
segs.en: O delight of the eyes of those who resort to Him and devote themselves to Him,
You are the Benevolent and we are the evil-doers,

segs.ar: فَتَجَاوَزْ یَا رَبِّ عَنْ قَبِیْحِ مَا عِنْدَنَا بِجَمِیْلِ مَا عِنْدَكَ
segs.en: So, overlook, O Lord, our detestable (actions) with Your Goodness,

segs.ar: وَاَیُّ جَهْلٍ یَا رَبِّ لَا یَسَعُهٗ جُوْدُكَ
segs.en: And what ignorance, my Lord, is not encompassed by Your Magnanimity?

segs.ar: اَوْ اَیُّ زَمَانٍ اَطْوَلُ مِنْ اَنَاتِكَ
segs.en: And what period is long than Your Forbearance?

segs.ar: وَمَا قَدْرُ اَعْمَالِنَا فِیْ جَنْۢبِ نِعَمِكَ
segs.en: And what value do our actions have in comparison to Your Blessings?

segs.ar: وَكَیْفَ نَسْتَكْثِرُ اَعْمَالًا نُقَابِلُ بِهَا كَرَمَكَ
segs.en: How can we deem any deeds great when we compare them to Your Generosity?

segs.ar: بَلْ كَیْفَ یَضِیْقُ عَلَی الْمُذْنِبِیْنَ مَا وَسِعَهُمْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ
segs.en: Moreover, how can Your encompassing Mercy become narrow for the sinners?
O the One whose Forgiveness is All-Encompassing,
And Who opens both hands with Mercy,
So I swear by Your Glory, my Lord,

segs.ar: لَوْ نَهَرْتَنِیْ مَا بَرِحْتُ مِنْ بَابِكَ
segs.en: even if you reproach me, I shall never depart from Your door,
and I shall never stop praising You

segs.ar: لِمَا انْتَهٰی اِلَیَّ مِنَ الْمَعْرِفَۃِ بِجُوْدِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ
segs.en: Because of the certainty I have come to about Your Generosity and Magnanimity,
Verily, You do whatever You will,

segs.ar: تُعَذِّبُ مَنْ تَشَآءُ بِمَا تَشَآءُ كَیْفَ تَشَآءُ
segs.en: You punish whomsoever You wish however You wish by whatever means You wish,

segs.ar: وَتَرْحَمُ مَنْ تَشَآءُ بِمَآ تَشَآءُ كَیْفَ تَشَآءُ
segs.en: And You have mercy upon whomsoever You wish, however You wish, by whatever means You wish,
You are not taken to account for what You do,
And You are not opposed in Your Kingdom,
You have no partner in Your affair,
And You are not challenged in Your Rule,

segs.ar: وَلَا یَعْتَرِضُ عَلَیْكَ اَحَدٌ فِیْ تَدْبِیْرِكَ
segs.en: and none can ever protest against Your plans.
To You alone belong the creation and The Affair,
Blessed be Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

segs.ar: یَا رَبِّ هٰذَا مَقَامُ مَنْ لَاذَبِكَ
segs.en: O my Lord, this is the position of one who seeks Your shelter in You,
resorts to Your Generosity,
and has become accustomed to Your Goodness and Blessings.

segs.ar: وَاَنْتَ الْجَوَادُ الَّذِی لَا یَضِیْقُ عَفْوُكَ
segs.en: You are certainly the Munificent whose pardon never straitens,
Whose favour never wanes,
and Whose mercy never diminishes.
We have full confidence in You on account of Your eternal forgiveness,
great kindness and expansive mercy.

segs.ar: اَفَتَرَاكَ یَا رَبِّ تُخْلِفُ ظُنُوْنَنَا اَوْ تُخَیِّبُ اٰمَالَنَا
segs.en: Would it be, O Lord, that You may go against our assumptions or disappoint our hopes?

segs.ar: كَلَا یَا كَرِیْمُ فَلَیْسَ هٰذَا ظَنُّنَا بِكَ
segs.en: No, never. O Magnanimous! This is neither our idea about You
nor is this our desire from You!

segs.ar: یَا رَبِّ اِنَّ لَنَا فِیْكَ اَمَلًا طَوِیْلًا كَثِیْرًا
segs.en: My Lord, we have hope, great and long-lasting, in You.
(My Lord), we have great expectation in You.

segs.ar: عَصَیْنَاكَ وَنَحْنُ نَرْجُوْ اَنْ تَسْتُرَ عَلَیْنَا
segs.en: We have disobeyed You, and we hope that You will conceal (our faults),

segs.ar: وَدَعَوْنَاكَ وَنَحْنُ نَرْجُوْ اَنْ تَسْتَجِیْبَ لَنَا
segs.en: We have prayed to You hoping that You will respond to us.
So, make true our hopes, our Lord
For we have come to know what we deserve for our deeds,

segs.ar: وَلٰكِنْ عِلْمُكَ فِیْنَا وَعِلْمُنَا بِاَنَّكَ لَا تَصْرِفُنَا عَنْكَ
segs.en: Yet, Your knowledge about us, and our knowledge that turn us away from Yourself,

segs.ar: حَثَّنا عَلٰی الرَّغْبَۃِ اِلَیْكَ وَاِنْ كُنَّا غَیْرَ مُسْتَوْجِبِیْنَ لِرَحْمَتِكَ
segs.en: has urged us to ask You, even though we do not deserve Your mercy,

segs.ar: فَاَنْتَ اَهْلٌ اَنْ تَجُوْدَ عَلَیْنَا وَعَلَی الْمُذْنِبِیْنَ  بِفَضْلِكَ سَعَتِكَ
segs.en: While it befits You to be generous towards us and the sinners, by the goodness of your expansive benevolence.
So, grace us as it befits You,

segs.ar: وَجُدْ عَلَیْنَا فَاِنَّا مُحْتَاجُوْنَ اِلٰی نَیْلِكَ
segs.en: and act generously towards us, for we are in need of whatever we can obtain from You,
O Oft-Forgiving, by Your Light we are guided,
By Your Favour we have become needless (of others)
By Your grace do we enter each morning and night,
Our sins are before You;
We seek forgiveness from You, O Allah, for them, and we repent before You.
You show affection to us through Your graces, while we confront You with sins,
You goodness descends to us
while our evil ascends to You.

segs.ar: وَلَمْ یَزَلْ وَلَا یَزَالُ مَلَكٌ كَرِیْمٌ یَاتِیْكَ عَنَّا بِعَمَلِ قَبِیْحٍ
segs.en: There has always been, and will always be, a noble angel bringing news of our evil actions to You,

segs.ar: فَلَا یَمْنَعُكَ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ اَنْ تَحُوْطَنَا بِنِعَمِكَ
segs.en: Yet this has never stopped You from encompassing us with Your graces
and conferring upon us your bounties.
Glory be to You! How Forbearing and Great You are
and how Generous, both in creation and resurrection.
Holy are Your Names.
And Exalted is Your praise.
Munificent are Your creations and acts,

segs.ar: اَنْتَ اِلٰهِیْ اَوْ سَعُ فَضْلًا وَاَعْظَمُ حِلْمًا
segs.en: You, my Lord, are too expansive in graciousness and too great in forbearance
to punish me for my deeds and mistakes.
(Here I am asking for) Pardon! Pardon! Pardon!
My Master, My Master, My Master
O Allah, occupy us with Your remembrance,
And protect us from Your Wrath,
deliver us from Your torture,
And grant us of your gifts,
And bless us from Your Grace,
and provide us the opportunity to perform Hajj to Your Sacred House
and to visit the grave of Your Prophet,

segs.ar: صَلَوَاتُكَ وَرَحْمَتُكَ وَمَغْفِرَتُكَ وَرِضْوَانُكَ عَلَیْهِ وَعَلٰی اَهْلِ بَیْتِهٖ
segs.en: may Your blessings, mercy, Forgiveness and pleasure be upon him and his Household.
Surely You are near, responsive,
Bless us to act in obedience to You,

segs.ar: وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلٰی مِلَّتِكَ وَسُنَّۃِ نَبِیِّكَ صَلَّی اللهُ عَلَیْهِ وَآلِهٖ
segs.en: And make us to die while we are (followers) of Your community and the tradition of Your Prophet, blessings of Allah be upon him and on his Household.
O Allah, forgive me and my parents,
and have mercy on them as they cared for me when I was young
Reward them with goodness for their good deeds, generously for their good deeds
and with forgiveness for their sins.
O Allah, forgive the believers (men and women)
be they alive or dead,
and join us together in goodness.
O Allah, forgive our living and our dead,
our present and absent ones,
our males and females,
our young ones and elderly ones,
our free ones and slaves.
Liars are those who hold others equal with their Lord,
they have wandered far astray
And suffered a manifest loss.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad (s.a.w.a.) and the Household of Muhammad (a.s.),
Make my ending good,

segs.ar: وَاكْفِنِیْ مَا اَهَمَّنِیْ مِنْ اَمْرِ دُنْیَایَ وَاٰخِرَتِیْ
segs.en: And relieve me of that which grieves me, both in matters of this world and the Hereafter,

segs.ar: وَلَا تُسَلِّطْ عَلَیَّ مَنْ لَا یَرْحَمُنِیْ
segs.en: And do not give one who will have no mercy on me authority over me,
And make for me an everlasting protection, given by You

segs.ar: وَلَا تَسْلُبْنِیْ صَالِحَ مَا اَنْعَمْتَ بِهٖ عَلَیَّ
segs.en: do not strip me of the good that you have blessed me with,

segs.ar: وَارْزُقْنِیْ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ رِزْقًا وَاسِعًا حَلَالًا طَیِّبًا
segs.en: and provide me, out of Your grace, with sufficient, lawfully gotten, good sustenance.
O Allah, keep me under Your alert surveillance,
And protect me with Your protection,
and protect me with Your protection,
grant me opportunity to perform Hajj (pilgrimage) to Your Sacred House,

segs.ar: فِیْ عَامِنَا هٰذَا وَفِیْ كُلِّ عَامٍ
segs.en: in this year and every year,

segs.ar: وَزِیَارَۃَ قَبْرِ نَبِیِّكَ وَالْاَئِمَّۃِ عَلَیْهِمُ السَّلَامُ
segs.en: And to visit the grave of Your Prophet, and the Imams, peace be upon them,

segs.ar: وَلَا تُخْلِنِیْ یَا رَبِّ مِنْ تِلْكَ الْمَشَاهِدِ الشَّرِیْفَۃِ
segs.en: My Lord, do not deprive me (of visiting) those holy shrines,
and noble stations.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ تُبْ عَلَیَّ حَتّٰی لَا اَعْصِیَكَ
segs.en: O Allah, accept my repentance, such that I will not disobey You (again)
And inspire me with goodness, and acting according to goodness,
and awe of You, during day and night, for as long as You keep me alive.
O Lord of the worlds!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ كُلَّمَا قُلْتُ قَدْ تَهَیَّاْتُ وَتَعَبَّاْتُ
segs.en: O' Lord! I, whenever I thought I was prepared and ready
and rose to pray before You and called upon You,

segs.ar: اَلْقَیْتَ عَلَیَّ نُعَاسًا اِذَا اَنَا صَلَّیْتُ
segs.en: You cast a sleepiness on me as I prayed
and denied me (the opportunity) of conversing with You  as I called upon You

segs.ar: مَالِیْ كُلَّمَا قُلْتُ قَدْ صَلُحَتْ سَرِیْرَتِیْ
segs.en: What is the wrong with me? Whenever I think that my soul has become righteous,
and my gatherings are close to the gatherings of the repentant,

segs.ar: عَرَضَتْ لِیْ بَلِیَّۃٌ اَزَالَتْ قَدَمِیْ وَحَالَتْ بَیْنِیْ وَبَیْنَ خِدْمَتِكَ
segs.en: a misfortune would befall me, making me stumble, and forming a barrier between me and Your service,
My Master, perhaps You have turned me away from Your door,
and You have cast me aside from Your service.

segs.ar: اَوْ لَعَلَّكَ رَاَیْتَنِیْ مُسْتَخِفًّا بِحَقِّكَ فَاَقْصَیْتَنِیْ
segs.en: Perhaps You found me taking your Right upon me lightly, so you cast me aside

segs.ar: اَوْ لَعَلَّكَ رَاَیْتَنِیْ مُعْرِضًا عَنْكَ فَقَلَیْتَنِیْ
segs.en: or perhaps you saw me turning away from You and so You turned away from me

segs.ar: اَوْ لَعَلَّكَ وَجَدْتَنِیْ فِیْ مَقَامِ الْكَاذِبِیْنَ فَرَفَضْتَنِیْ
segs.en: or perhaps You found me in the status of the liars and so You rejected me

segs.ar: اَوْ لَعَلَّكَ رَاَیْتَنِیْ غَیْرَ شَاكِرٍ لِنَعْمَآئِكَ فَحَرَمْتَنَیْ
segs.en: or perhaps You saw me ungrateful for Your blessings so You deprived me

segs.ar: اَوْ لَعَلَّكَ فَقَدْتَنِیْ مِنْ مَجَالِسِ الْعُلَمَآءِ فَخَذَلْتَنِیْ
segs.en: or perhaps You saw me missing from the gatherings of the scholars and so You humiliated me

segs.ar: اَوْ لَعَلَّكَ رَاَیْتَنِیْ فِی الْغَافِلِیْنَ فَمِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ اٰیَسْتَنِیْ
segs.en: or perhaps You saw me among the oblivious, so You made me despair of Your Mercy

segs.ar: اَوْ لَعَلَّكَ رَاَیْتَنِیْ اٰلِفَ مَجَالِسِ الْبَطَّالِیْنَ فَبَیْنِیْ وَبَیْنَهُمْ خَلَّیْتَنِیْ
segs.en: or perhaps You saw me comfortable in the gatherings of the promoters of falsehood so You let me be, among them

segs.ar: اَوْ لَعَلَّكَ لَمْ تُحِبَّ اَنْ تَسْمَعَ دُعَآئِی فَبَاعَدْتَنِیْ
segs.en: Or, perhaps, You did not like to hear my supplications, so You distanced me,
or perhaps You have recompensed me for my sins and transgressions

segs.ar: اَوْ لَعَلَّكَ بِقِلَّۃِ حَیَآئِیْ مِنْكَ جَازَیْتَنِیْ
segs.en: Or perhaps You have recompensed me for my lack of shyness before You

segs.ar: فَاِنْ عَفَوْتَ یَا رَبِّ فَطَالَ مَا عَفَوْتَ عَنِ الْمُذْنِبِیْنَ قَبْلِیْ
segs.en: If You forgive me, O Lord, then You have forgiven sinners like me for a long time,

segs.ar: لِاَنَّ كَرَمَكَ اَیْ رَبِّ یَجِلُّ عَنْ مُكَافَاتِ الْمُقَصِّرِیْنَ
segs.en: because Your Magnanimity, My Lord, is too Exalted than to recompense those with shortcomings,

segs.ar: وَاَنَا عَآئِذٌ بِفَضْلِكَ هَارِبٌ مِّنْكَ اِلَیْكَ
segs.en: And I am seeking refuge with Your Goodness, fleeing from You to You,

segs.ar: مُتَنَجِّزٌ مَا وَعَدْتَ مِنَ الصَّفْحِ عَمَّنْ اَحْسَنَ بِكَ ظَنًّا
segs.en: Seeking refuge in the promise that You have made to forgive those who have good assumptions about You,
My Lord, You are too expansive in favour

segs.ar: وَاَعْظَمُ حِلْمًا مِنْ اَنْ تُقَایِسَنِیْ بِعَمَلِیْ
segs.en: and too great in forbearance to punish me for my deed,
or to make me slip up because of my mistakes.

segs.ar: وَمَا اَنَا یَا سَیِّدِی وَمَا خَطَرِیْ
segs.en: What am I? O Master! What is my significance?
Grant me through Your benevolence
and be charitable to me by means of Your pardon.
And cover me with Your protective covering,
And overlook chastising me, by the Generosity of Your Face,
My Master, I am the young one that You have nurtured,
The ignorant that You have taught,
The straying that You have guided,
The base, that You have elevated,
I am the afraid that You have given security,
The hungry that You have satiated,
The thirsty that You have quenched,
The naked that You have dressed,
I am the poor that You have given affluence,
The weak that You have strengthened,
The lowly that You have given glory,
And the sick whom You cured,
The beseecher that You have given to,
The sinner that You have concealed,
I am the guilty that You have excused,
The worthless that You have made valuable,
The helpless, whom You have aided,
and I am the exile that You have given refuge.

segs.ar: اَنَا یَا رَبِّ الَّذِیْ لَمْ اَسْتَحْیِكَ فِی الْخَلَآئِ
segs.en: My Lord, I am the one who has not felt ashamed before You in private,
and was not observant of You in public,
I am the committer of the grave transgressions,
I am the one who showed daring against his Master,
I am the one who disobeyed the Powerful in the heavens,

segs.ar: اَنَا الَّذِیْ اَعْطَیْتُ عَلٰی مَعٰاصِی الْجَلِیْلِ الرُّشٰي
segs.en: I am the one who gave bribes in order to commit acts of disobedience against the Exalted (Lord)

segs.ar: اَنَا الَّذِیْ حِیْنَ بُشِّرْتُ بِهَا خَرَجْتُ اِلَیْهَا اَسْعٰی
segs.en: I am the one that, when informed of sinful acts, went hurrying towards them,
I am the one to whom You gave respite, yet I did not take heed,
whose (sins) You concealed, yet I felt no shame,
who committed acts of disobedience and overstepped (all bounds),
and whom You let fall from Your sight, yet I did not care.
By Your Forbearance, You have given me respite.
And You have concealed (my faults) with Your concealment, to the extent that it is as if You are unaware of my acts,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ عُقُوْبَاتِ الْمَعٰاصِیْ جَنَّبْتَنِیْ حَتّٰی كَاَنَّكَ اسْتَحْیَیْتَنِیْ
segs.en: and You have kept me away from the punishments of my acts of disobedience, to the extent that it is as if You feel shy of me.

segs.ar: اِلٰهِیْ لَمْ اَعْصِكَ حِیْنَ عَصَیْتُكَ وَاَنَا بِرُبُوْبِیَّتِكَ جَاهِدٌ
segs.en: My Lord, when I disobeyed You, I did not disobey while I was denying Your Lordship,
Nor because I was belittling Your commands,
Nor because I wanted to expose myself to Your punishment,
Nor because I was taking your promises of punishment lightly.

segs.ar: لٰكِنْ خَطِیْئَۃٌ عَرَضَتْ وَسَوَّلَتْ لِیْ نَفْسِیْ
segs.en: Rather, it was a mistake that occurred, and my self deceived me,
my desire overwhelmed me,
And my wretchedness helped me to it,
Your cover, spread over me, made me heedless,
So, I have disobeyed You and gone against You with my own efforts,
Now, who can save me from Your punishment?

segs.ar: وَمِنْ اَیْدِیْ الْخُصَمَآءِ غَدًا مَنْ یُخَلِّصُنِیْ
segs.en: And tomorrow, who can rescue me from the hands of my enemies?

segs.ar: وَبِحَبْلِ مَنْ اَتَّصِلُ اِنْ اَنْتَ قَطَعْتَ حَبْلَكَ عَنِّيْ
segs.en: Whose rope will I hold if You cut off Your rope from me,

segs.ar: فَوَا سَوْاَتَا عَلٰی مَا اَحْصٰی كِتَابُكَ مِنْ عَمَلِی
segs.en: Shame on me for what Your Book has recorded of my deeds,

segs.ar: الَّذِیْ لَوْلَا مَا اَرْجُوْ مِنْ كَرَمِكَ وَسَعَۃِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَنَهْیِكَ اِیَّایَ عَنِ الْقُنُوْطِ
segs.en: That had it not been my hope in Your generosity,  and the expanse of Your mercy, and Your prohibiting me from despair,
I would have despaired when I remember them,
For You are the best of those who are asked,
and the best of those in whom people hope.
O Allah, I beseech You by the honour of Islam,
I rely upon You, by the sanctity of the Qur’an,

segs.ar: وَبِحُبِّیْ النَّبِیَّ الْاُمِّیَّ الْقُرَشِیَّ الْهَاشِمِیَّ الْعَرَبِیَّ التِّهَامِیَّ الْمَكِّیَ الْمَدَنِیَّ
segs.en: And by of my love for the Ummi, Qurashi, Hashimi, Arabi, Tihami, Makki, Madani Prophet,
I hope for proximity to You.
So, do not disturb my familiarity with faith

segs.ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ ثَوَابِیْ ثَوَابَ مَنْ عَبَدَ سِوَاكَ
segs.en: and do not make my reward the reward given to those who worship other than You.

segs.ar: فَاِنَّ قَوْمًا اٰمَنُوْا بِاَلْسِنَتِهِمْ لِیَحْقِنُوْا بِهٖ دِمَآئَهُمْ
segs.en: For there is a certain group who believed with their tongue, so that they could protect their lives,
And they attained their wish,

segs.ar: وَاِنَّا اٰمَنَّابِكَ بِاَلْسِنَتِنَا وَقُلُوْبِنَا لِتَعْفُوَ عَنَّا
segs.en: While we have believed in You by our tongues and hearts, so that You may pardon us,
So make us to attain our wish.
make our hope in You firm in our hearts,

segs.ar: وَلَا تُزِغْ قُلُوْبَنَا بَعْدَ اِذْ هَدَیْتَنَا
segs.en: make not our hearts to deviate after You have guided us aright,
and grant us from You mercy.
Surely, You are the Best Bestower.

segs.ar: فَوَعِزَّتِكَ لَوِانْتَهَرْتَنِیْ مَا بَرِحْتُ مِنْ بَابِكَ
segs.en: even if you reproach me, I shall never depart from Your door,
and I shall never stop praising You

segs.ar: لِمَا اُلْهِمَ قَلْبِیْ (يَا سَيِّدِيْ) مِنَ الْمَعْرِفَۃِ بِكَرَمِكَ وَسَعَۃِ رَحْمَتِكَ
segs.en: Because of the knowledge that my heart has been inspired of your Generosity and the great scope of Your Mercy,

segs.ar: اِلٰی مَنْ یَذْهَبُ الْعَبْدُ اِلَّا اِلٰی مَوْلَاهُ
segs.en: To whom can a slave go except to his Master?

segs.ar: وَاِلٰی مَنْ یَلْتَجِئُ الْمَخْلُوْقُ اِلَّا اِلٰی خَالِقِهٖ
segs.en: To whom can the creature resort except to his Creator?
My Lord, even if You tie me with chains,
deprive me of the stream of Your bounties in the presence of people,
divulge all my scandalous acts before the eyes of all the slaves,
And You ordered me to Hell,
And placed a barrier between me and the pious,
I would not end my hope in You,
nor have I turned my hope for pardon away from You,
and Your love would not leave my heart.
I never forget Your graces that I enjoy
and Your having concealment (of my faults) in this world

segs.ar: سَیِّدِیْ اَخْرِجْ حُبَّ الدُّنْیَا مِنْ قَلْبِیْ
segs.en: My Master, remove the love of this world from my heart.

segs.ar: وَاجْمَعْ بَیْنِیْ وَبَیْنَ الْمُصْطَفٰی وَآلِهٖ خِیَرَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَخَاتَمِ النَّبِیِّیْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّی اللهُ عَلَیْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ
segs.en: And join between me and al-Mustafa (The Chosen One) and His Progeny Your chosen one from among Your creatures and the seal of the Prophets: Muhammad, blessings of Allah be upon him and on his Household.
Move me to the station of repentance to You,

segs.ar: وَاَعِنِّیْ بِالْبُكَآءِ عَلٰی نَفْسِیْ فَقَدْ اَفنَیْتُ بِالتَّسْوِیْفِ وَالْآمَالِ عُمْرِیْ
segs.en: and help me to weep over myself, for I have spent my whole life in putting off and (idle) hopes,

segs.ar: وَقَدْ نَزَلْتُ مَنْزِلَۃَ الْاٰیِسِیْنَ مِنْ خَیْرِیْ
segs.en: And I am in the position of those who are in despair of their own goodness,
Who, then, is in a worse state than me?

segs.ar: اِنْ اَنَا نُقِلْتُ عَلٰی مِثْلِ حَالِیْ
segs.en: If I am transported, in my current state,
To a grave which I have not prepared for my stay,
(a grave) which I have not furnished with righteous deeds for my stay therein,
What is wrong with me that I do not weep?

segs.ar: وَلَا اَدْرِیْ اِلٰی مَا یَكُوْنُ مَصِیْرِیْ
segs.en: while I do not know what my destiny will be?
And I see my self deceiving me,
my days are deceiving me,

segs.ar: وَقَدْ خَفَقَتْ عِنْدَ رَاسِیَ اَجْنِحَۃُ الْمَوْتِ
segs.en: And the wings of death have fluttered over my head.
So what is wrong with me that I do not weep?
Weep for the departure of my soul
Weep for the darkness of my grave
I weep for the narrowness of my vault.
Weep for Munkar and Nakeer  interrogating me.

segs.ar: اَبْكِیْ لِخُرُوْجِیْ مِنْ قَبْرِیْ عُرْیَانًا ذَلِیْلًا حَامِلًا ثِقْلِیْ عَلٰی ظَهْرِیْ
segs.en: Weep for my coming out of my grave (on the Resurrection Day) naked, humiliated, carrying my burden on my back,

segs.ar: اَنْظُرُ مَرَّۃً عَنْ یَمِیْنِیْ وَاُخْرٰی عَنْ شِمَالِیْ
segs.en: Looking at times to my right, and at other times to my left,

segs.ar: اِذِ الْخَلَآئِقُ فِیْ شَانٍ غَیْرِ شَانِیْ
segs.en: Behold, the creatures will each be engaged with matters other than mine.

segs.ar: لِكُلِّ امْرِءٍ مِّنْهُمْ یَوْمَئِذٍ شَانٌ یُّغْنِیْهِ
segs.en: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless of others.
Many faces on that day shall be bright, laughing, joyous.

segs.ar: وَوُجُوْهٌ یَّوْمَئِذٍ عَلَیْهَا غَبَرَۃٌ تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَۃٌ  وَّذِلَّۃٌ
segs.en: And many faces on that day, on them shall be dust. Darkness, and humiliation shall cover them.
My Master, on You I depend and rely.
In You I put my hope and trust.
And to Your mercy, I cling;
You direct Your mercy towards whomsoever You like
and You guide, out of Your Honour, whomsoever You like.

segs.ar: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلٰی مَا نَقَّیْتَ مِنَ الشِّرْكِ قَلْبِیْ
segs.en: So, all praise be to You for You have purified my heart from polytheism.
All praise be to You for You have made my tongue express utterly.
Can I thank You with this weak tongue?

segs.ar: اَمْ بِغَایَۃِ جَهْدِیْ فِیْ عَمَلِیْ اُرْضِیْكَ
segs.en: Or can I please You with the utmost effort in my actions?

segs.ar: وَمَا قَدْرُ لِسَانِیْ یَا رَبِّ فِیْ جَنْۢبِ شُكْرِكَ
segs.en: What is the value of my tongue, my Lord, in comparison to gratefulness to You?

segs.ar: وَمَا قَدْرُ عَمَلِیْ فِیْ جَنْۢبِ نِعَمِكَ وَاِحْسَانِكَ اِلَیَّ
segs.en: What is the value of my action, my Lord, in comparison to Your graces and favours?
My Lord, Your benevolence has expanded my hope,
And it is Your Gratefulness that has accepted my actions.
My Lord, in You is my desire,
And it is You that I fear,
and to You do I look forward.
My hope that has driven me towards You,
And my determination has settled with You, O My One,
And my hope is directed towards what You have,
And in You is my sincere hope and fear,
My Love has found familiarity in You,
And toward You I have cast my hand,
And I have stretched out my fear to the rope of Your obedience
My master, by Your remembrance my heart lives,
And through confidential conversations with You have I cooled the pains of my fear.

segs.ar: فَیَا مَوْلَایَ وَیَا مُؤَمَّلِیْ وَیَا مُنْتَهٰی سُؤْلِیْ
segs.en: So, O my Master, O my trusty patron, O my ultimate request

segs.ar: فَرِّقْ بَیْنِیْ وَبَیْنَ ذَنْۢبِیَ الْمَانِعِ لِیْ مِنْ لُزُوْمِ  طَاعَتِكَ
segs.en: Separate between me and my sin- which prevents me from adhering to Your obedience,
I ask You because of my eternal hope in You,
and my great desire from You,

segs.ar: الَّذِیْ اَوْ جَبْتَهٗ عَلٰی نَفْسِكَ مِنَ الرَّافَۃِ وَالرَّحْمَۃِ
segs.en: (and because of the) Mercy and Compassion which You have made obligatory upon Yourself,
So, the whole affair is Yours alone. You are One, and have no partner,
All the creatures are dependent upon You and are in Your grip.
All things are submissive to You.
Blessed are You, O Lord of the worlds.
O my Allah, have mercy on me when my argument is nullified,
And my tongue is paralysed when it comes to answering (You)
And when my mind becomes unable as You interrogate me.

segs.ar: فَیَاعَظِیْمَ رَجَآئِیْ لَا تُخَیِّبْنِیْ اِذَا اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتِیْ
segs.en: So, O my great hope, do not forsake me when my need becomes great,
do not reject me out of my ignorance,
and do not deprive because of my lack of patience,
Give me on account of my neediness,
And have mercy on me on account of my weakness,
O my Master, on You do I rely
and lean. And in You I hope and trust.
I cling to Your Mercy,
segs.tr: And to Your mercy, I cling;

segs.en: And in Your courtyard I alight,
On account of Your benevolence do I declare my request
And with Your Generosity, My Lord, I begin my prayers
With You do I desire for meeting my needs.
Through Your Needlessness I heal my neediness,
And under the shade of Your pardon I stand.
Towards Your benevolence and generosity I raise my sight.
And towards Your Forgiveness is directed my constant gaze,

segs.ar: فَلَا تُحْرِقْنِیْ بِالنَّارِ وَاَنْتَ مَوْضِعُ اَمَلِیْ
segs.en: so, do not burn me with The Fire, while You are my ultimate hope,

segs.ar: وَلَا تُسْكِنِّیْ الْهَاوِیَۃَ فَاِنَّكَ قُرَّۃُ عَیْنِیْ
segs.en: and do not embed me in al-Hawiyah (a pit of Hell) for You are the delight of my eyes.

segs.ar: یَا سَیِّدِیْ لَا تُكَذِّبْ ظَنِّیْ بِاِحْسَانِكَ وَمَعْرُوْفِكَ
segs.en: O my Master, do not belie my (good) assumptions about Your Grace and Favours,
For in You is my trust.
Do not deprive me of Your rewards,
for You know best my poverty.

segs.ar: اِلٰهِیْ اِنْ كَانَ قَدْ دَنَا اَجَلِیْ وَلَمْ یُقَرِّبْنِیْ مِنْكَ  عَمَلِیْ
segs.en: My Lord, if my time of death is close, and my actions have not brought me close to You,

segs.ar: فَقَدْ جَعَلْتُ الْاِعْتِرَافَ اِلَیْكَ بِذَنْۢبِیْ وَسَآئِلَ عِلَلِیْ
segs.en: then I have made my confession of having committed sins be my means of justification.

segs.ar: اِلٰهِیْ اِنْ عَفَوْتَ فَمَنْ اَوْلٰی مِنْكَ بِالْعَفْوِ
segs.en: My Lord, if You forgive, then who is worthier than You in forgiveness?

segs.ar: وَاِنْ عَذَّبْتَ فَمَنْ اَعْدَلُ مِنْكَ فِی الْحُكْمِ
segs.en: And if You punish, then who is fairer than You in judgment?
Have mercy on my estrangement in this world,
My grief at the time of death,
My solitude in the grave,
My loneliness in the grave,

segs.ar: وَاِذَا نُشِرْتُ لِلْحِسَابِ بَیْنَ یَدَیْكَ ذُلَّ مَوْقِفِیْ
segs.en: and on the degradation of my situation when I am resurrected fro the Account before You.

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِیْ مَا خَفِیَ عَلَی الْاٰدَمِیِّیْنَ مِنْ عَمَلِیْ
segs.en: Forgive for me those deeds which have been concealed from other humans,
make permanent for me that through which You have covered my faults,

segs.ar: وَارْحَمْنِیْ صَرِیْعًا عَلَی الْفِرَاشِ تُقَلِّبُنِیْ  اَیْدِیْ اَحِبَّتِیْ
segs.en: have mercy on me when I am deceased, on my (death)bed, being turned over by my loved ones,

segs.ar: وَتَفَضَّلْ عَلَیَّ مَمْدُوْدًا عَلَی الْمُغْتَسَلِ یُقَلِّبُنِیْ صَالِحُ جِیْرَتِیْ
segs.en: Show favour to me when I am stretched out on the washing-table, being turned from sided to side by my righteous neighbours,

segs.ar: وَتَحَنَّنَ عَلَیَّ مَحْمُوْلًا قَدْ تَنَاوَلَ الْاَقْرِبَآءُ اَطْرَافَ جَنَازَتِیْ
segs.en: Have compassion towards me when I am being and my relatives are holding the sides of my coffin,

segs.ar: وَجُدْ عَلَیَّ مَنْقُوْلًا قَدْ نَزَلْتُ بِكَ وَحِیْدًا فِیْ حُفْرَتِیْ
segs.en: Be magnanimous towards me when I am transferred, and am left to You, and placed into my grave, alone,

segs.ar: وَارْحَمْ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ الْبَیْتِ الْجَدِیْدِ غُرْبَتِیْ حَتّٰی لَا اَسْتَانِسَ بِغَیْرِكَ
segs.en: have mercy on my estrangement in that new dwelling, so that I will not find comfort with anyone other than You.

segs.ar: یَا سَیِّدِیْ اِنْ وَكَلْتَنِیْ اِلٰی نَفْسِیْ هَلَكْتُ
segs.en: My Master, if you entrust me to myself, I will certainly perish.

segs.ar: سَیِّدِیْ فَبِمَنْ اَسْتَغِیْثُ اِنْ لَمْ تُقِلْنِیْ عَثْرَتِیْ
segs.en: My Master, to whom will I resort if You do not overlook my slips?

segs.ar: فَاِلٰی مَنْ اَفْزَعُ اِنْ فَقَدْتُ عِنَایَتَكَ فِیْ ضَجْعَتِیْ
segs.en: To whom will I run for help if I lose Your care for me during my stay (in the grave)?

segs.ar: وَاِلٰی مَنْ اَلْتَجِیْءُ اِنْ لَمْ تُنَفِّسْ كُرْبَتِیْ
segs.en: With whom will I seek refuge if You do not relieve my grief?

segs.ar: سَیِّدِیْ مَنْ لِیْ وَمَنْ یَرْ حَمُنِیْ اِنْ لَمْ تَرْ حَمْنِیْ
segs.en: My Master, who do I have, And who will have mercy on me if You do not?

segs.ar: وَفَضْلَ مَنْ اُؤَمِّلُ اِنْ عَدِمْتُ فَضْلَكَ یَوْمَ فَاقَتِیْ
segs.en: In whose favour should I hope if You withhold Your favour on my day of need,

segs.ar: وَاِلٰی مَنِ الْفِرَارُ مِنَ الذُّنُوْبِ اِذَا انْقَضٰی اَجَلِیْ
segs.en: To whom will I flee from my sins when my appointed time arrives?
My Master, do not punish while I am imploring you,
My Lord, make my hopes reality,
And give me security from my fear.

segs.ar: فَاِنَّ كَثْرَۃَ ذُنُوْبِیْ لَا اَرْجُوْفِیْهَا لَهَآ اِلَّا عَفْوَكَ
segs.en: As for my numerous sins, my only hope in relation to them is Your pardon.
O my Master, I am asking You that which I do not deserve,
While You are the worthiest of being feared and the worthiest of forgiving.

segs.ar: فَاغْفِرْلِیْ وَالْبِسْنِیْ مِنْ نَظَرِكَ ثَوْبًا یُغَطِّیْ  عَلَیَّ التَّبِعَاتِ
segs.en: So, forgive me and dress me, out of Your attention, a garment covering all my defects,
and forgive them for me so that I will not be held responsible for them.
Verily, You are the Lord of eternal favours,
great pardon,
And generous forgiveness..

segs.ar: اِلٰهِیْ اَنْتَ الَّذِیْ تَفِیْضُ سَیْبَكَ عَلٰی مَنْ لَا یَسْئَلُكَ
segs.en: My Lord, You are the one whose flowing graces reach those who never ask You
and those who stubbornly deny Your Lordship.

segs.ar: فَكَیْفَ سَیِّدِیْ بِمَنْ سَئَلَكَ وَاَیْقَنَ اَنَّ الْخَلْقَ لَكَ وَالْاَمْرَ اِلَیْكَ
segs.en: So, my Master, what should You do to those who ask You and have certainty that all of creation and its affairs belong to You.
Blessed and Exalted are You, O Lord of the worlds!

segs.ar: سَیِّدِیْ عَبْدُكَ بِبَابِكَ اَقَامَتْهُ الْخَصَاصَۃُ بَیْنَ یَدَیْكَ
segs.en: My master, (this is) Your servant, at Your door; his neediness has made him stand before you,

segs.ar: یَقْرَعُ بَابَ اِحْسَانِكَ بِدُعَآئِهٖ فَلَا تُعْرِضْ بِوَجْهِكَ الْكَرِیْمِ عَنِّیْ
segs.en: am knocking on the door of Your Grace with his prayer So, do not turn Your Generous Face away from me.

segs.ar: وَاَقْبَلْ مِنِّیْ مَا اَقُوْلُ فَقَدْ دَعَوْتُ بِهٰذَا الدُّعَآئِ
segs.en: Accept that which I say, for I have asked through this prayer,

segs.ar: وَاَنَا اَرْجُوْ اَنْ لَا تَرُدَّنِیْ مَعْرِفَۃً مِّنِّیْ بِرَافَتِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ
segs.en: hoping that You will not reject me, because of the knowledge I have of Your compassion and mercy,
