At the fifteenth night of Ramadan, one who attends at the tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a) and offers a ten-unit prayer after the obligatory Isha Prayer, other than the Night Prayer (Salat al-Layl), reciting in each unit Surah al-Fatihah once and repeating Surah al-Tawheed ten times, and then seeks Almighty Allah's protection against Hellfire — if he does this, Almighty Allah will include him with those whom He releases from Hellfire, and he will not die before he sees in a dream angels conveying to him the good tidings of entering Paradise and security against Hellfire."

The fifteenth of Ramadan: on the fifteenth of Ramadan, AH 2, Imam al-Hasan al-Mujtaba (a) was born.

In the words of Shaykh al-Mufid, Imam Muhammad al-Taqi (a) was born on the fifteenth of Ramadan, AH 195 — though it is widely known that Imam Muhammad al-Taqi was not actually born on this date. Anyhow, the fifteenth of Ramadan is a blessed day; to give alms and do righteous deeds on this day brings great merit.

A_AA27.name: The 17th Night of Ramazan

segs.note: Give alms and thank Almighty Allah on the day of the 17th of Ramazan.
segs.ur: سترہ رمضان کے دن صدقہ دیں اور اللہ تعالیٰ کا شکر ادا کریں۔

segs.note: Bathe and practice acts of worship at this night.
segs.ur: اس رات غسل کریں اور عبادت کریں.

segs.note: Al-Sayyid al-Himyari, the famous poet, composed a few laudatory poetic verses immortalizing this event:
segs.ur: مشہور شاعر سید حمیری نے اس واقعے کو امر کرنے والے چند مدحیہ اشعار کہے:

segs.ar: اُقْسِمُ بِاللّٰهِ وَ اٰلاۤئِهٖ وَ الْمَرْءُ عَمَّا قَالَ مَسْئُولٌ اِنَّ عَلِيِّ بْنَ اَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَى التُّقٰى وَ الْبِرِّ مَجْبُولٌ كَانَ اِذَا الْحَرْبُ مَرَتْهَا الْقَنَا وَ اَحْجَمَتْ عَنْهَا الْبَهَالِيلُ يَمْشِي اِلَى الْقِرْنِ وَ فِي كَفِّهٖ اَبْيَضُ مَاضِي الْحَدِّ مَصْقُولٌ مَشْيَ الْعَفَرْنَا بَيْنَ اَشْبَالِهِ اَبْرَزَهٗ لِلْقَنَصِ الْغِيلُ ذَاكَ الَّذِي سَلَّمَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ عَلَيْهِ مِيكَالٌ وَ جِبْرِيلٌ مِيكَالُ فِي اَلْفٍ وَ جِبْرِيلُ فِي اَلْفٍ وَ يَتْلُوهُمْ سَرَافِيلُ لَيْلَةَ بَدْرٍ مَدَدًا اُنْزِلُوا كَاَنَّهُمْ طَيْرٌ اَبَابِيلُ
segs.en: I swear by Allah and His bounties - and a man is answerable for what he says - that 'Ali the son of Abu-Talib was moulded upon piety and righteousness. When war was stirred up by the spears and the champions shrank back from it, he would walk towards his opponent holding in his hand a bright, sharp-edged, polished blade, striding like a lion among its cubs whom the thicket has sent out to hunt. He is the one whom Mika'il and Jibra'il saluted in a single night: Mika'il among a thousand, Jibra'il among a thousand, and Israfil following them - on the night of Badr they were sent down as reinforcement, as if they were flocks of birds.
segs.tr: UQSIMU BIL LAAHI WA AALAA-IHEE WAL MAR-U A'MMAA QAALA MAS-OOLUN INNA A'LIYYI BNA ABEE TAALIBIN A'LAT TUQAA WAL BIRRI MAJBOOLUN KAANA IZAL HARBU MARATHAL QANAA WA AHJAMAT A'NHAL BAHAALEELU YAMSHEE ILAL QIRNI WA FEE KAFFIHEE ABYAZU MAAZIL HADDI MASQOOLUN MASHYAL 'AFARNAA BAYNA ASHBAALIHI ABRAZAHOO LILQANASIL GHEELU ZAAKAL LAZEE SALLAMA FEE LAYLATIN A'LAYHI MEEKAALUN WA JIBREELUN MEEKAALU FEE ALFIN WA JIBREELU FEE ALFIN WA YATLOOHUM SARAAFEELU LAYLATA BADRIN MADADAN UNZILOO KA-ANNAHUM TAYRUN ABAABEEL

A_AA27.merits:
At this blessed night, the two armies of the Muslims, under the leadership of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.), and the polytheists of Quraysh faced each other at Badr Spring. On the seventeenth of Ramadan, the Battle of Badr took place when Almighty Allah gave victory to the Holy Prophet’s army over the polytheists’. That was the Greatest conquest of Islam.

In view of that, our master scholars have declared that it is highly recommended to give alms and thank Almighty Allah on this day.

Besides, to bathe oneself and to practice acts of worship at this night achieve a great reward.

According to numerous narrations, the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) asked his companions, at the night before the Battle of Badr, to go to Badr Spring and bring some water. All the companions kept silent and none of them had the courage to undertake this mission. Imam AliAmeer al-Momineen(a.s.), therefore, took a skin of water and went towards that spring for getting some water. It was so murky, bitterly cold, and windy night. When Imam Ali(a.s.) reached that dark, deep spring, he could not find a bucket to use for taking water. He therefore had to step down that spring and fill in the skin with water. On his way back to the Holy Prophet’s camp, he faced such a strong storm that made him sit on the ground. When it calmed down, he continued marching. Then, another storm that was as intense as the first blew so heavily that he had to sit on the ground. When it calmed down, Imam Ali continued marching. Again, a third storm that was as intense as the previous ones blew so heavily that he had to sit on the ground. When it calmed down, he continued marching until he reached the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) who, then, asked why he had been late. “I faced three heavy storms that made me sit to the ground three times. I therefore had to wait until they would calm down,” explained Imam Ali(a.s.). “Did you know what these three storms were, Ali?” asked the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.). As Imam Ali(a.s.) answered in the negative, the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) explained, “The first storm was Archangel Gabriel with one thousand angels who, altogether, came to greet you. The second storm was Archangel Michael with one thousand angels who, altogether, came to greet you. The third storm was Archangel Seraph with one thousand angels who, altogether, came to greet you. All these angels descended to the earth to back us.”

To this event has a scholar referred, saying, “Imam Ali Ameer al-Momineen (a.s.) had three thousand merits at one night only.”

A_AA29.name: Common Aamal at Each of the Three Qadr Nights

segs.note: Ghusl, Worship & Ziyarat
segs.ur: غسل، عبادت اور زیارت

segs.note: Bathe at each of the three Qadr Nights, preferably at sunset.
segs.ur: تینوں شبِ قدر میں سے ہر رات غسل کریں، بہتر ہے کہ غروب کے وقت.

segs.note: Spend the whole three Qadr Nights in acts of worship.
segs.ur: تینوں شبہائے قدر پوری عبادت میں گزاریں۔

segs.note: Visit the holy tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a) on these nights.
segs.ur: ان راتوں میں امام حسین (ع) کے روضۂ مبارک کی زیارت کریں۔

segs.note: Recite Dua Jawshan al-Kabir at the three Qadr Nights.
segs.ur: تینوں شبہائے قدر میں [دعائے جوشن کبیر](E29) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Prayers & Istighfar
segs.ur: نمازیں اور استغفار

segs.note: Offer a two-unit prayer, reciting at each unit Surah al-Faatehah once and repeating Surah al-Ikhlas seven times.
segs.ur: دو رکعت نماز پڑھیں، ہر رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ پڑھیں اور [سورہ اخلاص](A116) سات مرتبہ دہرائیں۔

segs.note: After finishing, repeat seventy times:
segs.ur: ختم کرنے کے بعد، ستر مرتبہ دہرائیں:

segs.en: I implore Allah's forgiveness and I repent before Him.

segs.note: Offer the one-hundred-unit prayer, reciting in each unit Surah al-Faatehah once and repeating Surah al-Ikhlas ten times.
segs.ur: سو رکعت کی نماز پڑھیں، ہر رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ پڑھیں اور [سورہ اخلاص](A116) دس مرتبہ دہرائیں۔

segs.note: Dua with the Qur’an Open
segs.ur: کھلے قرآن کے ساتھ دعا

segs.note: Open a copy of the Holy Qur'an between your hands and say:
segs.ur: قرآن کریم کا ایک نسخہ اپنے ہاتھوں کے درمیان کھولیں اور کہیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّىْ اَسْاَلُكَ بِكِتَابِكَ الْمُنْزَلِ وَمَا فِيْهِ وَفِيْهِ اسْمُكَ الْاَكْبَرُ وَاَسْمَاۤؤُكَ الْحُسْنٰى
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by Your revealed Book and what is in it, and in it is Your Greatest Name and Your most beautiful Names,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALUKA BI-KITAABIKAL MUNZALI WA MAA FEEHI WA FEEHIS MUKAL AKBARU WA ASMAAA-UKAL HUSNAA

segs.ar: وَمَا يُخَافُ وَيُرْجٰى اَنْ تَجْعَلَنِيْ مِنْ عُتَقَاۤئِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
segs.en: and what is feared and hoped for, that You make me among those You have freed from the Fire.
segs.tr: WA MAA YUKHAAFU WA YURJAA AN TAJ-A'LANEE MIN U'TAQAAA-IKA MINAN NAAR

segs.note: One may then pray for the fulfillment of one's desires.
segs.ur: اس کے بعد وہ اپنی خواہشات پوری ہونے کے لیے دعا کر سکتا ہے۔

segs.note: Dua with the Qur’an on the Head
segs.ur: سر پر قرآن رکھ کر دعا

segs.note: Place a copy of the Holy Qur'an on the head and say:
segs.ur: قرآن کریم کا ایک نسخہ اپنے سر پر رکھیں اور کہیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ بِحَقِّ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنِ وَبِحَقِّ مَنْ اَرْسَلْتَهُ بِهِ
segs.en: O Allah, by the right of this Qur'an, and by the right of the one You sent with it,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA BI-HAQQI HAAZAL QUR-AANI WA BI-HAQQI MAN ARSALTAHU BIH

segs.ar: وَبِحَقِّ كُلِّ مُؤْمِنٍ مَدَحْتَهُ فِيْهِ وَبِحَقِّكَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَلَا اَحَدَ اَعْرَفُ بِحَقِّكَ مِنْكَ
segs.en: and by the right of every believer You have praised in it, and by Your right upon them — for no one knows Your right better than You.
segs.tr: WA BI-HAQQI KULLI MU'MININ MADAHTAHU FEEHI WA BI-HAQQIKA A'LAYHIM FALAA AHADA A'RAFU BI-HAQQIKA MINK

segs.note: Then repeat ten times:
segs.ur: پھر دس مرتبہ دہرائیں:

segs.ar: بِكَ يَاۤ اَللهُ بِمُحَمَّدٍ بِعَلِيٍّ بِفَاطِمَةَ بِالْحَسَنِ بِالْحُسَيْنِ بِعَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بِمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ بِجَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ بِمُوْسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ بِعَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوْسٰى بِمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ بِعَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ بِالْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ بِالْحُجَّةِ
segs.en: By You, O Allah; by Muhammad; by Ali; by Fatimah; by al-Hasan; by al-Husayn; by Ali ibn al-Husayn; by Muhammad ibn Ali; by Ja'far ibn Muhammad; by Musa ibn Ja'far; by Ali ibn Musa; by Muhammad ibn Ali; by Ali ibn Muhammad; by al-Hasan ibn Ali; by al-Hujjah.
segs.tr: BIKA YAA ALLAAHO BI-MUHAMMADIN BI-A'LEE-YIN BI-FAATIMATA BIL HASANI BIL HUSAYNI BI-A'LEE-YIBNIL HUSAYNI BI-MUHAMMADIBNI A'LEE-YIN BI-JA'FARIBNI MUHAMMADIN BI-MOOSAA IBNI JA'FARIN BI-A'LEE-YIBNI MOOSAA BI-MUHAMMADIBNI A'LEE-YIN BI-A'LEE-YIBNI MUHAMMADIN BIL HASANIBNI A'LEE-YIN BIL HUJJAH

segs.note: One should then pray Almighty Allah for the fulfillment of one's desires.
segs.ur: اس کے بعد اللہ تعالیٰ سے اپنی خواہشات پوری ہونے کی دعا کرنی چاہیے۔

segs.note: Dua Amsaytu Laka Abdan
segs.ur: دعا امسیتُ لک عبداً

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّىْ اَمْسَيْتُ لَكَ عَبْدًا دَاخِرًا لَا اَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِيْ نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا وَلَا اَصْرِفُ عَنْهَا سُوْۤءًا
segs.en: O Allah, I have entered this evening as Your humble servant, having no power to bring myself benefit or harm, nor to turn evil away from myself,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AMSAYTU LAKA A'BDAN DAAKHIRAN LAA AMLIKU LI-NAFSEE NAF-A'N WA LAA DARRAN WA LAA ASRIFU A'NHAA SOOO-AA

segs.ar: اَشْهَدُ بِذٰلِكَ عَلٰى نَفْسِيْ وَاَعْتَرِفُ لَكَ بِضَعْفِ قُوَّتِيْ وَقِلَّةِ حِيْلَتِيْ
segs.en: I bear witness to that against myself, and I confess to You the weakness of my strength and the paucity of my resource,
segs.tr: ASH-HADU BI-ZAALIKA A'LAA NAFSEE WA A'TARIFU LAKA BI-DA'FI QUWWATEE WA QILLATI HEELATEE

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاَنْجِزْ لِيْ مَا وَعَدْتَنِيْ وَجَمِيْعَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ مِنَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ
segs.en: so bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and fulfil for me — and for all the believing men and women — what You have promised of forgiveness on this night,
segs.tr: FASALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMADIN WA ANJIZ LEE MAA WA-A'DTANEE WA JAMEE-A'L MU'MINEENA WAL MU'MINAATI MINAL MAGHFIRATI FEE HAAZIHIL LAYLAH

segs.ar: وَاَتْمِمْ عَلَيَّ مَا اٰتَيْتَنِيْ فَاِنِّيْ عَبْدُكَ الْمِسْكِيْنُ الْمُسْتَكِيْنُ الضَّعِيْفُ الْفَقِيْرُ الْمَهِيْنُ
segs.en: and complete for me what You have given me, for I am Your poor, humble, weak, needy, lowly servant.
segs.tr: WA ATMIM A'LAYYA MAA AATAYTANEE FA-INNEE A'BDUKAL MISKEENUL MUSTAKEENUD DA-E'EFUL FAQEERUL MAHEEN

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْنِيْ نَاسِيًا لِذِكْرِكَ فِيْمَا اَوْلَيْتَنِيْ وَلَا لِاِحْسَانِكَ فِيْمَا اَعْطَيْتَنِيْ
segs.en: O Allah, do not make me forgetful of Your remembrance in what You have bestowed on me, nor of Your kindness in what You have given me,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA LAA TAJ-A'LNEE NAASIYAL LI-ZIKRIKA FEEMAA AWLAYTANEE WA LAA LI-IHSAANIKA FEEMAA A'TAYTANEE

segs.ar: وَلَا اٰيِسًا مِنْ اِجَابَتِكَ وَاِنْ اَبْطَاَتَ عَنِّيْ فِيْ سَرَّاۤءَ اَوْ ضَرَّاۤءَ اَوْ شِدَّةَ اَوْ رَخَاۤءَ
segs.en: nor despairing of Your response, even if it be delayed for me, whether in ease or hardship, in adversity or comfort,
segs.tr: WA LAA AAYISAM MIN IJAABATIKA WA IN ABTA-AT A'NNEE FEE SARRAAA-I AW DARRAAA-I AW SHIDDATIN AW RAKHAAA-I

segs.ar: اَوْ عَافِيَةٍ اَوْ بَلَاۤءٍ اَوْ بُؤْسٍ اَوْ نَعْمَاۤءَ اِنَّكَ سَمِيْعُ الدُّعَاۤءِ
segs.en: in well-being or trial, in misery or blessing; verily You are the Hearer of supplications.
segs.tr: AW A'AAFIYATIN AW BALAAA-IN AW BU'SIN AW NA'MAAA-I INNAKA SAMEE-U'D DUA-A'

A_AA29.merits:
Ghusl: According to Allamah al-Majlisi, it is preferable to perform the bathing at sunset so as to be ready for the Isha prayer with a bathing.

Two-unit prayer: According to a Hadith reported from the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.), Almighty Allah will forgive whoever offers this prayer, and will forgive his parents, before he leaves his place.

Ziyarat of Imam al-Husayn (a): A Hadith reads that at the Qadr Nights, a caller from the heavens calls out from the Seventh Sky, and specifically from the center of the Holy Throne, that Almighty Allah shall forgive whoever visits the tomb of al-Husayn (a).

Spending the nights in worship: A Hadith reads that whoever spends the whole Qadr Nights in worship will have all his sins forgiven, even if they are as many as the stars, as heavy as the mountains, and as weighty as the seawater.

One-hundred-unit prayer: it carries a remarkable reward.

Dua Amsaytu Laka Abdan: Al-Kaf'ami has narrated that Imam Zayn al-Abidin (a) used to say this supplicatory prayer very frequently at the Qadr Nights while sitting, standing, bowing, and prostrating.

Allamah al-Majlisi has mentioned that the most favorable rite at the Qadr Nights is to implore Almighty Allah's forgiveness, to mention Him, and to pray for the settlement of one's worldly and religious affairs as well as for one's parents, relatives, and brethren-in-faith — the dead and the living — and to invoke blessings upon the Holy Prophet and his Household.

Dua Jawshan al-Kabir: According to some narrations, it is recommended to recite Dua Jawshan al-Kabir at the three Qadr Nights.

It has also been narrated that when the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) was asked about the best prayer to say on the Qadr Night, he said, "Pray for good health."

segs.note: Repeat 100 times on the nineteenth night of Ramazan:
segs.ur: ماہِ رمضان کی انیسویں رات 100 مرتبہ دہرائیں:

segs.en: I implore Allah's forgiveness, my Lord, and I repent to Him.
segs.tr: ASTAGHFIRUL LAAHA RABBEE WA ATOOBU ILAYH.

segs.note: Repeat 100 times:
segs.ur: 100 مرتبہ دہرائیں:

segs.en: O Allah, curse the slayers of the Commander of the Faithful.

segs.note: Recite the dua that begins with "Ya dhal-ladhi kana qabla kulli shay".
segs.ur: وہ دعا پڑھیں جو ["یا ذا الذی کان قبل کل شیء"](AA19) سے شروع ہوتی ہے۔

segs.note: Also recite this dua:
segs.ur: نیز یہ دعا پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِيْمَا تَقْضِيْ وَتُقَدِّرُ مِنَ الْاَمْرِ الْمَحْتُوْمِ وَفِيْمَا تَفْرُقُ مِنَ الْاَمْرِ الْحَكِيْمِ فِيْ لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ وَفِي الْقَضَاۤءِ الَّذِيْ لَا يُرَدُّ وَلَا يُبَدَّلُ اَنْ تَكْتُبَنِيْ مِنْ حُجَّاجِ بَيْتِكَ الْحَرَامِ الْمَبْرُوْرِ حَجُّهُمُ الْمَشْكُوْرِ سَعْيُهُمُ، الْمَغْفُوْرِ ذُنُوْبُهُمُ، الْمُكَفَّرِ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُهُمْ، وَاجْعَلْ فِيْمَا تَقْضِيْ وَتُقَدِّرُ اَنْ تُطِيْلَ عُمْرِيْ، وَتُوَسِّعَ عَلَيَّ فِي رِزْقِيْ، وَتَفْعَلَ بِيْ۔
segs.en: O Allah, decide, among what You decree and ordain from the decisive matter, and what You apportion from the wise command on the Night of Decree, and in the destiny that is not reversed nor changed, to inscribe me among the pilgrims of Your Sacred House - whose pilgrimage is accepted, whose effort is thanked, whose sins are forgiven, and whose bad deeds are absolved - and decide, among what You decree and ordain, to prolong my life, to expand my sustenance, and to do with me...
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAJ A'L FEEMAA TAQDEE WA TUQADDIRU MINAL AMRIL MAHTOOMI WA FEEMAA TAFRUQU MINAL AMRIL HAKEEMI FEE LAYLATIL QADR, WA FIL QADAAA-IL LAZEE LAA YURADDU WA LAA YUBADDAL, AN TAKTUBANEE MIN HUJJAAJI BAYTIKAL HARAAMIL MABROORI HAJJUHUMUL MASHKOORI SA-I'YUHUM, AL-MAGHFOORI ZUNOOBUHUM, AL-MUKAFFARI A'NHUM SAYYI-AATUHUM, WAJ-A'L FEEMAA TAQDEE WA TUQADDIRU AN TUTEELA U'MREE, WA TUWASSI-A' A'LAYYA FEE RIZQEE, WA TAF-A'LA BEE.

segs.note: One may mention his desires after that.
segs.ur: اس کے بعد وہ اپنی حاجات بیان کر سکتا ہے۔

A_AA31.name: Aamal of the 21st Night of Ramazan

segs.note: Acts of the Night
Perform the Common Aamal at Each of the Three Qadr Nights. Ghusl and staying up the whole night in worship are especially stressed tonight and on the 23rd night.

These acts include visiting Imam al-Husayn (a.s.), a two-unit prayer with Surah al-Fatihah once and Surah al-Tawheed seven times in each unit, placing the Qur'an on the head with its dua, and Dua Jawshan Kabir.
Spending these nights in studying religious knowledge is also recommended.
From this night on, recite the duas of the Last Ten Nights of Ramazan. Ghusl on each of these nights and i'tikaf in the mosque are recommended.
Invoke blessings on the Holy Prophet and his Household as often as you can tonight, and curse those who wronged the Ahl al-Bayt and the killer of Amir al-Mu'minin (a.s.).
Dua of Sayyid Ibn Baqi

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.ar: وَاقْسِمْ لِي حِلْمًا يَسُدُّ عَنِّيْ بَابَ الْجَهْلِ
segs.en: and decide for me forbearance that blocks the door to ignorance against me,
segs.tr: WAQSIM LEE HILMAN YASUDDU A'NNEE BAABAL JAHL

segs.ar: وَهُدًى تَمُنُّ بِهٖ عَلَيَّ مِنْ كُلِّ ضَلَالَةٍ
segs.en: guidance that You confer upon me against any item of straying off,
segs.tr: WA HUDAN TAMUNNU BIHEE A'LAYYA MIN KULLI DALAALAH

segs.ar: وَغِنًى تَسُدُّ بِهٖ عَنِّيْ بَابَ كُلِّ فَقْرٍ
segs.en: affluence that blocks the door to all poverty against me,
segs.tr: WA GHINAN TASUDDU BIHEE A'NNEE BAABA KULLI FAQR

segs.ar: وَقُوَّةً تَرُدُّ بِهَا عَنِّي كُلَّ ضَعْفٍ
segs.en: power due to which You repel any weakness from me,
segs.tr: WA QUWWATAN TARUDDU BIHAA A'NNEE KULLA DA'F

segs.ar: وَعِزًّا تُكْرِمُنِيْ بِهٖ عَنْ كُلِّ ذُلٍّ
segs.en: might with which You honor me against all humiliation,
segs.tr: WA I'ZZAN TUKRIMUNEE BIHEE A'N KULLI DHULL

segs.ar: وَرِفْعَةً تَرْفَعُنِيْ بِهَا عَنْ كُلِّ ضَعَةٍ
segs.en: sublimity through which You exalt me against all humbleness,
segs.tr: WA RIF'ATAN TARFA'UNEE BIHAA A'N KULLI DA'AH

segs.ar: وَاَمْنًا تَرُدُّ بِهٖ عَنِّيْ كُلَّ خَوْفٍ
segs.en: security through which You protect me against any fear,
segs.tr: WA AMNAN TARUDDU BIHEE A'NNEE KULLA KHAWF

segs.ar: وَعَافِيَةً تَسْتُرُنِي بِهَا عَنْ كُلِّ بَلَاۤءٍ
segs.en: wellbeing by which You cover me against any ailment,
segs.tr: WA A'AFIYATAN TASTURUNEE BIHAA A'N KULLI BALAA'

segs.ar: وَعِلْمًا تَفْتَحُ لِيْ بِهٖ كُلَّ يَقِيْنٍ
segs.en: knowledge due to which You open before me all certitude,
segs.tr: WA I'LMAN TAFTAHOO LEE BIHEE KULLA YAQEEN

segs.ar: وَيَقِيْنًا تُذْهِبُ بِهٖ عَنِّيْ كُلَّ شَكٍّ
segs.en: certitude due to which You remove from me any doubt,
segs.tr: WA YAQEENAN TUDH-HIBU BIHEE A'NNEE KULLA SHAKK

segs.ar: وَدُعَاۤءً تَبْسُطُ لِيْ بِهِ الْاِجَابَةَ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَفِي هٰذِهِ السَّاعَةِ
segs.en: prayer through which You expand Your response to me at this very night and at this very hour,
segs.tr: WA DU'AA'AN TABSUTU LEE BIHIL IJAABATA FEE HAADHIHIL LAYLATI WA FEE HAADHIHIS SAA'AH

segs.en: this very hour, this very hour, this very hour, O All-generous,

segs.ar: وَخَوْفًا تَنْشُرُ لِيْ بِهٖ كُلَّ رَحْمَةٍ
segs.en: apprehension due to which You spread over me all items of mercy,
segs.tr: WA KHAWFAN TANSHURU LEE BIHEE KULLA RAHMAH

segs.ar: وَعِصْمَةً تَحُوْلُ بِهَا بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَ الذُّنُوْبِ
segs.en: and shelter due to which You intervene between my sins and me,
segs.tr: WA I'SMATAN TAHOOLU BIHAA BAYNEE WA BAYNADH DHUNOOB

segs.ar: حَتَّى اُفْلِحَ بِہَا عِنْدَ الْمَعْصُوْمِيْنَ عِنْدَكَ
segs.en: so that I shall succeed in the view of the Infallible ones with You,
segs.tr: HATTAA UFLIHA BIHAA I'NDAL MA'SOOMEENA I'NDAK

segs.en: in the name of Your mercy, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.

segs.note: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.)'s Dua in Sajdah
After the Fajr prayer and its taqibaat, go into sajdah and recite:

segs.ar: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوْبِ وَالْاَبْصَارِ
segs.en: There is no god save You, the Transformer of hearts and sights,
segs.tr: LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA MUQALLIBAL QULOOBI WAL ABSAAR

segs.ar: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ خالِقَ الْخَلْقِ
segs.en: There is no god save You, the Creator of the creatures,
segs.tr: LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA KHAALIQAL KHALQ

segs.en: While You do not need them.

segs.ar: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ مُبْدِئَ الْخَلْقِ
segs.en: There is no god save You, the Originator of the creation.
segs.tr: LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA MUBDI'AL KHALQ

segs.en: And nothing of creation decreases any of Your Kingdom.
segs.tr: WA LAA YANQUSU MIN MULKIKA SHAY'

segs.ar: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ بَاعِثَ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ
segs.en: There is no god save You, the Resurrector of those who are in graves.
segs.tr: LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA BAA'ITHA MAN FIL QUBOOR

segs.ar: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ مُدَبِّرَ الْاُمُورِ
segs.en: There is no god save You, the Manager of all affairs.
segs.tr: LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA MUDABBIRAL UMOOR

segs.ar: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ دَيَّانَ الدِّيْنِ وَجَبَّارَ الْجَبَابِرَةِ
segs.en: There is no god save You, the Judge of the religion and the most Omnipotent of all those who claim omnipotence.
segs.tr: LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA DAYYAANAD DEENI WA JABBAARAL JABAABIRAH

segs.ar: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ مُجْرِيَ الْمَاءِ فِي الصَّخْرَةِ الصَّمَّاءِ
segs.en: There is no god save You. It is You Who causes water to flow in hard rocks.
segs.tr: LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA MUJRIYAL MAA'I FIS SAKHRATIS SAMMAA'

segs.ar: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ مُجْرِيَ الْمَاءِ فِي النَّباتِ
segs.en: There is no god save You. It is You Who causes water to flow in plants.
segs.tr: LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA MUJRIYAL MAA'I FIN NABAAT

segs.ar: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ مُكَوِّنَ طَعْمِ الثِّمارِ
segs.en: There is no god save You, the Maker of the flavors of fruits.
segs.tr: LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA MUKAWWINA TA'MITH THIMAAR

segs.ar: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ مُحْصِيَ عَدَدِ الْقَطْرِ وَمَا تَحْمِلُهُ السَّحابُ
segs.en: There is no god save You. It is You Who keeps count of the number of the drops of rain and what is loaded by the clouds.
segs.tr: LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA MUHSIYA A'DADIL QATRI WA MAA TAHMILUHUS SAHAAB

segs.ar: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ مُحْصِيَ عَدَدِ ما تَجْرِي بِهِ الرِّياحُ فِي الْهَواءِ
segs.en: There is no god save You. It is You Who keeps count of the number of what the wind carry in the air.
segs.tr: LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA MUHSIYA A'DADI MAA TAJREE BIHIR REEHU FIL HAWAA'

segs.ar: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ مُحْصِيَ مَا فِي الْبِحَارِ مِنْ رَطْبٍ وَيَابِسٍ
segs.en: There is no god save You. It is You Who keeps count of what is there in oceans—the wet and the dry.
segs.tr: LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA MUHSIYA MAA FIL BIHAARI MIN RATBIN WA YAABIS

segs.ar: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ مُحْصِيَ ما يَدُبُّ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ الْبِحَارِ وَفِي اَطْباقِ الثَّرى
segs.en: There is no god save You. It is You Who keeps count of whatever creeps in the darknesses of oceans and in the layers of the earth.
segs.tr: LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA MUHSIYA MAA YADUBBU FEE ZULUMAATIL BIHAARI WA FEE ATBAAQITH THARAA

segs.ar: اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي سَمَّيْتَ بِهٖ نَفْسَكَ
segs.en: I beseech You by Your Name that You have used for Yourself
segs.tr: AS'ALUKA BISMIKAL LADHEE SAMMAYTA BIHEE NAFSAK

segs.ar: اَوِ اسْتَاْثَرْتَ بِهٖ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ
segs.en: Or You have stored for Yourself in the hidden knowledge of You.
segs.tr: AWIS TA'THARTA BIHEE FEE I'LMIL GHAYBI I'NDAK

segs.ar: وَاَسْاَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ سَمَّاكَ بِهٖ اَحَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segs.en: And I beseech You by every name that is ascribed to You by any of Your created beings:
segs.tr: WA AS'ALUKA BIKULLIS MIN SAMMAAKA BIHEE AHADUN MIN KHALQIK

segs.ar: مِنْ نَبِيٍّ اَوْ صِدِّيقٍ اَوْ شَهِيدٍ اَوْ اَحَدٍ مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِكَ
segs.en: Such as the Prophets, the veracious ones, the martyrs, or any of Your angels.
segs.tr: MIN NABIYYIN AW SIDDEEQIN AW SHAHEEDIN AW AHADIN MIN MALAA'IKATIK

segs.ar: وَاَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي اِذا دُعِيْتَ بِهٖ اَجَبْتَ
segs.en: And I beseech You by Your Name that You answer anyone who beseeches You by it,
segs.tr: WA AS'ALUKA BISMIKAL LADHEE IDHAA DU'EETA BIHEE AJABT

segs.en: And You respond to anyone who asks You by it.

segs.ar: وَاَسْاَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاَهْلِ بَيْتِهٖ صَلَواتُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَبَرَكاتُكَ
segs.en: And I beseech You in the name of the duty that is incumbent upon Muhammad and his Household—Your blessings and benedictions be upon them—toward You,
segs.tr: WA AS'ALUKA BIHAQQIKA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AHLI BAYTIHEE SALAWAATUKA A'LAYHIM WA BARAKAATUK

segs.en: And by the duty that You have made incumbent upon Yourself toward them,
segs.tr: WA BIHAQQIHIMUL LADHEE AWJABTAHOO A'LAA NAFSIK

segs.en: And through which You granted them Your favors,

segs.ar: اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ
segs.en: (please) bless Muhammad, Your servant and Your Messenger:
segs.tr: AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN A'BDIKA WA RASOOLIK

segs.en: The caller to You by Your permission,
And Your incandescent lantern from among Your servants
In Your lands and Your heavens,
And he whom You made mercy for the peoples,
And light through whom the believers have obtained their light;
He this conveyed to us the good tidings about Your abundant reward
And also warned us against Your painful chastisement.

segs.ar: اَشْهَدُ اَنَّهٗ قَدْ جَاءَ بِالْحَقِّ مِنْ عِنْدِ الْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
segs.en: I bear witness that he carried to us the truth from the True God, and he verified the Messengers.
segs.tr: ASH-HADU ANNAHOO QAD JAA'A BIL HAQQI MIN I'NDIL HAQQI WA SADDAQAL MURSALEEN

segs.ar: وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوهُ ذَائِقُو الْعَذَابِ الْاَلِيمِ
segs.en: And I bear witness that those who belied him shall certainly taste the painful chastisement.
segs.tr: WA ASH-HADU ANNAL LADHEENA KADHDHABOOHU DHAA'IQUL A'DHAABIL ALEEM

segs.ar: اَسْاَلُكَ يا اللهُ يا اَللهُ يا اَللهُ
segs.en: I beseech You, O Allah; O Allah; O Allah;
segs.tr: AS'ALUKA YALLAAHU YAA ALLAAHU YAA ALLAAH

segs.ar: يا رَبَّاهُ يا رَبَّاهُ يا رَبَّاهُ
segs.en: O our God; O our God; O our God;
segs.tr: YAA RABBAAHU YAA RABBAAHU YAA RABBAAH

segs.ar: يا سَيِّدِي يا سَيِّدِي يا سَيِّدِي
segs.en: O my Master; O my Master; O my Master;
segs.tr: YAA SAYYIDEE YAA SAYYIDEE YAA SAYYIDEE

segs.ar: يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا مَوْلَايَ
segs.en: O my Lord; O my Lord; O my Lord.
segs.tr: YAA MAWLAAYA YAA MAWLAAYA YAA MAWLAAY

segs.ar: اَسْاَلُكَ فِي هٰذِهِ الْغَداةِ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: I beseech You in this early morning to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: AS'ALUKA FEE HAADHIHIL GHADAATI AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَجْعَلَنِي مِنْ اَوْفَرِ عِبادِكَ وَسَائِلِيْكَ نَصِيْباً
segs.en: And to include me with Your servants and beseechers upon whom You confer the most abundant of Your rewards,
segs.tr: WA AN TAJ'ALANEE MIN AWFARI I'BAADIKA WA SAA'ILEEKA NASEEBAA

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَمُنَّ عَلَيَّ بِفَكَاكِ رَقَبَتِي مِنَ النَّارِ
segs.en: And to confer upon me with releasing me from Hellfire,
segs.tr: WA AN TAMUNNA A'LAYYA BIFAKAAKI RAQABATEE MINAN NAAR

segs.en: O the most Merciful of all those who show mercy.

segs.ar: وَاَسْاَلُكَ بِجَمِيْعِ ما سَاَلْتُكَ وَمَا لَمْ اَسْاَلْكَ مِنْ عَظِيْمِ جَلَالِكَ
segs.en: And I beseech You to settle for me all that which I asked from You and also all that which I did not ask from You; that which belongs to Your splendid majesty,
segs.tr: WA AS'ALUKA BIJAMEE'I MAA SA'ALTUKA WA MAA LAM AS'ALKA MIN A'ZEEMI JALAALIK

segs.en: That which I would ask from You if I knew it,

segs.ar: اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاَهْلِ بَيْتِهٖ
segs.en: (and I beseech You to) send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household,
segs.tr: AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AHLI BAYTIH

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَاْذَنَ لِفَرَجِ مَنْ بِفَرَجِهٖ فَرَجُ اَوْلِيَائِكَ وَاَصْفِيَائِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segs.en: And to permit the Relief of him whose relief achieves the relief of Your intimate servants and Your select ones from among Your created beings,
segs.tr: WA AN TA'DHANA LIFARAJI MAN BIFARAJIHEE FARAJU AWLIYAA'IKA WA ASFIYAA'IKA MIN KHALQIK

segs.en: And through whom You will terminate and eradicate the oppressors.
segs.tr: WA BIHEE TUBEEDUZ ZAALIMEENA WA TUHLIKUHUM

segs.en: (Please) hasten that, O the Lord of the worlds.

segs.ar: وَاَعْطِنِي سُؤْلِي يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْاِكْرامِ
segs.en: And (please) grant me my requests, O the Lord of majesty and honor,
segs.tr: WA A'TINEE SU'LEE YAA DHAL JALAALI WAL IKRAAM

segs.ar: فِي جَمِيعِ ما سَاَلْتُكَ لِعاجِلِ الدُّنْيا وَاٰجِلِ الْاٰخِرَةِ
segs.en: As regarding all that which I have asked You from my needs for this worldly life and the Hereafter.
segs.tr: FEE JAMEE'I MAA SA'ALTUKA LI'AAJILID DUNYAA WA AAJILIL AAKHIRAH

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ هُوَ اَقْرَبُ اِلَيَّ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ اَقِلْنِي عَثْرَتِي
segs.en: O He Who is nearer to me than my life-vein: (Please) overlook my slips,
segs.tr: YAA MAN HUWA AQRABU ILAYYA MIN HABLIL WAREEDI AQILNEE A'THRATEE

segs.en: And revive me through settling my needs.

segs.ar: يَا خَالِقِي وَيَا رَازِقي وَيَا بَاعِثِي
segs.en: O my Creator; O the Source of my sustenance; O my Resurrector;
segs.tr: YAA KHAALIQEE WA YAA RAAZIQEE WA YAA BAA'ITH

segs.en: O He Who shall give life to my bones when they are rotten:
segs.tr: WA YAA MUHYEE I'ZAAMEE WA HIYA RAMEEM

segs.en: (Please do) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.ar: وَاسْتَجِبْ لِي دُعَائِي يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
segs.en: And respond to my prayer; O the most Merciful of all those who show mercy.
segs.tr: WASTAJIB LEE DU'AA'EE YAA ARHAMAR RAAHIMEEN

A_AA31.merits:
The twenty-first night of Ramadan is more meritorious than the nineteenth. According to narrations, it is strongly advisable to do the bathing and to spend the whole night with painstaking acts of worship at this night as well as the twenty-third, since the real Qadr Night is one of these two nights.

When the Holy Infallibles (a.s.) were asked to specify the Qadr Night, they did not specify; rather they used to say, "It is too easy to act at two nights in order to win one's desire." They also used to say, "What will harm you if you do righteously at two nights?"

Dictating to his students, Shaykh al-Saduq said in one of his sessions, "It is preferable to spend these two nights with studying the religious knowledge."

Dua of Sayyid Ibn Baqi: Al-Kaf'ami has quoted Sayyid Ibn Baqi as saying that it is recommended to say this supplicatory prayer at the twenty-first night of Ramadan.

Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.)'s Dua in Sajdah: It has been narrated that Ali ibn Hammad visited Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a.s.) at the twenty-first night of Ramadan. "Have you bathed yourself, Hammad?" asked the Imam. "Yes, I have," answered Hammad. The Imam (a.s.) then asked him to stand by him so as to imitate him in offering prayers. Hammad did. When they finished all the prayers, the Imam (a.s.) began to supplicate and Hammad listened and prayed for response.

When dawn rose, the Imam (a.s.) declared the adhan (call to prayer), uttered the iqamah (the prefatory part of prayers), and then summoned one of his servants to participate in the prayer. They all stood behind the Imam (a.s.) who led their congregational Fajr (dawn) Prayer reciting Surahs al-Faatehah and al-Qadr in the first unit and Surahs al-Faatehah and al-Tawheed in the second.

When he finished the post-prayer litanies and doxologies (zikr), praising Him, venerating Him, thanking Him, invoking His blessings upon the Holy Prophet and his Household, and praying Him for the good of all the believing men and women as well as all the Muslims, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) prostrated himself. The companions could not hear anything except the Imam's breaths for a long time. Hammad narrated: I could then hear him saying this supplication. This long supplicatory prayer has been mentioned by Sayyid Ibn Tawus in his book of Iqbal al-A'mal.

Al-Kulayni has narrated that Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (a.s.) used to supplicate Almighty Allah at the twenty-first and twenty-third nights of Ramadan up to midnight. After that, he would offer prayers.

As for the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.), it has been narrated that he used to bathe himself at each of the last ten nights of Ramadan.

Being the best time of I'tikaf (the ritual seclusion in places of worship for practicing acts of worship), it is highly recommended to practice the ritual I'tikaf at the last ten nights of Ramadan, for this deed brings about an abundant reward. According to narrations, its reward is as same as the reward of two times of Hajj and two times of 'Umrah. In this regard, it is reported that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.), at the last ten nights of Ramadan, used to confine himself to the mosque where a dome made of camel hair would be erected for him while he would roll up his bed and prepare himself for worship.

It is worth mentioning that at the twenty-first night of Ramadan, the sadnesses of the Shi'ah should be shown. At the twenty-first night of Ramadan, AH 40, Imam Ali ibn Abi-Talib, Ameer al-Momineen - peace be upon him - departed life as martyr. It is narrated that fresh blood would be found under any rock that was lifted at that night. The same thing happened at the night of Imam al-Husayn's martyrdom.

Shaykh al-Mufid says: At this night, it is highly recommended, as frequently as possible, to invoke Almighty Allah's blessings upon the Holy Prophet and his Household and to invoke His curse upon those who have wronged the Ahl al-Bayt and upon the killer of Imam Ali Ameer al-Momineen.

A_AA32.name: Aamal of the Last Ten Nights of Ramazan

segs.note: Dua A'udhu bi-Jalali Wajhik
From the 21st night on, recite these duas on each of the last ten nights of Ramazan.

segs.ar: اَعُوْذُ بِجَلَالِ وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيْمِ اَنْ يَنْقَضِيَ عَنِّي شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ
segs.en: I seek the protection of the Majesty of Your Honorable Face against that the month of Ramadan elapses
segs.tr: A'OODHU BIJALAALI WAJHIKAL KAREEMI AN YANQADIYA A'NNEE SHAHRU RAMADAAN

segs.ar: اَوْ يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ مِنْ لَيْلَتِيْ هٰذِهِ وَلَكَ قِبَلِيْ ذَنْبٌ اَوْ تَبِعَةٌ تُعَذِّبُنِيْ عَلَيْهِ
segs.en: or dawn puts an end to this night but there is still an offense or a sin for which I am still liable and for which You will punish me.
segs.tr: AW YATLU'AL FAJRU MIN LAYLATEE HAADHIHEE WA LAKA QIBALEE DHANBUN AW TABI'ATUN TU'ADHDHIBUNEE A'LAYH

segs.note: Allahumma Addi Anna
After the obligatory and nafilah prayers, recite:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَدِّ عَنَّا حَقَّ مَا مَضٰى مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا تَقْصِيْرَنَا فِيْهِ
segs.en: O Allah, (please) help us fulfill the right of the past days of the month of Ramadan, forgive us our shortcoming during it
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA ADDI A'NNAA HAQQA MAA MADAA MIN SHAHRI RAMADAANA WAGHFIR LANAA TAQSEERANAA FEEH

segs.ar: وَتَسَلَّمْهُ مِنَّا مَقْبُوْلًا، وَلَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا بِاِسْرَافِنَا عَلٰى اَنْفُسِنَا
segs.en: receive it from us with acceptance, do not blame us for our extravagance in our affairs
segs.tr: WA TASALLAMHU MINNAA MAQBOOLAN WA LAA TU'AAKHIDHNAA BI-ISRAAFINAA A'LAA ANFUSINAA

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمَرْحُوْمِيْنَ وَلَا تَجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمَحْرُوْمِيْنَ
segs.en: include us with those upon whom mercy is had, and do not include us with those deprived (of the awards of Ramadan).
segs.tr: WAJ'ALNAA MINAL MARHOOMEENA WA LAA TAJ'ALNAA MINAL MAHROOMEEN

segs.note: Dua Allahumma Innaka Qulta

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّكَ قُلْتَ فِيْ كِتَابِكَ الْمُنْزَلِ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِيْ اُنْزِلَ فِيْهِ الْقُرْاٰنُ هُدًى لِلنَّاسِ وَبَيِّنَاتٍ مِنَ الْهُدٰى وَالْفُرْقَانِ
segs.en: O Allah, You have said in Your revealed Book: “The month of Ramadan is that in which the Qur'an was revealed, a guidance to men and clear proofs of the guidance and the distinction.”
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNAKA QULTA FEE KITAABIKAL MUNZALI SHAHRU RAMADAANAL LADHEE UNZILA FEEHIL QUR'AANU HUDAN LIN NAASI WA BAYYINAATIN MINAL HUDAA WAL FURQAAN

segs.ar: فَعَظَّمْتَ حُرْمَةَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ بِمَا اَنْزَلْتَ فِيْهِ مِنَ الْقُرْاٰنِ، وَخَصَصْتَهٗ بِلَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ وَجَعَلْتَهَا خَيْرًا مِنْ اَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
segs.en: You have thus rendered great the sanctity of this month of Ramadan, because You revealed the Qur'an in it, decided the Destiny Night to be in this month exclusively, and made it better than one thousand months.
segs.tr: FA'AZZAMTA HURMATA SHAHRI RAMADAANA BIMAA ANZALTA FEEHI MINAL QUR'AANI WA KHASASTAHOO BILAYLATIL QADRI WA JA'ALTAHAA KHAYRAN MIN ALFI SHAHR

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَهٰذِهِ اَيَّامُ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ قَدِ انْقَضَتْ، وَلَيَالِيْهِ قَدْ تَصَرَّمَتْ
segs.en: O Allah, the days of the month of Ramadan are elapsing, its nights are also elapsing
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WA HAADHIHEE AYYAAMU SHAHRI RAMADAANA QADIN QADAT WA LAYAALEEHI QAD TASARRAMAT

segs.ar: وَقَدْ صِرْتُ يَا اِلٰهِيْ مِنْهُ اِلٰى مَا اَنْتَ اَعْلَمُ بِهٖ مِنِّي وَاَحْصٰى لِعَدَدِهٖ مِنَ الْخَلْقِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ
segs.en: while I have become in the state that You, O my God, know better than I do, and You can count it more precisely than all the created beings.
segs.tr: WA QAD SIRTU YAA ILAAHEE MINHU ILAA MAA ANTA A'LAMU BIHEE MINNEE WA AHSAA LI-A'DADIHEE MINAL KHALQI AJMA'EEN

segs.ar: فَاَسْاَلُكَ بِمَا سَاَلَكَ بِهٖ مَلَآئِكَتُكَ الْمُقَرَّبُوْنَ وَاَنْبِيَآؤُكَ الْمُرْسَلُوْنَ، وَعِبَادُكَ الصَّالِحُوْنَ
segs.en: So, I beseech You in the name of that by which Your favorite angels, Your missioned Prophets, and Your righteous servants have besought You
segs.tr: FA-AS'ALUKA BIMAA SA'ALAKA BIHEE MALAA'IKATUKAL MUQARRABOONA WA ANBIYAA'UKAL MURSALOONA WA I'BAADUKAS SAALIHOON

segs.ar: اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاَنْ تَفُكَّ رَقَبَتِيْ مِنَ النَّارِ، وَتُدْخِلَنِيْ الْجَنَّةَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ
segs.en: to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, release me from Hellfire, allow me to enter Paradise by Your mercy
segs.tr: AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMADIN WA AN TAFUKKA RAQABATEE MINAN NAARI WA TUDKHILANIL JANNATA BIRAHMATIK

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيَّ بِعَفْوِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ وَتَتَقَبَّلَ تَقَرُّبِيْ وَتَسْتَجِيْبَ دُعَآئِيْ
segs.en: confer upon me with Your pardon and Your generosity, accept my seeking of nearness to You, respond to my prayer
segs.tr: WA AN TATAFADDALA A'LAYYA BI-A'FWIKA WA KARAMIKA WA TATAQABBALA TAQARRUBEE WA TASTAJEEBA DU'AA'EE

segs.ar: وَتَمُنَّ عَلَيَّ بِالْاَمْنِ يَوْمَ الْخَوْفِ مِنْ كُلِّ هَوْلٍ اَعْدَدْتَهٗ لِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
segs.en: and bestow upon me with security on the Day of Dread against all the horrors that You have prepared for the Resurrection Day.
segs.tr: WA TAMUNNA A'LAYYA BIL AMNI YAWMAL KHAWFI MIN KULLI HAWLIN A'DADTAHOO LIYAWMIL QIYAAMAH

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ وَاَعُوْذُ بِوَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيْمِ، وَبِجَلَالِكَ الْعَظِيْمِ اَنْ يَنْقَضِيَ اَيَّامُ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَلَيَالِيْهِ وَلَكَ قِبَلِيْ تَبِعَةٌ اَوْ ذَنْبٌ تُؤَاخِذُنِيْ بِهٖ
segs.en: O my God, I seek the protection of Your Noble Face and Your Great Majesty against that the days and nights of the month of Ramadan elapse while there is still a sin or an offense for which You may punish me
segs.tr: ILAAHEE WA A'OODHU BIWAJHIKAL KAREEMI WA BIJALAALIKAL A'ZEEMI AN YANQADIYA AYYAAMU SHAHRI RAMADAANA WA LAYAALEEHI WA LAKA QIBALEE TABI'ATUN AW DHANBUN TU'AAKHIDHUNEE BIH

segs.ar: اَوْ خَطِيْئَةٌ تُرِيْدُ اَنْ تَقْتَصَّهَا مِنِّيْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْهَا لِيْ
segs.en: or a wrongdoing for which You want to chastise me and You have not yet forgiven them for me.
segs.tr: AW KHATEE'ATUN TUREEDU AN TAQTASSAHAA MINNEE LAM TAGHFIRHAA LEE

segs.en: O my Master! O my Master! O my Master!

segs.ar: اَسْاَلُكَ يَا لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ اِذْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ
segs.en: I beseech You, O He save Whom there is no god, since there is indeed no god save You
segs.tr: AS'ALUKA YAA LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA IDH LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANT

segs.ar: اِنْ كُنْتَ رَضِيْتَ عَنِّي فِيْ هٰذَا الشَّهْرِ فَازْدَدْ عَنِّيْ رِضًا
segs.en: if You have been pleased with me in this month, then (please) increase Your satisfaction with me
segs.tr: IN KUNTA RADEETA A'NNEE FEE HAADHASH SHAHRI FAZDAD A'NNEE RIDAA

segs.ar: وَاِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ رَضِيْتَ عَنِّي فَمِنَ الْاٰنَ فَارْضَ عَنِّيْ
segs.en: but if You have not been pleased with me, then (please) be satisfied with me from this moment.
segs.tr: WA IN LAM TAKUN RADEETA A'NNEE FAMINAL AANA FARDA A'NNEE

segs.ar: يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ، يَا اَللهُ يَا اَحَدُ يَا صَمَدُ
segs.en: O most Merciful of all those who show mercy! O Allah! O One and Only! O Besought of all!
segs.tr: YAA ARHAMAR RAAHIMEENA YAA ALLAAHU YAA AHADU YAA SAMAD

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُوْلَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهٗ كُفُوًا اَحَدٌ
segs.en: O He Who begets not, nor is He begotten, and none is like Him!
segs.tr: YAA MAN LAM YALID WA LAM YOOLAD WA LAM YAKUN LAHOO KUFUWAN AHAD

segs.note: Dua Ya Mulayyin al-Hadid
Recite as many times as you can:

segs.ar: يَا مُلَيِّنَ الْحَدِيْدِ لِدَاوُدَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
segs.en: O He Who made the iron pliant for (Prophet) David, peace be upon him!
segs.tr: YAA MULAYYINAL HADEEDI LIDAAWUDA A'LAYHIS SALAAM

segs.ar: يَا كَاشِفَ الضُّرِّ وَالْكُرَبِ الْعِظَامِ عَنْ اَيُّوْبَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
segs.en: O He Who took off the harm and calamity that afflict (Prophet) Job, peace be upon him!
segs.tr: YAA KAASHIFAD DURRI WAL KURABIL I'ZAAMI A'N AYYOOBA A'LAYHIS SALAAM

segs.ar: اَيْ مُفَرِّجَ هَمِّ يَعْقُوْبَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
segs.en: O He Who relieved the sorrow of (Prophet) Jacob, peace be upon him!
segs.tr: AY MUFARRIJA HAMMI YA'QOOBA A'LAYHIS SALAAM

segs.ar: اَيْ مُنَفِّسَ غَمِّ يُوْسُفَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
segs.en: O He Who removed the grief of (Prophet) Joseph, peace be upon him!
segs.tr: AY MUNAFFISA GHAMMI YOOSUFA A'LAYHIS SALAAM

segs.ar: صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا اَنْتَ اَهْلُهٗ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ
segs.en: (Please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad as exactly as You are worth blessing them all
segs.tr: SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMADIN KAMAA ANTA AHLUHOO AN TUSALLIYA A'LAYHIM AJMA'EEN

segs.ar: وَافْعَلْ بِيْ مَا اَنْتَ اَهْلُهٗ وَلَا تَفْعَلْ بِيْ مَا اَنَا اَهْلُهٗ
segs.en: do to me that which befits You, and do not do to me that which I deserve.
segs.tr: WAF'AL BEE MAA ANTA AHLUHOO WA LAA TAF'AL BEE MAA ANAA AHLUH

segs.note: 21st Night: Ya Mulij al-Layl
On the 21st night, recite:

segs.ar: يَا مُوْلِجَ اللَّيْلِ فِي النَّهَارِ، وَمُوْلِجَ النَّهَارِ فِي اللَّيْلِ
segs.en: O He Who causes the night to enter into the day, causes the day to enter into the night
segs.tr: YAA MOOLIJAL LAYLI FIN NAHAARI WA MOOLIJAN NAHAARI FIL LAYL

segs.ar: وَمُخْرِجَ الْحَيِّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ، وَمُخْرِجَ الْمَيِّتِ مِنَ الْحَيِّ
segs.en: brings forth the living from the dead, and brings forth the dead from the living!
segs.tr: WA MUKHRIJAL HAYYI MINAL MAYYITI WA MUKHRIJAL MAYYITI MINAL HAYY

segs.ar: يَا رَازِقَ مَنْ يَشَاۤءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
segs.en: O He Who gives sustenance to whomever He please without measure!
segs.tr: YAA RAAZIQA MAN YASHAA'U BIGHAYRI HISAAB

segs.ar: يَا اَللهُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ، يَا اَللهُ يَا رَحِيْمُ، يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ
segs.en: O Allah! O All-beneficent! O Allah! O All-merciful! O Allah! O Allah! O Allah!
segs.tr: YAA ALLAAHU YAA RAHMAANU YAA ALLAAHU YAA RAHEEMU YAA ALLAAHU YAA ALLAAHU YAA ALLAAH

segs.ar: لَكَ الْاَسْمَاۤءُ الْحُسْنٰى، وَالْاَمْثَالُ الْعُلْيَا، وَالْكِبْرِيَاۤءُ وَالْاٰلَاۤءُ
segs.en: To You are the Most Excellent Names, the most elevated examples, greatness, and bounties.
segs.tr: LAKAL ASMAA'UL HUSNAA WAL AMTHAALUL U'LYAA WAL KIBRIYAA'U WAL AALAA'

segs.ar: اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: I beseech You to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: AS'ALUKA AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَجْعَلَ اسْمِيْ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ فِي السُّعَدَاۤءِ، وَرُوْحِيْ مَعَ الشُّهَدَاۤءِ
segs.en: include my name with the list of the happiest ones, add my soul to the martyrs
segs.tr: WA AN TAJ'ALAS MEE FEE HAADHIHIL LAYLATI FIS SU'ADAA'I WA ROOHEE MA'ASH SHUHADAA'

segs.en: record my good deeds in the most exalted rank, decide my offense to be forgiven
segs.tr: WA IHSAANEE FEE I'LLIYYEENA WA ISAA'ATEE MAGHFOORAH

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَهَبَ لِيْ يَقِيْنًا تُبَاشِرُ بِهٖ قَلْبِيْ، وَاِيْمَانًا يُذْهِبُ الشَّكَّ عَنِّي
segs.en: grant me certitude that fills in my heart and faith that removes doubt from me
segs.tr: WA AN TAHABA LEE YAQEENAN TUBAASHIRU BIHEE QALBEE WA EEMAANAN YUDH-HIBUSH SHAKKA A'NNEE

segs.en: make me feel satisfied with that which You decide for me

segs.ar: وَاٰتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً، وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً، وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الْحَرِيْقِ
segs.en: grant us reward in this world and reward in the Hereafter, save us from the torment of the burning Fire
segs.tr: WA AATINAA FID DUNYAA HASANATAN WA FIL AAKHIRATI HASANATAN WA QINAA A'DHAABAN NAARIL HAREEQ

segs.ar: وَارْزُقْنِيْ فِيْهَا ذِكْرَكَ وَشُكْرَكَ وَالرَّغْبَةَ اِلَيْكَ، وَالْاِنَابَةَ وَالتَّوْفِيْقَ لِمَا وَفَّقْتَ لَهٗ مُحَمَّدًا وَاٰلَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ
segs.en: and confer upon us at this night Your mentioning, thanking You, desiring for You, turning to You, and success to that to which You led Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, peace be upon him and them.
segs.tr: WARZUQNEE FEEHAA DHIKRAKA WA SHUKRAKA WAR RAGHBATA ILAYKA WAL INAABATA WAT TAWFEEQA LIMAA WAFFAQTA LAHOO MUHAMMADAN WA AALA MUHAMMADIN A'LAYHI WA A'LAYHIMUS SALAAM

A_AA32.merits:
Dua A'udhu bi-Jalali Wajhik: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni has reported Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a.s.) as saying: At the last ten nights of Ramadan, you may say this supplicatory prayer.

Allahumma Addi Anna: As a footnote in al-Balad al-Amin, al-Kaf'ami has mentioned that Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a.s.) used to say this supplicatory prayer at each of the last ten nights of Ramadan after the obligatory and supererogatory (mustahab / nafilah) prayers. He adds that Almighty Allah will forgive one who says this supplicatory prayer all the sins that he has committed in the past days of Ramadan and will protect him against sinning in the rest of it.

Dua Allahumma Innaka Qulta: In Iqbal al-A'mal, Sayyid Ibn Tawus has narrated on the authority of Ibn Abi-'Umayr on the authority of Murazim that Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a.s.) used to say this supplicatory prayer at each of the last ten nights of Ramadan.

21st Night: Ya Mulij al-Layl: Shaykh al-Kulayni, in al-Kafi, has narrated, with a complete chain of authority, that this supplicatory prayer, which is also narrated in al-Muqni'ah and al-Misbah yet with an interruption in the chain of authority, should be said at the twenty-first night of Ramadan.

A_AA33.name: Dua on the 22nd Night of Ramazan

segs.ar: يَا سَالِخَ النَّهَارِ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَاِذَا نَحْنُ مُظْلِمُوْنَ وَمُجْرِي الشَّمْسِ لِمُسْتَقَرِّهَا بِتَقْدِيْرِكَ يَا عَزِيْزُ يَا عَلِيْمُ
segs.en: O He Who draws forth daylight from night, and we are then in darkness, and Who makes the sun run to its resting place by Your decree — O Mighty, O Knowing,
segs.tr: YAA SAALIKHAN NAHAARA MINAL LAYLI FA-IZAA NAHNU MUZLIMOON, WA MUJRISH SHAMSI LI-MUSTAQARRIHAA BI-TAQDEERIK, YAA A'ZEEZU YAA A'LEEM

segs.ar: وَمُقَدِّرَ الْقَمَرِ مَنَازِلَ حَتّٰى عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُوْنِ الْقَدِيْمِ يَا نُوْرَ كُلِّ نُوْرٍ وَمُنْتَهٰى كُلِّ رَغْبَةٍ وَوَلِىَّ كُلِّ نِعْمَةٍ
segs.en: and Who ordained for the moon its phases until it returns like an old dry palm-branch — O Light of every light, O ultimate goal of every desire, O Guardian of every blessing,
segs.tr: WA MUQADDIRAL QAMARI MANAAZILA HATTAA A'ADA KAL U'RJOONIL QADEEM, YAA NOORA KULLI NOOR WA MUNTAHAA KULLI RAGHBAH WA WALIYYA KULLI NI'MAH

segs.ar: يَا اَللهُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا اَللهُ يَا قُدُّوْسُ يَا اَحَدُ يَا وَاحِدُ يَا فَرْدُ يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ لَكَ الْاَسْمَاۤءُ الْحُسْنٰى وَالْاَمْثَالُ الْعُلْيَا وَالْكِبْرِيَاۤءُ وَالْاٰلَاۤءُ
segs.en: O Allah, O All-beneficent; O Allah, O Holy; O One, O Single, O Unique; O Allah, O Allah, O Allah — to You belong the Most Excellent Names, the most exalted attributes, greatness, and bounties.
segs.tr: YAA ALLAAH YAA RAHMAAN, YAA ALLAAH YAA QUDDOOS, YAA AHADU YAA WAAHIDU YAA FARD, YAA ALLAAH YAA ALLAAH YAA ALLAAH, LAKAL ASMAAA-UL HUSNAA WAL AMTHAALUL U'LYAA WAL KIBRIYAAA-U WAL AALAAA-U

segs.ar: اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاَهْلِ بَيْتِهٖ وَاَنْ تَجْعَلَ اسْمِيْ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ فِي السُّعَدَاۤءِ وَرُوْحِيْ مَعَ الشُّهَدَاۤءِ وَاِحْسَانِيْ فِيْ عِلِّيِّيْنَ وَاِسَاۤءَتِيْ مَغْفُوْرَةً
segs.en: I ask You to bless Muhammad and the people of his household, and to include my name this night among the happy ones, my soul with the martyrs, my good deeds in the highest Illiyyin, and my wrongdoing forgiven,
segs.tr: AS-ALUKA AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AHLI BAYTIHI WA AN TAJ-A'LAS-MEE FEE HAAZIHIL LAYLATI FIS SU-A'DAAA-I WA ROOHEE MA-A'SH SHUHADAAA-I WA IHSAANEE FEE I'LLIYYEEN WA ISAAA-ATEE MAGHFOORAH

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَهَبَ لِيْ يَقِيْنًا تُبَاشِرُ بِهٖ قَلْبِيْ وَاِيْمَانًا يُذْهِبُ الشَّكَّ عَنِّيْ وَتُرْضِيَنِيْ بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِيْ وَاٰتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الْحَرِيْقِ
segs.en: and to grant me certitude that fills my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and to make me content with what You have apportioned for me; and grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the torment of the burning Fire,
segs.tr: WA AN TAHABA LEE YAQEENAN TUBAASHIRU BIHI QALBEE WA EEMAANAN YUZHIBUSH SHAKKA A'NNEE WA TURDIYANEE BIMAA QASAMTA LEE, WA AATINAA FID DUNYAA HASANATAN WA FIL AAKHIRATI HASANATAN WA QINAA A'ZAABAN NAARIL HAREEQ

segs.ar: وَارْزُقْنِيْ فِيْهَا ذِكْرَكَ وَشُكْرَكَ وَالرَّغْبَةَ اِلَيْكَ وَالْاِنَابَةَ وَالتَّوْفِيْقَ لِمَا وَفَّقْتَ لَهٗ مُحَمَّدًا وَاٰلَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ
segs.en: and grant me this night Your remembrance and Your thanks, and desire for You, and turning to You in repentance, and success in that to which You granted success to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, peace be upon them.
segs.tr: WARZUQNEE FEEHAA ZIKRAKA WA SHUKRAKA WAR RAGHBATA ILAYKA WAL INAABATA WAT TAWFEEQA LIMAA WAFFAQTA LAHU MUHAMMADAN WA AALA MUHAMMADIN A'LAYHIMUS SALAAM

A_AA34.name: 23rd Night of Ramazan

segs.note: Surahs of the Night
segs.ur: رات کی سورتیں

segs.note: These are recommended on the twenty-third night, in addition to the aamal common to all three Qadr Nights.
segs.ur: یہ اعمال تیئیسویں شب کو [تینوں شبہائے قدر کے مشترک اعمال](AA29) کے علاوہ مستحب ہیں۔

segs.note: Recite Surah al-Ankabut and Surah al-Rum.
segs.ur: [سورہ عنکبوت](A33) اور [سورہ روم](A34) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Recite Surah al-Dukhan.
segs.ur: [سورہ دخان](A48) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Recite Surah al-Qadr a thousand times.
segs.ur: [سورہ قدر](A101) ایک ہزار مرتبہ پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Dua for Imam al-Mahdi (a.t.f.s.)
segs.ur: امام مہدی (عج) کے لیے دعا

segs.note: Repeat this famous supplication as many times as possible this night:
segs.ur: اس مشہور دعا کو اس رات جتنا ممکن ہو دہرائیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ كُنْ لِوَلِيِّكَ الْحُجَّةِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى اٰبَآئِهِ فِي هٰذِهِ السَّاعَةِ وَفِيْ كُلِّ سَاعَةٍ
segs.en: O Allah, be for Your representative, the Proof, son of al-Hasan — Your blessings upon him and his forefathers — in this hour and in every hour,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA KUN LI-WALIYYIKAL HUJJATIBNIL HASANI SALAWAATUKA A'LAYHI WA A'LAA AABAAA-IHI FEE HAAZIHIS SAAA-A'TI WA FEE KULLI SAAA-A'H

segs.ar: وَلِيًّا وَحَافِظًا وَقَآئِدًا وَنَاصِرًا وَدَلِيْلًا وَعَيْنًا حَتّٰى تُسْكِنَهُ اَرْضَكَ طَوْعًا وَتُمَتِّعَهُ فِيْهَا طَوِيْلًا
segs.en: a guardian, a protector, a leader, a helper, a guide, and an eye, until You settle him on Your earth willingly, and let him enjoy it for a long time.
segs.tr: WALIYYAW WA HAAFIZAW WA QAAA-IDAW WA NAASIRAW WA DALEELAW WA A'YNAN HATTAA TUSKINAHU ARDAKA TAWA'AW WA TUMATTI-A'HU FEEHAA TAWEELAA

segs.note: Dua for Life, Provision & Fortune
segs.ur: زندگی، رزق اور نصیب کے لیے دعا

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ امْدُدْ لِي فِي عُمْرِيْ وَاَوْسِعْ لِي فِي رِزْقِي وَاَصِحَّ لِي جِسْمِيْ وَبَلِّغْنِيْ اَمَلِيْ
segs.en: O Allah, extend my life, expand my sustenance, keep my body sound, and bring me to attain my hope,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAM DUD LEE FEE U'MREE WA AWSI-A' LEE FEE RIZQEE WA ASIHHA LEE JISMEE WA BALLIGHNEE AMALEE

segs.ar: وَاِنْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الْاَشْقِيَاۤءِ فَامْحُنِيْ مِنَ الْاَشْقِيَاۤءِ وَاكْتُبْنِيْ مِنَ السُّعَدَاۤءِ
segs.en: and if I am among the wretched, then erase me from the wretched and record me among the felicitous,
segs.tr: WA IN KUNTU MINAL ASHQIYAAA-I FAMHUNEE MINAL ASHQIYAAA-I WAK TUBNEE MINAS SU-A'DAAA-I

segs.ar: فَاِنَّكَ قُلْتَ فِيْ كِتَابِكَ الْمُنْزَلِ عَلٰى نَبِيِّكَ الْمُرْسَلِ صَلَوٰتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهِ يَمْحُو اللهُ مَا يَشَاۤءُ وَيُثْبِتُ وَعِنْدَهُ اُمُّ الْكِتَابِ
segs.en: for You have said, in Your Book revealed to Your sent Prophet — Your blessings upon him and his Household — "Allah blots out whatever He wills and confirms whatever He wills, and with Him is the source of the Book."
segs.tr: FA-INNAKA QULTA FEE KITAABIKAL MUNZALI A'LAA NABIYYIKAL MURSALI SALAWAATUKA A'LAYHI WA AALIHI YAMHUL LAAHO MAA YASHAAA-O WA YUTHBITU WA I'NDAHU UMMUL KITAAB

segs.note: Dua to Be among the Pilgrims
segs.ur: حاجیوں میں شامل ہونے کی دعا

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِيْمَا تَقْضِيْ وَفِيْمَا تُقَدِّرُ مِنَ الْاَمْرِ الْمَحْتُوْمِ وَفِيْمَا تَفْرُقُ مِنَ الْاَمْرِ الْحَكِيْمِ فِيْ لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ
segs.en: O Allah, among what You decree and ordain from the decisive matter, and among what You distinguish from the wise command on the Night of Decree,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAJ-A'L FEEMAA TAQDEE WA FEEMAA TUQADDIRU MINAL AMRIL MAHTOOMI WA FEEMAA TAFRUQU MINAL AMRIL HAKEEMI FEE LAYLATIL QADR

segs.ar: مِنَ الْقَضَاۤءِ الَّذِيْ لَا يُرَدُّ وَلَا يُبَدَّلُ اَنْ تَكْتُبَنِيْ مِنْ حُجَّاجِ بَيْتِكَ الْحَرَامِ فِيْ عَامِيْ هٰذَا
segs.en: from the destiny that is not reversed nor changed — record me this year of mine among the pilgrims of Your Sacred House,
segs.tr: MINAL QADAAA-IL LAZEE LAA YURADDU WA LAA YUBADDAL AN TAKTUBANEE MIN HUJJAAJI BAYTIKAL HARAAMI FEE A'AAMEE HAAZAA

segs.ar: الْمَبْرُوْرِ حَجُّهُمْ الْمَشْكُوْرِ سَعْيُهُمُ الْمَغْفُوْرِ ذُنُوْبُهُمُ الْمُكَفَّرِ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُهُمْ
segs.en: whose pilgrimage is accepted, whose effort is thanked, whose sins are forgiven, and whose bad deeds are absolved,
segs.tr: AL-MABROORI HAJJUHUM AL-MASHKOORI SA-I'YUHUM AL-MAGHFOORI ZUNOOBUHUM AL-MUKAFFARI A'NHUM SAYYI-AATUHUM

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ فِيْمَا تَقْضِيْ وَتُقَدِّرُ اَنْ تُطِيْلَ عُمْرِيْ وَتُوَسِّعَ لِي فِيْ رِزْقِيْ
segs.en: and among what You decree and ordain, prolong my life and expand my sustenance for me.
segs.tr: WAJ-A'L FEEMAA TAQDEE WA TUQADDIRU AN TUTEELA U'MREE WA TUWASSI-A' LEE FEE RIZQEE

segs.note: Dua Ya Batinan fi Zuhurihi
segs.ur: دعا یا باطناً فی ظہورہ

segs.ar: يَا بَاطِنًا فِيْ ظُهُوْرِهِ وَيَا ظَاهِرًا فِيْ بُطُوْنِهِ
segs.en: O He Who is Hidden in His manifestation, O He Who is Manifest in His hiddenness,
segs.tr: YAA BAATINAN FEE ZUHOORIHI WA YAA ZAAHIRAN FEE BUTOONIH

segs.ar: وَيَا بَاطِنًا لَيْسَ يَخْفٰى وَيَا ظَاهِرًا لَيْسَ يُرٰى
segs.en: O He Who is Hidden yet not concealed, O He Who is Manifest yet not seen,
segs.tr: WA YAA BAATINAL LAYSA YAKHFAA WA YAA ZAAHIRAL LAYSA YURAA

segs.ar: يَا مَوْصُوْفًا لَا يَبْلُغُ بِكَيْنُوْنَتِهٖ مَوْصُوْفٌ وَلَا حَدٌّ مَحْدُوْدٌ
segs.en: O He Who is described, though no description can attain His Being, nor any bounded limit,
segs.tr: YAA MAWSOOFAL LAA YABLUGHU BI-KAYNOONATIHI MAWSOOFUW WA LAA HADDUN MAHDOOD

segs.ar: وَيَا غَاۤئِبًا غَيْرَ مَفْقُوْدٍ وَيَا شَاهِدًا غَيْرَ مَشْهُوْدٍ
segs.en: O He Who is absent yet not lost, O He Who is present yet not perceived,
segs.tr: WA YAA GHAAA-IBAN GHAYRA MAFQOOD WA YAA SHAAHIDAN GHAYRA MASH-HOOD

segs.ar: يُطْلَبُ فَيُصَابُ وَلَمْ يَخْلُ مِنْهُ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْاَرْضُ وَمَابَيْنَهُمَا طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
segs.en: He is sought and found, and the heavens, the earth, and what is between them have never, for the blink of an eye, been empty of Him,
segs.tr: YUTLABU FA-YUSAAB WA LAM YAKHLU MINHUS SAMAAWAATU WAL ARDU WA MAA BAYNAHUMAA TARFATA A'YN

segs.ar: لَا يُدْرِكُ بِكَيْفٍ وَلَا يُؤَيَّنُ بِاَيْنٍ وَلَا بِحَيْثِ
segs.en: He cannot be grasped by asking "how," nor located by asking "where" or "in what place,"
segs.tr: LAA YUDRAKU BI-KAYFIN WA LAA YU-AYYANU BI-AYNIN WA LAA BI-HAYTH

segs.ar: اَنْتَ نُوْرُ النُّوْرِ وَرَبَّ الْاَرْبَابِ اَحَطْتَ بِجَمِيْعِ الْاُمُوْرِ
segs.en: You are the Light of light and the Lord of lords; You have encompassed all matters.
segs.tr: ANTA NOORUN NOORI WA RABBUL ARBAAB AHATTA BI-JAMEE-I'L UMOOR

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ وَهُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْبَصِيْرُ
segs.en: Glory be to Him, nothing is like unto Him, and He is the All-hearing, the All-seeing;
segs.tr: SUBHAANA MAL LAYSA KA-MITHLIHI SHAY-UW WA HUWAS SAMEE-U'L BASEER

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ هٰكَذَا وَلَا هٰكَذَا غَيْرُهُ
segs.en: Glory be to Him Who is thus, and none other is thus.
segs.tr: SUBHAANA MAN HUWA HAAKAZAA WA LAA HAAKAZAA GHAYRUH

segs.note: One may then pray for the fulfillment of his needs.
segs.ur: اس کے بعد وہ اپنی حاجات پوری ہونے کے لیے دعا کر سکتا ہے۔

segs.note: Worship through the Night
segs.ur: پوری رات عبادت

segs.note: Perform a fresh bathing besides the first, in the last hours of the night.
segs.ur: پہلے غسل کے علاوہ، رات کے آخری گھنٹوں میں ایک اور نیا غسل کریں۔

segs.note: Spend the whole night in worship.
segs.ur: پوری رات عبادت میں گزاریں۔

segs.note: Visit the holy tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a).
segs.ur: امام حسین (ع) کے روضۂ مبارک کی زیارت کریں۔

segs.note: Offer the hundred-unit prayer, reciting Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Ikhlas ten times in each unit.
segs.ur: سو رکعت کی نماز پڑھیں، ہر رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ اخلاص](A116) دس مرتبہ پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Allamah al-Majlisi confirms it is recommended to recite as much of the Qur'an as possible this night, and to pray with the supplications of al-Sahifah al-Sajjadiyyah generally, and with the supplications known as Makarim al-Akhlaq and al-Tawbah in particular.
segs.ur: علامہ مجلسی تصدیق کرتے ہیں کہ اس رات جتنا ممکن ہو قرآن پڑھنا اور عمومی طور پر صحیفہ سجادیہ کی دعاؤں سے اور خاص طور پر «مکارم الاخلاق» اور «توبہ» کے نام سے مشہور دعاؤں سے دعا کرنا مستحب ہے۔

segs.note: The sanctity of the Qadr days should likewise be honored with worship, Qur'an recitation, and supplication — a substantial chain of narration holds the Qadr days to be as holy as the Qadr nights.
segs.ur: اسی طرح قدر کے دنوں کی حرمت کو بھی عبادت، تلاوتِ قرآن اور دعا کے ساتھ ملحوظ رکھنا چاہیے؛ ایک معتبر سلسلۂ روایت قدر کے دنوں کو قدر کی راتوں ہی کی طرح مقدس قرار دیتا ہے۔

A_AA34.merits:
The twenty-third night of Ramadan, the last of the Qadr Nights, is more meritorious than the two before it — the nineteenth and the twenty-first. Many narrations confirm it is the Night of Decree at which all wise affairs are settled.

Surah al-Ankabut and Surah al-Rum: Imam al-Sadiq (a) said: whoever recites these two surahs this night will be counted among the people of Paradise.

Dua Ya Batinan fi Zuhurihi: it is mentioned in Iqbal al-A’mal.

Night worship: Bathing, spending the whole night in worship, visiting the holy tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a), and offering the hundred-unit prayer are all confirmed by narrations for the twenty-third night of Ramadan.

In Tahdhib al-Ahkam, Shaykh al-Tusi narrates that Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a) instructed Abu-Basir to offer, on the night expected to be the Night of Decree, a hundred-unit prayer, reciting Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Ikhlas ten times in each unit. Abu-Basir asked, "If I cannot manage all its movements, what shall I do?" The Imam said, "Offer it sitting." "And if I cannot manage sitting either?" The Imam said, "Offer it lying on your bed."

Da'a'im al-Islam records that the Holy Prophet (s) used to roll up his bedding and tie his garment to devote all his time to worship during the last ten nights of Ramadan, and would wake his family on the twenty-third night by splashing water on their faces. Lady Fatimah al-Zahra (a) likewise kept her household from sleeping that night, reducing their food and making them nap by day so sleep would not overtake them at night, saying, "The truly deprived one is he who is deprived of the good of this night." It is also narrated that Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a), being unwell one twenty-third night, had his servants carry him to the mosque, where he spent the night until morning.

A_AA35.name: Dua for the 23rd Night of Ramazan

segs.ar: يَا رَبَّ لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ وَجَاعِلَهَا خَيْرًا مِّنْ اَلْفِ شَهْرٍ وَرَبَّ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَالْجِبَالِ وَالْبِحَارِ وَالظُّلَمِ وَالْاَنْوَارِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاۤءِ
segs.en: O Lord of the Night of Decree, Who made it better than a thousand months! O Lord of night and day, mountains and seas, darkness and light, the earth and the heavens!
segs.tr: YAA RABBA LAYLATIL QADRI WA JAA-I'LAHAA KHAYRAM MIN ALFI SHAHRIN WA RABBAL LAYLI WAN NAHAARI WAL JIBAALI WAL BIHAARI WAZ ZULAMI WAL ANWAARI WAL ARDI WAS SAMAAA-I

segs.ar: يَا بَارِئُ يَا مُصَوِّرُ يَا حَنَّانُ يَا مَنَّانُ يَا اَللهُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا اَللهُ يَا قَيُّوْمُ يَا اَللهُ يَا بَدِيْعُ يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ لَكَ الْاَسْمَاۤءُ الْحُسْنٰى وَالْاَمْثَالُ الْعُلْيَا وَالْكِبْرِيَاۤءُ وَالْاٰلَاۤءُ
segs.en: O Fashioner! O Shaper! O All-tender! O All-favoring! O Allah, O All-beneficent! O Allah, O Self-subsisting! O Allah, O Wondrous Originator! O Allah, O Allah, O Allah! To You belong the Most Excellent Names, the most exalted attributes, greatness, and bounties.
segs.tr: YAA BAARI-U' YAA MUSAWWIR YAA HANNAAN YAA MANNAAN, YAA ALLAAH YAA RAHMAAN, YAA ALLAAH YAA QAYYOOM, YAA ALLAAH YAA BADEE-U', YAA ALLAAH YAA ALLAAH YAA ALLAAH, LAKAL ASMAAA-UL HUSNAA WAL AMTHAALUL U'LYAA WAL KIBRIYAAA-U WAL AALAAA-U

segs.ar: اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاَنْ تَجْعَلَ اسْمِيْ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ فِي السُّعَدَاۤءِ وَرُوْحِيْ مَعَ الشُّهَدَاۤءِ وَاِحْسَانِيْ فِيْ عِلِّيِّيْنَ وَاِسَاۤءَتِيْ مَغْفُوْرَةً
segs.en: I ask You to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and to include my name this night among the happy ones, my soul with the martyrs, my good deeds in the highest Illiyyin, and my wrongdoing forgiven,
segs.tr: AS-ALUKA AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMADIN WA AN TAJ-A'LAS-MEE FEE HAAZIHIL LAYLATI FIS SU-A'DAAA-I WA ROOHEE MA-A'SH SHUHADAAA-I WA IHSAANEE FEE I'LLIYYEEN WA ISAAA-ATEE MAGHFOORAH

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَهَبَ لِيْ يَقِيْنًا تُبَاشِرُ بِهٖ قَلْبِيْ وَاِيْمَانًا يُذْهِبُ الشَّكَّ عَنِّيْ وَتُرْضِيَنِيْ بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِيْ وَاٰتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الْحَرِيْقِ
segs.en: and to grant me certitude that fills my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and to make me content with what You have apportioned for me; and grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the torment of the burning Fire,
segs.tr: WA AN TAHABA LEE YAQEENAN TUBAASHIRU BIHI QALBEE WA EEMAANAN YUZHIBUSH SHAKKA A'NNEE WA TURDIYANEE BIMAA QASAMTA LEE, WA AATINAA FID DUNYAA HASANATAN WA FIL AAKHIRATI HASANATAN WA QINAA A'ZAABAN NAARIL HAREEQ

segs.ar: وَارْزُقْنِيْ فِيْهَا ذِكْرَكَ وَشُكْرَكَ وَالرَّغْبَةَ اِلَيْكَ وَالْاِنَابَةَ وَالتَّوْبَةَ وَالتَّوْفِيْقَ لِمَا وَفَّقْتَ لَهٗ مُحَمَّدًا وَاٰلَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ
segs.en: and grant me this night Your remembrance and Your thanks, and desire for You, and turning to You in repentance, and success in that to which You granted success to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, peace be upon them.
segs.tr: WARZUQNEE FEEHAA ZIKRAKA WA SHUKRAKA WAR RAGHBATA ILAYKA WAL INAABATA WAT TAWBATA WAT TAWFEEQA LIMAA WAFFAQTA LAHU MUHAMMADAN WA AALA MUHAMMADIN A'LAYHIMUS SALAAM

A_AA37.name: Dua for the 25th Night of Ramazan

segs.ar: --يَا جَاعِلَ اللَّيْلِ لِبَاسًا، وَالنَّهَارِ مَعَاشًا، وَالْاَرْضِ مِهَادًا، وَالْجِبَالِ اَوْتَادًا، يَا اَللهُ يَا قَاهِرُ، يَا اَللهُ يَا جَبَّارُ، يَا اَللهُ يَا سَمِيْعُ، يَا اَللهُ يَا قَرِيْبُ، يَا اَللهُ يَا مُجِيْبُ، يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ، لَكَ الْاَسْمَاۤءُ الْحُسْنٰى، وَالْاَمْثَالُ الْعُلْيَا، وَالْكِبْرِيَاۤءُ وَالْاٰلَاۤءُ، اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَاَنْ تَجْعَلَ اسْمِيْ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ فِي السُّعَدَاۤءِ، وَرُوْحِيْ مَعَ الشُّهَدَاۤءِ، وَاِحْسَانِيْ فِي عِلِّيِّيْنَ، وَاِسَاۤءَتِيْ مَغْفُوْرَةً، وَاَنْ تَهَبَ لِيْ يَقيْنًا تُبَاشِرُ بِهٖ قَلْبِيْ، وَاِيْمَانًا يُذْهِبُ الشَّكَّ عَنِّيْ، وَرِضًى بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِيْ، وَاٰتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ، حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذابَ النَّارِ الْحَرِيْقِ، وَارْزُقْنِيْ فِيْهَا ذِكْرَكَ وَشُكْرَكَ وَالرَّغْبَةَ اِلَيْكَ وَالْاِنَابَةَ وَالتَّوْبَةَ والتَّوْفِيْقَ لِمَا وَفَّقْتَ لَهٗ مُحَمَّدًا وَاٰلَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ.
segs.en: O He Who makes night a covering, makes daylight for seeking livelihood, makes the earth an expanse, and mountains bulwarks! O Allah! O Dominant! O Allah! O Omnipotent! O Allah! O Allhearing! O Allah! O Nigh! O Allah! O Responding! O Allah! O Allah! O Allah! To You are the Most Excellent Names, the most elevated examples, greatness, and bounties. I beseech You to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, include my name with the list of the happiest ones, add my soul to the martyrs, record my good deeds in the most exalted rank, decide my offense to be forgiven, grant me certitude that fills in my heart and faith that removes doubt from me, make me feel satisfied with that which You decide for me, grant us reward in this world and reward in the Hereafter, save us from the torment of the burning Fire, and confer upon us at this night Your mentioning, thanking You, desiring for You, turning to You, and success to that to which You led Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, peace be upon him and them.
segs.tr: YAA JAA-I'LAL LAYLI LIBAASAA WAN NAHAARA MA-A'ASHAA WAL ARZ"I MIHAADAA WAL JIBAALI AWTAADA YAA ALLAAHU YAA QAAHIR YAA ALLAAHU YAA JABBAAR YAA ALLAAHU YAA SAMEE-U' YAA ALLAAHU YAA QAREEB YAA ALLAAHU YAA MUJEEB YAA ALLAAH YAA ALLAAH YAA ALLAAH LAKAL ASMAAA-UL H'USNAA WAL AMTHAALUL U'LYAA WAL KIBRIYAAA WAL AALAAA-U AS-ALUKA AN TUS'ALLIYA A'LAA MUH'AMMADIN WA AALI MUH'AMMAD WA AN TAJ-A'LAS-MEE FEE HAAD'IHIL LAYLATI FIS SU-A'DAAA-I WA ROOH'EE MA-ASH SHUHADAAA-I WA IH'SAANEE FEE I'LIYEENA WA ISAAA-ATEE MAGHFOORAH WA AN TAHABA LEE YAQEENAN TUBAASHIRU BIHEE QALBE WA EEMAANAN YUD'HIBUSH SHAKKA A'NNEE WA RIZ"AN BIMAA QASAMTA LEE WA AATINAA FID DUNYAA H'ASANATAN WA FIL AAKHIRATI H'ASANATAN WA QINAA A'D'AABIN NAARIL H'AREEQ WAR-ZUQNEE FEEHAA D'IKRAKA WA SHUKRAKA WAR RAGHBATA ILAYKA WAL INAABATA WAT TAWBAH WAT TAWFEQA LIMAA WAFFAQTA LAHOO MUH'AMMADAN WA AALI MUH'AMMADIN A'LAYHI WA A'LAYHIMUS SALAAM

A_AA38.name: Dua for the 26th Night of Ramazan

segs.ar: --يَا جَاعِلَ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ اٰيَتَيْنِ، يَا مَنْ مَحَا اٰيَةَ اللَّيْلِ وَجَعَلَ اٰيَةَ النَّهَارِ مُبْصِرَةً لِتَبْتَغُوْا فَضْلًا مِنْهُ وَرِضْوَانًا، يَا مُفَصِّلَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ تَفْصِيْلًا، يَا مَاجِدُ يَا وَهَّابُ، يَا اَللهُ يَا جَوَادُ، يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ، لَكَ الْاَسْمَاۤءُ الْحُسْنٰى، وَالْاَمْثَالُ الْعُلْيَا، وَالْكِبْرِيَاۤءُ وَالْاٰلَاۤءُ، اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَاَنْ تَجْعَلَ اسْمِيْ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ فِي السُّعَدَاۤءِ، وَرُوْحِيْ مَعَ الشُّهَدَاۤءِ وَاِحْسَانِيْ فِيْ عِلِّيِّيْنَ، وَاِسَاۤءَتِيْ مَغْفُوْرَةً، وَاَنْ تَهَبَ لِيْ يَقِيْنًا تُبَاشِرُ بِهٖ قَلْبِيْ، وَاِيْمَانًا يُذْهِبُ الشَّكَّ عَنِّيْ، وَتُرْضِيَنِيْ بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِيْ، وَاٰتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً، وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الْحَرِيْقِ، وَارْزُقْنِيْ فِيْهَا ذِكْرَكَ وَشُكْرَكَ وَالرَّغْبَةَ اِلَيْكَ وَالْاِنَابَةَ وَالتَّوْبَةَ وَالتَّوْفِيْقَ لِمَا وَفَّقْتَ لَهٗ مُحَمَّدًا وَاٰلَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ.
segs.en: O Maker of night and daylight two portents! O He Who makes dark the portent of night and makes the portent of the daylight sightgiving so that you may seek favor and pleasure from Him! O He Who expounds everything with clear expounding! O All-glorious! O Alldonor! O Allah! O All- magnanimous! O Allah! O Allah! O Allah! To You are the Most Excellent Names, the most elevated examples, greatness, and bounties. I beseech You to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, include my name with the list of the happiest ones, add my soul to the martyrs, record my good deeds in the most exalted rank, decide my offense to be forgiven, grant me certitude that fills in my heart and faith that removes doubt from me, make me feel satisfied with that which You decide for me, grant us reward in this world and reward in the Hereafter, save us from the torment of the burning Fire, and confer upon us at this night Your mentioning, thanking You, desiring for You, turning to You, and success to that to which You led Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, peace be upon him and them.
segs.tr: YAA JAA-I'LAL LAYLI WAN NAHAARI AAYATAYN YAA MAN MAH'AA AAYATAL LAYLI WA JA-A'LA AAYATAN NAHAARI MUBS'IRATAN LI-TABTAGHO FAZ"LAN MINHU WA RIZWAANAA YAA MUFAS'S'ILA KULI SHAY-IN TAFS'EELAA YAA MAAJIDU YAA WAHHAAB YAA ALLAAHU YAA JAWAAD YAA ALLAAH YAAA ALLAAH YAA ALLAAH LAKAL ASMAAA-UL H'USNAA WAL AMTHAALUL U'LYAA WAL KIBRIYAAA WAL AALAAA-U AS-ALUKA AN TUS'ALLIYA A'LAA MUH'AMMADIN WA AALI MUH'AMMAD WA AN TAJ-A'LAS-MEE FEE HAAD'IHIL LAYLATI FIS SU-A'DAAA-I WA ROOH'EE MA-A'SH SHUHADAAA-I WA IH'SAANEE FEE I'LLIYYEENA WA ISAAA-ATEE MAGHFOORAH WA AN TAHABA LEE YAQEENAN TUBAASHIRU BIHEE QALBEE WA EEMAANAN YUD'HIBUSH SHAKKA A'NNEE WA TURZ"IYANEE BINAA QASAMTA LEE WA AATINAA FID DUNYAA H'ASANATAN WA FIL AAKHIRATI H'ASANATAN WA QINAA A'D'AABIN NAARIL H'AREEQ WAR-ZUQNEE FEEHAA D'IKRAKA WA SHUKRAKA WAR RAGHBATA ILAYKA WAL INAABATA WAT-TAWFEEQA LIMAA WAFFAQTA LAHOO MUH'AMMADAN WA AALI MUH'AMMAD S'ALLAALLAAHU A'LAYHI WA A'LAYHIM

segs.note: According to narrations, it is recommended to bathe oneself at the twenty-seventh night of Ramadan. It has also been narrated that Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn Zayn al-'Abidin (a) used to repeat the following supplicatory prayer throughout this night:
segs.ur: روایات کے مطابق ماہ رمضان کی 27ویں رات غسل کرنا مستحب ہے۔ یہ بھی روایت ہے کہ امام علی بن حسین زین العابدین (ع) اس پوری رات یہ دعا دہراتے رہتے تھے:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِيْ التَّجَافِيْ عَنْ دَارِ الْغُرُوْرِ وَالْاِنَابَةَ اِلٰى دَارِ الْخُلُوْدِ وَالْاِسْتِعْدَادَ لِلْمَوْتِ قَبْلَ حُلُوْلِ الْفَوْتِ
segs.en: O Allah, grant me alienation from the abode of delusion, turning to the abode of eternity, and readiness for death before it is too late.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAR ZUQNIT TAJAAFEE A'N DAARIL GHUROOR WAL INAABATA ILAA DAARIL KHULOOD WAL ISTI'-DAADA LIL MAWTI QABLA HULOOLIL FAWT

A_AA40.name: Dua for the 27th Night of Ramazan

segs.ar: يَا مَادَّ الظِّلِّ وَ لَوْ شِئْتَ لَجَعَلْتَهٗ سَاكِنًا وَ جَعَلْتَ الشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيْلًا ثُمَّ قَبَضْتَهٗ اِلَيْكَ قَبْضًا يَّسِيْرًا
segs.en: O Spreader of the shade, and if You willed, You could make it still, then You have made the sun its pilot, then You withdraw it to Us, a gradual withdrawal!
segs.tr: YAA MAADDAZ ZILLI WA LAW SHI'TA LAJA'ALTAHU SAAKINAA, WA JA'ALTASH SHAMSA A'LAYHI DALEELAN THUMMA QABADTAHU ILAYKA QABDAY YASEERAA

segs.ar: يَا ذَا الْجُوْدِ وَ الطَّوْلِ وَ الْكِبْرِيَآءِ وَ الْاٰلَآءِ
segs.en: O Lord of magnanimity, conferral, greatness, and bounties!
segs.tr: YAA DHAL JOODI WAT TAWLI WAL KIBRIIYAAA'I WAL AALAAA'

segs.ar: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْتَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَ الشَّهَادَةِ الرَّحْمٰنُ الرَّحِيْمُ
segs.en: There is no god save You! You are the Knower of the hidden and the witnessed, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
segs.tr: LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA A'ALIMUL GHAYBI WASH SHAHAADATIR RAHMAANUR RAHEEM

segs.ar: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْتَ يَا قُدُّوْسُ يَا سَلَامُ يَا مُؤْمِنُ يَا مُهَيْمِنُ يَا عَزِيْزُ يَا جَبَّارُ يَا مُتَكَبِّرُ
segs.en: There is no god save You! O Holy! O Peace! O Bestower of faith! O Guardian! O Mighty! O Compeller! O Sublime!
segs.tr: LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA YAA QUDDOOSU YAA SALAAMU YAA MOO'MINU YAA MUHAYMINU YAA A'ZEEZU YAA JABBAARU YAA MUTAKABBIR

segs.ar: يَاۤ اَللّٰهُ يَا خَالِقُ يَا بَارِئُ يَا مُصَوِّرُ يَاۤ اَللّٰهُ يَاۤ اَللّٰهُ يَاۤ اَللّٰهُ
segs.en: O Allah! O Creator! O Maker! O Fashioner! O Allah! O Allah! O Allah!
segs.tr: YAA ALLAAHU YAA KHAALIQU YAA BAARI'U YAA MUSAWWIRU YAA ALLAAHU YAA ALLAAHU YAA ALLAAH

segs.ar: لَكَ الْاَسْمَآءُ الْحُسْنٰى وَ الْاَمْثَالُ الْعُلْيَا وَ الْكِبْرِيَآءُ وَ الْاٰلَآءُ
segs.en: Yours are the Best Names, the Highest Examples, Greatness, and Bounties!
segs.tr: LAKAL ASMAAA'UL HUSNAA WAL AMTHAALUL U'LYAA WAL KIBRIYAAA'U WAL AALAAA'

segs.ar: اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اَنْ تَجْعَلَ اسْمِيْ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ فِي السُّعَدَآءِ
segs.en: I beseech You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and to include my name with the happy ones on this night,
segs.tr: AS'ALUKA AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMADIN WA AN TAJ'ALASMEE FEE HAADHIHIL LAYLATI FIS SU'ADAAA'

segs.ar: وَ رُوْحِيْ مَعَ الشُّهَدَآءِ وَ اِحْسَانِيْ فِيْ عِلِّيِّيْنَ وَ اِسَآءَتِيْ مَغْفُوْرَةً
segs.en: and my soul with the martyrs, and my good deeds in the highest heaven (Illiyyin), and to forgive my evil deeds,
segs.tr: WA ROOHEE MA'ASH SHUHADAAA'I WA IHSAANEE FEE I'LLIYYEEN, WA ISA'ATEE MAGHFOORAH

segs.ar: وَ اَنْ تَهَبَ لِيْ يَقِيْنًا تُبَاشِرُ بِهٖ قَلْبِيْ وَ اِيْمَانًا يُذْهِبُ الشَّكَّ عَنِّيْ وَ تُرْضِيَنِيْ بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِيْ
segs.en: and to grant me conviction that fills my heart and faith that removes doubt from me, and to make me pleased with whatever You have decided for me,
segs.tr: WA AN TAHABA LEE YAQEENAN TUBAASHIRU BIHEE QALBEE WA EEMAANAN YUDH-HIBUSH SHAKKA A'NNEE WA TURDIYANEE BIMAA QASAMTA LEE

segs.ar: وَ اٰتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّ فِي الْاٰخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَّ قِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الْحَرِيْقِ
segs.en: and grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter and save us from the torment of the burning Fire,
segs.tr: WA AATINAA FID DUNYAA HASANATAN WA FIL AAKHIRATI HASANATAN WA QINAA A'DHAABAN NAARIL HAREEQ

segs.ar: وَ ارْزُقْنِيْ فِيْهَا ذِكْرَكَ وَ شُكْرَكَ وَ الرَّغْبَةَ اِلَيْكَ وَ الْاِنَابَةَ وَ التَّوْبَةَ وَ التَّوْفِيْقَ لِمَا وَفَّقْتَ لَهٗ مُحَمَّدًا وَّ اٰلَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَيْهِمْ
segs.en: and grant me therein remembrance of You, gratitude to You, desire for You, repentance, and success in achieving that which You granted to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad — Your blessings be upon him and upon them.
segs.tr: WARZUQNEE FEEHAA DHIKRAKA WA SHUKRAKA WAR RAGHBATA ILAYKA WAL INAABATA WAT TAWBATA WAT TAWFEEQA LIMAA WAFFAQTA LAHOO MUHAMMADAN WA AALA MUHAMMAD, SALAWAATUKA A'LAYHI WA A'LAYHIM

A_AA43.name: Last Night of Ramazan

segs.note: Acts of the Night
Perform ghusl tonight.
Visit the tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.).
Recite Surah al-An'am, Surah al-Kahf and Surah Ya-Sin.
Recite 100 times:

segs.en: I implore for Allah’s forgiveness and I repent before Him.

segs.note: Bid farewell to the month of Ramazan with its farewell duas, such as al-Kulayni's Farewell Prayer of Ramazan and Dua No. 45 of Sahifa al-Kamila, perhaps the best of them.
Dua Allahumma Hadha Shahru Ramadan

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ هٰذَا شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِيْ اَنْزَلْتَ فِيْهِ الْقُرْاٰنَ وَقَدْ تَصَرَّمَ
segs.en: O Allah, this month of Ramadan in which You revealed the Qur'an is about to come to its end.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA HAADHAA SHAHRU RAMADAANAL LADHEE ANZALTA FEEHIL QUR'AANA WA QAD TASARRAM

segs.ar: وَاَعُوْذُ بِوَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيْمِ يَا رَبِّ اَنْ يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ مِنْ لَيْلَتِيْ هٰذِهِ اَوْ يَتَصَرَّمَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ
segs.en: I seek refuge with Your Noble Face, O Lord, that it dawns tonight or the month of Ramadan elapses
segs.tr: WA A'OODHU BIWAJHIKAL KAREEMI YAA RABBI AN YATLU'AL FAJRU MIN LAYLATEE HAADHIHEE AW YATASARRAMA SHAHRU RAMADAAN

segs.ar: وَلَكَ قِبَلِيْ تَبِعَةٌ اَوْ ذَنْبٌ تُرِيْدُ اَنْ تُعَذِّبَنِيْ بِهٖ يَوْمَ اَلْقَاكَ
segs.en: but I am still liable to an offense or a sin that You want to punish me for committing it when I will meet You.
segs.tr: WA LAKA QIBALEE TABI'ATUN AW DHANBUN TUREEDU AN TU'ADHDHIBANEE BIHEE YAWMA ALQAAK

segs.note: Dua Ya Mudabbir al-Umur

segs.ar: يَا مُدَبِّرَ الْاُمُوْرِ، يَا بَاعِثَ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُوْرِ
segs.en: O Director of all affairs! O Resurrector of all those in graves!
segs.tr: YAA MUDABBIRAL UMOORI YAA BAA'ITHA MAN FIL QUBOOR

segs.ar: يَا مُجْرِيَ الْبُحُوْرِ يَا مُلَيِّنَ الْحَدِيْدِ لِدَاوُدَ
segs.en: O He Who causes oceans to flow; O He Who made the iron pliant for (Prophet) David
segs.tr: YAA MUJRIYAL BUHOORI YAA MULAYYINAL HADEEDI LIDAAWUD

segs.en: (Please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.en: And do for me (mention your legitimate desires)

segs.note: Short Farewell Duas

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْهُ اٰخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنْ صِيَامِيْ لِشَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ
segs.en: O Allah, (please) do not decide my observance of fasting in this month of Ramadan to be the last of my observance of fasting.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA LAA TAJ'ALHU AAKHIRAL A'HDI MIN SIYAAMEE LISHAHRI RAMADAAN

segs.ar: وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ اَنْ يَطْلُعَ فَجْرُ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ اِلَّا وَقَدْ غَفَرْتَ لِي
segs.en: I seek Your protection against that this day dawns before You shall forgive me.
segs.tr: WA A'OODHU BIKA AN YATLU'A FAJRU HAADHIHIL LAYLATI ILLAA WA QAD GHAFARTA LEE

segs.note: On the last Friday of Ramazan, bid it farewell with:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْهُ اٰخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنْ صِيَامِنَا اِيَّاهُ
segs.en: O Allah, (please) do not make it the last of our fasting in this month
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA LAA TAJ'ALHU AAKHIRAL A'HDI MIN SIYAAMINAA IYYAAH

segs.ar: فَاِنْ جَعَلْتَهٗ فَاجْعَلْنِيْ مَرْحُوْمًا وَلَا تَجْعَلْنِيْ مَحْرُوْمًا
segs.en: but if You decide so, then (please) make me enjoy (Your) mercy and do not make me deprived (of it).
segs.tr: FA-IN JA'ALTAHOO FAJ'ALNEE MARHOOMAN WA LAA TAJ'ALNEE MAHROOMAA

segs.note: Ten-Unit Prayer
Pray ten units, two at a time with tashahhud and salam. In each unit, after Surah al-Fatihah, recite Surah al-Tawheed 10 times.
In each ruku' and sajdah, recite 10 times:

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَلَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَاللهُ اَكْبَرُ
segs.en: All glory be to Allah, all praise be to Allah, there is no god save Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
segs.tr: SUBHAANALLAAHI WAL HAMDU LILLAAHI WA LAA ILAAHA ILLALLAAHU WALLAAHU AKBAR

segs.note: After the last salam, recite 1,000 times:

segs.en: I implore for Allah’s forgiveness and I repent before Him.

segs.note: Then go into sajdah and recite:

segs.ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ، يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْاِكْرَامِ
segs.en: O Ever-Alive! O Eternal! O Lord of Majesty and Honor!
segs.tr: YAA HAYYU YAA QAYYOOMU YAA DHAL JALAALI WAL IKRAAM

segs.en: O All-beneficent of this world and the Next World and the All-merciful of them!
segs.tr: YAA RAHMAANAD DUNYAA WAL AAKHIRATI WA RAHEEMAHUMAA

segs.ar: يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ، يَا اِلٰهَ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ وَالْاٰخِرِيْنَ
segs.en: O most Merciful of all those who show mercy! O God of the past and the coming generations!
segs.tr: YAA ARHAMAR RAAHIMEENA YAA ILAAHAL AWWALEENA WAL AAKHIREEN
