segs.ar: اِغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا، وَتَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا صَلَاتَنَا وَصِيَامَنَا وَقِيَامَنَا
segs.en: (Please) forgive us our sins and accept our prayers, fasting, and worship.
segs.tr: IGHFIR LANAA DHUNOOBANAA WA TAQABBAL MINNAA SALAATANAA WA SIYAAMANAA WA QIYAAMANAA

A_AA43.merits:
Farewell Duas: Farewell supplications for this night are mentioned by al-Kulayni, al-Saduq, al-Mufid, al-Tusi, and Sayyid Ibn Tawus - may Allah be pleased with them all.

Short Farewell Duas: Sayyid Ibn Tawus has reported Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a.s.) as saying: Whoever bids farewell to the month of Ramadan with the first of these supplicatory prayers, Almighty Allah will forgive him before it dawns and will confer upon him with the bliss of submission before Him (i.e. Almighty Allah).

Last Friday: Sayyid Ibn Tawus and Shaykh al-Saduq have both narrated the following on the authority of Jabir ibn 'Abdullah al-Ansari: I visited the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.) on the last Friday of Ramadan. As he saw me, he said: O Jabir, this is the last Friday of Ramadan. You should thus bid farewell to it by saying the second. Verily, whoever says this supplicatory prayer will win one of the two good things; either attaining the next Ramadan or having the forgiveness and mercy of Almighty Allah.

Ten-Unit Prayer: Sayyid Ibn Tawus and al-Kaf'ami have reported the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) as recommending this prayer at the last night of Ramadan. The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) then continues, "I swear by Him Who has sent me with the truth as prophet, Archangel Gabriel has reported to me from Archangel Seraph who directly reports from Almighty Allah that one who offers that prayer will not raise his head from prostration before Almighty Allah forgives him, accepts his acts during the month of Ramadan, and overlooks his sins... etc."

It is worth mentioning that other narrations have confirmed that this prayer is offered at the Night of 'Id al-Fitr (i.e. the first night of Shawwal) with a little difference in the form of the supplicatory prayer.

A_AA46.name: Prayers for the Nights of Ramazan

segs.note: First Night Prayer
segs.ur: پہلی رات کی نماز

segs.note: Four units with Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Tawheed fifteen times.
segs.ur: چار رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) 15 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔

segs.note: Second Night Prayer
segs.ur: دوسری رات کی نماز

segs.note: Four units with Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Qadr twenty times.
segs.ur: چار رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ قدر](A101) 20 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔

segs.note: Third Night Prayer
segs.ur: تیسری رات کی نماز

segs.note: Ten units with Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Tawheed fifty times.
segs.ur: دس رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) 50 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔

segs.note: Fourth Night Prayer
segs.ur: چوتھی رات کی نماز

segs.note: Eight units with Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Qadr twenty times.
segs.ur: آٹھ رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ قدر](A101) 20 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔

segs.note: Fifth Night Prayer
segs.ur: پانچویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Two units with Surah al-Faatehah and Surah al-Tawheed fifty times. After accomplishment, SWALAWAT is repeated one hundred times:
segs.ur: دو رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) اور [سورہ توحید](A116) 50 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔ نماز مکمل کرنے کے بعد صلوات 100 مرتبہ دہرائی جاتی ہے:

segs.note: Sixth Night Prayer
segs.ur: چھٹی رات کی نماز

segs.note: Four units with Surah al-Faatehah and Surah al-Mulk (No. 67).
segs.ur: چار رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) اور [سورہ ملک](A71) (نمبر 67) کے ساتھ۔

segs.note: Seventh Night Prayer
segs.ur: ساتویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Four units with Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Qadr thirteen times.
segs.ur: چار رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ قدر](A101) 13 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔

segs.note: Eighth Night Prayer
segs.ur: آٹھویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Two units with Surah al-Faatehah and Surah al-Tawheed ten times. After accomplishment, SUBHANA ALLAH is repeated one thousand times:
segs.ur: دو رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) اور [سورہ توحید](A116) 10 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔ نماز مکمل کرنے کے بعد «سبحان الله» ایک ہزار مرتبہ دہرایا جاتا ہے:

segs.note: Ninth Night Prayer
segs.ur: نویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Six units offered between the Maghrib and Isha’ obligatory Prayers with Surah al-Faatehah and Ayat al-Kursi seven times. After accomplishment, SWALAWAT is repeated fifty times:
segs.ur: چھ رکعت جو مغرب اور عشاء کی واجب نمازوں کے درمیان پڑھی جائیں، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) اور [آیت الکرسی](A4) 7 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔ نماز مکمل کرنے کے بعد صلوات 50 مرتبہ دہرائی جاتی ہے:

segs.note: Tenth Night Prayer
segs.ur: دسویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Twenty units with Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Tawheed thirty times.
segs.ur: بیس رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) 30 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔

segs.note: Eleventh Night Prayer
segs.ur: گیارہویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Two units with Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Kawthar (No. 108) twenty times.
segs.ur: دو رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ کوثر](A112) (نمبر 108) 20 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔

segs.note: Twelfth Night Prayer
segs.ur: بارہویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Eight units with Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Qadr thirty times.
segs.ur: آٹھ رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ قدر](A101) 30 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔

segs.note: Thirteenth Night Prayer
segs.ur: تیرہویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Four units with Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Tawheed twenty-five times.
segs.ur: چار رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) 25 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔

segs.note: Fourteenth Night Prayer
segs.ur: چودہویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Six units with Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Zalzalah (No. 99) thirty times.
segs.ur: چھ رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ زلزال](A103) (نمبر 99) 30 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔

segs.note: Fifteenth Night Prayer
segs.ur: پندرہویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Four units; in the first two units, Surah al-Faatehah is recited once and Surah al-Tawheed repeated one hundred times. In the last two units, Surah al-Faatehah is recited once and Surah al-Tawheed repeated fifty times.
segs.ur: چار رکعت؛ پہلی دو رکعتوں میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) 100 مرتبہ پڑھی جاتی ہے۔ آخری دو رکعتوں میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) 50 مرتبہ پڑھی جاتی ہے۔

segs.note: Sixteenth Night Prayer
segs.ur: سولہویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Twelve units with Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Takathur (No. 102) twelve times.
segs.ur: بارہ رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ تکاثر](A106) (نمبر 102) 12 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔

segs.note: Seventeenth Night Prayer
segs.ur: سترہویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Two units with Surah al-Faatehah once and any selected Surah in the first unit and Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Tawheed one hundred times. After accomplishment, LA ILAHA ILLA ALLAH is repeated one hundred times:
segs.ur: دو رکعت، پہلی رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور کوئی بھی منتخب سورہ کے ساتھ، اور [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) 100 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔ نماز مکمل کرنے کے بعد «لا إله إلا الله» 100 مرتبہ دہرایا جاتا ہے:

segs.note: Eighteenth Night Prayer
segs.ur: اٹھارہویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Four units with Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Kawthar twenty-five times.
segs.ur: چار رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ کوثر](A112) 25 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔

segs.note: Nineteenth Night Prayer
segs.ur: انیسویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Fifty units with Surah al-Faatehah and Surah al-Zalzalah (No. 99).
segs.ur: پچاس رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) اور [سورہ زلزال](A103) (نمبر 99) کے ساتھ۔

segs.note: Twentieth to Twenty-Fourth Nights Prayer
segs.ur: بیسویں سے چوبیسویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: At these nights, it is recommended to offer an eight unit prayer with any selected Surahs.
segs.ur: ان راتوں میں کسی بھی منتخب سورتوں کے ساتھ آٹھ رکعت نماز پڑھنا مستحب ہے۔

segs.note: Twenty-Fifth Night Prayer
segs.ur: پچیسویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Eight units with Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Tawheed ten times.
segs.ur: آٹھ رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) 10 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔

segs.note: Twenty-Sixth Night Prayer
segs.ur: چھبیسویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Eight units with Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Tawheed one hundred times.
segs.ur: آٹھ رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) 100 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔

segs.note: Twenty-Seventh Night Prayer
segs.ur: ستائیسویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Four units with Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Mulk. If this is impossible, replace Surah al-Mulk with repeating Surah al-Tawheed twenty-five times.
segs.ur: چار رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ ملک](A71) کے ساتھ۔ اگر یہ ممکن نہ ہو تو [سورہ ملک](A71) کی جگہ [سورہ توحید](A116) 25 مرتبہ دہرائیں۔

segs.note: Twenty-Eighth Night Prayer
segs.ur: اٹھائیسویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Six units with Surah al-Faatehah once and Ayat al-Kursi one hundred times, Surah al-Tawheed one hundred times, and Surah al-Kawthar one hundred times. After accomplishment, SWALAWAT is repeated one hundred times:
segs.ur: چھ رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [آیت الکرسی](A4) 100 مرتبہ، [سورہ توحید](A116) 100 مرتبہ اور [سورہ کوثر](A112) 100 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔ نماز مکمل کرنے کے بعد صلوات 100 مرتبہ دہرائی جاتی ہے:

segs.note: According to my own readings in the books of narrations, I found that the prayer of the twenty-eighth night of Ramadan consists of six units with Surah al-Faatehah once, Ayat al-Kursi ten times, Surah al-Kawthar ten times, and Surah al-Tawheed ten times. After accomplishment the same invocation is repeated one hundred times.
segs.ur: روایات کی کتابوں میں اپنے مطالعے کے مطابق مجھے معلوم ہوا کہ ماہ رمضان کی 28ویں رات کی نماز چھ رکعت پر مشتمل ہے، جس میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ، [آیت الکرسی](A4) دس مرتبہ، [سورہ کوثر](A112) دس مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) دس مرتبہ پڑھی جاتی ہے۔ مکمل ہونے کے بعد وہی دعا سو مرتبہ دہرائی جاتی ہے۔

segs.note: Twenty-Ninth Night Prayer
segs.ur: انتیسویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Two units with Surah al-Faatehah and Surah al-Tawheed twenty times.
segs.ur: دو رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) اور [سورہ توحید](A116) 20 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔

segs.note: Thirtieth Night Prayer
segs.ur: تیسویں رات کی نماز

segs.note: Twelve units with Surah al-Faatehah and Surah al-Tawheed twenty times. After accomplishment, SWALAWAT is repeated one hundred times:
segs.ur: بارہ رکعت، [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) اور [سورہ توحید](A116) 20 مرتبہ کے ساتھ۔ نماز مکمل کرنے کے بعد صلوات 100 مرتبہ دہرائی جاتی ہے:

segs.note: Note that each two units of all of these prayers should be separated by uttering the Taslim statement.
segs.ur: یاد رکھیں کہ ان تمام نمازوں کی ہر دو رکعت کو سلام کہہ کر الگ کرنا چاہیے۔

A_AA46.merits: In Zad al-Ma’ad, ‘Allamah al-Majlisi has referred to the prayers of Ramadan nights in the last chapter of the recommended rites of Ramadan. Hereby, I will refer to these prayers as briefly as mentioned in the book involved:

A_AA47.name: Farewell Prayer of Ramazan

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّكَ قُلْتَ فِيْ كِتَابِكَ الْمُنْزَلِ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِيْۤ اُنْزِلَ فِيْهِ الْقُرْاٰنُ
segs.en: O Allah, You have said in Your revealed Book: “The month of Ramadan in which the Qur'an was revealed.”
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNAKA QULTA FEE KITAABIKAL MUNZALI SHAHRU RAMADAANAL LADHEE UNZILA FEEHIL QUR'AAN

segs.en: This month of Ramadan is about to slip away.
segs.tr: WA HAADHAA SHAHRU RAMADAANA WA QAD TASARRAM

segs.en: I thus beseech You in the name of Your Noble Face and Your Perfect Words
segs.tr: FA-AS'ALUKA BIWAJHIKAL KAREEMI WA KALIMAATIKAT TAAMMAH

segs.ar: اِنْ كَانَ بَقِيَ عَلَيَّ ذَنْبٌ لَمْ تَغْفِرْهُ لِيْۤ اَوْ تُرِيْدُ اَنْ تُعَذِّبَنِيْ عَلَيْهِ اَوْ تُقَايِسَنِيْ بِهٖ
segs.en: If I am still liable to a sin that You have not forgiven yet, You want to punish me for it, or You want to retaliate upon me because of it
segs.tr: IN KAANA BAQIYA A'LAYYA DHANBUN LAM TAGHFIRHU LEE AW TUREEDU AN TU'ADHDHIBANEE A'LAYHI AW TUQAAYISANEE BIH

segs.ar: اَنْ لَا يَطْلُعَ فَجْرُ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ اَوْ يَتَصَرَّمَ هٰذَا الشَّهْرُ اِلَّا وَقَدْ غَفَرْتَهٗ لِيْ يَاۤ اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
segs.en: (I beseech You that) before the dawn of this night rises and before this month elapses (please) forgive it for me, O most merciful of all those who show mercy!
segs.tr: AN LAA YATLU'A FAJRU HAADHIHIL LAYLATI AW YATASARRAMA HAADHASH SHAHRU ILLAA WA QAD GHAFARTAHOO LEE YAA ARHAMAR RAAHIMEEN

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ بِمَحَامِدِكَ كُلِّهَا اَوَّلِهَا وَاٰخِرِهَا مَا قُلْتَ لِنَفْسِكَ مِنْهَا
segs.en: O Allah, all praise be to You in all expressions of praise; both the first and the last expressions; expressions that You have said about Yourself and
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDU BIMAHAAMIDIKA KULLIHAA AWWALIHAA WA AAKHIRIHAA MAA QULTA LINAFSIKA MINHAA

segs.ar: وَمَا قَالَ الْخَلَاۤئِقُ الْحَامِدُوْنَ الْمُجْتَهِدُوْنَ الْمَعْدُوْدُوْنَ الْمُوَقِّرُوْنَ ذِكْرَكَ وَالشُّكْرَ لَكَ
segs.en: expressions that have been used by the created beings who praise You; the beings that are diligent, selected, revering their remembrance of You and their thanking You
segs.tr: WA MAA QAALAL KHALAA'IQUL HAAMIDOONAL MUJTAHIDOONAL MA'DOODOONAL MUWAQQIROONA DHIKRAKA WASH SHUKRA LAK

segs.en: whom You helped carry out Your duty that is incumbent upon them

segs.ar: مِنْ اَصْنَافِ خَلْقِكَ مِنَ الْمَلَاۤئِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِيْنَ وَالنَّبِيِّيْنَ وَالْمُرْسَلِيْنَ وَاَصْنَافِ النَّاطِقِيْنَ وَالْمُسَبِّحِيْنَ لَكَ مِنْ جَمِيْعِ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
segs.en: from among the varieties of Your creatures, such as the Archangels, the Prophets, the Messengers, and the other varieties who speak of Your praise and glorify You from among all the creatures.
segs.tr: MIN ASNAAFI KHALQIKA MINAL MALAA'IKATIL MUQARRABEENA WAN NABIYYEENA WAL MURSALEENA WA ASNAAFIN NAATIQEENA WAL MUSABBIHEENA LAKA MIN JAMEE'IL A'ALAMEEN

segs.ar: عَلٰۤى اَنَّكَ بَلَّغْتَنَا شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ وَعَلَيْنَا مِنْ نِعَمِكَ وَعِنْدَنَا مِنْ قِسَمِكَ وَاِحْسَانِكَ وَتَظَاهُرِ امْتِنَانِكَ
segs.en: (Praise be to You for) You have allowed us to witness the month of Ramadan while we are covered by Your graces and enjoying Your bounties, favors, and evident conferrals.
segs.tr: A'LAA ANNAKA BALLAGHTANAA SHAHRA RAMADAANA WA A'LAYNAA MIN NI'AMIKA WA I'NDANAA MIN QISAMIKA WA IHSAANIKA WA TAZAAHURIM TINAANIK

segs.ar: فَبِذٰلِكَ لَكَ مُنْتَهَى الْحَمْدِ اَلْخَالِدُ الدَّاۤئِمُ الرَّاكِدُ الْمُخَلَّدُ السَّرْمَدِ اَلَّذِيْ لَا يَنْفَدُ طُوْلَ الْاَبَدِ
segs.en: For all that, ultimate praise be to You; such praise that is perpetual, ceaseless, endless, eternal, and everlasting; such praise that never ends evermore.
segs.tr: FABIDHAALIKA LAKA MUNTAHAL HAMDIL KHAALIDUD DAA'IMUR RAAKIDUL MUKHALLADUS SARMADI ALLADHEE LAA YANFADU TOOLAL ABAD

segs.ar: جَلَّ ثَنَاۤؤُكَ اَعَنْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ حَتّٰى قَضَيْتَ عَنَّا صِيَامَهٗ وَقِيَامَهٗ
segs.en: Splendid be the praising of You, for You have helped us accomplish our fasting and acts of worship in this month
segs.tr: JALLA THANAA'UKA A'ANTANAA A'LAYHI HATTAA QADAYTA A'NNAA SIYAAMAHOO WA QIYAAMAH

segs.ar: مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَّا فِيْهِ مِنْ بِرٍّ اَوْ شُكْرٍ اَوْ ذِكْرٍ
segs.en: including prayers and whatever good deed that we have done during this month as well as all praise and mention of You.
segs.tr: MIN SALAATIN WA MAA KAANA MINNAA FEEHI MIN BIRRIN AW SHUKRIN AW DHIKR

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَتَقَبَّلْهُ مِنَّا بِاَحْسَنِ قَبُوْلِكَ وَتَجَاوُزِكَ وَعَفْوِكَ وَصَفْحِكَ وَغُفْرَانِكَ وَحَقِيْقَةِ رِضْوَانِكَ
segs.en: O Allah, (please) accept all that from us with the most excellent of Your approval, Your overlooking, Your pardoning, Your excusing, Your forgiving, and the actuality of Your pleasure
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA FATAQABBALHU MINNAA BI-AHSANI QABOOLIKA WA TAJAAWUZIKA WA A'FWIKA WA SAFHIKA WA GHUFRAANIKA WA HAQEEQATI RIDWAANIK

segs.ar: حَتّٰى تُظَفِّرَنَا فِيْهِ بِكُلِّ خَيْرٍ مَطْلُوْبٍ وَجَزِيْلِ عَطَاۤءٍ مَوْهُوْبٍ
segs.en: so that You may make us win all good turns that is besought and the abundant share from any gifted bestowal
segs.tr: HATTAA TUZAFFIRANAA FEEHI BIKULLI KHAYRIN MATLOOBIN WA JAZEELI A'TAA'IN MAWHOOB

segs.ar: وَتُوْقِيَنَا فِيْهِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَرْهُوْبٍ اَوْ بَلَاۤءٍ مَجْلُوْبٍ اَوْ ذَنْبٍ مَكْسُوْبٍ
segs.en: and You may save us from any dangerous matter, any anticipated misfortune, or any committed sin.
segs.tr: WA TOOQIYANAA FEEHI MIN KULLI MARHOOBIN AW BALAA'IN MAJLOOBIN AW DHANBIN MAKSOOB

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْۤ اَسْاَلُكَ بِعَظِيْمِ مَا سَاَلَكَ بِهٖ اَحَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ مِنْ كَرِيْمِ اَسْمَاۤئِكَ وَجَمِيْلِ ثَنَاۤئِكَ وَخَآصَّةِ دُعَاۤئِكَ
segs.en: O Allah, I beseech You in the name of the greatest of all these by which any of Your servants have besought You, including Your Noble Names, the excellent praising of You, and the private supplication to You
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS'ALUKA BI-A'ZEEMI MAA SA'ALAKA BIHEE AHADUN MIN KHALQIKA MIN KAREEMI ASMAA'IKA WA JAMEELI THANAA'IKA WA KHAASSATI DU'AA'IK

segs.ar: اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَجْعَلَ شَهْرَنَا هٰذَاۤ اَعْظَمَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مَرَّ عَلَيْنَا مُنْذُ اَنْزَلْتَنَا اِلَى الدُّنْيَا بَرَكَةً
segs.en: decide this month of Ramadan to be the greatest month in blessings that we have ever witnessed since we were sent down to this world
segs.tr: WA AN TAJ'ALA SHAHRANAA HAADHAA A'ZAMA SHAHRI RAMADAANA MARRA A'LAYNAA MUNDHU ANZALTANAA ILAD DUNYAA BARAKAH

segs.ar: فِي عِصْمَةِ دِيْنِيْ وَخَلَاصِ نَفْسِيْ وَقَضَاۤءِ حَوَاۤئِجِيْ
segs.en: as regarding protection of my religion, redemption of myself, and settlement of my needs
segs.tr: FEE I'SMATI DEENEE WA KHALAASI NAFSEE WA QADAA'I HAWAA'IJEE

segs.ar: وَتُشَفِّعَنِيْ فِيْ مَسَاۤئِلِيْ وَتَمَامِ النِّعْمَةِ عَلَيَّ وَصَرْفِ السُّوْۤءِ عَنِّيْ وَلِبَاسِ الْعَافِيَةِ لِيْ فِيْهِ
segs.en: and to accept my intercession to You concerning Your settlement of my requests, perfecting Your graces upon me, keeping evil away from me, dressing me with wellbeing during this month
segs.tr: WA TUSHAFFI'ANEE FEE MASAA'ILEE WA TAMAAMIN NI'MATI A'LAYYA WA SARFIS SOO'I A'NNEE WA LIBAASIL A'AFIYATI LEE FEEH

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَجْعَلَنِيْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِمَّنْ خِرْتَ لَهٗ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ وَجَعَلْتَهَا لَهٗ خَيْرًا مِنْ اَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
segs.en: and to include me, out of Your mercy, with those whom You allowed to obtain the benefits of the Grand Night and those for whom You have decided this Night to be better than one thousand months
segs.tr: WA AN TAJ'ALANEE BIRAHMATIKA MIMMAN KHIRTA LAHOO LAYLATAL QADRI WA JA'ALTAHAA LAHOO KHAYRAN MIN ALFI SHAHR

segs.ar: فِيْۤ اَعْظَمِ الْاَجْرِ وَكَرَاۤئِمِ الذُّخْرِ وَحُسْنِ الشُّكْرِ وَطُوْلِ الْعُمْرِ وَدَوَامِ الْيُسْرِ
segs.en: as regarding obtaining its vastest rewards, its noblest gifts, approving of praiseworthiness, obtaining long lifetime, and perpetuity of comfort.
segs.tr: FEE A'ZAMIL AJRI WA KARAA'IMIDH DHUKHRI WA HUSNISH SHUKRI WA TOOLIL U'MRI WA DAWAAMIL YUSR

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَاَسْاَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ وَطَوْلِكَ وَعَفْوِكَ وَنَعْمَاۤئِكَ وَجَلَالِكَ وَقَدِيْمِ اِحْسَانِكَ وَامْتِنَانِكَ اَنْ لَا تَجْعَلَهٗ اٰخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنَّا لِشَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ
segs.en: O Allah, I also beseech You in the name of Your mercy, Your beneficence, Your pardon, Your graces, Your majesty, Your eternal favoring, and conferral not to decide this month of Ramadan to be the last one in our lifetime
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WA AS'ALUKA BIRAHMATIKA WA TAWLIKA WA A'FWIKA WA NA'MAA'IKA WA JALAALIKA WA QADEEMI IHSAANIKA WAMTINAANIKA AN LAA TAJ'ALAHOO AAKHIRAL A'HDI MINNAA LISHAHRI RAMADAAN

segs.ar: حَتّٰى تُبَلِّغَنَاهُ مِنْ قَابِلٍ عَلٰۤى اَحْسَنِ حَالٍ
segs.en: rather, You may decide us to catch the coming month of Ramadan while we enjoy the best of manners
segs.tr: HATTAA TUBALLIGHANAAHU MIN QAABILIN A'LAA AHSANI HAAL

segs.ar: وَتُعَرِّفَنِيْ هِلَالَهٗ مَعَ النَّاظِرِيْنَ اِلَيْهِ وَالْمُعْتَرِفِيْنَ لَهٗ فِيْۤ اَعْفٰى عَافِيَتِكَ وَاَنْعَمِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَاَوْسَعِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَاَجْزَلِ قِسَمِكَ
segs.en: and to decide me to see the new moon of the next month of Ramadan by including me with those who will see it and realize its value while enjoying the best wellbeing, the most blissful of Your bounties, the most expansive of Your mercy, and the most abundant of the share of Your sustenance that You decide for me.
segs.tr: WA TU'ARRIFANEE HILAALAHOO MA'AN NAAZIREENA ILAYHI WAL MU'TARIFEENA LAHOO FEE A'FAA A'AFIYATIKA WA AN'AMI NI'MATIKA WA AWSA'I RAHMATIKA WA AJZALI QISAMIK

segs.ar: يَا رَبِّيَ الَّذِيْ لَيْسَ لِيْ رَبٌّ غَيْرُهٗ
segs.en: O my Lord save Whom I have no lord!
segs.tr: YAA RABBIYAL LADHEE LAYSA LEE RABBUN GHAYRUH

segs.ar: لَا يَكُوْنُ هٰذَا الْوَدَاعُ مِنِّيْ لَهٗ وَدَاعَ فَنَاۤءٍ وَلَاۤ اٰخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنِّيْ لِلِقَاۤءٍ
segs.en: (Please) do not decide these words of bidding farewell to the month of Ramadan to be the last farewell after which there will be my termination and do not decide this time to be the last of my meeting the month of Ramadan
segs.tr: LAA YAKOONU HAADHAL WADAA'U MINNEE LAHOO WADAA'A FANAA'IN WA LAA AAKHIRAL A'HDI MINNEE LILIQAA'

segs.ar: حَتّٰى تُرِيَنِيْهِ مِنْ قَابِلٍ فِيْۤ اَوْسَعِ النِّعَمِ وَاَفْضَلِ الرَّجَاۤءِ وَاَنَا لَكَ عَلٰۤى اَحْسَنِ الْوَفَاۤءِ
segs.en: rather, You may decide that You will enable me to witness the coming Ramadan while enjoying the most expansive graces and attaining the best of my hopes, being loyal to You in the most faithful manner.
segs.tr: HATTAA TURIYANEEHI MIN QAABILIN FEE AWSA'IN NI'AMI WA AFDALIR RAJAA'I WA ANAA LAKA A'LAA AHSANIL WAFAA'

segs.en: Verily, You are the Hearer of prayers.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اسْمَعْ دُعَاۤئِيْ وَارْحَمْ تَضَرُّعِيْ وَتَذَلُّلِيْ لَكَ وَاسْتِكَانَتِيْ وَتَوَكُّلِيْ عَلَيْكَ وَاَنَا لَكَ مُسَلِّمٌ
segs.en: O Allah, (please) respond to my prayer and have mercy upon my acquiescence, submission before You, humbleness, and reliance upon You, while I am totally subservient to You.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAS MA' DU'AA'EE WARHAM TADARRU'EE WA TADHALLULEE LAKA WASTIKAANATEE WA TAWAKKULEE A'LAYKA WA ANAA LAKA MUSALLIM

segs.ar: لَاۤ اَرْجُوْ نَجَاحًا وَلَا مُعَافَاةً وَلَا تَشْرِيْفًا وَلَا تَبْلِيْغًا اِلَّا بِكَ وَمِنْكَ
segs.en: I hope success, wellbeing, honoring, and achievements of my wishes from none save You and through none save You.
segs.tr: LAA ARJOO NAJAAHAN WA LAA MU'AAFAATAN WA LAA TASHREEFAN WA LAA TABLEEGHAN ILLAA BIKA WA MINK

segs.ar: وَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ جَلَّ ثَنَاۤؤُكَ وَتَقَدَّسَتْ اَسْمَاۤؤُكَ
segs.en: So, (please) do this favor to me. Splendid be the praising of You and sacred be Your Names.
segs.tr: WAMNUN A'LAYYA JALLA THANAA'UKA WA TAQADDASAT ASMAA'UK

segs.ar: بِتَبْلِيْغِيْ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ وَاَنَا مُعَافًى مِنْ كُلِّ مَكْرُوْهٍ وَمَحْذُوْرٍ وَمِنْ جَمِيْعِ الْبَوَاۤئِقِ
segs.en: By allowing me to witness the (coming) month of Ramadan, please deliver me from any apprehensive and fearful matter and from all misfortunes.
segs.tr: BITABLEEGHEE SHAHRA RAMADAANA WA ANAA MU'AAFAN MIN KULLI MAKROOHIN WA MAHDHOORIN WA MIN JAMEE'IL BAWAA'IQ

segs.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْۤ اَعَانَنَا عَلٰى صِيَامِ هٰذَا الشَّهْرِ وَقِيَامِهٖ حَتّٰى بَلَّغَنِيْۤ اٰخِرَ لَيْلَةٍ مِنْهُ
segs.en: All praise be to Allah Who has helped us observe fasting during this month and do acts of worship; so, I am witnessing the last night of this month.
segs.tr: AL-HAMDU LILLAAHIL LADHEE A'AANANAA A'LAA SIYAAMI HAADHASH SHAHRI WA QIYAAMIHEE HATTAA BALLAGHANEE AAKHIRA LAYLATIN MINH

A_AA47.merits: Shaykh al-Kulayni, may Allah be pleased with him, in his book of al-Kafi, has reported on the authority of Abu-Basir that Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) instructed that this supplicatory prayer might be said for bidding farewell to the month of Ramazan.

A_AA48.name: Dua No. 44 of Sahifa al-Kamila (Welcoming Ramazan)

segs.en: Praise belongs to God who guided us to His praise

segs.ar: وَجَعَلَنَا مِنْ اَهْلِهٖ لِنَكُونَ لِاِحْسَانِهٖ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ
segs.en: and placed us among the people of praise, that we might be among the thankful for His beneficence
segs.tr: WA JA'ALANAA MIN AHLIHEE LINAKOONA LI-IHSAANIHEE MINASH SHAAKIREEN

segs.en: and that He might recompense us for that with the recompense of the good-doers!
segs.tr: WA LIYAJZIYANAA A'LAA DHAALIKA JAZAA'AL MUHSINEEN

segs.en: And praise belongs to God who showed favour to us through His religion,
segs.tr: WAL HAMDU LILLAAHIL LADHEE HABAANAA BIDEENIH

segs.ar: وَاخْتَصَّنَا بِمِلَّتِهٖ، وَسَبَّلَنَا فِي سُبُلِ اِحْسَانِهٖ
segs.en: singled us out for His creed, and directed us onto the roads of His beneficence,
segs.tr: WAKHTASSANAA BIMILLATIHEE WA SABBALANAA FEE SUBULI IHSAANIH

segs.en: in order that through His kindness we might travel upon them to His good pleasure,

segs.ar: حَمْداً يَتَقَبَّلُهٗ مِنَّا، وَيَرْضَى بِهٖ عَنَّا
segs.en: a praise which He will accept from us and through which He will be pleased with us!
segs.tr: HAMDAN YATAQABBALUHOO MINNAA WA YARDAA BIHEE A'NNAA

segs.ar: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي جَعَلَ مِنْ تِلْكَ السُّبُلِ شَهْرَهٗ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ
segs.en: And praise belongs to God who appointed among those roads His month, the month of Ramadan,
segs.tr: WAL HAMDU LILLAAHIL LADHEE JA'ALA MIN TILKAS SUBULI SHAHRAHOO SHAHRA RAMADAAN

segs.ar: شَهْرَ الصِّيَامِ، وَشَهْرَ الْاِسْلَامِ، وَشَهْرَ الطَّهُورِ
segs.en: the month of fasting, the month of submission, the month of purity,
segs.tr: SHAHRAS SIYAAMI WA SHAHRAL ISLAAMI WA SHAHRAT TAHOOR

segs.en: the month of putting to test, the month of standing in prayer,
segs.tr: WA SHAHRAT TAMHEESI WA SHAHRAL QIYAAM

segs.ar: الَّذِي اُنْزِلَ فِيهِ الْقُرْاٰنُ، هُدًى لِلنَّاسِ
segs.en: "in which the Qur'an was sent down as guidance to the people,
segs.tr: ALLADHEE UNZILA FEEHIL QUR'AANU HUDAN LIN NAAS

segs.en: and as clear signs of the Guidance and the Separator" (2:185)!
segs.tr: WA BAYYINAATIN MINAL HUDAA WAL FURQAAN

segs.en: He clarified its excellence over other months

segs.ar: بِمَا جَعَلَ لَهٗ مِنَ الْحُرُمَاتِ الْمَوْفُورَةِ، وَالْفَضَائِلِ الْمَشْهُورَةِ
segs.en: by the many sacred things and well-known excellencies which He placed therein,
segs.tr: BIMAA JA'ALA LAHOO MINAL HURUMAATIL MAWFOORATI WAL FADAA'ILIL MASH-HOORAH

segs.ar: فَحَرَّمَ فِيهِ مَا اَحَلَّ فِي غَيْرِهٖ اِعْظَاماً
segs.en: for He made unlawful in it what He declared lawful in others to magnify it,
segs.tr: FAHARRAMA FEEHI MAA AHALLA FEE GHAYRIHEE I'ZAAMAA

segs.en: He prohibited foods and drinks in it to honour it,
segs.tr: WA HAJARA FEEHIL MATAA'IMA WAL MASHAARIBA IKRAAMAA

segs.ar: وَجَعَلَ لَهٗ وَقْتاً بَيِّناً لَا يُجِيزُ جَلَّ وَعَزَّ اَنْ يُقَدَّمَ قَبْلَهٗ
segs.en: and He appointed for it a clear time which He (majestic and mighty is He) allows not to be set forward
segs.tr: WA JA'ALA LAHOO WAQTAN BAYYINAN LAA YUJEEZU JALLA WA A'ZZA AN YUQADDAMA QABLAH

segs.en: and accepts not to be placed behind.
segs.tr: WA LAA YAQBALU AN YU'AKHKHARA A'NH

segs.ar: ثُمَّ فَضَّلَ لَيْلَةً وَاحِدَةً مِنْ لَيَالِيهِ عَلَى لَيَالِي اَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
segs.en: Then He made one of its nights surpass the nights of a thousand months
segs.tr: THUMMA FADDALA LAYLATAN WAAHIDATAN MIN LAYAALEEHI A'LAA LAYAALEE ALFI SHAHR

segs.en: and named it the Night of Decree;

segs.ar: تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِاِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ اَمْرٍ
segs.en: "in it the angels and the Spirit descend by the leave of their Lord upon every command,
segs.tr: TANAZZALUL MALAA'IKATU WAR ROOHU FEEHAA BI-IDHNI RABBIHIM MIN KULLI AMR

segs.ar: سَلَامٌ، دَائِمُ الْبَرَكَةِ اِلَى طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ
segs.en: a peace" (97:4-5) constant in blessings until the rising of the dawn
segs.tr: SALAAMUN DAA'IMUL BARAKATI ILAA TULOO'IL FAJR

segs.ar: عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهٖ بِمَا اَحْكَمَ مِنْ قَضَائِهِ
segs.en: upon whomsoever He will of His servants according to the decision He has made firm.
segs.tr: A'LAA MAN YASHAA'U MIN I'BAADIHEE BIMAA AHKAMA MIN QADAA'IH

segs.en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.en: inspire us with knowledge of its excellence, veneration of its inviolability,
segs.tr: WA ALHIMNAA MA'RIFATA FADLIHEE WA IJLAALA HURMATIH

segs.en: and caution against what You have forbidden within it,

segs.ar: وَاَعِنَّا عَلَى صِيَامِهٖ بِكَفِّ الْجَوَارِحِ عَنْ مَعَاصِيكَ
segs.en: and help us to fast in it by our restraining our limbs from acts of disobedience toward You
segs.tr: WA A'INNAA A'LAA SIYAAMIHEE BIKAFFIL JAWAARIHI A'N MA'AASEEK

segs.en: and our employing them in that which pleases You,

segs.ar: حَتَّى لَا نُصْغِيَ بِاَسْمَاعِنَا اِلَى لَغْوٍ
segs.en: so that we lend not our ears to idle talk
segs.tr: HATTAA LAA NUSGHIYA BI-ASMAA'INAA ILAA LAGHW

segs.en: and hurry not with our eyes to diversion,
segs.tr: WA LAA NUSRI'A BI-ABSAARINAA ILAA LAHW

segs.ar: وَحَتَّى لَا نَبْسُطَ اَيْدِيَنَا اِلَى مَحْظُورٍ
segs.en: we stretch not our hands toward the forbidden
segs.tr: WA HATTAA LAA NABSUTA AYDIYANAA ILAA MAHZOOR

segs.en: and stride not with our feet toward the prohibited,
segs.tr: WA LAA NAKHTUWA BI-AQDAAMINAA ILAA MAHJOOR

segs.ar: وَحَتَّى لَا تَعِيَ بُطُونُنَا اِلَّا مَا اَحْلَلْتَ
segs.en: our bellies hold only what You have made lawful
segs.tr: WA HATTAA LAA TA'IYA BUTOONUNAA ILLAA MAA AHLALT

segs.ar: وَلَا تَنْطِقَ اَلْسِنَتُنَا اِلَّا بِمَا مَثَّلْتَ
segs.en: and our tongues speak only what You have exemplified,
segs.tr: WA LAA TANTIQA ALSINATUNAA ILLAA BIMAA MATHTHALT

segs.ar: وَلَا نَتَكَلَّفَ اِلَّا مَا يُدْنِي مِنْ ثَوَابِكَ
segs.en: we undertake nothing but what brings close to Your reward
segs.tr: WA LAA NATAKALLAFA ILLAA MAA YUDNEE MIN THAWAABIK

segs.ar: وَلَا نَتَعَاطَى اِلَّا الَّذِي يَقِي مِنْ عِقَابِكَ
segs.en: and pursue nothing but what protects from Your punishment!
segs.tr: WA LAA NATA'AATAA ILLAL LADHEE YAQEE MIN I'QAABIK

segs.ar: ثُمَّ خَلِّصْ ذَلِكَ كُلَّهٗ مِنْ رِئَاءِ الْمُرَاءِينَ، وَسُمْعَةِ الْمُسْمِعِينَ
segs.en: Then rid all of that from the false show of the false showers and the fame seeking of the fame seekers,
segs.tr: THUMMA KHALLIS DHAALIKA KULLAHOO MIN RI'AA'IL MURAA'EENA WA SUM'ATIL MUSMI'EEN

segs.en: lest we associate therein anything with You
or seek therein any object of desire but You!
segs.tr: WA LAA NABTAGHEE FEEHI MURAADAN SIWAAK

segs.en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.en: in it make us attend to the appointed moments
of the five prayers within the bounds You have set,

segs.ar: وَفُرُوضِهَا الَّتِي فَرَضْتَ، وَوَظَائِفِهَا الَّتِي وَظَّفْتَ
segs.en: the obligations You have decreed, the duties You have assigned,
segs.tr: WA FUROODIHAL LATEE FARADTA WA WAZAA'IFIHAL LATEE WAZZAFT

segs.en: and the times You have specified;
and in the prayers make us alight in the station of the keepers of their stations,
segs.tr: WA ANZILNAA FEEHAA MANZILATAL MUSEEBEENA LIMANAAZILIHAA

segs.en: the guardians of their pillars, their performers in their times,

segs.ar: فِي اَوْقَاتِهَا عَلَى مَا سَنَّهٗ عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهِ
segs.en: as Your servant and Your messenger set down in his Sunna (Your blessings be upon him and his Household)
segs.tr: FEE AWQAATIHAA A'LAA MAA SANNAHOO A'BDUKA WA RASOOLUKA SALAWAATUKA A'LAYHI WA AALIH

segs.en: in their bowings, their prostrations, and all their excellent acts,
segs.tr: FEE RUKOO'IHAA WA SUJOODIHAA WA JAMEE'I FAWAADILIHAA

segs.ar: عَلَى اَتَمِّ الطَّهُورِ وَاَسْبَغِهٖ، وَاَبْيَنِ الْخُشُوعِ وَاَبْلَغِهٖ
segs.en: with the most complete and ample ritual purity and the most evident and intense humility!
segs.tr: A'LAA ATAMMIT TAHOORI WA ASBAGHIHEE WA ABYANIL KHUSHOO'I WA ABLAGHIH

segs.ar: وَوَفِّقْنَا فِيهِ لِاَنْ نَصِلَ اَرْحَامَنَا بِالْبِرِّ وَالصِّلَةِ
segs.en: Give us success in this month to tighten our bonds of kin with devotion and gifts,
segs.tr: WA WAFFIQNAA FEEHI LI-AN NASILA ARHAAMANAA BIL BIRRI WAS SILAH

segs.en: attend to our neighbours with bestowal and giving,
segs.tr: WA AN NATA'AAHADA JEERAANANAA BIL IFDAALI WAL A'TIYYAH

segs.en: rid our possessions from claims,
segs.tr: WA AN NUKHALLISA AMWAALANAA MINAT TABI'AAT

segs.en: purify them through paying the alms,
go back to him who has gone far from us,
treat justly him who has wronged us,
make peace with him who shows enmity toward us
(except him who is regarded as an enemy in You and for You,
segs.tr: HAASHAA MAN U'OODIYA FEEKA WA LAK

segs.en: for he is the enemy whom we will not befriend,
the party whom we will not hold dear),

segs.ar: وَاَنْ نَتَقَرَّبَ اِلَيْكَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْاَعْمَالِ الزَّاكِيَةِ بِمَا تُطَهِّرُنَا بِهٖ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ
segs.en: and seek nearness to You through blameless works which will purify us from sins
segs.tr: WA AN NATAQARRABA ILAYKA FEEHI MINAL A'MAALIZ ZAAKIYATI BIMAA TUTAHHIRUNAA BIHEE MINADH DHUNOOB

segs.ar: وَتَعْصِمُنَا فِيهِ مِمَّا نَسْتَاْنِفُ مِنَ الْعُيُوبِ
segs.en: and preserve us from renewing faults,
segs.tr: WA TA'SIMUNAA FEEHI MIMMAA NASTA'NIFU MINAL U'YOOB

segs.ar: حَتَّى لَا يُورِدَ عَلَيْكَ اَحَدٌ مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِكَ
segs.en: so that none of Your angels will bring for You
segs.tr: HATTAA LAA YOORIDA A'LAYKA AHADUN MIN MALAA'IKATIK

segs.ar: اِلَّا دُونَ مَا نُورِدُ مِنْ اَبْوَابِ الطَّاعَةِ لَكَ، وَاَنْوَاعِ الْقُرْبَةِ اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: the kinds of obedience and sorts of nearness-seeking unless they be less than what we bring!
segs.tr: ILLAA DOONA MAA NOORIDU MIN ABWAABIT TAA'ATI LAKA WA ANWAA'IL QURBATI ILAYK

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اِنِّي اَسْاَلُكَ بِحَقِّ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ
segs.en: O God, I ask You by the right of this month
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS'ALUKA BIHAQQI HAADHASH SHAHR

segs.en: and by the right of him who worships You within it
segs.tr: WA BIHAQQI MAN TA'ABBADA LAKA FEEH

segs.en: from its beginning to the time of its passing,

segs.ar: مِنْ مَلَكٍ قَرَّبْتَهٗ، اَوْ نَبِيٍّ اَرْسَلْتَهٗ
segs.en: whether angel You have brought nigh to You, prophet You have sent,
segs.tr: MIN MALAKIN QARRABTAHOO AW NABIYYIN ARSALTAH

segs.en: or righteous servant You have singled out,
that You bless Muhammad and his Household,
segs.tr: AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.ar: وَاَهِّلْنَا فِيهِ لِمَا وَعَدْتَ اَوْلِيَاءَكَ مِنْ كَرَامَتِكَ
segs.en: make us worthy of the generosity You have promised Your friends,
segs.tr: WA AHHILNAA FEEHI LIMAA WA'ADTA AWLIYAA'AKA MIN KARAAMATIK

segs.ar: وَاَوْجِبْ لَنَا فِيهِ مَا اَوْجَبْتَ لِاَهْلِ الْمُبَالَغَةِ فِي طَاعَتِكَ
segs.en: make incumbent for us what You have made incumbent for those who go to great lengths in obeying You,
segs.tr: WA AWJIB LANAA FEEHI MAA AWJABTA LI-AHLIL MUBAALAGHATI FEE TAA'ATIK

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا فِي نَظْمِ مَنِ اسْتَحَقَّ الرَّفِيعَ الْاَعْلَى بِرَحْمَتِكَ
segs.en: and place us in the ranks of those who deserve through Your mercy the highest elevation!
segs.tr: WAJ'ALNAA FEE NAZMI MANIS TAHAQQAR RAFEE'AL A'LAA BIRAHMATIK

segs.en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.ar: وَجَنِّبْنَا الْاِلْحَادَ فِي تَوْحِيدِكَ، وَالْتَّقْصِيرَ فِي تَمْجِيدِكَ
segs.en: turn us aside from deviation in professing Your Unity, falling short in magnifying You,
segs.tr: WA JANNIBNAL ILHAADA FEE TAWHEEDIKA WAT TAQSEERA FEE TAMJEEDIK

segs.ar: وَالشَّكَّ فِي دِينِكَ، وَالْعَمَى عَنْ سَبِيلِكَ، وَالْاِغْفَالَ لِحُرْمَتِكَ
segs.en: uncertainty in Your religion, blindness toward Your path, heedlessness of Your inviolability,
segs.tr: WASH SHAKKA FEE DEENIKA WAL A'MAA A'N SABEELIKA WAL IGHFAALA LIHURMATIK

segs.en: and being deceived by Your enemy, the accursed Satan!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.ar: وَاِذَا كَانَ لَكَ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ مِنْ لَيَالِي شَهْرِنَا هَذَا
segs.en: and when in every night of this month's nights
segs.tr: WA IDHAA KAANA LAKA FEE KULLI LAYLATIN MIN LAYAALEE SHAHRINAA HAADHAA

segs.ar: رِقَابٌ يُعْتِقُهَا عَفْوُكَ، اَوْ يَهَبُهَا صَفْحُكَ
segs.en: You have necks which Your pardon will release and Your forgiveness disregard,
segs.tr: RIQAABUN YU'TIQUHAA A'FWUKA AW YAHABUHAA SAFHUK

segs.en: place our necks among those necks

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا لِشَهْرِنَا مِنْ خَيْرِ اَهْلٍ وَاَصْحَابٍ
segs.en: and place us among the best folk and companions of this our month!
segs.tr: WAJ'ALNAA LISHAHRINAA MIN KHAYRI AHLIN WA AS-HAAB

segs.en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.en: efface our sins along with the effacing of its crescent moon,

segs.ar: وَاسْلَخْ عَنَّا تَبِعَاتِنَا مَعَ انْسِلَاخِ اَيَّامِهٖ
segs.en: and make us pass forth from the ill effects of our acts with the passing of its days,
segs.tr: WASLAKH A'NNAA TABI'AATINAA MA'AN SILAAKHI AYYAAMIH

segs.ar: حَتَّى يَنْقَضِيَ عَنَّا وَقَدْ صَفَّيْتَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْخَطِيئَاتِ
segs.en: until it leaves us behind, while within it You have purified us of offenses
segs.tr: HATTAA YANQADIYA A'NNAA WA QAD SAFFAYTANAA FEEHI MINAL KHATEE'AAT

segs.en: and rid us of evil deeds!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.ar: وَاِنْ مِلْنَا فِيهِ فَعَدِّلْنَا، وَاِنْ زُغْنَا فِيهِ فَقَوِّمْنَا
segs.en: and should we go off to one side in this month, set us aright; should we swerve, point us straight;
segs.tr: WA IN MILNAA FEEHI FA'ADDILNAA WA IN ZUGHNAA FEEHI FAQAWWIMNAA

segs.ar: وَاِنِ اشْتَمَلَ عَلَيْنَا عَدُوُّكَ الشَّيْطَانُ فَاسْتَنْقِذْنَا مِنْهُ
segs.en: and should Your enemy Satan enwrap us, rescue us from him!
segs.tr: WA INISH TAMALA A'LAYNAA A'DUWWUKASH SHAYTAANU FASTANQIDHNAA MINH

segs.en: O God, fill this month with our worship of You,
adorn its times with our obedience toward You,
help us during its daytime with its fast,
segs.tr: WA A'INNAA FEE NAHAARIHEE A'LAA SIYAAMIH

segs.en: and in its night with prayer
and pleading toward You, humility toward You,
segs.tr: WAT TADARRU'I ILAYKA WAL KHUSHOO'I LAK

segs.en: and lowliness before You,

segs.ar: حَتَّى لَا يَشْهَدَ نَهَارُهٗ عَلَيْنَا بِغَفْلَةٍ، وَلَا لَيْلُهٗ بِتَفْرِيطٍ
segs.en: so that its daytime may not bear witness against our heedlessness, nor its night against our neglect!
segs.tr: HATTAA LAA YASH-HADA NAHAARUHOO A'LAYNAA BIGHAFLATIN WA LAA LAYLUHOO BITAFREET

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَاجْعَلْنَا فِي سَائِرِ الشُّهُورِ وَالْاَيَّامِ كَذَلِكَ مَا عَمَّرْتَنَا
segs.en: O God, make us like this in the other months and days as long as You give us life,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WAJ'ALNAA FEE SAA'IRISH SHUHOORI WAL AYYAAMI KADHAALIKA MAA A'MMARTANAA

segs.en: and place us among Your righteous servants,

segs.ar: الَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
segs.en: "those who shall inherit Paradise, therein dwelling forever" (23:11),
segs.tr: ALLADHEENA YARITHOONAL FIRDAWSA HUM FEEHAA KHAALIDOON

segs.en: "those who give what they give, while their hearts quake,
segs.tr: WAL LADHEENA YU'TOONA MAA AATAW WA QULOOBUHUM

segs.en: that they are returning to their Lord" (23:60),

segs.ar: وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَابِقُونَ
segs.en: those who "..vie in good works, outracing to them" (23:61)!
segs.tr: WA MINAL LADHEENA YUSAARI'OONA FIL KHAYRAATI WA HUM LAHAA SAABIQOON

segs.en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.ar: فِي كُلِّ وَقْتٍ وَكُلِّ اَوَانٍ وَعَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
segs.en: in every time, in all moments, and in every state,
segs.tr: FEE KULLI WAQTIN WA KULLI AWAANIN WA A'LAA KULLI HAAL

segs.ar: عَدَدَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى مَنْ صَلَّيْتَ عَلَيْهِ
segs.en: to the number that You have blessed whomsoever You have blessed
segs.tr: A'DADA MAA SALLAYTA A'LAA MAN SALLAYTA A'LAYH

segs.en: and to multiples of all that, through multiples
segs.tr: WA AD'AAFA DHAALIKA KULLIHEE BIL AD'AAF

segs.en: which none can count but You!
Surely You are Accomplisher of what You desire.

A_AA48.merits: The forty-fourth supplication of al-Sahifah al-Kamilah al-Sajjadiyyah, Imam Zayn al-Abidin (a.s.)'s supplication for the coming of the month of Ramadan. It is among the acts of the first night of Ramazan.

A_AA49.name: Dua No. 45 of Sahifa al-Kamila (Farewell to Ramazan)

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ لَا يَرْغَبُ فِي الْجَزَاءِ
segs.en: O God, O He who desires no repayment!
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA YAA MAN LAA YARGHABU FIL JAZAA'

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لَا يَنْدَمُ عَلَى الْعَطَاءِ
segs.en: O He who shows no remorse at bestowal!
segs.tr: WA YAA MAN LAA YANDAMU A'LAL A'TAA'

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ لَا يُكَافِئُ عَبْدَهٗ عَلَى السَّوَاءِ
segs.en: O He who rewards not His servant tit for tat!
segs.tr: WA YAA MAN LAA YUKAAFI'U A'BDAHOO A'LAS SAWAA'

segs.en: Your kindness is a new beginning, Your pardon gratuitous bounty,
Your punishment justice, Your decree a choice for the best!
segs.tr: WA U'QOOBATUKA A'DLUN WA QADAA'UKA KHIYARAH

segs.ar: اِنْ اَعْطَيْتَ لَمْ تَشُبْ عَطَاءَكَ بِمَنٍّ
segs.en: If You bestow, You stain not Your bestowal with obligation,
segs.tr: IN A'TAYTA LAM TASHUB A'TAA'AKA BIMANN

segs.ar: وَاِنْ مَنَعْتَ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَنْعُكَ تَعَدِّياً
segs.en: and if You withhold, You withhold not in transgression.
segs.tr: WA IN MANA'TA LAM YAKUN MAN'UKA TA'ADDIYAA

segs.ar: تَشْكُرُ مَنْ شَكَرَكَ وَاَنْتَ اَلْهَمْتَهٗ شُكْرَكَ
segs.en: You show gratitude to him who thanks You, while You have inspired him to thank You.
segs.tr: TASHKURU MAN SHAKARAKA WA ANTA ALHAMTAHOO SHUKRAK

segs.ar: وَتُكَافِئُ مَنْ حَمِدَكَ وَاَنْتَ عَلَّمْتَهٗ حَمْدَكَ
segs.en: You reward him who praises You, while though You have taught him Your praise.
segs.tr: WA TUKAAFI'U MAN HAMIDAKA WA ANTA A'LLAMTAHOO HAMDAK

segs.ar: تَسْتُرُ عَلَى مَنْ لَوْ شِئْتَ فَضَحْتَهٗ
segs.en: You cover him whom, if You willed, You would expose,
segs.tr: TASTURU A'LAA MAN LAW SHI'TA FADAHTAH

segs.ar: وَتَجُودُ عَلَى مَنْ لَوْ شِئْتَ مَنَعْتَهٗ
segs.en: and You are generous toward him from whom, if You willed, You would withhold.
segs.tr: WA TAJOODU A'LAA MAN LAW SHI'TA MANA'TAH

segs.en: Both are worthy of Your exposure and withholding,
segs.tr: WA KILAAHUMAA AHLUN MINKA LIL FADEEHATI WAL MAN'

segs.ar: غَيْرَ اَنَّكَ بَنَيْتَ اَفْعَالَكَ عَلَى التَّفَضُّلِ
segs.en: but You have founded Your acts upon gratuitous bounty,
segs.tr: GHAYRA ANNAKA BANAYTA AF'AALAKA A'LAT TAFADDUL

segs.en: channelled Your power into forbearance,
received him who disobeyed You with clemency,
segs.tr: WA TALAQQAYTA MAN A'SAAKA BIL HILM

segs.en: and disregarded him who intended wrongdoing against himself.
segs.tr: WA AMHALTA MAN QASADA LINAFSIHEE BIZ ZULM

segs.ar: تَسْتَنْظِرُهُمْ بِاَنَاتِكَ اِلَى الْاِنَابَةِ، وَتَتْرُكُ مُعَاجَلَتَهُمْ اِلَى التَّوْبَةِ
segs.en: You await their turning back without haste and refrain from rushing them toward repentance,
segs.tr: TASTANZIRUHUM BI-ANAATIKA ILAL INAABATI WA TATRUKU MU'AAJALATAHUM ILAT TAWBAH

segs.en: so that the perisher among them may not perish because of You
and the wretched may not be wretched through Your favour,
but only after Your prolonged excusing him
and successive arguments against him,
as an act of generosity through Your pardon, O Generous,
and an act of kindliness through Your tenderness, O Clement!
segs.tr: WA A'A'IDATAN MIN A'TFIKA YAA HALEEM

segs.en: It is You who have opened for Your servants a door
to Your pardon, which You have named 'repentance'.

segs.ar: وَجَعَلْتَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ الْبَابِ دَلِيلًا مِنْ وَحْيِكَ
segs.en: You have placed upon that door a pointer from Your revelation,
segs.tr: WA JA'ALTA A'LAA DHAALIKAL BAABI DALEELAN MIN WAHYIK

segs.ar: لِئَلَّا يَضِلُّوا عَنْهُ، فَقُلْتَ تَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ
segs.en: lest they stray from it: You have said (blessed is Your Name),
segs.tr: LI-ALLAA YADILLOO A'NHU FAQULTA TABAARAKAS MUK

segs.ar: تُوبُوا اِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحاً عَسَى رَبُّكُمْ
segs.en: "Repent toward God with unswerving repentance! It may be that Your Lord
segs.tr: TOOBOO ILALLAAHI TAWBATAN NASOOHAN A'SAA RABBUKUM

segs.en: will acquit of your evil deeds and will admit you into
segs.tr: AN YUKAFFIRA A'NKUM SAYYI'AATIKUM WA YUDKHILAKUM

segs.en: gardens beneath which rivers flow,
upon the day when God will not degrade the Prophet

segs.ar: وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوا مَعَهٗ، نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَى بَيْنَ اَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِاَيْمَانِهِمْ
segs.en: and those who have faith along with him, their light running before them and on their right hands,
segs.tr: WAL LADHEENA AAMANOO MA'AHOO NOORUHUM YAS'AA BAYNA AYDEEHIM WA BI-AYMAANIHIM

segs.ar: يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا
segs.en: and they say: 'Our Lord, complete for us our light, and forgive us!
segs.tr: YAQOOLOONA RABBANAA ATMIM LANAA NOORANAA WAGHFIR LANAA

segs.en: Surely You are powerful over everything" (66:8).

segs.ar: فَمَا عُذْرُ مَنْ اَغْفَلَ دُخُولَ ذَلِكَ الْمَنْزِلِ
segs.en: What is the excuse of him who remains heedless of entering that house
segs.tr: FAMAA U'DHRU MAN AGHFALA DUKHOOLA DHAALIKAL MANZIL

segs.en: after the opening of the door and the setting up of the pointer?
segs.tr: BA'DA FAT-HIL BAABI WA IQAAMATID DALEEL

segs.ar: وَاَنْتَ الَّذِي زِدْتَ فِي السَّوْمِ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ لِعِبَادِكَ
segs.en: It is You who have raised the price against Yourself to the advantage of Your servants,
segs.tr: WA ANTAL LADHEE ZIDTA FIS SAWMI A'LAA NAFSIKA LI-I'BAADIK

segs.en: desiring their profit in their trade with You,
their triumph through reaching You, and their increase on account of You,
segs.tr: WA FAWZAHUM BIL WIFAADATI A'LAYKA WAZ ZIYAADATI MINK

segs.en: for You have said (blessed is Your Name and high are You exalted),

segs.ar: مَنْ جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهٗ عَشْرُ اَمْثَالِهَا
segs.en: "Whoso brings a good deed shall have ten the like of it,
segs.tr: MAN JAA'A BIL HASANATI FALAHOO A'SHRU AMTHAALIHAA

segs.ar: وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجْزَى اِلَّا مِثْلَهَا
segs.en: and whoso brings an evil deed shall only be recompensed the like of it" (6:160).
segs.tr: WA MAN JAA'A BIS SAYYI'ATI FALAA YUJZAA ILLAA MITHLAHAA

segs.ar: وَقُلْتَ مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنْفِقُونَ اَمْوَالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ
segs.en: You have said, "The likeness of those who expend their wealth in the way of God is as the likeness of a grain of corn
segs.tr: WA QULTA MATHALUL LADHEENA YUNFIQOONA AMWAALAHUM FEE SABEELILLAAHI KAMATHALI HABBAH

segs.ar: اَنْبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ فِي كُلِّ سُنْبُلَةٍ مِائَةُ حَبَّةٍ
segs.en: that sprouts seven ears, in every ear a hundred grains;
segs.tr: ANBATAT SAB'A SANAABILA FEE KULLI SUNBULATIN MI'ATU HABBAH

segs.en: so God multiplies unto whom He wills" (2:261).

segs.ar: وَقُلْتَ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرْضاً حَسَناً
segs.en: You have said, "Who is he that will lend to God a good loan,
segs.tr: WA QULTA MAN DHAL LADHEE YUQRIDULLAAHA QARDAN HASANAA

segs.en: and He will multiply it for him manifold" (2:245)?

segs.ar: وَمَا اَنْزَلْتَ مِنْ نَظَائِرِهِنَّ فِي الْقُرْاٰنِ مِنْ تَضَاعِيفِ الْحَسَنَاتِ
segs.en: And You have sent down in the Qur'an similar verses on the multiplying of good deeds.
segs.tr: WA MAA ANZALTA MIN NAZAA'IRIHINNA FIL QUR'AANI MIN TADAA'EEFIL HASANAAT

segs.ar: وَاَنْتَ الَّذِي دَلَلْتَهُمْ بِقَوْلِكَ مِنْ غَيْبِكَ وَتَرْغِيبِكَ
segs.en: It is You who have pointed them through Your speech from Your Unseen and Your encouragement
segs.tr: WA ANTAL LADHEE DALALTAHUM BIQAWLIKA MIN GHAYBIKA WA TARGHEEBIK

segs.ar: الَّذِي فِيهِ حَظُّهُمْ عَلَى مَا لَوْ سَتَرْتَهٗ عَنْهُمْ
segs.en: in which lies their good fortune toward that which - had You covered it from them
segs.tr: ALLADHEE FEEHI HAZZUHUM A'LAA MAA LAW SATARTAHOO A'NHUM

segs.ar: لَمْ تُدْرِكْهُ اَبْصَارُهُمْ، وَلَمْ تَعِهٖ اَسْمَاعُهُمْ
segs.en: their eyes would not have perceived, their ears would not have heard,
segs.tr: LAM TUDRIK-HU ABSAARUHUM WA LAM TA'IHEE ASMAA'UHUM

segs.en: and their imaginations would not have grasped,

segs.ar: فَقُلْتَ فَاذْكُرُونِي اَذْكُرْكُمْ، وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
segs.en: for You have said, "Remember Me and I will remember you be thankful to Me, and be you not thankless towards Me" (2:152)!
segs.tr: FAQULTA FADHKUROONEE ADHKURKUM WASHKUROO LEE WA LAA TAKFUROON

segs.en: You have said, "If you are thankful, surely I will increase you,
but if you are thankless, My chastisement is surely terrible" (14:7);
segs.tr: WA LA-IN KAFARTUM INNA A'DHAABEE LASHADEED

segs.en: And You have said, "Supplicate Me and I will respond to you,
surely those who wax too proud to worship Me
shall enter Gehenna utterly abject" (40:60).
Hence You have named supplicating You 'worship' and refraining from it 'waxing proud',
segs.tr: FASAMMAYTA DU'AA'AKA I'BAADATAN WA TARKAHUS TIKBAARAA

segs.ar: وَتَوَعَّدْتَ عَلَى تَرْكِهٖ دُخُولَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ
segs.en: and You have threatened that the refraining from it would yield entrance into Gehenna in utter abjection.
segs.tr: WA TAWA''ADTA A'LAA TARKIHEE DUKHOOLA JAHANNAMA DAAKHIREEN

segs.en: So they remember You for Your kindness, they thank You for Your bounty,
they supplicate You by Your command,
and they donate for You in order to seek Your increase;
in all this lies their deliverance from Your wrath
segs.tr: WA FEEHAA KAANAT NAJAATUHUM MIN GHADABIK

segs.en: and their triumph through Your good pleasure.

segs.ar: وَلَوْ دَلَّ مَخْلُوقٌ مَخْلُوقاً مِنْ نَفْسِهٖ
segs.en: Were any creature himself to direct another creature
segs.tr: WA LAW DALLA MAKHLOOQUN MAKHLOOQAN MIN NAFSIH

segs.ar: عَلَى مِثْلِ الَّذِي دَلَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عِبَادَكَ مِنْكَ
segs.en: to the like of that to which You Yourself have directed Your servants,
segs.tr: A'LAA MITHLIL LADHEE DALALTA A'LAYHI I'BAADAKA MINK

segs.en: he would be described by beneficence,
qualified by kindness, and praised by every tongue.
segs.tr: WA MAN'OOTAN BIL IMTINAANI WA MAHMOODAN BIKULLI LISAAN

segs.ar: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ مَا وُجِدَ فِي حَمْدِكَ مَذْهَبٌ
segs.en: So to You belongs praise as long as there is found a way to praise You
segs.tr: FALAKAL HAMDU MAA WUJIDA FEE HAMDIKA MADH-HAB

segs.ar: وَمَا بَقِيَ لِلْحَمْدِ لَفْظٌ تُحْمَدُ بِهٖ، وَمَعْنًى يَنْصَرِفُ اِلَيْهِ
segs.en: and as long as there remains for praising words by which You may be praised and meanings which may be spent in praise!
segs.tr: WA MAA BAQIYA LIL HAMDI LAFZUN TUHMADU BIHEE WA MA'NAN YANSARIFU ILAYH

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ تَحَمَّدَ اِلَى عِبَادِهٖ بِالْاِحْسَانِ وَالْفَضْلِ
segs.en: O He who shows Himself praiseworthy to His servants through beneficence and bounty,
segs.tr: YAA MAN TAHAMMADA ILAA I'BAADIHEE BIL IHSAANI WAL FADL

segs.en: flooding them with kindness and graciousness!
segs.tr: WA GHAMARAHUM BIL MANNI WAT TAWL

segs.ar: مَا اَفْشَى فِينَا نِعْمَتَكَ، وَاَسْبَغَ عَلَيْنَا مِنَّتَكَ
segs.en: How much Your favour has been spread about among us, Your kindness lavished upon us,
segs.tr: MAA AFSHAA FEENAA NI'MATAKA WA ASBAGHA A'LAYNAA MINNATAK

segs.en: and Your goodness singled out for us!
You have guided us to Your religion which You have chosen,
Your creed with which You are pleased,
and Your path which You have made smooth,

segs.ar: وَبَصَّرْتَنَا الزُّلْفَةَ لَدَيْكَ، وَالْوُصُولَ اِلَى كَرَامَتِكَ
segs.en: and You have shown us proximity to You and arrival at Your generosity!
segs.tr: WA BASSARTANAZ ZULFATA LADAYKA WAL WUSOOLA ILAA KARAAMATIK

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَاَنْتَ جَعَلْتَ مِنْ صَفَايَا تِلْكَ الْوَظَائِفِ
segs.en: O God, You have appointed among the choicest of those duties
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WA ANTA JA'ALTA MIN SAFAAYAA TILKAL WAZAA'IF

segs.en: and the most special of those obligations

segs.ar: شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي اخْتَصَصْتَهٗ مِنْ سَائِرِ الشُّهُورِ
segs.en: the month of Ramadan, which You have singled out from other months,
segs.tr: SHAHRA RAMADAANAL LADHIKH TASASTAHOO MIN SAA'IRISH SHUHOOR

segs.en: chosen from among all periods and eras,
segs.tr: WA TAKHAYYARTAHOO MIN JAMEE'IL AZMINATI WAD DUHOOR

segs.en: and preferred over all times of the year
segs.tr: WA AATHARTAHOO A'LAA KULLI AWQAATIS SANAH

segs.ar: بِمَا اَنْزَلْتَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْقُرْاٰنِ وَالنُّورِ
segs.en: through the Qur'an and the Light which You sent down within it,
segs.tr: BIMAA ANZALTA FEEHI MINAL QUR'AANI WAN NOOR

segs.en: the faith which You multiplied by means of it,
the fasting which You obligated therein,
the standing in prayer which You encouraged at its time,
and the Night of Decree which You magnified therein,
segs.tr: WA AJLALTA FEEHI MIN LAYLATIL QADR

segs.ar: الَّتِي هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ اَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
segs.en: the night which is "better than a thousand months" (97:3).
segs.tr: ALLATEE HIYA KHAYRUN MIN ALFI SHAHR

segs.ar: ثُمَّ اٰثَرْتَنَا بِهٖ عَلَى سَائِرِ الْاُمَمِ
segs.en: Through it You have preferred us over the other communities
segs.tr: THUMMA AATHARTANAA BIHEE A'LAA SAA'IRIL UMAM

segs.en: and through its excellence You have chosen us to the exclusion of the people of the creeds.
We fasted by Your command in its daylight,
we stood in prayer with Your help in its night,

segs.ar: مُتَعَرِّضِينَ بِصِيَامِهٖ وَقِيَامِهٖ لِمَا عَرَّضْتَنَا لَهٗ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ
segs.en: presenting ourselves by its fasting and its standing to the mercy which You have held up before us,
segs.tr: MUTA'ARRIDEENA BISIYAAMIHEE WA QIYAAMIHEE LIMAA A'RRADTANAA LAHOO MIN RAHMATIK

segs.en: and we found through it the means to Your reward.

segs.ar: وَاَنْتَ الْمَلِيءُ بِمَا رُغِبَ فِيهِ اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: And You are full of what is sought from You,
segs.tr: WA ANTAL MALEE'U BIMAA RUGHIBA FEEHI ILAYK

segs.en: munificent with what is asked of Your bounty,
and near to him who strives for Your nearness.

segs.ar: وَقَدْ اَقَامَ فِينَا هَذَا الشَّهْرُ مُقَامَ حَمْدٍ
segs.en: This month stood among us in a standing place of praise,
segs.tr: WA QAD AQAAMA FEENAA HAADHASH SHAHRU MUQAAMA HAMD

segs.en: accompanied us with the companionship of one approved,
and profited us with the most excellent profit of the world's creatures.

segs.ar: ثُمَّ قَدْ فَارَقَنَا عِنْدَ تَمَامِ وَقْتِهٖ، وَانْقِطَاعِ مُدَّتِهٖ، وَوَفَاءِ عَدَدِهٖ
segs.en: Then it parted from us at the completion of its time, the end of its term, and the fulfilment of its number.
segs.tr: THUMMA QAD FAARAQANAA I'NDA TAMAAMI WAQTIHEE WANQITAA'I MUDDATIHEE WA WAFAA'I A'DADIH

segs.ar: فَنَحْنُ مُوَدِّعُوهُ وِدَاعَ مَنْ عَزَّ فِرَاقُهٗ عَلَيْنَا
segs.en: So we bid farewell to it with the farewell of one whose parting pains us,
segs.tr: FANAHNU MUWADDI'OOHU WIDAA'A MAN A'ZZA FIRAAQUHOO A'LAYNAA

segs.en: whose leaving fills us with gloom and loneliness,
segs.tr: WA GHAMMANAA WA AWHASHANAN SIRAAFUHOO A'NNAA

segs.en: and to whom we have come to owe a safeguarded claim,
an observed inviolability, and a discharged right.
segs.tr: WAL HURMATUL MAR'IYYATU WAL HAQQUL MAQDIYY

segs.en: We say: Peace be upon You,

segs.ar: يَا شَهْرَ اللَّهِ الْاَكْبَرَ، وَيَا عِيدَ اَوْلِيَائِهِ
segs.en: O greatest month of God! O festival of His friends!
segs.tr: YAA SHAHRALLAAHIL AKBARA WA YAA I'EEDA AWLIYAA'IH

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَكْرَمَ مَصْحُوبٍ مِنَ الْاَوْقَاتِ
segs.en: Peace be upon You, O most noble of accompanying times!
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA AKRAMA MAS-HOOBIN MINAL AWQAAT

segs.ar: وَيَا خَيْرَ شَهْرٍ فِي الْاَيَّامِ وَالسَّاعَاتِ
segs.en: O best of months in days and hours!
segs.tr: WA YAA KHAYRA SHAHRIN FIL AYYAAMI WAS SAA'AAT

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْرٍ قَرُبَتْ فِيهِ الْاٰمَالُ
segs.en: Peace be upon You, month in which expectations come near
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA MIN SHAHRIN QARUBAT FEEHIL AAMAAL

segs.en: and good works are scattered about!

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ قَرِينٍ جَلَّ قَدْرُهٗ مَوْجُوداً
segs.en: Peace be upon You, comrade who is great in worth when found
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA MIN QAREENIN JALLA QADRUHOO MAWJOODAA

segs.ar: وَاَفْجَعَ فَقْدُهٗ مَفْقُوداً، وَمَرْجُوٍّ اٰلَمَ فِرَاقُهُ
segs.en: and who torments through absence when lost, anticipated friend whose parting gives pain!
segs.tr: WA AFJA'A FAQDUHOO MAFQOODAN WA MARJUWWIN AALAMA FIRAAQUH

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ اَلِيفٍ اٰنَسَ مُقْبِلًا فَسَرَّ
segs.en: Peace be upon You, familiar who brought comfort in coming, thus making happy,
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA MIN ALEEFIN AANASA MUQBILAN FASARR

segs.en: who left loneliness in going, thus giving anguish!

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ مُجَاوِرٍ رَقَّتْ فِيهِ الْقُلُوبُ، وَقَلَّتْ فِيهِ الذُّنُوبُ
segs.en: Peace be upon You, neighbour in whom hearts became tender and sins became few!
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA MIN MUJAAWIRIN RAQQAT FEEHIL QULOOBU WA QALLAT FEEHIDH DHUNOOB

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ نَاصِرٍ اَعَانَ عَلَى الشَّيْطَانِ
segs.en: Peace be upon You, helper who aided against Satan,
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA MIN NAASIRIN A'AANA A'LASH SHAYTAAN

segs.en: companion who made easy the paths of good-doing!

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مَا اَكْثَرَ عُتَقَاءَ اللَّهِ فِيكَ
segs.en: Peace be upon You - How many became freedmen of God within You!
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA MAA AKTHARA U'TAQAA'ALLAAHI FEEK

segs.ar: وَمَا اَسْعَدَ مَنْ رَعَى حُرْمَتَكَ بِكَ
segs.en: How happy those who observed the respect due to You!
segs.tr: WA MAA AS'ADA MAN RA'AA HURMATAKA BIK

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مَا كَانَ اَمْحَاكَ لِلذُّنُوبِ
segs.en: Peace be upon You - How many the sins You erased!
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA MAA KAANA AMHAAKA LIDH DHUNOOB

segs.en: How many the kinds of faults You covered over!

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مَا كَانَ اَطْوَلَكَ عَلَى الْمُجْرِمِينَ
segs.en: Peace be upon You - How drawn out were You for the sinners!
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA MAA KAANA ATWALAKA A'LAL MUJRIMEEN

segs.en: How awesome were You in the hearts of the faithful!

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْرٍ لَا تُنَافِسُهُ الْاَيَّامُ
segs.en: Peace be upon You, month with which no days compete!
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA MIN SHAHRIN LAA TUNAAFISUHUL AYYAAM

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْرٍ هُوَ مِنْ كُلِّ اَمْرٍ سَلَامٌ
segs.en: Peace be upon You, month which is peace in all affairs!
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA MIN SHAHRIN HUWA MIN KULLI AMRIN SALAAM

segs.en: Peace be upon You, You whose companionship is not disliked,
You whose friendly mixing is not blamed!

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ كَمَا وَفَدْتَ عَلَيْنَا بِالْبَرَكَاتِ
segs.en: Peace be upon You, just as You have entered upon us with blessings
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA KAMAA WAFADTA A'LAYNAA BIL BARAKAAT

segs.en: and cleansed us of the defilement of offenses!
Peace be upon You - You are not bid farewell in annoyance
nor is Your fasting left in weariness!

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ مَطْلُوبٍ قَبْلَ وَقْتِهٖ
segs.en: Peace be upon You, object of seeking before Your time,
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA MIN MATLOOBIN QABLA WAQTIH

segs.en: object of sorrow before Your passing!

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ كَمْ مِنْ سُوءٍ صُرِفَ بِكَ عَنَّا
segs.en: Peace be upon You - How much evil was turned away from us through You!
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA KAM MIN SOO'IN SURIFA BIKA A'NNAA

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ اُفِيضَ بِكَ عَلَيْنَا
segs.en: How much good flowed upon us because of You!
segs.tr: WA KAM MIN KHAYRIN UFEEDA BIKA A'LAYNAA

segs.en: Peace be upon You and upon the Night of Decree
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA WA A'LAA LAYLATIL QADR

segs.ar: الَّتِي هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ اَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
segs.en: which is "better than a thousand months" (97:3)!
segs.tr: ALLATEE HIYA KHAYRUN MIN ALFI SHAHR

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مَا كَانَ اَحْرَصَنَا بِالْاَمْسِ عَلَيْكَ
segs.en: Peace be upon You - How much we craved You yesterday!
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA MAA KAANA AHRASANAA BIL AMSI A'LAYK

segs.en: How intensely we shall yearn for You tomorrow!

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى فَضْلِكَ الَّذِي حُرِمْنَاهُ
segs.en: Peace be upon You and upon Your bounty which has now been made unlawful to us
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMU A'LAYKA WA A'LAA FADLIKAL LADHEE HURIMNAAH

segs.en: and upon Your blessings gone by which have now been stripped away from us!
segs.tr: WA A'LAA MAADIN MIN BARAKAATIKA SULIBNAAH

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اِنَّا اَهْلُ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ الَّذِي شَرَّفْتَنَا بِهٖ
segs.en: O God, we are the people of this month. Through it You have ennobled us
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNAA AHLU HAADHASH SHAHRIL LADHEE SHARRAFTANAA BIH

segs.ar: وَوَفَّقْتَنَا بِمَنِّكَ لَهٗ حِينَ جَهِلَ الْاَشْقِيَاءُ وَقْتَهٗ
segs.en: and given us success because of Your kindness, while the wretched are ignorant of its time.
segs.tr: WA WAFFAQTANAA BIMANNIKA LAHOO HEENA JAHILAL ASHQIYAA'U WAQTAH

segs.en: Made unlawful to them is its bounty because of their wretchedness.

segs.ar: اَنْتَ وَلِيُّ مَا اٰثَرْتَنَا بِهٖ مِنْ مَعْرِفَتِهٖ
segs.en: You are the patron of the knowledge of it by which You have preferred us,
segs.tr: ANTA WALIYYU MAA AATHARTANAA BIHEE MIN MA'RIFATIH

segs.en: and its prescribed practices to which You have guided us.

segs.ar: وَقَدْ تَوَلَّيْنَا بِتَوْفِيقِكَ صِيَامَهٗ وَقِيَامَهٗ عَلَى تَقْصِيرٍ
segs.en: We have undertaken, through Your giving success, its fasting and its standing in prayer, but with shortcomings,
segs.tr: WA QAD TAWALLAYNAA BITAWFEEQIKA SIYAAMAHOO WA QIYAAMAHOO A'LAA TAQSEER

segs.en: and we have performed little of much.
segs.tr: WA ADDAYNAA FEEHI QALEELAN MIN KATHEER

segs.en: O God, so to You belongs praise, in admission of evil doing
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA FALAKAL HAMDU IQRAARAN BIL ISAA'AH

segs.ar: وَاعْتِرَافاً بِالْاِضَاعَةِ، وَلَكَ مِنْ قُلُوبِنَا عَقْدُ النَّدَمِ
segs.en: and confession of negligence, and to You belongs remorse firmly knitted in our hearts
segs.tr: WA'TIRAAFAN BIL IDAA'ATI WA LAKA MIN QULOOBINAA A'QDUN NADAM

segs.en: and seeking of pardon sincerely uttered by our tongues.

segs.ar: فَاْجُرْنَا عَلَى مَا اَصَابَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ التَّفْرِيطِ
segs.en: Reward us, in spite of the neglect that befell us in this month,
segs.tr: FA'JURNAA A'LAA MAA ASAABANAA FEEHI MINAT TAFREET

segs.ar: اَجْراً نَسْتَدْرِكُ بِهِ الْفَضْلَ الْمَرْغُوبَ فِيهِ
segs.en: with a reward through which we may reach the bounty desired from it
segs.tr: AJRAN NASTADRIKU BIHIL FADLAL MARGHOOBA FEEH

segs.ar: وَنَعْتَاضُ بِهٖ مِنْ اَنْوَاعِ الذُّخْرِ الْمَحْرُوصِ عَلَيْهِ
segs.en: and win the varieties of its craved stores!
segs.tr: WA NA'TAADU BIHEE MIN ANWAA'IDH DHUKHRIL MAHROOSI A'LAYH

segs.ar: وَاَوْجِبْ لَنَا عُذْرَكَ عَلَى مَا قَصَّرْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ حَقِّكَ
segs.en: Make incumbent upon us Your pardon for our falling short of Your right in this month
segs.tr: WA AWJIB LANAA U'DHRAKA A'LAA MAA QASSARNAA FEEHI MIN HAQQIK

segs.ar: وَابْلُغْ بِاَعْمَارِنَا مَا بَيْنَ اَيْدِينَا مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ الْمُقْبِلِ
segs.en: and make our lives which lie before us reach the coming month of Ramadan!
segs.tr: WABLUGH BI-A'MAARINAA MAA BAYNA AYDEENAA MIN SHAHRI RAMADAANAL MUQBIL

segs.en: Once You have made us reach it, help us perform
the worship of which You are worthy,

segs.ar: وَاَدِّنَا اِلَى الْقِيَامِ بِمَا يَسْتَحِقُّهٗ مِنَ الطَّاعَةِ
segs.en: cause us to undertake the obedience which You deserve,
segs.tr: WA ADDINAA ILAL QIYAAMI BIMAA YASTAHIQQUHOO MINAT TAA'AH

segs.en: and grant us righteous works
segs.tr: WA AJRI LANAA MIN SAALIHIL A'MAL

segs.ar: مَا يَكُونُ دَرَكاً لِحَقِّكَ فِي الشَّهْرَيْنِ مِنْ شُهُورِ الدَّهْرِ
segs.en: that we may fulfil Your right in these two months of the months of time.
segs.tr: MAA YAKOONU DARAKAN LIHAQQIKA FISH SHAHRAYNI MIN SHUHOORID DAHR

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَمَا اَلْمَمْنَا بِهٖ فِي شَهْرِنَا هَذَا مِنْ لَمَمٍ اَوْ اِثْمٍ
segs.en: O God, as for the small and large sins which we have committed in this our month,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WA MAA ALMAMNAA BIHEE FEE SHAHRINAA HAADHAA MIN LAMAMIN AW ITHM

segs.ar: اَوْ وَاقَعْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ ذَنْبٍ، وَاكْتَسَبْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ خَطِيئَةٍ
segs.en: the misdeeds into which we have fallen, and the offenses which we have earned
segs.tr: AW WAAQA'NAA FEEHI MIN DHANBIN WAKTASABNAA FEEHI MIN KHATEE'AH

segs.ar: عَلَى تَعَمُّدٍ مِنَّا، اَوْ عَلَى نِسْيَانٍ ظَلَمْنَا فِيهِ اَنْفُسَنَا، اَوِ انْتَهَكْنَا بِهٖ حُرْمَةً مِنْ غَيْرِنَا
segs.en: purposefully or in forgetfulness, wronging ourselves thereby or violating the respect due to others,
segs.tr: A'LAA TA'AMMUDIN MINNAA AW A'LAA NISYAANIN ZALAMNAA FEEHI ANFUSANAA AWIN TAHAKNAA BIHEE HURMATAN MIN GHAYRINAA

segs.ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِهِ، وَاسْتُرْنَا بِسِتْرِكَ
segs.en: bless Muhammad and his Household, cover us over with Your covering,
segs.tr: FASALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIHEE WASTURNAA BISITRIK

segs.en: pardon us through Your pardoning,
place us not before the eyes of the gloaters because of that,
segs.tr: WA LAA TANSIBNAA FEEHI LI-A'YUNISH SHAAMITEEN

segs.ar: وَلَا تَبْسُطْ عَلَيْنَا فِيهِ اَلْسُنَ الطَّاعِنِينَ
segs.en: stretch not toward us the tongues of the defamers,
segs.tr: WA LAA TABSUT A'LAYNAA FEEHI ALSUNAT TAA'INEEN

segs.en: and employ us in that which will alleviate and expiate
segs.tr: WASTA'MILNAA BIMAA YAKOONU HITTATAN WA KAFFAARAH

segs.ar: لِمَا اَنْكَرْتَ مِنَّا فِيهِ بِرَاْفَتِكَ الَّتِي لَا تَنْفَدُ
segs.en: whatever You disapprove from us within it through Your clemency which does not run out,
segs.tr: LIMAA ANKARTA MINNAA FEEHI BIRA'FATIKAL LATEE LAA TANFAD

segs.en: and Your bounty which does not diminish!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.en: redress our being afflicted by our month,

segs.ar: وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي يَوْمِ عِيدِنَا وَفِطْرِنَا
segs.en: bless us in this day of our festival and our fast-breaking,
segs.tr: WA BAARIK LANAA FEE YAWMI I'EEDINAA WA FITRINAA

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْهُ مِنْ خَيْرِ يَوْمٍ مَرَّ عَلَيْنَا اَجْلَبِهٖ لِعَفْوٍ، وَاَمْحَاهُ لِذَنْبٍ
segs.en: make it one of the best of days that have passed over us, the greatest in attracting Your pardon, and the most effacing toward sins,
segs.tr: WAJ'ALHU MIN KHAYRI YAWMIN MARRA A'LAYNAA AJLABIHEE LI-A'FWIN WA AMHAAHU LIDHANB

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا مَا خَفِيَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِنَا وَمَا عَلَنَ
segs.en: and forgive us our sins, both the concealed and the public!
segs.tr: WAGHFIR LANAA MAA KHAFIYA MIN DHUNOOBINAA WA MAA A'LAN

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اسْلَخْنَا بِانْسِلَاخِ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ مِنْ خَطَايَانَا
segs.en: O God, with the passing of this month make us pass forth from our offenses,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAS LAKHNAA BINSILAAKHI HAADHASH SHAHRI MIN KHATAAYAANAA

segs.en: with its departure make us depart from our evil deeds,
and appoint us thereby among its most felicitous people,

segs.ar: وَاَجْزَلِهِمْ قِسْماً فِيهِ، وَاَوْفَرِهِمْ حَظّاً مِنْهُ
segs.en: the most plentiful of them in portion, and the fullest of them in share!
segs.tr: WA AJZALIHIM QISMAN FEEHI WA AWFARIHIM HAZZAN MINH

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَمَنْ رَعَى هَذَا الشَّهْرَ حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهٖ
segs.en: O God, when any person observes this month as it should be observed,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WA MAN RA'AA HAADHASH SHAHRA HAQQA RI'AAYATIH

segs.ar: وَحَفِظَ حُرْمَتَهٗ حَقَّ حِفْظِهَا، وَقَامَ بِحُدُودِهٖ حَقَّ قِيَامِهَا
segs.en: safeguards its inviolability as it should be safeguarded, attends to its bounds as they should be attended to,
segs.tr: WA HAFIZA HURMATAHOO HAQQA HIFZIHAA WA QAAMA BIHUDOODIHEE HAQQA QIYAAMIHAA

segs.ar: وَاتَّقَى ذُنُوبَهٗ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهَا، اَوْ تَقَرَّبَ اِلَيْكَ بِقُرْبَةٍ
segs.en: fears its misdeeds as they should be feared, or seeks nearness to You with any act of nearness-seeking
segs.tr: WATTAQAA DHUNOOBAHOO HAQQA TUQAATIHAA AW TAQARRABA ILAYKA BIQURBAH

segs.ar: اَوْجَبَتْ رِضَاكَ لَهٗ، وَعَطَفَتْ رَحْمَتَكَ عَلَيْهِ
segs.en: which makes incumbent upon him Your good pleasure and bends toward him Your mercy,
segs.tr: AWJABAT RIDAAKA LAHOO WA A'TAFAT RAHMATAKA A'LAYH

segs.en: give to us the like [of that] from Your wealth
and bestow it upon us in multiples through Your bounty,

segs.ar: فَاِنَّ فَضْلَكَ لَا يَغِيضُ، وَاِنَّ خَزَائِنَكَ لَا تَنْقُصُ بَلْ تَفِيضُ
segs.en: for Your bounty does not diminish, Your treasuries do not decrease but overflow,
segs.tr: FA-INNA FADLAKA LAA YAGHEEDU WA INNA KHAZAA'INAKA LAA TANQUSU BAL TAFEED

segs.en: the mines of Your beneficence are not exhausted,
segs.tr: WA INNA MA'AADINA IHSAANIKA LAA TAFNAA

segs.en: and Your bestowal is the bestowal full of delight!
segs.tr: WA INNA A'TAA'AKA LAL A'TAA'UL MUHANNAA

segs.en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.ar: وَاكْتُبْ لَنَا مِثْلَ اُجُورِ مَنْ صَامَهٗ
segs.en: and write for us the like of the wages of him who fasted in it
segs.tr: WAKTUB LANAA MITHLA UJOORI MAN SAAMAH

segs.ar: اَوْ تَعَبَّدَ لَكَ فِيهِ اِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
segs.en: or worshipped You within it until the Day of Resurrection!
segs.tr: AW TA'ABBADA LAKA FEEHI ILAA YAWMIL QIYAAMAH

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اِنَّا نَتُوبُ اِلَيْكَ فِي يَوْمِ فِطْرِنَا
segs.en: O God, we repent to You in our day of fast-breaking,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNAA NATOOBU ILAYKA FEE YAWMI FITRINAA

segs.en: which You have appointed for the faithful a festival and a joy
segs.tr: ALLADHEE JA'ALTAHOO LIL MU'MINEENA I'EEDAN WA SUROORAA

segs.ar: وَلِاَهْلِ مِلَّتِكَ مَجْمَعاً وَمُحْتَشَداً مِنْ كُلِّ ذَنْبٍ اَذْنَبْنَاهُ
segs.en: and for the people of Your creed a time of assembly and gathering, from every misdeed we did,
segs.tr: WA LI-AHLI MILLATIKA MAJMA'AN WA MUHTASHADAN MIN KULLI DHANBIN ADHNABNAAH

segs.ar: اَوْ سُوءٍ اَسْلَفْنَاهُ، اَوْ خَاطِرِ شَرٍّ اَضْمَرْنَاهُ
segs.en: ill work we sent ahead, or evil thought we secretly conceived,
segs.tr: AW SOO'IN ASLAFNAAHU AW KHAATIRI SHARRIN ADMARNAAH

segs.ar: تَوْبَةَ مَنْ لَا يَنْطَوِي عَلَى رُجُوعٍ اِلَى ذَنْبٍ
segs.en: the repentance of one who does not harbour a return to sin
segs.tr: TAWBATA MAN LAA YANTAWEE A'LAA RUJOO'IN ILAA DHANB

segs.en: and who afterwards will not go back to offense,
segs.tr: WA LAA YA'OODU BA'DAHAA FEE KHATEE'AH

segs.ar: تَوْبَةً نَصُوحاً خَلَصَتْ مِنَ الشَّكِّ وَالِارْتِيَابِ
segs.en: an unswerving repentance rid of doubt and wavering.
segs.tr: TAWBATAN NASOOHAN KHALASAT MINASH SHAKKI WAL IRTIYAAB

segs.ar: فَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنَّا، وَارْضَ عَنَّا، وَثَبِّتْنَا عَلَيْهَا
segs.en: So accept it from us, be pleased with us, and fix us within it!
segs.tr: FATAQABBALHAA MINNAA WARDA A'NNAA WA THABBITNAA A'LAYHAA

segs.en: God, provide us with fear of the threatened punishment

segs.ar: وَشَوْقَ ثَوَابِ الْمَوْعُودِ حَتَّى نَجِدَ لَذَّةَ مَا نَدْعُوكَ بِهٖ
segs.en: and yearning for the promised reward, so that we may find the pleasure of that for which we supplicate You
segs.tr: WA SHAWQA THAWAABIL MAW'OODI HATTAA NAJIDA LADHDHATA MAA NAD'OOKA BIH

segs.en: and the sorrow of that from which we seek sanctuary in You!

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا عِنْدَكَ مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ الَّذِينَ اَوْجَبْتَ لَهُمْ مَحَبَّتَكَ
segs.en: And place us with You among the repenters, those upon whom You have made Your love obligatory
segs.tr: WAJ'ALNAA I'NDAKA MINAT TAWWAABEENAL LADHEENA AWJABTA LAHUM MAHABBATAK

segs.ar: وَقَبِلْتَ مِنْهُمْ مُرَاجَعَةَ طَاعَتِكَ، يَا اَعْدَلَ الْعَادِلِينَ
segs.en: and from whom You have accepted the return to obeying You! O Most Just of the just!
segs.tr: WA QABILTA MINHUM MURAAJA'ATA TAA'ATIKA YAA A'DALAL A'ADILEEN

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ تَجَاوَزْ عَنْ اٰبَائِنَا وَاُمَّهَاتِنَا وَاَهْلِ دِينِنَا جَمِيعاً
segs.en: O God, show forbearance toward our fathers and our mothers and all the people of our religion,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA TAJAAWAZ A'N AABAA'INAA WA UMMAHAATINAA WA AHLI DEENINAA JAMEE'AA

segs.ar: مَنْ سَلَفَ مِنْهُمْ وَمَنْ غَبَرَ اِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
segs.en: those who have gone and those who will pass by, until the Day of Resurrection!
segs.tr: MAN SALAFA MINHUM WA MAN GHABARA ILAA YAWMIL QIYAAMAH

segs.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّنَا وَاٰلِهِ
segs.en: O God, bless our prophet Muhammad and his Household,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN NABIYYINAA WA AALIH

segs.en: as You have blessed Your angels brought nigh,
bless him and his Household,
as You have blessed Your prophets sent out,

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
segs.en: bless him and his Household, as You have blessed Your righteous servants
segs.tr: WA SALLI A'LAYHI WA AALIHEE KAMAA SALLAYTA A'LAA I'BAADIKAS SAALIHEEN

segs.ar: وَاَفْضَلَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
segs.en: and better than that, O Lord of the worlds!
segs.tr: WA AFDALA MIN DHAALIKA YAA RABBAL A'ALAMEEN

segs.en: a blessing whose benediction will reach us, whose benefit will attain to us,
segs.tr: SALAATAN TABLUGHUNAA BARAKATUHAA WA YANAALUNAA NAF'UHAA

segs.en: and through which our supplication may be granted!
You are the most generous of those who are beseeched,
the most sufficient of those in whom confidence is had,
the most bestowing of those from whom bounty is asked,
segs.tr: WA A'TAA MAN SU'ILA MIN FADLIH

segs.en: You are powerful over everything!
segs.tr: WA ANTA A'LAA KULLI SHAY'IN QADEER

A_AA49.merits: The forty-fifth supplication of al-Sahifah al-Kamilah al-Sajjadiyyah, Imam Zayn al-Abidin (a.s.)'s farewell to the month of Ramadan. It is recited on the last night of Ramazan, and is perhaps the best of that night's farewell duas.

A_Zall.name: Daily Duas for the 30 Days of Ramadan

segs.note: Short Duas for the Days of Ramazan

It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Abbas that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) referred to the great merits and rewards of observing fast on each day of Ramadan. He also mentioned supplicatory prayers that are dedicated to each of these days with the merits and rewards of saying them. Let us hereby mention these supplicatory prayers only:
segs.ur: ابن عباس سے روایت ہے کہ نبی اکرم (ص) نے ماہ رمضان کے ہر دن روزہ رکھنے کی عظیم فضیلتوں اور ثواب کا ذکر فرمایا۔ آپ نے ان میں سے ہر دن کے لیے مخصوص دعاؤں کا بھی ان کے پڑھنے کی فضیلتوں اور ثواب کے ساتھ ذکر فرمایا۔ ہم یہاں صرف یہ دعائیں ذکر کرتے ہیں:

segs.note: 1st Day

segs.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ صِیَامِیْ فِیْهِ صِیَامَ الصَّآئِمِیْنَ
segs.en: O Allah! During this month accept my fast as the fast of (accepted) Fast-keepers.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAJ A’L SEYAAMEE FEEHE SEYAAMAS SAA-EMEENA

segs.en: Accept my standing in Namaz as the standing of the persons whose standing in Namaz is acceptable to Allah,
Keep me awake during this month and free from the dreams of the insensible negligent persons.
segs.tr: WA NABBEHNEE FEEHE A’N NAWMATIL GHAAFELEENA

segs.ar: وَهَبْ لِیْ جُرْمِیْ فِیْهِ یَا اِلٰهَ الْعَالَمِیْنَ
segs.en: In this holy month forgive my sins and errors, O the One worshipped in all the universe.
segs.tr: WA HAB LEE JURMEE FEEHE YAA ELAAHAL A’ALAMEENA

segs.ar: وَاعْفُ عَنِّیْ یَا عَافِیًا عَنِ الْمُجْرِمِیْنَ.
segs.en: Pardon me O One Who pardons the sinners.
segs.tr: WA’ FO A’NNEE YAA A’AFEYAN A’NIL MUJREMEENA.

segs.note: 2nd Day

segs.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
O Allah! On this day, take me closer towards Your pleasure,
keep me away from Your anger and punishment,
segs.tr: WA JANNIBNEE FEEHE MIN SAKAHTEKA WA NAQEMAATEKA

segs.en: grant me the opportunity to recite Your verses (of the Qur’an),
by Your mercy, O the most Merciful.

segs.note: 3rd Day

segs.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِیْ فِيْهِ الذِّهْنَ وَالتَّنْبِیْهَ وَبَاعِدْ نِیْ فِیْهِ مِنَ السَّفَاهَۃِ وَالتَّمْوِیْهِ وَاجْعَلْ لِیْ نَصِیْبًا مِنْ كُلِّ خَیْرٍ تُنْزِلُ فِیْهِ بِجُوْدِكَ یَا اَجْوَدَ الْاَجْوَدِیْنَ.
segs.en: O Allah! In this holy month, make me wise and alert on my sins. Keep me away, in this month from ignorance and ostentations. Award me a share from all the blessings that You may bestow in this month. I refer You to Your Kindness and Benevolence. O the most Benevolent of all benevolent!
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAR ZUQNEE FEEHIZ ZEHNA WAT TAMBEEHA WA BAA-I’DNE FEEHE MENAS SAFAAHATE WAT-TAMWEEHE WAJ-A’L LEE NASEEBAN MIN KULLE KHAYRIN TUNZELO FEEHE BE-JOODEKA YAA AJWADAL AJWADEENA.

segs.note: 4th Day

segs.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ قَوِّنِیْ فِیْهِ عَلٰی اِقَامَۃِ اَمْرِكَ وَاَذِقْنِیْ فِیْهِ حَلاَوَۃَ ذِكْرِكَ وَاَوْزِعْنِیْ فِیْهِ لِاَدَآءِ شُكْرِكَ بِكَرَمِكَ وَاحْفَظْنِیْ فِيْهِ بِحِفْطِكَ وَسِتْرِكَ یَااَبْصَرَ النَّاظِرِیْنَ.
segs.en: O Allah! In this holy month give me the strength to carry out Your orders. Let me taste, in this month the sweetness of Your remembrance. Encourage me, through Your kindness, to pay thanks to You. Protect me under Your protection and overlooking, in this month, O One! Who is the best Looker (Guard) of all the lookers after (guards)!
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA QAWWENEE FEEHE A’LAA EQAAMATE AMREKA WA AZIQNEE FEEHE HALAAWATA ZIKREKA WA AW-ZE’NEE FEEHE LE-ADAA-E SHUKREKA BEKARAMEKA WAH-FAZNEE FEEHE BE-HIFZEKA WA SITREKA YAA ABSARAN NAAZEREENA.

segs.note: 5th Day

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِىْ فِيْهِ مِنَ الْمُسْتَغْفِرِيْنَ، وَاجْعَلْنِىْ فِيْهِ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِيْنَ الْقَانِتِيْنَ، وَاجْعَلْنِىْ فِيْهِ مِنْ اَوْلِيَآئِكَ الْمُقَرَّبِيْنَ، بِرَاْفَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ.
segs.en: O Allah, on this day, (please) include me with the seekers of Your forgiveness, include me on it with Your righteous, submissive servants, and include me on it with Your favorite, intimate servants, in the name of Your kindness, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAJ A'LNEE FEEHE MENAL MUSTAGHFEREENA WAJ-A'LNEE FEEHE MIN E'BAADEKAS SAALEHEENAL QAANETEENA WAJ-A'LNEE FEEHE MIN AWLEYAA-EKAL MOQARRABEENA BE-RAA-FATEKA YAA ARHAMAR RAAHEMEENA.

segs.note: 6th Day

segs.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لاَ تَخْذُلْنِیْ فِیْهِ لِتَعَرُّضِ مَعْصِیَتِكَ وَلاَ تَضْرِبْنِیْ بِسِیَاطِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَزَحْزِحْنِیْ فِیْهِ مِنْ مُوْجِبَاتِ سَخَطِكَ بِمَنِّكَ وَاٰیَادِیْكَ یَامُنْتَهٰی رَغَبَۃِ الرَّاغِبِیْنَ.
segs.en: O Allah! Do not leave me free in this month to face the sins. Do not lash me with the lash of Your punishment. Keep me away in this month from such deeds that may influence Your anger, necessarily. I appeal to Your kindness and Blessings, O the last limit for the craving (creatures)!
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA LAA TAKHZULNEE FEEHE LE-TA-A’RROZE MA’SEYATEKA WA LAA TAZRIBNEE BE-SEYAATE NAQEMATEKA WA ZAHZEHNEE FEEHE MIN MOOJEBAATE SAKHATEKA BEMANNEKA WA AYAADEEKA YAA MUNTAHAA RAGHBATIR RAAGHEBEENA.

segs.note: 7th Day

segs.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَعِنِّیْ فِیْهِ عَلٰی صِیَامِهٖ وَقِیَامِهٖ
segs.en: O Allah, help me therein (in this month) to fast and to stand (in prayer).
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA A-I’NNEE FEEHE A’LAA SEYAAMEHI WA QEYAAMEHI

segs.en: And keep me away therein from its slips and its sins,
segs.tr: WA JANNIBNEE FEEHE MIN HAFAWAATEHI WA AASAAMEHI

segs.en: And grant me therein Your constant remembrance,
By Your grace, O Guide of those who go astray.

segs.note: 8th Day

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِىْ فِيْهِ رَحْمَةَ الْاَيْتَامِ، وَاِطْعَامَ الطَّعَامِ، وَاِفْشَاۤءَ السَّلَامِ، وَصُحْبَةَ الْكِرَامِ، بِطَوْلِكَ يَا مَلْجَاَ الْاٰمِلِيْنَ.
segs.en: O Allah, on this day, (please) grant me having mercy upon the orphans, serving food, greeting the people, and accompanying the noble ones, in the name of Your favoring, O Shelter of the hopeful ones!
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAR ZUQNEE FEEHE RAHMATAL AYTAAME WA IT-A'AMAT TA-A'AME WA IFSHAA-AS SALAAME WA SOHBATAL KERAAME BE-TAWLEKA YAA MAL-JA-AL AAMELEENA.

segs.note: 9th Day

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِىْ فِيْهِ نَصِيْبًا مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ الْوَاسِعَةِ، وَاهْدِنِىْ فِيْهِ لِبَرَاهِيْنِكَ السَّاطِعَةِ، وَخُذْ بِنَاصِيَتِىْ اِلٰى مَرْضَاتِكَ الْجَامِعَةِ، بِمَحَبَّتِكَ يَا اَمَلَ الْمُشْتَاقِيْنَ.
segs.en: O Allah, on this day, (please) decide for me a share from Your expansive mercy, guide me on this day to Your luminous proofs, and take me from the forelock to Your all-inclusive satisfaction, in the name of Your lovingness, O hope of the eager ones!
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAJ A'L LEE FEEHE NASEEBAN MIN RAHMATEKAL WAASE-A'TE WAHDENEE FEEHE LE-BARAAHEENEKAS SAA-TE-A'TE WA KHUZ BE-NAASEYATEE ELAA MARZAATEKAL JAA-ME-A'TE BE-MAHABBATEKA YAA AMALAL MUSHTAAQEENA.

segs.note: 10th Day

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِىْ فِيْهِ مِنَ الْمُتَوَكِّلِيْنَ عَلَيْكَ، وَاجْعَلْنِىْ فِيْهِ مِنَ الْفَآئِزِيْنَ لَدَيْكَ، وَاجْعَلْنِىْ فِيْهِ مِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِيْنَ اِلَيْكَ، بِاِحْسَانِكَ يَا غَايَةَ الطَّالِبِيْنَ.
