segs.tr: QABLOWA HUM KAAREHOONA YA AYYOHAL LAZEENA

segs.ar: اٰمَنُوْا مَنْ یَّرْتَدَّ مِنْكُمْ عَنْ دِیْنِهٖ
segs.en: believe! Whomsoever of you who turns away from his religion,
(he will not harm Allah in any way) for then surely Allah will bring forth a group whom He will love
segs.tr: FASAWFA YA YAATILLAAHO BE QAWMIN YOHIBBOHUM

segs.en: and they will love Him. They will be humble before the believers and very severe
segs.tr: WA YOHIBBOONAHU AZILLATIN A’LAL MOMINEENA A-I’ZZATIN

segs.en: upon the disbelievers. They will fight in the way of
Allah and will not fear the slandering of any slanderer (in the way of Allah).

segs.ar: ذٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اللهِ یُؤْتِیْهِ مَنْ یَشَّآءُ
segs.en: That is the Grace of Allah, He grants it to whomsoever

segs.ar: وَاللهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِیْمٌ اِنَّمَا وَلِیُّكُمُ اللهُ
segs.en: He wishes. And Allah is Abundant, All Knowing. Surely, your Guardian is Allah
and His Apostle and those who
establish prayer and offer poor-due
while they are bowing and whomsoever takes Allah
segs.tr: WA HUM RAAKEO’ONA WA MAN YATAWWALALLAAHA

segs.en: and His Apostle and those who believe as guardian, then surely the group of
segs.tr: WA RASOOLAHU WAL LAZEENA AAAMANU FA-INNA HIZBAL

segs.ar: اللهِ هُمُ الْغَالِبُوْنَ رَبَّنَا اٰمَنَّا بِمَا
segs.en: Allah will be successful. O Allah! We believe in what
segs.tr: LAAHE HOMUL GHAALEBOONA RABBANAA AAMANNA BEMAA

segs.en: You have revealed and we followed the Prophet, then include us among

segs.ar: الشَّاهِدِیْنَ رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوْبَنَا بَعْدَ
segs.en: the witnesses. O Our Lord, do not deviate our hearts after You
segs.tr: SHAAHEDEENA RABBANAA LAA TOZIGH QOLOOBANA BA’DA

segs.ar: اِذْ هَدَیْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ
segs.en: have guided us and grant us
segs.tr: IZ HADAYTANAA WAHAB LANAA MIN LADUNKA

segs.en: Mercy from Your side, Surely You are the Abundant Giver.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّا نَعْلَمُ اَنَّ هٰذَا هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ
segs.en: O Allah, we know that this is the truth from
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNAA NA’LAMO ANNA HAAZAA HWAL HAQQO MIN

segs.en: Your side then curse those who oppose it and exhibit haughtiness concerning it
and reject it and disbelieve in it and soon
segs.tr: WA KAZZABA BEHI WA KAFARA WA SAYA’LAMUL LAZEENA

segs.en: the oppressors shall know where they will be transferred to.
Peace be on you, O the leader of the faithful
and the chief of the vicegerent and the first of the worshippers
segs.tr: WA SAYYEDAL WASEEYYEENA WA AWWALAL A’ABEDEENA

segs.en: and the most abstinent one and the Mercy of Allah
and His Blessings and His Salutations and His Greetings. You
segs.tr: WA BARAKAATOHU WA SALAWAATOHU WA TAHIYYAATOHU ANTA

segs.en: fed the disolates, the orphans

segs.ar: وَیَتِیْمًا وَاَسِیْرًا لِوَجْهِ اللهِ لَا تُرِیْدُ
segs.en: and the captive in  the love of Allah, seeking His pleasure, you did
segs.tr: WA YATEEMAN WA ASEERAN LEWAJHILLAAHE LAA TOREEDO

segs.en: not desire from them any recompense or thanks and concerning you
segs.tr: MINHUM JAZAAA-AN WALAA SHOKOORAN WA FEEKA

segs.en: Allah, the Exalted has revealed, ‘And they give preference
to others over themselves even though their resources scarce.’
segs.tr: ANFOSEHIM WA LAW KAANA BEHIM KHASAASATUN

segs.ar: وَمَنْ یُّوْقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهٖ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ
segs.en: And one who guards against the stinginess of his self, then these are
segs.tr: WA MAN YOOQA SHO-HA NAFSEHI FA AOOLAAA-EKA HOMUL

segs.en: the successful ones and you were having control over anger
and you were forgiving the people and Allah loves
segs.tr: WAL A’AFEE ANIN-NAASE WAL LAAHO YOHIBBUL

segs.en: those who do good (to others) and you were patient
in difficulties and troubles and misfortunes.
segs.tr: BAA-SAAA-E WAZ ZARRAAA-E WA HEENA L BAASE

segs.en: And you were equitable in distribution and just
segs.tr: WA ANTAL QAASEMO BIS SAWIYYATE WAL A’ADELO

segs.ar: فِیْ الرَّعِیَّۃِ وَالْعَالِمُ بِحُدُوْدِ اللهِ مِنْ
segs.en: among the subjects and the most knowledgeable the limits imposed by Allah of
segs.tr: FIR RA-E’YYATE WAL A’ALEMO BE HODOODILLAAHE MIN

segs.ar: جَمِیْعِ الْبَرِیَّۃِ وَاللهُ تَعَالٰی اَخْبَرَ عَمَّا
segs.en: all the people and Allah has informed one and all concerning the
segs.tr: JAMEE-I’L BARIYYATE WALLAAHO TA-A’ALAA AKHBARA A’MMAA

segs.ar: اَوْلَاكَ مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ بِقَوْلِهٖ اَفَمَنْ كَانَ
segs.en: superiority He has granted you through His saying. Is the one who
segs.tr: AWLAAKA MIN FAZLEHI BE QAWLEHI AFAMAN KAANA

segs.ar: مُؤْمِنًا كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقًا لَا یَسْتَوٗنَ
segs.en: is a believer akin to the one who is a transgressor. They are not equal.
segs.tr: MOMENAN KAMAN KAANA FAASEQAN LAA YASTA-OONA

segs.en: As for those who believe and do good,
then for them are the abodes of Paradise,
a recompense for what they have done and have been
segs.tr: NOZOLAN BEMA KAANO YA’LAMOONA WA ANTAL

segs.en: specialised for knowledge of revelation and the wisdom
segs.tr: MAKHSOOSO BE I’LMIT TANZEELE WA HUKMIT

segs.en: of interpretation and the explicit mention by the Apostle and for you
segs.tr: TAAWEELE WA NASSIR RASOOLE WA LAKAL

segs.en: are distinguished stations and renowned positions and
the celebrated days, the day
of Badr and the day of Ahzaab when the
segs.tr: BADRIN WA YAWMAL AHZAABE IZ ZAAGHATIL

segs.en: eyes had severed and the hearts rose
upto the throats and you started having opinions about Allah, there was the examination
segs.tr: WA TAZUNNOONA BILLAAHIZ ZONOONAA HONAALEKAB TOLEYAL

segs.en: of the believers and they were shaken with a vigorous shaking
when the hypocrites and those in
segs.tr: WA IZ YAQOOLUL MONAAFEQOONA WAL LAZEENA FEE

segs.en: whose hearts was sickness said: Allah and His Apostle have not promised us

segs.ar: وَرَسُوْلُہٗ اِلَّا غُرُوْرًا وَاِذْ قَالَتْ طَآئِفَۃٌ
segs.en: anything except deception. When a group from among them said,
segs.tr: WA RASOOLOHU ILLAA GHOROORAN WA IZ QAALAT TAA-EFATUN

segs.ar: مِنْهُمْ یَآ اَهْلَ یَثْرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ
segs.en: ‘O the people of Medina! There  is no play of stay for you here,
segs.tr: MINHUM YAA AHLA YASREBA LAA MOKAAMA LAKUM

segs.en: then return back, while a group of them

segs.ar: النَّبِیَّ یَقُوْلُوْنَ اِنَّ بُیُوْتَنَا عَوْرَۃٌ وَمَا
segs.en: were saying: Surely our houses are empty even though they were not,
segs.tr: NABEEYYA YAQOOLOONA INNA BOYOOTANAA A’WRATUN WAMAA

segs.ar: هِیَ بِعَوْرَۃٍ اِنْ یُّرِیْدُوْنَ اِلَّا فِرَارًا
segs.en: they only desired to run away.
segs.tr: HEYA BE A’WRATIN IN YOREEDOONA ILLAA FERAARAN

segs.ar: وَقَالَ اللهُ تَعَالٰی وَلَمَّارَ اَی الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ
segs.en: And Allah, the High, said, ‘And when the believers
segs.tr: WA QAALALLAAHO TA-A’ALAA WALAMMAA RA-AL MOMENOONAL

segs.ar: الْاَحْزَابَ قَالُوْا هٰذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا اللهُ
segs.en: saw the allies, they said. That is what Allah
segs.tr: AHZAABA QAALOO HAAZAA MAA WA A’DANALLAAHO

segs.en: and His Apostle had promised us and Allah and His Apostle
segs.tr: WA RASOOLOHU WA SADAQALLAAHO WA MAA

segs.en: have spoken the truth and their faith and submission
segs.tr: ZAADAHUM ILLA EEMANAN WA TASLEEMAN FAQATALAT

segs.en: was augmented on account of it, then you killed Amr and defeated their armies and Allah
segs.tr: A’MRAHUM WA HAZAMTA JAM-A’HUM WA RADDAL LAAHUL

segs.en: made the disbelievers return in anger, they did not reach to any
segs.tr: LAZEENA KAFAROO BE GHAIZEHIM LAM YANAALOO

segs.en: goodness and Allah is Sufficient for the believers

segs.ar: وَكَانَ اللهُ قَوِیًّا عَزِیْزًا وَیَوْمَ اُحُدٍ اِذْ
segs.en: in fighting and Allah is Powerful, Honoured and on the Day of Ohad when
segs.tr: WA KAANALLAAHO QAWIYYAN AZEEZAN WA YAWMA OHADIN IZ

segs.en: the people climbed atop the mountains and did not turn back to look at anyone
even though the Apostle was calling them from behind and you were repelling the
scavengers from the polytheists away
segs.tr: WA ANTA TAZOODO BOHAMAL MUSHREKEENA A’NIN

segs.en: from the Prophet from the right and from the left
segs.tr: NABBIYYE ZAATAL YAMEENE WA ZAATAS SHEMAALE

segs.en: till the time Allah repelled them from you both
while they were in the state of fear and through you, He helped the forsaken ones and on the Day
segs.tr: KHAAA-EFEENA WA NASARA BEKAL KHAAZELEENA WA YAWMA

segs.ar: حُنَیْنٍ عَلٰی مَا نَطَقَ بِهِ التَّنْزِیْلُ اِذْ
segs.en: of Hunain as Quran says, ‘When the abundance of
segs.tr: HONAYNIN A’LAA MAA NATAQA BEHIT TANZEELO IZ

segs.en: your number amazed you but it did not benefit you
at all and the earth became straitened for you in spite of
segs.tr: SHAYAN WAZAA QAT ALAYKUMUL ARZO BEMAA

segs.ar: رَحُبَتْ ثُمَّ وَلَّیْتُمْ مُدْبِرِیْنَ ثُمَّ اَنْزَلَ
segs.en: its vastness, then you turned back, then
segs.tr: RAHOBAT SUMMA WALLAYTUM MUDBEREENA SUMMA ANZALAL

segs.en: Allah sent down tranquility upon His Apostle and the
segs.tr: LAAHO SAKEENATAHU A’LAA RASOOLEHI WA A’LAL

segs.en: believing men and the term believers refers to you and
those who were with you and your uncle Abbas kept
on calling out of the fleeing Muslims. O the people of

segs.ar: الْبَقَرَۃِ یَا اَهْلِ بَیْعَۃِ الشَّجَرَۃِ حَتّٰی
segs.en: the chapter of the cow, O those who had pledged allegiance under the tree till
segs.tr: BAQARATE YAA AHLE BAYTISH SHAJARATE HATTAS

segs.ar: اسْتَجَابَ لَہٗ قَوْمٌ قَدْ كَفَیْتَهُمُ الْمَؤُنَۃَ
segs.en: a group of them responded. Then you arranged for their provisions
segs.tr: TAJAABA LAHU QAWMUN QAD KAFAYTOHOMUL MA-OONATA

segs.en: and became their protector for their daily necessities.

segs.ar: اٰیِسِیْنَ مِنَ الْمَثُوْبَۃِ رَاجِیْنَ وَعْدَ اللهِ
segs.en: Then these people returned, despair of recompense, expectant of the promise of Allah,

segs.ar: تَعَالٰی بِالتَّوْبَۃِ وَذٰلِكَ قَوْلُ اللهِ جَلَّ
segs.en: the High, through repentance. And that is the saying of Allah, Honoured
segs.tr: TA-A’ALAA BITTAWBATE WA ZAALEKA QAWLULLAAHE JALLA

segs.ar: ذِكْرُہٗ ثُمَّ یَتُوْبُ اللهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ
segs.en: be His Remembrance. Then Allah turned (with Mercy)
segs.tr: ZIKRAHU SUMMA YATOOBULLAAHO MIN BA’DE ZAALEKA

segs.ar: عَلٰی مَنْ یَشَآءُ وَاَنْتَ حَآئِزٌ دَرَجَۃَ
segs.en: after that to whomsoever He wished and you were  firmly on the grades
segs.tr: A’LAA MAN YASHAAA-O WA ANTA HAA-EZUN DARAJATAS

segs.en: of patience and successful with a great recompense and on the Day

segs.ar: خَیْبَرَ اِذْ اَظْهَرَ اللهُ خَوَرَ الْمُنَافِقِیْنَ
segs.en: of Khaibar, when Allah exposed the slackness of the hypocrites
and cut off the roots of the disbelievers
and all praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Universe

segs.ar: وَلَقَدْ كَانُوْا عَاهَدُوْا اللهَ مِنْ قَبْلُ
segs.en: and surely they had made a covenant from Allah from before
segs.tr: WA LAQAD KAANOO A’AHADULLAAHA MIN QABLO

segs.ar: لَا یُوَلُّوْنَ الْاَدْبَارَ وَكَانَ عَهْدُ اللهِ
segs.en: that they will not turn their backs and surely the covenant of Allah
segs.tr: LAA YOWALLOONAL ADBAARA WA KAANA A’HADULLAHE

segs.en: will be questioned. O my master, you are the far-reaching
argument and the evident aim and the perfect bounty
and the evident proof. Then congratulations be to you,
segs.tr: SAABEGHATO WAL BURHAANUL  MONEERO FA-HANEE-AN LAKA

segs.ar: بِمَا اٰتٰیكَ اللهُ مِنْ فَضْلٍ وَتَبًّا
segs.en: due to what Allah has granted you from the grace, and may it be away from your enemy,
segs.tr: BEMA AATAAKALLAAHO MIN FAZLIN WA TABBAN

segs.en: the ignorant, You participated in all the

segs.ar: النَّبِیِّ صَلَّی اللهُ عَلَیْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ جَمِیْعَ
segs.en: battles alongwith the Holy Prophet, blessings of Allah be on him and his progeny
segs.tr: NABIYYE SALLALLAAHO ALAYHE WA AALEHI JAMEE-A’N

segs.en: you carried the flags while leading him and were fighting with the sword
in front of him. Then
segs.tr: AMAAMAHU WA TAZREBO BIS SAYFE QUDDAAMAHU SUMMA

segs.en: due to Your famed prudence and your foresight
in the affairs, he made you
segs.tr: OMOORE AMMARAKA FIL MAWAATENE WA LAM

segs.ar: یَكُنْ عَلَیْكَ اَمِیْرٌ وَكَمْ مِنْ اَمْرٍ
segs.en: the commander in various places and there was no commander over you and there were so many affairs
segs.tr: YAKUN A’LAYKA AMEERUN WAKAM MIN AMRIN

segs.ar: صَدَّكَ عَنْ اِمْضَآءِ عَزْمِكَ فِیْهِ التُّقٰی
segs.en: in which piety kept desisted you from its
segs.tr: SADDAKA A’N IMZAAA-E A’ZMEKA FEEHIT TOQAA

segs.ar: وَاتَّبَعَ غَیْرُكَ فِیْ مِثْلِهِ الْهَوٰی فَظَنَّ
segs.en: performance while others have followed their desires in committing.
segs.tr: WAT-TABA-A’ GHAYROKA FEE MISLEHIL HAWAA FAZANNAL

segs.en: Then the ignorant used to opine that you were helpless

segs.ar: انْتَهٰی ضَلَّ وَاللهِ الظَّآنُّ لِذٰلِكَ وَمَا
segs.en: in their performance. It is not like that rather, by Allah, the one who thinks so is
segs.tr: TAHAA ZALLA WALLAAHIZ ZAAANNO LEZAALEKA WA MAH

segs.en: indeed deviated in his opinion and he is not guided and certainly by your words,
segs.tr: TADAA WA LAQAD AWZAHTA MAAA ASHKALA

segs.en: you had removed the skepticism of the presumers

segs.ar: بِقَوْلِكَ صَلَّی اللهُ عَلَیْكَ قَدْ یَرَی
segs.en: and the falsehood of the slanderers. Blessings of Allah be upon you, ‘Certainly the variable
segs.tr: BE QAWLEKA SALLALLAAHO A’LAYKA QAD YARAL

segs.en: and adaptable ones see the rise which
segs.tr: HUWWALUL QULLABO WAJHAL HEELATEH WA DOONAHAA

segs.ar: حَاجِزٌ مِنْ تَقْوَی اللهِ فَیَدْعُهَا رَاْیَ
segs.en: only fear of Allah can impede. Then they forsake it
intentionally and those who have no soft-corner or
segs.tr: A’YNE WA YANTAHEZO FURSATAHAA MAN LAA

segs.en: concern for religion, they seize this opportunity.’ Surely you have spoken the truth
and the deniers are in loss. And when the
segs.tr: WA KHASERAL MUBTELOONA WA IZ MAAKARAKAN

segs.en: covenant breakers plotted against you and said that we have come to perform the ‘umrah’, you told them.
I swear by your life, you do not intend to perform umrah,
segs.tr: LAHOMAA LA-A’MRO KOMAA MAA TOREEDAANIL U’MRATA

segs.en: rather your intention is that of deceit. Then you took the pledge of allegiance
from both of them and renewed the covenant with them, they strove and struggled
in acts of hypocrisy. Then when you appraised them of their actions,
they were negligent and returned and did not pay
segs.tr: AGHFALAA WA-A’ADAA WA MAN TAFA-A’A WA KAANA

segs.en: any heed and the end-result of their affair was ‘loss’.
Then the people of Damascus followed them and you took after

segs.ar: الْاِعْذَارِ وَهُمْ لَا یَدِیْنُوْنَ دِیْنَ الْحَقِّ
segs.en: completing the argument, rose up to defend against them while they did not believe in the true religion
segs.tr: EA’ZAARE WAHUM LAA YADEENOONA DEENAL HAQQE

segs.en: and did not ponder on the Holy Quran. They were debased, foolish and
segs.tr: WA LAA YATADABBAROONAL QUR-AANA HAMAJUN RA-A’A-U’N

segs.en: deviated and did not believe in all that
segs.tr: ZAAALLOONA WA BILLAZEE UNZELA A’LAA MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: was revealed on Mohammad concerning you.

segs.ar: عَلَیْكَ نَاصِرُوْنَ وَقَدْ اَمَرَ اللهُ تَعَالٰی
segs.en: They assisted your enemies while Allah, the High,
segs.tr: A’LAYKA NAASEROONA WA QAD AMARALLAAHO TA-A’ALAA

segs.en: had ordered them to follow you and had called them to

segs.ar: نَصْرِكَ وَقَالَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ یَآ اَیُّهَا الَّذِیْنَ
segs.en: assist you and He, the Honoured, the Majestic, said: O those who believe!
segs.tr: NASREKA WAQAALAA A’ZZA WAJALLA YAA AYYOHAL LAZEENA

segs.en: Fear Allah and be with the
truthful ones.’ O my master! Through you the truth
has been manifested when the creatures had forsaken it and you have made evident
segs.tr: WA QAD NABAZHUL KHALQO WA AWZAHTAS

segs.en: the ‘tradition’ after it had been eradicated and effaced.
Then you initially fought in the way of establishing the truth
of the revelation of Holy Quran and later on you fought to establish the actualization
segs.tr: TANZEELE WA LAKA FAZEELATAHUL JEHAADE A’LAA

segs.en: of the interpretation and your enemy
was the enemy of Allah, denier of the Apostle of Allah, he was calling towards falsehood
and ordering for tyranny and ruling with usurpation
segs.tr: WA YAHKOMO JAAA-ERAN WA YATA-AMMARO GHAASEBAN

segs.en: and was calling his party towards the fire while Ammar was
segs.tr: WA YAD-O’O HIZBAHU ILAN NAARE WA A’MMAA RUN

segs.en: fighting on your side and was calling out between the rows of battlefield:
Hasten towards Paradise and when he was thirsty,
segs.tr: RAWAAHAR RAWAAHA ELAL JANNATE WA LAMMAS

segs.en: he was offered milk and drink, he glorified Allah and stated that the
segs.tr: TASQAA FASOQEYAL LABANO KABBARA WA QAALA

segs.ar: قَالَ لِیْ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ صَلَّی اللهُ عَلَیْهِ
segs.en: Apostle of Allah peace be upon him and his

segs.ar: وَاٰلِهٖ اٰخِرُ شَرَابِكَ مِنَ الدُّنْیَا ضَیَاحٌ
segs.en: progeny had told him: The last drink that you will have in this world
segs.tr: WA AALEHI WA AAKHERO SHARAABEKA MENAD DUNYAA ZAYAAHUN

segs.en: will be milk and the rebellious group will kill you.
segs.tr: MIN LABANIN WA TAQTOLOKAL FE-ATUL BAAGHEYATO

segs.en: Then Abul Aadiyaa al-Fazaari came forward and he killed Ammaar.

segs.ar: فَعَلٰی اَبِیْ الْعَادِیَۃِ لَعْنَۃُ اللهِ وَلَعْنَۃُ
segs.en: Then upon Abul Aadiyah be the curse of Allah,
segs.tr: FA-A’LAA ABIL A’ADEYATE LA’NATULLAAHE WA LA’NATO

segs.en: His angles and His Apostles, all of them and also on
segs.tr: MALAAA-EKATEHI WA ROSOLEHI AJMA-E’ENA WA A’LAA

segs.en: those who raised their swords against you and you drew
segs.tr: MAN SALLA SAYFAHU A’LAYKA WA SALALTA

segs.ar: سَیْفَكَ عَلَیْهِ یَا اَمِیْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ مِنَ
segs.en: your sword against them, be they, O the commander of the faithful,
segs.tr: SAYFAKA A’LAYHE YAA AMEERAL MOMINEENA MENAL

segs.en: from the polytheists or the hypocrites, till the Day

segs.ar: الدِّیْنِ وَعَلٰی مَنْ رَضِیَ بِمَا سَآئَكَ
segs.en: of Judgement and those who were satisfied with the evil
segs.tr: DEENE WA A’LAA MAN RAZEYA BEMA SAAA-AKA

segs.en: that afflicted you and did not detest it, and covered it up and
segs.tr: WA LAM YAKRAH-HO WA AGHMAZA A’YNAHU WALAM

segs.ar: یُنْكِرْ اَوْ اَعَانَ عَلَیْكَ بِیَدٍ اَوْ لِسَانٍ
segs.en: did not deny it nor helped you to ward it off by their hand or tongue or sat down
segs.tr: YUNKIR  AW A-A’ANA A’LAYKA BEYADIN AW LESAANIN

segs.ar: اَوْ قَعَدَ عَنْ نَصْرِكَ اَوْ خَذَلَ عَنِ
segs.en: when it came to helping you and forsook you in
segs.tr: AW QA-A’DAN A’N NASREKA AW KHAZALA A’NIL

segs.en: fighting and tried to reduce your superiority

segs.ar: وَجَحَدَ حَقَّكَ اَوْ عَدَلَ بِكَ مَنْ
segs.en: and denied your right or equated you with the one
segs.tr: WA JAHADA HAQQAKA AW A’DALA BEKA MAN

segs.ar: جَعَلَكَ اللهَ اَوْلٰی بِهٖ مِنْ نَفْسِهٖ
segs.en: over whom Allah has given you more authority than he has over himself.
Blessings of Allah be upon you, and the Mercy of Allah
and His Blessings and His Peace
and His Greetings and upon the leaders from the pure
segs.tr: WA TAHIYYAATOHU WA A’LAL A-IMMATE MIN AALEKAT

segs.en: progeny, surely He is the Praiseworthy, Majestic.
segs.tr: TAAHEREENA INNAHU HAMEEDUN MAJEEDUN WAL AMRUL

segs.en: And a most astonishing event and the most detestable situation after
the denial of your right was the usurpation of Fadak that belonged to the Truthful and Pure
and Fair lady (Fatimah), the leader of the women (of the universe)
and the rejection of your testimony and that
segs.tr: FADAKAN WA RADDO SHAHAADATEKA WA SHAHAADATIS

segs.en: of the two leaders from the progeny
of Al-Mustafa blessings of Allah be on you concerning

segs.ar: اَعْلَی اللهُ تَعَالٰی عَلَی الْاُمَّۃِ دَرَجَتَكُمْ
segs.en: it while Allah has extolled your status over the nations and has raised your position
and has made clean your superiority and has
segs.tr: WA RAFA-A’ MANZELATAKUM WA ABAANA FAZLAKUM

segs.en: honoured you over the universe,
then He removed from you all types of filth and has purified you as purification ought to be,

segs.ar: قَالَ اللهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ اِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ خُلِقَ
segs.en: Allah, the Honoured, the Majestic. Surely, man has been created greedy (by nature) and
segs.tr: QAALALLAAHO AZZA WA JALLA INNAL INSAANA KHOLEQA

segs.ar: هَلُوْعًا اِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ جَزُوْعًا وَاِذَا
segs.en: when evil afflicts him, he becomes anxious and
segs.tr: HALOO-A’N EZAA MASSAHUSH SHARRO JAZOO-A’N WA EZAA

segs.en: when good occurs to him, he does not acknowledge except the praying ones.
Then Allah, the High, excepted His Prophet al-Mustafa

segs.ar: وَاَنْتَ یَا سَیِّدَ الْاَوْصِیَآءِ مِنْ جَمِیْعِ
segs.en: and you, O the chief of the vicegerents, from the entire creation.
segs.tr: WA ANTA YAA SAYYEDAL AWSEYAAA-E MIN JAMEE-I’L

segs.ar: الْخَلْقِ فَمَا اَعْمَهَ مَنْ ظَلَمَكَ عَنِ
segs.en: How blinded is he, who has oppressed you concerning your right, then through deceit
segs.tr: KHALQE FAMAA A’AMAHA MAN ZALAMAKA A’NIL

segs.en: they took away the share of the near ones of the Apostle and through oppression,
they prevented it from reaching to its rightful owners.
segs.tr: QURBAA MAKRAN WA AHAADOOHO A’N AHLEHI

segs.ar: جَوْرًا فَلَمَّا اٰلَ الْاَمْرُ اِلَیْكَ اَجْرَیْتَهُمْ
segs.en: Then, when the affair (of Caliphate) came to you, you left them
segs.tr: JAWRAN FALAMMAA AALAL AMRO ELAYKA AJRAYTAHUM

segs.ar: عَلٰی مَا اَجْرَ یَا رَغْبَةً عَنْهُمَا بِمَا عِنْدَ
segs.en: on their own and kept away from them, seeking reward from
segs.tr: A’LAA MAA AJRAYAA RAGHBATAN A’NHOMAA BEMAA I’NDAL

segs.en: Allah. How similar is your trial to those of the
Prophets, peace be upon them, in being
left alone and devoid of any helpers.
You were similar to the sacrificed  ‘Ismaeel’ when you slept

segs.ar: عَلَیْهِ السَّلَامُ اِذَا اَجَبْتَ كَمَا اَجَابَ
segs.en: on the bed of the Apostle in the night of migration because you responded in
segs.tr: A’LAYHIS SALAAMO EZAA AJABTA KAMAA AJAABA

segs.en: the same manner as him and you obeyed that just as Ismael obeyed, being patient
segs.tr: WA ATA’TA KAMAA ATAA-A’ ISMAAE’ELO SAABERAN

segs.ar: مُحْتَسِبًا اِذْ قَالَ لَہٗ یَا بُنَیَّ اِنِّیْٓ اَرٰی
segs.en: and forebearing. When Ibrahim said to him, ‘O my son! Surely, I see
segs.tr: MOHTASEBAN IZ QAALA LAHU YA BONAYYA INNI ARAA

segs.ar: فِی الْمَنَامِ اَنِّیْ اَذْبَحُكَ فَانْظُرْ مَاذَا
segs.en: in the dream that I am slaughtering you, then what
segs.tr: FIL MANAAME ANNI AZBAHOKA FANZUR MAAZA

segs.ar: تَریٰ قَالَ یَا اَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ
segs.en: do you say? He said, ‘O father! You carry out what you have been ordered.
segs.tr: TARAA QAALA YAA ABATIF-A’L MAA TOAMARO

segs.en: You will soon find me among the patient ones

segs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَنْتَ لَمَّا اَبَاتَكَ النَّبِیُّ صَلَّی
segs.en: and you also recited in the same manner when the Prophet (blessings be
segs.tr: WA KAZAALEKA ANTA LAMMA ABAATAKAN NABIYYO SALLAL

segs.ar: اللهُ عَلَیْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ وَاَمَرَكَ اَنْ تَضْجِعَ
segs.en: upon him and his progeny) ordered you to spend the
segs.tr: LAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI WA AMARAKA AN TAZJE-A’

segs.en: night sleeping in his bed in order that his life be saved.
segs.tr: FEE MARQADEHI WAAQEYAN LAHU BE NAFSEKA

segs.en: Then you responded very quickly and prepared
yourself to die obediently.
segs.tr: WA LE NAFSEKA A’LAL QATLO MAWATTENAN FA-SHAKARAL

segs.ar: اللهُ تَعَالٰی طَاعَتَكَ وَاَبَانَ عَنْ جَمِیْلِ
segs.en: Then Allah thanked your obedience and manifested your good
segs.tr: LAAHO TA-A’ALAA TAA-A’TAKA WA ABAANA A’N JAMEELE

segs.ar: فِعْلِكَ بِقَوْلِهٖ جَلَّ ذِكْرُہٗ وَمِنَ النَّاسِ
segs.en: deed through His saying, ‘And from among the men are those
segs.tr: FE’LAKA BE QAWLEHI JALLA ZIKROHU WA MENAN NAASE

segs.en: who sell their souls to seek the satisfaction of Allah.

segs.ar: اللهِ ثُمَّ مِحْنَتُكَ یَوْمَ صِفِّیْنَ وَقَدْ
segs.en: And then your examination of the Day of Siffeen when
segs.tr: LLAHE SUMMA MEHNATOKA YAWMA SIFFEENA WA QAD

segs.en: people raised the Holy Quran in deceit, the people
became skeptical and truth was covered,
and conjectures were followed.This resembled the examination of Haroon
segs.tr: WAT TOBE-A’Z ZANNO ASHBAHAT MEHNATA HAAROONA

segs.ar: اِذْ اَمَّرَہٗ مُوْسٰی عَلٰی قَوْمِهٖ فَتَفَرَّقُوْا
segs.en: when Moosa made them the leader of his nation then they separated
segs.tr: IZ AMMARAHU MOOSA A’LAA QAWMEHI FATAFARRAQOO

segs.en: from him while Haroon was calling to them saying,
segs.tr: A’NHO WA HAAROONO YONAADEE BEHIM WA YAQOOLO

segs.ar: یَا قَوْمٍ اِنَّمَا فُتِنْتُمْ بِهٖ وَاِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ
segs.en: ‘O my  people, surely you are being examined through this and surely your Lord
segs.tr: YAA QAWME INNAMAA FOTINTUM BEHI WA INNA RABBAKOMUR

segs.en: is the All-Beneficent, then you follow me and obey my command.’

segs.ar: قَالُوْا لَنْ نَبْرَحَ عَلَیْهِ عَاكِفِیْنَ حَتّٰی
segs.en: They  replied, ‘We will keep on worshipping the calf till
segs.tr: QAALOO LAN NABRAHA A’LAYHE A’AKEFEENA HATTA

segs.en: the time Moosa returns. The same things occurred with you. When the Holy Quran
segs.tr: YARJE-A’ ELAYNA MOOSAA WA KAZAALEKA ANTA

segs.ar: لَمَّا رُفِعَتِ الْمَصَاحِفُ قُلْتَ یَا قَوْمِ
segs.en: were being raised, you called out, O my people,
segs.tr: LAMMA ROFE-A’TIL MASAAHEFO QULTA YAA QAWME

segs.en: you are being examined by it and you are being deceived,
segs.tr: INNAMA FOTINTUM BEHAA WA KHO-DEA’TUM FA A’SAWKA

segs.en: then they disobeyed you and opposed you and called for arbitration
so you refused and disowned from them
segs.tr: HAKAMAYNE FA ABAYTA A’LAYHIM WA TABARRAATA

segs.ar: اِلَی اللهِ مِنْ فِعْلِهِمْ وَفَوَّضْتَہٗ اِلَیْهِمْ
segs.en: infront of Allah and you left the matter to them.
segs.tr: ELALLAAHE MIN FEA’LEHIM WA FAWWAZTAHU ELAYHIM

segs.en: Then when the truth was made evident and
segs.tr: FALAMMA ASFARAL HAQQO WA SAFEHAL MUNKARO

segs.en: the foolishness was exposed and they admitted to their mistakes and tyranny and opposed
oppression after that and made allegations that you had
segs.tr: QASDIKH TALAFOO MIN BA’DEHI WA ALZAMOOKA

segs.en: set up the foolish act of arbitration which in fact you had opposed and they wanted it.
You warned them about it but they deemed their sin as permissible.
segs.tr: WA AHABBOOHU WA KHATARATAHU WA ABAAHOWAA ZANBAHOMUL

segs.en: While you were on the peak of foresight
segs.tr: LAZIQ TARAFOOHO WA ANTA A’LAA NAHJE

segs.en: and guidance and they were on the path of
segs.tr: BASEERAT IN WAHODAN WAHUM A’LAA SONANIN

segs.en: deviation and blindness. They then persisted in their
segs.tr: ZALAALATIN WA A’MAN FAMAA ZAALOO A’LAN

segs.en: hypocrisy and wandering back and forth in error,
until Allah made them taste the evil consequences of their affair;
then He caused the one who opposed you to die by your sword, so he became wretched
segs.tr: FA AMAATA BESAYFEKA MAN A’ANADAKA FA SHAQEYA

segs.en: and deviated. And He enlivened by your proof, the one who was fortunate
segs.tr: WA HAWAA WA AHYAA BEHUJJATEKA MAN SA-A’DA

segs.en: and was guided, blessings of Allah be you, morning and evening, from the beginning to the end,
in motion and while still, then no eulogizers can truly
segs.tr: WARAAA-EHATAN WA AAKEFATAN WA ZAAHEBATAN FAMAA

segs.en: comprehend your attributes and neither can
any maligner comprehend your virtues. You were the best of creation
in the matter of worship and the most sincere
segs.tr: E’BAADATAN WA AKHLASOHUM ZAHAADATAN WA AZZABOHUM

segs.en: in abstinence and the most defending of the religion.
You strove to uphold the limits imposed by Allah and defeated the enemies of the deviated ones
segs.tr: BE JOHADEKA WA FALAKA A’SAAKERAL MAAREQEENA

segs.en: by your sword and you doused the fire of war
by your power and you tore to shreds the curtains of doubts
by your oratory and you exposed the deception of falsehood
segs.tr: BE BAYAANEKA WA TAKSHEFO LABSAL BAATELE

segs.ar: عَنْ صَرِیْحِ الْحَقِّ لَا تَاْخُذُكَ فِی اللهِ
segs.en: by explanation of truth. The slandering of any slanderer
segs.tr: A’N SAREEHIL HAQQE LAA TAAKHOZOKA FIL LAAHE

segs.ar: لَوْمَۃُ لَائِمٍ وَفِیْ مَدْحِ اللهِ تَعَالٰی لَكَ
segs.en: did not bother you in the way of Allah and your praising by Allah
segs.tr: LAUMATO LAAEMIN WA FEE MADHILLAAHE TA-A’ALAA LAKA

segs.en: made you needless of the praises of the praising ones
segs.tr: GHENAN A’N MADHIL MAADEHEENA WA TAQREEZIL

segs.en: and the attribution by those who do so. Allah, the Exalted, said, ‘From the men
are those who fulfill their covenant then from those

segs.ar: اللهَ عَلَیْهِ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَضٰی نَحْبَہٗ
segs.en: are some who have departed from this world
segs.tr: LAAHA A’LAYHE FAMINHUM MAN QAZAA NAHBAHU

segs.ar: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ یَنْتَظِرُ وَمَا بَدَّلُوْا تَبْدِیْلًا
segs.en: and some are awaiting and they have not changed a thing
segs.tr: WA MINHUM MAN YANTAZER WA MAA BADDALOO TABDEELAN

segs.en: and when you saw that you were fighting against the covenant,
segs.tr: WA LAMMA RA-AYATA AN QATALTAN NAAKESEENA

segs.en: breakers, the oppressers and the deviated ones
segs.tr: WAL QAASETEENA WAL MAAREQEENA WA SADAQAKA

segs.ar: رَسُوْلُ اللهِ صَلَّی اللهُ عَلَیْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ
segs.en: and the Apostle of Allah, Blessings of Allah be on him and his progeny

segs.ar: وَعْدَہٗ فَاَوْفَیْتَ بِعَهْدِهٖ قُلْتَ اَمَا اٰنَ
segs.en: had fulfilled his promise to you, then you too observed your covenant which you had made to him. You said,
segs.tr: WA’DAHU FA-AWAFAYTA BE A’HDEHI QULTA AMAA ANA

segs.ar: اَنْ تُخْضَبَ هٰذِهٖ مِنْ هٰذِهٖ اَمْ مَتٰی
segs.en: Has the time not arrived that my beard be dyed with the blood of my head.
segs.tr: AN TUKHZABA HAAZEHI MIN HAAZEHI MATAA

segs.ar: یُبْعَثُ اَشْقَاهَا وَاثِقًا بِاَنَّكَ عَلٰی بَیِّنَۃٍ
segs.en: When will the most unfortunate one of the nation,
segs.tr: YUB-A’SO ASHQAAHAA WAASEQAN BEANNAKA A’LAA BAYYENATIN

segs.en: entrusted for this action rise up. Surely, you were on a proof from your Lord and had foresight
in your affair. Proceeding towards Allah,
receiving glad tidings of the trading that

segs.ar: بَایَعْتَہٗ بِهٖ وَذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِیْمُ
segs.en: you have performed with Him and that is a great success.
segs.tr: BAAYA’TAHU BEHI WA ZAALEKA HOWAL FAWZUL A’ZEEMO

segs.en: O Allah, you curse the killers of Your Prophets and the vicegerents
of Your Prophets by all Your curse and throw them
segs.tr: ANBEYAAA-EKA BE JAMEE-E’ LA’NAATEKA WA ASLEHIM

segs.ar: حَرَّ نَارِكَ وَالْعَنْ مَنْ غَصَبَ وَلِیَّكَ
segs.en: in Your Hell fire and curse the one who usurped the right of
segs.tr: HARRA NAAREKA WAL-A’N MAN GHASABA WALEEYYAKA

segs.en: Your representative and rejected his covenant and denied him after
segs.tr: HAQQAHU WA ANKARA A’HDAHU WA JAHADAHU BA’DAL

segs.en: being certain and after affirming to his mastership on the day
segs.tr: YAQEENE WAL IQRAARE BIL WELAAYATE LAHU YAWMA

segs.en: when You perfected the religion for him
O Allah! Curse the killers of the leader of the faithful
and those who oppressed him and their adherents and their helpers.
segs.tr: WA MAN ZALAMAHU WA ASHYAA-A’HUM WA ANSAARAHUM

segs.en: O Allah! Curse those who have oppressed Husayn
and killed him and those who followed his enemies

segs.ar: وَنَاصِرِیْهِ وَالرَّاضِیْنَ بِقَتْلِهٖ وَخَاذِلِیْهِ لَعْنًا وَبِیْلًا
segs.en: and their aides and those who are satisfied with his killing and those who forsook him with a calamitous cursing.
segs.tr: WA NAASEREEHE WAR RAAZEENA BE QATLEHI WA KHAZELEEHE LA’NAN WABEELAN

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ الْعَنْ اَوَّلَ ظَالِمٍ ظَلَمَ اٰلَ
segs.en: O Allah! Curse the first oppressor who oppressed the progeny
of Mohammad and denied them their rights.
O Allah! Mark out the first oppressor and usurper

segs.ar: لِاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ بِاللَّعْنِ وَكُلَّ مُسْتَنٍّ بِمَا
segs.en: of the progeny of Mohammad with curse and all those who treaded such a
segs.tr: LEAALE MOHAMMADIN BIL LA’NE WA KULLA MUSTANNIN BEMAA

segs.en: path till the Day of Judgement.
O Allah! Bless Mohammad the last
of the Prophets and Ali, the leader of the vicegerents
segs.tr: NABIYYEENA WA A’LAA A’LIYYIN SAYYEDIL WASIYYEENA

segs.en: and his pure progeny and include us with them,
being attached to them and being successful
segs.tr: MOTAMASSEKEENA WA BE WELAAYATEHIM MENAL FAAEZEENAL

segs.en: through their mastership, among those who have no fear
and neither do they grieve.

A_AC1.merits: Through authoritative chains of authority, it is narrated that Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi (a.s.) said this form of ziyarah at the holy tomb of Imam Ali Ameer al-Moamenin (a.s.) on the Ghadeer day when he was summoned by the Abbasid ruler, al-Mo’tasim, to be present before him in Iraq.

A_AC2.name: Another Ziyarat on the Day of Ghadir

segs.note: There is another form of ziyarah mentioned in Iqbal al-Aa’maal by Sayyid Ibn Taaoos who says that Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) is reported to have said:
segs.ur: زیارت کی ایک اور صورت سید ابن طاؤس کی اقبال الاعمال میں مذکور ہے، جو کہتے ہیں کہ امام صادق (ع) سے روایت ہے کہ آپ نے فرمایا:

segs.note: If you are present at the holy tomb of Imam Ali (a.s.) on the Ghadeer Day, you may come near the tomb and say the following supplicatory prayer. If you are in a remote place, you may point to him after the prayer and say the supplicatory prayer involved:
segs.ur: اگر آپ غدیر کے دن امام علی (ع) کے مقدس روضے پر موجود ہوں تو قبر کے قریب جا کر درج ذیل دعا پڑھ سکتے ہیں۔ اگر آپ دور کسی جگہ ہوں تو نماز کے بعد آپ کی طرف اشارہ کر کے متعلقہ دعا پڑھ سکتے ہیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى وَلِيِّكَ وَاَخِيْ نَبِيِّكَ
segs.en: O Allah, bless Your close friend (Wali), the brother of Your Prophet,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA WALIYYEKA WA AKHEE NABIYYEKA

segs.en: his vizier, his beloved, his intimate friend,
segs.tr: WA WAZEEREHI WA HABEEBEHI WA KHALEELEHI

segs.en: the repository of his secret, his chosen one from his family,
segs.tr: WA MAWZE-E’ SIRREHI WA KHEYARATEHI MIN USRATEHI

segs.en: his executor (Wasi), his elite selection, his sincere friend, his trustee,
segs.tr: WA WASIYYEHI WA SAFWATEHI WA KHAALESATEHI WA AMEENEHI

segs.ar: وَوَلِيِّهٖ وَاَشْرَفِ عِتْرَتِهِ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا بِهٖ
segs.en: his guardian, and the most noble of his progeny who believed in him;
segs.tr: WA WALIYYEHI WA ASHRAFE I’TRATEHIL LAZEENA AAMANOO BEHI

segs.ar: وَاَبِيْ ذُرِّيَّتِهٖ وَبَابِ حِكْمَتِهٖ وَالنَّاطِقِ بِحُجَّتِهٖ
segs.en: the father of his offspring, the gate to his wisdom, the speaker with his proof,
segs.tr: WA ABEE ZURRIYYATEHI WA BAABE HIKMATEHI WAN NAATEQE BE-HUJJATEHI

segs.ar: وَالدَّاعِيْ اِلٰى شَرِيْعَتِهٖ وَالْمَاضِيْ عَلٰى سُنَّتِهٖ
segs.en: the caller to his law, the one who persevered upon his practice (Sunnah),
segs.tr: WAD DAA-E’E ELAA SHAREE-A’TEHI WAL MAAZEE A’LAA SUNNATEHI

segs.en: and his successor (Khalifah) over his nation—the Master of the Muslims,
segs.tr: WA KHALEEFATEHI A’LAA UMMATEHI SAYYEDIL MUSLEMEENA

segs.en: the Commander of the Faithful, and the leader of the radiant, white-faced ones;
segs.tr: WA AMEERIL MO-MENEENA WA QAAA-EDIL GHURRIL MOHAJJALEENA

segs.ar: اَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى اَحَدٍ مِّنْ خَلْقِكَ
segs.en: with the most excellent blessings You have ever bestowed upon any of Your creation,
segs.tr: AFZALA MAA SALLAYTA A’LAA AHADIM MIN KHALQEKA

segs.en: Your chosen ones, or the executors of Your Prophets.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّي اَشْهَدُ اَنَّهٗ قَدْ بَلَّغَ عَنْ نَبِيِّكَ
segs.en: O Allah, indeed I bear witness that he conveyed on behalf of Your Prophet
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE ASH-HADO ANNAHU QAD BALLAGHA A’N NABIYYEKA

segs.ar: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ مَا حُمِّلَ وَرَعٰى مَا اسْتُحْفِظَ
segs.en: may the peace and blessings of Allah be upon him and his family, what he was charged with,
segs.tr: SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI MAA HUMMELA WA RA-A’A MASTOHFEZA

segs.ar: وَحَفِظَ مَا اسْتُوْدِعَ وَحَلَّلَ حَلَالَكَ وَحَرَّمَ حَرَامَكَ
segs.en: safeguarded what he was asked to protect, preserved what was entrusted to him, declared lawful Your lawful matters, declared forbidden Your forbidden matters,
segs.tr: WA HAFEZA MASTOODE-A’ WA HALLALA HALAALAKA WA HARRAMA HARAAMAKA

segs.en: established Your laws, called to Your path,
segs.tr: WA AQAAMA AHKAAMAKA WA DA-A’A ELAA SABEELEKA

segs.en: befriended Your close friends, opposed Your enemies,
segs.tr: WA WAALAA AWLEYAAA-AKA WA A’ADAA A-A’DAAA-AKA

segs.en: and fought those who broke their allegiance from Your path,
those who acted unjustly, and those who apostatized from Your command;
segs.tr: WAL QAASETEENA WAL MAAREQEENA A’N AMREKA

segs.en: doing so patiently, seeking Your reward, advancing forward and never turning back,

segs.ar: لَّا تَأْخُذُهٗ فِي اللّٰهِ لَوْمَةُ لَاۤئِمٍ حَتّٰى بَلَغَ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ الرِّضَا
segs.en: never swayed in [the service of] Allah by the blame of any blamer, until he reached Your satisfaction in that,
segs.tr: LAA TAA-KHOZOHU FILLAAHE LAWMATO LAAA-EMIN HATTAA BALAGHA FEE ZAALEKAR REZAA

segs.en: submitted the decree to You, worshipped You with absolute sincerity,
segs.tr: WA SALLAMA ELAYKAL QAZAAA-A WA A’BADAKA MUKHLESAN

segs.ar: وَنَصَحَ لَكَ مُجْتَهِدًا حَتّٰى اَتَاهُ الْيَقِيْنُ
segs.en: and counseled for Your sake with ultimate effort until certainty [death] came to him.
segs.tr: WA NASAHA LAKA MUJTAHEDAN HATTAA ATAAHUL YAQEENO

segs.en: Thus, You took him to Yourself as a martyr, felicitous,

segs.ar: وَّلِيًّا تَقِيًّا رَضِيًّا زَكِيًّا هَادِيًا مَّهْدِيًّا
segs.en: a close friend, God-fearing, well-pleased, pure, a guide, and rightly-guided.
segs.tr: WALIYYAN TAQIYYAN RAZIYYAN ZAKIYYAN HAADEYAM MAHDIYYAN

segs.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and bless him,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADINW WA A’LAYHE

segs.ar: اَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى اَحَدٍ مِّنْ اَنْبِيَاۤئِكَ
segs.en: with the most excellent blessings You have ever bestowed upon any of Your Prophets
segs.tr: AFZALA MAA SALLAYTA A’LAA AHADIM MIN ANBEYAAA-EKA

segs.en: and Your chosen ones, O Lord of the Worlds.

segs.note: In his book of Misbah al-Zaaer, Sayyed Ibn Taaoos has mentioned another form of ziyarah that is dedicated to this day (Ghadeer Day). However, it is not certain that this form is dedicated to this day. This form of ziyarah is in fact composed of two forms that Allamah al-Majlisi has mentioned them in his book of al-Tohfah as the second and the third forms of ziyarah dedicated to the Ghadeer Day.
segs.ur: سید ابن طاؤس نے اپنی کتاب «مصباح الزائر» میں زیارت کی ایک اور صورت ذکر کی ہے جو اس دن (روز غدیر) کے لیے مخصوص ہے۔ تاہم یہ یقینی نہیں کہ یہ صورت اس دن کے لیے مخصوص ہو۔ یہ زیارت درحقیقت دو صورتوں سے مل کر بنی ہے جنہیں علامہ مجلسی نے اپنی کتاب «التحفہ» میں روز غدیر کی مخصوص زیارت کی دوسری اور تیسری صورت کے طور پر ذکر کیا ہے۔

A_AC3.name: Ziyarat on the Days of Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha

segs.note: On the two nights before Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha, say this ziyarah at the holy shrine of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.). On the two days themselves, say Ziyarat of Imam Husayn (a.s.) on the Qadr Nights.
segs.ur: عید الفطر اور عید الاضحی سے پہلے کی دونوں راتوں میں یہ زیارت امام حسین (ع) کے روضۂ مقدس پر پڑھیں۔ ان دونوں دنوں میں [شب ہائے قدر میں امام حسین (ع) کی زیارت](G14) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: When you intend to visit Imam al-Husayn (a.s.)’s tomb at these two nights, you may stop at the gate of the holy dome, cast your sight on the tomb, and seek permission of admission by saying,
segs.ur: جب آپ ان دونوں راتوں میں امام حسین (ع) کی قبر کی زیارت کرنا چاہیں تو مقدس گنبد کے دروازے پر رک کر، قبر پر نظر ڈال کر، یہ کہتے ہوئے داخلے کی اجازت مانگ سکتے ہیں،

segs.ar: یَا مَوْلَایَ یَا اَبَا عَبْدِ اﷲِ یَابْنَ رَسُوْلِ اﷲِ
segs.en: O my master, O Abu Abdullah, O the son of the Apostle of Allah,
segs.tr: YAA MAWLAAYA YAA ABAA A’BDILLAAHE YABNA RASOOLILLAAHE

segs.ar: عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ اَمَتِكَ الذَّلِیْلُ بَیْنَ یَدَیْكَ
segs.en: your servant and the son of your maidservant, abased before you and
segs.tr: A’BDOKA WABNO AMATEKAZ ZALEELO BAYNA YADAYKA

segs.en: diminutive in front of your lofty stature, attestor of
segs.tr: WAL MOSAGHGHARO FEE O’LUWWE QADREKA WAL MO’TAREFO

segs.ar: بِحَقِّكَ جَآئَكَ مُسْتَجِیْرًا بِكَ قَاصِداً اِلیٰ
segs.en: your right, He has come to you seeking refuge in you, entrant in
segs.tr: BE HAQQEKA JAAA-AKA MUSTAJEERAN BEKA QAASEDAN ELAA

segs.ar: حَرَمِكَ مُتَوَجِّهًا اِلیٰ مَقَامِكَ مُتَوَسِّلًا اِلَی
segs.en: your sanctuary, facing your position beseeching Allah
segs.tr: HARAMEKA MOTAWAJJEHAN ELAA MAQAAMEKA MOTAWASSELAN ELAL

segs.ar: اﷲِ تَعَالیٰ بِكَ ءَ اَدْخُلُ یَا مَوْلَایَ ءَاَدْخُلُ
segs.en: through you, Do I enter, O my master. Do I enter,
segs.tr: LAAHE TA-A’ALAA BEKA A-ADKHOLO YAA MAWLAAYA A-ADKHOLO

segs.ar: یَا وَلِیَّ اﷲِ ءَاَدْخُلُ یَا مَلَائِكَۃَ اﷲِ
segs.en: O the representative of Allah? Do I enter, O the angels of Allah
who encircle this sanctuary, and reside in
segs.tr: MOHDEQEENA BE HAAZAL HARAMIL MOQEEMEENA FEE

segs.en: this holy shrine?

segs.note: If your heart feels reverence and your eyes shed tears, then you may enter by preceding your right foot to your left one. You may then say the following words:
segs.ur: اگر آپ کا دل ادب و تعظیم محسوس کرے اور آنکھوں سے آنسو بہیں تو دایاں پاؤں بائیں سے پہلے رکھ کر داخل ہوں۔ پھر درج ذیل کلمات کہیں:

segs.ar: بِسْمِ اﷲِ وَبِاﷲِ وَفِیْ سَبِیْلِ اﷲِ وَعَلیٰ
segs.en: In the name of Allah and by Allah and in the way of Allah and on the
segs.tr: BISMILLAAHE WA BILLAAHE WA FEE SABEELILLAAHE WA A’LAA

segs.ar: مِلَّۃِ رَسُوْلِ اﷲِ اَللّٰھُمَّ اَنَزِلْنِیْ مُنْزَلًا
segs.en: nation of the Apostle of Allah. O Allah, You send down upon me a blessed
station and You are the best of those who reveal.

segs.note: You may then say the following words:
segs.ur: پھر آپ درج ذیل الفاظ کہہ سکتے ہیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ كَبِیْرًا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ كَثِیْرًا وَسُبْحَانَ
segs.en: Allah is most great and abundant praise is for Allah and I glorify Allah
segs.tr: ALLAAHO AKBARO KABEERAN WAL HAMDO LILLAAHE KASEERAN WA SUBHAANAL

segs.ar: اﷲِ بُكْرَۃً وَاَصِیْلًا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الْفَرْدِ
segs.en: morning and evening. All Praise belongs to Allah, the Unique,
segs.tr: LAAHE BUKRATAN WA ASEELAN WAL HAMDOLILLAAHIL FARDIS

segs.en: the Self-Sufficient, the Majestic, the One, the Gracious, the Obliger, the Benevolent,

segs.ar: الْمُتَطَوِّلِ الْحَنَّانِ الَّذِیْ مِنْ تَطَوُّلِهٖ سَهَّلَ
segs.en: the Benefactor, the One due to whose Benevolence and Goodness. He has eased
segs.tr: MOTA-TAWWELIL HANNAANIL LAZEE MIN TA-TAWWOLEHI SAH-HALA

segs.ar: لِیْ زِیَارَۃَ مَوْلَایَ بِاِحْسَانِهٖ وَلَمْ یَجْعَلْنِیْ
segs.en: for me the visitation of my master through His kindness and did not prevent me from
segs.tr: LEE ZEYAARATA MAWLAAYA BE EHSAANEHI WA LAM YAJ-A’LNEE

segs.ar: عَنْ زِیَارَتِهٖ مَمْنُوْعًا وَلَا عَنْ ذِمَّتِهٖ مَدْفُوْعًا
segs.en: it and has not stopped me from the discharge of my responsibilities.
segs.tr: A’N ZEYAARATEHI MAMNOO-A’N WA LAA A’N ZIMMATEHI MAD-FOO-A’N

segs.en: Rather He has favoured and honoured me.

segs.note: You may then enter the shrine. When you reach its center, you may stop near the tomb with reverence, weeping, and submission, and say the following words:
segs.ur: پھر آپ حرم میں داخل ہو سکتے ہیں۔ جب اس کے وسط میں پہنچیں تو ادب، گریہ اور عاجزی کے ساتھ قبر کے قریب رک سکتے ہیں اور درج ذیل الفاظ کہیں:

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا وَارِثَ اٰدَمَ صَفْوَۃِ اﷲِ
segs.en: Peace be on you, O the inheritor of Adam the sincerely attached friend of Allah!
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA WAARESA AADAMA SAFWATIL LAAHE

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَاوَارِثَ نُوْحٍ اَمِیْنِ اﷲِ
segs.en: Peace be on you, O the inheritor of Nooh, the trustee of Allah!
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA WAARESA NOOHIN AMEENIL LAAHE

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا وَارِثَ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ خَلِیْلِ اﷲِ
segs.en: Peace be on you, O the inheritor of Abraham, the intimate friend of Allah!
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA WAARESA IBRAAHEEMA KHALEELIL LAAHE

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا وَارِثَ مُوْسٰی كَلِیْمِ اﷲِ
segs.en: Peace be on you, O the inheritor of Moses who spoke to Allah!
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA WAARESA MOOSAA KALEEMIL LAAHE

segs.ar: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا وَارِثَ عِیْسیٰ رُوْحِ اﷲِ
segs.en: Peace be on you, O the inheritor of Jesus, the Spirit of Allah!
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA WAARESA E’ESAA ROOHIL LAAHE

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا وَارِثَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّی
segs.en: Peace be on you, O the inheritor of Mohammad, blessings of
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA WAARESA MOHAMMADIN SALLAL

segs.en: Allah be upon him and his family, the dearest beloved of Allah!

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا وَارِثَ عَلِیٍّ حُجَّۃٍ اﷲِ
segs.en: Peace be on you, O the inheritor of Ali, the Proof of Allah!
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA WAARESA A’LIYYIN HUJJATILLAAHE

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْوَصِیُّ الْبَرُّ التَّقِیُّ
segs.en: Peace be on you, O the vicegerent, the righteous, the pious
segs.tr: ASSAALAMO A’LAYKA AYYOHAL WASIYYUL BARRUT TAQIYYO

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا ثَارَاﷲِ وَابْنَ ثَارِهٖ وَالْوِتْرَ الْمَوْتُوْرَ
segs.en: Peace be on you, O he whose blood-claimer is Allah, He is the blood-claimer of your father also, as those who persecuted you, your relatives and friends have not been punished for the crimes.
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA SAARALLAAHE WABNA SAAREHI WAL WITRAL MAWTOORA

segs.ar: اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ قَدْ اَقَمْتَ الصَّلوٰۃَ وَاٰتَیْتَ
segs.en: I bear witness that verily you established the prayers, gave
segs.tr: ASH-HADO ANNAKA QAD AQAMTAS SALAATA WA AATAYTAZ

segs.en: the zakat (prescribed share) to the needy, commanded to do what is right and lawful, not to do that
segs.tr: ZAKAATA WA AMARTA BIL MA’ROOFE WA NAHAYTA

segs.ar: عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَجَاهَدْتَ فِی اﷲِ حَقَّ
segs.en: which is wrong and unlawful, and you fought in the way of Allah in letter and
segs.tr: A’NIL MUNKARE WA JAAHADTA FILLAAHE HAQQA

segs.ar: جِهَادِهِ حَتَّی اسْتُبِیْحَ حَرَمُكَ وَقُتِلْتَ مَظْلُوْمًا
segs.en: spirit till your sanctuary was violated and you were killed oppressively.
segs.tr: JEHAADEHI HATTAS TOBEE-HA HARAMOKA WA QOTILTA MAZLOOMAN

segs.note: You may then stop at the side of the Imam’s head with submissive heart and teary eyes and say the following words:
segs.ur: پھر آپ خاشع دل اور اشک بار آنکھوں کے ساتھ امام کے سر مبارک کی جانب کھڑے ہو کر درج ذیل الفاظ کہیں:

segs.en: Peace be on you, O Abu Abdullah
Peace be on you, O the son of the Apostle of Allah

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا بْنَ سَیِّدِ الْوَصِیِّیْنَ
segs.en: Peace be on you, O the son of the chief of the successors

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ فَاطِمَۃَ الزَّهْرَآئِ سَیِّدَۃِ نِسَآئِ الْعَالَمِیْنَ
segs.en: Peace be on you, O the son of Fatemah Zahra, the chief of the women of the universe
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YABNA FAATEMATAZ ZAHRAAA-E SAYYEDATE NESAAA-IL A’ALAMEENA

segs.en: Peace be on you, O the valiant warrior of the Muslims.

segs.ar: یَا مَوْلَایَ اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ كُنْتَ نُوْراً فِیْ
segs.en: O my Master, I bear witness that verily you were a light in the
segs.tr: YAA MAWLAAYA ASH-HADO ANNAKA KUNTA NOORAN FIL

segs.en: sublime loins and purified wombs,
the impurities of ignorance did not even touch you, nor
segs.tr: LAM TONAJJISKAL JAAHELIYYATO BE ANJAASEHAA WA LAM

segs.en: could its soiled and dirty bearing ever smear you.

segs.ar: وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ مِنْ دَعَآئِمِ الدِّیْنِ وَاَرْكَانِ
segs.en: I bear witness that, verily, you are the mainstay of the religion, and the support
segs.tr: WA ASH-HADO ANNAKA MIN  DA-AAA-EMID DEENE WA ARKAANIL

segs.en: of the Muslims and the sanctuary of the believers.
I bear witness that, verily, you are a righteous, pious, satisfied,
segs.tr: WA ASH-HADO ANNAKAL EMAAMUL BARRUT TAQIYYUR RAZIYYUZ

segs.en: chaste, guide, guided, and I bear witness that
segs.tr: ZAKIYYUL HAADIL MAHDIYYE WA ASH-HADO ANNAL

segs.ar: الْاَئِمَّۃَ مِنْ وُلْدِكَ كَلِمَۃُ التّقْویٰ وَاَعْلَامُ
segs.en: the leaders from your progeny are the words of piety and the standards
segs.tr: A-IMMATA MIN WULDEKA KALAMATUT TAQWAA WA A-ALAAMUL

segs.en: of guidance and the strong rope and proofs upon
segs.tr: HODAA WAL U’RWATUL WUSQAA WAL HUJJATO A’LAA

segs.en: the people of the world.

segs.note: You may then throw yourself on the tomb and say the following words:
segs.ur: پھر آپ اپنے آپ کو قبر پر ڈال دیں اور درج ذیل الفاظ کہیں:

segs.ar: اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَاِنَّا اِلَیْهِ رَاجِعُوْنَ یَامَوْلَایَ اَنَا
segs.en: To Allah do we belong and unto Him shall we return. O my master, I am
segs.tr: INNAA LILLAAHE WA INNAA ELAYHE RAA-JE-O’ONA YAA MAWLAAYA ANAA

segs.ar: مُوَالٍ لِوَلِیِّكُمْ وَمُعَادٍ لِعَدُوِّكُمْ وَاَنَا بِكُمْ
segs.en: a friend of your friends and an enemy to your enemy. I believe in you
segs.tr: MOWAALIN LE WALIYYEKUM WA MO-A’ADIN LE A’DUWWEKUM WA ANAA BEKUM

segs.en: and am certain about your return along with the laws of my religion
segs.tr: MOA-MENUN WA BE EYAAKUM MOOQENUN BE SHA-RAA-YE-E’ DEENEE

segs.en: and the end result of my deeds and my heart submits to your heart
segs.tr: WA KHAWAATEEME A’MALEE WA QALBEE LE QALBEKUM SILMUN

segs.ar: وَاَمْرِیْ لِأَمْرِكُمْ مُتَّبِعٌ یَا مَوْلَایَ اَتَیْتُكَ
segs.en: and my affair follows your command. O my master! I come to you
segs.tr: WA AMREE LE AMREKUM MUTTABE-O’ON YAA MAWLAAYA ATAYTOKA

segs.en: as a fearful person then grant me security and I come to you as one seeking your refuge then grant me cover
segs.tr: KHAA-EFAN FA-AAMINNEE WA ATAYTOKA MUSTAJEERAN FA-AJIRNEE

segs.en: and I come to you as a destitute. Then you make me needless of other. O my master and my chief,
segs.tr: WA ATYATOKA FAQEERAN FA-AGHNENEE SAYYEDEE WA MAWLAAYA

segs.ar: اَنْتَ مَوْلَایَ حُجَّۃُ اﷲِ عَلَی الْخَلْقِ
segs.en: you are my master, the proof of Allah upon the entire
creation. I believe in your hidden and your evident affairs
segs.tr: AJ-MAE’ENA AAMANTO BE SIRREKUM WA A’LAANIYYATEKUM

segs.en: and your exterior and your interior and your first and your last.
segs.tr: WA BE JAAHEREKUM WA BAATENEKUM WA AWWALEKUM WA AAKHEREKUM

segs.ar: وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ التَّالِیْ لِكِتابِ اﷲِ وَاَمِیْنُ
segs.en: And I bear witness that you are the reciter the Book of Allah and the trustee
segs.tr: WA ASH-HADO ANNAKAT TAALEE LE-KETAABILLAAHE WA AMEENUL

segs.ar: اﷲِ الدَّاعِی اِلَی اﷲِ بِالحْكْمَۃِ وَالْمَوْعِظَۃِ
segs.en: of Allah and the caller towards Allah with wisdom and goodly
segs.tr: LAAHID DAA-E’EE ELALLAAHE BIL HIKMATE WAL MAW-E’ZATIL

segs.ar: الْحَسَنَۃِ لَعَنَ اﷲُ اُمَّۃً ظَلَمَتْكَ وَاُمَّۃً
segs.en: admonition. May Allah curse the people who have oppressed you and the people who have
segs.tr: HASANATE LA-A’NALLAAHO UMMATAN ZALAMATKA WA UMMATAN

segs.ar: قَتَلَتْكَ وَلَعَنَ اﷲُ اُمَّۃً سَمِعَتْ بِذَالِكَ
segs.en: killed you and the people who heard about it
segs.tr: QATALATKA WA LA-A’NALLAAHO UMMATAN SAME-A’T BE ZAALEKA

segs.en: but agree to it.

segs.note: You may then offer a two-unit prayer to the side of the Imam’s head and when you finish, you may say the following words:
segs.ur: پھر امام کے سرہانے دو رکعت نماز پڑھیں اور فارغ ہو کر یہ کلمات کہیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰھُمَّ اِنِّیْ لَكَ صَلَّیْتُ وَلَكَ رَكَعْتُ
segs.en: O Allah! I have prayed to You
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE LAKA SALLAAYTO WA LAKA RA-KA’TO

segs.ar: وَلَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَحَدْكَ لَا شَرِیْكَ لَكَ فَاِنَّهٗ
segs.en: and I have bowed down before You and I prostrate in front of You. You are One, There is no partner unto You
segs.tr: WA LAKA SAJADTO WAHDAKA LAA SHAREEKA LAKA FA INNAHU

segs.en: as there is no prayer or bowing or prostration except for You.
segs.tr: LAA TAJOOZUS SALAATO WAR ROKOO-O’ WAS SOJOODO

segs.ar: اِلاَّ لَكَ لِاَنَّكَ اَنْتَ اﷲُ الَّذِیْ لَا اِلٰهَ اَنْتَ
segs.en: For surely You are Allah. There is no God except You.
segs.tr: ILLAA LAKA LE ANNAKA ANTALLAAHUL LAZEE LAA ELAAHA ANTA

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلیٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah! Send blessings on Mohammad and the progeny of Mohammad
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: and convey to them from me the best of peace and greetings,
segs.tr: WA ABLIGH-HUM A’NNEE AFZALAS SALAAME WAT TAHIYYATE

segs.en: and return to me their greetings of peace.

segs.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَهَاتَانِ الرَّكْعَتَانِ هَدِیَّۃٌ مِنِّیْ اِلیٰ
segs.en: O Allah! These are two cycles of prayers, which is a gift from my side in the service
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WA HAATAANIR RAK-A’TAANE HADIYYATUN MINNEE ELAA

segs.ar: سَیِّدِیْ الْحُسَیْنِ بنِ عَلِیٍّ عَلَیْهِمَا السَّلَامُ
segs.en: of my master and leader and my chief Husayn ibn Ali, peace be upon both of them.
O Allah! Send blessings on Mohammad and upon him (al-Husayn),
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA A’LAYHE

segs.en: and accept that from me and reward me for that to the extent
segs.tr: WA TAQABBAL-HOMAA MINNEE WAJ-ZENEE A’LAYHEMAA AFZALA

segs.ar: اَمَلِیْ وَرَجَآئِیْ فِیْكَ وَفِیْ وَلِیِّكَ یَا وَلِیَّ
segs.en: of my greatest desires and hopes from You and Your representative
segs.tr: AMALEE WA RA-JAAA-EE FEEKA WA FEE WALIYYEKA YAA WALIYYAL

segs.en: of the believers

segs.note: You may then throw yourself on the tomb, kiss it, and say the following words:
segs.ur: پھر آپ اپنے آپ کو قبر پر ڈال دیں، اسے چومیں اور درج ذیل الفاظ کہیں:

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَی الْحُسَیْنِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ الْمَظْلُوْمِ
segs.en: Peace be on Husayn son of Ali, the oppressed,
the martyr, the one slain (and wept over) with tears, and the captive of agonies.
segs.tr: SHAHEEDE QATEELIL A’BRAATE WA ASEERIL KOROBAATE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَشْهَدُ اَنَّهٗ وَلِیُّكَ وَابْنُ وَلِیِّكَ
segs.en: O Allah, I bear witness that he is Your representative and the son of Your representative
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE ASH-HADO ANNAHU WALIYYOKA WABNO WALIYYEKA

segs.en: and Your chosen one, the one who will take revenge by Your right, You have honoured him by Your nobility
segs.tr: WA SAFIYYOKAS SAA-ERO BE HAKKEKA AKRAMTAHU BE KARAAMATEKA

segs.ar: وَخَتَمْتَ لَهٗ بِالشَّهَادَۃِ وَجَعَلْتَهٗ سَیِّدًا مِنَ
segs.en: and have sealed his fate with martyrdom and have made him as a leader
segs.tr: WA KHATAMTA LAHU BISH SHA-HAADATE WA JA-A’LTAHU SAYYEDAN MENAS

segs.en: of the leaders and a guide of the guides and You have honoured him
segs.tr: SAADATE WA QAAEDAN MENAL QAADATE WA AKRAMTAHU

segs.en: with a pure lineage and granted him the inheritance of the Prophets
segs.tr: BE TEEBIL WELAADATE WA’ZAMTAHU MAWAAREESAL ANBEYAA-E

segs.en: and made him a proof over Your creation
segs.tr: WA JA-A’LTAHU HUJJATAN A’LAA KHALQEKA MENAL

segs.en: from the vicegerents. Then he fulfilled the right of calling (towards You) and offered
segs.tr: AWSEYAAA-E FA-AA’ZARA FID DO-AAA-E WA MANAHAN

segs.en: advice and laid down his life for You
segs.tr: NASEEHATA WA BAZALA MOH-JATAHU FEEKA HATTAS

segs.en: to the extent that he removed Your servants from ignorance and the perplexity of
segs.tr: TANQAZA E’BAADAKA MENAL JAHAALATE WA HAYRATIZ

segs.ar: الضَّلالَۃِ وَقَدْ تَوَازَرَ عَلَیْهِ مَنْ غَرَّتْهُ
segs.en: deviation. Then a group rose up against him who had been deceived
segs.tr: ZALAALATE WA QAD TAWAA-ZARA A’LAYHE MIN GHARRAT-HUD

segs.ar: الدُّنْیَا وَبَاعَ حَظَّهُ مِنَ الْاٰخِرَۃِ بِالْاَدْنیٰ
segs.en: by this world and had sold their share of the hereafter for a measly remuneration
segs.tr: DUNYAA WA BAA-A’ HAZZAHU MENAL AAKHERATE BIL AD-NAA

segs.en: and perished in their carnal desires and angered You and
segs.tr: WA TARADDAA FEE HOWAAHO WA AS-KHATAKA WA AS-KHATA

segs.ar: نَبِیِّكَ وَاَطَاعَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ اُولِی الشِّقَاقِ
segs.en: Your Prophet and obeyed from Your servants the people of discord,
segs.tr: NABIYYEKA WA A-TAA-A’ MIN E’BAADEKA OOLISH SHEQAAQE

segs.en: and hypocrisy and the committer of sins which makes them deserve
segs.tr: WAN NEFAAQE WA HAMALATAL AWZAARIL MUSTAWHEBEENAN

segs.en: Hell-fire. Then he fought against such people in Your way as a patient, expectant,
segs.tr: NAARA FA JAAHADAHUM FEEKA SAABERAN MOHTASEBAN

segs.ar: مُقْبِلًا غَیْرَ مُدْبِرٍ لَا تَاْخُذُهٗ فِیْ اﷲِ لَوْمَۃُ
segs.en: stepping forward and not turning back. The slandering of any maligner did not affect him in the
segs.tr: MUQBELAN GHAYRA MUDBERAN LAA TA-KHOZOHU FILLAAHE LAWMATO

segs.ar: لآئِمٍ حَتّٰی سُفِكَ فِیْ طَاعَتِكَ دَمُهٗ
segs.en: way of Allah till his blood was shed in Your way and
segs.tr: LAAA-EMIN HATTAA SOFEKA FEE TAA-A’TEKA DAMOHU

segs.ar: وَاسْتُبِیْحَ حَرِیْمُهُ اَللّٰهُمَّ الْعَنْهُمْ لَعْنًا وَبِیْلًا
segs.en: his sanctity was violated. O Allah! Curse them with a calamitous curse
segs.tr: WAS TOBEEHA HAREEMOHU ALLAAHUMMAL A’NHUM LA’NAN  WABEELAN

segs.en: and punish them with a painful punishment.

segs.note: You may then turn to ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.), who is buried to the side of Imam al-Husayn’s feet, and say the following words:
segs.ur: پھر آپ علی بن الحسین (ع) کی طرف جائیں جو امام حسین کے پائنتی کی جانب دفن ہیں، اور درج ذیل الفاظ کہیں:

segs.en: Peace be on you, O the representative of Allah.

segs.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا بْنَ رَسُوْلِ اﷲِ
segs.en: Peace be on you, O the son of the Apostle of Allah.
Peace be on you, O the son of the last of the Prophets.

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ فَاطِمَۃَ سَیَّدَۃِ نِسَآئِ الْعٰلَمِیْنَ
segs.en: Peace be on you, O the son of Fatemah, the leader of the women of the Universe.
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YABNA FAATEMATA SAYYEDATE NESAAA-IL A’ALAMEENA

segs.en: Peace be on you, O the son of the commander of the faithful.
Peace be on you, O the oppressed,

segs.ar: الشَّهِیْدُ بِاَبِیْ اَنْتَ وَاُمِّیْ عِشْتَ سِعِیْدًا
segs.en: the martyred May my father and my mother be sacrificed for you,
segs.tr: SHAHEEDO BE ABEE ANTA WA UMMEE ISHTA SA-E’EDAN

segs.en: you lived a very fortunate life and were killed as oppressed martyred.

segs.note: You may then turn to the tombs of the martyrs - may Allah’s pleasure be upon them - and say the following words:
segs.ur: پھر آپ شہداء کی قبور کی طرف جائیں - اللہ کی رضوان ان پر ہو - اور درج ذیل الفاظ کہیں:

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الذّٰابُونَ عَنْ تَوْحِیْدِ اﷲِ
segs.en: Peace be on you, O the defenders of the unity of Allah.
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA AYYOHAZ ZAABBOONA A’N TAWHEEDILLAAHE

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمْ بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ فَنِعْمَ عَقْبَی
segs.en: Peace be on you, for what you were patient upon, then you have the best
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKUM BEMAA SABARTUM FA NEA’MA AQBAD

segs.ar: الدَّارِ بِاَبِیْ اَنْتُمْ وَاُمِّیْ فُزْتُمْ فَوْزاً عَظِیْمًا
segs.en: abode in the hereafter. May my father and my mother be sacrificed for you, you have attained a great success.
segs.tr: DAARE BE ABEE ANTUM WA UMMEE FUZTUM FAWZAN A’ZEEMAN

segs.note: You may then walk to the shrine of al-’Abbas ibn ‘Ali, stop at his holy tomb, and say the following words:
segs.ur: پھر آپ عباس بن علی کے حرم کی طرف جا کر ان کی مقدس قبر کے پاس کھڑے ہوں اور درج ذیل الفاظ کہیں:

segs.en: Peace be on you, O the righteous servant
and the truthful one who shared (his life) in sacrifice.

segs.ar: اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ اَمَنْتَ بِاﷲِ وَنَصَرْتَ ابْنَ
segs.en: I bear witness that you believed in Allah and helped the son of
segs.tr: ASH-HADO ANNAKA AMANTA BILLAAHE WA NASARTABNA

segs.ar: رَسُوْلِ اﷲِ وَدَعَوْتَ اِلیٰ سَبِیْلِ اﷲِ
segs.en: the Apostle of Allah and you called towards the way of Allah
segs.tr: RASOOLILLAAHE WA DA-A’WTA ELAA SABEELILLAAHE WA

segs.ar: وَوَاسَیْتَ بِنَفْسِكَ عَلَیْكَ مِنَ اﷲِ اَفْضَلُ التَّحِیَّۃِ وَالسَّلَامِ
segs.en: and laid down your own  life, then upon you be the best of greetings and salutation from Allah.
segs.tr: WAA SAYTA BE NAFSEKA A’LAYKA MENALLAAHE AFZALUT TAHIYYATE WASSALAAME

segs.note: You may now throw yourself on the tomb and say the following words:
segs.ur: اب آپ قبر پر اپنے آپ کو گرا سکتے ہیں اور درج ذیل الفاظ کہہ سکتے ہیں:

segs.ar: بِاَبِیْ اَنْتَ وَاَمِّیْ یَا نَاصِرَ دِیْنِ اﷲِ
segs.en: May my father and my mother be sacrificed for you, O the helper of the religion of Allah.
segs.tr: BE ABEE ANTA WA UMMEE YAA NAASERA DEENILLAAHE

segs.en: Peace be on you, O the helper of Husayn, the truthful.
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA NAASERAL HUSAYNISH SIDDEEQE

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا نَاصِرَ الْحُسَیْنِ الشَّهِیْدِ
segs.en: Peace be on you, O the helper of Husayn, the martyr.
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA NAASERAL HUSAYNISH SHAHEEDE

segs.ar: عَلَیْكَ مِنِّیْ السَّلَامُ مَا بَقِیْتُ وَبَقِیَ اللَّیْلُ
segs.en: Peace be on you from me till the time I exist and the night and the
segs.tr: A’LAYKA MINNIS SALAAMO MAA BAQEETO WA BAQEYAL LAYLO

segs.en: day exist.

segs.note: You may then stand up to offer a two-unit prayer to the side of his head and then repeat the same words that you have said after offering a prayer at Imam al-Husayn’s shrine. These words begin:
segs.ur: پھر آپ ان کے سر مبارک کی جانب کھڑے ہو کر دو رکعت نماز پڑھیں اور پھر وہی الفاظ دہرائیں جو آپ نے امام حسین (ع) کے حرم میں نماز کے بعد کہے تھے۔ ان الفاظ کا آغاز یوں ہوتا ہے:

segs.en: O Allah! I prayed namaz….

segs.note: You may then return to the shrine of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) to reside there for any period you like. However, it is recommended not to appoint the holy shrine as one’s place of residence and spending the night there.
segs.ur: پھر آپ امام حسین (ع) کے حرم میں واپس جا کر جتنی مدت چاہیں وہاں ٹھہر سکتے ہیں۔ البتہ مستحب ہے کہ حرم مقدس کو اپنی رہائش گاہ نہ بنایا جائے اور وہاں رات نہ گزاری جائے۔

segs.note: If you intend to leave and bid farewell to the Imam (a.s.), you may stop at the side of the head and say the following words while weeping:
segs.ur: اگر آپ رخصت ہونا اور امام (ع) کو الوداع کہنا چاہیں تو سرہانے کی جانب کھڑے ہو کر روتے ہوئے درج ذیل کلمات کہہ سکتے ہیں:

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا مَوْلَایَ سَلَامَ مُوَدِّعٍ لَا
segs.en: Peace be on you, O my Master! This is the farewell salutation of the departing visitor,
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA MAWLAAYA SALAAMA MOWADDE-I’N LAA

segs.ar: قَالٍ وَلَا سَئِمٍ فَاِنْ اَنْصَرِفْ فَلَا عَنْ مَلَالَۃٍ
segs.en: neither due to lack of interest, nor on account of fatigue; and if I go back, it is not because of uneasiness; and
segs.tr: QAALIN WA LAA SA-EMIN FA-IN ANSARIF FALAA A’N MALAA-LATIN

segs.ar: وَاِنْ اُقِمْ فَلَا عَنْ سُوْٓئِ ظَنٍّ بِمَا وَعَدَ اﷲُ
segs.en: if I stay, it is not in view of the tempting persuasion which Allah has set forth for
segs.tr: WA IN OQIM FALAA A’N SOOO-E ZANNIN BEMAA WA-A’DALLAAHUS

segs.ar: الصَّابِرِیْنَ یَا مَوْلَایَ لَا جَعَلَهُ اﷲُ اٰخِرَ
segs.en: those who endure. O my Master, may Allah let not my this visit to you be the last one,
segs.tr: SAABEREENA YAA MAWLAAYA LAA JA-A’LAHULLAAHO AAKHERAL

segs.en: but enable me to come back here again and again,
segs.tr: A’HDE MINNEE LE ZEYAARATEKA WA RAZAQANIL A’WDA

segs.ar: اِلَیْكَ وَالْمَقَامَ فِیْ حَرَمِكَ وَالْكَوْنَ فِیْ
segs.en: visit your holy Haram and be near your resting
segs.tr: ELAYKA WAL MAQAAMA FEE HARAMEKA WAL KAWNA FEE

segs.en: abode. So let it be, O Lord of the worlds!

segs.note: You may then kiss the tomb and try to pass your entire body over it, because this tomb is security and protection. You may then leave it by walking backwards without giving your back to the tomb. You may say the following words:
segs.ur: پھر قبر کو بوسہ دیں اور اپنا پورا جسم اس پر سے گزارنے کی کوشش کریں، کیونکہ یہ قبر امان اور حفاظت ہے۔ پھر قبر کی طرف پیٹھ کیے بغیر الٹے پاؤں چلتے ہوئے وہاں سے نکلیں۔ یہ کلمات کہیں:

segs.en: Peace be on you, O the door of dignity.
Peace be on you, O the associate of Holy Quran.
Peace be on you, O the argument of Allah against the enemies.
Peace be on you, O the ark of salvation.

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمْ یَا مَلآئِكَۃَ رَبِّیْ الْمُقِیْمِیْنَ فِیْ هٰذَا الْحَرَمِ
segs.en: Peace be on you, O the angles of my Lord who reside in this sanctuary.
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKUM YAA MALAAA-EKATA RABBIL MOQEEMEENA FEE HAAZAL HARAME

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَبَدًا مَا بَقِیْتُ وَبَقِیَ اللَّیْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ
segs.en: Peace be on you always till I exist and the night and the day exist.
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA ABADAN MAA BAQEETO WA BAQEYAL LAYLO WAN NAHAARO

segs.note: You may also say the following words:
segs.ur: آپ درج ذیل الفاظ بھی کہہ سکتے ہیں:

segs.ar: اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَاِنَّا اِلَیْهِ رَاجِعُوْنَ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا
segs.en: To Allah we belong to Him shall we return. And there is no Power
segs.tr: INNAA LILLAAHE WA INNAA ELAYHE RAAJE-O’ONA WA LAA HAWLA

segs.en: no Strength except with Allah, the exalted, the great.
segs.tr: WA LAA QUWWATA ILLAA BILLAAHIL A’LIYYIL A’ZEEME

segs.note: You may then leave.
segs.ur: پھر روانہ ہو جائیں۔

A_AC3.merits:
It is worth mentioning that scholars have dedicated two forms of ziyarah to these two blessed feast days (i.e. ‘Id al-Fitr and ‘Id al-Azha). The first form has been cited as the ziyarah form at the Qadr Nights, while the other is this one. What is apparently understood from the words of the scholars is that the first form of ziyarah is said when one visits the holy shrine on the two days of ‘Id al-Fitr and ‘Id al-Azha, while this form is said when the holy shrine is visited at the two nights before these two days.

According to a validly reported tradition on the authority of a valid chain of authority, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) has said, “Whoever visits the tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) at one of the following three nights, will have all his sins forgiven by Almighty Allah, including the past and the coming: the night before ‘Id al-Fitr Day, the night before ‘Id al-Azha Day, and the mid-Sha’ban night.”

According to another validly reported tradition, Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (al-Kazim) (a.s.) has said, “Whoever visits (Imam) al-Husayn (a.s.) at these three nights, will have all his sins forgiven by Almighty Allah, both the past and the coming: the mid-Sha’ban night, the twenty-third night of Ramazan, and the ‘Id al-Fitr night.”

Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) is reported to have said, “If one visits al-Husayn ibn ‘Ali at the mid-Sha’ban night, the ‘Id al-Fitr night, and the ‘Arafat night in the same year, Almighty Allah will record for him the reward of one thousand times of admissible hajj and one thousand times of acceptable ‘umrah and will grant him one thousand requests for this world and the Hereafter.”

Imam al-Baqir (a.s.) is reported to have said, “Whoever spends the ‘Arafat Night in the land of Karbala’ and resides to spend the ‘Arafat Day there and then leaves, Almighty Allah shall save him from the evils of that year.”

Sayyid Ibn Tawus and Muhammad ibn al-Mashhadi said, “If you do all these devotional acts (correctly), you will be as if you have visited Almighty Allah in His Divine Throne.”

A_AC5.name: First Ten Days of Dhul Hijjah

segs.note: Salaat between Maghrib and Isha
segs.ur: مغرب اور عشاء کے درمیان کی نماز

segs.note: On each of these ten nights, it is recommended to offer the two-unit Wa Wa'adna Prayer between the Maghrib and Isha prayers.
segs.ur: ان دس راتوں میں سے ہر رات مغرب اور عشاء کی نمازوں کے درمیان دو رکعت [نماز و واعدنا](AC6) پڑھنا مستحب ہے۔

segs.note: Dua after Fajr and before Maghrib
segs.ur: فجر کے بعد اور مغرب سے پہلے کی دعا

segs.note: It is recommended to say the following supplicatory prayer, which is reported by Shaykh al-Tusi and Sayyid Ibn Tawus from Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s.), after the obligatory Fajr and Maghrib Prayers since the first day of Zilhajj and up to the eve of the ‘Arafat Night, the ninth of Zilhajj:
segs.ur: مستحب ہے کہ درج ذیل دعا جسے شیخ طوسی اور سید ابن طاؤس نے امام جعفر صادق (ع) سے روایت کیا ہے، ذی الحجہ کے پہلے دن سے شب عرفہ کی شام تک، یعنی ذی الحجہ کی نویں تاریخ تک، واجب نماز فجر اور مغرب کے بعد پڑھی جائے:

segs.en: O Allah, these days that
You have preferred and favored on other days,
You have allowed me to attain them out of Your favor and mercy;
so, (please) descend on us Your blessings
and expand for us Your boons.
segs.tr: WA AW-SEA' A'LAYNAA FEEHAA MIN NA'MAAA-EKA

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْۤ اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, I beseech you to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA AN TOSALLEYA A'LAA MOHAMMADIWN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: and to guide us on these days to the path of guidance,
segs.tr: WA AN TAHDEYANAA FEEHAA LESABEELIL HODAA

segs.en: chastity, sufficiency,
and doing that which You like and please.
segs.tr: WAL A'MALE FEEHAA BEMAA TOHIBBO WA TARZAA

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْۤ اَسْاَلُكَ يَا مَوْضِعَ كُلِّ شَكْوٰى
segs.en: O Allah, I beseech You, O object of all complaints,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA YAA MAWZE-A' KULLE SHAKWAA

segs.en: O Hearer of all confidential talks,
O Attendant in all sessions,
O Knower of all hidden matters,

segs.ar: اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: AN TOSALLEYA A'LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: relieve us from all hardships on these days,
segs.tr: WA AN TAKSHEFA A'NNAA FEEHAL BALAAA-A

segs.en: respond to our prayers,
grant us power, aid us,

segs.ar: وَتُوَفِّقَنَا فِيْهَا لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضٰى
segs.en: and lead us successfully to all that which You,
segs.tr: WA TOWAFFEQANAA FEEHAA LEMAA TOHIBBO RABBANAA WA TARZAA

segs.en: O our Lord, like and please and to do acts of
obedience to You that which You have made obligatory upon us as well as acts of obedience to Your Messenger
and to the men of Your leadership.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْۤ اَسْاَلُكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
segs.en: O Allah, I beseech You, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOK YAA ARHAMAR RAAHEMEENA

segs.ar: اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: AN TOSALLEYA A'LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: and grant us [Your] pleasure on these days.
segs.tr: WA AN TAHABA LANAA FEEHAR REZAA

segs.en: You are verily Hearer of prayers.

segs.ar: وَلَا تَحْرِمْنَا خَيْرَ مَا تُنْزِلُ فِيْهَا مِنَ السَّمَاۤءِ
segs.en: Do not deprive us of the good that You cause to come down from the heavens on these days,
segs.tr: WA LAA TAHRIMNAA KHAYRA MAA TUNZELO FEEHAA MENAS SAMAAA-E

segs.en: purify us from sins,
O Knower of all unseen things,
and make certain for us the abode of immortality.
segs.tr: WA AWJIB LANAA FEEHAA DAARAL KHOLOODE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A'LAA MOHAMMAHDINW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.ar: وَلَا تَتْرُكْ لَنَا فِيْهَا ذَنْبًا اِلَّا غَفَرْتَهٗ
segs.en: and do not leave for us a sin but that You forgive it,
segs.tr: WA LAA TATRUK LANAA FEEHAA ZANBAN ILLAA GHAFARTAHU

segs.en: no depression but that You relieve it,
no debt but that You help us settle it,
no absent but that You make join us,

segs.ar: وَلَا حَاجَةً مِنْ حَوَاۤئِجِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ
segs.en: and no need in this world and the Next World
segs.tr: WA LAA HAAJATAN MIN HAWAA-EJID DUNYAA WAL AAAKHERATE

segs.en: but that You make it easy and obtainable.
You, verily, have power over all things.
O Allah! O Knower of all hidden things!

segs.ar: يَا رَاحِمَ الْعَبَرَاتِ يَا مُجِيْبَ الدَّعَوَاتِ
segs.en: O Merciful of all tears! O Answerer of all prayers!
segs.tr: YAA RAAHEMAL A'BARAATE YAA MOJEEBAD DA'WAATE

segs.en: O Lord of the [layers of the] earth and the heavens!

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ لَا تَتَشَابَهٗ عَلَيْهِ الْاَصْوَاتُ
segs.en: O He Who is not confused by various sounds!
segs.tr: YAA MAN LAA TATASHAABAHU A'LAYHIL ASWAATO

segs.en: (Please) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: SALLE A'LAA MOHAMMADIWN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: and include us, on these days, with those whom You release
and discharge from Hellfire,
those whom You make win Your Paradise, and those whom You save,
out of Your mercy. O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!

segs.ar: وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِهٖ اَجْمَعِيْنَ
segs.en: Allah may send blessings to our master, Muhammad, and to his entire Household.
segs.tr: WA SALLAL LAAHO A'LAA SAYYEDENA MOHAMMADINW WA AALEHI AJMA-E'ENA.

segs.note: Five Tasbeeh
segs.ur: پانچ تسبیحات

segs.note: It is recommended to say the following five testaments on the first ten days of Zilhajj:
segs.ur: مستحب ہے کہ ذی الحجہ کے پہلے دس دنوں میں درج ذیل پانچ وصیتیں پڑھی جائیں:

segs.ar: (1) اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ
segs.en: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah, alone without having any partner.
segs.tr: ASH-HADO AN LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO WAHDAHU LAA SHAREEKA LAHU

segs.ar: لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ
segs.en: His is the kingdom and His is all praise. In His Hand is all goodness,
segs.tr: LAHUL MULKO WA LAHUL HAMDO BEYADEHIL KHAYRO

segs.en: and He has power over all things.
segs.tr: WA HOWA A'LAA KULLE SHAY-IN QADEERUN.

segs.ar: (2) اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ
segs.en: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah, alone without having any partner.
segs.tr: ASH-HADO AN LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO WAHDAHU LAA SHAREEKA LAHU

segs.ar: اَحَدًا صَمَدًا لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ صَاحِبَةً وَّلَا وَلَدًا
segs.en: One and Only and Besought of all. He has not taken to Himself wife nor son.
segs.tr: AHADAN SAMADAN LAM YATTAKHIZ SAAHEBATAN WA LAA WALADAN.

segs.ar: (3) اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ
segs.en: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah, alone without having any partner,
segs.tr: ASH-HADO AN LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO WAHDAHU LAA SHAREEKA LAHU

segs.ar: اَحَدًا صَمَدًا لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُوْلَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهٗ كُفُوًا اَحَدٌ
segs.en: One and Only and Besought of all. He begets not, nor is He begotten, and there is none comparable to Him.
segs.tr: AHADAN SAMADAN LAM YALID WA LAM YOOLAD WA LAM YAKUN LAHU KOFOWAN AHADUN.

segs.ar: (4) اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ
segs.en: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah, alone without having any partner.
segs.tr: ASH-HADO AN LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO WAHDAHU LAA SHAREEKA LAHU

segs.ar: لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِيْ وَيُمِيْتُ
segs.en: His is the kingdom and His is all praise. He brings to life and causes to die,
segs.tr: LAHUL MULKO WA LAHUL HAMDO YOHYEE WA YOMEETO

segs.ar: وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوْتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
segs.en: and He is Ever-living and never dies. In His Hand is all goodness and He has power over all things.
segs.tr: WA HOWA HAYYUN LAA YAMOOTO BEYADEHIL KHAYRO WA HOWA A'LAA KULLE SHAY-IN QADEERUN.

segs.ar: (5) حَسْبِيَ اللّٰهُ وَكَفٰى سَمِعَ اللّٰهُ لِمَنْ دَعَا
segs.en: Sufficient to me is Allah and nothing else. May Allah listen from him who prays to Him.
segs.tr: HASBEYAL LAAHO WA KAFAA SAME-A'L LAAHO LEMAN DA-A'A

segs.ar: لَيْسَ وَرَاۤءَ اللّٰهِ مُنْتَهٰى اَشْهَدُ لِلّٰهِ بِمَا دَعَا
segs.en: There is no end beyond Allah. I bear witness to Allah for all that He has declared,
segs.tr: LAYSA WARAAA-AL LAAHE MUNTAHAA ASH-HADO LILLAAHE BEMAA DA-A'AA

segs.ar: وَاَنَّهٗ بَرِيْۤ‏ءٌ مِمَّنْ تَبَرَّاَ وَاَنَّ لِلّٰهِ الْاٰخِرَةَ وَالْاُوْلٰى.
segs.en: He is clear of all that from which He has declared clearness, and Allah’s is the end and the beginning of all things.
segs.tr: WA ANNAHU BAREE-UN MIMMAN TABARRA-A WA ANNA LILLAAHIL AAKHERATO WAL OOLAA.

segs.note: Archangel Gabriel has conveyed these five testaments as gift of Almighty Allah to Prophet Jesus (a.s.) and instructed him to say them on the first ten days of Zilhajj.
segs.ur: جبرائیل (ع) نے یہ پانچ وصیتیں اللہ تعالیٰ کی طرف سے تحفے کے طور پر حضرت عیسیٰ (ع) تک پہنچائیں اور انہیں حکم دیا کہ انہیں ذی الحجہ کے پہلے دس دنوں میں پڑھیں.

segs.note: An excellent reward has been mentioned to be for whoever repeats these five statements one hundred times each day. However, ‘Allamah al-Majlisi (r.a.) says that it is not improbable that each of these five testaments is repeated ten times each day. Yet, to repeat them one hundred times is better.
segs.ur: جو شخص ان پانچ جملوں کو ہر روز سو مرتبہ دہرائے اس کے لیے بہترین اجر ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔ تاہم علامہ مجلسی (رح) فرماتے ہیں کہ یہ بعید نہیں کہ ان پانچوں وصیتوں میں سے ہر ایک روزانہ دس مرتبہ دہرائی جائے۔ پھر بھی سو مرتبہ دہرانا بہتر ہے۔

segs.note: Tahlilat (Hymns of God's Unity)
segs.ur: تہلیلات (توحیدِ الٰہی کے کلمات)

segs.note: It is recommended to say the following doxology (zikr), which is reported from Imam Ali Ameer al-Momineen (a.s.), on the first ten days of Zilhajj. An excellent reward has been reported for those saying this doxology (zikr), which should preferably be repeated ten times a day:
segs.ur: مستحب ہے کہ امام علی امیرالمومنین (ع) سے منقول درج ذیل ذکر ذی الحجہ کے پہلے دس دنوں میں پڑھا جائے۔ اس ذکر کے پڑھنے والوں کے لیے بہترین ثواب نقل ہوا ہے، اور بہتر ہے کہ اسے دن میں دس مرتبہ دہرایا جائے:

segs.ar: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ عَدَدَ اللَّيَالِيْ وَالدُّهُوْرِ
segs.en: There is no god save Allah as many as nights and ages.
segs.tr: LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO A'DADAL LAYAALEE WAD DOHOORE

segs.ar: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ عَدَدَ اَمْوَاجِ الْبُحُوْرِ
segs.en: There is no god save Allah as many as the waves of oceans.
segs.tr: LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO A'DADA AMWAAJIL BOHOORE

segs.ar: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَرَحْمَتُهٗ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا يَجْمَعُوْنَ
segs.en: There is no god save Allah and His mercy is better than what they amass.
segs.tr: LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO WA RAHMATOHU KHAYRUN MIMMAA YAJ-MA-O'ONA

segs.ar: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ عَدَدَ الشَّوْكِ وَالشَّجَرِ
segs.en: There is no god save Allah as many as thorns and trees.
segs.tr: LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO A'DADASH SHAWKE WASH SHAJARE

segs.ar: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ عَدَدَ الشَّعْرِ وَالْوَبَرِ
segs.en: There is no god save Allah as many as hairs and piles.
segs.tr: LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO A'DADASH SHA’RE WAL WABARE

segs.ar: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ عَدَدَ الْحَجَرِ وَالْمَدَرِ
segs.en: There is no god save Allah as many as stones and loams.
segs.tr: LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO A'DADAL HAJARE WAL MADARE

segs.ar: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ عَدَدَ لَمْحِ الْعُيُوْنِ
segs.en: There is no god save Allah as many as sights of eyes.
segs.tr: LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO A'DADA LAMHIL O'YOONE

segs.ar: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ فِي اللَّيْلِ اِذَا عَسْعَسَ وَالصُّبْحِ اِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
segs.en: There is no god save Allah in the night when it departs and in the morning when it brightens.
segs.tr: LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO FIL LAYLE EZAA A'S-A'SA WA FISH SUBHE EZAA TANAFFASA

segs.ar: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ عَدَدَ الرِّيَاحِ فِي الْبَرَارِيْ وَالصُّخُوْرِ
segs.en: There is no god save Allah as much as wind in lands and rocks.
segs.tr: LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO A'DADAR REYAAHE FIL BARAAREE WAS-SOKHOORE

segs.ar: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ مِنَ الْيَوْمِ اِلٰى يَوْمِ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّوْرِ.
segs.en: There is no god save Allah from this day up to the day when the Trumpet will be blown.
segs.tr: LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO MENAL YAWME ELAA YAWMIN YUNFAKHO FIS SOORE.

A_AC5.merits:
Introduction
In the blessed month of Zilhajj, the pious companions of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) and their followers used to do acts of worship extraordinarily. The first ten days of this month are called al-ayyam al-ma’lumat (The Stated Days) by the Holy Qur’an.
About these highly honorable days, the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) is reported to have said that nothing is more preferable to Almighty Allah than practicing acts of worship on these ten stated days.
It is recommended to observe fasting on the first nine days of Zilhajj, for it is equal to the fasting of one’s whole lifetime.
The 8th Day Of Zilhajj is called the Tarwiyah Day. To observe fasting on this day brings about a great reward. According to a narration, it erases the sins of sixty years. Shaykh al-Shahid (the martyr) has said that it is recommended to bathe oneself on this day.

A_AC6.name: Salat of وَ وَاعَدْنَا

segs.note: On each of the first ten nights of Dhul Hijjah, between the Maghrib and Isha prayers, offer a prayer of two units.
In each unit, recite Surah al-Fatihah once, Surah al-Tawheed once, and this verse of Surah al-A'raf (7:142):

segs.ar: وَوٰعَدْنَا مُوْسٰى ثَلٰثِيْنَ لَيْلَةً وَّاَتْمَمْنٰهَا بِعَشْرٍ فَتَمَّ مِيْقَاتُ رَبِّهٖۤ اَرْبَعِيْنَ لَيْلَةً  ۚ
segs.en: And We appointed with Moses a time of thirty nights and completed them with ten more, so the appointed time of his Lord was complete forty nights,
segs.tr: WA WAA'ADNAA MOOSAA THALAATHEENA LAYLATAN WA ATMAMNAAHAA BI-A'SHRIN FATAMMA MEEQAATU RABBIHEE ARBA'EENA LAYLAH

segs.ar: وَقَالَ مُوْسٰى لِاَخِيْهِ هٰرُوْنَ اخْلُفْنِىْ فِىْ قَوْمِىْ وَاَصْلِحْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ سَبِيْلَ الْمُفْسِدِيْنَ‏(142)
