segs.en: and Moses said to his brother Aaron: Take my place among my people, and act well and do not follow the way of the mischief-makers.
segs.tr: WA QAALA MOOSAA LI-AKHEEHI HAAROONAKH LUFNEE FEE QAWMEE WA ASLIH WA LAA TATTABI' SABEELAL MUFSIDEEN

segs.note: It is also recommended to fast the first nine days of Dhul Hijjah.
For the other acts of these ten days, see First Ten Days of Dhul Hijjah.

A_AC6.merits: The reward of offering this prayer is to participate in the rewards of those who go on Hajj.

A_AC7.name: 1st Day of Dhul Hijjah

segs.note: Fast and Salat Faatemah
segs.ur: روزہ اور نمازِ فاطمہ

segs.note: Fast on this day.
segs.ur: اس دن روزہ رکھیں۔

segs.note: Offer Salat Faatemah: four units, each pair offered separately. In each unit, recite Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Tawheed 50 times.
segs.ur: نمازِ فاطمہ پڑھیں: چار رکعت، ہر دو رکعت الگ الگ۔ ہر رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) 50 مرتبہ پڑھیں۔

segs.note: After the Tasleem, do the famous Tasbeeh al-Zahra litany, then say this doxology (zikr):
segs.ur: سلام کے بعد مشہور [تسبیح حضرت زہرا (س)](I9) پڑھیں، پھر یہ ذکر کہیں:

segs.en: Glory be to the Lord of Honor and Sublime Authority.
Glory be to the Lord of Majesty and Exalted Greatness.
Glory be to the Lord of eternal, splendid sovereignty.

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ يَرٰى اَثَرَ النَّمْلَةِ فِيْ الصَّفَا
segs.en: Glory be to Him Who makes out the footprints of the ant on the stone.
segs.tr: SUBHAANA MAN YARAA ASARAN NAMLATE FIS SAFAA

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ يَرٰى وَقْعَ الطَّيْرِ فِىْ الْهَوَاۤءِ
segs.en: Glory be to Him Who knows the exact time and place of the bird dipping down through the air.
segs.tr: SUBHAANA MAN YARAA WAQ-A'T TAYRE FIL HAWAAA-E

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ هٰكَذَا وَلَا هٰكَذَا غَيْرُهٗ
segs.en: Glory be to Him Who is like this and no one other than Him is like this.
segs.tr: SUBHAANA MAN HOWA HAAKAZAA WA LAA HAAKAZAA GHAYROHU.

segs.note: Prayer before Zuhr
segs.ur: نماز ظہر سے پہلے کی نماز

segs.note: Half an hour before midday (Zuhr), offer a two-unit prayer. In each unit, recite Surah al-Faatehah once, then Surah al-Tawheed, Ayat al-Kursi and Surah al-Qadr ten times each.
segs.ur: ظہر سے آدھا گھنٹہ پہلے دو رکعت نماز پڑھیں۔ ہر رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک بار پڑھیں، پھر [سورہ توحید](A116)، [آیت الکرسی](A4) اور [سورہ قدر](A101) ہر ایک دس مرتبہ پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Protection from an Oppressor
segs.ur: ظالم سے حفاظت

segs.note: If you fear an oppressor, say:
segs.ur: اگر آپ کو کسی ظالم کا خوف ہو تو کہیں:

segs.ar: حَسْبِيْ حَسْبِيْ حَسْبِيْ مِنْ سُؤَالِيْ عِلْمُكَ بِحَالِيْ
segs.en: Sufficient for me, sufficient for me, sufficient for me regarding my asking is Your knowledge of my condition.
segs.tr: HASBEE HASBEE HASBEE MIN SO-AALEE I'LMOKA BEHAALEE.

A_AC7.merits:
Fasting: It is recommended to observe fasting on this day, for its reward is equal to the reward of eighty months worship.

Salat Faatemah: According to Shaykh al-Tusi, this prayer consists of four units each couple of which are offered separately.

Protection from an oppressor: One who fears an oppressor and says these words on this day will be saved, by Almighty Allah.

On this day, Prophet Abraham (a.s.) was born. On this day too, yet according to the narration of the two Shaykhs, Imam Ali Ameer al-Moameneen (a.s.) married Lady Fatimah al-Zahra (a.s.).

A_AC10.name: Aamal of the Night of Arafah

segs.note: Dua Allahumma Ya Shahida Kulli Najwa
segs.ur: دعا اللهم یا شاہد کل نجویٰ

segs.note: On the night of Arafah, or on any Friday night, recite:
segs.ur: شب عرفہ، یا کسی بھی شب جمعہ، پڑھیں:

segs.en: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
O Allah Who witnesses all secrets of hearts,
Who is the object of all complaints,
Who knows all hidden things,
and Who is the aim of all needs!
O He Who instigates favoring on the Servants!
O He Who is All-generous in pardoning!
O He Who is All-excellent in overlooking!

segs.ar: یَا جَوَادُ یَا مَنْ لَا یُوَارِىْ مِنْهُ لَیْلٌ دَاجٍ
segs.en: O All-magnanimous! O He Who cannot be concealed by the covering darkness of night,
segs.tr: YAA JAWAADO YAA MAN LAA YOWAAREE MINHO LAYLUN DAAJIN

segs.ar: وَلَا بَحْرٌ عَجَّاجٌ وَلَا سَمَآءٌ ذَاتُ اَبْرَاجٍ
segs.en: the roaring clamor of oceans, the skies along with their constellations,
segs.tr: WA LAA BAHRUN A’JJAAJUN WA LAA SAMAAA-UN ZAATO ABRAAJIN

segs.en: or the thunderous murk.
O He with Whom the entire murk is light,
I beseech You in the name of the brightness of Your Noble Face

segs.ar: الَّذِيْ تَجَلَّیْتَ بِہٖ لِلْجَبَلِ فَجَعَلْتَہٗ دَکًّا
segs.en: through which You manifested Your glory to the mountain; so, You made it crumble
segs.tr: LAZEE TAJALLAYTA BEHI LIL-JABALE FA-JA-A’LTAHU DAKKAA

segs.en: and (Prophet) Moses fell down in a swoon,

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِیْ رَفَعْتَ بِهِ السَّمٰوٰتِ بِلَا عَمَدٍ
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which You raised the heavens without any pillars
segs.tr: WA BISMEKAL LAZEE RA-FA’TA BEHIS SAMAAWAATE BELAA A’MADIN

segs.ar: وَسَطَحْتَ بِهِ الْاَرْضَ عَلٰی وَجْهِ مَآءٍ جَمَدٍ
segs.en: and by which You flattened the earth on the surface of solid water,
segs.tr: WA SATAHTA BEHIL ARZA A’LAA WAJHE MAAA-IN JAMADIN

segs.en: in the name of Your Name—the concealed, the stored,
the scribed, and the pure, which
You answer any one who beseeches You
in its name and grant any one who asks You his request,
in the name of Your Name; the Praised, Holy,

segs.ar: الْبُرْهَانِ الَّذِیْ هُوَ نُوْرٌ عَلٰی كُلِّ نُوْرٍ
segs.en: and Demonstrative, which is light over the entire light,
segs.tr: BURHAANIL LAZEE HOWA NOORUN A’LAA KULLE NOORINW

segs.ar: وَّنُوْرٌ مِنْ نُوْرٍ یُضِیْءُ مِنْهُ كُلُّ نُوْرٍ
segs.en: which is light made of light, and from which all lights take their brightness;
segs.tr: WA NOORUN MIN NOORIN YOZEE-O MINHO KULLO NOORIN

segs.en: if it reaches the earth, it will be rent asunder,
if it reaches the heavens, they will be opened,
and if it reaches the throne, it will quiver;

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِیْ تَرْتَعِدُ مِنْهُ فَرَائِصُ مَلٰٓئِكَتِكَ
segs.en: and in the name of Your Name from the fear of which the muscles of Your angels tremble.
segs.tr: WA BISMEKAL LAZEE TARTA-E’DO MINHO FARAA-ESO MALAA-EKATEKA

segs.en: I beseech You in the name of [Archangels] Gabriel, Michael, and Seraph,
segs.tr: WA AS-ALOKA BE-HAQQE JABRA-EELA WA MEEKAA-EELA WA ISRAAFEELA

segs.en: in the name of Muhammad, the Divinely-chosen Prophet,
peace be upon him, his Household,
and all prophets and angels;
segs.tr: WA A’LAA JAMEE-I’L AMBEYAA-E WA JAMEE-I’L MALAA-EKATE

segs.ar: وَبِالْاِسْمِ الَّذِیْ مَشٰی بِهِ الْخَضِرُ عَلٰی قُلَلِ الْمَآءِ
segs.en: in the name of the Name through which al-Khizr could walk on waters
segs.tr: WA BIL-ISLMIL LAZEE MASHAA BEHIL KHAZERO A’LAA QOLALIL MAAA-E

segs.ar: كَمَا مَشٰی بِہٖ عَلٰی جُدَدِ الْاَرْضِ
segs.en: just as he used to walk on lands;
segs.tr: KAMAA MASHAA BEHI A’LAA JODADIL ARZE

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِیْ فَلَقْتَ بِهِ الْبَحْرَ لِمُوْسٰی
segs.en: in the name of You Name through which You caused the sea to cleave asunder for Moses,
segs.tr: WA BISMEKAL LAZEE FALAQTA BEHIL BAHRA LE-MOOSAA

segs.en: You drowned Pharaoh and his people,

segs.ar: وَاَنْجَیْتَ بِہٖ مُوْسَی بْنَ عِمْرَانَ وَمَنْ مَعَهٗ
segs.en: and saved Moses, the son of Imran, and those who accompanied him;
segs.tr: WA ANJAYTA BEHI MOOSAB NA I’MRAANA WA MAN MA-A’HU

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِیْ دَعَاكَ بِہٖ مُوْسَی بْنَ عِمْرَانَ
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which Moses, the son of Imran,
segs.tr: WA BISMEKAL LAZEE DA-A’AKA BEHI MOOSAB NA I’MRAANA

segs.en: besought You from the right slope of the Mount;

segs.ar: فَاسْتَجَبْتَ لَہٗ وَاَلْقَیْتَ عَلَیْهِ مَحَبَّۃً مِنْكَ
segs.en: so, You responded to him and cast down upon him love from You;
segs.tr: FAS-TAJABTA LAHU WA ALQAYTA A’LAYHE MAHABBATAN MINKA

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِیْ بِہٖ اَحْیٰی عِیْسَی بْنُ مَرْیَمَ الْمَوْتٰی
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which Jesus, the son of Mary, brought life to the dead,
segs.tr: WA BISMEKAL LAZEE BEHI AHYAA E’ESAB NO MARYAMAL MAWTAA

segs.en: could speak while he was a child in the cradle,
and healed the blind and the leprous by Your permission;
segs.tr: WA ABRA-AL AKMAHA WAL ABRASA BE-IZNEKA

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِیْ دَعَاكَ بِہٖ حَمَلَۃُ عَرْشِكَ
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which the bearers of Your Throne besought You
segs.tr: WA BISMEKAL LAZEE DA-A’AKA BEHI HAMALATO A’RSHEKA

segs.en: and so did Gabriel, Michael, Seraph,
segs.tr: WA JABRA-EELO WA MEEKAA-EELO WA ISRAAFEELO

segs.ar: وَحَبِیْبُكَ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّی اللهُ عَلَیْهِ وَاٰلِہٖ
segs.en: Muhammad Your most beloved one (peace be upon him and upon his Household),
segs.tr: WA HABEEBOKA MOHAMMADUN SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI

segs.en: Your favorite angels, Your messaged Prophets,
segs.tr: WA MALAA-EKATOKAL MOQARRABOONA WA AMBEYAAA-OKAL MURSALOONA

segs.ar: وَعِبَادُكَ الصَّالِحُوْنَ مِنْ اَهْلِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرَضِیْنَ
segs.en: and Your righteous servants from among the inhabitants of the heavens and the layers of the earth;
segs.tr: WA E’BAADOKAS SAALEHOONA MIN AHLIS SAMAAWAATE WAL ARAZEENA

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِی دَعَاكَ بِہٖ ذُو النُّوْنِ
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which Zu’l-Nun (Prophet Jonah) besought You
segs.tr: WA BISMEKAL LAZEE DA-A’AKA BEHI ZOON NOONE

segs.ar: اِذْ ذَهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا فَظَنَّ اَنْ لَنْ نَقْدِرَ عَلَیْهِ
segs.en: when he departed in wrath: he imagined that You had no power over him,
segs.tr: IZ ZAHABA MOGHAAZEBAN FAZANNA AN LAN NAQDERA A’LAYHE

segs.ar: فَنَادٰی فِی الظُّلُمَاتِ اَنْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ
segs.en: but he cried through the depths of darkness, “There is no god but You.
segs.tr: FA-NAADAA FIZ ZOLOMAATE AN LAA ELAAHA ILLAA ANTA

segs.en: Glory be to You. I was indeed one of those who are wrong!”
So, You responded to him and delivered him from the grief
segs.tr: FASTAJABTA LAHU WA NAJJAYTAHU MENAL GHAMME

segs.en: and thus do You deliver the believers;

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِیْمِ الَّذِیْ دَعَاكَ بِہٖ دَاوٗدُ
segs.en: in the name of Your Great Name by which David besought You
segs.tr: WA BISMEKAL A’ZEEMIL LAZEE DA-A’AKA BEHI DA-WOODA

segs.ar: وَخَرَّ لَكَ سَاجِدًا فَغَفَرْتَ لَہٗ ذَنْبَہٗ
segs.en: and fell down prostrating himself to You, so You forgave him his sin;
segs.tr: WA KHARRA LAKA SAAJEDAN FAHGAFARTA LAHU ZANBAHU

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِیْ دَعَتْكَ بِہٖ اٰسِیَۃُ امْرَاَۃُ فِرْعَوْنَ
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which Aasiyah, the wife of Pharaoh, besought You,
segs.tr: WA BISMEKAL LAZEE DA-A’TKA BEHI AASEYATUM RA-ATO FIR-A’WNA

segs.ar: اِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ابْنِ لِیْ عِنْدَكَ بَیْتًا فِی الْجَنَّۃِ
segs.en: saying, “My Lord! Build for me a house with You in Paradise,
segs.tr: IZ QAALAT RABBIB NE LEE I’NDAKA BAYTAN FIL JANNATE

segs.en: deliver me from Pharaoh and his doing,
segs.tr: WA NAJJENEE MIN FIR-A’WNA WA A’MALEHI

segs.en: and deliver me from the unjust people.”
So, You responded to her prayer;
in the name of Your Name by which (Prophet) Job
segs.tr: WA BISMEKAL LAZEE DA-A’AKA BEHI AYYOOBO

segs.en: besought You after misfortune had befallen him;
so, You healed him and gave him his family and the like of them with them:
segs.tr: WA AATAYTAHU AHLAHU WA MISLAHUM MA-A’HUM

segs.en: a mercy from You and a reminder to the worshippers;
segs.tr: RAHMATAM MIN I’NDEKA WA ZIKRAA LIL-A’ABEDEENA

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِیْ دَعَاكَ بِہٖ یَعْقُوْبُ فَرَدَدْتَ عَلَیْهِ بَصَرَہٗ
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which (Prophet) Jacob besought You; so, You returned to him his sight
segs.tr: WA BISMEKAL LAZEE DA-A’AKA BEHI YA’QOOBO FA-RADADTA A’LAYHE BASARAHU

segs.en: and the delight of his heart, Joseph, and You reunified him;
segs.tr: WA QURRATA A’YNEHI YOOSOFA WA JA-MA’TA SHAMLAHU

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِیْ دَعَاكَ بِہٖ سُلَیْمَانُ فَوَهَبْتَ لَہٗ مُلْکًا
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which (Prophet) Solomon besought You; so, You gifted him kingdom
segs.tr: WA BISMEKAL LAZEE DA-A’AKA BEHI SOLAYMAANO FA-WAHABTA LAHU MULKAL

segs.en: that none else should never gain,
for You are verily the Granter of bounties;

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِیْ سَخَّرْتَ بِهِ الْبُرَاقَ لِمُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which You subdued the Buraq to Muhammad,
segs.tr: WA BISMEKAL LAZEE SAKHKHARTA BEHIL BORAAQA LE-MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: peace and blessings be upon him and his Household,
segs.tr: SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHE WAA LAAHI WA SALLAAMA

segs.ar: اِذْ قَالَ تَعَالٰی سُبْحَانَ الَّذِیْ اَسْرٰی بِعَبْدِہٖ
segs.en: as Almighty Allah says, “Glory be to Him Who made His servant
segs.tr: IZ QAALA TA-A’ALAA SUBHAANAL LAZEE ASRAA BE-A’BDEHI

segs.ar: لَیْلًا مِّنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ اِلَی الْمَسْجِدِ الْاَقْصٰی
segs.en: to go on a night from the Sacred Mosque to the remote mosque.”
segs.tr: LAYLAM MENAL MASJEDIL HARAAME ELAL MASJEDIL AQSAA

segs.ar: وَقَوْلُہٗ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِیْ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا
segs.en: He also says, “Glory be to Him Who made this subservient to us
segs.tr: WA QAWLOHU SUBHAANAL LAZEE SAKHKHARA LANAA HAAZAA

segs.ar: وَمَا كُنَّا لَہٗ مُقْرِنِیْنَ وَاِنَّا اِلٰی رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُوْنَ
segs.en: and we were not able to do it. Surely, to our Lord we must return;”
segs.tr: WA MAA KUNNA LAHU MUKRENEENA WA INNAA ELAA RABBENAA LA-MUNQALEBOONA

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِیْ تَنَزَّلَ بِہٖ جَبْرَئِیْلُ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which (Archangel) Jibraeel descended upon Muhammad,
segs.tr: WA BISMEKAL LAZEE TANAZZALA BEHI JABRA-EELO A’LAA MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: peace be upon him and his Household;
and in the name of Your Name by which Adam besought You;
segs.tr: WA BISMEKAL LAZEE DA-A’AKA BEHI AADAMO

segs.en: so, You forgave him his sin and allowed him to dwell in Your Paradise.
segs.tr: FA-GHAFARTA LAHU ZAMBAHU WA ASKANTAHU JANNATAKA

segs.en: I beseech You in the name of the Great Qur'an,
in the name of Muhammad, the Seal of the Prophets,

segs.ar: وَبِحَقِّ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَبِحَقِّ فَصْلِكَ نَوْمَ الْقَضَآءِ
segs.en: in the name of Abraham, in the name of Your Judgment on the Day of the Administration of Justice,
segs.tr: WA BE-HAQQE IBRAAHEEMA WA BE-HAQQE FAZLEKA NAWMAL QAZAAA-E

segs.en: in the name of the Scales when they shall be set up,
the Scrolls when they shall be laid open,
the Pen and whatever has been decided,
segs.tr: WA BE-HAQQIL QALAME WA MAA JARAA

segs.en: and the Tablet and whatever it has recorded;

segs.ar: وَبِحَقِّ الْاِسْمِ الَّذِیْ كَتَبْتَہٗ عَلٰی سُرَادِقِ الْعَرْشِ
segs.en: in the name of the Name that You had inscribed on the pavilion of the Divine Throne
segs.tr: WA BE-HAQQIL ISMIL LAZEE KATABTAHU A’LAA SORAADEQIL A’RSHE

segs.ar: قَبْلَ خَلْقِكَ الْخَلْقَ وَالدُّنْیَا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ بِاَلْفَیْ عَامٍ
segs.en: two thousand years before You created the beings, the world, the sun, and the moon.
segs.tr: QABLA KHALQEKAL KHALQA WAD DUNYAA WASH SHAMSA WAL QAMARA BE-ALFAY A’AMIN

segs.ar: وَاَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَہٗ لَا شَرِیْكَ لَہٗ
segs.en: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah, alone without having any partner,
segs.tr: WA ASH-HADO AN LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO WAHDAHU LAA SHAREEKA LAHU

segs.en: and that Muhammad is his servant and messenger.
segs.tr: WA ANNA MOHAMMADAN A’BDOHU WA RASOOLOHU

segs.en: I beseech You in the name of Your Name that is hoarded in Your stores,
segs.tr: WA AS-ALOKA BISMEKAL MAKHZOONE FEE KHAZAA-ENEKAL

segs.ar: الَّذِیْ اسْتَاْثَرْتَ بِہٖ فِیْ عِلْمِ الْغَیْبِ عِنْدَكَ
segs.en: You have kept in the knowledge of the Unseen with You
segs.tr: LAZIS TAASARTA BEHI FEE I’LMIL GHAYBE I’NDAKA

segs.ar: لَمْ یَظْهَرْ عَلَیْهِ اَحَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segs.en: and it has not been shown to any of Your creatures,
segs.tr: LAM YAZHAR A’LAYHE AHADUN MIN KAHLQEKA

segs.ar: لَا مَلَكٌ مُّقَرَّبٌ وَّلَا نَبِیٌّ مُرْسَلٌ
segs.en: be him a favorite angel, a missioned Prophet,
segs.tr: LAA MALAKUM MOQARRABUNW WA LAA NABIYYUN MURSALUNW

segs.en: or a chosen servant.

segs.ar: وَاَسْئَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِیْ شَقَقْتَ بِهِ الْبِحَارَ
segs.en: I beseech You in the name of Your Name by which You rent asunder the oceans,
segs.tr: WA AS-ALOKA BISMEKAL LAZEE SHAQAQTA BEHIL BEHAARA

segs.en: the mountains rose,
and night and day follow each other,
segs.tr: WAKH TALABA BEHIL LAYLO WAN NAHAARO

segs.en: in the name of the seven of the oft-repeated verses
and the Grand Qur'an,
in the name of the noble, recording angels,
in the name of Ta-Ha, Ya-Sin, Kaf-Ha-Ya-Ayn-Sad,
segs.tr: WA BE-HAQQE TAAHAA WA YAASEEN WA KAAF-HAA-YAA-A’YN-SAAD

segs.en: Ha-Mim-Ayn-Sin-Qaf, and in the name of the Torah of Moses,
segs.tr: WA HAA-MEEM-A’YN-SEEN-QAAF WA BE-HAQQE TAWRAYTE MOOSAA

segs.en: the Gospel of Jesus, the Psalms of David,
segs.tr: WA INJEELE E’ESAA WA ZABOORE DA-WOODA

segs.en: the Furqan (Criterion) of Muhammad,
peace be upon him, his Household,
and all the messengers and baaheyaa sharaaheyaa
segs.tr: WA A’LAA JAMEE-I’R ROSOLE WA BAAHEYAA SHARAA-HEYAA

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ بِحَقِّ تِلْكَ الْمُنَاجَاتِ
segs.en: O Allah, I beseech You in the name of this confidential talk
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA BE-HAQQE TILKAL MONAAJAATIL

segs.ar: الَّتِیْ كَانَتْ بَیْنَكَ وَبَیْنَ مُوْسَی بْنِ عِمْرَانَ
segs.en: which took place between You and Moses, the son of Imran,
segs.tr: LATEE KAANAT BAYNAKA WA BAYNA MOOSAB NE I’MRAANA

segs.en: on the Mount Tur Sayna’,

segs.ar: وَاَسْئَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِی عَلَّمْتَہٗ مَلَكَ الْمَوْتِ
segs.en: I beseech You in the name of Your Name which You taught the Angel of Death
segs.tr: WA AS-ALOKA BISMEKAL LAZEE A’LLAMTAHU MALAKAL MAWTE

segs.en: so that he would be able to grasp the souls,

segs.ar: وَاَسْئَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِیْ كُتِبَ عَلٰی وَرَقِ الزَّیْتُوْنِ
segs.en: I beseech You in the name of Your Name which was written on the leaves of olive-trees;
segs.tr: WA AS-ALOKA BISMEKAL LAZEE KOTEBA A’LAA WARAQIZ ZAYTOONE

segs.en: so, fires subdued to these leaves

segs.ar: فَقُلْتَ یَا نَارُ كُوْنِیْ بَرْدًا وَّسَلَامًا
segs.en: after You said, “O fire! Be a comfort and peace,”
segs.tr: FA-QULTA YAA NAARO KOONEE BARDANW WA SALAAMAN

segs.en: and I beseech You in the name of Your Name that You wrote
on the canopies of Glory and Dignity.
O He Who cannot be annoyed by any beseecher,
and Whom no giving can ever diminish!

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ بِہٖ یُسْتَغَاثُ وَاِلَیْهِ یُلْجَاءُ
segs.en: O He Whose refuge is taken and to Whom resort is made!
segs.tr: YAA MAN BEHI YUSTAGHAASO WA ELAYHE YULJAA-O

segs.en: I beseech You in the name of the Seats of Honor belonging to Your Throne,
the utmost of mercy in Your Book,
Your All-great Name, Your All-high majesty,
segs.tr: WA BISMEKAL A-A’ZAME WA JADDEKAL A-A’LAA

segs.en: and Your most high, perfect Words.
O Allah, Lord of winds and whatever they scatter far,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA RABBAR REYAAHE WA MAA ZARAT

segs.en: Lord of the sky and whatever it covers,
the Lord of the earth and whatever it carries,
the Lord of the devils and whomever they mislead,
and the Lord of the oceans and wherever they flow.

segs.ar: وَبِحَقِّ كُلِّ حَقٍّ هُوَ عَلَیْكَ حَقٌّ
segs.en: I beseech You in the name of everything that enjoys a right with You,
segs.tr: WA BE-HAQQE KULLE HAQQIN HOWA A’LAYKA HAQQUN

segs.en: in the name of the favorite angels,
the angels managing the spirits, the cherubim,

segs.ar: وَالْمُسَبِّحِیْنَ لَكَ بِاللَّیْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَا یَفْتُرُوْنَ
segs.en: and the angels praising You night and day without showing sluggishness,
segs.tr: WAL MOSABBEHEENA LAKA BIL-LAYLE WAN NAHAARE LAA YAFTOROONA

segs.en: in the name of Abraham, Your intimate friend,

segs.ar: وَبِحَقِّ كُلِّ وَلِیٍّ یُّنَادِیْكَ بَیْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَۃِ
segs.en: and in the name of each and every saint who calls You between Safa and Marwah
segs.tr: WA BE-HAQQE KULLE WALIYYIN YONAADEEKA BAYNAS SAFAA WAL MARWATE

segs.en: And You grant him his prayer, O Granter of prayers.
segs.tr: WA TASTAJEEBO LAHU DO-A’AA-AHU YAA MOJEEBO

segs.en: I beseech You in the name of all these names
and all these prayers

segs.ar: اَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَنَا مَا قَدَّمْنَا وَمَا اَخَّرْنَا
segs.en: to forgive us all our past and coming sins,
segs.tr: AN TAGHFERA LANAA MAA QADDAMNAA WA MAA AKHKHARNAA

segs.en: including the secret and the open,
segs.tr: WA MAA ASRARNAA WA MAA A-A’LANNAA

segs.en: the hidden and the public,
segs.tr: WA MAA ABDAYNAA WA MAA AKHFAYNAA

segs.en: and those whom You know better than we do.
segs.tr: WA MAA ANTA A-A’LAMO BEHI MINNAA

segs.en: Verily, You have power over all things.
In the name of Your mercy, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.

segs.ar: یَا حَافِظَ كُلِّ غَرِیْبٍ یَا مُوْنِسَ كُلِّ وَحِیْدٍ
segs.en: O He Who guards all strangers! O He Who brings entertainment to all lonely ones!
segs.tr: YAA HAAFEZA KULLE GHAREEBIN YAA MOONESA KULLE WAHEEDIN

segs.ar: یَا قُوَّۃَ كُلِّ ضَعِیْفٍ یَا نَاصِرَ كُلِّ مَظْلُوْمٍ
segs.en: O He Who is the power of all the weak! O He Who is the support of all the persecuted!
segs.tr: YAA QUWWATA KULLE ZA-E’EFIN YAA NAASERA KULLE MAZLOOMIN

segs.ar: یَا رَازِقَ كُلِّ مَحْرُوْمٍ یَا مُوْنِسَ كُلِّ مُسْتَوْحِشٍ
segs.en: O He Who bestows upon all the deprived! O He Who brings entertainment to all the lonesome!
segs.tr: YAA RAAZEQA KULLE MAHROOMIN YAA MOONESA KULLE MUSTAWHESHIN

segs.ar: یَا صَاحِبَ كُلِّ مُسَافِرٍ یَا عِمَادَ كُلِّ حَاضِرٍ
segs.en: O He Who is the company of all those on journeys! O He Who is the pillar of all the present!
segs.tr: YAA SAAHEBA KULLE MOSAAFERIN YAA E’MAADA KULLE HAAZERIN

segs.en: O He Who forgives all sins and offenses!
segs.tr: YAA GHAAFERA KULLE ZANBINW WA KHATEE-ATIN

segs.en: O He Who is the aid of all those begging aid!
O He Who is the relief of all those pleading for relief!
O He Who relieves the calamity of those inflicted with calamities!
O He Who alleviate the distress of the distressed ones!
O He Who is the Originator of the heavens and the layers of the earth!
O He Who is the utmost hope of the seekers!
O He Who responds to the prayers of the troubled!
O He Who is the most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
O Lord of the worlds!
O Master of the Judgment Day!
O most Magnanimous of all those who act magnanimously!
O most Generous of all those who act generously!
O most Hearing of all those who can hear!
O most Seeing of all those who can see!
O most Powerful of all those who have power!

segs.ar: اغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تُغَیِّرُ النِّعَمَ
segs.en: forgive my sins that change the bounties
segs.tr: IGHFIR LEYAZ ZONOOBAL LATEE TOGHAYYERUN NE-A’MA

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تُوْرِثُ النَّدَمَ
segs.en: And forgive me my sins that bring about remorse,
segs.tr: WAGH FIR LEYAZ ZONOOBAL LATEE TOORESUN NADAMA

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تُوْرِثُ السَّقَمَ
segs.en: forgive me my sins that result in ailment,
segs.tr: WAGH FIR LEYAZ ZONOOBAL LATEE TOORESUS SAQAMA

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تَهْتِكُ الْعِصَمَ
segs.en: forgive me my sins that tear safeguards,
segs.tr: WAGH FIR LEYAZ ZONOOBAL LATEE TAHTEKUL E’SAMA

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تَرُدُّ الدُّعَآءَ
segs.en: forgive me my sins that repel prayers,
segs.tr: WAGH FIR LEYAZ ZONOOBAL LATEE TARUDDUD DO-A’AA-A

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تَحْبِسُ قَطْرَ السَّمَآءِ
segs.en: forgive me my sins that withhold the drops of the sky,
segs.tr: WAGH FIR LEYAZ ZONOOBAL LATEE TAHBESO QATRIS SAMAAA-E

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تُعَجِّلُ الْفَنَآءَ
segs.en: forgive me my sins that hasten extinction,
segs.tr: WAGH FIR LEYAZ ZONOOBAL LATEE TO-A’JJELUL FANAAA-A

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تَجْلِبُ الشَّقَآءَ
segs.en: forgive me my sins that beget misery,
segs.tr: WAGH FIR LEYAZ ZONOOBAL LATEE TAJLEBUSH SHAQAAA-A

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تُظْلِمُ الْهَوَآءَ
segs.en: forgive me my sins that darken the atmospheres,
segs.tr: WAGH FIR LEYAZ ZONOOBAL LATEE TUZLEMUL HAWAAA-A

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تَکْشِفُ الْغِطَآءَ
segs.en: forgive me my sins that disclose the coverings,
segs.tr: WAGH FIR LEYAZ ZONOOBAL LATEE TAKSHEFUL GHETAAA-A

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ لَا یَغْفِرُهَا غَیْرُكَ یَا اَللهُ
segs.en: forgive me my sins that none can forgive save You, O Allah,
segs.tr: WAGH FIR LEYAZ ZONOOBAL LATEE LAA YAGHFEROHAA GHAYROKA YAA ALLAAHO

segs.ar: وَاحْمِلْ عَنِّیْ كُلَّ تَبِعَۃٍ لِّاَحَدٍ مِّنْ خَلْقِكَ
segs.en: bear from me every liability that I owe to any of Your creatures,
segs.tr: WAH MIL A’NNEE KULLA TABE-A’TIL LE-AHADIM MIN KHALQEKA

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ لِیْ مِنْ اَمْرِیْ فَرَجًا وَمَخْرَجًا
segs.en: make all my affairs reach at relief, exit, and easiness,
segs.tr: WAJ A’L LEE MIN AMREE FARAJAN WA MAKHRAJANW

segs.en: and ease, send down certainty in You into my breast
segs.tr: WA YUSRAN WA ANZIL YAQEENAKA FEE SADREE

segs.ar: وَرَجَآئَكَ فِیْ قَلْبِیْ حَتّٰی لَا اَرْجُوْ غَیْرَكَ
segs.en: and hope in You into my heart, so that I shall never hope for anyone save You.
segs.tr: WA RAJAAA-AKA FEE QALBEE HATTAA LAA ARJOWA GHAYRAKA

segs.en: O Allah, safeguard me, heal me in all my situations,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAH FAZNEE WA A’AFENEE FEE MAQAAMEE

segs.en: be my companion at nights and days,
segs.tr: WAS HABNEE FEE LAYLEE WA NAHAAREE

segs.en: be ahead of me, behind me,
segs.tr: WA MIM BAYNE YADAYYA WA MIN KHALFEE

segs.en: from my right side, from my left side,
segs.tr: WA A’N YAMEENEE WA A’N SHEMAALEE

segs.en: from above me, and from beneath me,
segs.tr: WA MIN FAWQEE WA MIN TAHTEE

segs.ar: وَیَسِّرْ لِیَ السَّبِیْلَ وَاَحْسِنْ لِیَ التَّیْسِیْرَ
segs.en: make easy all the ways for me, make excellent facilitation for me,
segs.tr: WA YASSIR LEYASSABEELA WA AHSIN LEYAT TAYSEERA

segs.en: do not disappoint me in hardships,
guide me, O Best of all guides,

segs.ar: وَلَا تَكِلْنِیْ اِلٰی نَفْسِیْ فِی الْاُمُوْرِ
segs.en: do not leave me alone in all my affairs,
segs.tr: WA LAA TAKILNEE ELAA NAFSEE FIL OMOORE

segs.en: make me receive all pleasures,
and make me return to my family with prosperity, success,
segs.tr: WAQ LIBNEE ELAA AHLEE BIL-FALAAHE WAN NAJAAHE

segs.en: and gladness in the present and in the future.
Verily, You have power over all things.
bestow upon me with Your favors,
expand for me the most favorable of Your sustenance,
segs.tr: WA AWSE’ A’LAYYA MIN TAYYEBAATE RIZQEKA

segs.en: apply me to the obedience to You,
redeem me from Your chastisement and Fire,
segs.tr: WA AJIRNEE MIN A’ZAABEKA WA NAAREKA

segs.ar: وَاقْلِبْنِیْ اِذَا تَوَفَّیْتَنِیْ اِلٰی جَنَّتِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ
segs.en: and when You grasp my soul, lead me to Your Paradise, by Your mercy.
segs.tr: WAQ LIBNEE EZAA TAWAFFAYTANEE ELAA JANNATEKA BE-RAHMATEKA

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ
segs.en: O Allah, I seek Your protection against confiscation of Your graces,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE A-O’OZO BEKA MIN ZAWAALE NE’MATEKA

segs.en: against alternation of Your conferral of wellbeing on me,
against the befalling of Your punishment,
and against the ensuing of Your chastisement.
I seek Your protection against arduous hardships,
segs.tr: WA A-O’OZO BEKA MIN JAHDIL BALAAA-E

segs.en: against coming about of misery,
against evil end results,
against my enemies’ gloating over my grief,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا یَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ
segs.en: against the evil of everything that descends from the heavens,
segs.tr: WA MIN SHARRE MAA YANZELO MENAS SAMAAA-E

segs.ar: وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِیْ الْكِتَابِ الْمُنْزَلِ
segs.en: and against the evils mentioned in the Revealed Book.
segs.tr: WA MIN SHARRE MAA FIL KETAABIL MUNZALE

segs.en: O Allah, do not include me with the evil ones,
do not include me with the people of Hellfire,
do not deprive me of the companionship of the upright people,
grant me a pleasant lifetime,
decide for me a kind of death
due to which You will join me to the Pious Ones,
and confer upon me with the companionship of the Prophets

segs.ar: فِیْ مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ مَلِیْكٍ مُقْتَدِرٍ
segs.en: in the seat of honesty with the All-powerful King.
segs.tr: FEE MAQ-A’DE SIDQIN I’NDA MALEEKIN MUQTADERIN

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلٰی حُسْنِ بَلَآئِكَ
segs.en: O Allah, all praise be to You for Your pleasant trials and deeds to us.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDO A’LAA HUSNE BALAAA-EKA

segs.en: All praise be to You for my being Muslim
segs.tr: WA SUN-E’KA WA LAKAL HAMDO A’LAL ISLAAME

segs.en: and for my following the Prophet’s traditions.
O my Lord, as You have guided them (i.e. the pious)
and taught them Your Book, (please) guide us and teach us.
segs.tr: WA A’LLAMTAHUM KETAABAKA FAHDENAA WA A’LLIMNAA

segs.en: All praise be to You for Your pleasant trials
segs.tr: WA LAKAL HAMDO A’LAA HUSNE BALAAA-EKA

segs.ar: وَصُنْعِكَ عِنْدِیْ خَاصَّۃً كَمَا خَلَقْتَنِیْ فَاَحْسَنْتَ خَلْقِیْ
segs.en: and deeds to me in private, as You created me, gifted me an excellent form,
segs.tr: WA SUN-E’KA I’NDEE KHAASSATAN KAMAA KHALAQTANEE FA-AHSANTA KHALQEE

segs.en: taught me, gifted me excellent erudition,
guided me, and gifted me excellent guidance.
So, all praise be to You for Your favors that You conferred upon me
in the past and in the present.

segs.ar: فَكَمْ مِنْ كَرْبٍ یَا سَیِّدِیْ قَدْ فَرَّجْتَہٗ
segs.en: Too many are the agonies that You, my Master, relieved.
segs.tr: FAKAM MIN KARBIN YAA SAYYEDEE QAD FARRJATAHU

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ غَمٍّ یَا سَیِّدِیْ قَدْ نَفَّسْتَہٗ
segs.en: Too many are the distresses that You, my Master, eased.
segs.tr: WA KAM MIN GHAMMIN YAA SAYYEDEE QAD NAFFASTAHU

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ هَمٍّ یَا سَیِّدِیْ قَدْ كَشَفْتَہٗ
segs.en: Too many are the sufferings that You, my Master, alleviated.
segs.tr: WA KAM MIN HAMMIN YAA SAYYEDEE QAD KASHAFTAHU

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِّنْ بَلَآءٍ یَا سَیِّدِیْ قَدْ صَرَفْتَہٗ
segs.en: Too many are the hardships from which You, my Master, saved me.
segs.tr: WA KAM MIN BALAAA-IN YAA SAYYEDEE QAD SARAFTAHU

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ عَیْبٍ یَا سَیِّدِیْ قَدْ سَتَرْتَہٗ
segs.en: Too many are the defects that You, my Master, covered.
segs.tr: WA KAM MAN A’YBIN YAA SAYYEDEE QAD SATARTAHU

segs.en: So, all praise be to You for all conditions,
in every place and time,
every circumstance and situation,
and for the current condition and all conditions.
segs.tr: WA A’LAA HAAZEHIL HAALE WA KULLE HAALIN

segs.en: O Allah, shower upon me the best share of every good thing

segs.ar: نَصِیْبًا فِیْ هٰذَ الْیَوْمِ مِنْ خَیْرٍ تَقْسِمُہٗ
segs.en: that You decide for Your servants on this day,
segs.tr: NASEEBAN FEE HAAZAL YAWME MIN KAHYRIN TAQSEMOHU

segs.ar: اَوْ ضُرٍّ تَکْشِفُہٗ اَوْ سُوْءٍ تَصْرِفُہٗ
segs.en: such as harm that You decide to hold off, evil that You decide to ward off,
segs.tr: AW ZURRIN TAKSHEFOHU AW SOO-IN TASREFOHU

segs.ar: اَوْ بَلَآءٍ تَدْفَعُہٗ اَوْ خَیْرٍ تَسُوْقُہٗ
segs.en: ordeal that You decide to deter, grace that You decide to grant,
segs.tr: AW BALAA-IN TAD-FA-O’HU AW KHAYRIN TASOOQOHU

segs.ar: اَوْ رَحْمَۃٍ تَنْشُرُهَا اَوْ عَافِیَۃٍ تُلْبِسُهَا
segs.en: mercy that You decide to spread, and wellbeing with which You decide to clothe (Your servants),
segs.tr: AW RAHMATIN TANSHOROHAA AW A’AFEYATIN TULBESOHAA

segs.en: for You verily have power over all things,
in Your hands lie the hoards of the heavens and the earth,
segs.tr: WA BE-YADEKA KHAZAAA-ENUS SAMAAWAATE WAL ARZE

segs.en: You are verily the One, the All-generous, and the Best Bestower,
You are the One Whose beseechers are not rejected,
and You are the One Who never disappoint those who put hope in Him,
and Whose giving never diminishes (His treasures),
and the One Whose possessions never run out;
rather, You always increase in quantity, excellent gift,
conferrals, and magnanimity.

segs.ar: وَارْزُقْنِیْ مِنْ خَزَآئِنِكَ الَّتِیْ لَا تَفْنٰی
segs.en: bestow upon me from Your hoards that never come to an end
segs.tr: WAR ZUQNEE MIN KHAZAAA-ENEKAL LATEE LAA TAFNAA

segs.en: and from Your expansive mercy.
Your conferral shall never be confined
and You have power over all things;
segs.tr: WA ANTA A’LAA KULLE SHAY-IN QADEERUN

segs.en: in the name of Your mercy; O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.

segs.note: Dua Allahumma Man Ta’abba’a
segs.ur: دعا اللهم من تعبّأ

segs.note: On the day of Arafah, or on Friday nights and days, recite:
segs.ur: یوم عرفہ، یا جمعہ کی راتوں اور دنوں میں پڑھیں:

segs.en: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
O Allah, One may call up, prepare,
ready oneself, and stand prepared
for purpose of coming to a creature
in the hope of gaining his aid
and asking for his gift and present.
As for myself, to You—O my Lord—I make my preparations and readiness
segs.tr: FA-ELAYKA YAA RABBE TA’BEYATEE WAS TEA’DAADEE

segs.en: hoping for Your pardon
and asking for Your gift and present.
So, do not disappoint my entreaty.

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ لَا يَخِيْبُ عَلَيْهِ سَائِلٌ
segs.en: O He Who never disappoints His beseechers
segs.tr: YAA MAN LAA YAKHEEBO A’LAYHE SAAA-ELUN

segs.en: and Whose prizes never decrease His ample-giving!

segs.ar: فَاِنِّيْ لَمْ آتِكَ ثِقَةً بِعَمَلٍ صَالِحٍ عَمِلْتُهٗ
segs.en: I have not come to You with confidence of a righteous deed that I have done
segs.tr: FA-INNEE LAM AATEKA SEQATAN BE-A’MALIN SAALEHIN A’MILTOHU

segs.en: nor have I had any hope in a grant of any creature.

segs.ar: اَتَيْتُكَ مُقِرًّا عَلٰى نَفْسِيْ بِالْاِسَائَةِ وَالظُّلْمِ
segs.en: Rather, I have come to You professing myself to be evildoer and transgressor
segs.tr: ATAYTOKA MOQIRRAN A’LAA NAFSEE BIL-ESAAA-ATE WAZ ZULME

segs.ar: مُعْتَرِفُا بِاَنْ لَا حُجَّةَ لِيْ وَلَا عُذْرَ
segs.en: and confessing that I lack any pretext or excuse.
segs.tr: MO’TAREFAN BE-AN LAA HUJJATA LEE WA LAA U’ZRA

segs.en: I have come to You hoping for Your great pardon
due to which You have pardoned the wrongdoers.

segs.ar: فَلَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ طُوْلُ عُكُوْفِهِمْ عَلٰي عَظِيْمِ الْجُرْمِ
segs.en: Hence, their long-lasting retirement to their grave offenses has not prevented You
segs.tr: FALAM YAMNA’KA TOOLO O’KOOFEHIM A’LAA A’ZEEMIL JURME

segs.en: from turning to them with mercy.
O He Whose mercy is huge
and Whose pardon is great;

segs.ar: يَا عَظِيْمُ يَا عَظِيْمُ يَا عَظِيْمُ
segs.en: O All-great, O All-great, O All-great;
segs.tr: YAA A’ZEEMO YAA A’ZEEMO YAA A’ZEEMO

segs.en: nothing can repel Your rage except Your forbearance

segs.ar: وَلَا يُنْجِيْ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ اِلَّا التَّضَرُّعُ اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: and nothing can save from Your wrath except imploring earnestly to You.
segs.tr: WA LAA YUNJEE MIN SAKHATEKA ILLAAT TAZARRO-O’ ELAYKA

segs.en: So, my God, grant me a relief

segs.ar: بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتِيْ تُحْيِيْ بِهَا مَيْتَ الْبِلَادِ
segs.en: in the name of the power through which You restore to life the derelict lands,
segs.tr: BIL-QUDRATIL LATEE TOHYEE BEHAA MAYTAL BELAADE

segs.ar: وَلَا تُهْلِكْنِيْ غَمًّا حَتّٰى تَسْتَجِيْبَ لِيْ
segs.en: and do not cause me to perish out of grief until You respond to me
segs.tr: WA LAA TOHLIKNEE GHAMMAN HATTAA TASTAJEEBA LEE

segs.en: and show me signs of Your response to my prayers.

segs.ar: وَاَذِقْنِيْ طَعْمَ الْعَافِيَةِ اِلٰى مُنَتَهٰى اَجَلِيْ
segs.en: Make me taste the flavor of wellbeing up to the end of my lifetime,
segs.tr: WA AZIQNEE TA’MAL A’AFEYATE ELAA MUNTAHAA AJALEE

segs.en: do not make my enemies gloat over me,
do not give them a hand over me,
and do not make them control over me.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنْ وَضَعْتَنِيْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَرْفَعُنِيْ
segs.en: O Allah, If You humiliate me, who can then exalt me?
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA IN WAZA’TANEE FAMAN ZAL LAZEE YARFA-O’NEE

segs.ar: وَاِنْ رَفَعْتَنِيْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْ يَضَعُنِيْ
segs.en: And if You exalt me, who can then humiliate me?
segs.tr: WA IN RAFA’TANEE FAMAN ZAL LAZEE YAZA-O’NEE

segs.ar: وَاِنْ اَهْلَكْتَنِيْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْ يَعْرِضُ لَكَ فِي عَبْدِكَ
segs.en: If You annihilate me, who can then interfere before You concerning the affair of me—Your slave
segs.tr: WA IN AHLAKTANEE FAMAN ZAL LAZEE YA’REZO LAKA FEE A’BDEKA

segs.en: or who can intercede to ask You about it?

segs.ar: وَقَدْ عَلِمْتُ اَنَّهٗ لَيْسَ فِي حُكْمِكَ ظُلْمٌ
segs.en: I have already known for sure that Your decrees are devoid of injustice
segs.tr: WA QAD A’LIMTO ANNAHU LAYSA FEE HUKMEKA ZULMUN

segs.en: and Your punishment does not count on immediateness.
Verily, immediateness is the work of him who fears lest he may miss,
segs.tr: WA INNAMA YA’JELO MAN YAKHAAFUL FAWTA

segs.en: and only do the weak need injustice.
segs.tr: WA INNAMAA YAHTAJO ELAZ ZULMIZ ZA-E’EFO

segs.ar: وَقَدْ تَعَالَيْتَ يَا اِلٰهِيْ عَنْ ذٰلِكَ عُلُوًّا كَبِيْرًا
segs.en: As for You, O my God, You are too exalted to be so—Exalted and Great You are beyond all measure!
segs.tr: WA QAD TA-A’ALAYTA YAA ELAAHI A’N ZAALEKA O’LUWWAN KABEERAN

segs.en: O Allah, I take refuge in You; so, have protection upon me!
I call for Your safekeeping; so, keep me under Your security!
I appeal for Your sustenance; so, provide me with sustenance!
I put trust in You; so, keep me under Your supervision!
I call for Your aid against my enemy; so, grant me support!
I seek Your assistance; so, assist me!
I ask for Your forgiveness; so, forgive me.
segs.tr: WA ASTAGHFEROKA YAA ELAAHI FAGH-FIR LEE

segs.en: So, respond! Respond! Respond!

segs.note: Tasbihat & Visiting Karbala
segs.ur: تسبیحات اور زیارت کربلا

segs.note: Recite the Ten Statements of Glorification (Tasbihat) one thousand times, as given in the Aamal of the Day of Arafah.
segs.ur: دس تسبیحات ایک ہزار مرتبہ پڑھیں، جیسا کہ [یومِ عرفہ کے اعمال](AC11) میں دیا گیا ہے۔

segs.note: Visit the holy tomb of Imam Husayn (a.s.) at the land of Karbala and reside there up to the ‘Id al-Azha Day (the tenth of Zilhajj).
segs.ur: کربلا کی سرزمین پر امام حسین (ع) کے مقدس مزار کی زیارت کریں اور وہاں عید الاضحیٰ (دس ذی الحجہ) کے دن تک قیام کریں۔

A_AC10.merits:
This blessed night is the night of praying for granting all requests. Repentance at this night is accepted, prayers responded, and acts of worship and obedience achieve the reward of one hundred and seventy years of worship. 

Dua Ya Shahida Kulli Najwa: It is narrated that Almighty Allah will forgive one who says this supplicatory prayer at the ‘Arafat Night or Friday nights.

Visiting Karbala: It is highly recommended to visit the holy tomb of Imam Husayn (a.s.) at the land of Karbala and to reside there up to the ‘Id al-Azha Day (the tenth of Zilhajj) so that Almighty Allah will save from all evils of that year.

A_AC11.name: Aamal of the Day of Arafah (9th Dhul Hijjah)

segs.note: Fasting, Ghusl & Ziyarat
segs.ur: روزہ، غسل اور زیارت

segs.note: Fast on the Arafah Day, unless fasting keeps you from saying the supplications.
segs.ur: یومِ عرفہ کا روزہ رکھیں، سوائے اس کے کہ روزہ آپ کو دعائیں پڑھنے سے روک دے۔

segs.note: Bathe on this day, before midday (Zuhr).
segs.ur: اس دن ظہر سے پہلے غسل کریں.

segs.note: Visit the holy tomb of Imam Husayn (a.s.), by day and by night. Recite Ziyarat of Imam Husayn (a.s.) on the Day of Arafah.
segs.ur: امام حسین (ع) کے روضۂ مبارک کی دن اور رات میں زیارت کریں۔ [یوم عرفہ میں امام حسین (ع) کی زیارت](G75) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Recite the third comprehensive ziyarah, Ziyaarah al-Jaame’ah.
segs.ur: تیسری زیارتِ جامعہ، [زیارت جامعہ](AC13) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Prayer after Asr
segs.ur: نماز عصر کے بعد کی نماز

segs.note: Immediately after the obligatory Asr Prayer and before saying the supplicatory prayers of Arafah, offer a two unit prayer. Offer it outdoors and include confessions of sins.
segs.ur: فرض نماز عصر کے فوراً بعد اور عرفہ کی دعائیں پڑھنے سے پہلے دو رکعت نماز پڑھیں۔ اسے کھلی جگہ پر پڑھیں اور اس میں گناہوں کا اعتراف کریں۔

segs.note: After this prayer, begin with the acts and supplications of the Arafah Day that are reported from the Holy Infallibles (a.s.).
segs.ur: اس نماز کے بعد یوم عرفہ کے وہ اعمال اور دعائیں شروع کریں جو معصومین (ع) سے منقول ہیں۔

segs.note: Prayers at Midday
segs.ur: دوپہر کی نمازیں

segs.note: At midday (Zuhr), leave your house and offer the obligatory Zuhr and Asr prayers outdoors, with complete performance of their parts.
segs.ur: ظہر کے وقت اپنے گھر سے نکلیں اور واجب نماز ظہر و عصر کھلی فضا میں، ان کے تمام اجزاء مکمل ادا کرتے ہوئے پڑھیں.

segs.note: After that, offer a two unit prayer, reciting Surah al-Faatehah and Surah al-Tawheed in the first unit and Surah al-Faatehah and Surah al-Kaferun in the second.
segs.ur: اس کے بعد، دو رکعت نماز پڑھیں، پہلی رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) اور [سورہ توحید](A116) اور دوسری میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) اور [سورہ کافرون](A113) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: After that, offer the four unit Namaz of Imam Ali (a.s.): in each unit, recite Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Tawheed fifty times.
segs.ur: اس کے بعد، چار رکعت کی [امام علی (ع) کی نماز](F15) پڑھیں: ہر رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) پچاس مرتبہ پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Zikr Sequence of Ibn Taaoos
segs.ur: ابن طاووس کے اذکار کی ترتیب

segs.note: Recite this doxology (zikr), reported from the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.):
segs.ur: نبی اکرم (ص) سے منقول یہ ذکر پڑھیں:

segs.en: Glory be to the One Whose Throne is in the heaven;
Glory be to the One Whose authority is in the earth;
Glory be to the One Whose decree is in the graves;
Glory be to the One Whose path is in the sea;
Glory be to the One Whose dominion is in the Fire;
Glory be to the One Whose mercy is in Paradise;
Glory be to the One Whose justice is in the Resurrection;
Glory be to the One Who raised the heaven;
Glory be to the One Who spread the earth;

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِیْ مَلْجَاَ وَلَامَنْجَا مِنْهُ اِلَّا اِلَیْهِ.
segs.en: Glory be to the One from Whom there is no shelter nor escape except toward Him.
segs.tr: SUBHAANAL LAZEE MALJA-A WA LAA MANJAA MINHO ILLAA ELAYHE.

segs.note: Recite this doxology (zikr) 100 times:
segs.ur: یہ ذکر 100 مرتبہ پڑھیں:

segs.en: Glory be to Allah, and all praise is due to Allah,

segs.ar: وَلَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَاللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ.
segs.en: and there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
segs.tr: WA LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO WAL LAAHO AKBARO.

segs.note: Recite Surah al-Tawheed, Ayat al-Kursi and salawat upon Muhammad and his Household 100 times each.
segs.ur: [سورہ توحید](A116)، [آیت الکرسی](A4) اور محمد و آلِ محمد پر درود، ہر ایک 100 مرتبہ پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Recite 100 times:
segs.ur: 100 مرتبہ پڑھیں:

segs.ar: لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَہٗ لَا شَرِیْكَ لَہٗ
segs.en: There is no god but Allah, alone without partner;
segs.tr: LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO WAHDAHU LAA SHAREEKA LAHU

segs.ar: لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ یُحْیِیْ وَیُمِیْتُ
segs.en: to Him belongs the kingdom and to Him belongs the praise; He gives life and He causes death,
segs.tr: LAHUL MULKO WA LAHUL HAMDO YOHYEE WA YOMEETO

segs.ar: وَیُمِیْتُ وَیُحْیِیْ وَهُوَ حَیٌّ لَا یَمُوْتُ
segs.en: and He causes death and He gives life; and He is the Ever-Living who does not die;
segs.tr: WA YOMEETO WA YOHYEE WA HOWA HAYYUN LAA YAMOOTO

segs.ar: بِیَدِهِ الْخَیْرُ وَهُوْ عَلٰی کُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیْرٌ.
segs.en: in His hand is all good, and He has power over all things.
segs.tr: BEYADEHIL KHAYRO WA HOWA A’LAA KULLE SHAYIN QADEER.

segs.note: Recite each of these ten times:
segs.ur: ان میں سے ہر ایک دس مرتبہ پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اَسْتَغْفِرُاللهَ الَّذِیْ لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْحَیُّ الْقَیُّوْمُ وَاَتُوْبُ اِلَیْهِ.
segs.en: I seek forgiveness from Allah, there is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I turn to Him in repentance.
segs.tr: ASTAGHFERUL LAAHAL LAZEE LAA ELAAHA ILLAA HOWAL HAYYUL QAYYOOMO WA ATOOBO ELAYHE.

segs.en: O Allah
O All-Beneficent
O All-Merciful
O Originator of the heavens and the earth
O Lord of Majesty and Honor
O Ever-Living, O Sustainer
O All-Affectionate, O Bestower of Favors
O You besides Whom there is no god
Amen.

segs.note: Then recite this supplication:
segs.ur: پھر یہ دعا پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ یَا مَنْ هُوَ اَقْرَبُ اِلَیَّ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِیْدِ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You, O He who is closer to me than my jugular vein;
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA YAA MAN HOWA AQRABO ELAYYA MIN HABLIL WAREEDE

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ یَحُوْلُ بَیْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِہٖ
segs.en: O He who comes between a man and his heart;
segs.tr: YAA MAN YAHOOLO BAYNAL MAR-E WA QALBEHI

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ هُوْ بِالْمَنْظَرِ الْاَعْلَی وَبِالْاُفُقِ الْمُبِیْنِ
segs.en: O He who is in the highest vantage point and at the clear horizon;
segs.tr: YAA MAN HOWA BIL-MANZARIL A-A’LAA WA BIL-OFOQIL MOBEENE

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ هُوَ الرَّحْمٰنُ عَلَی الْعَرْشِ اسْتَوٰی
segs.en: O He who is the All-Beneficent, established upon the Throne;
segs.tr: YAA MAN HOWAR RAHMAANO A’LAL A’RSHIS TAWAA

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ لَیْسَ كَمِثْلِہٖ شَیْءٌ وَهُوَ السَّمِیْعُ الْبَصِیْرُ
segs.en: O He whom nothing is like, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing;
segs.tr: YAA MAN LAYSA KAMISLEHI SHAY-UN WA HOWAS SAMEE-U’L BASEER

segs.ar: اَسْئَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّیَ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ.
segs.en: I ask You to bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
segs.tr: AS-ALOKA AN TOSALLEYA A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN.

segs.note: Then submit your needs; they will be granted, by the permission of Almighty Allah.
segs.ur: پھر اپنی حاجتیں مانگیں؛ اللہ تعالیٰ کے اذن سے وہ پوری کی جائیں گی۔

segs.note: Dua Ya Ajwada Man A’ta
segs.ur: دعا یا اجود من اعطیٰ

segs.note: Recite this dua, reported from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.):
segs.ur: امام صادق (ع) سے منقول یہ دعا پڑھیں:

segs.en: O Allah, O most Generous of those who give,
O Best of those who are asked,
and O most Merciful of those from whom mercy is sought.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِہٖ فِی الْاَوَّلِیْنَ
segs.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family among the first generations,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALEHI FIL AWWALEENA

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِہٖ فِی الْآخِرِیْنَ
segs.en: and bless Muhammad and his family among the latter generations,
segs.tr: WA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALEHI FIL AAKHEREENA

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِہٖ فِی الْمَلَاءِ الْاَعلٰی
segs.en: and bless Muhammad and his family in the highest assembly,
segs.tr: WA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALEHI FIL MALAA-IL A-A’LAA

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِہٖ فِی الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
segs.en: and bless Muhammad and his family among the messengers.
segs.tr: WA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALEHI FIL MURSALEENA

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَعْطِ مُحَمَّدًا وَآلِهِ الْوَسِیْلَۃَ الْفَضِیْلَۃَ
segs.en: O Allah, grant Muhammad and his family the right of mediation, the excellence,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA A-A’TE MOHAMMADAN WA AALEHIL WASEELATAL FAZEELATA

segs.en: the honor, the eminence, and the great station.
segs.tr: WASH SHARAFA WAR RIF-A’TA WAD DARAJATAL KABEERATA

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّی اٰمَنْتُ بِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّی اللهُ عَلَیْهِ وَآلِہٖ
segs.en: O Allah, I have believed in Muhammad—blessings of Allah be upon him and his family—
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AAMANTO BE-MOHAMMADIN SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI

segs.ar: وَلَمْ اَرَہٗ فَلَا تَحْرِمْنِیْ فِی الْقِیَامَۃِ رُؤْیَتَہٗ
segs.en: though I have not seen him, so do not deprive me of his vision on the Day of Resurrection;
segs.tr: WA LAM ARAHU FALAA TAHRIMNEE FIL QEYAAMATE ROAYATAHU

segs.en: grant me his companionship, cause me to die upon his creed,
segs.tr: WAR ZUQNEE SOHBATAHU WA TAWAFFANEE A’LAA MILLATEHI

segs.en: and give me to drink from his fountain a drink

segs.ar: رَوِیًّا سَآئِغًا هَنِیْٓئًا لَا اَظْمَاُ بَعْدَہٗ اَبَدًا
segs.en: that is quenching, easy to swallow, and pleasant, after which I shall never thirst again.
segs.tr: RAWIYYAN SAAA-EGHAN HANEE-AN LAA AZMA-O BA’DAHU ABADAN

segs.en: Indeed, You have power over all things.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّی اٰمَنْتُ بِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّی اَللهُ عَلَیْهِ وَآلِہٖ
segs.en: O Allah, I have believed in Muhammad—blessings of Allah be upon him and his family—
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AAMANTO BE-MOHAMMADIN SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI

segs.ar: وَلَمْ اَرَہٗ فَعَرِّفْنِیْ فِی الْجِنَانِ وَجْهَہٗ
segs.en: though I have not seen him, so make his face known to me in the gardens of Paradise.
segs.tr: WA LAM ARAHO FA-A’RRIFNEE FIL JENAANE WAJHAHU

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ بَلِّغْ مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّی اَللهُ عَلَیْهِ وَآلِہٖ
segs.en: O Allah, convey to Muhammad—blessings of Allah be upon him and his family—
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA BALLIGH MOHAMMADAN SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI

segs.en: abundant greetings and peace from me.

segs.note: Umm Dawood & Subhan Allah Zikr
segs.ur: ام داؤد اور سبحان اللہ کا ذکر

segs.note: Recite Dua Umm-e-Dawood.
segs.ur: [دعائے ام داؤد](X14) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Recite this doxology (zikr):
segs.ur: یہ ذکر پڑھیں:

segs.en: Glory be to Allah before everyone,
and Glory be to Allah after everyone,
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAL LAAHE BA’DA KULLE AHADIN

segs.en: and Glory be to Allah with everyone.
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAL LAAHE MA-A’ KULLE AHADIN

segs.ar: وَسُبْحَانَ اللهِ یَبْقٰی رَبُّنَا وَیَفْنٰی کُلُّ اَحَدٍ
segs.en: Glory be to Allah; our Lord remains while everyone perishes.
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAL LAAHE YABQAA RABBONAA WA YAFNAA KULLO AHADIN

segs.ar: وَسُبْحَانَ اللهِ تَسْبِیْحًا یَفْضُلُ تَسْبِیْحَ الْمُسَبِّحِیْنَ فَضْلًا كَثِیْرًا قَبْلَ کُلِّ اَحَدٍ
segs.en: Glory be to Allah with a glorification that excels the glorification of those who glorify Him by a great excellence before everyone.
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAL LAAHE TASBEEHAN YAFZOLO TASBEEHAL MOSABBEHEENA FAZLAN KASEERAN QABLA KULLE AHADIN

segs.ar: وَسُبْحَانَ اللهِ تَسْبِیْحًا یَفْضُلُ تَسْبِیْحَ الْمُسَبِّحِیْنَ فَضْلًا كَثِیْرًا بَعْدَ کُلِّ اَحَدٍ
segs.en: Glory be to Allah with a glorification that excels the glorification of those who glorify Him by a great excellence after everyone.
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAL LAAHE TASBEEHAN YAFZOLO TASBEEHAL MOSABBEHEENA FAZLAN KASEERAN BA’DA KULLE AHADIN

segs.ar: وَسُبْحَانَ اللهِ تَسْبِیْحًا یَفْضُلُ تَسْبِیْحَ الْمُسَبِّحِیْنَ فَضْلًا كَثِیْرًا مَعَ کُلِّ اَحَدٍ
segs.en: Glory be to Allah with a glorification that excels the glorification of those who glorify Him by a great excellence with everyone.
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAL LAAHE TASBEEHAN YAFZOLO TASBEEHAL MOSABBEHEENA FAZLAN KASEERAN MA-A’ KULLE AHADIN

segs.ar: وَسُبْحَانَ اللهِ تَسْبِیْحًا یَفْضُلُ تَسْبِیْحَ الْمُسَبِّحِیْنَ
segs.en: Glory be to Allah with a glorification that excels the glorification of those who glorify Him
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAL LAAHE TASBEEHAN YAFZOLO TASBEEHAL MOSABBEHEENA

segs.ar: فَضْلًا كَثِیْرًا لِرَبِّنَا الْبَاقِیْ وَیَفْنٰی کُلُّ اَحَدٍ
segs.en: by a great excellence for our Lord who remains while everyone perishes.
segs.tr: FAZLAN KASEERAN LE-RABBENAL BAAQEE WA YAFNAA KULLO AHADIN

segs.ar: وَسُبْحَانَ اللهِ تَسْبِیْحًا لَا یُحْصٰی وَلَا یُدْرٰی
segs.en: Glory be to Allah with a glorification that cannot be numbered, nor perceived,
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAL LAAHE TASBEEHAN LAA YOHSAA WA LAA YUDRAA

segs.ar: وَلَا یُنْسٰی وَلَا یَبْلٰی وَلَا یَفْنٰی وَلَیْسَ لَہٗ مُنْتَہٰی
segs.en: nor forgotten, nor worn out, nor exhausted, and for which there is no end.
segs.tr: WA LAA YUNSAA WA LAA YABLAA WA LAA YAFNAA WA LAYSA LAHU MUNTAHAA

segs.en: Glory be to Allah with a glorification that lasts with His everlastingness
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAL LAAHE TASBEEHAN YADOOMO BE-DAWAAMEHI

segs.en: and remains with His subsistence throughout the years of the worlds,
segs.tr: WA YABQAA BE-BAQAAA-EHI FEE SENIL A’ALAMEENA

segs.ar: وَشُهُوْرِ الدُّهُوْرِ وَاَیَّامِ الدُّنْیَا وَسَاعَاتِ اللَّیْلِ وَالنَّہَارِ.
segs.en: the months of the ages, the days of the world, and the hours of the night and the day.
segs.tr: WA SHOHOORID DOHOORE WA AYYAAMID DUNYAA WA SAA-A’ATIL LAYLE WAN NAHAARE.

segs.ar: وَسُبْحَانَ اللهِ اَبَدَا الْاَبَدِ وَمَعَ الْاَبَدِ مِمَّا لَا یُحْصِیْهِ الْعَدَدُ
segs.en: Glory be to Allah forever and ever, and alongside eternity—a glorification that numbers cannot count,
segs.tr: WA SUBHAANAL LAAHE ABADAL ABADE WA MA-A’L ABADE MIMMAA LAA YOHSEEHIL A’DADO

segs.note: Man Ta’abba’a & Zayn al-Abidin Duas
segs.ur: من تعبّأ اور زین العابدین کی دعائیں

segs.note: Recite the famous supplicatory prayer Dua Allahumma Man Ta’abba’a, which is its second tab.
segs.ur: مشہور دعا [دعائے اللهم من تعبّأ](AC10) پڑھیں، جو اس کا دوسرا ٹیب ہے۔

segs.note: Recite the supplicatory prayer ascribed to Imam Zayn al-Aabedin (a.s.), which begins ‘allaahumma antal laaho rabbul a’alameen’.
segs.ur: امام زین العابدین (ع) سے منسوب دعا پڑھیں، جو «اللهم أنت الله رب العالمین» سے شروع ہوتی ہے۔

segs.note: Recite the forty-seventh supplication of Saheefah al-Kaamelah al-Sajjaadiyyah, which comprises all the requirements of worldly and religious life, with reverence.
segs.ur: صحیفۂ کاملہ سجادیہ کی سینتالیسویں دعا، جو دنیاوی اور دینی زندگی کی تمام ضروریات پر مشتمل ہے، ادب و احترام کے ساتھ پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Praying for Your Brethren
segs.ur: اپنے بھائیوں کے لیے دعا

segs.note: Pray to Almighty Allah for the good of your brethren and sisters in faith, the alive and the dead.
segs.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ سے اپنے دینی بھائیوں اور بہنوں کی بھلائی کے لیے دعا کریں، چاہے وہ زندہ ہوں یا وفات پا چکے ہوں۔

segs.note: Last Hour before Sunset
segs.ur: غروب آفتاب سے پہلے کا آخری گھنٹہ

segs.note: In the last hour of the Arafah Day, recite:
segs.ur: یوم عرفہ کی آخری ساعت میں پڑھیں:

segs.ar: يَا رَبِّ اِنَّ ذُنُوْبِيْ لَا تَضُرُّكَ
segs.en: O my Lord, indeed my sins do not harm You,
segs.tr: YAA RABBE INNA ZONOOBEE LAA TAZURROKA

segs.en: and indeed Your forgiveness of me does not diminish You.
segs.tr: WA INNA MAGHFERATAKA LEE LAA TANQOSOKA

segs.en: So grant me that which does not diminish You,
and forgive me for that which does not harm You.
segs.tr: WAGH FIR LEE MAA LAA YAZURROKA

segs.note: Also recite:
segs.ur: نیز پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنِيْ خَيْرَ مَا عِنْدَكَ
segs.en: O Allah, do not deprive me of the good that is with You
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA LAA TAHRIMNEE KHAYRA MAA I’NDAKA

segs.en: because of the evil that is with me.

segs.ar: فَاِنْ اَنْتَ لَمْ تَرْحَمْنِيْ بِتَعَبِيْ وَنَصَبِيْ
segs.en: So if You do not have mercy upon me for my fatigue and my toil,
segs.tr: FA-IN ANTA LAM TARHAMNEE BE-TA-A’BEE WA NASABEE

segs.ar: فَلَا تَحْرِمْنِيْۤ اَجْرَ الْمُصَابِ عَلٰى مُصِيْبَتِهٖ
segs.en: then do not deprive me of the reward of the afflicted one for his affliction.
segs.tr: FA LAA TAHRIMNEE AJRAL MOSAABE A’LAA MOSEEBATEHI

segs.note: Immediately before sunset, recite Dua Asharaat.
segs.ur: غروب آفتاب سے ٹھیک پہلے [دعائے عشرات](E10) پڑھیں۔

A_AC11.merits:
Although it is not included with the feasts of Islam, the ninth of Zilhajj is one of the great feast days in Islam. On this day, Almighty Allah commanded His servants to obey and worship Him. He thus extended for them the tables of His benevolence and magnanimity. On this day too, Satan becomes abject, lowly, expelled, and angry more than any other day.

It is narrated that Imam Zayn al-Aabedin (a.s.), on the ninth of Zilhajj, heard someone begging people for financial aid. The Imam (a.s.) said to him, “Woe is you! On such a day, do you beg other than Almighty Allah? On this day, even fetuses in wombs are expected to be included with the mercy of Almighty Allah and they will be delighted.

Visiting Imam Husayn (a.s.): Its reward is equal to the reward of one thousand times of Hajj, one thousand times of Umrah, and one thousand times of jihad (holy war), and even more. The narrations entailing the great merits and rewards of visiting the holy tomb of Imam Husayn (a.s.) on the ninth of Zilhajj have been uninterruptedly reported. In fact, the reward of visiting the holy tomb of Imam Husayn (a.s.) and having the honor of attending therein is not less than the reward of attending on Mount Arafah and even more.

Prayer after Asr: One who offers this prayer will be granted the reward of attending on Mount Arafah and having all sins forgiven.

Fasting, ghusl and visiting: In al-Misbah, al-Kaf’ami says that it is recommended to observe fasting on the Arafah Day, unless fasting prevents from saying the supplications. It is also recommended to bathe oneself before midday (zohr) and to visit the holy tomb of Imam Husayn (a.s.) on day and night.

Prayers at midday: Al-Kaf’ami mentions these in al-Misbah. The four unit prayer is the prayer of Imam Ali Ameer al-Momineen (a.s.), which is also recommended on Fridays.

Zikr sequence: Sayyid Ibn Taaoos says in Iqbal al-Aamaal that this sequence is recommended.

Dua Ya Ajwada Man A’ta: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) said: If you wish to please Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad - peace be upon them all - you may say this invocation.

Subhan Allah zikr: The reward of this doxology is too much to be mentioned.

Dua of Imam Zayn al-Aabedin (a.s.): Shaykh al-Tusi mentions this supplicatory prayer in Misbah al-Mutahajjid, and it is also mentioned in the book ‘Mazaar al-Kabeer, p. 445’. It is worth mentioning that this supplicatory prayer is also advisably said during the ritual of al-wuqoof al-Arafah (Halting At Mount Arafah), which is one of the rituals of Hajj.

Praying for others: Many supplicatory prayers and acts of worship are reported to be done on this day for those who have the honor of being present on Mount Arafah. However, the best deed on this day is to pray Almighty Allah, since the most distinctive feature of the Arafah Day is praying. The narration that has reported the manner of Abdullah ibn Jundab - may Allah have mercy upon him - during the ritual of halting on Mount Arafah when he prayed Almighty Allah for the good of his brethren-in-faith is too famous to be denied. Similarly,  Zayd al-Narsi has reported that Mu’awiyah ibn Wahab - the dignified, trustworthy scholar - prayed Almighty Allah for the good of his brethren-in-faith in names during the ritual of the halting at Mount Arafah on the Arafah Day. He then reported that Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) mentioned a great merit for anyone who prays for the good of his brethren-in-faith on Mount Arafah on the ninth of Zilhajj. In fact, this narration is worth ponderation and consideration.

Dua Asharaat: Sayyid Ibn Tawus has advised that immediately before sunset, one may say Dua al-Asharaat. Accordingly, it is important not to neglect Dua al-Asharaat at the end of the Arafah Day since it is recommended to say this supplicatory prayer each morning and evening. It is worth mentioning that the supplicatory prayers that are mentioned by al-Kaf’ami, as well as Sayyid Ibn Taaoos, are the same as the ones with which Dua al-Asharaat ends.

A_AC12.name: Dua of Imam Husayn (a.s.) on the Day of Arafah

segs.en: In the Name of Allah, the All-compassionate, the All-merciful.

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِیْ لَیْسَ لِقَضَآئِہٖ دَافِعٌ
segs.en: Praise be to Allah Whose determination cannot be repelled by anything,
segs.tr: ALHAMDO LILLAAHIL LAZEE LAYSA LEQAZAAA-EHI DAAFE-U’N

segs.en: Whose gifts cannot be stopped by anything,
and Whose making cannot be resembled by the making of anyone.
He is the All-magnanimous, the All-liberal.
He originated the genus of the wonderfully created things
and He perfected the made things by His wisdom.
All growing things cannot be hidden from Him
and all things deposited with Him shall never be wasted.

segs.ar: جَازِیْ كُلِّ صَانِعٍ وَرَآئِشُ كُلِّ قَانِعٍ
segs.en: He is the Repayer on every deed, the Enricher of every satisfied one,
segs.tr: JAAZEE KULLE SAANE-I’N WA RA-AAA-ESHO KULLE QAANE-I’N

segs.en: the Merciful toward every suppliant, and the Revealer of the benefits
segs.tr: WA RAAHEMO KULLE ZAA-RE-I’N WA MUNZELUL MANAA-FE-E’

segs.en: and the All-comprehensive Book with the glaring light.
He is also the Hearer of prayers,
the Warder-off of anguishes, the Raiser of ranks,
segs.tr: WA LIL-KOROBAATE DAA-FE-U’N WA LID-DARAJAATE RAAFE-U’N

segs.en: and the Suppressor of the tyrants. There is no god other than Him
segs.tr: WA LILJABAABERATE QAAME-U’N FALAA ELAAHA GHAYROHU

segs.en: and there is nothing equivalent to Him

segs.ar: وَلَیْسَ كَمِثْلِہٖ شَیْءٌ وَهُوَ السَّمِیْعُ الْبَصِیْرُ
segs.en: and nothing like a likeness of Him, and He is the All-hearing, the All-seeing,
segs.tr: WA LAYSA KAMISLEHI SHAYUN WA HOWAS SAMEE-U’L BASEERUL

segs.ar: اللَّطِیْفُ الْخَبِیْرُ وَهُوَ عَلٰی كُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیْرٌ
segs.en: the All-gentle, the All-aware, and He has power over all things.
segs.tr: LATEEFUL KHABEERO WA HOWA A’LAA KULLE SHAY-IN QADEERUN

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَرْغَبُ اِلَیْكَ وَاَشْهَدُ بِالرُّبُوْبِیَّۃِ لَكَ
segs.en: O Allah, I willingly desire for You and I testify to the Lordship of You,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE ARGHABO ELAYKA WA ASH-HADO BIR-ROBOOBIYYATE LAKA

segs.en: confessing that You are verily my Lord
and to You shall be my return. You had begun bestowing on me
segs.tr: WA ANNA ELAYKA MARADDEE IBTADAA-TANEE BE-NE’MATEKA

segs.en: before I was anything worth mentioning,

segs.ar: وَخَلَقْتَنِیْ مِنَ تُّرَابِ ثُمَّ اَسْكَنْتَنِیْ الْاَصْلَابَ
segs.en: and You created me from dust. You then put me up in the loins,
segs.tr: WA KHALAQTANEE MENAT TORAABE SUMMA ASKANTANIL ASLAABA

segs.ar: اٰمِنًا لِرَیْبَ الْمَنُوْنَ وَاخْتِلَافِ الدُّهُوْرِ وَالسِّنِیْنَ
segs.en: (making me) saved from vicissitudes of time, and change of ages and years.
segs.tr: AAMENAN LERAYBIL MANOONE WAKHTELAAFID DOHOORE WAS SENEENA

segs.ar: فَلَمْ اَزَلْ ظَاعِنًا مِنْ صُلْبٍ اِلٰی رَحْمٍ
segs.en: I was moving from a loin to a womb
segs.tr: FALAM AZAL ZAA-E’NAN MIN SULBIN ELAA RAHEMIN

segs.en: throughout the passage of the past days
and the ancient ages;
as You have not taken me out (to this world) — on account of Your sympathy to me,
and Your kindness to me, and Your compassion to me —
segs.tr: WA LUTFEKA LEE WA EHSAANEKA ELAYYA

segs.en: in the government of the heads of unbelief
who breached their covenant with You and denied Your messengers.
segs.tr: LAZEENA NAQAZOO A’HDAKA WA KAZZABOO ROSOLAKA

segs.ar: لٰكِنَّكَ اَخْرَجْتَنِیْ لِلَّذِیْ سَبَقَ لِیْ مِنَ الْهُدٰی
segs.en: However, You took me out on account of the guidance that You have already known about me
segs.tr: LAAKINNAKA AKHRAJTANIL LILLAZEE SABAQA LEE MENAL HODAL

segs.en: and You have made easy the way to it and You have brought me up in it.
segs.tr: LAZEE LAHU YASSARTANEE WA FEEHE ANSHAATANEE

segs.ar: وَمِنْ قَبْلِ ذٰلِكَ رَؤُفْتَ‏ بِیْ بِجَمِیْلِ صُنْعِكَ
segs.en: Even before that, You had compassion on me, through Your excellent conferral
segs.tr: WA MIN QABLE RA-UFTA BEE BEJAMEELE SUN-E’KA

segs.en: and Your affluent bestowals.
So, You fashioned my creation from semen that gushed forth
and put me up in triple darkness

segs.ar: بَیْنَ لَحْمٍ وَّدَمٍ وَّجِلْدٍ لَمْ تُشْهِدْنِیْ خَلْقِیْ
segs.en: among flesh, blood, and skin. You have not made me witness my creation,
segs.tr: BAYNA LAHMIN WA DAMINW WA JILDIN LAM TUSH-HIDNEE KHALQEE

segs.ar: وَلَمْ تَجْعَلْ اِلَیَّ شَیْئًا مِّنْ اَمْرِیْ
segs.en: and You have not referred any part of my creation to me.
segs.tr: WA LAM TAJ-A’L ELAYYA SHAY-AM MIN AMREE

segs.ar: ثُمَّ اَخْرَجْتَنِیْ لِلَّذِیْ سَبَقَ لِیْ مِنَ الْهُدٰی
segs.en: You then took me out on account of the guidance that You have already known about me
segs.tr: SUMMA AKHRAJTANEE LIL-LAZEE SABAQA LEE MENAL HODAA

segs.en: to the world, perfect and in sound health.
You have safeguarded me in the cradle
segs.tr: WA HAFIZTANEE FIL MAHDE TIFLAN SABIYYAN

segs.en: as small child. You have provided me with wholesome milk as food.
segs.tr: WA RAZAQTANEE MENAL GHEZAAA-E LABANAN MARIYYAN

segs.en: You have made the hearts of the nursemaids tender.
You have given me into the charge of merciful mothers.
You have saved me from the visits of the Jinn.
And You have delivered me from increase and decrease.
segs.tr: WA SALLAMTANEE MENAZ ZEYAADATE WAN NUQSAANE

segs.en: So, Exalted be You, O All-merciful,
O All-beneficent. When I commenced (my life) by pronouncing words,
You perfected for me the affluent bestowals,
and brought me up with an increase every year.
segs.tr: WA RABBAYTANEE ZAAYEDAN FEE KULLE A’AMIN

segs.en: When my creation was accomplished,
and my power became straight, You put me under the obligation of Your Claim,
segs.tr: WA’ TADALAT MIRRATEE AWJABTA A’LAYYA HUJJATAKA

segs.en: which is that You inspired me with recognition of You
and alarmed me by the wonders of Your wisdom,

segs.ar: وَاَیْقَظْتَنِیْ لِمَا ذَرَأْتَ فِیْ سَمَآئِكَ وَاَرْضِكَ
segs.en: and awakened me to what You created in Your heavens and Your earth
segs.tr: WA AYQAZTANEE LEMAA ZARAATA FEE SAMAAA-EKA WA ARZEKA

segs.en: which is the excellent creation of You.
You attracted my attentions to thank and mention You.
You made obligatory on me to obey and worship You.
segs.tr: WA AWJABTA A’LAYYA TAA-A’TAKA WA E’BAADATAKA

segs.en: You made me understand that with which Your Apostles came.
segs.tr: WA FAHHAMTANEE MAA JAA-AT BEHI ROSOLOKA

segs.en: You made easy for me to find agreeable Your pleasure.
You bestowed upon me with the favor of all that,
segs.tr: WA MANANTA A’LAYYA FEE JAMEE-E’ ZAALEKA

segs.ar: بِعَوْنِكَ وَلُطْفِكَ ثُمَّ اِذْ خَلَقْتَنِیْ مِنْ خَیْرِ الثَّرٰی
segs.en: out of Your aid and Your gentleness. As You created me from the best of soil,
segs.tr: BE-A’WNEKA WA LUTFEKA SUMMA IZ KHALAQTANEE MIN KHAYRIS SARAA

segs.ar: لَمْ تَرْضَ لِیْ یَا اِلٰهِیْ نِعْمَۃً دُوْنَ اُخْرٰی
segs.en: You, my God, have not wanted for me to have a certain favor (and to be deprived of another)
segs.tr: LAM TARZA LEE YAA ELAAHI NE’MATAN DOONA UKHRAA

segs.en: and You therefore provided me with the various kinds of living

segs.ar: وَصُنُوْفِ الرِّیَاشِ بِمَنِّكَ الْعَظِیْمِ الْاَعْظَمِ عَلَیَّ
segs.en: and types of wealth, out of Your great and grand conferral upon me,
segs.tr: WA SONOOFIR REYAASHE BEMANNEKAL A’ZEEMIL A-A’ZAME A’LAYYA

segs.ar: وَاِحْسَانِكَ الْقَدِیْمِ اِلَیَّ حَتّٰی اِذَا اَتْمَمْتَ عَلَیَّ جَمِیْعَ النِّعَمِ
segs.en: and Your eternal kindness to me. As You perfected for me all the graces
segs.tr: WA EHSAANEKAL QADEEME ELAYYA HATTAA EZAA ATMAMTA A’LAYYA JAMEE-A’N NE-A’ME

segs.ar: وَصَرَفْتَ عَنِّیْ كُلَّ النِّقَمِ لَمْ یَمْنَعْكَ جَهْلِیْ وَجُرْاَتِیْ عَلَیْكَ
segs.en: and warded off all misfortunes, my ignorance of You and challenge have not stopped You
segs.tr: WA SARAFTA A’NNEE KULLAN NEQAME LAM YAMNA’KA JAHLEE WA JUR-ATEE A’LAYKA

segs.ar: اَنْ دَلَلْتَنِیْ اِلٰی مَا یُقَرِّبُنِیْ اِلَیْكَ
segs.en: from showing me that which takes me near to You,
segs.tr: AN DALALTANEE ELAA MAA YOQARREBONEE ELAYKA

segs.en: and from leading me to that which grants me proximity to You.

segs.ar: فَاِنْ دَعَوْتُكَ اَجَبْتَنِیْ وَاِنْ سَئَلْتُكَ اَعْطَیْتَنِیْ
segs.en: So, if I pray You, You will respond to me; and if I beg You, You will give me;
segs.tr: FA-IN DA-A’WTOKA AJABTANEE WA IN SA-ALTOKA A-A’TAYTANEE

segs.ar: وَاِنْ اَطَعْتُكَ شَكَرْتَنِیْ وَاِنْ شَكَرْتُكَ زِدْتَنِیْ
segs.en: and if I obey You, You will thank me; and if I thank You, You will give me more.
segs.tr: WA IN ATA’TOKA SHAKARTANEE WA IN SHAKARTOKA ZID-TANEE

segs.en: All that is completion of Your favors for me,
and Your kindness to me. So, all glory be to You; all glory be to You.
You are verily Originator and Reproducer (of the creation) and
worthy of all praise and full of all glory.
Holy be Your Names as Your bounties are so immeasurable.

segs.ar: فَاَیُّ نِعَمِكَ یَا اِلٰهِیْ اُحْصِیْ عَدَدًا وَّذِكْرًا
segs.en: Which of Your favors, O my God, can I count in numbers and examples?
segs.tr: FA-AYYO NE-A’MEKA YAA ELAAHEE OHSEE A’DADANW WA ZIKRAN

segs.ar: اَمْ اَیُّ عَطَایَاكَ اَقُوْمُ بِهَا شُكْرًا
segs.en: Or which of Your gifts can I thank properly?
segs.tr: AM AYYO A’TAAYAAKA AQOOMO BEHAA SHUKRAN

segs.ar: وَهِیَ یَا رَبِّ اَكْثَرُ مِنْ اَنْ یُّحْصِیَهَا الْعَآدُّوْنَ
segs.en: They are, O my Lord, too numerous to be counted by counters
segs.tr: WA HEYA YAA RABBE AKSARO MIN AN-Y YOHSEYAHAL A’AAD-DOONA

segs.en: or to be realized by memorizers.
Moreover, that which You have warded off and repelled,
segs.tr: SUMMA MAA SARAFTA WA DARAATA A’NNEE

segs.en: O Allah, from (the various kinds of) harm and mischief

segs.ar: اَكْثَرَ مِمَّا ظَهَرَ لِیْ مِنَ الْعَافِیَۃِ وَالسَّرَّآءِ
segs.en: is more than that which came to me from wellbeing and joy.
segs.tr: AKSARA MIMMAA ZAHARA LEE MENAL A’AFEYATE WAS SARRAAA-E

segs.ar: وَاَنَا اَشْهَدُ یَا اِلٰهِیْ بِحَقِیْقَۃِ اِیْمَانِیْ
segs.en: And I bear witness, O my God, with my true belief,
segs.tr: WA ANAA ASH-HADO YAA ELAAHEE BEHAQEEQATE EEMAANEE

segs.en: and the fortitude of the determinations of my conviction
and the purity of my open belief in Your Oneness
and the essence of the secret of my conscience,
and the ties of the canals of the light of my sight,
and the lines of my forehead
and the hollows of the courses of my breath,
and the (nasal) cavities of my nose,
and the courses of the meatus of my hearing,
and whatever my two lips hide and cover up,
segs.tr: WA MAA ZUMMAT WA ATBAQAT A’LAYHE SHAFATAAYA

segs.en: and the motions of the vocalization of my tongue,
and the socket of the palate of my mouth and jaw,
segs.tr: WA MAGHRAZE HANAKE FAMEE WA FAKKEE

segs.en: and the matrices of my dents,
and the tasting of my food and my drink,
and the bearer of my skull,
and the tube of the tissues of my neck
and what is included by the cloak of my chest,
segs.tr: WA MASH TAMALA A’LAYHE TAAMOORO SADREE

segs.ar: وَحَمَایِلِ حَبْلِ وَتِیْنِیْ وَنِیَاطِ حِجَابِ قَلْبِیْ
segs.en: and the carriers of the cord of my aorta, and the cords of the pericardium of my heart,
segs.tr: WA HAMAA-YELE HABLE WATEENEE WA NEYAATE HEJAABE QALBEE

segs.en: and the pieces of the retinues of my liver,
and that which is included by the cartilages of my ribs,
and the cavities of my joints, and the interactings of my organisms,
segs.tr: WA HEQAAQO MAFAASELEE WA QABZO AWAAMELEE

segs.en: and the extremes of my fingertips, and my flesh, and my blood,
segs.tr: WA ATRAAFO ANAAMELEE WA LAHMEE WA DAMEE

segs.en: and my hair, and my skin, and my nerve, and my sinews,
segs.tr: WA SHA’REE WA BASHAREE WA A’SABEE WA QASABEE

segs.en: and my bones, and my brain, and my veins, and all of my organs,
segs.tr: WA E’ZAAMEE WA MUKHKHI WA O’ROOQEE WA JAMEE-E’ JAWAAREHEE

segs.ar: وَمَا انْتَسَجَ عَلٰی ذٰلِكَ اَیَّامَ رِضَاعِیْ
segs.en: and that which was pieced together during the days of my suckling,
segs.tr: WA MAN TASAJA A’LAA ZAALEKA AYYAAMA REZAA-E’E

segs.en: and whatever of my body that the ground carries,
and my sleeping, and my wakefulness, and my motionlessness,
segs.tr: WA NAWMEE WA YAQAZATEE WA SOKOONEE

segs.en: and the movements of my bowing and prostration;

segs.ar: اَنْ لَوْ حَاوَلْتُ وَاجْتَهَدْتُ مَدَی الْاَعْصَارِ
segs.en: (by all that I bear witness) that if I try my best and strive throughout all ages
segs.tr: AN LAW HAAWALTO WAJ TAHADTO MADAL A-A’SAARE

segs.en: and all times, if I live them,

segs.ar: اَنْ اُؤَدِّیَ شُكْرَ وَاحِدَۃٍ مِنْ اَنْعُمِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ ذٰلِكَ
segs.en: to thank properly only one of Your favors, I will not be able to do that,
segs.tr: AN O-ADDEYA SHUKRA WAAHEDATIN MIN AN-O’MEKA MAS TATA’TO ZAALEKA

segs.ar: اِلَّا بِمَنِّكَ الْمُوْجِبِ عَلَیَّ بِہٖ شُكْرَكَ
segs.en: except through a favor of You, which also requires me to thank You for it,
segs.tr: ILLAA BEMANNEKAL MOOJEBE A’LAYYA BEHI SHUKRAKA

segs.en: once again with new thanking and with praise that is newly acquired and newly prepared.
segs.tr: ABADAN JADEEDAN WA SANAAA-AN TAAREFAN A’TEEDAN

segs.ar: اَجَلْ وَلَوْ حَرَصْتُ اَنَا وَالْعَآدُّوْنَ مِنْ اَنَامِكَ
segs.en: True is this! And if I try hard, as well as the counters from Your creatures,
segs.tr: AJAL WA LAW HARASTO ANAA WAL A’AAD-DOONA MIN ANAAMEKA

segs.ar: اَنْ نُحْصِیَ مَدٰی اِنْعَامِكَ سَالِفِہٖ وَاٰنِفِہٖ
segs.en: to count the scope of Your favoring, both the past and the present,
segs.tr: AN NOHSEYA MADAA IN-A’AMEKA SAALEFEHI WA AANEFEHI

segs.ar: مَا حَصَرْنَاهُ عَدَدًا وَلَاْ اَحْصَیْنَاهُ اَمَدًا
segs.en: we shall never be able to calculate it in number, or count it in time.
segs.tr: MAA HASARNAAHO A’DADAN WA LAA AHSAYNAAHO AMADAN

segs.en: Too far is this! How can it be!
While it is You Who have informed in Your rational Book
segs.tr: WA ANTAL MUKHBERO FEE KETAABEKAN NAATEQE

segs.en: and true news:

segs.ar: وَاِنْ تَعُدُّوْا نِعْمَۃَ اﷲِ لَاْ تُحْصُوْهَا
segs.en: “And if you count Allah's favors, you will not be able to number them.”
segs.tr: WA IN TA-U’DDOO NE’MATAL LAAHE LAA TOHSOOHAA

segs.en: True is Your Book, O Allah, and Your informing.
Your Prophets and Messengers have conveyed
what You revealed to them, from Your Revelation,
and what You have made plain for them and through them Your religion.
segs.tr: WA SHARA’TA LAHUM WA BEHIM MIN DEENEKA

segs.en: Nevertheless, O my God,
I bear witness by my ultimate possibility and my diligence

segs.ar: وَمَبْلَغِ طَاعَتِیْ وَوُسْعِیْ وَاَقُوْلُ مُؤْمِنًا مُوْقِیًا
segs.en: and the scope of my vigor and my capacity, and I say with full faith and conviction:
segs.tr: WA MABLAGHE TAA-A’TEE WA WUS-E’E WA AQOOLO MOA-MENAN MOOQENAN

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِیْ لَمْ یَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا فَیَكُوْنَ مَوْرُوْثًا
segs.en: All praise be to Allah Who has not taken to Himself a son to be inherited,
segs.tr: ALHAMDO LILLAAHIL LAZEE LAM YATTAKHIZ WALADAN FAYAKOONO MAWROOSAN

segs.ar: وَلَمْ یَكُنْ لَّہٗ شَرِیْكٌ فِیْ مُلْكِہٖ
segs.en: and Who does not have a partner in His kingdom,
segs.tr: WA LAM YAKUL LAHU SHAREEKUN FEE MULKEHI

segs.en: to oppose Him in what He fashions,
and Who does not have a helper to save Him from disgrace,
to help Him in what He makes. So, glory be to Him, glory be to Him.

segs.ar: لَوْ كَانَ فِیْهِمَا اٰلِهَۃٌ اِلَّا اﷲُ
segs.en: If there had been in them any gods except Allah, they would both have
segs.tr: LAW KAANA FEEHEMAA AALEHATUN ILLAL LAAHO

segs.en: certainly been in a state of disorder and destruction.
All glory be to Allah, the One, the Only One, the Besought of all,

segs.ar: الَّذِیْ لَمْ یَلِدْ وَلَمْ یُوْلَدْ وَلَمْ یَكُنْ لَّہٗ كُفُوًا اَحَدٌ
segs.en: Who begets not nor is He begotten, and there is none like Him.
segs.tr: LAZEE LAM YALID WA LAM YOOLAD WA LAM YAKUL LAHU KOFOWAN AHADUN

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ حَمْدًا یُعَادِلُ حَمْدَ مَلَآئِكَتِهِ الْمُقَرَّبِیْنَ
segs.en: All praise be to Allah — praise that is equal to the praise of His Favorite Angels,
segs.tr: ALHAMDO LILLAAHE HAMDAN YO-A’ADELO HAMDA MALAAA-EKATEHIL MOQARRABEENA

segs.ar: وَاَنْۢبِیَآئِهِ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ وَصَلَّی اﷲُ عَلٰی خِیَرَتِہٖ
segs.en: and His missioned Prophets. May Allah send blessings to His Select,
segs.tr: WA AMBEYAAA-EHIL MURSALEENA WA SALLAL LAAHO A’LAA KHEYARATEHI

segs.en: Muhammad, the Seal of Prophets,
and upon his Household, the pure, immaculate,
and well-chosen, and may He send benedictions upon them.

segs.note: Imam (a.s.) then besought Almighty Allah so earnestly that his eyes shed tears. He then said:
segs.ur: پھر امام (ع) نے اللہ تعالیٰ کی بارگاہ میں اتنے اخلاص سے التجا کی کہ آپ کی آنکھوں سے آنسو بہہ پڑے۔ پھر آپ نے فرمایا:

segs.en: O Allah, (please) make me fear You as if I can see You.
Make happy by fearing You. Do not make me unhappy by disobeying You.
segs.tr: WA AS-I’DNEE BETAQWAAKA WA LAA TUSHQENEE BEMA’SEYATEKA

segs.ar: وَخِرْ لِیْ فِیْ قَضَآئِكَ وَبَارِكْ لِیْ فِیْ قَدَرِكَ
segs.en: Choose for me through Your decree. Bless me through Your determination,
segs.tr: WA KHIR LEE FEE QAZAAA-EKA WA BAARIK LEE FEE QADAREKA

segs.ar: حَتّٰی لَاْ اُحِبَّ تَعْجِیْلَ مَا اَخَّرْتَ
segs.en: so that I will not long for hastening that which You have delayed
segs.tr: HATTAA LAA OHIBBA TA’JEELA MAA AKHKHARTA

segs.en: or delaying that which You would hasten.
O Allah, (please) make my richness in my conscience,

segs.ar: وَالْیَقِیْنَ فِیْ قَلْبِیْ وَالْاِخْلَاصَ فِیْ عَمْلِیْ
segs.en: conviction in my heart, sincerity in my deeds,
segs.tr: WAL YAQEENA FEE QALBEE WAL IKHLAASA FEE A’MALEE

segs.ar: وَالنُّوْرَ فِی بَصَرِیْ وَالْبَصِیْرَۃَ فِیْ دِیْنِیْ
segs.en: light in my sight, and insight in my religion.
segs.tr: WAN NOORA FEE BASAREE WAL-BASEERATA FEE DEENEE

segs.en: Make me find enjoyment in my organs.
Make my hearing and my sight sound until I am inherited.
segs.tr: WAJ A’L SAM-E’E WA BASAREYAL WAARESAINE MINNEE

segs.en: Grant me victory over him who wrongs me,
make me witness my avenge and objective in him,
segs.tr: WA ARENEE FEEHE SAAREE WA MAA-REBEE

segs.en: and make it the delight of my eye.
O Allah, (please) relieve my agony,
conceal my flaws, forgive my sin,
segs.tr: WAS TUR A’WRATEE WAGH FIR LEE KHATEE-ATEE

segs.en: drive away my devil from me, redeem my mortgage,
segs.tr: WAKH SAA SHAYTAANEE WA FUKKA REHAANEE

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ لِیْ یَا اِلٰهِی الدَّرَجَۃَ الْعُلْیَا فِی الْاٰخِرَۃِ وَالْاُوْلٰی
segs.en: and decide for me, O my God, the supreme rank in the Hereafter and in the former (life).
segs.tr: WAJ A’L LEE YAA ELAAHID DARAJATAL U’LYAA FIL AAKHERATE WAL OOLAA

segs.en: O Allah, all praise be to You for You have created me
and made me hear and see.
All praise be to You for you have created me
and made my creation perfect, on account of Your having mercy on me,
and You could dispense with creating me.
segs.tr: WA QAD KUNTA A’N KHALQEE GHANIYYAN

segs.en: O my Lord, as You gave rise to me and perfected my creation;
O my Lord, as You originated me and did well my form;

segs.ar: رَبِّ بِمَا اَحْسَنْتَ اِلَیَّ وَفِیْ نَفْسِیْ عَافَیْتَنِیْ
segs.en: O my Lord, as You conferred favors on me and granted me wellbeing in myself;
segs.tr: RABBE BEMAA AHSANTA ELAYYA WA FEE NAFSEE A’AFAYTANEE

segs.en: O my Lord, as You saved me and led me to success;
O my Lord, as You bestowed favors on me and guided me;

segs.ar: رَبِّ بِمَا اَوْلَیْتَنِیْ وَمِنْ كُلِّ خَیْرٍ اَعْطَیْتَنِیْ
segs.en: O my Lord, as You presented me and gave me from every good;
segs.tr: RABBE BEMAA AWLAYTANEE WA MIN KULLE KHAYRIN A-A’TAYTANEE

segs.en: O my Lord, as you fed me and watered me;
O my Lord, as You enriched me and gave me to hold;
O my Lord, as You helped me and braced me;

segs.ar: رَبِّ بِمَا اَلْبَسْتَنِیْ مِنْ سِتْرِكَ الصَّافِیْ
segs.en: O my Lord, as you clothed me from Your pure cover
segs.tr: RABBE BEMAA ALBASTANEE MIN SITREKAS SAAFEE

segs.en: and made easy for me Your adequate making,
segs.tr: WA YASSARTA LEE MIN SUN-E’KAL KAAFEE

segs.en: so, (please) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: help me against calamities of ages
and changes of nights and days,

segs.ar: وَنَجِّنِیْ مِنْ اَهْوَالِ الدُّنْیَا وَكُرُبَاتِ الْاٰخِرَۃِ
segs.en: rescue me from the horrors of this world and the anguishes of the Hereafter,
segs.tr: WA NAJJENEE MIN AHWAALID DUNYAA WA KOROBAATIL AAKHERATE

segs.ar: وَاكْفِنِیْ شَرَّ مَا یَعْمَلُ الظَّالِمُوْنَ فِی الْاَرْضِ
segs.en: and save me from the evils of what the wrongdoers do in the earth.
segs.tr: WAK FENEE SHARRA MAA YA’MALUZ ZAALEMOONA FIL ARZE

segs.en: O Allah, as to what I anticipate, (please) save me (from it).
As to what I watch out, (please) protect me (against it).

segs.ar: وَفِیْ نَفْسِیْ وَدِیْنِیْ فَاحْرُسْنِیْ وَفِیْ سَفَرِیْ فَاحْفَظْنِیْ
segs.en: Safeguard me in my soul and religion, watch over me in my journeys,
segs.tr: WA FEE NAFSEE WA DEENEE FAHRUSNEE WA FEE SAFAREE FAHFAZNEE

segs.en: be in charge of my family members and properties during my absence,
segs.tr: WA FEE AHLEE WA MAALEE FAKHLUFNEE

segs.en: bless me in that which You provide as sustenance,
segs.tr: WA FEE MAA RAZAQTANEE FABAARIK LEE

segs.ar: وَفِیْ نَفْسِیْ فَذَلِّلْنِیْ وَفِیْ اَعْیُنِ النَّاسِ فَعَظِّمْنِیْ
segs.en: make me see myself as humble, make people see me as great,
segs.tr: WA FEE NAFSEE FA-ZALLILNEE WA FEE A-A’YONIN NAASE FA-A’ZZIMNEE

segs.en: keep me sound from the evils of the Jinn and people,
segs.tr: WA MIN SHARRIL JINNE WAL INSE FASALLIMNEE

segs.en: do not disclose me because of my sins,
do not disgrace me because of the secret side (of myself),
do not try me in my deeds,
do not deprive me of Your bounties,
and do not refer me to anyone other than You.
To whom do You entrust me?
To a relative, and he will rupture my relation with him!
Or to a strange, and he will glower at me!
Or to those who deem me weak!
While You are my Lord and the master of my affairs!
segs.tr: WA ANTA RABBEE WA MALEEKO AMREE

segs.en: I complain to You about my alienation and my foreignness
segs.tr: ASHKOO ELAYKA GURBATEE WA BO’DA DAAREE
