segs.en: and my ignominy in the eyes of him whom You have given domination over me.
segs.tr: WA HAWAANEE A’LAA MAN MALLAKTAHU AMREE

segs.en: So, O my God, do not make Your wrath come upon me.

segs.ar: فَاِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ غَضِبْتَ عَلَیَّ فَلَاْ اُبَالِیْ
segs.en: If You are not wrathful with me, then I care for nothing save You.
segs.tr: FA-IN LAM TAKUN GHAZIBTA A’LAYYA FALAA OBAALEE

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ غَیْرَ اَنَّ عَافِیَتَكَ اَوْسَعُ لِیْ
segs.en: All glory be to You; yet, Your granting me wellbeing is more favorable for me.
segs.tr: SUBHAANAKA GHAYRA ANNA A’AFEYATAKA AWSA-O’ LEE

segs.en: So, I beseech You, O my Lord, in the name of the Light of Your Face
to which the earth and the heavens have shone,
segs.tr: LAZEE ASHRAQAT LAHUL ARZO WAS SAMAAWAATO

segs.en: by which all darkness has been uncovered,
and by which the affairs of the past and the coming generations are made right,
segs.tr: WA SALOHA BEHI AMRUL AWWALEENA WAL AAKHEREENA

segs.en: do not cause me to die while You are wrathful with me
and do not inflict on me Your rage.
You have the right to scold; You have the right to scold;

segs.ar: حَتّٰی تَرْضٰیْ قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ لَاْ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ
segs.en: until You are pleased (with me) before that. There is no god save You;
segs.tr: HATTAA TARZAA QABLA ZAALEKA LAA ELAAHA ILLAA ANTA

segs.en: Lord of the Holy City, the Holy Monument,
segs.tr: RABBAL BALADIL HARAAME WAL MASHA’RIL HARAAME

segs.en: and the Ancient House that You have encompassed with blessing
segs.tr: WAL BAYTIL A’TEEQIL LAZEE AHLALTAHUL BARAKATA

segs.en: and made security for people.

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ عَفَا عَنْ عَظِیْمِ الذُّنُوْبِ بِحِلْمِہٖ
segs.en: O He Who pardoned the grand sins by His forbearance!
segs.tr: YAA MAN A’FAA A’N A’ZEEMIZ ZONOOBE BEHILMEHI

segs.en: O He Who bestowed bounties by His favoring!
O He Who gave in abundance by His generosity!

segs.ar: یَا عُدَّتِیْ فِیْ شِدَّتِیْ وَیَا صَاحِبِیْ فِیْ وَحْدَتِیْ
segs.en: O my means in my hardship! O my companion in my loneliness!
segs.tr: YAA U’DDATEE FEE SHIDDATEE YAA SAAHEBEE FEE WAHDATEE

segs.ar: یَا غِیَاثِیْ فِیْ كُرْبَتِیْ یَا وَلِیِّ فِیْ نِعْمَتِیْ
segs.en: O my relief in my agony! O my Benefactor in my amenities!
segs.tr: YAA GHEYAASEE FEE KURBATEE YAA WALIYYEE FEE NEA’MATEE

segs.en: O my God and the God of my forefathers:
Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, and Jacob;
segs.tr: IBRAAHEEMA WA ISMAA-E’ELA WA ISHAAQA WA YA’QOOBA

segs.en: the Lord of Gabriel, Michael, and Seraph;
segs.tr: WA RABBA JABRA-EELA WA MEEKAA-EELA WA ISRAAFEELA

segs.en: the Lord of Muhammad, the Seal of Prophets,
and his elite Household; the Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel,
segs.tr: WA AALEHIL MUNTAJABEENA WA MUNZELAT TAWRAATE WAL INJEELE

segs.en: the Psalms, and the Furqan;
the Revealer of kaaf-haa-yaa-ayn-saad and Taa-haa, Yaa-seen,
segs.tr: WA MONAZZELA KAAAF-HAAA-YAAA-A’YN-SAAD WA TAAHAA WA YAAASIN

segs.en: and the Quran, full of wisdom.

segs.ar: اَنْتَ كَهْفِيْ حِیْنَ تُعْیِیْنِيْ الْمَذَاهِبُ فِيْ سَعَتِهَا
segs.en: You are my haven when the wide courses fail to carry me
segs.tr: ANTA KAHFEE HEENA TO’YEENIL MAZAAHEBO FEE SA-A’TEHAA

segs.en: and when the earth, despite its width, become too narrow to bear me.

segs.ar: وَلَوْلَاْ رَحْمَتُكَ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْهَالِكِیْنَ وَاَنْتَ مُقِیْلُ عَثْرَتِیْ
segs.en: Without Your mercy, I would have been of those perishing. You overlook my slips;
segs.tr: WA LAWLAA RAHMATOKA LAKUNTO MENAL HAALEKEENA WA ANTA MOQEELO A’SRATEE

segs.ar: وَلَوْلَاْ سَتْرُكَ اِیَّایَ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَفْضُوْحِیْنَ
segs.en: and without Your covering me, I would have been of those exposed.
segs.tr: WA LAWLAA SATROKA IYYAAYA LAKUNTO MENAL MAFZOOHEENA

segs.en: You aid me with Your support against my enemies;
segs.tr: WA ANTA MOAYYEDEE BIN-NASRE A’LAA A-A’DAAA-EE

segs.ar: وَلَوْلَاْ نَصْرُكَ اِیَّایَ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَغْلُوْبِیْنَ
segs.en: and without Your support, I would have been of those overwhelmed.
segs.tr: WA LAWLAA NASROKA IYYAAYA LAKUNTO MENAL MAGHLOOBEENA

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ خَصَّ نَفْسَہٗ بِالسُّمُوِّ وَالرِّفْعَۃِ
segs.en: O He Who gives Himself exclusively superiority and highness;
segs.tr: YAA MAN KHASSA NAFSAHU BIS-SOMUWWE WAR RIF-A’TE

segs.en: so, His friends pride themselves on account of His pride.

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ جَعَلَتْ لَهُ الْمُلُوْكُ نِیْرَ الْمَذَلَّۃِ عَلٰی اَعْنَاقِهِمْ
segs.en: O He for Whom the kings put the yoke of humiliation on their necks;
segs.tr: YAA MAN JA-A’LAT LAHUL MOLOOKO NEERAL MAZALLATE A’LAA A-A’NAAQEHIM

segs.en: for they are fearful of His authority.

segs.ar: یَعْلَمُ خَآئِنَۃَ الْاَعْیُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِیْ الصُّدُوْرُ
segs.en: He knows the stealthy looks of eyes and that which the breasts conceal
segs.tr: YA’LAMO KHAA-ENATAL A-A’YONE WA MAA TUKHFIS SODOORO

segs.ar: وَغَیْبَ مَا تَاْتِیْ بِهِ الْاَزْمِنَۃُ وَالدُّهُوْرُ
segs.en: and the future of the times and ages.
segs.tr: WA GHAYBA MAA TAATEE BEHIL AZMENATO WAD DOHOORO

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ لَاْ یَعْلَمُ كَیْفَ هُوَ اِلَّا هُوَ
segs.en: O He save Whom none knows how He is!
segs.tr: YAA MAN LAA YA’LAMO KAYFA HOWA ILLAA HOWA

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ لَاْ یَعْلَمُ مَا هُوَ اِلَّا هُوَ
segs.en: O He save Whom none knows what He is!
segs.tr: YAA MAN LAA YA’LAMO MAA HOWA ILLAA HOWA

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ لَاْ يعَلْمُ مَا یَعْلَمُہٗ اِلَّا هُوَ
segs.en: O He save Whom none knows what He knows!
segs.tr: YAA MAN LAA YA’LAMO MAA YA’LAMOHU ILLAA HOWA

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ كَبَسَ الْاَرْضَ عَلَی الْمَآءِ
segs.en: O He Who surfaced the earth over the water
segs.tr: YAA MAN KABASAL ARZA A’LAL MAAA-E

segs.ar: وَسَدَّ الْهَوَآءَ بِالسَّمَآءِ یَا مَنْ لَہٗ اَكْرَمُ الْاَسْمَآءِ
segs.en: and blocked the air with the heavens! O He Who has the noblest of names!
segs.tr: WA SADDAL HAWAAA-A BIS-SAMAAA-E YAA MAN LAHU AKRAMUL ASMAAA-E

segs.ar: یَا ذَالْمَعْرُوْفِ الَّذِیْ لَاْ یَنْقَطِعُ اَبَدًا
segs.en: O Owner of favor that is never interrupted!
segs.tr: YAA ZAL MA’ROOFIL LAZEE LAA YANQATE-O’ ABADAN

segs.ar: یَا مُقَیِّضَ الرَّكْبِ لِیُوْسُفَ فِی الْبَلَدِ الْقَفْرِ
segs.en: O He Who directed the caravan towards Joseph in the wasteland,
segs.tr: YAA MOQAYYEZAR RAKBE LE-YOOSOFA FIL BALADIL QAFRE

segs.ar: وَمُخْرِجَہٗ مِنَ الْجُبِّ وَجَاعِلَہٗ بَعْدَ الْعُبُوْدِیَّۃِ مَلِکًا
segs.en: took him out of the pit, and made him king after enslavement!
segs.tr: WA MUKHREJAHU MENAL JUBBE WA JAA-E’LAHU BA’DAL O’BOODIYYATE MALEKAN

segs.en: O He Who had returned him to Jacob

segs.ar: بَعْدَ اَنِ ابْیَضَّتْ عَیْنَاهُ مِنَ الْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِیْمٌ
segs.en: after his eyes became white on account of the grief, and he was a repressor of grief!
segs.tr: BA’DA ANIB YAZZAT A’YNAAHO MENAL HUZNE FAHOWA KAZEEMUN

segs.ar: یَا كَاشِفَ الضُّرِّ وَالْبَلْوٰی عَنْ اَیُّوْبَ
segs.en: O He Who removed the distress and misfortune from Job
segs.tr: YAA KAASHEFAZ ZURRE WAL BALWAA A’N AYYOOBA

segs.ar: وَمُمْسِكَ یَدَیْ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ عَنْ ذَبْحِ ابْنِہٖ
segs.en: and withheld the hands of Abraham from slaying his son
segs.tr: WA MUMSEKA YADAY IBRAAHEEMA A’N ZABHIB NEHI

segs.en: after his old age and termination of his lifetime!
segs.tr: BA’DA KEBARE SINNEHI WA FANAAA-E O’MOREHI

segs.ar: یَا مَنِ اسْتَجَابَ لِزَكَرِیَّا فَوَهَبَ لَہٗ یَحْیٰی
segs.en: O He Who responded to Zachariah and granted him John
segs.tr: YAA MANIS TAJAABA LEZAKARIYYAA FAWAHABA LAHU YAHYAA

segs.en: without leaving him alone and lonely!

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ اَخْرَجَ یُوْنُسَ مِنْ بَطْنِ الْحُوْتِ
segs.en: O He Who took Jonah out of the belly of the big fish!
segs.tr: YAA MAN AKHRAJA YOONOSA MIN BATNIL HOOTE

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ فَلَقَ الْبَحْرَ لِبَنِیْ اِسْرَآئِیْلَ
segs.en: O He Who cleft the sea to the children of Israel;
segs.tr: YAA MAN FALAQAL BAHRA LEBANEE ISRAAA-EELA

segs.ar: فَاَنْجَاهُمْ وَجَعَلَ فِرْعُوْنَ وَجُنُوْدَہٗ مِنَ الْمُغْرَقِیْنَ
segs.en: so, He saved them and made Pharaoh and his army of the drowned!
segs.tr: FA-ANJAAHUM WA JA-A’LA FIR-A’WNA WA JONOODAHU MENAL MUGHRAQEENA

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ اَرْسَلَ الرِّیَاحَ مُبَشِّرَاتٍۢ بَیْنَ یَدَیْ رَحْمَتِہٖ
segs.en: O He Who sent the winds, bearing good news, before His mercy!
segs.tr: YAA MAN ARSALAR REYAAHA MOBASH-SHERAATIM BAYNA YADAY RAHMATEHI

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ لَمْ یَعْجَلْ عَلٰی مَنْ عَصَاهُ مِنْ خَلْقِہٖ
segs.en: O He Who has no hastiness on His creatures who disobey Him!
segs.tr: YAA MAN LAM YA’JAL A’LAA MAN A’SAAHO MIN KHALQEHI

segs.ar: یَا مَنِ سْتَنْقَذَ السَّحَرَۃَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ طُوْلِ الْجُحُوْدِ
segs.en: O He Who saved the sorcerers after their long denial!
segs.tr: YAA MANIS TANQAZAS SAHARATA MIM BA’DE TOOLIL JOHOODE

segs.en: and after they had lived in His bounty,
eating from His sustenance, but serving someone else other than Him,
acting in opposition to Him, antagonizing Him,

segs.ar: وَكَذَّبُوْا رُسُلَہٗ یَا اَﷲُ یَا اَﷲُ یَا بَدِیْءُ
segs.en: and denying His messengers. O Allah! O Allah! O Originator!
segs.tr: WA KAZZABOO ROSOLAHU YAA ALLAAHO YAA ALLAAHO YAA BADEE-O

segs.ar: یَا بَدِیْعُ لَاْ نِدَّ لَكَ یَا دَآئِمًا لَاْ نَفَادَ لَكَ
segs.en: O Fashioner! There is no equal to You. O Everlasting! There is no end to You.
segs.tr: YAA BADEE-O’ LAA NIDDA LAKA YAA DAAA-EMAN LAA NAFAADA LAKA

segs.ar: یَا حَیًّا حِیْنَ لَاْ حَیَّ یَا مُحْیِی الْمَوْتٰی
segs.en: O Ever-living when there was no living thing! O Raiser from the dead!
segs.tr: YAA HAYYAN HEENA LAA HAYYA YAA MOHAYEYAL MAWTAA

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ هُوَ قَآئِمٌ عَلٰی كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ
segs.en: O He Who watches every soul as to what it earns!
segs.tr: YAA MAN HOWA QAAA-EMUN A’LAA KULLE NAFSIN BEMAA KASABAT

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ قَلَّ لَہٗ شُكْرِیْ فَلَمْ  یَحْرِمْنِیْ
segs.en: O He to Whom I rarely turned thankful; yet, He did not deprive me,
segs.tr: YAA MAN QALLA LAHU SHUKRE FALAM YAHRIMNEE

segs.en: against Whom I committed grand sins; yet, He did not disclose me,
and Who saw me insisting on disobeying Him; yet, He did not divulge me.
segs.tr: WA RA-AANEE A’LAL MA-A’ASEE FALAM YASH-HARNEE

segs.en: O He Who safeguarded me in my early life!
O He Who provided me with sustenance in my old age!

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ اَیَادِیْهِ عِنْدِیْ لَاْ تُحْصٰی وَنِعَمُہٗ لَاْ تُجَازٰی
segs.en: O He Whose favors to me are innumerable and Whose bounties cannot be compensated!
segs.tr: YAA MAN AYAADEEHE I’NDEE LAA TOHSAA WA NE-A’MOHU LAA TOJAAZAA

segs.en: O He Who receives me with good turn and kindness
segs.tr: YAA MAN A’ARAZANEE BIL-KHAYRE WAL EHSANE

segs.en: but I meet Him with offense and disobedience!
O He Who had guided me to faith

segs.ar: مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ اَعْرِفَ شُكْرَ الْاِمْتِنَانِ
segs.en: before I learnt showing gratitude!
segs.tr: MIN QABLE AN A-A’REFA SHUKRAL IMTENAANE

segs.en: O He Whom I besought in sickness; so, He restored me to health,
in bareness; so, He covered me, in hunger; so, He satiated me,
segs.tr: WA U’RYAANAN FAKASAANEE WA JAAA-E-A’N FA-ASHBA-A’NEE

segs.en: in thirst; so, He quenched my thirst, in humility; so, He granted me dignity,
segs.tr: WA A’TSHAANAN FA-ARWAANEE WA ZALEELAN FA-A-A’ZZANEE

segs.en: in ignorance; so, He taught me, in loneliness; so, He increased my number,
segs.tr: WA JAAHELAN FA-A’RRAFANEE WA WAHEEDAN FAKASSARANEE

segs.en: in absence; so, He returned me (home),
in poverty; so, He enriched me, in victory-seeking; so, He supported me,
segs.tr: WA MOQILLAN FA-AGHNAANEE WA MUNTASERAN FA-NASARANEE

segs.en: and in richness; so, He did not deprive me.
When I withheld praying Him in all these situation, He took the initiative.
segs.tr: WA AMSAKTO A’N JAMEE-E’ ZAALEKA FABTADA-ANEE

segs.ar: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَالشُّكْرُ یَا مَنْ اَقَالَ عَثْرَتِیْ
segs.en: So, all praise and thanks be to You; O He Who overlooked my slips,
segs.tr: FALAKAL HAMDO WASH-SHUKRO YAA MAN AQAALA A’SRATEE

segs.en: relieved my agonies, responded to my prayer,
segs.tr: WA NAFFASA KURBATEE WA AJAABA DA’WATEE

segs.en: covered my flaws, forgave my sins,
segs.tr: WA SATARA A’WRATEE WA GHAFARA ZONOOBEE

segs.en: settled my need, and supported me against my enemy.
segs.tr: WA BALLAGHANEE TALEBATEE WA NASARANEE A’LAA A’DUWWEE

segs.ar: وَاِنْ اَعُدَّ نِعَمَكَ وَمِنَنَكَ وَكَرَائِمَ مِنَحِكَ لَاْ اُحْصِیْهَا
segs.en: If I count Your bounties, favors, and liberal gifts, I will never number them.
segs.tr: WA IN A-U’DDO NE-A’MAKA WA MENANAKA WA KARAA-EMA MENAHEKA LAA OHSEEHAA

segs.en: O my Master! It is You Who bestowed (upon me).

segs.ar: اَنْتَ الَّذِیْ اَنْعَمْتَ اَنْتَ الَّذِیْ اَحْسَنْتَ
segs.en: It is You Who conferred favors (upon me). It is You Who did good (to me).
segs.tr: ANTAL LAZEE AN-A’MTA ANTAL LAZEE AHSANTA

segs.ar: اَنْتَ الَّذِیْ اَجْمَلْتَ اَنْتَ الَّذِیْ اَفْضَلْتَ
segs.en: It is You Who treated (me) excellently. It is You Who favored (me).
segs.tr: ANTAL LAZEE AJMALTA ANTAL LAZEE AFZALTA

segs.en: It is You Who perfected (Your blessings upon me).
It is You Who provided (me) with sustenance.
It is You Who led (me) to success.
It is You Who gave (me).
It is You Who enriched (me).
It is You Who gave (me) to hold.
It is You Who gave (me) shelter.
It is You Who saved (me).
It is You Who guided (me).
It is You Who protected (me).
It is You Who covered my faults.
It is You Who forgave (me).
It is You Who overlooked my sins.
It is You Who established (me).
It is You Who consolidated (me).
It is You Who helped (me).
It is You Who backed (me) up.
It is You Who aided (me).
It is You Who supported (me).
It is You Who restored (me) to health.
It is You Who granted (me) wellbeing.
It is You Who honored (me).
Blessed be You and Exalted be You.
So, all praise be to You permanently,
and all thanks be to You enduringly and eternally.

segs.ar: ثُمَّ اَنَا یَا اِلٰهِیْ الْمُعْتَرِفُ بِذُنُوْبِیْ
segs.en: However, it is I, O my God, who confess of my sins;
segs.tr: SUMMA ANAA YAA ELAAHIL MO’TAREFO BEZONOOBEE

segs.en: so, forgive them to me.
It is I who did badly.
It is I who did wrong.
It is I who had evil intention.
It is I who acted ignorantly.
It is I who was inadvertent.
It is I who was inattentive.
It is I who leaned (on something other than You).
It is I who did wrong deliberately.
It is I who promised.
It is I who failed to fulfill it.
It is I who breached.
It is I who confessed.

segs.ar: اَنَا الَّذِیْ اعْتَرَفْتُ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَیَّ وَعِنْدِیْ
segs.en: It is I who testified to Your favors upon and with me,
segs.tr: ANAL LAZEE’ TARAFTO BE-NE’MATEKA A’LAYYA WA I’NDEE

segs.en: and I now acknowledge of my sins; so, forgive them to me.

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ لَاْ تَضُرُّہٗ ذُنُوْبُ عِبَادِہٖ
segs.en: O He Who is not injured by the sins of His servants,
segs.tr: YAA MAN LAA TAZURROHU ZONOOBO E’BAADEHI

segs.en: and Who can surely do without their obedience,
and Who inspires those of them to do good,
segs.tr: WAL MOWAFFEQO MAN A’MELA SAALEHAM MINHUM

segs.en: out of His aid and mercy.
So, all praise be to You, O my God and my Master.
O my God: You ordered me, but I disobeyed You.
You warned me, but I violated Your warning

segs.ar: فَاَصْبَحْتُ لَاْ ذَا بَرَآئَۃٍ لِّیْ فَاَعْتَذِرُ
segs.en: So, I am now without any innocence with which to excuse myself
segs.tr: FA-ASBAHTO LAA ZAA BARAAA-ATIL LEE FA-A-A’TAZERO

segs.en: nor power to support myself.
By which thing can I now meet You, O my Master?

segs.ar: اَبِسَمْعِیْ اَمْ بِبَصَرِیْ اَمْ بِلِسَانِیْ اَمْ بِیَدِیْ اَمْ بِرِجْلِیْ
segs.en: Is it by my hearing, my sight, my tongue, my hand, or my foot?
segs.tr: A BESAM-E’E AM BE-BASAREE AM BELESAANEE AM BEYADEE AM BERIJLEE

segs.en: Are all these not Your bounties on me
and with all of them I have disobeyed You, O my Master?
You have absolute argument and claim against me.

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ سَتَرَنِیْ مِنَ الْاٰبَآءِ وَالْاُمَّهَاتِ اَنْ یَزْجُرُوْنِیْ
segs.en: O He Who covered me from fathers and mothers lest they might have driven me away,
segs.tr: YAA MAN SATARANEE MENAL AAABAAA-E WAL UMMAHAATE AN YAZJOROONEE

segs.en: from relatives and friends lest they might have gibed me,
segs.tr: WA MENAL A’SHAA-ERE WAL IKHWAANE AN YO-A’YYEROONEE

segs.ar: وَمِنَ السَّلَاطِیْنِ اَنْ یُعَاقِبُوْنِیْ وَلَوِاطَّلَعُوْا یَا مَوْلَایَ
segs.en: and from rulers lest they might have punished me.  Had they, O my Master, seen
segs.tr: WA MENAS SALAATEENE AN YO-A’AQEBOONEE WA LAWIT TALAO’O YAA MAWLAAYA

segs.ar: عَلٰی مَا اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَیْهِ مِنِّیْ اِذًا مَّا اَنْظَرُوْنِیْ
segs.en: that which You knew about me, they would certainly have granted me no respite
segs.tr: A’LAA MAT TALA’TA A’LAYHE MINNEE EZAM MAA ANZAROONEE

segs.en: and they would have rejected and parted company with me.

segs.ar: فَهَا اَنَا ذَا یَا اِلٰهِیْ بَیْنَ یَدَیْكَ یَا سَیِّدِیْ
segs.en: Here I am now, O my God, between Your hands, O my Master,
segs.tr: FAHAA ANAA ZAA YAA ELAAHEE BAYNA YADAYKA YAA SAYYEDEE

segs.en: submissive, humble, helpless, and worthless.
without any innocence with which to excuse myself,
nor power to support myself,
nor excuse to advance as a plea,

segs.ar: وَلَاْ قَآئِلٌ لَمْ اَجْتَرِحْ وَلَمْ اَعْمَلْ سُوْٓ ءً
segs.en: nor can I claim not committing and not acting badly.
segs.tr: WA LAA QAAA-ELUN LAM AJTAREH WA LAM A-A’MAL SOOO-AN

segs.ar: وَمَا عَسَی الْجُحُوْدُ وَلَوْ جَحَدْتُ یَا مَوْلَایَ یَنْفَعُنِیْ
segs.en: How can denial, if I deny, O my Master, serve me?
segs.tr: WA MAA A’SAL JOHOODO WA LAW JAHADTO YAA MAWLAAYA YANFA-O’NEE

segs.en: How and in what manner can I do so,

segs.ar: وَجَوَارِحِیْ كُلُّهَا شَاهِدَۃٌ عَلَیَّ بِمَا قَدْ عَمِلْتُ
segs.en: while all my organs are witnesses for what I did?
segs.tr: WA JAWAAREHEE KULLAHAA SHAHEDATUN A’LAYYA BEMAA QAD A’MILTO

segs.en: I know for sure and without doubt
segs.tr: WA A’LIMTO YAQEENAN GHAYRA ZEE SHAKKIN

segs.en: that You will interrogate me about these grand matter,

segs.ar: وَاَنَّكَ الْحَكَمُ الْعَدْلُ الَّذِیْ لَاْ تَجُوْرُ
segs.en: You are the Just Judge Who never wrongs,
segs.tr: WA ANNAKAL HAKAMUL A’DLUL LAZEE LAA TAJOORO

segs.ar: وَعَدْلُكَ مُهْلِكِیْ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَدْلِكَ مَهْرَبِیْ
segs.en: Your justice will ruin me, and from Your all justice I flee.
segs.tr: WA A’DLOKA MOHLEKEE WA MIN KULLE A’DLEKA MAHRABEE

segs.en: If You, O my God, chastise me,
then it is because of my sins after Your claim against me;
and if You pardon me,
then it is on account of Your forbearance, magnanimity, and generosity.
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of the wrongdoers.
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of those seeking forgiveness.
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of those professing Your Oneness.
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of the fearful.
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of the apprehensive.
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of those hoping (for You).
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of those desiring (for You).
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of those professing that there is no god save You.
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of those beseeching (You).
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of those glorifying (You).
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of those professing that You are the Greatest.
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
You are my Lord and the Lord of my bygone fathers.
O Allah, this is my praise for You, celebrating Your glory,
my sincerity to mention You and profess Your Oneness,
and my acknowledgment of Your bounties, counting them,

segs.ar: وَاِنْ كُنْتُ مُقِرًّا اَنِّیْ لَمْ اُحْصِهَا
segs.en: although I confess that I could never count them
segs.tr: WA IN KUNTO MOQIRRAN ANNEE LAM OH-SEHAA

segs.ar: لِكَثْرَتِهَا وَسُبُوْعِهَا وَتَظَاهُرِهَا وَتَقَادُمِهَا اِلٰی حَادِثٍ
segs.en: for they are innumerable, abundant, continuous, and prior to a certain event.
segs.tr: LEKASRATEHAA WA SOBOO-E’HAA WA TAZAAHOREHAA WA TAQAADOMEHAA ELAA HAADESIN

segs.ar: مَا لَمْ تَزَلْ تَتَعَهَدُنِیْ بِہٖ مَعَهَا
segs.en: You have been conferring upon me with these bounties
segs.tr: MAA LAM TAZAL TATA-A’H-HADONEE BEHI MA-A’HAA

segs.ar: مُنْذُ خَلَقْتَنِیْ وَبَرَاتَنِیْ مِنْ اَوَّلِ الْعُمْرِ
segs.en: since You created and originated me from the beginning of my age
segs.tr: MUNZO KHALAQTANEE WA BARAATANEE MIN AWWALIL U’MRE

segs.ar: مِنَ الْاَغْنَاءِ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ وَكَشْفِ الضُّرِّ
segs.en: through meeting my poverty relieving me from harm,
segs.tr: MENAL AGHNAAA-E MENAL FAQRE WA KASHFIZ ZURRE

segs.en: giving me means of easiness, repelling misery from me,
segs.tr: WA TASBEEBIL YUSRE WA DAF-I’L U’SRE

segs.en: alleviating my agonies, granting me wellbeing in my body,
segs.tr: WA TAFREEJIL KARBE WAL A’AFEYATE FIL BADANE

segs.en: and furnishing me with sound faith.

segs.ar: وَلَوْرَفَدَنِیْ عَلٰی قَدْرِ ذِكْرِ نِعْمَتِكَ جَمِیْعُ الْعَالَمِیْنَ
segs.en: If all creatures assist me to be able to mention Your bounties,
segs.tr: WA LAW RAFADANEE A’LAA QADRE ZIKRE NE’MATEKA JAMEE-U’L A’ALAMEENA

segs.en: including the past and the coming generations,

segs.ar: مَا قَدَرْتُ وَلَاْ هُمْ عَلٰی ذٰلِكَ تَقَدَّسْتَ وَتَعَالَیْتَ
segs.en: neither I nor will they be able to do that. Holy be You and Exalted be You;
segs.tr: MAA QADARTO WA LAA HUM A’LAA ZAALEKA TAQADDASTA WA TA-A’ALAYTA

segs.en: You are All-generous, All-great, and All-merciful Sustainer.

segs.ar: لَاْ تُحْصٰی اٰلَآؤُكَ وَلَاْ یَبْلُغُ ثَنَآؤُكَ
segs.en: Your bounties are innumerable, (proper) praise of You is unreachable,
segs.tr: LAA TOHSAA AA-LAAA-OKA WA LAA YUBLAGHO SANAAA-OKA

segs.en: and Your graces cannot be rewarded.
send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: perfect Your bounties for us, and make us happy by obeying You.
segs.tr: WA ATMIM A’LAYNAA NE-A’MAKA WA AS-I’DNAA BE-TAA-A’TEKA

segs.en: All glory be to You. There is no god save You.
O Allah, verily, You answer the distressed,
remove the evil, aid the anguished,
segs.tr: WA TAKSHEFUS SOOO-A WA TOGHEESUL MAKROOBA

segs.en: cure the ailed, enrich the poor,
segs.tr: WA TASHFIS SAQEEMA WA TUGHNIL FAQEERA

segs.en: set the broken, have mercy on the young,
segs.tr: WA TAJBORUL KASEERA WA TARHAMUS SAGHEERA

segs.en: help the old, none can help against You,
segs.tr: WA TO-E’ENUL KABEERA WA LAYSA DOONAKA ZAHEERUN

segs.ar: وَلَاْ فَوْقَكَ قَدِیْرٌ وَاَنْتَ الْعَلِیُّ الْكَبِیْرُ
segs.en: none is more powerful than You, and You are the Most High, the All-great.
segs.tr: WA LAA FAWQAKA QADEERUN WA ANTAL A’LIYYUL KABEERO

segs.ar: یَا مُطْلِقَ الْمُكَبَّلِ الْاَسِیْرِ یَا رَازِقَ الطِّفْلِ الصَّغِیْرِ
segs.en: O He Who release the shackled captive! O He Who provides sustenance to the young child!
segs.tr: YAA MUTLEQAL MOKABBALIL ASEERE YAA RAAZEQAT TIFLIS SAGHEERE

segs.en: O He Who is the Preserver of the afraid seeker of refuge!

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ لَاْ شَرِیْكَ لَہٗ وَلَاْ وَزِیْرَ
segs.en: O He Who has neither partner nor assistant,
segs.tr: YAA MAN LAA SHAREEKA LAHU WA LAA WAZEERA

segs.en: send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.ar: وَاَعْطِنِیْ فِیْ ہٰذِهِ الْعَشِیَّۃِ اَفْضَلَ مَا اَعْطَیْتَ وَاَنَلْتَ
segs.en: and grant me, in this evening, the best of what You have granted and awarded
segs.tr: WA A-A’TENEE FEE HAAZEHIL A’SHIYYATE AFZALA MAA A-A’TAYTA WA ANALTA

segs.ar: اَحَدًا مِّنْ عِبَادِكَ مِنْ نِعْمَۃٍ تُوْلِیْهَا
segs.en: to any of Your servants, including a grace that You donate,
segs.tr: AHADAM MIN E’BAADEKA MIN NE’MATIN TOOLEEHAA

segs.en: bounties that You re-offer, a tribulation that You deter,
segs.tr: WA AA-LAAA-IN TOJADDEDOHAA WA BALIYYATIN TASREFOHAA

segs.en: an anguish that You remove, a prayer that You answer,
segs.tr: WA KURBATIN TAKSHEFOHAA WA DA’WATIN TASMA-O’HAA

segs.en: a good deed that You admit, and an evildoing that You screen.
segs.tr: WA HASANATIN TATAQABBALOHAA WA SAYYE-ATIN TATAGHAMMADOHAA

segs.en: Verily, You are All-tender to him You will, and All-aware,
and You have power over all things.
O Allah, Verily, You are the nearest of those whom are prayed,
You are the promptest of those who may respond,
the most generous of those who may pardon,
the most liberal of those who give,
and the most hearing of those who are asked.
O All-beneficent of the world and the Hereafter, and All-merciful!
segs.tr: YAA RAHMAANAD DUNYAA WAL AAKHERATE WA RAHEEMAHOMAA

segs.ar: لَیْسَ كَمِثْلِكَ مَسْئُوْلٌ وَلَاْ سِوَاكَ مَاْمُوْلٌ
segs.en: No besought one is like You and none save You is hoped.
segs.tr: LAYSA KAMISLEKA MAS-OOLUN WA LAA SEWAAKA MAAMOOLUN

segs.en: I prayed You and You answered me. I besought You and You gave me.

segs.ar: وَرَغِبْتُ اِلَیْكَ فَرَحِمْتَنِیْ وَوَثِقْتُ بِكَ فَنَجَّیْتَنِیْ
segs.en: I desired for You and You had mercy on me. I had confidence in You and You saved me.
segs.tr: WA RAGHIBTO ELAYKA FARAHIMTANEE WA WASIQTO BEKA FANAJJAYTANEE

segs.en: I resorted to You in awe and You delivered me.
O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad,
Your servant, messenger, and prophet,
and to all of his Household, the pure and immaculate,
segs.tr: WA A’LAA AALEHIT TAYYEBEENAT TAAHEREENA AJMA-E’ENA

segs.en: and perfect for us Your graces, make us taste the pleasure of Your gifts,
segs.tr: WA TAMMIM LANAA NA’MAAA-AKA WA HANNEA-NAA A’TAAA-AKA

segs.en: and register us as thankful for You and as oft-referring to You.
segs.tr: WAK TUBNAA LAKA SHAAKEREENA WA LE-AALAAA-EKA ZAAKEREENA

segs.ar: اٰمِیْنَ اٰمِیْنَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِیْنَ اَللّٰهُمَّ یَا مَنْ مَلَكَ فَقَدَرَ
segs.en: Respond, respond! O Lord of the worlds! O Allah, Who owns; therefore, He controls,
segs.tr: AAMEENA AAMEENA RABBAL A’ALAMEENA ALLAAHUMMA YAA MAN MALAKA FAQADARA

segs.en: and controls; therefore, He has absolute authority, and is disobeyed; yet, He covers,
segs.tr: WA QADARA FAQAHARA WA O’SEYA FASATARA

segs.en: and is prayed for forgiveness; therefore, He forgives.
O He Who is the aim of seekers and desirers
and the ultimate purpose of the hope of hopers!

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ اَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَیْءٍ عِلْمًا
segs.en: O He Who encompasses all things in knowledge
segs.tr: YAA MAN AHAATA BE-KULLE SHAY-IN I’LMAN

segs.en: and embraces those who turn to Him with kindness, mercy, and forbearance!
segs.tr: WA WASE-A’L MUSTAQBELEENA RAAFATANW WA RAHMATANW WA HILMAN

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّا نَتَوَجَّهُ اِلَیْكَ فِیْ ہٰذِهِ الْعَشِیَّۃِ
segs.en: O Allah, we turn our faces to You in this evening
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNAA NATAWAJJAHO ELAYKA FEE HAAZEHIL A’SHIYYATIL

segs.en: that You deem honorable and reverential
(asking You) in the name of Muhammad, Your Prophet, Messenger,

segs.ar: وَخِیَرَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَاَمِیْنِكَ عَلٰی وَحْیِكَ
segs.en: the best of Your creation, Your trustee on Your Revelation,
segs.tr: WA KHEYARATEKA MIN KHALQEKA WA AMEENEKA A’LAA WAHYEKAL

segs.en: the bearer of glad tidings, the warner, and the shining lantern,
with whom You have conferred upon the Muslims,
and whom You made mercy for the worlds.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: So, O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA FASALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.ar: كَمَا مُحَمَّدٌ اَهْلٌ لِذٰلِكَ مِنْكَ یَا عَظِیْمُ
segs.en: For as much as Muhammad deserves that from You, O All-great.
segs.tr: KAMAA MOHAMMADUN AHLUN LEZAALEKA MINKA YAA A’ZEEMO

segs.en: So, send blessings to him and his Household,
the elite, pure, and immaculate — all of them,
and encompass us with Your pardoning us.
To You are the voices of various languages clamoring;

segs.ar: فَاجْعَلْ لَنَا اَللّٰهُمَّ فِیْ ہٰذِهِ الْعَشِیَّۃِ
segs.en: so, decide for us, O Allah, in this evening
segs.tr: FAJ-A’L LANAA ALLAAHUMMA FEE HAAZEHIL A’SHIYYATE

segs.ar: نَصِیْبًا مِنْ كُلِّ خَیْرٍ تَقْسِمُہٗ بَیْنَ عِبَادِكَ
segs.en: a share from every good item that You distribute among Your servants,
segs.tr: NASEEBAN MIN KULLE KHAYRIN TAQSEMOHU BAYNA E’BAADEKA

segs.en: illumination by which You guide, mercy that You spread,
segs.tr: WA NOORIN TAHDEE BEHI WA RAHMATIN TANSHOROHAA

segs.en: blessing that You bring down, wellbeing that You extend,
segs.tr: WA BARAKATIN TUNZELOHAA WA A’AFEYATIN TOJALLELOHAA

segs.en: and sustenance that You stretch, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
segs.tr: WA RIZQIN TABSOTOHU YAA ARHAMAR RAAHEMEENA

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اقْلِبْنَا فِی ہٰذَا الْوَقْتِ مُنْجِحِیْنَ مُفْلِحِیْنَ
segs.en: O Allah, turn us in this hour successful, flourishing,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA AQLIBNAA FEE HAAZAL WAQTE MUNJEHEENA MUFLEHEENA

segs.ar: مَبْرُوْرِیْنَ غَانِمِیْنَ وَلَاْ تَجْعَلْنَ مِنَ الْقَانِطِیْنَ
segs.en: blessed, and gainers. Do not include us with the despondent.
segs.tr: MABROOREENA GHAANEMEENA WA LAA TAJ-A’LNAA MENAL QAANETEENA

segs.en: Do not leave us without Your mercy.

segs.ar: وَلَاْ تَحْرِمْنَا مَا نُؤَمِّلُہٗ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
segs.en: Do not deprive us of that which we hope from Your favor.
segs.tr: WA LAA TAHRIMNAA MAA NOAMMELOHU MIN FAZLEKA

segs.en: Do not make us deprived of Your mercy,
segs.tr: WA LAA TAJ-A’LNAA MIR RAHMATEKA MAHROOMEENA

segs.ar: وَلَاْ لِفَضْلِ مَا نُؤَمِّلُہٗ مِنْ عَطَآئِكَ قَانِطِیْنَ
segs.en: or despair of the favor of what we hope from Your gifts.
segs.tr: WA LAA LEFAZLE MAA NOAMMELOHU MIN A’TAAA-EKA QAANETEENA

segs.ar: وَلَاْ تَرُدَّنَا خَائِبِیْنَ وَلَاْ مِنْۢ بَابِكَ مَطْرُوْدِیْنَ
segs.en: Do not turns us down disappointed or driven away from Your door.
segs.tr: WA LAA TARUDDANAA KHAAA-EBEENA WA LAA MIM BAABEKA MATROODEENA

segs.en: O most Magnanimous of all those who treat magnanimously
and most Generous of all those who act generously!
To You are we advancing with full conviction
and to Your Holy House are we betaking ourselves purposefully;

segs.ar: فَاَعِنَّا عَلٰی مَنَاسِكِنَا وَاَكْمِلْ لَنَا حَجَّنَا
segs.en: So, help us do our rituals (perfectly) perfect for us our pilgrimage
segs.tr: FA-A-I’NNAA A’LAA MANAASEKENAA WA AKMIL LANAA HAJJANAA

segs.ar: وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَعَافِنَا فَقَدْ مَدَدْنَا اِلَیْكَ اَیْدِیَنَا
segs.en: pardon us, and grant us wellbeing. We are stretching our hands toward You;
segs.tr: WA’ FO A’NNAA WA A’AFENAA FAQAD MADADNAA ELAYKA AYDEYANAA

segs.en: so, they are marked by the humiliation of confession.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَاَعْطِنَا فِیْ ہٰذِهِ الْعَشِیَّۃِ مَا سَئَلْنَاكَ
segs.en: O Allah, grant us in this evening that which we have besought from You
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA FA-A-A’TENAA FEE HAAZEHIL A’SHIYYATE MAA SA-ALNAAKA

segs.en: and save us from that which we have besought You to save us;

segs.ar: فَلَاْ كَافِیَ لَنَا سِوَاكَ وَلَاْ رَبَّ لَنَا غَیْرُكَ
segs.en: for we have no savior but You and we have no sustainer but You.
segs.tr: FALAA KAAFEYA LANAA SEWAAKA WA LAA RABBA LANAA GHAYROKA

segs.ar: نَافِذٌ فِیْنَا حُكْمُكَ مُحِیْطٌ بِنَا عِلْمُكَ
segs.en: Your decree is prevalent on us, Your knowledge is encompassing us,
segs.tr: NAAFEZUN FEENAA HUKMOKA MOHEETUN BENAA I’LMOKA

segs.ar: عَدْلٌ فِیْنَا قَضَآؤُكَ اِقْضِ لَنَا الْخَیْرَ
segs.en: and Your decisions about us is just. (Please) decree for us that which is good
segs.tr: A’DLUN FEENA QAZAAA-OKA IQZE LANAL KHAYRA

segs.en: and make us of the people of goodness.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ  اَوْجِبْ لَنَا بِجُوْدِكَ عَظِیْمَ الْاَجْرِ
segs.en: O Allah, decide for us, on account of Your magnanimity, a great reward,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA AWJIB LANAA BEJOODEKA A’ZEEMAL AJRE

segs.en: a generous reserve, and a permanent easiness,
segs.tr: WA KAREEMAZ ZUKHRE WA DAWAAMAL YUSRE

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا اَجْمَعِیْنَ وَلَاْ تُهْلِكْنَا مَعَ الْهَالِكِیْنَ
segs.en: and forgive us all our sins, do not annihilate us with those annihilated,
segs.tr: WAGH FIR LANAA ZONOOBANAA AJMA-E’ENA WA LAA TOHLIKNAA MA-A’L HAALEKEENA

segs.en: and do not drive away from us Your tenderness and mercy;
segs.tr: WA LAA TASRIF A’NNAA RAAFATAKA WA RAHMATAKA

segs.en: O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنَا فِیْ ہٰذَا الْوَقْتِ مِمَّنْ سَاَلَكَ فَاَعْطَیْتَہٗ
segs.en: O Allah, include us, at this hour, with them who besought You and You thus gave them,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAJ A’LNAA FEE HAAZAL WAQTE MIMMAN SA-ALAKA FA-A-A’TAYTAHU

segs.en: who thanked You and You thus increased them,
who returned to You and You thus accepted them,

segs.ar: وَتَنَصَّلَ اِلَیْكَ مِنْ ذُنُوْبِہٖ كُلِّهَا فَغَفَرْتَهَا لَہٗ
segs.en: and who renounced all their sins before You and You thus forgave them;
segs.tr: WA TANASSALA ELAYKA MIN ZONOOBEHI KULLEHAA FAGHAFARTAHAA LAHU

segs.ar: یَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْاِكْرَامِ اَللّٰهُمَّ وَنَقِّنَا وَسَدِّدْنَا
segs.en: O Lord of Majesty and Honor! O Allah, purify us and lead us to success
segs.tr: YAA ZAL JALAALE WAL IKRAAME ALLAAHUMMA WA WAFFIQNAA WA SADDIDNAA

segs.en: and admit our earnest entreaty;
O He Who is the best of all those who are besought
and most Merciful of all those whose mercy is sought!

segs.ar: یَا مَنْ لَاْ یَخْفٰی عَلَیْهِ اِغْمَاضُ الْجُفُوْنِ
segs.en: O He from Whom the closing of eyelids cannot be hidden,
segs.tr: YAA MAN LAA YAKHFAA A’LAYHE IGHMAAZUL JOFOONE

segs.ar: وَلَاْ لَحْظُ الْعُیُوْنِ وَلَاْ مَا اسْتَقَرَّ فِیْ الْمَكْنُوْنِ
segs.en: nor are the glances of eyes, nor is that which settles in the unseen,
segs.tr: WA LAA LAHZUL O’YOONE WA LAA MAS TAQARRA FIL MAKNOONE

segs.ar: وَلَاْ مَا انْطَوَتْ عَلَیْهِ مُضْمَرَاتُ الْقُلُوْبِ
segs.en: nor are things vanished under the secrets of hearts.
segs.tr: WA LAA MAN TAWAT A’LAYHE MUZMARAATUL QOLOOBE

segs.ar: اَلَاْ كُلُّ ذٰلِكَ قَدْ اَحْصَاهُ عِلْمُكَ
segs.en: Verily, all that has been encompassed by Your knowledge
segs.tr: ALAA KULLO ZAALEKA QAD AHSAAHO I’LMOKA

segs.en: and covered by Your forbearance.
All glory be to You; and Exalted be You above all that the wrongdoers say,
segs.tr: SUBHAANAKA WA TA-A’ALAYTA A’MMA YAQOOLUZ ZAALEMOONA

segs.ar: عُلُوًّا كَبِیْرًا تُسَبِّحُ لَكَ السَّمٰوٰتُ السَّبْعُ
segs.en: in high exaltation! Declaring You glory are the seven heavens,
segs.tr: O’LUWWAN KABEERAN TOSABBEHO LAKAS SAMAAWAATUS SAB-O’

segs.en: the (layers of the) earth, and all beings therein.

segs.ar: وَاِنْ مِّنْ شَیْءٍ اِلَّا یُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِكَ
segs.en: There is not a thing but celebrates Your praise.
segs.tr: WA IM MIN SHAY-IN ILLAA YOSABBEHO BEHAMDEKA

segs.en: Yours are all praise, glory, and exaltation of majesty.
segs.tr: FALAKAL HAMDO WAL MAJDO WA O’LUWWUL JADDE

segs.ar: یَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْاِكْرَامِ وَالْفَصْلِ وَالْاِنْعَامِ
segs.en: O Owner of majesty, honor, grace, favoring,
segs.tr: YAA ZAL JALAALE WAL IKRAAME WAL FAZLE WAL IN-A’AME

segs.en: and huge bestowals. You are the All-magnanimous, the All-generous,
segs.tr: WAL AYAADIL JESAAME WA ANTAL JAWAADUL KAREEMUR

segs.en: the All-tender, the All-merciful.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَوْسِعْ عَلَیَّ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ الْحَلَالِ
segs.en: O Allah, provide me largely with Your legally gotten sustenance,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA AWSE’ A’LAYYA MIN RIZQEKAL HALAALE

segs.en: grant me wellbeing in my body and my faith,
segs.tr: WA A’AFENEE FEE BADANEE WA DEENEE

segs.ar: وَاٰمِنْ خَوْفِیْ وَاَعْتِقْ رَقَبَتِیْ مِنَ النَّارِ
segs.en: secure my fears, and release me from Hellfire.
segs.tr: WA AAMIN KHAWFEE WA A-A’TIQ RAQABATEE MENAN NAARE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَاْ تَمْكُرْ بِیْ وَلَاْ تَسْتَدْرِجْنِیْ
segs.en: O Allah, do not plan against me, do not draw me near to destruction,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA LAA TAMKUR BEE WA LAA TASTADRIJNEE

segs.en: do not overreach me,

segs.ar: وَادْرَأْ عَنِّیْ شَرَّ فَسَقَۃِ الْجِنِّ وَاْلاِنْسِ.
segs.en: and drive away from me the evils of the corruptive Jinn and men.
segs.tr: WAD RAA A’NNEE SHARRA FASAQATIL JINNE WAL INSE.

segs.note: Imam al-Husain (a.s.) then raised his head and sight to the sky with teary eyes and said with an audible voice:
segs.ur: پھر امام حسین (ع) نے اشک بھری آنکھوں کے ساتھ اپنا سر اور نگاہ آسمان کی طرف اٹھائی اور بلند آواز سے فرمایا:

segs.en: O most Hearing of all those who can hear!
O most Seeing of all those who can see!
And O swiftest of all those who call to account!
And O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: the auspicious chiefs; and I beseech You for my request
segs.tr: SAADATIL MAYAAMEENA WA AS-ALOKA ALLAAHUMMA HAAJATEYAL

segs.ar: الَّتِیْ اِنْ اَعْطَیْتَنِیْهَا لَمْ یَضُرَّنِیْ مَا مَنَعْتَنِیْ
segs.en: that if You answer, anything else that You reject will not harm me
segs.tr: LATEE IN A-A’TAYTANEEHAA LAM YAZURRANEE MAA MANA’-TANEE

segs.ar: وَاِنْ مَنَعْتَنِيْهَا لَمْ یَنْفَعُنِیْ مَا اَعْطَیْنَتِیْ
segs.en: and if You reject, anything else that You respond will not benefit me.
segs.tr: WA IN MANA’TANEEHAA LAM YANFA-O’NEE MAA A-A’TAYTANEE

segs.ar: اَسْئَلُكَ فَكَاكَ رَقَبَتِیْ مِنَ النَّارِ لَاْ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ
segs.en: I beseech You for releasing me from Hellfire. There is no god save You,
segs.tr: AS-ALOKA FAKAAKA RAQABATEE MENAN NAARE LAA ELAAHA ILLAA ANTA

segs.ar: وَحْدَكَ لَاْ شَرِیْكَ لَكَ لَكَ الْمُلْكُ وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ
segs.en: only You, there is no partner with You. To You is the kingdom and to You is all praise,
segs.tr: WAHDAKA LAA SHAREEKA LAKA LAKAL MULKO WA LAKAL HAMDO

segs.en: and You have power over all things.
segs.tr: WA ANTA A’LAA KULLE SHAY-IN QADEERUN

segs.ar: یَا رَبِّ یَا رَبِّ یَا رَبِّ...
segs.en: O my Lord! O my Lord! O my Lord…
segs.tr: YAA RABBE YAA RABBE YAA RABBE.

segs.note: Imam al-Husain (a.s.) then repeated yaa-rabbe so frequently and effectively that he attracted the attentions of all the others who, instead of praying for granting their needs, surrounded Imam al-Husain (a.s.) to listen to him and pray for the response of his supplication. Then, they wept with him. At sunset, they left Mount Arafaat with him.
segs.ur: پھر امام حسین (ع) نے «یا رب» اس قدر کثرت سے اور اثر کے ساتھ دہرایا کہ سب حاضرین کی توجہ آپ کی طرف مبذول ہو گئی؛ وہ اپنی حاجتوں کے لیے دعا کرنے کے بجائے امام حسین (ع) کی بات سننے اور ان کی دعا کی قبولیت کے لیے دعا کرنے کی خاطر آپ کے گرد جمع ہو گئے۔ پھر وہ آپ کے ساتھ روئے۔ غروب آفتاب کے وقت وہ آپ کے ساتھ کوہ عرفات سے روانہ ہوئے۔

segs.note: This is the end of Imam al-Husain (a.s.)’s supplicatory prayer on the Arafat Day according to the narrations of al-Kafami in his book of al-Balad al-Ameen and Allamah al-Majlisi in his book of Zaad al-Maad. As for Sayyid Ibn Taaoos, he, in his book of Iqbal al-Aamaal, adds the following statements to the supplicatory prayer:
segs.ur: یہ یومِ عرفہ کی امام حسین (ع) کی دعا کا اختتام ہے، کفعمی کی کتاب البلد الامین اور علامہ مجلسی کی کتاب زاد المعاد کی روایات کے مطابق۔ جہاں تک سید ابن طاؤس کا تعلق ہے تو انہوں نے اپنی کتاب اقبال الاعمال میں دعا میں درج ذیل عبارات کا اضافہ کیا ہے:

segs.en: O my God, I am needy despite my richness;

segs.ar: فَكَيْفَ لَاْ اَكُوْنُ فَقِيْرًا فِيْ فَقْرِيْ؟
segs.en: so, how can I not be needy in my neediness?
segs.tr: FAKAYFA LAA AKOONO FAQEERAN FEE FAQREE?

segs.en: O my God, I am ignorant despite my knowledge;

segs.ar: فَكَيْفَ لَاْ اَكُوْنُ جَهُوْلًا فِيْ جَهْلِيْ؟
segs.en: so, how can I not be ignorant in my ignorance?
segs.tr: FAKAYFA LAA AKOONO JAHOOLAN FEE JAHLEE?

segs.en: O my God, the variety of Your regulating of matters
and the swiftness of changes in Your ordainments

segs.ar: مَنَعَا عِبَادَكَ الْعَارِفِيْنَ بِكَ عَنِ السُّكُوْنِ اِلٰى عَطَاءٍ
segs.en: have urged Your servants, who recognize You, not to stop at a certain gift
segs.tr: MANA-A’A E’BAADAKAL A’AREFEENA BEKA A’NIS SOKOONE ELAA A’TAAA-IN

segs.en: and not to despair of You in tribulations.
O my God, coming out of me is that which fits my lowliness;
but coming from You is that which befits Your nobleness.

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ وَصَفْتَ نَفْسَكَ بِاللُّطْفِ وَالرَّافَةِ لِيْ
segs.en: O my God, You had ascribed to Yourself gentleness and kindness to me
segs.tr: ELAAHEE WASAFTA NAFSAKA BIL-LUTFE WAR-RAAFATE LEE

segs.en: before the existence of my weakness.
Will You deprive me of these two after the emergence of my weakness?
O my God, if amenities appear in my conduct,
then that is on account of Your favors and Your conferral on me.
If evildoings appear in my conduct,
then that is still Your justice and You have claim against me.

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ كَيْفَ تَكِلُنِيْ وَقَدْ تَكَفَّلْتَ لِيْ؟
segs.en: O my God, how may it be that You abandon me after You have vouched for me?
segs.tr: ELAAHEE KAYFA TAKELONEE WA QAD TAKAFFALTA LEE?

segs.en: How may I be aggrieved and You are my support?
segs.tr: WA KAYFA AZAAMO WA ANTAN NAASERO LEE?

segs.ar: اَمْ كَيْفَ اَخِيْبُ وَاَنْتَ الْحَفِيُّ بِيْ؟
segs.en: How may I be disappointed and You are undertaking my affairs?
segs.tr: AM KAYFA AKHEEBO WA ANTAL HAFIYYO BEE?

segs.ar: هَا اَنَا اَتَوَسَّلُ اِلَيْكَ بِفَقْرِيْ اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: Here I am begging You by my need for You.
segs.tr: HAA ANAA ATAWASSALO ELAYKA BE-FAQREE ELAYKA

segs.ar: وَكَيْفَ اَتَوَسَّلُ اِلَيْكَ بِمَا هُوَ مَحَالٌ اَنْ يَصِلَ اِلَيْكَ؟
segs.en: How can I beg You by something that is impossible to reach You?
segs.tr: WA KAYFA ATAWASSALO ELAYKA BEMAA HOWA MAHAALUN AN YASELA ELAYKA?

segs.ar: اَمْ كَيْفَ اَشْكُوْ اِلَيْكَ حَالِيْ وَهُوَ لَاْ يَخْفٰى عَلَيْكَ؟
segs.en: How can I complain to You about my manners while they cannot be hidden from You?
segs.tr: AM KAYFA ASHKOO ELAYKA HAALEE WA HOWA LAA YAKHFAA A’LAYKA?

segs.ar: اَمْ كَيْفَ اُتَرْجِمُ بِمَقَالِيْ وَهُوَ مِنْكَ بَرَزٌ اِلَيْكَ؟
segs.en: How can I interpret my words while You are their source?
segs.tr: AM KAYFA OTARJEMO BEMAQAALEE WA HOWA MINKA BARAZUN ELAYKA?

segs.ar: اَمْ كَيْفَ تُخَيِّبُ آمَالِيْ وَهِيَ قَدْ وَفَدَتْ اِلَيْكَ؟
segs.en: How come that You may let down my hopes, while they are addressed to You?
segs.tr: AM KAYFA TOKHAYYEBO AAMAALEE WA HEYA QAD WAFA-DAT ELAYKA?

segs.ar: اَمْ كَيْفَ لَاْ تُحْسِنُ اَحْوَالِيْ وَبِكَ قَامَتْ
segs.en: How come that You may not improve my conditions while they are originated by You?
segs.tr: AM KAYFA LAA TOHSENO AHWAALEE WA BEKA QAAMAT

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ مَا اَلْطَفَكَ بِيْ مَعَ عَظِيْمِ جَهْلِيْ
segs.en: O my God, how gentle You are to me despite my notorious ignorance!
segs.tr: ELAAHEE MAA ALTAFAKA BEE MA-A’ A’ZEEME JAHLEE

segs.ar: وَمَا اَرْحَمَكَ بِيْ مَعَ قَبِيْحِ فِعْلِيْ
segs.en: How merciful You are to me despite my hideous deeds!
segs.tr: WA MAA ARHAMAKA BEE MA-A’ QABEEHE FE’LEE

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ مَا اَقْرَبَكَ مِنِّيْ وَاَبْعَدَنِيْ عَنْكَ
segs.en: O my God, how nigh to me You are and how far from You I am!
segs.tr: ELAAHEE MAA AQRABAKA MINNEE WA AB-A’DANEE A’NKA

segs.ar: وَمَا اَرْاَفَكَ بِيْ فَمَا الَّذِيْ يَحْجُبُنِيْ عَنْكَ؟
segs.en: How kind to me You are; so, what is that which can prevent me from You?
segs.tr: WA MAA AR-AFAKA BEE FAMAL LAZEE YAHJOBONEE A’NKA?

segs.en: O my God, I have known, through variety of signs and changes of phases,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE A’LIMTO BIKHTELAAFIL AASAARE WA TANAQQOLAATIL ATWAARE

segs.ar: اَنَّ مُرَادَكَ مِنِّيْ اَنْ تَتَعَرَّفَ اِلَيَّ فِيْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
segs.en: that what You want from me is that You introduce Yourself to me in all things
segs.tr: ANNA MORAADAKA MINNEE AN TATA-A’RRAFA ELAYYA FEE KULLE SHAY-IN

segs.en: so that I will not ignore You in any thing.
O my God, whenever my lowliness suppresses my voice,
Your nobility encourages me to speak.
Whenever my features lead me to despair (of You), Your bestowals make me crave for You.
segs.tr: WA KULLAMAA AAYASATNEE AWSAAFEE AT-MA-A’TNEE MENANOKA

segs.en: O my God, as for he whose good deeds are wrongdoings;
how can his wrongdoings not be wrongdoings?
As for he whose facts are mere claims,
how can his claims not be claims?
O my God, Your unstoppable decree and Your surmounting volition
segs.tr: ELAAHEE HUKMOKAN NAAFEZO WA MASHIYYATOKAL QAAHERATO

segs.en: have not left any word to be said by any orator
and have not left any manner to be displayed.
segs.tr: WA LAA LE ZEE HAALIN HAALAN

segs.en: O my God, too many are the acts of obedience that I have prepared
and the conducts that I have established,
but Your justice has ruined my reliance on these,
and, moreover, Your favoring has made me abandon them.
O my God, You surely know

segs.ar: اَنِّيْ وَاِنْ لَّمْ تَدُمِ الطَّاعَةُ مِنِّيْ فِعْلًا جَزْمًا
segs.en: that even my obedience (to You) has not lasted in reality,
segs.tr: ANNEE WA IL LAM TADOMIT TAA-A’TO MINNEE FE’LAN JAZMAN

segs.en: it has lasted in love (for it) and determination (to do it)!
O my God, how can I determine, while You are All-supreme?
segs.tr: ELAAHEE KAYFA A-A’ZEMO WA ANTAL QAAHERO?

segs.en: How can I quit determining, while it is Your command (to determine)?
segs.tr: WA KAYFA LAA A-A’ZEMO WA ANTAL AAMERO?

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ تَرَدُّدِيْ فِيْ الْآثَارِيُوْجِبُ بُعْدَ الْمَزَارِ
segs.en: O my God, my wavering among the traces makes the visitation (of You) far off;
segs.tr: ELAAHEE TARADDODEE FIL AASAARE YOOJEBO BOA’DAL MAZAARE

segs.en: so, join me to You through a service that takes me to You.

segs.ar: كَيْفَ يُسْتَدَلُّ عَلَيْكَ بِمَا هُوَ فِيْ وُجُوْدِهٖ مُفْتَقِرٌ اِلَيْكَ؟
segs.en: How can You be figured out through that whose existence relies on You?
segs.tr: KAYFA YUSTADALLO A’LAYKA BEMAA HOWA FEE WOJOODEHEE MUFTAQERUN ELAYKA?

segs.ar: اَيَكُوْنُ لِغَيْرِكَ مِنَ الظُّهُوْرِ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ
segs.en: Can any thing other than You hold a (kind of) manifestation that You lack
segs.tr: A-YAKOONO LEGHAYREKA MENAZ ZOHOORE MAA LAYSA LAKA

segs.en: and thus it may act as an appearance for You?

segs.ar: مَتٰى غِبْتَ حَتّٰى تَحْتَاجَ اِلٰى دَلِيْلٍ يَدُلُّ عَلَيْكَ؟
segs.en: When have You ever been absent so that You may need something to point to You?
segs.tr: MATAA GHIBTA HATTAA TAHTAAJA ELAA DALEELIN YADULLO A’LAYKA?

segs.ar: وَمَتٰى بَعُدْتَ حَتّٰى تَكُوْنَ الْآثَارُ هِيَ الَّتِيْ تُوْصِلُ اِلَيْكَ؟
segs.en: When have You ever been far-off so that traces may lead to You?
segs.tr: WA MATAA BA-U’DTA HATTAA TAKOONAL AASAARO HEYAL LATEE TOOSELO ELAYKA?

segs.ar: عَمِيَتْ عَيْنٌ لَاْ تَرَاكَ عَلَيْهَا رَقِيْبًا
segs.en: Blind be the eye that cannot see You watching it.
segs.tr: A’MEYAT A’YNUN LAA TARAAKA A’LAYHAA RAQEEBAN

segs.ar: وَخَسِرَتْ صَفْقَةُ عَبْدٍ لَمْ تَجْعَلْ لَهٗ مِنْ حُبِّكَ نَصِيْبًا
segs.en: Losing is a servant’s deal that does not dedicate a share to the love for You.
segs.tr: WA KHASERAT SAFQATO A’BDIN LAM TAJ-A’L LAHU MIN HUBBEKA NASEEBAN

segs.en: O my God, You have ordered us to refer to the traces;
therefore, (please do) make me refer to You with the garb of lights
and the guidance of insight

segs.ar: حَتّٰى اَرْجِعَ اِلَيْكَ مِنْهَا كَمَا دَخَلْتُ اِلَيْكَ مِنْهَا
segs.en: so that I will return to You in the same way as I have entered to You from them
segs.tr: HATTAA AR-JE-A’ ELAYKA MINHAA KAMAA DAKHALTO ELAYKA MINHAA

segs.en: as being too protected to look at them
and too determining to depend upon them,
segs.tr: WA MARFOO-I’L HIMMATE A’NIL E-A’TEMAADE A’LAYHAA

segs.en: for You have power over all things.

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ هٰذَا ذُلِّيْ ظَاهِرٌ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
segs.en: O my God, this is my humiliation; it manifests itself before You.
segs.tr: ELAAHEE HAAZAA ZULLEE ZAAHERUN BAYNA YADAYKA

segs.en: This is my manner; it cannot be concealed against You.
segs.tr: WA HAAZAA HAALEE LAA YAKHFAA A’LAYKA

segs.en: From You do I beseech soaring to You
and through You do I take the way to You.
So, (please do) guide me to You through Your Light
and make me stand up before Your Hands with the true servitude to You.
segs.tr: WA AQIMNEE BESIDQIL O’BOODIYYATE BAYNA YADAYKA

segs.en: O my God, teach me from Your veiled knowledge
and protect me with Your shielding shelter.
O my God, (please do) grant me the realities that are enjoyed by the people who are near to You
and make me follow the course of the people who are attracted to You.
segs.tr: WAS LUK BEE MAS-LAKA AHLIL JAZBE

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ اَغْنِنِيْ بِتَدْبِيْرِكَ لِيْ عَنْ تَدْبِيْرِيْ
segs.en: O my God, make Your management of my affairs replace my management of my affairs,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE AGHNENEE BE-TADBEEREKA LEE A’N TADBEEREE

segs.en: make Your choice for me replace my choice for myself,
and make me stand at the positions of my utter need.
O my God, (please do) take my out of the humiliation of myself

segs.ar: وَطَهِّرْنِيْ مِنْ شَكِّيْ وَشِرْكِيْ قَبْلَ حُلُوْلِ رَمْسِيْ
segs.en: and purify me from my suspicion and polytheism before I enter my grave.
segs.tr: WA TAHHIRNEE MIN SHAKKEE WA SHIRKEE QABLA HOLOOLE RAMSEE

segs.en: Only through You do I achieve victory; so, (please do) give me victory.
Only upon You do I rely; so, do not refer me to anyone else.
Only You do I beseech; so, do not disappoint me.
Only for Your favors do I desire; so, do not deprive me (of Your favors).
segs.tr: WA FEE FAZLEKA ARGHABO FALAA TAHRIMNEE

segs.en: Only to Your side do I resort; so, do not set me aside.
At Your door only do I stand; so, do not drive me away.

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ تَقَدَّسَ رِضَاكَ اَنْ يَّكُوْنَ لَهٗ عِلَّةٌ مِنْكَ
segs.en: O my God, Your pleasure is too sanctified to receive a defect from You;
segs.tr: ELAAHEE TAQADDASA REZAAKA AN-Y YAKOONA LAHU I’LLATUN MINKA

segs.en: hence, how can it receive a defect from me?

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ اَنْتَ الْغَنِيُّ بِذَاتِكَ اَنْ يَّصِلَ اِلَيْكَ النَّفْعُ مِنْكَ
segs.en: O my God, You are too self-sufficient by Yourself to be benefited by Yourself;
segs.tr: ELAAHEE ANTAL GHANIYYO BEZAATEKA AN-Y YASELA ELAYKAN NAF-O’ MINKA

segs.en: hence, how can You not be self-sufficient from me?
O my God, fate awakens my hope
segs.tr: ELAAHEE INNAL QAZAAA-A WAL QADARE YOMANNEENEE

segs.en: and whim has enchained me with the firm chains of lust;
segs.tr: WA INNAL HAWAA BEWASAAA-EQISH SHAH-WATE ASARANEE

segs.ar: فَكُنْ اَنْتَ النَّصِيْرَ لِيْ حَتّٰى تَنْصُرَنِيْ وَتُبَصِّرَنِيْ
segs.en: so, (please do) be my Supporter so that You shall back me and show me the right path.
segs.tr: FAKUN ANTAN NASEERA LEE HATTAA TANSORANEE WA TOBASSERANEE

segs.en: And (please do) help me (to dispense with anyone else) through Your favors
so that I shall depend upon You exclusively in my requests.

segs.ar: اَنْتَ الَّذِي اَشْرَقْتَ الْاَنْوَارَ فِيْ قُلُوْبِ اَوْلِيَائِكَ
segs.en: It is You Who have lit the illuminations in the hearts of Your intimate servants
segs.tr: ANTAL LAZEE ASHRAQTAL ANWAARA FEE QOLOOBE AWLEYAAA-EKA

segs.en: so that they have recognized and testified Your Oneness.

segs.ar: وَاَنْتَ الَّذِيْ اَزَلْتَ الْاَغْيَارَ عَنْ قُلُوْبِ اَحِبَّائِكَ
segs.en: It is You Who have removed love for others from the hearts of Your lovers
segs.tr: WA ANTAL LAZEE AZALTAL AGHYAARA A’N QOLOOBE AHIBBAAA-EKA

segs.ar: حَتّٰى لَمْ يُحِبُّوْا سِوَاكَ وَلَمْ يَلْجَأُوْا اِلٰى غَيْرِكَ
segs.en: so that they have loved none save You and they have resorted to none save You.
segs.tr: HATTAA LAM YOHIBBOO SEWAAKA WA LAM YAL-JA-OO ELAA GHAYREKA

segs.ar: اَنْتَ الْمُؤْنِسُ لَهُمْ حَيْثُ اَوْحَشَتْهُمُ الْعَوَالِمُ
segs.en: You alone are their Intimate Companion when the worlds have made them feel lonely.
segs.tr: ANTAL MOONESO LAHUM HAYSO AW HASHAT-HOMUL A’WAALEMO

segs.ar: وَاَنْتَ الَّذِيْ هَدَيْتَهُمْ حَيْثُ اسْتَبَانَتْ لَهُمُ الْمَعَالِمُ
segs.en: You alone have guided them, so that the signposts have become clear to them.
segs.tr: WA ANTAL LAZEE HADAYTAHUM HAYSUS TABAANAT LAHOMUL MA-A’ALEMO

segs.en: What can one who misses You find any substitute?
What can one who finds You miss anything else?
segs.tr: WA MAL LAZEE FAQADA MAN WAJADAKA?

segs.ar: لَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ رَضِيَ دُوْنَكَ بَدَلًا
segs.en: Definitely, failing is he who has accepted anyone other than You as substitute.
segs.tr: LAQAD KHAABA MAN RAZEYA DOONAKA BADALAN

segs.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَسِرَ مَنْ بَغٰى عَنْكَ مُتَحَوِّلًا
segs.en: Definitely, loser is he who have desired for anyone other than You.
segs.tr: WA LAQAD KHASERA MAN BAGHAA A’NKA MOTAHAWWELAN

segs.en: How can anyone other than You be hoped
whilst You have never stopped Your bounties?
How can anyone other than You be besought
whilst You have never changed Your habit of ceaseless bestowal?
segs.tr: WA ANTA MAA BADDALTA A’ADATAL IMTENAANE?

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ اَذَاقَ اَحِبَّائَهٗ حَلَاوَةَ الْمُؤَانَسَةِ
segs.en: O He Who has made His lovers taste the sweetness of intimacy with Him;
segs.tr: YAA MAN A-ZAAQA AHIBBAAA-AHU HALAAWATAL MOAANASATE

segs.en: therefore, they have stood up before Him flattering Him!

segs.ar: وَيَا مَنْ اَلْبَسَ اَوْلِيَآءَهُ مَلَابِسَ هَيْبَتِهٖ
segs.en: O He Who has dressed His intimate servants the garments of fearing Him;
segs.tr: WA YAA MAN ALBASA AWLEYAAA-AHU MALAABESA HAYBATEHI

segs.en: therefore, they have stood before Him seeking His forgiveness!
You do mention the others (with bounties) before they mention You.

segs.ar: وَاَنْتَ الْبَادِئُ بِالْاِحْسَانِ قَبْلَ تَوَجُّهِ الْعَابِدِيْنَ
segs.en: You do spread Your compassion before the worshippers direct towards You.
segs.tr: WA ANTAL BAADEE BIL-EHSAANE QABLA TAWAJJOHIL A’ABEDEENA

segs.ar: وَاَنْتَ الْجَوَادُ بِالْعَطَاءِ قَبْلَ طَلَبِ الطَّالِبِيْنَ
segs.en: You do give generously before You are asked.
segs.tr: WA ANTAL JAWAADO BIL-A’TAA-E QABLA TALABIT TAALEBEENA

segs.ar: وَاَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ ثُمَّ لِمَا وَهَبْتَ لَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْتَقْرِضِيْنَ
segs.en: You do bestow upon us and then borrow from us that which You have bestowed upon us.
segs.tr: WA ANTAL WAHHAABO SUMMA LEMAA WAHABTA LANAA MENAL MUSTAQREZEENA

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ اُطْلُبْنِيْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ حَتّٰى اَصِلَ اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: O my God, (please do) seek me out with Your mercy so that I may reach You,
segs.tr: ELAAHEE UTLUBNEE BE-RAHMATEKA HATTAA A-SELA ELAYKA

segs.en: draw me towards You through Your endless favoring so that I will advance to You.
segs.tr: WAJ ZIBNEE BEMANNEKA HATTAA UQBELA A’LAYKA

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ اِنَّ رَجَائِي لَاْ يَنْقَطِعُ عَنْكَ وَاِنْ عَصَيْتُكَ
segs.en: O my God, verily, my hope for You does not cease despite that I may disobey You.
segs.tr: ELAAHEE INNA RAJAAA-EE LAA YANQATE-O’ A’NKA WA IN A’SAYTOKA

segs.ar: كَمَا اَنَّ خَوْفِيْ لَاْ يُزَايِلُنِيْ وَاِنْ اَطَعْتُكَ
segs.en: Similarly, my fear from You does not leave me even if I obey You.
segs.tr: KAMAA ANNA KHAWFEE LAA YOZAAYELONEE WA IN A-TA’TOKA

segs.en: The Worlds have pushed me towards You
and my acquaintance with Your magnanimity has led me to You.
segs.tr: WA QAD AWQA-A’NEE I’LMEE BEKARAMEKA A’LAYKA

segs.en: O my God, how can I fail whilst You are my hope?
segs.tr: ELAAHEE KAYFA AKHEEBO WA ANTA AMALEE?

segs.en: How can I be humiliated whilst I depend upon You?
segs.tr: AM KAYFA OHAANO WA A’LAYKA MUTTAKALEE?

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ كَيْفَ اَسْتَعِزُّ وَفِيْ الذِّلَّةِ اَرْكَزْتَنِيْ؟
segs.en: O my God, how can I seek dignity whilst You have fixed me in humility?
segs.tr: ELAAHEE KAYFA ASTA-I’ZZO WA FIZ ZILLATE ARKAZTANEE?

segs.ar: اَمْ كَيْفَ لَاْ اَسْتَعِزُّ وَاِلَيْكَ نَسَبْتَنِيْ؟
segs.en: How can I not seek dignity whilst You have attached me to Yourself?
segs.tr: AM KAYFA LAA AS-TAI’ZZO WA ELAYKA NASABTANEE?

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ كَيْفَ لَاْ اَفْتَقِرُ وَاَنْتَ الَّذِيْ فِيْ الْفُقَرَاءِ اَقَمْتَنِيْ؟
segs.en: O my God, how can I not be needy whilst it is You Who have lodged me among the needy?
segs.tr: ELAAHEE KAYFA LAA AFTAQERO WA ANTAL LAZEE FIL FOQARAAA-E AQAMTANEE?

segs.ar: اَمْ كَيْفَ اَفْتَقِرُ وَاَنْتَ الَّذِيْ بِجُوْدِكَ اَغْنَيْتَنِيْ؟
segs.en: How can I be needy whilst You have made me rich out of Your magnanimity?
segs.tr: AM KAYFA AFTAQERO WA ANTAL LAZEE BEJOODEKA AGHNAYTANEE?

segs.en: It is You, there is no god save You,
segs.tr: WA ANTAL LAZEE LAA ELAAHA GHAYROKA

segs.ar: تَعَرَّفْتَ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ فَمَا جَهِلَكَ شَيْءٌ
segs.en: Who have introduced Yourself to all things; therefore, nothing has ever ignored You.
segs.tr: TA-A’RRAFTA LEKULLE SHAY-IN FAMAA JAHELAKA SHAY-UN

segs.ar: وَاَنْتَ الَّذِيْ تَعَرَّفْتَ اِلَيَّ فِيْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
segs.en: It is You Who have introduced Yourself to me in all things;
segs.tr: WA ANTAL LAZEE TA-A’RRAFTA ELAYYA FEE KULLE SHAY-IN

segs.en: therefore, I have seen You Manifest in all things.
It is You Who give manifestation to all things.
O He Who is firm in power through His All-beneficence;
therefore, the Throne has become unseen in His Essence.
You have erased the traces by the traces;
and You have erased the changeable by the surroundings of the orbits of lights.
segs.tr: WA MAHAW-TAL AGHYAARA BEMOHEETAATE AFLAAKIL ANWAARE

segs.ar: يَا مَنِ احْتَجَبَ فِيْ سُرَادِقَاتِ عَرْشِهٖ
segs.en: O He Who has screened Himself in the curtains of His Throne;
segs.tr: YAA MANEH TAJABA FEE SORAADEQAATE A’RSHEHI

segs.en: hence, He cannot be comprehended by visions!
O He Who has manifested Himself with His perfect Magnificence;
therefore, His Grandeur has become firmly established.
How can You be hidden whilst You are the Manifester (of all things)?
Or how can You be absent whilst You are the Watcher (over all things)
and the Present (at all times.)
Verily, You have power over all things.
All praise be to Allah alone.

A_AC13.name: Ziyarat Jamia of the 14 Masumeen (a.s.) - Especially on the Day of Arafah

segs.note: THIRD COMPREHENSIVE FORM OF ZIYARAH
segs.ur: زیارت کی تیسری جامع صورت

segs.note: Allamah al-Majlisi (r.a.), in his book of Tohfat al-Zaaer, has listed the following comprehensive form of ziyarah as the eighth, saying: This form of ziyarah has been reported by Sayyid Ibn Tawus (r.a.) within the supplicatory prayers of the Arafah Day from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.). It can be said at visiting any shrine at any time, especially on the Arafah Day. It is as follows:
segs.ur: علامہ مجلسی (رح) نے اپنی کتاب «تحفۃ الزائر» میں زیارت کی درج ذیل جامع صورت کو آٹھویں صورت کے طور پر درج کیا ہے اور کہا ہے: زیارت کی یہ صورت سید ابن طاووس (رح) نے یوم عرفہ کی دعاؤں میں امام صادق (ع) سے روایت کی ہے۔ اسے کسی بھی حرم کی زیارت کے وقت، کسی بھی وقت، خاص طور پر یوم عرفہ میں پڑھا جا سکتا ہے۔ وہ یہ ہے:

segs.en: Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Prophet of Allah.

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خِيَرَةَ اللّٰهِ مِنْ خَلْقِهٖ وَاَمِيْنَهٗ عَلٰى وَحْيِهٖ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O chosen one of Allah from His creation, and His trustee over His revelation.
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA KHIYARATAL LAAHE MIN KHALQEHE WA AMEENAHO A’LAA WAHYEHI

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَاۤ اَمِيْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O my master, O Commander of the Faithful.
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA MAWLAAYA YAA AMEERAL MO-MENEENA

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ اَنْتَ حُجَّةُ اللّٰهِ عَلٰى خَلْقِهٖ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O my master; you are the proof of Allah over His creation,
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA MAWLAAYA ANTA HUJJATUL LAAHE A’LAA KHALQEHI

segs.en: the gate to His knowledge, the executor of His Prophet,
segs.tr: WA BAABO I’LMEHI WA WASIYYO NABIIYYEHI

segs.en: and the successor after him within his nation.
segs.tr: WAL KHALEEFATO MIM BA’-DEHI FEE UMMATEHI

segs.ar: لَعَنَ اللّٰهُ اُمَّةً غَصَبَتْكَ حَقَّكَ وَقَعَدَتْ مَقْعَدَكَ
segs.en: May Allah curse the nation that usurped your right and seated themselves in your place;
segs.tr: LA-A’NAL LAAHO UMMATAN GHASABATKA HAQQAKA WA QA-A’DAT MAQ-A’DAKA

segs.ar: اَنَا بَرِيْۤءٌ مِنْهُمْ وَمِنْ شِيْعَتِهِمْ اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: I disassociate myself from them and from their followers before you.
segs.tr: ANA BA-REE-UM MINHUM WA MIN SHEE-A’TEHIM ELAYKA

segs.en: Peace be upon you, O Fatemah al-Batool.

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا زَيْنَ نِسَاۤءِ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O adornment of the women of the worlds.
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMO A’LAYKE YAA ZAYNA NESAAA-IL A’ALAMEENA

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ رَسُوْلِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Messenger of the Lord of the worlds;
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMO A’LAYKE YAA BINTA RASOOLE RABBIL A’ALAMEENA

segs.en: may the blessings of Allah be upon you and upon him.

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَاۤ اُمَّ الْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O mother of al-Hasan and al-Husayn.
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMO A’LAYKE YAA UMMAL HASANE WAL HUSAYNE

segs.en: May Allah curse the nation that usurped your right

segs.ar: وَمَنَعَتْكِ مَا جَعَلَهُ اللّٰهُ لَكِ حَلَالًا
segs.en: and withheld from you what Allah had made lawful for you;
segs.tr: WA MANA-A’TKE MAA JA-A’LAHUL LAAHO LAKE HALAALAN

segs.ar: اَنَا بَرِيْ‏ءٌ اِلَيْكِ مِنْهُمْ وَمِنْ شِيْعَتِهِمْ
segs.en: I disassociate myself from them and from their followers before you.
segs.tr: ANA BA-REE-UM ELAYKE MINHUM WA MIN SHEE-A’TEHIM

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَاۤ اَبَا مُحَمَّدٍۨ الْحَسَنَ الزَّكِيَّ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O my master, O Aba Muhammad, al-Hasan the pure.
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA MAWLAAYA YAA ABAA MOHAMMADINIL HASANAZ ZAKIYYA

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ لَعَنَ اللّٰهُ اُمَّةً قَتَلَتْكَ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O my master. May Allah curse the nation that killed you,
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA MAWLAAYA LA-A’NAL LAAHO UMMATAN QATALATKA

segs.en: compromised against you, and aligned with [your enemies];
segs.tr: WA BAAYA-A’T FEE AMREKA WA SHAAYA-A’T

segs.ar: اَنَا بَرِيۤ‏ءٌ اِلَيْكَ مِنْهُمْ وَمِنْ شِيْعَتِهِمْ
segs.en: I disassociate myself from them and from their followers before you.
segs.tr: ANA BA-REE-UN ELAYKA MINHUM WA MIN SHEE-A’TEHIM

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَاۤ اَبَا عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ الْحُسَيْنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O my master, O Aba Abdillah, al-Husayn ibn Ali;
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA MAWLAAYA YAA ABAA A’BDIL LAAHIL HUSAYN ABNA A’LIYYIN

segs.ar: صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلٰۤى اَبِيْكَ وَجَدِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ
segs.en: may the blessings of Allah be upon you, and upon your father and your grandfather Muhammad, may the peace and blessings of Allah be upon him and his family.
segs.tr: SALAWAATUL LAAHE A’LAYKA WA A’LAA ABEEKA WA JADDEKA MOHAMMADIN SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI

segs.en: May Allah curse the nation that deemed your blood lawful,

segs.ar: وَلَعَنَ اللّٰهُ اُمَّةً قَتَلَتْكَ وَاسْتَبَاحَتْ حَرِيْمَكَ
segs.en: and may Allah curse the nation that killed you and violated your sanctity.
segs.tr: WA LA-A’NAL LAAHO UMMATAN QATALATKA WAS TABAAHAT HAREEMAKA

segs.en: May Allah curse their factions and their followers,
segs.tr: WA LA-A’NAL LAAHO ASHYAA-A’HUM WA ATBAA-A’HUM

segs.ar: وَلَعَنَ اللّٰهُ الْمُمَهِّدِيْنَ لَهُمْ بِالتَّمْكِيْنِ مِنْ قِتَالِكُمْ
segs.en: and may Allah curse those who paved the way for them by enabling them to fight against you;
segs.tr: WA LA-A’NAL LAAHUL MOMAHHEDEENA LAHUM BIT-TAMKEENE MIN QETAALEKUM

segs.ar: اَنَا بَرِيْۤ‏ءٌ اِلَى اللّٰهِ وَاِلَيْكَ مِنْهُمْ
segs.en: I disassociate myself from them before Allah and before you.
segs.tr: ANA BA-REE-UN ELAL LAAHE WA ELAYKA MINHUM

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا اَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَلِيَّ بْنَ الْحُسَيْنِ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O my master, O Aba Muhammad, Ali ibn al-Husayn.
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA MAWLAAYA YAA ABAA MOHAMMADIN A’LIY YABNAL HUSAYNE

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا اَبَا جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O my master, O Aba Ja'far, Muhammad ibn Ali.
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA MAWLAAYA YAA ABAA JA’-FARIN MOHAMMAD ABNA A’LIYYIN

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا اَبَا عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ جَعْفَرَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O my master, O Aba Abdillah, Ja'far ibn Muhammad.
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA MAWLAAYA YAA ABAA A’BDIL LAAHE JA’-FAR ABNA MOHAMMADIN

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا اَبَا الْحَسَنِ‏ مُوْسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O my master, O Aba al-Hasan, Musa ibn Ja'far.
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA MAWLAAYA YAA ABAL HASANE MOOSAB NA JA’-FARIN

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا اَبَا الْحَسَنِ‏ عَلِيَّ بْنَ مُوْسٰۤى
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O my master, O Aba al-Hasan, Ali ibn Moosa.
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA MAWLAAYA YAA ABAL HASANE A’LIY YABNA MOOSA

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا اَبَا جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O my master, O Aba Ja'far, Muhammad ibn Ali.
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA MAWLAAYA YAA ABAA JA’-FARIN MOHAMMAD ABNA A’LIYYIN

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا اَبَا الْحَسَنِ‏ عَلِيَّ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O my master, O Aba al-Hasan, Ali ibn Muhammad.
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA MAWLAAYA YAA ABAL HASANE A’LIYYAB NA MOHAMMADIN

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا اَبَا مُحَمَّدٍۨ الْحَسَنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O my master, O Aba Muhammad, al-Hasan ibn Ali.
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA MAWLAAYA YAA ABAA MOHAMMADENIL HASAN ABNA A’LIYYIN

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا اَبَا الْقَاسِمِ‏ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ الْحَسَنِ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O my master, O Aba al-Qasim, Muhammad ibn al-Hasan,
segs.tr: AS-SALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA MAWLAAYA YAA ABAL QAASEME MOHAMMAD ABNAL HASANE

segs.ar: صَاحِبَ الزَّمَانِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلٰى عِتْرَتِكَ الطَّاهِرَةِ الطَّيِّبَةِ
segs.en: the Master of the Time; may the blessings of Allah be upon you and upon your pure and wholesome progeny.
segs.tr: SAAHEBAZ ZAMAANE SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYKA WA A’LAA I’TRATEKAT TAAHERATIT TAYYEBATE

segs.ar: يَا مَوَالِيَّ كُوْنُوْا شُفَعَاۤئِيْ فِيْ حَطِّ وِزْرِيْ وَخَطَايَايَ
segs.en: O my masters, be my intercessors in the shedding of my burdens and my mistakes.
segs.tr: YAA MAWAALIYYA KOONOO SHOFA-A’AAA-EE FEE HATTE WIZREE WA KHATAAYAAYA

segs.ar: اٰمَنْتُ بِاللّٰهِ وَبِمَا اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْكُمْ وَاَتَوَالٰى اٰخِرَكُمْ بِمَا اَتَوَالٰى اَوَّلَكُمْ
segs.en: I believe in Allah and in what has been revealed to you. I accept the leadership of the last of you just as I accept the leadership of the first of you,
segs.tr: AAMANTO BILLAAHE WA BEMAA UNZELA ELAYKUM WA ATAWAALAA AAKHERAKUM BEMAA ATAWAALAA AWWALAKUM

segs.ar: وَبَرِئْتُ مِنَ الْجِبْتِ وَالطَّاغُوْتِ وَاللَّاتِ وَالْعُزّٰى
segs.en: and I disassociate myself from the false sorcerer (Jibt), the tyrant (Taghut), al-Lat, and al-Uzza.
segs.tr: WA BARE-TO MENAL JIBTE WAT TAAGHOOTE WAL LAATE WAL U’ZZAA

segs.ar: يَا مَوَالِيَّ اَنَا سِلْمٌ لِمَنْ سَالَمَكُمْ وَحَرْبٌ لِمَنْ حَارَبَكُمْ
segs.en: O my masters, I am at peace with whomever is at peace with you, at war with whomever is at war with you,
segs.tr: YAA MAWAALIYYA ANA SILMUN LEMAN SAALAMAKUM WA HARBUN LEMAN HAARABAKUM

segs.ar: وَعَدُوٌّ لِمَنْ عَادَاكُمْ وَوَلِيٌّ لِمَنْ وَالَاكُمْ اِلٰى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
segs.en: an enemy to whomever shows enmity to you, and a friend to whomever aligns with you, until the Day of Resurrection.
segs.tr: WA A’DUWWUL LEMAN A’ADAAKUM WA WALIYYUN LEMAN WAALAAKUM ELAA YAWMIL QEYAAMATE

segs.en: May Allah curse those who oppressed you and usurped your rights,
segs.tr: WA LA-A’NAL LAAHO ZAALEMEEKUM WA GHAASEBEEKUM

segs.ar: وَلَعَنَ اللّٰهُ اَشْيَاعَهُمْ وَاَتْبَاعَهُمْ وَاَهْلَ مَذْهَبِهِمْ
segs.en: and may Allah curse their factions, their followers, and the people of their school of thought;
segs.tr: WA LA-A’NAL LAAHO ASHYAA-A’HUM WA ATBAA-A’HUM WA AHLA MAZHABEHIM

segs.en: I disassociate myself from them before Allah and before you.
segs.tr: WA ABRA-O ELAL LAAHE WA ELAYKUM MINHUM.

segs.note: The tenth night of Zilhajj is a blessed night since it is one of the four nights that should be advisably spent with acts of worship. At this night, the doors of the heavens are opened. It is also highly recommended to visit the tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) at this night and to say this supplication, which is also among the rites of Friday nights:
segs.ur: ذی الحجہ کی دسویں رات مبارک رات ہے کیونکہ یہ ان چار راتوں میں سے ایک ہے جنہیں عبادت کے ساتھ جاگ کر گزارنا مستحب ہے۔ اس رات آسمان کے دروازے کھول دیے جاتے ہیں۔ اس رات امام حسین (ع) کی قبر کی زیارت کرنا اور یہ دعا پڑھنا بھی بہت مستحب ہے، جو [شبِ جمعہ کے اعمال](P1) میں بھی شامل ہے:

segs.en: O He Who is continuous in bestowing favor upon the creation!
O He Who extends both hands with giving!
O Owner of magnificent gifts!
Bless Muhammad and his family—
the best of mankind in natural disposition—
and forgive us, O Possessor of Exaltation,
segs.tr: WAGH FIR LANAA YAA ZAL O’LAA

segs.en: on this evening.

A_AC15.name: The Day of Eid al-Adha (Qurban)

segs.note: Ghusl, Eid Prayer & Sacrifice
segs.ur: غسل، نمازِ عید اور قربانی

segs.note: Bathe on this day (highly recommended).
segs.ur: اس دن غسل کریں (انتہائی مستحب).

segs.note: Offer Salat al-Eid, as described in the acts of Eid al-Fitr. On this day, break your fast after Salat al-Eid and eat from the meat of the sacrificed animals.
segs.ur: [نمازِ عید](AD4) پڑھیں، جیسا کہ عید الفطر کے اعمال میں بیان ہوا ہے۔ اس دن نمازِ عید کے بعد روزہ کھولیں اور قربانی کے جانوروں کا گوشت کھائیں۔

segs.note: Say the supplications reported for before and after Salat al-Eid.
segs.ur: نمازِ عید سے پہلے اور بعد کے لیے وارد دعائیں پڑھیں۔

segs.note: The most important is supplication No. 48 of al-Saheefah al-Kaamelah al-Sajjaadiyyah, which begins with “O Allah, This is a blessed day….”
segs.ur: ان میں سب سے اہم صحیفۂ کاملہ سجادیہ کی دعا نمبر 48 ہے، جو «اے اللہ! یہ مبارک دن ہے...» سے شروع ہوتی ہے۔

segs.note: Also say supplication No. 46 of the same book, which begins with “O He Who has mercy upon him whom is not compassionated by the servants”.
segs.ur: نیز اسی کتاب کی دعا نمبر 46 پڑھیں، جو «اے وہ جو اس پر رحم کرتا ہے جس پر بندے رحم نہیں کرتے» سے شروع ہوتی ہے۔

segs.note: Say Dua al-Nudbah (The Supplication of Lamentation).
segs.ur: [دعائے ندبہ](E34) (نوحہ و فریاد کی دعا) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Offer a sacrifice, which is to slaughter an animal (confirmedly recommended).
segs.ur: قربانی کریں، یعنی جانور ذبح کریں (مستحبِ مؤکد)۔

segs.note: Takbirat after Prayers
segs.ur: نمازوں کے بعد تکبیرات

segs.note: At Mina, say these statements fifteen times immediately after fifteen obligatory prayers, beginning with the Zohr Prayer on the Eid al-Azhaa Day and ending with the Fajr Prayer on the thirteenth of Zilhajj.
segs.ur: منیٰ میں، یہ کلمات پندرہ واجب نمازوں کے فوراً بعد پندرہ مرتبہ کہیں، عید الاضحیٰ کے دن کی نماز ظہر سے شروع کر کے تیرہ ذی الحجہ کی نماز فجر تک.

segs.note: Elsewhere, say them ten times instead of fifteen, immediately after ten obligatory prayers, beginning with the Zohr Prayer on the Eid al-Azhaa Day and ending with the Fajr Prayer on the twelfth of Zilhajj.
segs.ur: دوسری جگہ: انہیں پندرہ کے بجائے دس مرتبہ کہیں، دس واجب نمازوں کے فوراً بعد، عید الاضحیٰ کے دن کی نمازِ ظہر سے شروع کر کے ذی الحجہ کی بارہویں تاریخ کی نمازِ فجر تک۔

segs.note: According to the authentic narration mentioned in al-Kafi, the statements are:
segs.ur: الکافی میں مذکور معتبر روایت کے مطابق، کلمات یہ ہیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَاللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ وَلِلّٰهِ الْحَمْدُ وَاللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ عَلٰى مَا هَدَانَا اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ عَلٰى مَا رَزَقَنَا مِنْ بَهِيْمَةِ الْاَنْعَامِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَلٰى مَاۤ اَبْلَانَا.
segs.en: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. Allah is the Greatest, and for Allah is all praise. Allah is the Greatest for what He has guided us to; Allah is the Greatest for what He has provided for us of grazing livestock; and all praise is for Allah for what He has tested us with [and bestowed upon us].
segs.tr: ALLAAHO AKBAR ALLAAHO AKBAR LAA ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO WAL LAAHO AKBAR ALLAAHO AKBAR WA LILLAAHIL HAMD WAL LAAHO AKBAR A’LAA MAA HADAANAA ALLAAHO AKBAR A’LAA MAA RAZAQANAA MIM BAHEEMATIL AN-A’AME WAL HAMDO LILLAAHE A’LAA MAA ABLAANAA.

segs.note: It is recommended to repeat these statements immediately after the obligatory and supererogatory (mustahab / naafelah) prayers as many times as possible.
segs.ur: مستحب ہے کہ ان کلمات کو واجب اور مستحب (نافلہ) نمازوں کے فوراً بعد جتنی بار ممکن ہو دہرایا جائے۔

A_AC15.merits:
The tenth of Zilhajj is the Eid al-Azhaa (The feast of immolation) Day. A number of acts has been narrated to be done on this honorable day.

Ghusl: In fact, some scholars have decided it as obligatory.

Supplications of Salat al-Eid: These supplications are mentioned in the book of Iqbal al-Aa’mal.

A_AC17.name: Aamal of the Night of Eid al-Ghadir

segs.note: The eighteenth night of Zilhajj is the Eid al-Ghadeer Night. It is a blessed night. Sayyid Ibn Tawus, in al-Iqbal, has mentioned that a prayer of twelve units with one Taslim statement (i.e. continuous and uninterrupted prayer), followed by a supplicatory prayer, should be advisably practiced and said at this night.
segs.ur: ذی الحجہ کی اٹھارہویں رات عید غدیر کی رات ہے۔ یہ ایک مبارک رات ہے۔ سید ابن طاؤس نے الاقبال میں ذکر کیا ہے کہ اس رات ایک سلام کے ساتھ (یعنی مسلسل اور بلا وقفہ) بارہ رکعت نماز پڑھنا اور اس کے بعد دعا کرنا مستحب ہے۔

A_AC18.name: Aamal of the Day of Eid al-Ghadir

segs.note: Fasting, Ghusl & Ziyarat
segs.ur: روزہ، غسل اور زیارت

segs.note: Fast on this day.
segs.ur: اس دن روزہ رکھیں۔

segs.note: Bathe on this day.
segs.ur: اس دن غسل کریں.

segs.note: Visit the holy tomb of Imam Ali Ameer al-Momineen (a.s.). Do your best to attend at it on this day even if such a journey be difficult.
segs.ur: امام علی امیر المومنین (ع) کے مقدس مزار کی زیارت کریں۔ اس دن وہاں حاضر ہونے کی پوری کوشش کریں خواہ ایسا سفر دشوار ہو۔

segs.note: Three forms of Ziyarat have been decided for this day: Ziyarat Ameenullah, which can be recited whether one is present at the holy tomb or far away from it; Ziyarat on the Day of Ghadir; and Another Ziyarat on the Day of Ghadir.
segs.ur: اس دن کے لیے زیارت کی تین صورتیں مقرر کی گئی ہیں: [زیارت امین اللہ](G2) جو مقدس مزار پر حاضر ہوں یا اس سے دور، دونوں صورتوں میں پڑھی جا سکتی ہے؛ [یوم غدیر کی زیارت](AC1)؛ اور [یوم غدیر کی دوسری زیارت](AC2)۔

segs.note: Say the supplication of seeking Almighty Allah’s protection against Satan (Istea’azah).
segs.ur: شیطان سے اللہ تعالیٰ کی پناہ مانگنے کی دعا (استعاذہ) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Two Unit Prayer & Sajdah
segs.ur: دو رکعت نماز اور سجدہ

segs.note: Offer a two unit prayer, preferably at midday (Zuhr). In the first unit recite Surah al-Faatehah then Surah al-Qadr; in the second, Surah al-Faatehah then Surah al-Tawheed.
segs.ur: دو رکعت نماز پڑھیں، بہتر ہے کہ دوپہر (ظہر) کے وقت پڑھیں۔ پہلی رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) پھر [سورہ قدر](A101) پڑھیں؛ دوسری میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) پھر [سورہ توحید](A116) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: After the prayer, prostrate yourself and thank Almighty Allah one hundred times. Then raise your head from the prostration and say:
segs.ur: نماز کے بعد سجدہ کریں اور اللہ تعالیٰ کا سو مرتبہ شکر ادا کریں۔ پھر سجدے سے سر اٹھائیں اور کہیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ بِاَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ وَاَنَّكَ وَاحِدٌ اَحَدٌ صَمَدٌ لَّمْ تَلِدْ وَلَمْ تُوْلَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّكَ كُفُوًا اَحَدٌ وَاَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُوْلُكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ.  يَا مَنْ هُوَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ فِيْ شَاْنٍ كَمَا كَانَ مِنْ شَاْنِكَ اَنْ تَفَضَّلْتَ عَلَيَّ بِاَنْ جَعَلْتَنِيْ ‏مِنْ اَهْلِ اِجَابَتِكَ وَاَهْلِ دِيْنِكَ وَاَهْلِ دَعْوَتِكَ وَوَفَّقْتَنِيْ لِذٰلِكَ فِيْ مُبْتَدَاِ خَلْقِيْ تَفَضُّلًا مِّنْكَ وَكَرَمًا وَّجُوْدًا ثُمَّ اَرْدَفْتَ الْفَضْلَ فَضْلًا وَالْجُوْدَ جُوْدًا وَالْكَرَمَ كَرَمًا رَأْفَةً مِّنْكَ وَرَحْمَةً اِلٰی اَنْ جَدَّدْتَ ذٰلِكَ الْعَهْدَ لِيْ تَجْدِيْدًا ۢ بَعْدَ تَجْدِيْدِكَ خَلْقِيْ وَكُنْتُ نَسْيًا مَّنْسِيًّا نَاسِيًا سَاهِيًا غَافِلًا فَاَتْمَمْتَ نِعْمَتَكَ بِاَنْ ذَكَّرْتَنِيْ ذٰلِكَ وَمَنَنْتَ بِهٖ عَلَيَّ وَهَدَيْتَنِيْ لَهٗ فَلْيَكُنْ مِّنْ شَأْنِكَ يَا اِلٰهِيْ وَسَيِّدِيْ وَمَوْلَايَ اَنْ تُتِمَّ لِيْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا تَسْلُبْنِيْهِ حَتّٰى تَتَوَفَّانِيْ عَلٰى ذٰلِكَ وَاَنْتَ عَنِّيْ رَاضٍ فَاِنَّكَ اَحَقُّ الْمُنْعِمِيْنَ اَنْ تُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَكَ عَلَيَّ.  اَللّٰهُمَّ سَمِعْنَا وَاَطَعْنَا وَاَجَبْنَا دَاعِيَكَ بِمَنِّكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَاِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيْرُ اٰمَنَّا بِاللهِ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ وَبِرَسُوْلِهٖ مُحَمَّدٍ وَصَدَّقْنَا وَاَجَبْنَا دَاعِيَ اللهِ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُوْلَ فِيْ مُوَالَاةِ مَوْلَانَا وَمَوْلَى الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ اَمِيْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَبِيْ طَالِبٍ عَبْدِ اللهِ وَاَخِيْ رَسُوْلِهٖ وَالصِّدِّيْقِ الْاَكْبَرِ وَالْحُجَّةِ عَلٰى بَرِيَّتِهِ الْمُؤَيِّدِ بِهٖ نَبِيُّهٗ وَدِينُهُ الْحَقَّ الْمُبِيْنَ عَلَمًا لِّدِيْنِ اللهِ وَخَازِنًا لِّعِلْمِهٖ وَعَيْبَةِ غَيْبِ اللهِ وَمَوْضِعِ سِرِّ اللهِ وَاَمِيْنَ اللهِ عَلٰى خَلْقِهٖ وَشَاهِدَهٗ فِيْ بَرِيَّتِهٖ.  اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّنَا اِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُّنَادِيْ لِلْاِيْمَانِ اَنْ اٰمِنُوْا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَاٰمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْاَبْرَارِ رَبَّنَا وَاٰتِنَا مَا وَعَدْتَنَا عَلٰى‏ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ اِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيْعَادَ. فَاِنَّا يَا رَبَّنَا بِمَنِّكَ وَلُطْفِكَ اَجَبْنَا دَاعِيَكَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُوْلَ وَصَدَّقْنَاهُ وَصَدَّقْنَا مَوْلَى الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَكَفَرْنَا بِالْجِبْتِ وَالطَّاغُوْتِ فَوَلِّنَا مَا تَوَلَّيْنَا وَاحْشُرْنَا مَعَ اَئِمَّتِنَا فَاِنَّا بِهِمْ مُؤْمِنُوْنَ مُوْقِنُوْنَ وَلَهُمْ مُسَلِّمُوْنَ اٰمَنَّا بِسِرِّهِمْ وَعَلَانِيَتِهِمْ وَشَاهِدِهِمْ وَغَاۤئِبِهِمْ وَحَيِّهِمْ وَمَيِّتِهِمْ وَرَضِيْنَا بِهِمْ اَئِمَّةً وَقَادَةً وَسَادَةً وَحَسْبُنَا بِهِمْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ اللهِ دُوْنَ خَلْقِهٖ لَا نَبْتَغِيْ بِهِمْ بَدَلًا وَّلَا نَتَّخِذُ مِنْ دُوْنِهِمْ وَلِيْجَةً وَّبَرِئْنَا اِلَی اللهِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَنْ نَصَبَ لَهُمْ حَرْبًا مِّنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنْسِ مِنَ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ وَالْاٰخِرِيْنَ وَكَفَرْنَا بِالْجِبْتِ وَالطَّاغُوْتِ وَالْاَوْثَانِ الْاَرْبَعَةِ وَاَشْيَاعِهِمْ وَاَتْبَاعِهِمْ وَكُلِّ مَنْ وَالَاهُمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنْسِ مِنْ اَوَّلِ الدَّهْرِ اِلٰی اٰخِرِهٖ  اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّا نُشْهِدُكَ اَنَّا نَدِيْنُ بِمَا دَانَ بِهٖ مُحَمَّدٌ وَّاٰلُ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ وَقَوْلُنَا مَا قَالُوْا وَدِيْنُنَا مَا دَانُوْا بِهٖ مَا قَالُوْا بِهٖ قُلْنَا وَمَا دَانُوْا بِهٖ دِنَّا وَمَاۤ اَنْكَرُوْا اَنْكَرْنَا وَمَنْ وَالَوْا وَالَيْنَا وَمَنْ عَادَوْا عَادَيْنَا وَمَنْ لَعَنُوْا لَعَنَّا وَمَنْ تَبَرَّئُوْا مِنْهُ تَبَرَّاْنَا مِنْهُ وَمَنْ تَرَحَّمُوْا عَلَيْهِ تَرَحَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ اٰمَنَّا وَسَلَّمْنَا وَرَضِيْنَا وَاتَّبَعْنَا مَوَالِيَنَا صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ عَلَيْهِمْ. اَللّٰهُمَّ فَتَمِّمْ لَنَا ذٰلِكَ وَلَا تَسْلُبْنَاهُ وَاجْعَلْهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا ثَابِتًا عِنْدَنَا وَلَا تَجْعَلْهُ مُسْتَعَارًا وَاَحْيِنَا مَا اَحْيَيْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ وَاَمِتْنَا اِذَا اَمَتَّنَا عَلَيْهِ اٰلُ مُحَمَّدٍ اَئِمَّتُنَا فَبِهِمْ نَأْتَمُّ وَاِيَّاهُمْ نُوَالِيْ وَعَدُوَّهُمْ عَدُوَّ اللهِ نُعَادِيْ فَاجْعَلْنَا مَعَهُمْ فِيْ الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ وَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِيْنَ فَاِنَّا بِذٰلِكَ رَاضُوْنَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ.
segs.en: O Allah, indeed I ask You by virtue of the fact that all praise belongs to You alone, You have no partner; and that You are One, Unique, Absolute, Who begets not nor is He begotten, and there is none like unto Him; and that Muhammad is Your servant and Your Messenger, Your blessings be upon him and his family. O He Who every day is engaged in a matter! Just as it was part of Your matter that You bestowed favor upon me by making me among the people who answer You, the people of Your religion, and the people of Your call, and You guided me to that at the very beginning of my creation out of Your grace, generosity, and bounty; then You followed up favor with favor, bounty with bounty, and generosity with generosity, out of Your kindness and mercy, until You renewed that covenant for me, a thorough renewal after Your renewal of my creation, when I was something forgotten, unremembered, oblivious, inadvertent, and heedless. Thus, You completed Your blessing by reminding me of it, favored me with it, and guided me to it. So let it be part of Your matter, O my God, my Master, and my Chief, to complete this for me and not to strip me of it until You take me in death while I am upon this state and You are well-pleased with me; for You are the most entitled of all benefactors to complete Your blessing upon me. O Allah, we have heard, we have obeyed, and we have answered Your caller through Your favor, so to You belongs all praise. We seek Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the eventual return.
