We believe in Allah alone, Who has no partner, and in His Messenger Muhammad; we have verified [the truth], answered the caller of Allah, and followed the Messenger in accepting the guardianship (Wilayah) of our master and the master of the believers, the Commander of the Faithful (Amir al-Mu'minin), Ali ibn Abi Talib—the servant of Allah, the brother of His Messenger, the Greatest Truthful One (al-Siddiq al-Akbar), the proof over His creation, through whom He supported His Prophet and His religion, the manifest truth, a beacon for the religion of Allah, a treasurer of His knowledge, the repository of the unseen of Allah, the location of the secret of Allah, the trustee of Allah over His creation, and His witness among His creatures. O Allah, our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, saying, 'Believe in your Lord,' so we have believed. Our Lord, forgive us our sins, expiate from us our evil deeds, and take us in death with the righteous. Our Lord, grant us what You promised us through Your Messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection; indeed, You never break Your promise. For indeed, O our Lord, by Your favor and Your kindness, we have answered Your caller, followed the Messenger, and believed him; and we have believed the master of the believers, and we have disbelieved in the false sorcerer (Jibt) and the tyrant (Taghut). Therefore, turn us toward that which we have turned to, and gather us with our Imams, for we are believers in them, certain of them, and submissive to them. We believe in their secret and their public, their witness and their absent, their living and their dead. We are well-pleased with them as Imams, leaders, and masters; they are sufficient for us between us and Allah to the exclusion of the rest of His creation—we seek no substitute for them, nor do we take any intimate support besides them. We disassociate ourselves before Allah from everyone who waged war against them, from among the jinn and mankind, from the first to the last; and we disavow the false sorcerer (Jibt), the tyrant (Taghut), the four idols, their factions, their followers, and everyone who aligned with them from among the jinn and mankind, from the beginning of time to its end. O Allah, indeed we call You to witness that we profess the religion that Muhammad and the family of Muhammad (may the blessings of Allah be upon him and upon them) professed. Our word is what they said, and our religion is what they practiced as religion; what they spoke of, we speak of, and what they took as religion, we take as religion. What they denied, we deny; whomever they aligned with, we align with; whomever they cursed, we curse; whomever they disassociated from, we disassociate from; and whomever they invoked mercy upon, we invoke mercy upon. We believe, we submit, we are well-pleased, and we follow our masters—may the blessings of Allah be upon them. O Allah, so complete this for us and do not strip us of it. Make it permanently settled and firmly established with us, and do not make it a temporary loan. Keep us alive upon it as long as You keep us alive, and cause us to die upon it when You cause us to die. The family of Muhammad are our Imams, so by them we lead ourselves, to them we give our allegiance, and their enemy—the enemy of Allah—we oppose. Therefore, place us with them in this world and the Hereafter, and make us among those brought near [to You]; for indeed, we are well-pleased with that, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA BE-ANNA LAKAL HAMDA WAHDAKA LAA SHAREEKA LAKA WA ANNAKA WAAHEDUN AHADUN SAMADUL LAM TALID WA LAM TOOLAD WA LAM YAKUL LAKA KOFOWAN AHADUN WA ANNA MOHAMMADAN A’BDOKA WA RASOOLOKA SALAWAATOKA A’LAYHE WA AALEHI. segs.note: Prostrate yourself again and repeat each of these doxological prayers one hundred times:
segs.ur: دوبارہ سجدہ کریں اور ان تسبیحات میں سے ہر ایک کو سو مرتبہ دہرائیں:

segs.en: All praise is for Allah, and thanks be to Allah.

segs.note: Prayer before Zuhr
segs.ur: نماز ظہر سے پہلے کی نماز

segs.note: Bathe, and half an hour before midday (Zuhr) offer a two unit prayer. In each unit, recite Surah al-Faatehah once, Surah al-Tawheed ten times, Ayat al-Kursi ten times and Surah al-Qadr ten times.
segs.ur: غسل کریں اور ظہر سے آدھا گھنٹہ پہلے دو رکعت نماز پڑھیں۔ ہر رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ، [سورہ توحید](A116) دس مرتبہ، [آیت الکرسی](A4) دس مرتبہ اور [سورہ قدر](A101) دس مرتبہ پڑھیں.

segs.note: After this prayer, it is preferable to say the supplicatory prayer that begins: رَبَّنَاۤ اِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا...
segs.ur: اس نماز کے بعد وہ دعا پڑھنا مستحب ہے جو اس طرح شروع ہوتی ہے: رَبَّنَاۤ اِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا...

segs.note: Dua Nudba & Dua of Shaykh al-Mufid
segs.ur: دعائے ندبہ اور دعائے شیخ مفید

segs.note: Recite Dua al-Nudbah.
segs.ur: [دعائے ندبہ](E34) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Recite this supplicatory prayer, which is reported by Sayyid Ibn Taaoos from Shaykh al-Mufeed:
segs.ur: یہ دعا پڑھیں، جسے سید ابن طاووس نے شیخ مفید سے نقل کیا ہے:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ وَعَلِيٍّ وَلِيِّكَ وَالشَّأْنِ وَالْقَدْرِ الَّذِيْ خَصَصْتَهُمَا بِهٖ دُوْنَ خَلْقِكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلِيٍّ وَاَنْ تَبْدَاَ بِهِمَا فِيْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ عَاجِلٍ اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍۨ الْاَئِمَّةِ الْقَادَةِ وَالدُّعَاةِ السَّادَةِ وَالنُّجُوْمِ الزَّاهِرَةِ وَالْاَعْلَامِ الْبَاهِرَةِ وَسَاسَةِ الْعِبَادِ وَاَرْكَانِ الْبِلَادِ وَالنَّاقَةِ الْمُرْسَلَةِ وَالسَّفِيْنَةِ النَّاجِيَةِ الْجَارِيَةِ فِيْ اللُّجَجِ الْغَامِرَةِ اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ خُزَّانِ عِلْمِكَ وَاَرْكَانِ تَوْحِيْدِكَ وَدَعَاۤئِمِ دِيْنِكَ وَمَعَادِنِ كَرَامَتِكَ وَصَفْوَتِكَ مِنْ بَرِيَّتِكَ وَخِيَرَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ الْاَتْقِيَاۤءِ الْاَنْقِيَاۤءِ النُّجَبَاۤءِ الْاَبْرَارِ وَالْبَابِ الْمُبْتَلٰى بِهِ النَّاسُ مَنْ اَتَاهُ نَجَا وَمَنْ اَبَاهُ هَوٰى، اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَهْلِ الذِّكْرِ الَّذِيْنَ اَمَرْتَ بِمَسْاَلَتِهِمْ وَذَوِيْ الْقُرْبَى الَّذِيْنَ اَمَرْتَ بِمَوَدَّتِهِمْ وَفَرَضْتَ حَقَّهُمْ وَجَعَلْتَ الْجَنَّةَ مَعَادَ مَنِ اقْتَصَّ اٰثَارَهُمْ. اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَاۤ اَمَرُوْا بِطَاعَتِكَ وَنَهَوْا عَنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ وَدَلُّوْا عِبَادَكَ عَلٰى وَحْدَانِيَّتِكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ وَنَجِيْبِكَ وَصَفْوَتِكَ وَاَمِيْنِكَ وَرَسُوْلِكَ اِلٰى خَلْقِكَ وَبِحَقِّ اَمِيْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَيَعْسُوْبِ الدِّيْنِ وَقَاۤئِدِ الْغُرِّ الْمُحَجَّلِيْنَ الْوَصِيِّ الْوَفِيِّ وَالصِّدِّيْقِ الْاَكْبَرِ وَالْفَارُوْقِ بَيْنَ الْحَقِّ وَالْبَاطِلِ وَالشَّاهِدِ لَكَ وَالدَّآلِّ عَلَيْكَ وَالصَّادِعِ بِاَمْرِكَ وَالْمُجَاهِدِ فِيْ سَبِيْلِكَ لَمْ تَأْخُذْهُ فِيْكَ لَوْمَةُ لَاۤئِمٍ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَاَنْ تَجْعَلَنِيْ فِيْ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ الَّذِيْ عَقَدْتَ فِيْهِ لِوَلِيِّكَ الْعَهْدَ فِيْ اَعْنَاقِ خَلْقِكَ وَاَكْمَلْتَ لَهُمُ الدِّيْنَ مِنَ الْعَارِفِيْنَ بِحُرْمَتِهٖ وَالْمُقِرِّيْنَ بِفَضْلِهٖ مِنْ عُتَقَاۤئِكَ وَطُلَقَاۤئِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَلَا تُشْمِتَ بِيْ حَاسِدِيْ النِّعَمِ اَللّٰهُمَّ فَكَمَا جَعَلْتَهٗ عِيْدَكَ الْاَكْبَرَ وَسَمَّيْتَهٗ فِيْ السَّمَاۤءِ يَوْمَ الْعَهْدِ الْمَعْهُوْدِ وَفِي الْاَرْضِ يَوْمَ الْمِيْثَاقِ الْمَأْخُوْذِ وَالْجَمْعِ الْمَسْئُوْلِ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاَقْرِرْ بِهٖ عُيُوْنَنَا وَاجْمَعْ بِهٖ شَمْلَنَا وَلَا تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَ اِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا لِاَنْعُمِكَ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِيْنَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ. اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ عَرَّفَنَا فَضْلَ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ وَبَصَّرَنَا حُرْمَتَهٗ وَكَرَّمَنَا بِهٖ وَشَرَّفَنَا بِمَعْرِفَتِهٖ وَهَدَانَا بِنُوْرِهٖ يَا رَسُوْلَ اللّٰهِ يَا اَمِيْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ عَلَيْكُمَا وَعَلٰى عِتْرَتِكُمَا وَعَلٰى مُحِبِّيْكُمَا مِنِّيْ اَفْضَلُ السَّلَامِ مَا بَقِيَ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ وَبِكُمَاۤ اَتَوَجَّهُ اِلَى اللّٰهِ رَبِّيْ وَرَبِّكُمَا فِيْ نَجَاحِ طَلِبَتِيْ وَقَضَاۤءِ حَوَاۤئِجِيْ وَتَيْسِيْرِ اُمُوْرِيْ. اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاَنْ تَلْعَنَ مَنْ جَحَدَ حَقَّ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ وَاَنْكَرَ حُرْمَتَهٗ فَصَدَّ عَنْ سَبِيْلِكَ لِاِطْفَاۤءِ نُوْرِكَ فَاَبَى اللّٰهُ اِلَّاۤ اَنْ يُّتِمَّ نُوْرَهٗ. اَللّٰهُمَّ فَرِّجْ عَنْ اَهْلِ بَيْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ وَاكْشِفْ عَنْهُمْ وَبِهِمْ عَنِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ الْكُرُبَاتِ. اَللّٰهُمَّ امْلَأِ الْاَرْضَ بِهِمْ عَدْلًا كَمَا مُلِئَتْ ظُلْمًا وَّجَوْرًا وَّاَنْجِزْ لَهُمْ مَا وَعَدْتَهُمْ اِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيْعَادَ.
segs.en: O Allah, indeed I ask You by the right of Muhammad Your Prophet and Ali Your close friend, and by the status and the measure with which You have uniquely favored them both to the exclusion of the rest of Your creation, that You bless Muhammad and Ali, and that You begin with them both in every immediate good. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, the leading Imams, the master callers, the brilliant stars, the radiant beacons, the statesmen of the servants, the pillars of the lands, the sent-forth she-camel, and the rescuing ark that courses through the overwhelming deep waters. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, the treasurers of Your knowledge, the pillars of Your monotheism, the supports of Your religion, the sources of Your nobility, Your elite selection from Your creation, and Your chosen ones from Your creatures—the God-fearing, the pure, the noble, the righteous, and the gate through which mankind is tested: whoever comes to it is saved, and whoever rejects it falls into destruction. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, the People of the Remembrance (Ahl al-Dhikr) whom You commanded to be questioned, and the near kindred whose love You commanded and whose right You made obligatory, and for whom You made Paradise the ultimate return for whoever follows their traces. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, just as they commanded obedience to You, forbade disobedience to You, and guided Your servants to Your Oneness. O Allah, indeed I ask You by the right of Muhammad Your Prophet, Your elite choice, Your select friend, Your trustee, and Your Messenger to Your creation; and by the right of the Commander of the Faithful (Amir al-Mu'minin), the chief of the religion, the leader of the radiant white-faced ones, the loyal executor, the Greatest Truthful One, the distinguisher between truth and falsehood, the witness for You, the guide to You, the proclaimer of Your command, and the warrior in Your path—never swayed in Your service by the blame of any blamer—that You bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad. And [I ask] that You place me on this day—in which You bound the covenant of Your close friend upon the necks of Your creation and perfected the religion for them—among those who recognize its sanctity and acknowledge his merit, and among those whom You liberate and set free from the Fire; and do not let those who envy Your blessings rejoice over my misfortune. O Allah, just as You made it Your greatest Eid, and named it in the heaven "the Day of the Witnessed Covenant" and on the earth "the Day of the Taken Pledge and the Questioned Assembly," bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and comfort our eyes through it, bring our unity together through it, do not misguide us after You have guided us, and make us among the thankful for Your bounties, O Most Merciful of the merciful. All praise is for Allah, Who made known to us the merit of this day, granted us insight into its sanctity, honored us through it, ennobled us with its recognition, and guided us by its light. O Messenger of Allah, O Commander of the Faithful, upon both of you, upon your progeny, and upon your lovers, be my most excellent greetings of peace, as long as the night and the day endure. Through both of you, I turn toward Allah, my Lord and your Lord, for the success of my pursuit, the fulfillment of my needs, and the easing of my affairs. O Allah, indeed I ask You by the right of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, that You bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and that You curse whoever denied the right of this day, rejected its sanctity, and barred from Your path to extinguish Your light—but Allah refuses except to perfect His light. O Allah, grant relief to the People of the House (Ahl al-Bayt) of Muhammad Your Prophet, and remove distress from the believers through them and on their account. O Allah, fill the earth through them with justice just as it has been filled with tyranny and oppression, and fulfill for them what You have promised them; indeed, You never break Your promise.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA BE-HAQQE MOHAMMADIN NABIIYYEKA WA A’LIYYIN WALIYYEKA WASH SHAA-NE WAL QADRIL LAZEE KHASASTAHOMAA BEHI DOONE KHALQEKA AN TOSALLEYA A’LAA MOHAMMADINW WA A’LIYYIN WA AN TABDA-A BEHAMAA FEE KULLE KHAYRIN A’AJELIN ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADENIL A-IMMATIL QAADATE WAD DO-A’ATIS SAADATE WAN NOJOOMIZ ZAAHERATE WAL AA’-LAAMIL BAAHERATE WA SAASATIL E’BAADE WA ARKAANIL BELAADE WAN NAAQATIL MURSALATE WAS SAFEENATIN NAAJEYATIL JAAREYATE FIL LOJAJIL GHAAMERATE ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN KHUZZAANE I’LMEKA WA ARKAANE TAWHEEDEKA WA DA-A’AA-EME DEENEKA WA MA-A’ADENE KARAAMATEKA WA SAFWATEKA MIN BARIYYATEKA WA KHEYARATEKA MIN KHALQEKAL ATQEYAAA-IL ANQEYAAA-IN NOJABAAA-IL ABRAARE WAL BAABIL MUBTALAA BEHIN NAASO MAN ATAAHO NAJAA WA MAN ABAAHO HAWAA, ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN AHLIZ ZIKRIL LAZEENA AMARTA BEMAS-ALATEHIM WA ZAWIL QURBAL LAZEENA AMARTA BEMAWADDATEHIM WA FARAZTA HAQQAHUM WA JA-A’LTAL JANNATA MA-A’ADA MANIQTASSA AASAARAHUM. ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN KAMAAA AMAROO BETA-A’ATEKA WA NAHAW A’N MA’-SEYATEKA WA DALLOO E’BAADAKA A’LAA WAHDAANIYYATEKA ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA BE-HAQQE MOHAMMADIN NABIYYEKA WA NAJEEBEKA WA SAFWATEKA WA AMEENEKA WA RASOOLEKA ELAA KHALQEKA WA BE-HAQQE AMEERIL MO-MENEENA WA YA’-SOOBID DEENE WA QAAA-EDIL GHURRIL MOHAJJALEENAL WASIYYIL WAFIYYE WAS SIDDEEQIL AKBARE WAL FAAROOQE BAYNAL HAQQE WAL BAATELE WASH SHAAHEDE LAKA WAD DAALLE A’LAYKA WAS SAADE-E’ BE-AMREKA WAL MOJAAHEDE FEE SABEELEKA LAM TA-KHUZHO FEEKA LAWMATO LAAA-EMIN AN TOSALLEYA A’LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN, WA AN TAJ-A’LANEE FEE HAAZAL YAWMIL LAZEE A’QADTA FEEHE LE-WALIYYEKAL A’HDA FEE AA’-NAAQE KHALQEKA WA AKMALTA LAHOMUD DEENA MENAL A’AREFEENA BE-HURMATEHI WAL MOQIRREENA BE-FAZLEHI MIN O’TAQAAA-EKA WA TOLAQAAA-EKA MENAN NAARE WA LAA TUSHMIT BEE HAASEDIN NE-A’ME ALLAAHUMMA FA-KAMAA JA-A’LTAHU E’EDAKAL AKBARA WA SAMMAYTAHU FIS SAMAAA-E YAWMAL A’HDIL MA’-HOODE WA FIL ARZE YAWMAL MEESAAQIL MAAKHOOZE WAL JAM-I’L MAS-OOLE SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADINW WA AQRIR BEHI O’YOONANAA WAJ MA’ BEHI SHAMLANAA WA LAA TOZILLANAA BA’-DA IZ HADAYTANAA WAJ A’LNAA LE-AN-O’MEKA MENASH SHAAKEREENA YAA ARHAMAR RAAHEMEENA. ALHAMDO LILLAAHIL LAZEE A’RRAFANAA FAZLA HAAZAL YAWME WA BASSARANAA HURMATAHU WA KARRAMANAA BEHI WA SHARRAFANAA BE-MA’-REFATEHI WA HADAYNAA BE-NOOREHI YAA RASOOLAL LAAHE YAA AMEERAL MO-MENEENA A’LAYKOMAA WA A’LAA I’TRATEKOMAA WA A’LAA MOHIBBEEKOMAA MINNEE AFZALUS SALAAME MAA BAQEYAL LAYLO WAN NAHAARO WA BEKOMAA ATAWAJJAHO ELAL LAAHE RABBEE WA RABBEKOMA FEE NAJAAHE TALEBATEE WA QAZAAA-E HAWAAA-EJEE WA TAYSEERE OMOOREE. ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA BE-HAQQE MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN AN TOSALLEYA A’LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADINW WA AN TAL-A’NA MAN JAHADA HAQQA HAAZAL YAWME WA ANKARA HURMATAHU FA-SADDA A’N SABEELEKA LE-ITFAAA-E NOOREKA FA-ABAL LAAHO ILLAAA AY YOTIMMA NOORAHU. ALLAAHUMMA FARRIJ A’N AHLE BAYTE MOHAMMADIN NABIYYEKA WAK SHIF A’NHUM WA BEHIM A’NIL MO-MENEENAL KOROBAATE. ALLAAHUMMA IM-LA-IL ARZA BEHIM A’DLAN KAMAA MOLE-AT ZULMAW WA JAWRAW WA ANJIZ LAHUM MAA WA-A’DTAHUM INNAKA LAA TUKHLEFUL MEE-A’AD.

segs.note: It is also recommended to say the short supplicatory prayers that are recorded by Sayyed Ibn Taaoos in Iqbal al-Aa’maal.
segs.ur: یہ بھی مستحب ہے کہ سید ابن طاووس نے اقبال الاعمال میں جو مختصر دعائیں درج کی ہیں انہیں پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Eid Greetings & Zikr ×100
segs.ur: عید کی مبارکباد اور ذکر ×100

segs.note: Congratulate your brethren-in-faith on this day by saying:
segs.ur: اس دن اپنے دینی بھائیوں کو یہ کہہ کر مبارکباد دیں:

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ جَعَلَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَمَسِّكِيْنَ بِوِلَايَةِ اَمِيْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْاَئِمَّةِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ.
segs.en: All praise is for Allah, Who made us among those who hold fast to the guardianship (Wilayah) of the Commander of the Faithful and the Imams, peace be upon them.
segs.tr: ALHAMDO LILLAAHIL LAZEE JA-A’LANAA MENAL MOTAMASSEKEENA BE-WELAAYATE AMEERIL MO-MENEENA WAL A-IMMATE A’LAYHEMUS SALAAMO.

segs.note: Also say:
segs.ur: نیز کہیں:

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ اَكْرَمَنَا بِهٰذَا الْيَوْمِ وَجَعَلَنَا مِنَ الْمُوْفِيْنَ بِعَهْدِهٖ اِلَيْنَا وَمِيْثَاقِهِ الَّذِيْ وَاثَقَنَا بِهٖ مِنْ وِلَايَةِ وُلَاةِ اَمْرِهٖ وَالْقُوَّامِ بِقِسْطِهٖ وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الْجَاحِدِيْنَ وَالْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ.
segs.en: All praise is for Allah, Who honored us with this day and made us among those who fulfill His covenant to us, and His pledge with which He bound us concerning the guardianship (Wilayah) of the guardians of His command and those who establish His justice; and He did not make us among the deniers and rejecters of the Day of Judgment.
segs.tr: ALHAMDO LILLAAHIL LAZEE AKRAMANAA BE-HAAZAL YAWME WA JA-A’LANAA MENAL MOOFEENA BE-A’HDEHI ELAYNAA WA MEESAAQEHIL LAZEE WAASAQANAA BEHI MIN WELAAYATE WOLAATE AMREHI WAL QUWWAAME BE-QISTEHI WA LAM YAJ-A’LNAA MENAL JAAHEDEENA WAL MOKAZZEBEENA BE-YAWMID DEENE.

segs.note: Recite this doxology (zikr) one hundred times:
segs.ur: یہ ذکر سو مرتبہ پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ جَعَلَ كَمَالَ دِيْنِهٖ وَتَمَامَ نِعْمَتِهٖ بِوِلَايَةِ اَمِيْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَبِيْ طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
segs.en: All praise is for Allah, Who made the perfection of His religion and the completion of His blessing dependent upon the guardianship (Wilayah) of the Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him.
segs.tr: ALHAMDO LILLAAHIL LAZEE JA-A’LA KAMAALA DEENEHI WA TAMAAMA NE’-MATEHI BE-WELAAYATE AMEERIL MO-MENEENA A’LIYYIB NE ABEE TAALEBIN A’LAYHIS SALAAMO.

segs.note: Honouring the Day
segs.ur: دن کی تعظیم

segs.note: Put on your best clothes, adorn yourself and apply perfume; show delight and happiness.
segs.ur: بہترین کپڑے پہنیں، آراستہ ہوں اور خوشبو لگائیں؛ خوشی اور مسرت کا اظہار کریں۔

segs.note: Give pleasure to the adherents of Imam Ali Ameer al-Momineen (a.s.), pardon them and settle their needs; visit your relatives and give gifts to your family.
segs.ur: امام علی امیرالمومنین (ع) کے پیروکاروں کو خوش کریں، انہیں معاف کریں اور ان کی حاجات پوری کریں؛ اپنے رشتہ داروں سے ملیں اور اپنے گھر والوں کو تحفے دیں۔

segs.note: Offer food to the believers and to those who are fasting; shake hands with, visit, smile at and give gifts to the believers; give alms.
segs.ur: مومنین اور روزہ داروں کو کھانا کھلائیں؛ مومنین سے مصافحہ کریں، ان سے ملاقات کریں، ان کی طرف دیکھ کر مسکرائیں اور انہیں تحفے دیں؛ صدقہ دیں۔

segs.note: Thank Almighty Allah for the bliss of recognizing the Divinely commissioned leadership of Imam Ali (a.s.), invoke blessings upon the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) and his Household (a.s.), and practice acts of worship and obedience to Almighty Allah.
segs.ur: اللہ تعالیٰ کا شکر ادا کریں کہ اس نے امام علی (ع) کی الٰہی طور پر مقرر کردہ امامت کی پہچان کی نعمت عطا فرمائی، رسول اللہ (ص) اور ان کے اہل بیت (ع) پر صلوات بھیجیں، اور اللہ تعالیٰ کی عبادت اور اطاعت بجا لائیں۔

A_AC18.merits:
The EId al-Ghadeer is the Greatest feast day of Almighty Allah. It is also the feast of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.)’s Household. It is in fact the most celebrated feast day. All the Prophets that Almighty Allah appointed used to celebrate this day and maintain its sanctity. In the heavens, this day is called “the Day of the Promised Covenant” and in the earth “the Day of the Exacted Covenant and the Witnessed Crowd.”

It has been narrated that when Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) was asked whether Muslims have a feast day other than Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Azhaa, and Fridays, he (a.s.) answered, “Yes, they have. There is still the holiest feast day, which falls on the day when the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.) appointed Ameer al-Momineen - Imam Ali (a.s.) - (as his successor and the coming leader of the Muslim community). On that day, the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) declared, ‘Whoever has regarded me as his master must now regard Ali as his master.’ It falls on the eighteenth of Zilhajj.”

When he was asked about the deeds that should be done on that day, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) instructed, “(The best acts on this day are) observance of fasting, acts of worship, mention of the Household of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.), and invocation of blessings upon them. The Holy Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.) instructed Imam Ali Ameer al-Momineen (a.s.) to betake that day as feast. Similarly, the Prophets (a.s.) used to instruct their successors to betake the eighteenth of Zilhajj as feast day.”

Abu Nasr al-Bizanti has narrated that Imam al-Reza (a.s.) said to him, “Wherever you are, try to be present on the Ghadeer Day at the tomb of Imam Ali Ameer al-Momineen (a.s.). Verily, Almighty Allah will forgive the sins of sixty years for any believer and Muslim - male and female - on that day and will release from Hellfire twice as many as the number of those whom He releases from Hellfire in the month of Ramazan, at the Qadr Night and at the Eid al-Fitr Night. A single dirham (a currency) that is given as alms on this day to the believing brethren is equal to one thousand dirhams (that are given as alms on other occasions). Try to do favors to your brethren on this day and try to please each believing man and woman. By Allah I swear, if people recognized the reality of this day, the angels should shake hands with them ten times a day.”

To sum it up, to honor this day is necessary.

Fasting: It erases the sins of sixty years. Furthermore, it has been narrated that to observe fasting on this day is equal to the observance of fasting of one’s whole lifetime and its reward is equal to the rewards of one hundred times of Hajj and Umrah.

Istea’azah: It is mentioned by Sayyid Ibn Tawus, in his book of Iqbal al-Aa’maal, who has reported it from the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.).

Two unit prayer: According to a narration, to practice this act brings about the same reward of one who was present at that day and swore allegiance to the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) as regards the divinely commissioned leadership (wilayah) of Imam Ali (a.s.). Besides, it is preferable to offer this prayer at midday (zohr), which is the very time when the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) declared the successorship and leadership of Imam Ali (a.s.) at Ghadeer Khumm.

Prayer before Zuhr: The reward of practicing this act is equal, in the sight of Almighty Allah, to the rewards of one hundred thousand times of Hajj and one hundred thousand times of Umrah. Almighty Allah will also grant all the worldly and religious needs of the performer with easiness and good health.

It is however worth mentioning that Sayyid Ibn Taaoos, in Iqbal al-Aa’maal, referring to this prayer, has preceded Surah al-Qadr to Ayat al-Kursi. Also, Allamah al-Majlisi, in Zaad al-Ma’ad, mentioned that Surah al-Qadr should be preceded to Ayat al-Kursi. But it is found out that the majority of scholars who have mentioned this prayer preceded Ayat al-Kursi to Surah al-Qadr. At any rate, there is probability that such confusion has occurred due to an error in writing by Sayyed Ibn Taaoos himself or the copiers of the book, since Sayyid Ibn Taaoos is too lofty to disagree with the consensus of the other scholars. Finally, Almighty Allah alone knows the most accurate form.

It is worth mentioning that a great reward has been narrated to be the share of one who, on this day, puts on the best dress, adorns himself, imparts a sweet smell, shows delight and happiness, gives pleasure to the adherents of Imam Ali Ameer al-Momineen (a.s.), pardons them, settles their needs, visits the relatives, confers upon the family members with gifts and whatever they need, offers food to the believers and the observers of fasting, shakes hands with, visits, smiles in the faces of, and presents gifts to the believers, thanks Almighty Allah for the grand bliss of recognizing the Divinely commissioned leadership of Imam Ali (a.s.), invokes blessings upon the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) and his Household (a.s.), and practices acts of worship and obedience to Almighty Allah. One dirham that is given as alms on this day to a believer is equal to one thousand dirhams that are given on other days. Finally, to offer food to a believer on this day is equal, in reward, to offering food to all the prophets and the veracious people.

Addressing a sermon on the Eid al-Ghadeer Day, Imam Ali (a.s.) said, “The reward of offering food to an observant of fasting on this day is equal to the reward of offering food to two hundred thousand prophets, veracious people, and martyrs multiplied by ten. As for one who provides for a number of believing men and women, I guarantee that Almighty Allah will secure him against atheism, poverty ...etc.”

A_AC20.name: Sigha of Brotherhood (Ukhuwwat) on the Day of Ghadir

segs.note: On this day, form brotherhood with a brother-in-faith: put your right hand on his right hand and say:
segs.ur: اس دن کسی دینی بھائی کے ساتھ اخوت قائم کریں: اپنا دایاں ہاتھ اس کے دائیں ہاتھ پر رکھیں اور کہیں:

segs.ar: وَاخَيْتُكَ فِيْ اللّٰهِ وَصَافَيْتُكَ فِيْ اللّٰهِ
segs.en: I take you as a brother for the sake of Allah, I choose you as a sincere friend for the sake of Allah,
segs.tr: WAAKHAYTOKA FIL LAAHE WA SAAFAYTOKA FIL LAAHE

segs.ar: وَصَافَحْتُكَ فِيْ اللّٰهِ وَعَاهَدْتُ اللّٰهَ وَمَلَاۤئِكَتَهٗ
segs.en: and I clasp your hand for the sake of Allah. And I make a covenant with Allah, His angels,
segs.tr: WA SAAFAHTOKA FIL LAAHE WA A’AHADTUL LAAHA WA MALAAA-EKATAHU

segs.ar: وَكُتُبَهٗ وَرُسُلَهٗ وَاَنْبِيَاۤئَهٗ وَالْاَئِمَّةَ الْمَعْصُوْمِيْنَ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ
segs.en: His Books, His Messengers, His Prophets, and the Infallible Imams, peace be upon them,
segs.tr: WA KOTOBAHU WA ROSOLAHU WA ANBEYAAA-AHU WAL A-IMMATAL MA’-SOOMEENA A’LAYHEMUS SALAAMO

segs.ar: عَلٰى اَنِّيْ اِنْ كُنْتُ مِنْ اَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ وَالشَّفَاعَةِ
segs.en: that if I am among the people of Paradise and intercession,
segs.tr: A’LAA ANNEE IN KUNTO MIN AHLIL JANNATE WASH SHAFAA-A’TE

segs.ar: وَاُذِنَ لِيْ بِاَنْ اَدْخُلَ الْجَنَّةَ لَا اَدْخُلُهَا اِلَّا وَاَنْتَ مَعِيْ.
segs.en: and am permitted to enter Paradise, I shall not enter it unless you are with me.
segs.tr: WA OZENA LEE BE-AN ADKHOLAL JANNATA LAA ADKHOLOHAA ILLAA WA ANTA MA-E’E.

segs.note: The other party should then agree by saying:
segs.ur: پھر دوسرا فریق یہ کہہ کر اتفاق کرے:

segs.en: I accept.

segs.note: Then, the first party says:
segs.ur: پھر پہلا فریق کہتا ہے:

segs.en: I release you from all the obligations and rights of brotherhood,
except for intercession (Shafa'ah), supplication (Du'a), and visitation (Ziyarah).
segs.tr: MAA KHALASH SHAFAA-A’TA WAD DOA’AA-A WAZ ZEYAARATA.

segs.note: Similar to this form, al-Mohaddis al-Fayz, in his book of Khulaasat al-Azkaar, has mentioned a form of fraternization adding that the other party, or his representative, may accept the fraternization by uttering any statement entailing agreement. Then, each party releases the other from the duties of fraternity except supplication and visiting the tombs of the Infallibles.
segs.ur: اسی طرح کی ایک صورت محدث فیض نے اپنی کتاب “خلاصۃ الاذکار” میں مؤاخات (بھائی چارے) کی ذکر کی ہے اور اضافہ کیا ہے کہ دوسرا فریق یا اس کا وکیل موافقت ظاہر کرنے والے کسی بھی لفظ سے بھائی چارہ قبول کر سکتا ہے۔ پھر ہر فریق دوسرے کو بھائی چارے کے فرائض سے آزاد کر دیتا ہے، سوائے دعا اور معصومین کی قبور کی زیارت کے۔

A_AC20.merits:
The merit of the Eid al-Ghadeer Day is too great to be cited. On this day, the deeds of the Shi’ah are admitted and their grievances are relieved. On this day, Prophet Moosa (a.s.) overcame the sorcerers, the fire in which Prophet Ibrahim (a.s.) was thrown was made by Almighty Allah comfort and peace, Prophet Moosa (a.s.) appointed Yushaa ibn Nun as his successor, Prophet Sulaiman (a.s.) declared openly before his people that Asif ibn Barkhiya would be his successor, and the Holy Prophet Muhammad (s.a.w.a.) united as brothers his companions; therefore, the believers are advised to form brotherhood with each other on this day.

Shaykh al-Noori quotes this form in Mustadrak al-Wasaael from the book of Zaad al-Firdaws.

A_AC21.name: The Day of Mubahala

segs.note: Ghusl, Fasting & Prayer
segs.ur: غسل، روزہ اور نماز

segs.note: Bathe on this day.
segs.ur: اس دن غسل کریں.

segs.note: Fast on this day.
segs.ur: اس دن روزہ رکھیں۔

segs.note: Offer a two unit prayer that is similar, in form, time and reward, to the two unit prayer of the Eid al-Ghadeer Day (the “Prayer before Zuhr” tab of Aamal of the Day of Eid al-Ghadir). The only difference is that Ayat al-Kursi is recited with the two verses following it.
segs.ur: دو رکعت نماز پڑھیں جو شکل، وقت اور ثواب میں عید غدیر کے دن کی دو رکعت نماز کی طرح ہے (“ظہر سے پہلے کی نماز” ٹیب، [عید غدیر کے دن کے اعمال](AC18) میں)۔ فرق صرف یہ ہے کہ [آیت الکرسی](A4) کے ساتھ اس کے بعد کی دو آیتیں بھی پڑھی جاتی ہیں۔

segs.note: After the prayer, seek forgiveness seventy times and say the supplicatory prayer that begins: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ فَاطِرِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْاَرْضِ
segs.ur: نماز کے بعد ستر مرتبہ استغفار کریں اور وہ دعا پڑھیں جو اس طرح شروع ہوتی ہے: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ فَاطِرِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْاَرْضِ

segs.note: Alms & Visiting Imam Ali (a.s.)
segs.ur: صدقہ اور امام علی (ع) کی زیارت

segs.note: Give alms on this day, in imitation of the Commander of the Believers, Imam Ali (a.s.); each believing man and woman is required to.
segs.ur: اس دن امیرالمومنین امام علی (ع) کی پیروی میں صدقہ دیں؛ ہر مومن مرد اور عورت پر یہ لازم ہے۔

segs.note: Visit the holy tomb of Imam Ali (a.s.) and say al-Ziyarah al-Jaame’ah (the Comprehensive Ziyarah).
segs.ur: امام علی (ع) کے مقدس مزار کی زیارت کریں اور [زیارت جامعہ](G13) (جامع زیارت) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Dua al-Mubahala
segs.ur: دعائے مباہلہ

segs.note: Recite the version of Shaykh al-Tusi, reported from Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s.):
segs.ur: شیخ طوسی کی روایت، جو امام جعفر صادق (ع) سے نقل ہوئی ہے، پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ بِهَآئِكَ بِاَبْهَاهُ وَکُلُّ بَهَآئِكَ بَہِیٌّ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the most radiant of Your radiance, and all of Your radiance is radiant.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN BAHAAA-EKA BE-ABHAAHO WA KULLO BAHAAA-EKA BAHIYYUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your radiance.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ جَلَالِكَ بِاَجَلِّہٖ وَکُلُّ جَلَالِكَ جَلِیْلٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the most majestic of Your majesty, and all of Your majesty is majestic.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN JALAALEKA BE-AJALLEHI WA KULLO JALAALEKA JALEELUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your majesty.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ جَمَالِكَ بِاَجْمَلِہٖ وَکُلُّ جَمَالِكَ جَمِیْلٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the most beautiful of Your beauty, and all of Your beauty is beautiful.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN JAMAALEKA BE-AJMALEHI WA KULLO JAMAALEKA JAMEELUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your beauty.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَدْعُوْكَ كَمَا اَمَرْتَنِیْ فَاسْتَجِبْ لِیْ كَمَا وَعَدْتَنِیْ
segs.en: O Allah, I call upon You as You commanded me, so answer me as You promised me.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AD-O'OKA KAMAA AMARTANEE FAS-TAJIB LEE KAMAA WA-A'DTANEE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ عَظَمَتِكَ بِاَعْظَمِهَا وَکُلُّ عَظَمَتِكَ عَظِیْمَۃٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the greatest of Your greatness, and all of Your greatness is great.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN A'ZAMATEKA BE-AA'ZAMEHAA WA KULLO A'ZAMATEKA A'ZEEMATUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your greatness.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ نُوْرِكَ بِاَنْوَرِہٖ وَکُلُّ نُوْرِكَ نَیِّرٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the brightest of Your light, and all of Your light is luminous.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN NOOREKA BE-ANWAREHI WA KULLO NOOREKA NAYYERUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your light.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ بِاَوْسَعِهَا وَکُلُّ رَحْمَتِكَ وَاسِعَۃٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the vastest of Your mercy, and all of Your mercy is vast.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN RAHMATEKA BE-AWSA-E'HAA WA KULLO RAHMATEKA WAASE-A'TUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your mercy.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَدْعُوْكَ كَمَا اَمَرْتَنِیْ فَاسْتَجِبْ لِیْ كَمَا وَعَدْتَنِیْ
segs.en: O Allah, I call upon You as You commanded me, so answer me as You promised me.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AD-O'OKA KAMAA AMARTANEE FAS-TAJIB LEE KAMAA WA-A'DTANEE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ كَمَالِكَ بِاَكْمَلِہٖ وَکُلُّ كَمَالِكَ كَامِلٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the most perfect of Your perfection, and all of Your perfection is perfect.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN KAMAALEKA BE-AKMALEHI WA KULLO KAMAALEKA KAAMELUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your perfection.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ كَلِمَاتِكَ بِاَتَمِّهَا وَکُلُّ كَلِمَاتِكَ تَآمَّۃٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the most complete of Your words, and all of Your words are complete.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN KALEMAATEKA BE-ATAMMEHAA WA KULLO KALEMAATEKA TAAAM-MATUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your words.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ اَسْمَآئِكَ بِاَكْبَرِهَا وَکُلُّ اَسْمَآئِكَ كَبِیْرَۃٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the greatest of Your names, and all of Your names are great.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN ASMAAA-EKA BEAKBAREHAA WA KULLO ASMAAA-EKA KABEERATUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your names.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَدْعُوْكَ كَمَا اَمَرْتَنِیْ فَاسْتَجِبْ لِیْ كَمَا وَعَدْتَنِیْ
segs.en: O Allah, I call upon You as You commanded me, so answer me as You promised me.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AD-O'OKA KAMAA AMARTANEE FAS-TAJIB LEE KAMAA WA-A'DTANEE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ عِزَّتِكَ بِاَعَزِّهَا وَکُلُّ عِزَّتِكَ عَزِیْزَۃٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the mightiest of Your might, and all of Your might is mighty.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN I'ZZATEKA BE-A-A'ZZEHAA WA KULLO I'ZZATEKA A'ZEEZATUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your might.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ مَشِیَّتِكَ بِاَمْضَاهَا وَکُلُّ مَشِیَّتِكَ مَاضِیَۃٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the most effective of Your will, and all of Your will is effective.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN MASHIYYATEKA BE-AMZAAHAA WA KULLO MASHIYYATEKA MAAZEYATUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your will.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ الَّتِیْ اسْتَطَلْتَ بِهَا عَلٰی کُلِّ شَیْءٍ وَکُلُّ قُدْرَتِكَ مُسْتَطِیْلَۃٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by Your power through which You have dominion over all things, and all of Your power is all-encompassing.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA BE-QUDRATEKAL LATIS TATALTA BEHAA A'LAA KULLE SHAY-IN WA KULLO QUDRATEKA MUSTATEELATUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your power.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَدْعُوْكَ كَمَا اَمَرْتَنِیْ فَاسْتَجِبْ لِیْ كَمَا وَعَدْتَنِیْ
segs.en: O Allah, I call upon You as You commanded me, so answer me as You promised me.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AD-O'OKA KAMAA AMARTANEE FAS-TAJIB LEE KAMAA WA-A'DTANEE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ عِلْمِكَ بِاَنْفَذِہٖ وَکُلُّ عِلْمِكَ نَافِذٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the most penetrating of Your knowledge, and all of Your knowledge is penetrating.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN I'LMEKA BE-ANFAZEHI WA KULLO I'LMEKA NAAFEZUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your knowledge.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ قَوْلِكَ بِاَرْضَاهُ وَکُلُّ قَوْلِكَ رَضِیٌّ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the most pleasing of Your speech, and all of Your speech is pleasing.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN QAWLEKA BE-ARZAAHO WA KULLO QAWLEKA RAZIYYUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your speech.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN BE-QAWLEKA KULLEHI

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ مَسَآئِلِكَ بِاَحَبِّهَا وَکُلُّهَا اِلَیْكَ حَبِیْبٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the most beloved of the things asked from You, and all of them are beloved to You.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN MASAAA-ELEKA BE-AHABBEHAA WA KULLO ELAYKA HABEEBUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all that is asked from You.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَدْعُوْكَ كَمَا اَمَرْتَنِیْ فَاسْتَجِبْ لِیْ كَمَا وَعَدْتَنِیْ
segs.en: O Allah, I call upon You as You commanded me, so answer me as You promised me.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AD-O'OKA KAMAA AMARTANEE FAS-TAJIB LEE KAMAA WA-A'DTANEE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ شَرَفِكَ بِاَشْرَفِہٖ وَکُلُّ شَرَفِكَ شَرِیْفٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the noblest of Your honor, and all of Your honor is noble.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN SHARAFEKA BE-ASHRAFEHI WA KULLO SHARAFEKA SHAREEFUN

segs.en: O Allah, indeed I ask You by all of Your honor.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ سُلْطَانِكَ بِاَدْوَمِہٖ وَکُلُّ سُلْطَانِكَ دَآئِمٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the most enduring of Your authority, and all of Your authority is everlasting.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN SULTAANEKA BE-ADWAMEHI WA KULLO SULTAANEKA DAAA-EMUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your authority.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ مُلْکِكَ بِاَفْخَرِہٖ وَکُلُّ مُلْکِكَ فَاخِرٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the most splendid of Your kingdom, and all of Your kingdom is splendid.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN MULKEKA BE-AFKHAREHI WA KULLO MULKEKA FAAKHERUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your kingdom.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَدْعُوْكَ كَمَا اَمَرْتَنِیْ فَاسْتَجِبْ لِیْ كَمَا وَعَدْتَنِیْ
segs.en: O Allah, I call upon You as You commanded me, so answer me as You promised me.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AD-O'OKA KAMAA AMARTANEE FAS-TAJIB LEE KAMAA WA-A'DTANEE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّی اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ عَلَآئِكَ بِاَعْلَاهُ وَکُلُّ عَلَآئِكَ عَالٍ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the loftiest of Your exaltedness, and all of Your exaltedness is exalted.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN A'LAAA-EKA BE-A-A'LAAHO WA KULLO A'LAAA-EKA A'ALIN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your exaltedness.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ آیَاتِكَ بِاَعْجَبِهَا وَکُلُّ آیَاتِكَ عَجِیْبَۃٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the most wondrous of Your signs, and all of Your signs are wondrous.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN AAAYAATEKA BE-AA'JABEHAA WA KULLO AAAYAATEKA  A'JEEBATUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your signs.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ مَنِّكَ بِاَقْدَمِہٖ وَکُلُّ مَنِّكَ قَدِیْمٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the most ancient of Your favors, and all of Your favors are ancient.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN MANNEKA BE-AQDAMEHI WA KULLO MANNEKA QADEEMUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your favors.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَدْعُوْكَ كَمَا اَمَرْتَنِیْ فَاسْتَجِبْ لِیْ كَمَا وَعَدْتَنِیْ
segs.en: O Allah, I call upon You as You commanded me, so answer me as You promised me.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AD-O'OKA KAMAA AMARTANEE FAS-TAJIB LEE KAMAA WA-A'DTANEE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ بِمَا اَنْتَ فِیْہِ مِنَ الشُّئُوْنِ وَالْجَبَرُوْتِ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by that majesty and omnipotence which belong to You.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA BEMAA ANTA FEEHE MENASH SHO-OONE WAL JABAROOTE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ بِکُلِّ شَاْنٍ وَکُلِّ جَبَرُوْتٍ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by every affair and every omnipotence.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA BEKULLE SHAANIN WA KULLE JABAROOTIN

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ بِمَا تُجِیْبُنِیْ بِہٖ حِیْنَ اَسْئَلُكَ یَا اَﷲُ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by that through which You answer me when I ask You: O Allah!
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA BEMAA TOJEEBONEE BEHI HEENA AS-ALOKA YAA ALLAAHO

segs.ar: یَا لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ اَسْئَلُكَ بِبَهَآءِ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ
segs.en: O there is no god except You! I ask You by the radiance of ‘There is no god except You.’
segs.tr: YAA LAA ELAAHA ILLAA ANTA AS-ALOKA BE-BAHAAA-E LAA ELAAHA ILLAA ANTA

segs.ar: یَا لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ اَسْئَلُكَ بِجَلَالِ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ
segs.en: O there is no god except You! I ask You by the majesty of ‘There is no god except You.’
segs.tr: YAA LAA ELAAHA ILLAA ANTA AS-ALOKA BE-JALAALE LAA ELAAHA ILLAA ANTA

segs.ar: یَا لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ اَسْئَلُكَ بِلَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ
segs.en: O there is no god except You! I ask You by ‘There is no god except You.’
segs.tr: YAA LAA ELAAHA ILLAA ANTA AS-ALOKA BE-LAA ELAAHA ILLAA ANTA

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَدْعُوْكَ كَمَا اَمَرْتَنِیْ فَاسْتَجِبْ لِیْ كَمَا وَعَدْتَنِیْ
segs.en: O Allah, I call upon You as You commanded me, so answer me as You promised me.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AD-O'OKA KAMAA AMARTANEE FAS-TAJIB LEE KAMAA WA-A'DTANEE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ بِاَعَمِّہٖ وَکُلُّ رِزْقِكَ عَآمٌّ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the most comprehensive of Your sustenance, and all of Your sustenance is comprehensive.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN RIZQEKA BE-A-A'MMEHI WA KULLO RIZQEKA A'AAM-MUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your sustenance.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ عَطَآئِكَ بِاَهْنَاهُ وَکُلُّ عَطَآئِكَ هَنِیْٓءٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the most pleasant of Your gifts, and all of Your gifts are pleasant.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN A'TAAA-EKA BE-AHNAAHO WA KULLO A'TAAA-EKA HANEEE-UN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your gifts.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ خَیْرِكَ بِاَعْجَلِہٖ وَکُلُّ خَیْرِكَ عَاجِلٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the swiftest of Your goodness, and all of Your goodness is swift.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA MIN KHAYREKA BE-A-A'JALEHI WA KULLO KHAYREKA A'AJELUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your goodness.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ بِاَفْضَلِہٖ وَکُلُّ فَضْلِكَ فَاضِلٌ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the most excellent of Your bounty, and all of Your bounty is excellent.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INEE AS-ALOKA MIN FAZLEKA BE-AFZALEHI WA KULLO FAZLEKA FAAZELUN

segs.en: O Allah, I ask You by all of Your bounty.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَدْعُوْكَ كَمَا اَمَرْتَنِیْ فَاسْتَجِبْ لِیْ كَمَا وَعَدْتَنِیْ
segs.en: O Allah, I call upon You as You commanded me, so answer me as You promised me.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AD-O'OKA KAMAA AMARTANEE FAS-TAJIB LEE KAMAA WA-A'DTANEE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A'LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.ar: وَابْعَثْنِیْ عَلَی الْاِیْمَانِ بِكَ وَالتَّصْدِیْقِ بِرَسُوْلِكَ عَلَیْہِ وَآلِہِ السَّلَامُ
segs.en: and resurrect me upon faith in You, belief in Your Messenger — peace be upon him and his family —
segs.tr: WAB A'SNEE A'LAL EEMAANE BEKA WAT TASDEEKE BE-RASOOLEKA A'LAYHE WA AALEHIS SALAAMO

segs.ar: وَالْوِلَایَۃِ لِعَلِیِّ بْنِ اَبِیْ طَالِبٍ وَالْبَرَآئَۃِ مِنْ عَدُوِّہٖ
segs.en: loyalty to Ali ibn Abi Talib, dissociation from his enemies,
segs.tr: WAL WELAAYATE LE-A'LIYYIB NE ABEE TAALEBIN WAL BARAAA-ATE MIN A'DUWWEHI

segs.ar: وَالْاِیْتِمَامِ بِالْاَئِمَّۃِ مِنْ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَیْہِمُ السَّلَامُ
segs.en: and adherence to the Imams from the family of Muhammad, peace be upon them;
segs.tr: WAL EETEMAAME BIL-A-IMMATE MIN AALE MOHAMMADIN A'LAYHEMUS SALAAMO

segs.ar: فَاِنِّیْ قَدْ رَضِیْتُ بِذَالِكَ یَا رَبِّ
segs.en: for indeed I am pleased with that, O my Lord.
segs.tr: FA-INNEE QAD RAZEETO BE-ZAALEKA YAA RABBE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُوْلِكَ فِیْ الْاَوَّلِیْنَ
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, Your servant and Messenger, among the former peoples,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A'LAA MOHAMMADIN A'BDEKA WA RASOOLEKA FIL AWWALEENA

segs.en: and send blessings upon Muhammad among the later peoples,
segs.tr: WA SALLE A'LAA MOHAMMADIN FIL AAKHEREENA

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ فِی الْمَلَاءِ الْاَعْلٰی
segs.en: and send blessings upon Muhammad in the highest assembly,
segs.tr: WA SALLE A'LAA MOHAMMADIN FIL MA-LAA-IL A-A'LAA

segs.en: and send blessings upon Muhammad among the messengers.
segs.tr: WA SALLE A'LAA MOHAMMADIN FIL MURSALEENA

segs.en: O Allah, grant Muhammad the highest station,
honor, excellence, and the greatest rank.
segs.tr: WASH SHARAFA WAL FAZEELATA WAD DARAJATAL KABEERATA

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A'LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.ar: وَقَنِّعْنِیْ بِمَا رَزَقْتَنِیْ وَبَارِكْ لِیْ فِیْمَا اٰتَیْتَنِیْ
segs.en: make me content with what You have provided for me, bless me in what You have given me,
segs.tr: WA QANNE'NEE BEMAA RAZAQTANEE WA BAARIK LEE FEEMAA AATAYTANEE

segs.ar: وَاحْفَظْنِیْ فِیْ غَیْبَتِیْ وَفِیْ کُلِّ غَآئِبٍ هُوَ لِیْ
segs.en: and protect me in my absence and in everything absent from me.
segs.tr: WAH FAZNEE FEE GHAYBATEE WA FEE KULLE GHAAA-EBIN HOWA LEE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A'LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.ar: وَابْعَثْنِیْ عَلَی الْاِیْمَانِ بِكَ وَالتَّصْدِیْقِ بِرَسُوْلِكَ
segs.en: and resurrect me upon faith in You and belief in Your Messenger.
segs.tr: WAB A'SNEE A'LAL EEMAANE BEKA WAT TASDEEQE BERASOOLEKA

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A'LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: and I ask You for the best of all good: Your pleasure and Paradise;
segs.tr: WA AS-ALOKA KHAYRAL KHAYRE RIZWAANAKA WAL JANNATA

segs.ar: وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ الشَّرِّ سَخَطِكَ وَالنَّارِ
segs.en: and I seek refuge in You from the worst of all evil: Your wrath and the Fire.
segs.tr: WA A-O'OZO BEKA MIN SHARRISH SHARRE SAKHATEKA WAN NAARE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A'LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.ar: وَاحْفَظْنِیْ مِنْ کُلِّ مُصِیْبَۃٍ وَمِنْ کُلِّ بَلِیَّۃٍ
segs.en: and protect me from every calamity, every affliction,
segs.tr: WAH FAZNEE MIN KULLE MOSEEBATIN WA MIN KULLE BALIYYATIN

segs.ar: وَمِنْ کُلِّ عُقُوْبَۃٍ وَمِنْ کُلِّ فِتْنَۃٍ
segs.en: every punishment, every trial,
segs.tr: WA MIN KULLE O'QOOBATIN WA MIN KULLE FITNATIN

segs.ar: وَمِنْ کُلِّ بَلَآءٍ وَمِنْ کُلِّ شَرٍّ وَمِنْ کُلِّ مَكْرُوْہٍ
segs.en: every tribulation, every evil, every hateful thing,
segs.tr: WA MIN KULLE BALAAA-IN WA MIN KULLE SHARRIN WA MIN KULLE MAKROOHIN

segs.ar: وَمِنْ کُلِّ مُصِیْبَۃٍ وَمِنْ کُلِّ آفَۃٍ نَزَلَتْ
segs.en: every disaster, and every harm descending
segs.tr: WA MIN KULLE MOSEEBATIN WA MIN KULLE AAAFATIN NAZALAT

segs.ar: اَوْ تَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ اِلَی الْاَرْضِ فِیْ هٰذِہِ السَّاعَۃِ
segs.en: or about to descend from the heaven to the earth in this hour,
segs.tr: AW TANZELO MENAS SAMAAA-E ELAL ARZE FEE HAAZEHIS SAA-A'TE

segs.ar: وَفِیْ هٰذِہِ اللَّیْلَۃِ وَفِیْ هٰذَا الْیَوْمِ
segs.en: this night, this day,
segs.tr: WA FEE HAAZEHIL LAYLATE WA FEE HAAZAL YAWME

segs.ar: وَفِیْ هٰذَا الشَّہْرِ وَفِیْ هٰذِہِ السَّنَۃِ
segs.en: this month, and this year.
segs.tr: WA FEE HAAZASH SHAHRE WA FEE HAAZEHIS SANATE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A'LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.ar: وَاقْسِمْ لِیْ مِنْ کُلِّ سُرُوْرٍ وَمِنْ کُلِّ بَہْجَۃٍ
segs.en: and allot for me from every joy, delight,
segs.tr: WAQ SIM LEE MIN KULLE SOROORIN WA MIN KULLE BAHJATIN

segs.ar: وَمِنْ کُلِّ اسْتِقَامَۃٍ وَمِنْ کُلِّ فَرَجٍ
segs.en: uprightness, relief,
segs.tr: WA MIN KULLIS TEQAAMATIN WA MIN KULLE FARAJIN

segs.ar: وَمِنْ کُلِّ عَافِیَۃٍ وَمِنْ کُلِّ سَلَامَۃٍ
segs.en: wellbeing, safety,
segs.tr: WA MIN KULLE A'AFEYATIN WA MIN KULLE SALAAMATIN

segs.ar: وَمِنْ کُلِّ كَرَامَۃٍ وَمِنْ کُلِّ رِزْقٍ وَاسِعٍ حَلَالٍ طَیِّبٍ
segs.en: honor, lawful and wholesome abundant sustenance,
segs.tr: WA MIN KULLE KARAAMATIN WA MIN KULLE RIZQIN WAASE-I'N HALAALIN TAYYEBIN

segs.ar: وَمِنْ کُلِّ نِعْمَۃٍ وَمِنْ کُلِّ سَعَۃٍ
segs.en: blessing, and ease
segs.tr: WA MIN KULLE NE'MATIN WA MIN KULLE SA-A'TIN

segs.ar: نَزَلَتْ اَوْ تَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ اِلَی الْاَرْضِ
segs.en: descending or about to descend from the heaven to the earth
segs.tr: NAZALAT AW TANZELO MENAS SAMAAA-E ELAL ARZE

segs.ar: فِیْ هٰذِہِ السَّاعَۃِ وَفِیْ هٰذِہِ اللَّیْلَۃِ
segs.en: in this hour, this night,
segs.tr: FEE HAAZEHIS SAA-A'TE WA FEE HAAZEHIL LAYLATE

segs.ar: وَفِیْ هٰذَا الْیَوْمِ وَفِیْ هٰذَا الشَّہْرِ وَفِیْ هٰذِہِ السَّنَۃِ
segs.en: this day, this month, and this year.
segs.tr: WA FEE HAAZAL YAWME WA FEE HAAZASH SHAHRE WA FEE HAAZEHIS SANATE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنْ كَانَتْ ذُنُوْبِیْ قَدْ اَخْلَقَتْ وَجْہِیْ
segs.en: O Allah, if my sins have worn away my honor
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA IN KAANAT ZONOOBEE QAD AKHLAQAT WAJHEE

segs.en: before You, come between me and You,
segs.tr: I'NDAKA WA HAALAT BAYNEE WA BAYNAKA

segs.en: and changed my state before You,

segs.ar: فَاِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ بِنُوْرِ وَجْہِكَ الَّذِیْ لَا یُطْفَاُ
segs.en: then I ask You by the light of Your Face which is never extinguished,
segs.tr: FA-INNEE AS-ALOKA BENOORE WAJHEKAL LAZEE LAA YUTFA-O

segs.en: by the face of Muhammad Your chosen beloved,
by the face of Your friend Ali al-Murtaza,
and by the right of Your chosen saints,

segs.ar: اَنْ تُصَلِّیَ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: that You send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
segs.tr: AN TOSALLEYA A'LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِیْ مَا مَضٰی مِنْ ذُنُوْبِیْ
segs.en: forgive my past sins,
segs.tr: WA AN TAGHFERA LEE MAA MAZAA MIN ZONOOBEE

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَعْصِمَنِیْ فِیْمَا بَقِیَ مِنْ عُمْرِیْ
segs.en: protect me during the remainder of my life,
segs.tr: WA AN TA'SEMANEE FEEMAA BAQEYA MIN U'MREE

segs.ar: وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْ اَعُوْدَ فِیْ شَیْءٍ مِنْ مَعَاصِیْكَ اَبَدًا
segs.en: and I seek refuge in You, O Allah, from ever returning to any disobedience to You
segs.tr: WA A-O'OZO BEKA ALLAAHUMMA AN A-OODA FEE SHAY-IN MIN MA-A'ASEEKA ABADAM

segs.ar: مَّا اَبْقَیْتَنِیْ حَتّٰی تَتَوَفّٰنِیْ وَاَنَا لَكَ مُطِیْعٌ
segs.en: as long as You keep me alive — until You cause me to die while I am obedient to You
segs.tr: MAA ABQAYTANEE HATTAA TATA-WAFFAAANEE WA ANAA LAKA MO-TEE-U'N

segs.ar: وَاَنْتَ عَنِّیْ رَاضٍ وَاَنْ تَخْتِمَ لِیْ عَمَلِیْ بِاَحْسَنِہٖ
segs.en: and You are pleased with me. And that You conclude my deeds with the best of them,
segs.tr: WA ANTA A'NNEE RAAZIN WA AN TAKHTEMA LEE A'MALEE BE-AHSANEHI

segs.en: make Paradise my reward,

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَفْعَلَ بِیْ مَآ اَنْتَ اَهْلُہٗ یَا اَهْلَ التَّقْوٰی
segs.en: and deal with me according to what befits You, O Lord of piety
segs.tr: WA AN TAF-A'LA BEE MAAA ANTA AHLOHU YAA AHLAT TAQWAA

segs.ar: وَیَا اَهْلَ الْمَغْفِرَۃِ وَصَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: and Lord of forgiveness. And send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
segs.tr: WA YAA AHLAL MAGHFERATE WA SALLE A'LAA MOHAMMADINW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: and have mercy upon me by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.”
segs.tr: WAR HAMNEE BE-RAHMATEKA YAA ARHAMAR RAAHEMEENA.

A_AC21.merits:
Invoking Allah’s Curse Upon the Lying Party

On the twenty-forth of Zilhajj, the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) invited the Christians of Najran that each party would invoke Almighty Allah’s curse upon the liars among them so that the truthful party would be distinguished and the lying party would be cursed. The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) put on a cloak and embraced Imam Ali, Lady Fatemah al-Zahra, Imam al-Hasan, and Imam al-Husayn - peace be upon them all - and prayed Almighty Allah, saying, “O Allah, verily, each Prophet had a family members whom were the nearest to him. O Allah, these are my Household; so, remove uncleanness from them and purify them with thorough purification.” Immediately after that, Archangel Jibraeel descended carrying the Verse of Purification. Then, the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) accompanied his family members as his partners in the process of invoking Almighty Allah’s curse upon the lying party. As soon as the Christians’ eyes fell on the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.)’s household, they realized that those individuals were the most truthful and that chastisement would be the share of anyone who would oppose them. They therefore did not dare to participate in that invocation of curse and, instead, they agreed to pay a tribute (jizyah) to the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.).

On the twenty-fourth of Zilhajj too, Imam Ali Ameer al-Momineen (a.s.), while he was offering a prayer and, more precisely, while he was in the genuflection (ruku') of that prayer, gave his ring as alms to a poor who was begging in the mosque. Therefore, Almighty Allah revealed the holy verses (5:55-56): “Only Allah is your walee (master) and His Messenger and those who believe, those who keep up prayers and pay the poor-rate while they bow. And whoever takes Allah and His messenger and those who believe for a guardian, then surely the party of Allah are they that shall be triumphant.”

Supplication after the prayer: It is the supplicatory prayer that Shaykh al-Tusi and Sayyid Ibn Taaoos reported to be said after offering a two unit prayer and imploring for forgiveness seventy times.

Dua al-Mubahalah: It is similar to the famous supplicatory prayer known as Dua al-Baha’ that is said at the last hours of Ramazan nights (i.e. sahar). Nevertheless, a little difference in this supplication is noticed between the version of Shaykh al-Tusi and the version of Sayyid Ibn Taaoos. I will thus choose the earlier one that is recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s book of Misbah al-Mutahajjid and reported from Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s.).

A_AC22.name: The Twenty-Fifth of Dhul Hijjah

segs.note: Imitate the Ahl al-Bayt (a.s.) in their three days of fasting: observe fasting, give alms to the poor and the orphans (especially at the twenty-fifth night of Zilhajj) and do your best to offer food to the needy.
segs.ur: اہل بیت (ع) کی پیروی ان کے تین دن کے روزوں میں کریں: روزہ رکھیں، فقیروں اور یتیموں کو صدقہ دیں (خاص طور پر ذی الحجہ کی پچیسویں رات کو) اور ضرورت مندوں کو کھانا کھلانے کی بھرپور کوشش کریں۔

segs.note: Say al-Ziyarah al-Jaame’ah and Dua al-Mubaahalah. In the view of some scholars, the twenty-fifth of Zilhajj is the Day of Mubaahalah.
segs.ur: [زیارت جامعہ](G13) اور [دعائے مباہلہ](AC21) پڑھیں۔ بعض علما کے نزدیک ذی الحجہ کی پچیسویں تاریخ یومِ مباہلہ ہے۔

A_AC22.merits: On this blessed day, Surah al-Dahr (or al-Insan No. 76) was revealed praising the Ahl al-Bayt (a.s.) for they had observed fasting for three days and given their food to a poor, an orphan, and a captive for three days respectively. All over these three days, they used to break their fasting with water only.

A_AC23.name: The Last Day of Dhul Hijjah

segs.note: On the last day of Zilhajj, offer a two unit prayer: recite Surah al-Faatehah once, and each of Surah al-Tawheed and Ayat al-Kursi ten times.
segs.ur: ذی الحجہ کے آخری دن دو رکعت نماز پڑھیں: ایک مرتبہ [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) اور [سورہ توحید](A116) و [آیت الکرسی](A4) میں سے ہر ایک دس مرتبہ پڑھیں۔

segs.note: After the prayer, say:
segs.ur: نماز کے بعد کہیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ مَا عَمِلْتُ فِيْ هٰذِهِ السَّنَةِ
segs.en: O Allah, whatever deed I have committed in this year
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA MAA AMILTO FEE HAAZEHIS SANATE

segs.en: that You forbade me from,
which You were not pleased with, and which I forgot but You did not forget,
segs.tr: WA LAM TARZAHO WA NASEETOHU WA LAM TANSAHU

segs.ar: وَدَعَوْتَنِيْ اِلَى التَّوْبَةِ بَعْدَ اجْتِرَاۤئِيْ عَلَيْكَ
segs.en: and You called me to repentance after my audacity against You—
segs.tr: WA DA-A’WTANEE ELAT TAWBATE BA’DAJ TERAAA-EE A’LAYKA

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَاِنِّيْ اَسْتَغْفِرُكَ مِنْهُ فَاغْفِرْ لِيْ
segs.en: O Allah, I seek Your forgiveness for it, so forgive me.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA FA-INNEE ASTAGHFEROKA MINHO FAGHFIR LEE

segs.ar: وَمَا عَمِلْتُ مِنْ عَمَلٍ يُقَرِّبُنِيْ اِلَيْكَ فَاقْبَلْهُ مِنِّيْ
segs.en: And whatever deed I have committed that brings me closer to You, accept it from me,
segs.tr: WA MAA A’MILTO MIN A’MALIN YOQARREBONEE ELAYKA FAQBALHO MINNEE

segs.ar: وَلَا تَقْطَعْ رَجَاۤئِيْ مِنْكَ يَا كَرِيْمُ.
segs.en: and do not cut off my hope in You, O Generous One.
segs.tr: WA LAA TAQTA’ RAJAAA-EE MINKA YAA KAREEMO.

A_AC23.merits:
The last day of Zilhajj is the last day in the Arabic calendar. According to some narrations mentioned by Sayyid Ibn Taaoos in his book of Iqbal al-Aa’maal, it is recommended to offer this two unit prayer on this day.

If these statements are said, Satan will say, “Woe to me! All the efforts that I have exerted throughout this year for misleading this person have been failed by the utterance of these statements.” Besides, one who says these words will be testified by the year that he sealed it in a good way.

A_J1.name: Merits & Rituals of Friday Night & Day

segs.note: Spend Friday day and night in worship, supplication and good deeds, and keep away from every act of disobedience.
segs.ur: جمعہ کا دن اور رات عبادت، دعا اور نیک اعمال میں گزاریں اور ہر گناہ سے دور رہیں۔

A_J1.merits:
Friday days and nights excel the other days and nights in standing, honor, and regard. In this connection, the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) is reported to have said, “Surely, in each hour of the twenty-four hours of the Friday day and night, Almighty Allah releases from Hellfire six hundred thousand persons.”

Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s.) is reported to have said, “One who dies in the period between midday (zohr) on Thursdays and midday (zohr) on Fridays will be released, by Almighty Allah, from pressure in graves.”

Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) is also reported as saying, “Verily, Fridays enjoy rights (incumbent upon people). Therefore, beware of violating Fridays’ sanctity through showing shortcoming in acts of worship; rather, seek nearness to Almighty Allah by means of righteous deeds and abandonment of all forbidden acts. Certainly, on Fridays, Almighty Allah doubles up the rewards (of good deeds), erases forgivingly punishments (for evildoings), and raises the ranks (of faith). Friday daytimes are as same as Friday nights; therefore, you may, when possible, stay up supplicating and offering prayers to Almighty Allah Who, at that night, orders the angels to descend to the lower sky in order to double up the rewards and erase the evildoings. Most surely, Allah is Ample-giving and All-generous.”

Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) is also reported, in a validly reported tradition, to have said, “When a believing individual prays to Him for granting him his request, Almighty Allah may postpone the answer of that request to Friday in order that the individual will be given all the more due to the exclusive merit of Fridays.”

Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) is also reported as narrating that when Prophet Joseph’s brothers asked their father, Prophet Jacob, to ask Almighty Allah’s forgiveness of their faults, he promised to do that. Yet, he postponed that appeal to Friday early dawn (fajr) so as to guarantee response.

Again, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) is reported as saying that on Friday nights, fishes in oceans and beasts in wildernesses raise their heads and pray Almighty Allah saying in a loud sound, “O Our Lord; torture us not for the sins of the human beings.”

Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (a.s.) is reported to have said that on Friday nights, Almighty Allah gives orders to an angel - on behalf of Him - to call out, from above the Divine Throne, throughout the night, “Is there not any believing servant who will, right now, supplicate Me, before dawn (fajr) comes upon him, for his world and Next World needs so that I will respond to him? Is there not any believing servant who, right now, repents to Me, before dawn (fajr) comes upon him, and gives up his sins so that I will accept his repentance? Is there not any believing servant whose sustenance has been made reduced who will, right now, prays Me for increase, before dawn (fajr) comes upon him, so that I will increase and develop his sustenance? Is there not any believing servant, being ailed, who will, right now, pray Me for healing, before dawn (fajr) comes upon him, so that I will heal him? Is there not any believing servant, being grieved and detained, who will, right now, pray Me for relief and release, before dawn (fajr) comes upon him, so that I will relieve and release him? Is there not any believing servant, being oppressed, who will, right now, pray Me for giving him victory and releasing him from oppression, before dawn (fajr) comes upon him, so that I will back and release from oppression?” This angel will keep saying so until dawn (fajr).

Likewise, Imam Ali Ameer al-Momineen (a.s.) is reported to have said, “As He has chosen Friday, Almighty Allah has decided their daytimes and nights to be feasts. One of its merits, whoever beseeches Him on Fridays will be granted his request. Chastisement that is decided for a people because of an evildoing will be canceled by Him if that evildoing is committed on Friday. All graces that Almighty Allah decides are put into practice on Friday nights. Hence, Friday nights are more favorable than other nights and so are their days.”

Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) is reported as saying, “Avoid committing any act of disobedience (to Almighty Allah) on Friday nights, for the punishments (of evildoing) are doubled up, and rewards (for good deeds) are also doubled up. Whoever avoids committing an act of disobedience at Friday nights, Almighty Allah will forgive all of his previous sins. In the same way, whoever challenges Almighty Allah by committing an act of disobedience at such nights, Almighty Allah will punish him for each and every act of disobedience that he did in his whole lifetime and will double up the punishment for him.”

It has been authentically narrated on the authority of Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Rida(a.s.) that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) said, “Verily, Friday is the master of days. On Fridays, Almighty Allah doubles up the rewards (for good deeds), erases, forgivingly, the punishments (for evildoings), raises the ranks (of faith), responds to prayers, relieves from misfortunes, and fulfills the grand requests. Friday is the day of bonus. Almighty Allah, on Fridays, releases numerous individuals from Hellfire. When anyone prays Him on Friday while having already appreciated the actual standing and the sanctity of this day, it will be incumbent upon Almighty Allah to release him/her from Hellfire. If that individual dies on that day or night, he/she will be decided as martyr and will be resurrected (on the Judgement Day) secured. Conversely, if one belittles the sanctity of Friday and disrespects its standings, it will be incumbent upon Almighty Allah to cast him/her into Hellfire unless he/she repents thereafter.”

Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (a.s.) is reported, through an authentic chain of authority, to have said, “Sunlight has never risen in a day better than Friday. When beards meet each other on that day, they greet each other with, Peace! Good day!”

Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq(a.s.) is authentically reported to have said, “On Fridays, do not engage yourselves in anything other than acts of worship, for the servants’ faults are forgiven and the divine mercy is sent down on Fridays.”

A_J3.name: Ziyarat on Friday

segs.note: Ziyarat of Imam al Mahdi (a.t.f.s.)
segs.ur: زیارت امام مہدی (عج)

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ اللهِ فِیْ اَرْضِهٖ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O argument of Allah in His lands!
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA HUJJATAL LAAHE FEE ARZEHI

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَيْنَ اللهِ فِیْ خَلْقِهٖ
segs.en: Peace be upon you, O sight of Allah on His creatures!
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA AYNAL LAAHE FEE KHALQEHI

segs.en: Peace be upon you, O light of Allah
by which those who have been guided [to the true guidance] are guided
and by which the believers are relieved!
Peace be upon you, O polite and fearful!
Peace be upon you, O sincere patron!
Peace be upon you, O ark of salvation!
Peace be upon you, O essence of life!
Peace be upon you. May Allah send blessings to you
and upon your Household, the pure and immaculate.
segs.tr: WA A’LAA AALE BAYTEKAT TAYYABEENAT TAAHEREENA

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ عَجَّلَ اللهُ لَكَ مَا وَعَدَكَ
segs.en: Peace be upon you. May Allah hasten that which He has promised you;
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA A’JJALAL LAAHO LAKA MAA WA-A’DAKA

segs.en: namely, victory and prevalence of your authority.
Peace be upon you, O my master.
I am a servant of you
and I recognize the first and the last of your affair.

segs.ar: اَتَقَرَّبُ اِلَی اللهِ تَعَالٰی بِكَ وَبِآلِ بَيْتِكَ
segs.en: I seek nearness to Allah, the Exalted, through your Household and you
segs.tr: ATAQARRABO ELAL LAAHE TA-A’ALAA BEKA WA BE-AALE BAYTEKA

segs.ar: وَاَنْتَظِرُ ظُهُوْرَكَ وَظُهُوْرَ الْحَقِّ عَلٰی يَدَيْكَ
segs.en: and I am expecting your advent and the prevalence of the truth at your hands.
segs.tr: WA ANTAZERU ZOHOORAKA WA ZOHOORAL HAQQE A’LAA YADAYKA

segs.ar: وَاَسْئَلُ اللهَ اَنْ يُصَلِّیَ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: And I beseech Allah to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: WA AS-ALUL LAAHA AN YOSALLEYA A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: and to include me with those who are expecting you,
segs.tr: WA AYN YAJA’LANEE MENAL MUNTAZEREENA LAKA

segs.en: those who follow you and support you against your enemies,
segs.tr: WAT TAABE-E’ENA WAN NAASEREENA LAKA A’LAA AA’-DAAAEKA

segs.en: and those who will be martyred in front of you

segs.ar: فِیْ جُمْلَةِ اَوْلِيَآئِكَ يَا مَوْلَایَ يَا صَاحِبَ الزَّمَانِ
segs.en: in the group of your loyalists. O my master, O Patron of the Age!
segs.tr: FEE JUMLATE AWLEYAAA-EKA YAA MAWLAAYA YAA SAAHEBAZ ZAMAANE

segs.ar: صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلٰی آلِ بَيْتِكَ
segs.en: May Allah’s blessings be upon you and upon your Household.
segs.tr: SALAWAATUL LAAHE ALAYKA WA A’LAA AALE BAYTEKA

segs.ar: هٰذَا يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ وَهُوَ يَوْمُكَ الْمُتَوَقَّعُ فِيْهِ ظُهُوْرُكَ
segs.en: Today is Friday, which is your day on which your advent is expected
segs.tr: HAAZAA YAWMUL JOMO-A’TE WA HOWA YAWMOKAL MOTAWAQQAO’ FEEHE ZOHOOROKA

segs.en: to bring about relief to the believers at your hands,
segs.tr: WAL FARAJO FEEHE LIL MOMENEENA A’LAA YADAYKA

segs.en: and killing of the disbelievers with your sword.

segs.ar: وَاَنَا يَا مَوْلَایَ فِيْهِ ضَيْفُكَ وَجَارُكَ
segs.en: On this day, O my master, I am your guest and in your vicinity
segs.tr: WA ANAA YAA MAWLAALYA FEEHE ZAYFOKA WA JAAROKA

segs.ar: وَاَنْتَ يَا مَوْلَایَ كَرِيْمٌ مِنْ اَوْلَادِ الْكِرَامِ
segs.en: and you, my master, are generous and the descendant of the generous people,
segs.tr: WA ANTA YAA MAWLAAYA KAREEMUN MIN AWLAADIL KERAAME

segs.en: and you are commanded to receive your guests and neighbours hospitably;
so, receive me as your guest and neighbour.

segs.ar: صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ عَلَيكَ وَعَلٰی اَهْلِ بَيْتِكَ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ.
segs.en: May Allah’s blessings be upon you and upon your Household, the immaculate.
segs.tr: SALAWAATUL LAAHE A’LAYKA WA A’LAA AHLE BAYTEKAT TAAHEREENA.

A_J3.merits:
As per the traditions of the infallible Imams (a.s.), the day of Friday is reserved for the Imam of the Time, Imam-e- Zamana (a.t.f.s.). Since Friday is largely considered as the day of reappearance of the Imam, this ziyarat assumes that much more importance. While it is essential for the Shiah to convey salaam to Imam every day, this ziyarat is special because it is recited on the day reserved for the Imam (a.t.f.s.). In this ziyarat, the believer salutes the Imam (a.t.f.s.) through his forefathers and affectionately calls out to the Imam (a.t.f.s.) saying that since this is Friday; the day on which your reappearance is ordained, come soon and extract revenge from the enemies of Allah and your enemies and please the hearts of the believers through that. Then the believer pleads to Imam (a.t.f.s.) saying, O my master, on this day, I am your guest. You are a marvellous host, you are generous and the son of generous (Imams). So be an excellent host to me!
One of the benefits of reciting these loving sentences is that Inshallah, when the Imam (a.t.f.s.) arrives, he will remember our dua and invite us to be his guest. It is the habit of worldly parents that they remember the requests of their children. Imam (a.t.f.s.) loves us more than our parents and therefore he will remember our request well. Hence one should not forsake the recitation of this special ziyarat on Friday.

segs.en: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segs.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الْاَوَّلِ قَبْلَ الْاِنْشَآءِ وَالْاِحْيَآءِ
segs.en: All praise be to Allah, the First before the bringing forth and the giving of life,
segs.tr: ALHAMDO LILLAHIL AWWALE QABLAL INSHAAA-E WAL AHYAAA-E

segs.en: and the Last after the annihilation of all things,

segs.ar: الْعَلِيْمِ الَّذِىْ لَا يَنْسٰى مَنْ ذَكَرَهٗ
segs.en: the All-knowing Who forgets not him who remembers Him,
segs.tr: A’LEEMIL LAZEE LAA YANSAA MAN ZAKARAHU

segs.en: decreases not him who thanks Him,
disappoints not him who supplicates Him,
and cuts not off the hope of him who hopes in Him!
segs.tr: WA LAA YAQTA-O’ RAJAAA-A MAN RAJAAHO

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّىْ اُشْهِدُكَ وَكَفٰى بِكَ شَهِيْدًا
segs.en: O Allah, I call You to witness and You are sufficient Witness
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE USH-HEDOKA WA KAFAA BEKA SHAHEEDAN

segs.en: and I call to witness all Your angels,
the inhabitants of Your heavens, the bearers of Your Throne,
segs.tr: WA SUKKAANA SAMAAWAATEKA WA HAMALATA A’RSHEKA

segs.en: Your prophets and Your messengers whom You have sent out,
segs.tr: WA MAN BA-A’STA MIN AMBEYAAA-EKA WA ROSOLEKA

segs.en: and the various kinds of creatures You have brought forth,
that I bear witness that You are Allah;
there is no god but You, You alone,
Who have no associate nor any equal,

segs.ar: وَلَا عَدِيْلَ وَلَا خُلْفَ لِقَوْلِكَ وَلَا تَبْدِيْلَ
segs.en: and Your word has no failing, nor any change;
segs.tr: WA LAA ADEELA WA LAA KHULFA LE-QAWLEKA WA LAA TABDEELA

segs.ar: وَاَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهٖ عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُوْلُكَ
segs.en: and that Muhammad, Allah bless him and his Household, is Your servant and Your messenger;
segs.tr: WA ANNA MOHAMMADAN SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI WA SALLAMA A’BDOKA WA RASOOLOKA

segs.en: he delivered to the servants that with which You charged him,

segs.ar: وَجَاهَدَ فِىْ اللهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ حَقَّ الْجِهَادِ
segs.en: struggled for Allah as is His due,
segs.tr: WA JAAHADA FILLAAHE A’ZZA WA JALLA HAQQAL JEHAADE

segs.ar: وَاَنَّهٗ بَشَّرَ بِمَا هُوَ حَقٌّ مِنَ الثَّوَابِ
segs.en: gave the good news of the truth of reward,
segs.tr: WA ANNAHU BASHSHARA BEMAA HOWA HAQQUN MENAS SAWAAB

segs.ar: وَاَنْذَرَ بِمَا هُوَ صِدْقٌ مِنَ الْعِقَابِ
segs.en: and warned of the veracity of punishment.
segs.tr: WA ANZARA BEMAA HOWA SIDQUN MENAL E’QAABE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ ثَبِّتْنِىْ عَلٰى دِيْنِكَ مَا اَحْيَيْتَنِىْ
segs.en: O Allah, make me firm in Your religion as long as You keep me alive,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SABBITNEE A’LAA DEENEKA MAA AHYAYTANEE

segs.ar: وَلَا تُزِغْ قَلْبِىْ بَعْدَ اِذْ هَدَيْتَنِىْ
segs.en: make not my heart swerve after You have guided me,
segs.tr: WA LAA TOZIGH QALBEE BA’DA IZ HADAYTANEE

segs.en: and give me mercy from You,
segs.tr: WA HAB LEE MIN LADUNKA RAHMATAN

segs.en: surely, You are the All-bestower.

segs.ar: صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلٰى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: Bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: make me one of his followers and his partisans,
segs.tr: WAJ A’LNEE MIN AT-BAA-E’HI WA SHEE-A’TEHI

segs.en: muster me in his band,
and give me the success of accomplishing the obligatory observance of Fridays,

segs.ar: وَمَا اَوْجَبْتَ عَلَىَّ فِيْهَا مِنَ الطَّاعَاتِ
segs.en: performing the acts of obedience which You have made incumbent upon me within it,
segs.tr: WA MAA AWJABTA A’LAYYA FEEHAA MENAT TAA-A’ATE

segs.ar: وَقَسَمْتَ لِاَهْلِهَا مِنَ الْعَطَآءِ فِىْ يَوْمِ الْجَزَآءِ
segs.en: and receiving the bestowal which You have apportioned for its people on the Day of Recompense!
segs.tr: WA QASAMTA LE AHLEHAA MENAL A’TAAA-E FEE YAWMIL JAZAAA-E

segs.en: Surely, You are the Almighty, the All-wise!

A_J6.name: Recommended Rites of Friday

segs.note: Fajr Prayer until Sunrise
segs.ur: نمازِ فجر سے طلوعِ آفتاب تک

segs.note: In the Fajr prayer, recite Surah al-Jumu'ah in the first unit and Surah al-Tawhid in the second.
segs.ur: نماز فجر میں پہلی رکعت میں [سورہ جمعہ](A66) اور دوسری رکعت میں [سورہ توحید](A116) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: After the Fajr prayer, before speaking to anyone, recite (at least once a month):
segs.ur: نماز فجر کے بعد، کسی سے بات کرنے سے پہلے پڑھیں (مہینے میں کم از کم ایک مرتبہ):

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ مَا قُلْتُ فِيْ جُمُعَتِيْ هٰذِهٖ مِنْ قَوْلٍ
segs.en: O Allah, whatever word I speak in this Friday of mine,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA MAA QULTO FEE JOMO-A’TEE HAAZEHI MIN QAWLIN

segs.en: or whatever oath I take,
or whatever vow I make,
Your will precedes all of that;

segs.ar: فَمَا شِئْتَ مِنْهُ اَنْ يَّكُوْنَ كَانَ
segs.en: whatever You will to be shall be,
segs.tr: FAMAA SHEA-TA MINHO ANY YAKOONA KAANA

segs.ar: وَمَا لَمْ تَشَأْ مِنْهُ لَمْ يَكُنِ
segs.en: and whatever You do not will shall not be.
segs.tr: WA MAA LAM TASHAA MINHO LAM YAKONIL

segs.en: O Allah, forgive me and overlook my faults.
segs.tr: LAAHUMMAGH FIR LEE WA TAJAAWAZ A’NNEE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ مَنْ صَلَّيْتَ عَلَيْهِ فَصَلَوَاتِىْ عَلَيْهِ
segs.en: O Allah, whomever You bless, may my blessings be upon him,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA MAN SALLAYTA A’LAYHE FA-SALAWAATEE A’LAYHE

segs.en: and whomever You curse, may my curse be upon him.

segs.note: Shaykh al-Tusi highly recommends this dua after the Fajr prayer:
segs.ur: شیخ طوسی نماز فجر کے بعد اس دعا کی بہت تاکید کرتے ہیں:

segs.en: O Allah, I have directed myself toward You with my need,
and today I have brought before You my poverty,
my want, and my destitution.
I have more hope in Your forgiveness than I have in my own deeds,
for Your forgiveness and Your mercy are more vast than my sins.
segs.tr: WA LE-MAGHFERATOKA WA RAHMATOKA AWSA-O’ MIN ZONOOBEE

segs.ar: فَتَوَلَّ قَضَاۤءَ كُلِّ حَاجَةٍ لِيْ بِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَيْهَا
segs.en: So, take charge of fulfilling every need of mine through Your power over it,
segs.tr: FATAWALLA QAZAAA-A KULLE HAAJATIN LEE BE-QUDRATEKA A’LAYHAA

segs.en: for that is easy for You and because of my poverty toward You.
segs.tr: WA TAYSEERE ZAALEKA A’LAYKA WA LE-FAQREE ELAYKA

segs.ar: فَاِنِّي لَمْ اُصِبْ خَيْرًا قَطُّ اِلَّا مِنْكَ
segs.en: Indeed, I have never attained any good except from You,
segs.tr: FA-INNEE LAM OSIB KHAYRAN QATTO ILLAA MINKA

segs.ar: وَلَمْ يَصْرِفْ عَنِّيْ سُوۤءًا قَطُّ اَحَدٌ سِوَاكَ
segs.en: and no one has ever averted any evil from me except You.
segs.tr: WA LAM YASRIF A’NNEE SOOO-AN QATTO AHADUN SEWAAKA

segs.en: I do not place my hope for my hereafter, my worldly life,
segs.tr: WA LASTU ARJOO LE-AAKHERATEE WA DUNYAAYA

segs.ar: وَلَا لِيَوْمِ فَقْرِيْ يَوْمَ يُفْرِدُنِيْ النَّاسُ فِيْ حُفْرَتِيْ
segs.en: or for the day of my poverty—the day when people leave me alone in my grave
segs.tr: WA LAA LE-YAWME FAQREE YAWMA YUFERODONIN NAASO FEE HUFRATEE

segs.en: and I come before You with my sins—in anyone other than You.

segs.note: After the Fajr and Zuhr prayers, recite once, or 100 times:
segs.ur: نماز فجر اور ظہر کے بعد ایک مرتبہ یا 100 مرتبہ پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ
segs.en: O Allah, bless Mohammad and the family of Mohammad and hasten their relief.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WA A’JJIL FARA-JAHUM.

segs.note: Recite Surah al-Rahman, and wherever the verse “Then which of the favors of your Lord will ye deny?” comes, say “None of Your favors do I deny.”
segs.ur: [سورہ رحمٰن](A59) پڑھیں، اور جہاں بھی آیت «پھر تم اپنے رب کی کون کون سی نعمتوں کو جھٹلاؤ گے؟» آئے وہاں کہیں: «تیری نعمتوں میں سے میں کسی کو نہیں جھٹلاتا۔»

segs.note: Recite Surah al-Tawhid, salawat and istighfar 100 times each.
segs.ur: [سورہ توحید](A116)، درود اور استغفار ہر ایک 100 مرتبہ پڑھیں۔

segs.note: If you can, also recite Surah al-Nisa, Surah Hud, Surah al-Kahf and Surah al-Saffat.
segs.ur: اگر ہو سکے تو [سورہ نساء](A8)، [سورہ ہود](A15)، [سورہ کہف](A22) اور [سورہ صافات](A41) بھی پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Before sunrise, recite Surah al-Kafirun 10 times, then pray to Allah for your needs.
segs.ur: طلوعِ آفتاب سے پہلے [سورہ کافرون](A113) 10 مرتبہ پڑھیں، پھر اللہ سے اپنی حاجتیں مانگیں۔

segs.note: Until sunrise, keep to worship, duas and the remembrance of Allah.
segs.ur: طلوعِ آفتاب تک عبادت، دعاؤں اور ذکرِ الٰہی میں مشغول رہیں۔

segs.note: Ghusl & Grooming
segs.ur: غسل اور آراستگی

segs.note: Perform the Friday ghusl between sunrise and midday (Zuhr) - the nearer to midday, the better. While washing, recite:
segs.ur: غسل جمعہ طلوع آفتاب اور ظہر کے درمیان کریں - جتنا ظہر کے قریب ہو اتنا بہتر ہے۔ غسل کرتے ہوئے پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ
segs.en: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, alone without partner,
segs.tr: ASH-HADO AN LAA ELAAHA ELLAL LAAHO WAHDAHU LAA SHAREEKA LAHU

segs.en: and I bear witness that Mohammad is His servant and His Messenger.
segs.tr: WA ASH-HADO ANNA MOHAMMADAN A’BDOHU WA RASOOLOHU

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, bless Mohammad and the family of Mohammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: and make me among those who constantly repent,
and make me among those who purify themselves.

segs.note: Dye with hibiscus.
segs.ur: گل خیرو (ختمی) سے خضاب لگائیں۔

segs.note: Trim your mustache and nails, and while doing so, recite:
segs.ur: مونچھیں اور ناخن تراشیں اور اس دوران کہیں:

segs.ar: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَبِاللّٰهِ وَعَلٰى سُنَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: In the name of Allah and by Allah, and upon the way (Sunnah) of Mohammad and the family of Mohammad.
segs.tr: BISMIL LAAHE WA BILLAAHE WA A’LAA SUNNATE MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.note: It is also recommended, on cutting the nails, to start with the little finger of the left hand and end with that of the right hand. The same thing is applicable to the nails of the feet. Then, the cut nails should be buried.
segs.ur: یہ بھی مستحب ہے کہ ناخن کاٹتے وقت بائیں ہاتھ کی چھنگلی سے شروع کیا جائے اور دائیں ہاتھ کی چھنگلی پر ختم کیا جائے۔ یہی بات پاؤں کے ناخنوں پر بھی لاگو ہوتی ہے۔ پھر کٹے ہوئے ناخن دفن کر دینے چاہئیں۔

segs.note: Apply perfume and put on your best clothes.
segs.ur: خوشبو لگائیں اور اپنے بہترین کپڑے پہنیں۔

segs.note: Quran, Salawat & Dua Nudba
segs.ur: قرآن، صلوات اور دعائے ندبہ
