segs.note: From early morning until midday (Zuhr), recite Ayat al-Kursi repeatedly, and after the obligatory prayers recite Surah al-Qadr often.
segs.ur: صبح سویرے سے ظہر تک [آیت الکرسی](A4) بار بار پڑھیں، اور واجب نمازوں کے بعد [سورہ قدر](A101) کثرت سے پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Recite Surah al-Ahqaf and Surah al-Mu'minun.
segs.ur: [سورہ احقاف](A50) اور [سورہ مومنون](A27) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Recite salawat 1,000 times - or, if there is not enough time, at least 100 times.
segs.ur: 1,000 مرتبہ درود پڑھیں - یا اگر وقت کم ہو تو کم از کم 100 مرتبہ۔

segs.note: Recite salawat 100 times, Surah al-Tawhid 100 times, and this istighfar 100 times:
segs.ur: 100 مرتبہ درود، [سورہ توحید](A116) 100 مرتبہ، اور یہ استغفار 100 مرتبہ پڑھیں:

segs.en: I seek forgiveness from Allah, my Lord, and I turn to Him in repentance.
segs.tr: ASTAGHFERUL LAAHA RABBEE WA ATOOBO ELAYHE

segs.note: Recite Dua Nudba.
segs.ur: [دعائے ندبہ](E34) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Alms, Family, Learning & Visits
segs.ur: صدقہ، خاندان، علم اور زیارات

segs.note: Give alms.
segs.ur: صدقہ دیں۔

segs.note: Bring fruits and good meals for your family, so that Friday is a day of pleasure for them.
segs.ur: اپنے گھر والوں کے لیے پھل اور اچھے کھانے لائیں تاکہ جمعہ ان کے لیے خوشی کا دن ہو۔

segs.note: Eat a pomegranate before breakfast and seven leaves of endive before midday (Zuhr).
segs.ur: ناشتے سے پہلے ایک انار اور ظہر سے پہلے کاسنی کے سات پتے کھائیں۔

segs.note: Dedicate the day to learning the religious laws and instructions. Avoid wandering in others' gardens, keeping company with the vicious and the licentious, speaking about others' defects, laughing and guffawing, reciting poetry, and discussing useless subjects.
segs.ur: دن کو دینی احکام اور تعلیمات سیکھنے کے لیے مخصوص کریں۔ دوسروں کے باغوں میں گھومنے، بدکاروں اور فاسقوں کی صحبت، دوسروں کے عیوب کی باتیں کرنے، ہنسی اور قہقہوں، شعر خوانی اور فضول موضوعات پر گفتگو سے پرہیز کریں۔

segs.note: Recite the ziyarat of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) and the Imams (a.s.).
segs.ur: رسول اکرم (ص) اور ائمہ (ع) کی زیارت پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Visit the graves of your relatives, especially your parents.
segs.ur: اپنے رشتہ داروں، خاص طور پر اپنے والدین کی قبروں کی زیارت کریں۔

A_J6.merits:
Dua before speaking: Before opening the mouth with any word, it is recommended to say this supplicatory prayer after the dawn (fajr) Prayer so that all sins committed throughout the week will be forgiven. This act should be done once a month at least.

Until sunrise: It has been also narrated that one who, after the accomplishment of the dawn (fajr) Prayer on Fridays, does devotional acts and says supplications and invocations until sunrise will be raised seventy ranks to the Supreme Paradise.

Salawat with Ajjil Farajahum: It has been narrated that one who says this invocation after the Zohr and Fajr Prayers on Fridays, as well as other days, will catch Imam al-Mahdi(a.s.) before he dies. In addition, it has been narrated that one who repeats this invocation one hundred times will have sixty of his requests granted for him - thirty in this worldly life and thirty on the Resurrection Day.

Tawhid, salawat and istighfar: Shaykh al-Tusi has recorded that it is highly recommended to recite Surah al-Tawheed, to invoke Almighty Allah’s blessings upon Mohammad and his Household, and to pray Him for forgiveness each one hundred times after the Fajr Prayer on Fridays. It is also highly recommended to recite Surahs al-Nisa’ (No. 4), Hud (No. 11), al-Kahf (No. 18), al-Saaffaat (No. 37), and al-Rahman (No. 55) during that time.

Surah al-Kafirun: It is recommended to repeat it ten times before sunrise and then pray Almighty Allah so that all prayers will be answered.

Surah al-Ahqaf and Surah al-Muminun: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) is reported as saying that anyone who recites Surah al-Ahqaf at Friday nights or on Fridays will not be inflicted by dismays in his worldly life and will be saved from the horrors on the Resurrection Day. The Imam (a.s.) is also reported as saying that anyone who recites Surah al-Momenun regularly each Friday will come upon a happy end and will be granted an abode in the Supreme Paradise with the Prophets and Messengers of Almighty Allah.

Ayat al-Kursi and Surah al-Qadr: It has been narrated that Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn Zayn al-Aabedeen (a.s.) used to repeat reciting Ayat al-Kursi (verse No. 255 of Surah al-Baqarah No. 2) from early morning up to midday (zohr) on Fridays. When he accomplished the obligatory prayers, he would recite Surah al-Qadr (No. 97) frequently. It is worth mentioning that to recite Ayat al-Kursi in the form of revelation on Fridays achieves a great reward.

Ghusl: It is highly recommended to bathe oneself. In fact, this is one of the most confirmed rituals of Fridays. The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) is reported to have instructed Imam Ali (a.s.) by saying, “O Ali; wash yourself every Friday even if you have to purchase water with your Daily provisions and have nothing to eat. Verily, no voluntary act is better than this.” Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) is also reported to have said: Whoever washes himself on Fridays and, meanwhile, says this supplicatory prayer will be pure all through that week.  “Pure” in this Hadith stands for purification from sins or acceptance of the deeds, which is thus moral purification. In any case, it is important not to neglect bathing oneself on Fridays when possible. The recommended time of this bathing is between sunrise and midday (zohr). In addition, the nearer to midday (zohr) the better.

Hibiscus: It is recommended to dye with hibiscus, for it saves from leprosy and insanity.

Mustache and nails: It is also recommended to cut the mustache neatly and trim the nails so as not to miss the great merits of doing these acts. As has been mentioned in narrations, these acts bring about expansion in sustenance, cancellation of sins up to the next Friday, and security from insanity and leprosy.

Alms: It is recommended to give alms, for the rewards are doubled up on Fridays and at Friday nights, as is confirmed by narrations, as one thousand folds as giving alms on other days.

Pomegranate: Imam Musa al-Kazim (a.s.) is reported to have said, “The heart of him who eats a pomegranate before breakfast on Fridays will be enlightened for forty days. To eat two pomegranates increases the period of enlightenment to eighty days, and so on. It also dismisses the evil suggestions. Of course, to get rid of Satan’s suggestions is to stop acting disobediently to Almighty Allah; and to stop acting disobediently to Him allows entrance to Paradise.” In al-Misbah, the author has said that to eat pomegranates on Fridays and at Friday nights achieves great merits.

Learning the religion: Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s.) is reported as saying, “Woe to a Muslim who does not dedicate Fridays to learning the affairs of his religion.” The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) is also reported to have said, “If you, on Fridays, see old men telling the tales of infidelity and of the pre-Islamic era, you should then make their heads the targets of stones.” Disadvantages arisen from such matters are too many to be mentioned.

Salawat: Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (a.s.) is reported to have said, “For me, no act of worship is more favorable than invoking blessings upon the Prophet and his immaculate Household - may Allah bless them all - on Fridays.” If there is not enough time to repeat this invocation one thousand times, it must be repeated one hundred times at least so that faces will be brightened on the Judgement Day. It has been also narrated that all sins will be totally forgiven for those who repeat invocations of blessings upon the Holy Prophet and his Household one hundred times, repeat this supplicatory prayer one hundred times, and recite Surah al-Tawheed (No. 112) one hundred times on Fridays. It has been also narrated that to invoke blessings upon the Holy Prophet and his household is equal (in reward) to seventy times of going on Hajj.

Visiting graves: Imam al-Baqir (a.s.) is reported as saying, “Visit the graves of your relatives on Fridays, for they know about those who visit their graves and will be happy for that.”

Dua Nudba: It is one of the rites to be done on the Four Feast Days (i.e. Eid al-Fitr - the first of Shawwal, Eid al-Azha - the tenth of Zilhajj, Eid al-Ghadeer - the eighteenth of Zilhajj, and Fridays).

A_J7.name: Aamal of Zuhr Prayer on Friday

segs.note: Dua at Midday (Zuhr)
segs.ur: دوپہر کی دعا (ظہر)

segs.note: At midday (Zuhr) on Friday, recite:
segs.ur: جمعہ کے دن ظہر کے وقت پڑھیں:

segs.en: There is no god save Allah.
Allah is the Most Great.
Glory be to Allah.

segs.ar: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا
segs.en: All praise be to Allah Who has not taken to Himself a son
segs.tr: WAL HAMDO LILLAAHIL LAZEE LAM YATTAKHIZ WALADAN

segs.ar: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهٗ شَرِيْكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ
segs.en: nor has He had any partner in sovereignty
segs.tr: WA LAM YAKUN LAHU SHAREEKUN FIL MULKE

segs.ar: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهٗ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ الذُّلِّ
segs.en: nor does He need any to protect Him from humiliation,
segs.tr: WA LAM YAKUN LAHU WALIYYUN MENAZ ZULLE

segs.en: and magnify Him for His greatness and glory.

segs.note: You may then say:
segs.ur: پھر آپ کہہ سکتے ہیں:

segs.en: O Conferrer of boon amply!
O Repeller of troubles!
O Maker of souls!
O Sublime in determinations!
O Coverer [of daylight] with darkness!
O Lord of magnanimity and nobility!
O Remover of harm and pains!
O Entertainer of those lonely in darkness!
O All-knowing Who never needs teaching!
Send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: and do to me all that which befits You.
segs.tr: WAF A’L BEE MAA ANTA AHLOHU

segs.en: O He Whose Name is remedy,
the remembrance of Whom is cure,
and the obedience to Whom is sufficiency,
have mercy upon him whose wealth is only hope [for You]
and whose weapon is only weeping.
Glory be to You. There is no god save You.
O All-tender, O All-Bestower,
O Fashioner of the heavens and the earth,
O Lord of majesty and honor.

segs.note: Surahs in Friday Prayers
segs.ur: نماز جمعہ میں سورتیں

segs.note: In the Zuhr prayer on Friday, recite Surah al-Jumu'ah and Surah al-Munafiqun.
segs.ur: جمعہ کے دن نماز ظہر میں [سورہ جمعہ](A66) اور [سورہ منافقون](A67) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: In the Asr prayer on Friday, recite Surah al-Jumu'ah and Surah al-Tawhid.
segs.ur: جمعہ کے دن نماز عصر میں [سورہ جمعہ](A66) اور [سورہ توحید](A116) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: In the obligatory prayers on Friday night, recite Surah al-Jumu'ah and Surah al-Ala.
segs.ur: شب جمعہ کی واجب نمازوں میں [سورہ جمعہ](A66) اور [سورہ اعلیٰ](A91) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Surahs for Protection ×7
segs.ur: حفاظت کی سورتیں ×7

segs.note: After the Friday Zuhr prayer, recite Surah al-Fatihah, Surah al-Nas, Surah al-Falaq, Surah al-Tawhid and Surah al-Kafirun 7 times each, then the last two verses of Surah al-Tawbah, the final verses of Surah al-Hashr and the final verses of Surah Aal-e-Imran.
segs.ur: جمعہ کے دن نماز ظہر کے بعد [سورہ فاتحہ](A5)، [سورہ ناس](A118)، [سورہ فلق](A117)، [سورہ توحید](A116) اور [سورہ کافرون](A113) ہر ایک 7 مرتبہ پڑھیں، پھر [سورہ توبہ](A13) کی آخری دو آیات، [سورہ حشر](A63) کی آخری آیات اور [سورہ آل عمران](A7) کی آخری آیات پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Salawat after Fajr or Zuhr
segs.ur: فجر یا ظہر کے بعد کی صلوات

segs.note: After the Fajr or Zuhr prayer, recite:
segs.ur: نماز فجر یا ظہر کے بعد پڑھیں:

segs.en: O Allah, (please do) let Your blessings
and the blessings of Your angels and Messengers
be on Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

segs.note: After the Fajr or Zuhr prayer on Friday, recite:
segs.ur: جمعہ کے دن نماز فجر یا ظہر کے بعد پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and hasten their Relief.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WA A’JJIL FARAJAHUM

segs.note: Between the obligatory Zuhr and Asr prayers, invoke Allah’s blessings upon the Holy Prophet and his Household.
segs.ur: ظہر اور عصر کی واجب نمازوں کے درمیان رسولِ اکرم اور ان کی آل پر درود بھیجیں۔

segs.note: Two Units after Zuhr
segs.ur: ظہر کے بعد دو رکعت

segs.note: After the obligatory Zuhr prayer on Friday, pray 2 units, reciting Surah al-Fatihah once and Surah al-Tawhid 7 times in each unit. Then recite:
segs.ur: جمعہ کے دن واجب نماز ظہر کے بعد 2 رکعت نماز پڑھیں، ہر رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) ایک مرتبہ اور [سورہ توحید](A116) 7 مرتبہ پڑھیں۔ پھر پڑھیں:

segs.en: O Allah, include me with the inhabitants of Paradise
whose stuffing is blessing
and whose constructors are the angels
with our Prophet Muhammad,
peace of Allah be upon him and his Household,
and our father Abraham, peace be upon him.

segs.note: Commenting on this supplication, Shaykh al-Tusi instructs that one who is not from the Holy Prophet’s offspring should say, “his father (abihi)” instead of “our father (abina).”
segs.ur: اس دعا کے بارے میں شیخ طوسی ہدایت کرتے ہیں کہ جو نبی کی اولاد میں سے نہ ہو وہ “ابینا (ہمارے باپ)” کی جگہ “ابیہ (اس کے باپ)” کہے۔

segs.note: Sahifah Duas & Salawat
segs.ur: صحیفہ کی دعائیں اور صلوات

segs.note: Recite Dua No. 46 and Dua No. 48 of al-Sahifah al-Sajjadiyyah.
segs.ur: صحیفۂ سجادیہ کی دعا نمبر 46 اور دعا نمبر 48 پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Then pray as you wish and invoke blessings upon the Holy Prophet and his Household 1,000 times.
segs.ur: پھر جو چاہیں دعا مانگیں اور نبی (ص) اور ان کی آل پر 1,000 مرتبہ درود بھیجیں۔

A_J7.merits:
Dua at midday: It is narrated by Muhammad ibn Muslim on the authority of Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, that one may say this supplicatory prayer at midday (zohr) on Fridays. This form of the supplication has been quoted from Shaykh al-Tusi’s famous book entitled Misbah al-Mutahajjid.

Surahs in Friday prayers: Shaykh al-Saduq has narrated that Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq(a.s.) said: It is obligatory upon all believers who claim being adherents (Shi’ah) to us (i.e. to the Ahl al-Bayt) to recite Surah al-Jumu’ah and Surah al-A’la (No. 78) in the obligatory prayers at Friday nights and to recite Surah al-Jumu’ah and Surah al-Munafiqun in the Zohr Prayer on Fridays. One who does so will be regarded as following the example of the Holy Messenger, peace be upon him and his Household, and Almighty Allah will award him Paradise.

Shaykh al-Kulayni has narrated in a semi-authentic narration that al-Halabi asked Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s.) whether one should recite the Zohr Prayer audibly on Fridays (in case one cannot attend the congregational Friday Prayer). The Imam (a.s.) answered on the affirmative and confirmed that one should recite Surah al-Jumu’ah and al-Munafiqun in the Zohr Prayer on Fridays.

Surahs for protection: With reference to the post-prayer litanies in general and the supplications to be said after the Friday Zohr Prayer, Shaykh al-Tusi has quoted Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq(a.s.) as saying: Whoever recites on Friday after the concluding part of the Zohr Prayer these parts of the Holy Qur’an will be under the divine protection all over the week.

Salawat after Fajr or Zuhr: Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s.) is also reported to have said: If one says the first supplicatory prayer after the Fajr Prayer or the Zohr Prayer, no sin will be recorded against him for a whole year.

Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq(a.s.) is also reported to have said: If one says the second supplicatory prayer after the Fajr Prayer or the Zohr Prayer (on Fridays), he will not die before he catches the age of Imam al-Mahdi, peace be upon him.

The second supplication also brings about security from misfortunes up to the next Friday if it is repeated three times after the Friday Zohr Prayer.

It has been also narrated that one who invokes Almighty Allah’s blessings upon the Holy Prophet and his Household, peace be upon them, between the two obligatory Zohr and Asr prayers will have the reward of offering a seventy-unit prayer.

Two units after Zuhr: In his book of Misbah al-Mutahajjid, Shaykh al-Tusi says that the Holy Imams, peace be upon them, are reported to have said: When one offers, after the obligatory Zohr Prayer on Fridays, a two-unit prayer and after accomplishment says this supplicatory prayer, one will be saved against all misfortunes and seditious matters up to the next Friday, and will be joined with Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him and his Household, and Prophet Abraham, peace be upon him.

Sahifah duas: Thus was Imam Zayn al-’Abidin (a.s.) used to do.

A_J8.name: Aamal of Asr on Friday

segs.note: Salawat ×100
segs.ur: صلوات ×100

segs.note: After the Asr prayer on Friday, recite 100 times:
segs.ur: جمعہ کے دن نماز عصر کے بعد 100 مرتبہ پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ
segs.en: O Allah, bless Mohammad and the family of Mohammad and hasten their relief.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WA A’JJIL FARA-JAHUM.

segs.note: Shaykh al-Tusi also recommends reciting this 100 times at the same time:
segs.ur: شیخ طوسی یہ بھی سفارش کرتے ہیں کہ اسی وقت اسے 100 مرتبہ پڑھیں:

segs.en: The blessings of Allah, His angels, His prophets, His messengers,
segs.tr: SALAWAATUL LAAHE WA MALAA-EKATEHI WA ANBEYAAA-EHI WA ROSOLEHI

segs.ar: وَجَمِيْعِ خَلْقِهٖ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: and all of His creation be upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad;
segs.tr: WA JAMEE-A’ KHALQEHI A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: and peace be upon him and upon them,
and upon their souls and their bodies,
and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.

segs.note: Salawat of the Awsiya
segs.ur: اوصیاء کی صلوات

segs.note: After the Asr prayer on Friday, recite 7 times (or 10):
segs.ur: جمعہ کے دن نماز عصر کے بعد 7 مرتبہ (یا 10 مرتبہ) پڑھیں:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍۨ
segs.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MHAMMADENIL

segs.en: with the most excellent of Your blessings;
and shower them with the most excellent of Your favors;
and peace be upon them and upon their souls
segs.tr: WAS SALAAMO A’LAYHIM WA A’LAA ARWAAHEHIM

segs.en: and their bodies, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.
segs.tr: WA AJSAADEHIM WA RAHMATUL LAAHE WA BARAKAATOHU.

segs.note: Al-Kafi records it in this form:
segs.ur: الکافی نے اسے اس صورت میں نقل کیا ہے:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍۨ
segs.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIN WA AALE MHAMMADENIL

segs.en: with the most excellent of Your blessings;
and shower them with the most excellent of Your favors;
and peace be upon him and them
and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.

segs.note: Istighfar, al-Qadr & Asharat
segs.ur: استغفار، قدر اور عشرات

segs.note: After the Asr prayer, recite 70 times:
segs.ur: نماز عصر کے بعد 70 مرتبہ پڑھیں:

segs.en: I seek forgiveness from Allah, my Lord, and I turn to Him in repentance.
segs.tr: ASTAGHFERUL LAAHA RABBEE WA ATOOBO ELAYHE

segs.note: Recite Surah al-Qadr 100 times.
segs.ur: [سورہ قدر](A101) 100 مرتبہ پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Recite Dua Asharat.
segs.ur: [دعائے عشرات](E10) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Last Hour before Sunset
segs.ur: غروب آفتاب سے پہلے کا آخری گھنٹہ

segs.note: The last hour of Friday, until sunset, is the hour in which prayers are answered, so pray insistently then. Recite this litany, reported from the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.):
segs.ur: جمعہ کے دن کی آخری گھڑی، غروبِ آفتاب تک، دعا کی قبولیت کی گھڑی ہے، لہٰذا اس وقت اصرار کے ساتھ دعا کریں۔ نبی (ص) سے روایت شدہ یہ ذکر پڑھیں:

segs.en: Glory be to You, there is no god but You,
O All-Affectionate, O Bestower of Favors,
O Originator of the heavens and the earth,
O Lord of Majesty and Honor.

segs.note: Recite Dua Simat.
segs.ur: [دعائے سمات](E26) پڑھیں۔

A_J8.merits:
It has been narrated that the best hours of Fridays are these coming after the Asr Prayer.

Salawat of the Awsiya: The reverent scholar, Ibn Idris, has quoted in his book entitled al-Sara’ir that it has been recorded in the book of Jami’ complied by al-Bazanti on the authority of Abu Baseer that Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s.) has said: To invoke Almighty Allah’s blessings upon the Prophet and his Household in the time between the Zohr and Asr Prayers (on Fridays) is equal (in reward) to seventy times of Hajj Pilgrimage. Moreover, one who says this invocation after the Asr Prayer on Fridays will be awarded the reward of the righteous deeds of all men and jinn on that day.

Books of master scholars of Hadith have authentically narrated great rewards for saying this invocation. However, it is better to repeat it seven times and even ten times. In this respect, Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s.) is reported as saying: One who repeats this invocation ten times immediately after the Asr Prayer on Fridays will receive the blessings of the angels up to the next Friday and the very hour. The Imam (a.s.) is also reported as saying: When you offer the Asr Prayer on Friday, repeat this invocation afterward seven times.

In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni has narrated: When you accomplish the Asr Prayer on Friday, say this invocation, for if one says it at that time, Almighty Allah will record for him one hundred thousand rewards, erase one hundred thousand of his evildoings, grant him one hundred thousand requests, and elevate him one hundred thousand ranks. He adds that if one repeats the same invocation seven times, Almighty Allah will give him rewards as many as His servants, accept his deeds on that day, and place light between his eyes on the Resurrection Day.

Istighfar: It is recommended to repeat it seventy times after the Asr Prayer so that sins will be forgiven.

Surah al-Qadr: Imam Musa al-Kazim (a.s.) is reported as saying: On Fridays, Almighty Allah has one thousand gifts of mercy. He grants a servant whatever number He wills. Thus, He grants the servant who recites Surah al-Qadr one hundred times after the Asr Prayer on Fridays all these gifts and their like.

The last hour: Shaykh al-Tusi has mentioned that the last hour of Friday, which lasts to sunset, is the hour in which prayers are responded. It has been also narrated that this hour begins when half of the sun disk sets and the other half only remains visible. Lady Fatimah al-Zahra’, peace be upon her, used to pray Almighty Allah at this hour so that her prayers be answered.

segs.note: Imam al-Hasan al-Askari (a.s.) is also reported to have said that whoever offers on Fridays a four unit prayer; reciting in each unit Surah al-Faatehah, Surah al-Mulk, and Surah Fusselat (No. 41), Almighty Allah will allow him Paradise, grant him the right to intercede for his household, and guard him against the grave pressure and the horrors on the Resurrection Day.
segs.ur: امام حسن عسکری (ع) سے یہ بھی روایت ہے کہ آپ نے فرمایا: جو شخص جمعہ کے دنوں میں چار رکعت نماز پڑھے، ہر رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5)، [سورہ ملک](A71) اور [سورہ فصلت](A45) (نمبر 41) پڑھے، اللہ تعالیٰ اسے جنت میں داخل کرے گا، اسے اپنے اہل خانہ کی شفاعت کا حق عطا کرے گا اور اسے فشارِ قبر اور قیامت کے دن کی ہولناکیوں سے محفوظ رکھے گا۔

segs.note: When the reporter asked Imam al-Askari (a.s.) about the best time of offering these prayers, the Imam (a.s.) answered, “The best time is the period between sunrise and midday (zohr).”
segs.ur: جب راوی نے امام عسکری (ع) سے ان نمازوں کے پڑھنے کے بہترین وقت کے بارے میں پوچھا تو امام (ع) نے جواب دیا، “بہترین وقت طلوع آفتاب اور ظہر کے درمیان کا وقت ہے۔”

A_P1.name: Recommended Rites of Friday Night (Shab-e-Jumu'ah)

segs.note: Glorification, Salawat and Istighfar
segs.ur: تسبیح، صلوات اور استغفار

segs.note: From Thursday after the Asr prayer until the end of Friday, repeat often:
segs.ur: جمعرات کو نمازِ عصر کے بعد سے جمعہ کے اختتام تک کثرت سے کہیں:

segs.en: All Glory be to Allah.
Allah is the Most Great.
There is no god save Allah.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.note: On Friday night, recite the salawat at least 100 times; the more, the better.
segs.ur: جمعہ کی رات کم از کم 100 مرتبہ صلوات پڑھیں؛ جتنی زیادہ ہو اتنا بہتر ہے۔

segs.note: From Thursday afternoon until the last hour of Friday, recite 1,000 times (Shaykh al-Tusi’s form):
segs.ur: جمعرات کی سہ پہر سے جمعہ کی آخری گھڑی تک 1,000 مرتبہ پڑھیں (شیخ طوسی کی صورت):

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.en: hasten their Relief,
and destroy their enemies
from both jinn and human beings,
both the foremost and the later ones.

segs.note: In the last hour of Thursday, recite this prayer of forgiveness (Shaykh al-Tusi):
segs.ur: جمعرات کی آخری ساعت میں یہ دعائے استغفار پڑھیں (شیخ طوسی):

segs.ar: اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ
segs.en: I pray the forgiveness of Allah; there is no god but He,
segs.tr: ASTAGHFIRULLAAHAL LADHEE LAA ILAAHA ILLAA HUW

segs.en: the Ever-living, the Self-Subsisting,
and I repent to Him
as a slave who is submissive,
acquiescent, and poor,

segs.ar: لَا يَسْتَطِيْعُ لِنَفْسِهٖ صَرْفاً وَلَا عَدْلاً
segs.en: not controlling for himself any harm or profit,
segs.tr: LAA YASTATEE'U LINAFSIHEE SARFAN WA LAA A'DLAA

segs.en: or benefit or damage
segs.tr: WA LAA NAF'AN WA LAA DARRAA

segs.ar: وَلَا حَيَاةً وَلَا مَوْتاً وَلَا نُشُوْرًا
segs.en: and not controlling death nor life, nor raising (the dead) to life.
segs.tr: WA LAA HAYAATAN WA LAA MAWTAN WA LAA NUSHOORAA

segs.en: May Allah send peace upon Muhammad
and his Household; the pure, the immaculate,
the choicest, and the pious;
and may He spread thorough blessings over them.

segs.note: Surahs of the Night
segs.ur: رات کی سورتیں

segs.note: On Friday night, recite these surahs:
segs.ur: جمعہ کی رات یہ سورتیں پڑھیں:

segs.note: Surah al-Isra
segs.ur: [سورہ اسراء](A21)

segs.note: Surah al-Kahf
segs.ur: [سورہ کہف](A22)

segs.note: Surah al-Shu'ara
segs.ur: [سورہ شعراء](A30)

segs.note: Surah al-Naml
segs.ur: [سورہ نمل](A31)

segs.note: Surah al-Qasas
segs.ur: [سورہ قصص](A32)

segs.note: Surah al-Sajdah
segs.ur: [سورہ سجدہ](A36)

segs.note: Surah Ya-Sin
segs.ur: [سورہ یاسین](A40)

segs.note: Surah Sad
segs.ur: [سورہ ص](A42)

segs.note: Surah al-Ahqaf
segs.ur: [سورہ احقاف](A50)

segs.note: Surah al-Waqi'ah
segs.ur: [سورہ واقعہ](A60)

segs.note: Surah Fussilat
segs.ur: [سورہ فصلت](A45)

segs.note: Surah al-Dukhan
segs.ur: [سورہ دخان](A48)

segs.note: Surah al-Tur
segs.ur: [سورہ طور](A56)

segs.note: Surah al-Qamar
segs.ur: [سورہ قمر](A58)

segs.note: Surah al-Jumu'ah
segs.ur: [سورہ جمعہ](A66)

segs.note: If there is not enough time, recite Surah al-Waqi'ah and the surahs before it in this list.
segs.ur: اگر وقت کم ہو تو [سورہ واقعہ](A60) اور اس فہرست میں اس سے پہلے والی سورتیں پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Prayers and Other Acts of the Night
segs.ur: رات کی نمازیں اور دیگر اعمال

segs.note: Offer many nafilah prayers on Friday night, such as the Prayer of Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.).
segs.ur: جمعہ کی رات بہت سی نفل نمازیں پڑھیں، جیسے [نمازِ امیرالمومنین (ع)](F15)۔

segs.note: Pray 2 units; in each unit recite Surah al-Fatihah once and Surah al-Zalzalah 15 times.
segs.ur: 2 رکعت نماز پڑھیں؛ ہر رکعت میں ایک مرتبہ [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) اور 15 مرتبہ [سورہ زلزال](A103) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: In the first unit of the Maghrib and Isha obligatory prayers, recite Surah al-Jumu'ah. In the second unit, recite Surah al-Tawhid (Maghrib) or Surah al-A'la (Isha).
segs.ur: مغرب اور عشا کی واجب نمازوں کی پہلی رکعت میں [سورہ جمعہ](A66) پڑھیں۔ دوسری رکعت میں [سورہ توحید](A116) (مغرب) یا [سورہ اعلیٰ](A91) (عشا) پڑھیں۔

segs.note: Avoid reciting poetry on Friday night.
segs.ur: شبِ جمعہ میں شعر پڑھنے سے پرہیز کریں.

segs.note: Pray often for your brethren-in-faith, following the example of Lady Fatimah al-Zahra (s.a.).
segs.ur: حضرت فاطمہ زہرا (س) کی پیروی میں اپنے دینی بھائیوں کے لیے کثرت سے دعا کریں۔

segs.note: Eat a pomegranate on Friday night, preferably before going to sleep, following Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s.).
segs.ur: شبِ جمعہ، بہتر ہے کہ سونے سے پہلے، امام جعفر صادق (ع) کی پیروی میں انار کھائیں۔

segs.note: Spread a cloth on the ground so as to save every seed of the pomegranate and eat them all; do not share it with anyone.
segs.ur: زمین پر کپڑا بچھائیں تاکہ انار کا ہر دانہ محفوظ رہے اور سب کھا لیں؛ اسے کسی کے ساتھ شریک نہ کریں۔

segs.note: Last Prostration of the Isha Nafilah
segs.ur: نافلۂ عشا کا آخری سجدہ

segs.note: In the last prostration of the Isha nafilah on Friday night (desirably every night), recite 7 times:
segs.ur: شب جمعہ کو (اور بہتر ہے کہ ہر رات) عشا کی نافلہ کے آخری سجدے میں 7 مرتبہ پڑھیں:

segs.en: O Allah, I beseech You in the name of Your Noble Face
and in the name of Your Sublime Name
to send blessings to Muhammad and his Household
segs.tr: AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.en: and to forgive me my grave sin.
segs.tr: WA AN TAGHFIRA LEE DHANBIYAL A'ZEEM

segs.note: Dua Allahumma Anta Rabbi
segs.ur: دعا اللهم انت ربی

segs.note: On Friday night, or during Friday, recite 7 times:
segs.ur: جمعہ کی رات یا جمعہ کے دن کے دوران 7 مرتبہ پڑھیں:

segs.en: O Allah, You are my Lord;
there is no god save You;
You have created me, and I am Your slave and the son of Your bondmaid;
segs.tr: KHALAQTANEE WA ANAA A'BDUKA WABNU AMATIK

segs.en: and I am in Your grip; and my forehead is in Your Hand;
segs.tr: WA FEE QABDATIKA WA NAASIYATEE BIYADIK

segs.ar: اَمْسَيْتُ عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ
segs.en: I come to observe my covenant and promise to You as much as I can.
segs.tr: AMSAYTU A'LAA A'HDIKA WA WA'DIKA MAS TATA'T

segs.ar: اَعُوْذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ
segs.en: I take refuge in Your pleasure against the evil of my deeds.
segs.tr: A'OODHU BIRIDAAKA MIN SHARRI MAA SANA'T

segs.en: I acknowledge Your favors and confess of my sins.
So, (please) forgive my sins,

segs.ar: اِنَّهٗ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ
segs.en: for none can forgive sins save You.
segs.tr: INNAHOO LAA YAGHFIRUDH DHUNOOBA ILLAA ANT

segs.note: Dua Allahumma Man Ta'abba'a
segs.ur: دعا اللهم من تعبّأ

segs.note: On Fridays and Friday nights, and on the day and night of Arafah (9 Dhul Hijjah), recite:
segs.ur: جمعہ کے دنوں اور راتوں میں، اور عرفہ کے دن اور رات (9 ذی الحجہ) میں پڑھیں:

segs.en: O Allah, One may call up, prepare,
ready oneself, and stand prepared
for purpose of coming to a creature
in the hope of gaining his aid
and asking for his gift and present.
As for myself, to You—O my Lord—I make my preparations and readiness
hoping for Your pardon
and asking for Your gift and present.
So, (please) do not disappoint my entreaty.

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ لَا يَخِيْبُ عَلَيْهِ سَائِلٌ
segs.en: O He Who never disappoints His beseechers
segs.tr: YAA MAN LAA YAKHEEBU A'LAYHI SAA'IL

segs.en: and Whose prizes never decrease His ample-giving!

segs.ar: فَاِنِّيْ لَمْ اٰتِكَ ثِقَةً بِعَمَلٍ صَالِحٍ عَمِلْتُهٗ
segs.en: I have not come to You with confidence of a righteous deed that I have done
segs.tr: FA-INNEE LAM AATIKA THIQATAN BI-A'MALIN SAALIHIN A'MILTUH

segs.en: nor have I had any hope in a grant of any creature.

segs.ar: اَتَيْتُكَ مُقِرّاً عَلَىٰ نَفْسِيْ بِالْاِسَاءَةِ وَالظُّلْمِ
segs.en: Rather, I have come to You professing myself to be evildoer and transgressor
segs.tr: ATAYTUKA MUQIRRAN A'LAA NAFSEE BIL ISAA'ATI WAZ ZULM

segs.ar: مُعْتَرِفاً بِاَنْ لَّا حُجَّةَ لِيْ وَلَا عُذْرَ
segs.en: and confessing that I lack any pretext or excuse.
segs.tr: MU'TARIFAN BI-AL LAA HUJJATA LEE WA LAA U'DHR

segs.en: I have come to You hoping for Your great pardon
due to which You have pardoned the wrongdoers.

segs.ar: فَلَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ طُوْلُ عُكُوْفِهِمْ عَلِي عَظِيْمِ الْجُرْمِ
segs.en: Hence, their long-lasting retirement to their grave offenses has not prevented You
segs.tr: FALAM YAMNA'KA TOOLU U'KOOFIHIM A'LEE A'ZEEMIL JURM

segs.en: from turning to them with mercy.
O He Whose mercy is huge
and Whose pardon is great;

segs.ar: يَا عَظِيمُ يَا عَظِيمُ يَا عَظِيمُ
segs.en: O All-great, O All-great, O All-great;
segs.tr: YAA A'ZEEMU YAA A'ZEEMU YAA A'ZEEM

segs.en: nothing can repel Your rage except Your forbearance

segs.ar: وَلَا يُنْجِيْ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ اِلَّا التَّضَرُّعُ اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: and nothing can save from Your wrath except imploring earnestly to You.
segs.tr: WA LAA YUNJEE MIN SAKHATIKA ILLAT TADARRU'U ILAYK

segs.en: So, my God, (please) grant me a relief

segs.ar: بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتِي تُحْيِيْ بِهَا مَيْتَ الْبِلَادِ
segs.en: in the name of the power through which You restore to life the derelict lands,
segs.tr: BIL QUDRATIL LATEE TUHYEE BIHAA MAYTAL BILAAD

segs.ar: وَلَا تُهْلِكْنِيْ غَمّاً حَتَّىٰ تَسْتَجِيْبَ لِيْ
segs.en: and do not cause me to perish out of grief until You respond to me
segs.tr: WA LAA TUHLIKNEE GHAMMAN HATTAA TASTAJEEBA LEE

segs.en: and show me signs of Your response to my prayers.

segs.ar: وَاَذِقْنِي طَعْمَ الْعَافِيَةِ اِلَىٰ مُنْتَهٰى اَجَلِيْ
segs.en: (please) Make me taste the flavor of wellbeing up to the end of my lifetime,
segs.tr: WA ADHIQNEE TA'MAL A'AFIYATI ILAA MUNTAHAA AJALEE

segs.en: do not make my enemies gloat over me,
do not give them a hand over me,
and do not make them control over me.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ اِنْ وَضَعْتَنِيْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَرْفَعُنِي
segs.en: O Allah, If You humiliate me, who can then exalt me?
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA IN WADA'TANEE FAMAN DHAL LADHEE YARFA'UNEE

segs.ar: وَاِنْ رَفَعْتَنِيْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَضَعُنِيْ
segs.en: And if You exalt me, who can then humiliate me?
segs.tr: WA IN RAFA'TANEE FAMAN DHAL LADHEE YADA'UNEE

segs.ar: وَاِنْ اَهْلَكْتَنِيْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَعْرِضُ لَكَ فِي عَبْدِكَ
segs.en: If You annihilate me, who can then interfere before You concerning the affair of me—Your slave
segs.tr: WA IN AHLAKTANEE FAMAN DHAL LADHEE YA'RIDU LAKA FEE A'BDIK

segs.en: or who can intercede to ask You about it?

segs.ar: وَقَدْ عَلِمْتُ اَنَّهٗ لَيْسَ فِي حُكْمِكَ ظُلْمٌ
segs.en: I have already known for sure that Your decrees are devoid of injustice
segs.tr: WA QAD A'LIMTU ANNAHOO LAYSA FEE HUKMIKA ZULM

segs.en: and Your punishment does not count on immediateness.
Verily, immediateness is the work of him who fears lest he may miss,
segs.tr: WA INNAMAA YA'JALU MAN YAKHAAFUL FAWT

segs.en: and only do the weak need injustice.
segs.tr: WA INNAMAA YAHTAAJU ILAZ ZULMID DA'EEF

segs.ar: وَقَدْ تَعَالَيْتَ يَا اِلٰهِي عَنْ ذٰلِكَ عُلُوّاً كَبِيراً
segs.en: As for You, O my God, You are too exalted to be so—Exalted and Great You are beyond all measure!
segs.tr: WA QAD TA'AALAYTA YAA ILAAHEE A'N DHAALIKA U'LUWWAN KABEERAA

segs.en: O Allah, I take refuge in You; so, (please) have protection upon me!
I call for Your safekeeping; so, (please) keep me under Your security!
I appeal for Your sustenance; so, (please) provide me with sustenance!
I put trust in You; so, (please) keep me under Your supervision!
I call for Your aid against my enemy; so, (please) grant me support!
I seek Your assistance; so, (please) assist me!
I ask for Your forgiveness; so, (please) forgive me.
segs.tr: WA ASTAGHFIRUKA YAA ILAAHEE FAGHFIR LEE

segs.en: So, respond! Respond! Respond!

segs.note: Dua Ya Shahida Kulli Najwa
segs.ur: دعا یا شاہد کل نجویٰ

segs.note: On Friday nights and on the night of Arafah, recite:
segs.ur: جمعہ کی راتوں اور شبِ عرفہ میں پڑھیں:

segs.en: O Allah Who witnesses all secrets of hearts,
Who is the object of all complaints,
Who knows all hidden things,
and Who is the aim of all needs!
O He Who instigates favoring on the Servants!
segs.tr: YAA MUBTADI'AN BIN NI'AMI A'LAL I'BAAD

segs.en: O He Who is All-generous in pardoning!
O He Who is All-excellent in overlooking!
O All-magnanimous!

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ لَا يُوَارِيْ مِنْهُ لَيْلٌ دَاجٍ
segs.en: O He Who cannot be concealed by the covering darkness of night,
segs.tr: YAA MAN LAA YUWAAREE MINHU LAYLUN DAAJ

segs.en: the roaring clamor of oceans,
the skies along with their constellations,
or the thunderous murk.
O He with Whom the entire murk is light,
I beseech You in the name of the brightness of Your Noble Face

segs.ar: الَّذِي تَجَلَّيْتَ بِهٖ لِلْجَبَلِ فَجَعَلْتَهٗ دَكّاً
segs.en: through which You manifested Your glory to the mountain; so, You made it crumble
segs.tr: ALLADHEE TAJALLAYTA BIHEE LIL JABALI FAJA'ALTAHOO DAKKAA

segs.en: and (Prophet) Moses fell down in a swoon,

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي رَفَعْتَ بِهٖ السَّمَاوَاتِ بِلَا عَمَدٍ
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which You raised the heavens without any pillars
segs.tr: WA BISMIKAL LADHEE RAFA'TA BIHIS SAMAAWAATI BILAA A'MAD

segs.ar: وَسَطَحْتَ بِهٖ الْاَرْضَ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِ مَاءٍ جَمَدٍ
segs.en: and by which You flattened the earth on the surface of solid water,
segs.tr: WA SATAHTA BIHIL ARDA A'LAA WAJHI MAA'IN JAMAD

segs.en: in the name of Your Name—the concealed, the stored,
the scribed, and the pure,
which You answer any one who beseeches You in its name
and grant any one who asks You his request,
in the name of Your Name; the Praised, Holy, and Demonstrative,

segs.ar: الَّذِي هُوَ نُوْرٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نُوْرٍ
segs.en: which is light over the entire light,
segs.tr: ALLADHEE HUWA NOORUN A'LAA KULLI NOOR

segs.en: which is light made of light,
and from which all lights take their brightness;
if it reaches the earth, it will be rent asunder,
if it reaches the heavens, they will be opened,
and if it reaches the throne, it will quiver;

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي تَرْتَعِدُ مِنْهُ فَرَائِصُ مَلَاۤئِكَتِكَ
segs.en: and in the name of Your Name from the fear of which the muscles of Your angels tremble.
segs.tr: WA BISMIKAL LADHEE TARTA'IDU MINHU FARAA'ISU MALAA'IKATIK

segs.en: I beseech You in the name of [Archangels] Gabriel, Michael, and Seraph,
segs.tr: WA AS'ALUKA BIHAQQI JABRAA'EELA WA MEEKAA'EELA WA ISRAAFEEL

segs.en: in the name of Muhammad, the Divinely-chosen Prophet,
peace be upon him, his Household,
and all prophets and angels;
segs.tr: WA A'LAA JAMEE'IL ANBIYAA'I WA JAMEE'IL MALAA'IKAH

segs.ar: وَبِالْاِسْمِ الَّذِي مَشَىٰ بِهٖ الْخِضْرُ عَلَىٰ قُلَلِ الْمَاءِ
segs.en: in the name of the Name through which al-Khadir could walk on waters
segs.tr: WA BIL ISMIL LADHEE MASHAA BIHIL KHIDRU A'LAA QULALIL MAA'

segs.ar: كَمَا مَشَىٰ بِهٖ عَلَىٰ جَدَدِ الْاَرْضِ
segs.en: just as he used to walk on lands;
segs.tr: KAMAA MASHAA BIHEE A'LAA JADADIL ARD

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي فَلَقْتَ بِهٖ الْبَحْرَ لِمُوسَىٰ
segs.en: in the name of You Name through which You caused the sea to cleave asunder for Moses,
segs.tr: WA BISMIKAL LADHEE FALAQTA BIHIL BAHRA LIMOOSAA

segs.en: You drowned Pharaoh and his people,

segs.ar: وَاَنْجَيْتَ بِهٖ مُوسَىٰ بْنَ عِمْرَانَ وَمَنْ مَعَهٗ
segs.en: and saved Moses, the son of 'Imran, and those who accompanied him;
segs.tr: WA ANJAYTA BIHEE MOOSABNA I'MRAANA WA MAN MA'AH

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي دَعَاكَ بِهٖ مُوسَىٰ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which Moses, the son of 'Imran, besought You
segs.tr: WA BISMIKAL LADHEE DA'AAKA BIHEE MOOSABNU I'MRAAN

segs.en: from the right slope of the Mount;

segs.ar: فَاسْتَجَبْتَ لَهٗ وَالْقَيْتَ عَلَيْهِ مَحَبَّةً مِنْكَ
segs.en: so, You responded to him and cast down upon him love from You;
segs.tr: FASTAJABTA LAHOO WAL QAYTA A'LAYHI MAHABBATAN MINK

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي بِهٖ اَحْيَا عِيسَىٰ بْنُ مَرْيَمَ الْمَوْتَىٰ
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which Jesus, the son of Mary, brought life to the dead,
segs.tr: WA BISMIKAL LADHEE BIHEE AHYAA I'EESABNU MARYAMAL MAWTAA

segs.en: could speak while he was a child in the cradle,
and healed the blind and the leprous by Your permission;
segs.tr: WA ABRA'UL AKMAHA WAL ABRASA BI-IDHNIK

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي دَعَاكَ بِهٖ حَمَلَةُ عَرْشِكَ
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which the bearers of Your Throne besought You
segs.tr: WA BISMIKAL LADHEE DA'AAKA BIHEE HAMALATU A'RSHIK

segs.en: and so did Gabriel, Michael, Seraph,
segs.tr: WA JABRAA'EELU WA MEEKAA'EELU WA ISRAAFEEL

segs.ar: وَحَبِيبُكَ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّىٰ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهٖ
segs.en: Muhammad Your most beloved one (peace be upon him and upon his Household)
segs.tr: WA HABEEBUKA MUHAMMADUN SALLALLAAHU A'LAYHI WA AALIH

segs.en: Your favorite angels,
Your messaged Prophets,

segs.ar: وَعِبَادُكَ الصَّالِحُونَ مِنْ اَهْلِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْاَرَضِينَ
segs.en: and Your righteous servants from among the inhabitants of the heavens and the layers of the earth;
segs.tr: WA I'BAADUKAS SAALIHOONA MIN AHLIS SAMAAWAATI WAL ARADEEN

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي دَعَاكَ بِهٖ ذُوْ النُّونِ
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which Dhu’l-Nun (Prophet Jonah) besought You
segs.tr: WA BISMIKAL LADHEE DA'AAKA BIHEE DHUN NOON

segs.ar: اِذْ ذَهَبَ مُغَاضِباً فَظَنَّ اَنْ لَنْ تَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ
segs.en: when he departed in wrath: he imagined that You had no power over him,
segs.tr: IDH DHAHABA MUGHAADIBAN FAZANNA AN LAN TAQDIRA A'LAYH

segs.ar: فَنَادَىٰ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ اَنْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ
segs.en: but he cried through the depths of darkness, “There is no god but You. Glory be to You.
segs.tr: FANAADAA FIZ ZULUMAATI AN LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA SUBHAANAK

segs.en: I was indeed one of those who are wrong!”
So, You responded to him and delivered him from the grief
segs.tr: FASTAJABTA LAHOO WA NAJJAYTAHOO MINAL GHAMM

segs.en: and thus do You deliver the believers;

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيمِ الَّذِي دَعَاكَ بِهٖ دَاوُودُ
segs.en: in the name of Your Great Name by which David besought You
segs.tr: WA BISMIKAL A'ZEEMIL LADHEE DA'AAKA BIHEE DAAWOOD

segs.ar: وَخَرَّ لَكَ سَاجِداً فَغَفَرْتَ لَهٗ ذَنْبَهٗ
segs.en: and as he fell down prostrating himself to You, You rectified it for him;
segs.tr: WA KHARRA LAKA SAAJIDAN FAGHAFARTA LAHOO DHANBAH

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي دَعَتْكَ بِهٖ اٰسِيَةُ امْرَاَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which Asiyah, the wife of Pharaoh, besought You,
segs.tr: WA BISMIKAL LADHEE DA'ATKA BIHEE AASIYATUM RA'ATU FIR'AWN

segs.ar: اِذْ قَالَتْ: ”رَبِّ ابْنِ لِيْ عِنْدَكَ بَيْتاً فِي الْجَنَّةِ
segs.en: saying, “My Lord! Build for me a house with You in Paradise,
segs.tr: IDH QAALAT RABBIBNI LEE I'NDAKA BAYTAN FIL JANNAH

segs.en: deliver me from Pharaoh and his doing,
segs.tr: WA NAJJINEE MIN FIR'AWNA WA A'MALIH

segs.en: and deliver me from the unjust people.”
So, You responded to her prayer;

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي دَعَاكَ بِهٖ اَيُّوْبُ اِذْ حَلَّ بِهٖ الْبَلَاءُ
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which (Prophet) Job besought You after misfortune had befallen him;
segs.tr: WA BISMIKAL LADHEE DA'AAKA BIHEE AYYOOBU IDH HALLA BIHIL BALAA'

segs.en: so, You healed him and gave him his family and the like of them with them:
segs.tr: FA'AAFAYTAHOO WA AATAYTAHOO AHLAHOO WA MITHLAHUM MA'AHUM

segs.en: a mercy from You and a reminder to the worshippers;
segs.tr: RAHMATAN MIN I'NDIKA WA DHIKRAA LIL A'ABIDEEN

segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which (Prophet) Jacob besought You;
segs.tr: WA BISMIKAL LADHEE DA'AAKA BIHEE YA'QOOB

segs.ar: فَرَدَدْتَ عَلَيْهِ بَصَرَهٗ وَقُرَّةَ عَيْنِهٖ يُوْسُفَ وَجَمَعْتَ شَمْلَهٗ
segs.en: so, You returned to him his sight and the delight of his heart, Joseph, and You reunified him.
segs.tr: FARADADTA A'LAYHI BASARAHOO WA QURRATA A'YNIHEE YOOSUFA WA JAMA'TA SHAMLAH

segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which (Prophet) Solomon besought You;
segs.tr: WA BISMIKAL LADHEE DA'AAKA BIHEE SULAYMAAN

segs.ar: فَوَهَبْتَ لَهٗ مُلْكاً لَا يَنْبَغِيْ لِاَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِهٖ
segs.en: So, You gifted him kingdom that none else should never gain,
segs.tr: FAWAHABTA LAHOO MULKAN LAA YANBAGHEE LI-AHADIN MIN BA'DIH

segs.en: for You are verily the Granter of bounties;

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي سَخَّرْتَ بِهٖ الْبُرَاقَ لِمُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which You subdued the Buraq to Muhammad,
segs.tr: WA BISMIKAL LADHEE SAKHKHARTA BIHIL BURAAQA LIMUHAMMAD

segs.en: peace and blessings be upon him and his Household,
segs.tr: SALLALLAAHU A'LAYHI WA AALIHEE WA SALLAM

segs.ar: اِذْ قَالَ تَعَالَىٰ: ”سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي اَسْرٰى بِعَبْدِهٖ لَيْلاً
segs.en: as Almighty Allah says, “Glory be to Him Who made His servant to go on a night
segs.tr: IDH QAALA TA'AALAA SUBHAANAL LADHEE ASRAA BI-A'BDIHEE LAYLAA

segs.ar: مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ اِلَىٰ الْمَسْجِدِ الْاَقْصَىٰ“
segs.en: from the Sacred Mosque to the remote mosque.”
segs.tr: MINAL MASJIDIL HARAAMI ILAL MASJIDIL AQSAA

segs.ar: وَقَوْلُهٗ: ”سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهٗ مُقْرِنِيْنَ
segs.en: He also says, “Glory be to Him Who made this subservient to us and we were not able to do it.
segs.tr: WA QAWLUHOO SUBHAANAL LADHEE SAKHKHARA LANAA HAADHAA WA MAA KUNNAA LAHOO MUQRINEEN

segs.en: Surely, to our Lord we must return;”

segs.ar: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي تَنَزَّلَ بِهٖ جَبْرَائِيلُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: in the name of Your Name by which (Archangel) Gabriel used to ascend to Muhammad,
segs.tr: WA BISMIKAL LADHEE TANAZZALA BIHEE JABRAA'EELU A'LAA MUHAMMAD

segs.en: peace be upon him and his Household;
and in the name of Your Name by which Adam besought You;
segs.tr: WA BISMIKAL LADHEE DA'AAKA BIHEE AADAM

segs.en: so, You rectified him and allowed him to dwell in Your Paradise.
segs.tr: FAGHAFARTA LAHOO DHANBAHOO WA ASKANTAHOO JANNATAK

segs.en: I beseech You in the name of the Great Qur'an,
in the name of Muhammad, the Seal of the Prophets,
in the name of Abraham,
in the name of Your Judgment on the Day of the Administration of Justice,
in the name of the Scales when they shall be set up,
the Scrolls when they shall be laid open,
the Pen and whatever has been decided,
segs.tr: WA BIHAQQIL QALAMI WA MAA JARAA

segs.en: and the Tablet and whatever it has recorded;

segs.ar: وَبِحَقِّ الْاِسْمِ الَّذِي كَتَبْتَهٗ عَلَىٰ سُرَادِقِ الْعَرْشِ
segs.en: in the name of the Name that You had inscribed on the pavilion of the Divine Throne
segs.tr: WA BIHAQQIL ISMIL LADHEE KATABTAHOO A'LAA SURAADIQIL A'RSH

segs.en: two thousand years before You created the beings, the world,
the sun, and the moon.
segs.tr: WASH SHAMSA WAL QAMARA BI-ALFAY A'AM

segs.ar: وَاَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللَّهُ
segs.en: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah,
segs.tr: WA ASH-HADU AN LAA ILAAHA ILLALLAAH

segs.en: alone without having any partner,
and that Muhammad is his servant and messenger.
segs.tr: WA ANNA MUHAMMADAN A'BDUHOO WA RASOOLUH

segs.en: I beseech You in the name of Your Name that is hoarded in Your stores,
segs.tr: WA AS'ALUKA BISMIKAL MAKHZOONI FEE KHAZAA'INIK

segs.ar: الَّذِي اسْتَاْثَرْتَ بِهٖ فِيْ عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ
segs.en: You have kept in the knowledge of the Unseen with You
segs.tr: ALLADHIS TA'THARTA BIHEE FEE I'LMIL GHAYBI I'NDAK

segs.ar: لَمْ يَظْهَرْ عَلَيْهِ اَحَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segs.en: and it has not been shown to any of Your creatures,
segs.tr: LAM YAZHAR A'LAYHI AHADUN MIN KHALQIK

segs.en: be him a favorite angel,
a missioned Prophet,
or a chosen servant.

segs.ar: وَاَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي شَقَقْتَ بِهٖ الْبِحَارَ
segs.en: I beseech You in the name of Your Name by which You rent asunder the oceans,
segs.tr: WA AS'ALUKA BISMIKAL LADHEE SHAQAQTA BIHIL BIHAAR

segs.en: the mountains rose,
and night and day follow each other,
in the name of the seven of the oft-repeated verses and the Grand Qur'an,
segs.tr: WA BIHAQQIS SAB'IL MATHAANEE WAL QUR'AANIL A'ZEEM

segs.en: in the name of the noble, recording angels,
in the name of Ta-Ha, Ya-Sin, Kaf-Ha-Ya-'Ayn-Sad,
segs.tr: WA BIHAQQI TAA HAA WA YAA SEEN WA KAAAF HAA YAA A'YN SAAAD

segs.en: Ha-Mim-'Ayn-Sin-Qaf,
segs.tr: WA HAA MEEM A'YN SEEN QAAAF

segs.en: and in the name of the Torah of Moses,
the Gospel of Jesus,
the Psalms of David,
the Furqan (Criterion) of Muhammad,
peace be upon him, his Household,
and all the messengers and bahiyya sharahiyya.
segs.tr: WA A'LAA JAMEE'IR RUSULI WA BAAHIYYAN SHARAAHIYYAA

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْۤ اَسْاَلُكَ بِحَقِّ تِلْكَ الْمُنَاجَاةِ
segs.en: O Allah, I beseech You in the name of this confidential talk
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS'ALUKA BIHAQQI TILKAL MUNAAJAAH

segs.ar: الَّتِي كَانَتْ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ مُوسَىٰ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ
segs.en: which took place between You and Moses, the son of 'Imran,
segs.tr: ALLATEE KAANAT BAYNAKA WA BAYNA MOOSABNI I'MRAAN

segs.en: on the Mount Tur Sayna',

segs.ar: وَاَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي عَلَّمْتَهٗ مَلَكَ الْمَوْتِ لِقَبْضِ الْاَرْوَاحِ
segs.en: I beseech You in the name of Your Name which You taught the Angel of Death so that he would be able to grasp the souls,
segs.tr: WA AS'ALUKA BISMIKAL LADHEE A'LLAMTAHOO MALAKAL MAWTI LIQABDIL ARWAAH

segs.ar: وَاَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي كُتِبَ عَلَىٰ وَرَقِ الزَّيْتُونِ
segs.en: I beseech You in the name of Your Name which was written on the leaves of olive-trees;
segs.tr: WA AS'ALUKA BISMIKAL LADHEE KUTIBA A'LAA WARAQIZ ZAYTOON

segs.en: so, fires subdued to these leaves
after You said, “O fire! Be a comfort and peace,”
segs.tr: FAQULTA YAA NAARU KOONEE BARDAN WA SALAAMAA

segs.ar: وَاَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي كَتَبْتَهٗ عَلَىٰ سُرَادِقِ الْمَجْدِ وَالْكَرَامَةِ
segs.en: and I beseech You in the name of Your Name that You wrote on the canopies of Glory and Dignity.
segs.tr: WA AS'ALUKA BISMIKAL LADHEE KATABTAHOO A'LAA SURAADIQIL MAJDI WAL KARAAMAH

segs.en: O He Who cannot be annoyed by any beseecher
He Who cannot be influenced by any reward (that He presents)!

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ بِهٖ يُسْتَغَاثُ وَاِلَيْهِ يُلْجَاُ
segs.en: O He Whose refuge is taken and to Whom resort is made!
segs.tr: YAA MAN BIHEE YUSTAGHAATHU WA ILAYHI YULJA'

segs.en: I beseech You in the name of the Seats of Honor belonging to Your Throne,
the utmost of mercy in Your Book,
Your All-great Name,
Your All-high majesty,
and Your most high, perfect Words.
O Allah, Lord of winds and whatever they scatter far,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA RABBAR RIYAAHI WA MAA DHARAT

segs.en: Lord of the sky and whatever it covers,
the Lord of the earth and whatever it carries,
the Lord of the devils and whomever they mislead,
and the Lord of the oceans and wherever they flow.

segs.ar: وَبِحَقِّ كُلِّ حَقٍّ هُوَ عَلَيْكَ حَقٌّ
segs.en: I beseech You in the name of everything that enjoys a right with You,
segs.tr: WA BIHAQQI KULLI HAQQIN HUWA A'LAYKA HAQQ

segs.en: in the name of the favorite angels,
the angels managing the spirits, the cherubim,

segs.ar: وَالْمُسَبِّحِينَ لَكَ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَا يَفْتُرُوْنَ
segs.en: and the angels praising You night and day without showing sluggishness,
segs.tr: WAL MUSABBIHEENA LAKA BIL LAYLI WAN NAHAARI LAA YAFTUROON

segs.en: in the name of Abraham, Your intimate friend,

segs.ar: وَبِحَقِّ كُلِّ وَلِيٍّ يُنَادِيْكَ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ
segs.en: and in the name of each and every saint who calls You between Safa and Marwah
segs.tr: WA BIHAQQI KULLI WALIYYIN YUNAADEEKA BAYNAS SAFAA WAL MARWAH

segs.en: and You respond to his/her prayer.

segs.ar: يَا مُجِيْبُ اَسْاَلُكَ بِحَقِّ هٰذِهِ الْاَسْمَاءِ وَبِهٰذِهِ الدَّعَوَاتِ
segs.en: O Responsive Lord! I beseech You in the name of all these names and all these prayers
segs.tr: YAA MUJEEBU AS'ALUKA BIHAQQI HAADHIHIL ASMAA'I WA BIHAADHIHID DA'AWAAT

segs.ar: اَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَنَا مَا قَدَّمْنَا وَمَا اَخَّرْنَا
segs.en: to forgive us all our past and coming sins,
segs.tr: AN TAGHFIRA LANAA MAA QADDAMNAA WA MAA AKHKHARNAA

segs.en: including the secret and the open,
segs.tr: WA MAA ASRARNAA WA MAA A'LANNAA

segs.en: the hidden and the public,
segs.tr: WA MAA ABDAYNAA WA MAA AKHFAYNAA

segs.en: and those whom You know better than we do.
segs.tr: WA MAA ANTA A'LAMU BIHEE MINNAA

segs.en: Verily, You have power over all things.
[Respond] in the name of Your mercy, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.
O He Who guards all strangers!
O He Who brings entertainment to all lonely ones!
O He Who is the power of all the weak!
O He Who is the support of all the persecuted!
O He Who bestows upon all the deprived!
O He Who brings entertainment to all the lonesome!
O He Who is the company of all those on journeys!
O He Who is the pillar of all the present!
O He Who forgives all sins and offenses!
segs.tr: YAA GHAAFIRA KULLI DHANBIN WA KHATEE'AH

segs.en: O He Who is the aid of all those begging aid!
O He Who is the relief of all those pleading for relief!
O He Who relieves the calamity of those inflicted with calamities!
O He Who alleviate the distress of the distressed ones!
O He Who is the Originator of the heavens and the layers of the earth!
O He Who is the utmost hope of the seekers!
O He Who responds to the prayers of the troubled!
O He Who is the most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
O Lord of the worlds!
O Master of the Judgment Day!
O most Magnanimous of all those who act magnanimously!
O most Generous of all those who act generously!
O most Hearing of all those who can hear!
O most Seeing of all those who can see!
O most Powerful of all those who have power!

segs.ar: اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُغَيِّرُ النِّعَمَ
segs.en: (Please) forgive my sins that change the bounties
segs.tr: IGHFIR LIYADH DHUNOOBAL LATEE TUGHAYYIRUN NI'AM

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُوْرِثُ النَّدَمَ
segs.en: And forgive me my sins that bring about remorse,
segs.tr: WAGHFIR LIYADH DHUNOOBAL LATEE TOORITHUN NADAM

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُوْرِثُ السَّقَمَ
segs.en: forgive me my sins that result in ailment,
segs.tr: WAGHFIR LIYADH DHUNOOBAL LATEE TOORITHUS SAQAM

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَهْتِكُ الْعِصَمَ
segs.en: forgive me my sins that tear safeguards,
segs.tr: WAGHFIR LIYADH DHUNOOBAL LATEE TAHTIKUL I'SAM

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَرُدُّ الدُّعَاءَ
segs.en: forgive me my sins that repel prayers,
segs.tr: WAGHFIR LIYADH DHUNOOBAL LATEE TARUDDUD DU'AA'

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَحْبِسُ قَطْرَ السَّمَاءِ
segs.en: forgive me my sins that withhold the drops of the sky,
segs.tr: WAGHFIR LIYADH DHUNOOBAL LATEE TAHBISU QATRAS SAMAA'

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُعَجِّلُ الْفَنَاءَ
segs.en: forgive me my sins that hasten extinction,
segs.tr: WAGHFIR LIYADH DHUNOOBAL LATEE TU'AJJILUL FANAA'

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَجْلِبُ الشَّقَاءَ
segs.en: forgive me my sins that beget misery,
segs.tr: WAGHFIR LIYADH DHUNOOBAL LATEE TAJLIBUSH SHAQAA'

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُظْلِمُ الْهَوَاءَ
segs.en: forgive me my sins that darken the atmospheres,
segs.tr: WAGHFIR LIYADH DHUNOOBAL LATEE TUZLIMUL HAWAA'

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَكْشِفُ الْغِطَاءَ
segs.en: forgive me my sins that disclose the coverings,
segs.tr: WAGHFIR LIYADH DHUNOOBAL LATEE TAKSHIFUL GHITAA'

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي لَا يَغْفِرُهَا غَيْرُكَ يَا اَللّٰهُ
segs.en: forgive me my sins that none can forgive save You, O Allah,
segs.tr: WAGHFIR LIYADH DHUNOOBAL LATEE LAA YAGHFIRUHAA GHAYRUKA YAA ALLAAH

segs.ar: وَاحْمِلْ عَنِّيْ كُلَّ تَبِعَةٍ لِاَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segs.en: bear from me every offensive that I have made against any of Your creatures,
segs.tr: WAHMIL A'NNEE KULLA TABI'ATIN LI-AHADIN MIN KHALQIK

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ لِيْ مِنْ اَمْرِيْ فَرَجاً وَمَخْرَجاً وَيُسْراً
segs.en: make all my affairs reach at relief, exit, and easiness,
segs.tr: WAJ'AL LEE MIN AMREE FARAJAN WA MAKHRAJAN WA YUSRAA

segs.en: make Your tranquility ascend on my chest,

segs.ar: وَرَجَاءَكَ فِيْ قَلْبِيْ حَتَّىٰ لَا اَرْجُوَ غَيْرَكَ
segs.en: and make hope in You ascend on my heart so that I shall never hope for anyone save You.
segs.tr: WA RAJAA'AKA FEE QALBEE HATTAA LAA ARJUWA GHAYRAK

segs.en: O Allah, (please) safeguard me, heal me in all my situations,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAH FAZNEE WA A'AFINEE FEE MAQAAMEE

segs.en: be my companion at nights and days,
be ahead of me, behind me,
segs.tr: WA MIN BAYNI YADAYYA WA MIN KHALFEE

segs.en: from my right side, from my left side,
segs.tr: WA A'N YAMEENEE WA A'N SHIMAALEE

segs.en: from above me, and from beneath me,
segs.tr: WA MIN FAWQEE WA MIN TAHTEE

segs.en: make easy all the ways for me,
make excellent facilitation for me,
do not disappoint me in hardships,
guide me, O Best of all guides,

segs.ar: وَلَا تَكِلْنِيْ اِلَى نَفْسِيْ فِيْ الْاُمُورِ
segs.en: do not leave me alone in all my affairs,
segs.tr: WA LAA TAKILNEE ILAA NAFSEE FIL UMOOR

segs.en: make me receive all pleasures,
and make me return to my family with prosperity, success,
segs.tr: WAQLIBNEE ILAA AHLEE BIL FALAAHI WAN NAJAAH

segs.en: and gladness in the present and in the future.
Verily, You have power over all things.
(Please) bestow upon me with Your favors,
expand for me the most favorable of Your sustenance,
segs.tr: WA AWSI' A'LAYYA MIN TAYYIBAATI RIZQIK

segs.en: apply me to the obedience to You,
redeem me from Your chastisement and Fire,
segs.tr: WA AJIRNEE MIN A'DHAABIKA WA NAARIK

segs.ar: وَاقْلِبْنِي اِذَا تَوَفَّيْتَنِيْۤ اِلَىٰ جَنَّتِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ
segs.en: and when You grasp my soul, lead me to Your Paradise, by Your mercy.
segs.tr: WAQLIBNEE IDHAA TAWAFFAYTANEE ILAA JANNATIKA BIRAHMATIK

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّي اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ
segs.en: O Allah, I seek Your protection against confiscation of Your graces,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE A'OODHU BIKA MIN ZAWAALI NI'MATIK

segs.en: against alternation of Your conferral of wellbeing on me,
against the befalling of Your punishment,
and against the ensuing of Your chastisement.
I seek Your protection against arduous hardships,
segs.tr: WA A'OODHU BIKA MIN JAHDIL BALAA'

segs.en: against coming about of misery,
against evil end results,
against my enemies’ gloating over my grief,

segs.ar: وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ
segs.en: against the evil of everything that ascends from the heavens,
segs.tr: WA MIN SHARRI MAA YANZILU MINAS SAMAA'

segs.ar: وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيْ الْكِتَابِ الْمُنْزَلِ
segs.en: and against the evils mentioned in the Revealed Book.
segs.tr: WA MIN SHARRI MAA FIL KITAABIL MUNZAL

segs.en: O Allah, (please) do not include me with the evil ones,
do not include me with the people of Hellfire,
do not deprive me of the companionship of the upright people,
grant me a pleasant lifetime,
decide for me a kind of death due to which You will join me to the Pious Ones,
segs.tr: WA TAWAFFANEE WAFAATAN TAYYIBATAN TULHIQUNEE BIL ABRAAR

segs.en: and confer upon me with the companionship of the Prophets

segs.ar: فِيْ مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ مَلِيْكٍ مُقْتَدِرٍ
segs.en: in the seat of honesty with the All-powerful King.
segs.tr: FEE MAQ'ADI SIDQIN I'NDA MALEEKIN MUQTADIR

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَىٰ حُسْنِ بَلَائِكَ وَصُنْعِكَ
segs.en: O Allah, all praise be to You for Your pleasant trials and deeds to us.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDU A'LAA HUSNI BALAA'IKA WA SUN'IK

segs.ar: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَىٰ الْاِسْلَامِ وَاتِّبَاعِ السُّنَّةِ
segs.en: All praise be to You for my being Muslim and for my following the Prophet’s traditions.
segs.tr: WA LAKAL HAMDU A'LAL ISLAAMI WATTIBAA'IS SUNNAH

segs.en: O my Lord, as You have guided them (i.e. the pious)
and taught them Your Book, (please) guide us and teach us.
segs.tr: WA A'LLAMTAHUM KITAABAKA FAHDINAA WA A'LLIMNAA

segs.ar: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَىٰ حُسْنِ بَلَائِكَ وَصُنْعِكَ عِنْدِيْ خَاصَّةً
segs.en: All praise be to You for Your pleasant trials and deeds to me in private,
segs.tr: WA LAKAL HAMDU A'LAA HUSNI BALAA'IKA WA SUN'IKA I'NDEE KHAASSAH

segs.en: as You created me, gifted me an excellent form,
taught me, gifted me excellent erudition,
guided me, and gifted me excellent guidance.

segs.ar: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَىٰ اِنْعَامِكَ عَلَيَّ قَدِيْمًا وَحَدِيثاً
segs.en: So, all praise be to You for Your favors that You conferred upon me in the past and in the present.
segs.tr: FALAKAL HAMDU A'LAA IN'AAMIKA A'LAYYA QADEEMAN WA HADEETHAA

segs.ar: فَكَمْ مِنْ كَرْبٍ يَا سَيِّدِيْ قَدْ فَرَّجْتَهٗ
segs.en: Too many are the agonies that You, my Master, relieved.
segs.tr: FAKAM MIN KARBIN YAA SAYYIDEE QAD FARRAJTAH

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ غَمٍّ يَا سَيِّدِيْ قَدْ نَفَّسْتَهٗ
segs.en: Too many are the distresses that You, my Master, eased.
segs.tr: WA KAM MIN GHAMMIN YAA SAYYIDEE QAD NAFFASTAH

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ هَمٍّ يَا سَيِّدِيْ قَدْ كَشَفْتَهٗ
segs.en: Too many are the sufferings that You, my Master, alleviated.
segs.tr: WA KAM MIN HAMMIN YAA SAYYIDEE QAD KASHAFTAH

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ بَلَاءٍ يَا سَيِّدِيْ قَدْ صَرَفْتَهٗ
segs.en: Too many are the hardships from which You, my Master, saved me.
segs.tr: WA KAM MIN BALAA'IN YAA SAYYIDEE QAD SARAFTAH

segs.ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ عَيْبٍ يَا سَيِّدِيْ قَدْ سَتَرْتَهٗ
segs.en: Too many are the defects that You, my Master, covered.
segs.tr: WA KAM MIN A'YBIN YAA SAYYIDEE QAD SATARTAH

segs.en: So, all praise be to You for all conditions,
in every place and time,
every circumstance and situation,
and for the current condition and all conditions.
segs.tr: WA A'LAA HAADHIHIL HAALI WA KULLI HAAL

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِيْ مِنْ اَفْضَلِ عِبَادِكَ نَصِيْبًا
segs.en: O Allah, (please) shower upon me the best share of every good thing
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAJ A'LNEE MIN AFDALI I'BAADIKA NASEEBAA

segs.ar: فِيْ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ مِنْ خَيْرٍ تَقْسِمُهٗ
segs.en: that You decide for Your servants on this day,
segs.tr: FEE HAADHAL YAWMI MIN KHAYRIN TAQSIMUH

segs.en: such as harm that You decide to hold off,
evil that You decide to ward off,
ordeal that You decide to deter,
grace that You decide to grant,
item of mercy that You decide to distribute,
and item of wellbeing that You decide to cover up (on one of Your servants),
for You verily have power over all things,
in Your hands lie the hoards of the heavens and the earth,
segs.tr: WA BIYADIKA KHAZAA'INUS SAMAAWAATI WAL ARD

segs.en: You are verily the One, the All-generous, and the Best Bestower,
You are the One Whose beseechers are not rejected,
and You are the One Who never disappoint those who put hope in Him,
the One Who is never influenced by the rewards that He bestows upon anyone,
and the One Whose possessions never run out;
rather, You always increase in quantity, excellent gift,
conferrals, and magnanimity.

segs.ar: وَارْزُقْنِي مِنْ خَزَائِنِكَ الَّتِي لَا تَفْنَىٰ
segs.en: (Please) bestow upon me from Your hoards that never come to an end
segs.tr: WARZUQNEE MIN KHAZAA'INIKAL LATEE LAA TAFNAA

segs.en: and from Your expansive mercy.
Your conferral shall never be confined
and You have power over all things;
segs.tr: WA ANTA A'LAA KULLI SHAY'IN QADEER

segs.en: in the name of Your mercy; O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.

segs.note: Dua Ya Da'im al-Fadl
segs.ur: دعا یا دائم الفضل

segs.note: On Friday night (and the nights of Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha), recite 10 times:
segs.ur: جمعہ کی رات (اور عید الفطر اور عید الاضحی کی راتوں) میں 10 مرتبہ پڑھیں:

segs.en: O He Who is ever-Favorer on the beings!
O He Who is openhandedly Bestower of gifts!
O He Who is the Giver of sublime donations!
Bless Muhammad and his Household,
the best of all creatures in traits,
and forgive us, O Lord of Highness,
at this evening.

segs.note: Between Fajr Nafilah and Fajr Prayer
segs.ur: نافلۂ فجر اور نمازِ فجر کے درمیان

segs.note: Between the nafilah and the obligatory Fajr prayer, recite 100 times:
segs.ur: نافلہ اور فجر کی واجب نماز کے درمیان 100 مرتبہ پڑھیں:

segs.en: All glory be to Allah, the All-great and with the Praising of Him;
I pray the forgiveness of Allah, my Lord, and I turn repentant to Him.

segs.note: Dua Before Dawn on Friday
segs.ur: جمعہ کے فجر سے پہلے کی دعا

segs.note: Just before dawn (Fajr) on Friday night, recite:
segs.ur: جمعہ کی رات فجر سے ذرا پہلے پڑھیں:

segs.en: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and his Household,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.en: grant me Your satisfaction this very early morning,
place fear of You in my heart,
and separate it from (leaning to) anyone other than You,

segs.ar: حَتَّىٰ لَا اَرْجُوَ وَلَا اَخَافَ اِلَّا اِيَّاكَ
segs.en: so that I will hope for and fear none save You.
segs.tr: HATTAA LAA ARJUWA WA LAA AKHAAFA ILLAA IYYAAK

segs.en: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and his Household
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH

segs.en: and grant me resolute faith,
pure sincerity (to You),
honorable belief in (Your) oneness,
persistent straightness,
essential tolerance,
and satisfaction with (Your) predetermination and decrees.
segs.tr: WAR RIDAA BIL QADAA'I WAL QADAR

segs.en: O He Who settles the needs of His beseechers;

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِيْ ضَمِيْرِ الصَّامِتِينَ
segs.en: O He Who knows what is in the innermost of the silent;
segs.tr: YAA MAN YA'LAMU MAA FEE DAMEERIS SAAMITEEN

segs.en: send blessings to Muhammad and his Household,
respond to my prayers,
forgive my sins,
expand my means of livelihood,
and settle the needs of myself
and my brethren-in-faith and my family members.
segs.tr: WA IKHWAANEE FEE DEENEE WA AHLEE

segs.ar: اِلٰهِي طُمُوْحُ الْاٰمَالِ قَدْ خَابَتْ اِلَّا لَدَيْكَ
segs.en: O Allah, all ambitions of expectations are disappointed except those addressed to You,
segs.tr: ILAAHEE TUMOOHUL AAMAALI QAD KHAABAT ILLAA LADAYK

segs.ar: وَمَعَاكِفُ الْهِمَمِ قَدْ تَعَطَّلَتْ اِلَّا عَلَيْكَ
segs.en: all resolute determinations are paralyzed except those relied upon You,
segs.tr: WA MA'AAKIFUL HIMAMI QAD TA'ATTALAT ILLAA A'LAYK

segs.ar: وَمَذَاهِبُ الْعُقُولِ قَدْ سَمَتْ اِلَّا اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: and all reason-based tendencies are wasted except those directed to You.
segs.tr: WA MADHAAHIBUL U'QOOLI QAD SAMAT ILLAA ILAYK

segs.en: So, You are the ultimate hope and to You is the resort.
O He Who is the noblest objective and the most magnanimous desired,
segs.tr: YAA AKRAMA MAQSOODIN WA AJWADA MAS'OOL

segs.en: I am fleeing to You from myself.
O shelter of those who flee overburdened with the heavy loads of sins,
carrying my sins on my back,
I cannot find any interceder for me

segs.ar: سِوَىٰ مَعْرِفَتِيْ بِاَنَّكَ اَقْرَبُ مَنْ رَجَاهُ الطَّالِبُونَ
segs.en: except that I know for sure that You are the nearest of all those who are hoped by beseechers
segs.tr: SIWAA MA'RIFATEE BI-ANNAKA AQRABU MAN RAJAAHUT TAALIBOON

segs.en: and of all those whose donations are expected by the desirous.
O He Who has split the intellects on the recognition of Him,
made tongues articulate with the praising of Him

segs.ar: وَجَعَلَ مَا امْتَنَّ بِهٖ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهٖ فِي كِفَاءٍ لِتَاْدِيَةِ حَقِّهٖ
segs.en: and made that which He has conferred upon His servants enough means for the fulfillment of their duties towards Him;
segs.tr: WA JA'ALA MAM TANNA BIHEE A'LAA I'BAADIHEE FEE KIFAA'IN LITA'DIYATI HAQQIH

segs.en: (please) send blessings to Muhammad and his Household,

segs.ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ لِّلشَّيْطَانِ عَلَىٰ عَقْلِيْ سَبِيْلًا
segs.en: do not give Satan any way (of success) over my reason,
segs.tr: WA LAA TAJ'AL LISH SHAYTAANI A'LAA A'QLEE SABEELAA

segs.en: and do not give wrongness a way to reach my deeds.
segs.tr: WA LAA LIL BAATILI A'LAA A'MALEE DALEELAA

segs.note: Prayer of Imam al-Mahdi (a.t.f.s.)
segs.ur: امام مہدی (عج) کی نماز

segs.note: For an urgent request, bathe after midnight on Friday night, go to your place of prayer and pray 2 units. In the first unit, recite Surah al-Fatihah, and when you reach this verse repeat it 100 times:
segs.ur: فوری درخواست کے لیے جمعہ کی رات آدھی رات کے بعد غسل کریں، اپنی نماز کی جگہ جائیں اور دو رکعت نماز پڑھیں۔ پہلی رکعت میں [سورہ فاتحہ](A5) پڑھیں، اور جب اس آیت پر پہنچیں تو اسے 100 مرتبہ دہرائیں:

segs.en: You alone do we worship, and You alone do we ask for help.

segs.note: Complete the surah and recite Surah al-Tawhid once. In the ruku' of each unit, repeat 7 times:
segs.ur: سورت مکمل کریں اور [سورہ توحید](A116) ایک مرتبہ پڑھیں۔ ہر رکعت کے رکوع میں 7 مرتبہ دہرائیں:

segs.en: Glory be to my Lord, the Great, and praise belongs to Him.

segs.note: In each of the two prostrations of each unit, repeat 7 times:
segs.ur: ہر رکعت کے دونوں سجدوں میں سے ہر ایک میں 7 مرتبہ دہرائیں:

segs.en: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High, and praise belongs to Him.

segs.note: After the prayer, recite this supplication:
segs.ur: نماز کے بعد یہ دعا پڑھیں:

segs.en: O Allah, if I obey You, then praise is due to You,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA IN ATA'TUKA FAL MAHMADATU LAK

segs.en: and if I disobey You, then the argument is Yours.
segs.tr: WA IN A'SAYTUKA FAL HUJJATU LAK

segs.en: From You comes ease, and from You comes relief.
Glory be to Him Who bestows favor and is grateful!
Glory be to Him Who decrees and forgives!
O Allah, if I have disobeyed You,

segs.ar: فَاِنِّي قَدْ اَطَعْتُكَ فِي اَحَبِّ الْاَشْيَاءِ اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: I have obeyed You in the thing most beloved to You,
segs.tr: FA-INNEE QAD ATA'TUKA FEE AHABBIL ASHYAA'I ILAYK

segs.en: which is faith in You.
I have not taken a son for You,
nor have I called on any partner besides You;
this is Your favor upon me,
not my favor upon You.

segs.ar: وَقَدْ عَصَيْتُكَ يَا اِلٰهِي عَلَى غَيْرِ وَجْهِ الْمُكَابَرَةِ
segs.en: I have disobeyed You, my God, not out of arrogance,
segs.tr: WA QAD A'SAYTUKA YAA ILAAHEE A'LAA GHAYRI WAJHIL MUKAABARAH

segs.en: nor to depart from servitude to You,
nor to deny Your Lordship;
rather, I followed my desires,
and Satan made me slip.
So Yours is the argument against me, and the clear proof.
If You punish me, it is for my sins, and You do not wrong me;

segs.ar: وَاِنْ تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي فَاِنَّكَ جَوَادٌ كَرِيمٌ
segs.en: and if You forgive me and have mercy on me, then You are the Magnanimous, the Generous.
segs.tr: WA IN TAGHFIR LEE WA TARHAMNEE FA-INNAKA JAWAADUN KAREEM

segs.note: Then repeat, as long as one breath lasts:
segs.ur: پھر جب تک ایک سانس ساتھ دے دہراتے رہیں:

segs.en: O Generous! O Generous!

segs.note: Then continue:
segs.ur: پھر جاری رکھیں:

segs.en: O He Who is safe from everything,
while everything fears You and is wary of You!
segs.tr: WA KULLU SHAY'IN MINKA KHAA'IFUN HADHIR

segs.en: I ask You by Your being safe from everything
and by everything's fear of You

segs.ar: اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: to send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.en: to grant me security for myself,
my family, my property, my children
segs.tr: WA AHLEE WA MAALEE WA WALADEE

segs.en: and all the favors You have bestowed upon me,
segs.tr: WA SAA'IRI MAA AN'AMTA BIHEE A'LAYY

segs.en: so that I fear no one
and am wary of nothing, ever.
segs.tr: WA LAA AHDHARA MIN SHAY'IN ABADAA

segs.en: Verily, You have power over all things.
Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Guardian.
O He Who sufficed Abraham against Nimrod!
O He Who sufficed Moses against Pharaoh!

segs.ar: اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: AS'ALUKA AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَكْفِيَنِيْ شَرَّ فُلَانِ بْنِ فُلَانٍ
segs.en: and to spare me the evil of so-and-so, son of so-and-so.
segs.tr: WA AN TAKFIYANEE SHARRA FULAANIBNI FULAAN

segs.note: Mention by name, with his father’s name, the one whose harm you fear, and ask Almighty Allah to repel his harm and save you from his evil. Then prostrate, submit your request, and beseech Almighty Allah earnestly and sincerely.
segs.ur: جس کے نقصان کا آپ کو خوف ہو اس کا نام اس کے والد کے نام کے ساتھ لیں، اور اللہ تعالیٰ سے دعا کریں کہ وہ اس کا نقصان آپ سے دور کر دے اور اس کے شر سے آپ کو بچا لے۔ پھر سجدہ کریں، اپنی حاجت پیش کریں اور اللہ تعالیٰ کے حضور اصرار اور خلوص کے ساتھ گڑگڑائیں۔

A_P1.merits:
It has been narrated that because Friday nights are illustrious and their daytimes are brilliant, you may repeat very often the litanies of subhanallah, Allahu akbar and la ilaha illallah, and invoke Almighty Allah's blessings upon Muhammad and his Household very frequently on this night.

According to another narration, one may invoke blessings upon Muhammad and his Household at least one hundred times on Friday nights; and the more, the better. Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) is reported as saying, "To invoke Almighty Allah's blessings upon Muhammad and his Household on Friday nights is equal to winning one thousand rewards, having one thousand evildoings erased, and having one thousand ranks raised."

Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s.) said, “On Thursday afternoons, angels from the heavens descend to the lowest space carrying golden pens and silver papers on which they record nothing except the invocations of blessings upon Muhammad and his Household.”

Great reward will be the share of him who says this from Thursday afternoon up to the last hour of Friday.

Surahs of the night: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) is reported to have said that one who recites Surah al-Isra' every Friday night will join Imam al-Mahdi (a.t.f.s.) as one of his companions; that one who recites Surah al-Kahf on Friday nights will die a martyr and will be resurrected with the martyrs; and that one who recites the three Surahs beginning with Ta-Sin on Friday nights will be among the intimate servants of Almighty Allah, in His vicinity and under His protection, will never be afflicted with misery in this world, and will be given beyond his pleasure on the Day of Resurrection.

He (a.s.) is also reported to have said that one who recites Surah al-Sajdah on Friday nights will be given his Record of Deeds in his right hand, will not be called to account for his evildoings, and will be included with the companions of Muhammad and his Household (a.s.).

Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (a.s.) is authentically reported to have said that one who recites Surah Sad on Friday nights will be granted the good of this world and the Hereafter as none but the Prophets and the archangels are given, and will be admitted to Paradise together with all those of his household whom he loves, including his servants.

Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a.s.) is reported to have said that one who recites Surah al-Ahqaf on Fridays or on Friday nights will be saved by Almighty Allah from terror in this world and will be secured from the horror of the Day of Resurrection; and that one who recites Surah al-Waqi'ah on Friday nights will be loved by Almighty Allah and by all people, will be saved from all misery, poverty, need and misfortune in this world, and will be among the companions of Amir al-Mu'minin (a.s.), because this Surah belongs to him.

It has also been narrated that reciting Surah al-Jumu'ah on Friday nights is an expiation for the sins committed during the week. A similar merit has been narrated for reciting Surah al-Kahf on Friday nights, or after the Zuhr and Asr Prayers on Fridays.

Prayer of two units: It has been narrated that one who offers this prayer will be saved by Almighty Allah from the torment of the grave and the horrors of the Day of Resurrection.

Poetry: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a.s.) is authentically reported to have said that it is disliked to recite poetry for one who is fasting, for one in the state of ihram, and on Fridays and Friday nights; when asked whether this applies to religiously acceptable poetry too, the Imam (a.s.) answered that it does. It has also been authentically narrated from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) said, "One who recites even one verse of poetry on a Friday or a Friday night will have no share of reward on it except for that poetry." According to another narration, the prayers of those who recite poetry on Fridays will not be accepted.

Praying for believers: According to a hadith, one who prays for ten deceased believers will certainly be admitted to Paradise.

Pomegranate: It has been narrated that eating a pomegranate before sleeping brings security until the morning.

Last prostration of the Isha nafilah: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a.s.) is authentically reported as saying that one who says the following dua seven times in the last prostration of the supererogatory (nafilah) prayer of Isha on Friday nights will have all his sins forgiven as soon as he finishes that prayer.

Dua Allahumma Anta Rabbi: The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) is reported to have said that one who repeats the following supplication seven times on a Friday night will be admitted to Paradise if he dies that night, and one who repeats it seven times on Friday will be admitted to Paradise if he dies that day.

Dua Allahumma Man Ta'abba'a: Shaykh al-Tusi, Sayyid Ibn Tawus, al-Kaf'ami and Sayyid Ibn Baqi have recorded that it is recommended to say the following supplication on Fridays and Friday nights, and on the day and night of Arafah (the ninth of Dhul Hijjah). It is cited here as given in Shaykh al-Tusi's al-Misbah.

Dua Ya Shahida Kulli Najwa: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.), narrating from the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.), said that Almighty Allah will forgive one who says this prayer on the night of Arafah or on Friday nights.

Between the Fajr nafilah and the Fajr prayer: Eleventh: In his book al-'Arus, Shaykh Ja'far ibn Ahmad al-Qummi has recorded that Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) said that one who repeats this one hundred times between the supererogatory (nafilah) and obligatory prayers of Fajr will be given a house in Paradise by Almighty Allah:

Dua before dawn: Shaykh al-Tusi, Sayyid Ibn Tawus and others have mentioned this supplication, recommended on Friday nights just before dawn (Fajr).

Prayer of Imam al-Mahdi: Quoting the book Kunuz al-Najah by Shaykh al-Tabrisi, the author of al-Najm al-Thaqib mentions this statement from the Holy Region (i.e. Imam al-Mahdi, a.t.f.s.).

If he says this supplication after the prayer, Almighty Allah will certainly grant his request, unless it involves cutting off relations with his relatives.

Almighty Allah will certainly repel the harm, if He wills.

If any believing man or woman offers this prayer and says this supplication, the doors of the heavens will be opened for them, their requests will be granted, and their prayer will be answered at once, whatever it may be. This is one of the favors of Almighty Allah upon us and upon the people.

Radi al-Din Hasan ibn al-Fadl, the son of Shaykh al-Tabrisi, has also reported this prayer in Makarim al-Akhlaq with small differences in the supplication: he adds qad (surely) after kuntu, ahadan (anyone) after akhafa, and as'aluka (I beseech You) after fir'awna.

All praises are due to Allah, the Lord of the Universe. Our salutations and blessings upon His last prophet and messenger, Hazrat Mohammed (s.a.w.a.) and his purified Ahle Bait (a.s.) through whom Allah guided mankind.
Allah, the Mighty invites us to Dua in the Quran through the verse, “And your Lord says, call upon Me, I will answer you; surely those that are too proud for My service shall soon enter Hell abused.”
At another place, Allah, the Mighty says, “And when My servants ask you, concerning Me, then surely I am very near. I answer the prayer of the supplicant when he calls on Me.”
These verses highlight two aspects. Firstly, Allah commands us to invoke Him through supplications. Secondly He has made it incumbent upon Himself to respond to that invocation.
When it comes to the matter of supplication one can “communicate” with Allah in his own language and his own words. However, it is better to turn to Allah through the words of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) and the Infallible Imams (a.s.).
Supplication is an integral part of the teachings of the Holy Prophet of Islam (s.a.w.a.) and the Ahle Bait (a.s.). Apart from the treasure of traditions, the Shiite school of thought is blessed by a rich trove of supplications from Ahle Bait (a.s.). These supplications, in themselves, are a guide to the fundamentals of faith (Usoole Deen) and the acts of faiths (Furue Deen). Through their supplications, the Ahle Bait (a.s.) taught us the true meaning of unity of Allah, the importance and position of Prophets and Imams, and instilled in us fear and hope for the day of Judgment.
